10dc7a73f85f3703b8b9b72ed4e9ea171d3a6462.result: Wavelet-coupled ensemble models forecast SPI more accurately than the stand-alone models, with the bootstrap and boosting variants giving the best skill; exact scores are not reproduced here.
10dc7a73f85f3703b8b9b72ed4e9ea171d3a6462.open_work: Testing at longer lead times and in other climates, and adding predictors beyond past SPI such as climate indices.
10dc7a73f85f3703b8b9b72ed4e9ea171d3a6462.issues: Single basin with short gauge records; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if not applied causally; results depend on SPI aggregation scale.

7c658e18ae5f9e36e7d9b298badc86b8dc88083c.goal: Compares how well process-based crop models, regression and machine learning reproduce the mean, variability and extremes of US maize yield, and uses the best method to project climate impacts.
7c658e18ae5f9e36e7d9b298badc86b8dc88083c.architecture: Inter-comparison of process-based crop models, a traditional regression model and a machine-learning algorithm; the specific ML algorithm family is not specified in the abstract.
7c658e18ae5f9e36e7d9b298badc86b8dc88083c.data: Observed US county-level maize yields and climate predictors; harmonized process-based crop model simulations; climate projections for 1.5 °C and 2 °C global warming scenarios.
7c658e18ae5f9e36e7d9b298badc86b8dc88083c.result: Machine learning explains 93% of national yield variability versus 51% for regression and 42% for process-based models, and projects a 13.5% maize yield loss under 2 °C warming.
7c658e18ae5f9e36e7d9b298badc86b8dc88083c.open_work: Extending the probabilistic risk analysis to more crops, regions and scenarios, and adding adaptation and management effects.
7c658e18ae5f9e36e7d9b298badc86b8dc88083c.issues: Statistical models extrapolate to warmer climates outside the training range and lack CO2 fertilization and adaptation processes; ML method details are not given in the abstract.

2b848436cb36954ac84706d5b15638246fd80fea.goal: Maps agricultural drought hazard in south-east Queensland by identifying the hydro-environmental drivers of drought occurrence, to support drought management and adaptation planning.
2b848436cb36954ac84706d5b15638246fd80fea.architecture: Comparison of classification and regression trees, boosted regression trees, random forest, multivariate adaptive regression splines, flexible discriminant analysis and support vector machines.
2b848436cb36954ac84706d5b15638246fd80fea.data: Relative departure of soil moisture for eight severe droughts in south-east Queensland, 1994–2013, as the drought inventory, with eight hydro-environmental predictors such as soil water capacity, rainfall and clay content.
2b848436cb36954ac84706d5b15638246fd80fea.result: Random forest performs best (AUC-ROC 97.7%, TSS 0.873) and FDA worst (AUC-ROC 73.9%); about 21.2% of the area falls in high or very high drought hazard classes.
2b848436cb36954ac84706d5b15638246fd80fea.open_work: Applying the mapping to other drought-prone regions and incorporating dynamic climate predictors for time-varying hazard assessment.
2b848436cb36954ac84706d5b15638246fd80fea.issues: Static hazard map rather than a forecast; few drought events; spatially autocorrelated samples may inflate validation scores.

41527711c9395038c9dc39a6bed9033082993123.goal: Forecasts daily groundwater levels in an irrigated agricultural aquifer to support groundwater management and irrigation planning.
41527711c9395038c9dc39a6bed9033082993123.architecture: Nonlinear autoregressive network with exogenous inputs (NARX), a recurrent neural network that uses past groundwater levels and exogenous drivers such as precipitation.
41527711c9395038c9dc39a6bed9033082993123.data: Daily groundwater level records from monitoring wells in the Mississippi River Valley alluvial aquifer with precipitation inputs; exact wells and periods are not given here.
41527711c9395038c9dc39a6bed9033082993123.result: NARX models give accurate short-term daily groundwater level forecasts at the studied wells; specific error values are not reproduced here.
41527711c9395038c9dc39a6bed9033082993123.open_work: Adding pumping and irrigation data, longer horizons and regional multi-well models.
41527711c9395038c9dc39a6bed9033082993123.issues: Few wells and site-specific training; limited exogenous inputs; performance under unusual pumping or drought conditions is uncertain.

41dc8080372075d3f29df7fb43bf326bbf9900d1.goal: Forecasts tropical cyclone (typhoon) formation, which is hard to anticipate with conventional approaches, by learning spatio-temporal precursor patterns.
41dc8080372075d3f29df7fb43bf326bbf9900d1.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM model: a convolutional neural network extracts spatial features and a long short-term memory network models their temporal evolution.
41dc8080372075d3f29df7fb43bf326bbf9900d1.data: Not reported here; the abstract is unavailable and the gridded atmospheric and oceanic inputs are not specified.
41dc8080372075d3f29df7fb43bf326bbf9900d1.result: The title indicates the hybrid model is proposed for typhoon formation forecasting; quantitative skill is not available.
41dc8080372075d3f29df7fb43bf326bbf9900d1.open_work: Longer lead times, other ocean basins and comparison with dynamical genesis forecasts.
41dc8080372075d3f29df7fb43bf326bbf9900d1.issues: Genesis events are rare, so class imbalance and few positive examples limit evaluation; details unknown without the abstract.

3536a7cd6737e381b8e310cf3b5b15be9e2f8551.goal: Predicts hurricane trajectories at 6-hour intervals to reduce economic losses and save lives, given the nonlinearity of weather data.
3536a7cd6737e381b8e310cf3b5b15be9e2f8551.architecture: Fully connected recurrent neural network (RNN) applied over a fine spatial grid to reduce truncation errors.
3536a7cd6737e381b8e310cf3b5b15be9e2f8551.data: National Hurricane Center (NHC) best-track data: latitude, longitude, wind speed and pressure at 6-hour intervals.
3536a7cd6737e381b8e310cf3b5b15be9e2f8551.result: The RNN is reported as competitive with methods used by the NHC and predicts hurricane paths up to about 120 hours ahead.
3536a7cd6737e381b8e310cf3b5b15be9e2f8551.open_work: Adding environmental steering fields and satellite data, and quantifying track uncertainty.
3536a7cd6737e381b8e310cf3b5b15be9e2f8551.issues: Uses only track and intensity history without atmospheric fields; competitiveness with NHC is not quantified in the abstract; no probabilistic output.

2eea713f8325d37566566e5e86f4c5bcaf4a12f6.goal: Prevents quantile crossing and overfitting in nonlinear quantile regression, which produce nonphysical results such as a 10-year rainstorm exceeding a 20-year storm.
2eea713f8325d37566566e5e86f4c5bcaf4a12f6.architecture: Monotone composite quantile regression neural network (MCQRNN), an MLP estimating multiple non-crossing quantiles with optional monotonicity, non-negativity and additive constraints.
2eea713f8325d37566566e5e86f4c5bcaf4a12f6.data: Monte Carlo synthetic data from multiple functions and error distributions; annual maximum rainfall intensities at Canadian stations for Intensity–Duration–Frequency curves.
2eea713f8325d37566566e5e86f4c5bcaf4a12f6.result: MCQRNN outperforms benchmark models, especially for non-normal errors, and gives more robust and realistic IDF curve estimates than standard QRNN.
2eea713f8325d37566566e5e86f4c5bcaf4a12f6.open_work: Applying the constrained framework to other environmental extremes and to spatial or nonstationary IDF estimation.
2eea713f8325d37566566e5e86f4c5bcaf4a12f6.issues: Small to moderate samples of annual maxima limit extreme-quantile reliability; station-based application without spatial pooling.

fe38f3a2c85eb361ae6e2e33096c632df7a5ef0a.goal: Predicts typhoon tracks directly from satellite imagery, aiming to anticipate the future typhoon centre and cloud structure.
fe38f3a2c85eb361ae6e2e33096c632df7a5ef0a.architecture: Generative adversarial network (GAN) that generates a 6-hour-ahead typhoon image from time series of satellite images, optionally with velocity fields.
fe38f3a2c85eb361ae6e2e33096c632df7a5ef0a.data: Time series of satellite images of past typhoons affecting the Korean Peninsula; tested on 10 typhoons not used in training.
fe38f3a2c85eb361ae6e2e33096c632df7a5ef0a.result: Mean centre error of 95.6 km at 6 hours for 10 test typhoons; adding velocity fields significantly improves prediction.
fe38f3a2c85eb361ae6e2e33096c632df7a5ef0a.open_work: Longer lead times, better handling of sudden track changes and inclusion of more atmospheric fields.
fe38f3a2c85eb361ae6e2e33096c632df7a5ef0a.issues: Only 6-hour lead time; sudden westward or northward turns are hard to predict; small test set; error larger than operational short-range track errors.

84b84232162e941326348ee0b40b7dfd5b68a0dd.goal: Builds a flood forecasting model for early warning in flood-prone Fiji, predicting a daily flood index from rainfall.
84b84232162e941326348ee0b40b7dfd5b68a0dd.architecture: Hybrid ConvLSTM combining convolutional neural network and long short-term memory, using lagged flood index plus antecedent and real-time rainfall.
84b84232162e941326348ee0b40b7dfd5b68a0dd.data: Daily rainfall records from 9 stations in flood-prone regions of Fiji used to compute the Flood Index.
84b84232162e941326348ee0b40b7dfd5b68a0dd.result: ConvLSTM beats benchmarks at 1, 3, 7 and 14 days, with RMSE 0.101–0.279 and LME 0.939–0.726, though margins over the next best model are small.
84b84232162e941326348ee0b40b7dfd5b68a0dd.open_work: Adding streamflow and other hydrological inputs and testing operational deployment.
84b84232162e941326348ee0b40b7dfd5b68a0dd.issues: Target is a rainfall-derived index rather than observed flooding; small improvements over benchmarks; station-based with no spatial convolution context.

8c871949863cea1629be2ca20670300354ebbb58.goal: Produces storm-based probabilistic hail size forecasts from convection-allowing ensembles, improving on simple proxies and physically based hail models.
8c871949863cea1629be2ca20670300354ebbb58.architecture: Machine learning on identified storm objects, including random forest and gradient boosting regression trees that predict hail occurrence and size distribution parameters.
8c871949863cea1629be2ca20670300354ebbb58.data: Storm objects from convection-allowing ensemble forecasts (CAPS Storm-Scale Ensemble Forecasts) verified against radar-derived Maximum Expected Size of Hail (MESH).
8c871949863cea1629be2ca20670300354ebbb58.result: Machine learning hail forecasts are more skilful than the physics-based HAILCAST and updraft-helicity baselines; exact scores are not reproduced here.
8c871949863cea1629be2ca20670300354ebbb58.open_work: Operational testing, calibration across seasons and model configurations, and better hail observations.
8c871949863cea1629be2ca20670300354ebbb58.issues: Radar-estimated hail size is an uncertain verification target; trained on specific ensemble configurations; limited seasons.

01370b140954fc9890701273a9b29be55dd2eb9d.goal: Tests convolutional neural networks for identifying and predicting large-scale weather regimes, using unsupervised clustering to avoid costly human labelling.
01370b140954fc9890701273a9b29be55dd2eb9d.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network (CNN) trained on labels from K-means-style unsupervised clustering, compared with logistic regression.
01370b140954fc9890701273a9b29be55dd2eb9d.data: Daily large-scale circulation patterns over North America from a fully coupled climate model (CESM Large Ensemble), clustered into 4 regimes.
01370b140954fc9890701273a9b29be55dd2eb9d.result: With at least 1000 samples per cluster accuracy exceeds 90%; with 3000 samples it reaches 94% for identification and 93–76% for 1–5 day prediction, about 25% better than logistic regression.
01370b140954fc9890701273a9b29be55dd2eb9d.open_work: Applying the auto-labelling approach to reanalysis and observations, and to other spatio-temporal climate patterns and extremes.
01370b140954fc9890701273a9b29be55dd2eb9d.issues: Trained on climate model output; only 4 coarse regimes; labels inherit clustering choices; prediction skill degrades with lead time.

1cc87983dfc1881ff5f4751edd755d69046e67a2.goal: Collects and organizes deep learning methods and applications across the Earth sciences for researchers entering the field.
1cc87983dfc1881ff5f4751edd755d69046e67a2.architecture: Review book covering deep learning approaches such as convolutional networks, recurrent networks, generative models and physics-aware learning applied to Earth system problems.
1cc87983dfc1881ff5f4751edd755d69046e67a2.data: Not applicable; surveys applications using remote sensing, reanalysis, climate model and in situ data.
1cc87983dfc1881ff5f4751edd755d69046e67a2.result: Provides an overview of deep learning for remote sensing, weather and climate, and hydrology; no single quantitative result.
1cc87983dfc1881ff5f4751edd755d69046e67a2.open_work: Interpretability, physical consistency, uncertainty quantification and causal understanding in Earth science deep learning.
1cc87983dfc1881ff5f4751edd755d69046e67a2.issues: Abstract unavailable; content inferred from the title and knowledge of the 2021 edited Wiley volume; coverage dates quickly.

d9b0af095aa61da197a053b1407da4b30c364503.goal: Improves flood forecasting in data-sparse basins by transferring knowledge learned in data-rich basins.
d9b0af095aa61da197a053b1407da4b30c364503.architecture: Transformer model pre-trained on data-rich source basins and fine-tuned on data-sparse target basins (deep transfer learning).
d9b0af095aa61da197a053b1407da4b30c364503.data: Not reported here; the abstract is unavailable, so basins, periods and inputs are not specified.
d9b0af095aa61da197a053b1407da4b30c364503.result: The title indicates transfer learning with a transformer improves flood forecasts where local data are scarce; quantitative results are not available.
d9b0af095aa61da197a053b1407da4b30c364503.open_work: Choosing source basins by hydrological similarity and testing across climates and longer lead times.
d9b0af095aa61da197a053b1407da4b30c364503.issues: Benefit depends on similarity between source and target basins; details unknown without the abstract.

9bda40c479cdf128103b29c029120dbfa3c00757.goal: Forecasts 1-hour-ahead global horizontal irradiance from sky images alone, supporting power system operations under variable solar generation.
9bda40c479cdf128103b29c029120dbfa3c00757.architecture: SolarNet, a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) with 20 convolutional, max-pooling and fully connected layers; parallel models produce each forecast step.
9bda40c479cdf128103b29c029120dbfa3c00757.data: Six years of ground-based sky images and GHI measurements; no numerical meteorological inputs or engineered features.
9bda40c479cdf128103b29c029120dbfa3c00757.result: SolarNet achieves 8.85% normalized RMSE and a 25.14% forecast skill score, outperforming persistence of cloudiness and other machine learning models across weather conditions.
9bda40c479cdf128103b29c029120dbfa3c00757.open_work: Adding numerical measurements or satellite data, probabilistic forecasting and transfer to other sites.
9bda40c479cdf128103b29c029120dbfa3c00757.issues: Single-site sky camera; deterministic output; sky images limit the horizon because clouds leave the field of view.

ba9abfa82f1843fad530d40c6ca0c4dfa36b629e.goal: Assesses long short-term memory networks for daily streamflow forecasting in a tropical river and how data choices affect performance.
ba9abfa82f1843fad530d40c6ca0c4dfa36b629e.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network compared with a classic backpropagation neural network (MLP).
ba9abfa82f1843fad530d40c6ca0c4dfa36b629e.data: Historical daily streamflow of the Kelantan River, north-east Peninsular Malaysia.
ba9abfa82f1843fad530d40c6ca0c4dfa36b629e.result: LSTM outperforms the backpropagation network, performing well in steady dry-season flows and capturing rapidly fluctuating rainy-season flows; no metrics are given in the abstract.
ba9abfa82f1843fad530d40c6ca0c4dfa36b629e.open_work: Adding meteorological inputs and testing on other basins and longer horizons.
ba9abfa82f1843fad530d40c6ca0c4dfa36b629e.issues: Single catchment; streamflow-only inputs; quantitative results not reported in the abstract.

3396333763140feff121120f1d5e4348db1d7699.goal: Predicts solar PV power output directly from sky video to support very short-term solar forecasting.
3396333763140feff121120f1d5e4348db1d7699.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) mapping sky images from video streams, with past PV output, to concurrent or near-future PV power.
3396333763140feff121120f1d5e4348db1d7699.data: Sky camera video and PV output measurements from a rooftop installation at Stanford University; exact period not given here.
3396333763140feff121120f1d5e4348db1d7699.result: The CNN estimates PV output from sky images with skill above simple baselines; exact errors are not reproduced here.
3396333763140feff121120f1d5e4348db1d7699.open_work: Extending from nowcasting to longer forecast horizons and to other sites.
3396333763140feff121120f1d5e4348db1d7699.issues: Single site; short horizon; abstract unavailable so details rely on knowledge of the paper.

f27a005c8e0979ecd59bdc9bbda62b65062f280f.goal: Makes GAN emulators of chaotic PDE-governed systems reproduce the true statistics of training data, as a route to data-driven closures for unresolved physics.
f27a005c8e0979ecd59bdc9bbda62b65062f280f.architecture: Statistically constrained generative adversarial network (GAN) with a covariance-matching penalty added to the generator loss.
f27a005c8e0979ecd59bdc9bbda62b65062f280f.data: Fully resolved numerical simulations of Rayleigh–Bénard convection, an idealized turbulent analogue of the atmosphere.
f27a005c8e0979ecd59bdc9bbda62b65062f280f.result: The constrained GAN emulates physical properties more faithfully than a standard GAN and cuts training time to convergence by up to 80%.
f27a005c8e0979ecd59bdc9bbda62b65062f280f.open_work: Using constrained GANs as closures or parameterizations in multiscale models such as climate models, and adding higher-order or physical constraints.
f27a005c8e0979ecd59bdc9bbda62b65062f280f.issues: Idealized 2D convection only; constraints limited to second-order statistics; not tested coupled online in a solver.

c9bc2ec5f3c11fe86f066ff7abd75e9c20472105.goal: Shows how interpretable machine learning can advance process understanding in the geosciences, and guards against careless use.
c9bc2ec5f3c11fe86f066ff7abd75e9c20472105.architecture: Review and perspective on interpretable machine learning, including application scenarios, a practical workflow, common pitfalls and good practices.
c9bc2ec5f3c11fe86f066ff7abd75e9c20472105.data: Not applicable; draws on geoscientific examples.
c9bc2ec5f3c11fe86f066ff7abd75e9c20472105.result: Identifies scenarios such as quantifying relationships, generating mechanism hypotheses and evaluating process-based models, plus pitfalls that lead to misleading conclusions.
c9bc2ec5f3c11fe86f066ff7abd75e9c20472105.open_work: Broader yet more careful integration of interpretable ML, and linking explanations with causal inference and domain knowledge.
c9bc2ec5f3c11fe86f066ff7abd75e9c20472105.issues: Perspective without new quantitative experiments; explanations describe the model, not necessarily the physical system.

d024995b60cac391bbaddbb7ddf3df3b8e2cfa0d.goal: Forecasts groundwater table response to storms in a flood-prone coastal city, where shallow groundwater amplifies flooding under sea level rise.
d024995b60cac391bbaddbb7ddf3df3b8e2cfa0d.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) networks compared with simple recurrent neural networks (RNN).
d024995b60cac391bbaddbb7ddf3df3b8e2cfa0d.data: Observed groundwater table, rainfall and sea level in Norfolk, Virginia, 2010–2018, as continuous series or storm-only datasets; forecast rainfall and sea level for real-time tests.
d024995b60cac391bbaddbb7ddf3df3b8e2cfa0d.result: LSTM beats RNN (RMSE 0.09 m versus 0.14 m); in real-time forecasting, storm-trained models reach RMSE 0.07 m versus 0.66 m for continuous-trained models.
d024995b60cac391bbaddbb7ddf3df3b8e2cfa0d.open_work: Operational real-time deployment and coupling with coastal flood and stormwater models.
d024995b60cac391bbaddbb7ddf3df3b8e2cfa0d.issues: Few wells in one city; skill depends on quality of rainfall and sea level forecasts; continuous-series models fail with forecast inputs.

f968b3cf14facdeb6612fa361cbedd373bdab912.goal: Provides near-real-time forecasts of satellite-based surface soil moisture, using recent observations to correct a data-driven model.
f968b3cf14facdeb6612fa361cbedd373bdab912.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network with an adaptive data integration kernel that ingests the latest available SMAP observations.
f968b3cf14facdeb6612fa361cbedd373bdab912.data: SMAP Level-3 soil moisture over the contiguous United States with meteorological forcings and static attributes.
f968b3cf14facdeb6612fa361cbedd373bdab912.result: Data integration markedly reduces forecast error compared with LSTM without integration and with the land surface model; exact metrics are not reproduced here.
f968b3cf14facdeb6612fa361cbedd373bdab912.open_work: Extending to root-zone soil moisture, longer lead times and other satellite products.
f968b3cf14facdeb6612fa361cbedd373bdab912.issues: Target is SMAP retrievals, so it inherits their errors and shallow sensing depth; truncated abstract.

8c998bcb07dc0efc146d288dd3afdcc7e5407bd1.goal: Computes downstream runoff directly from two-dimensional rainfall radar maps rather than one-dimensional rainfall series.
8c998bcb07dc0efc146d288dd3afdcc7e5407bd1.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM: a convolutional neural network processes radar rainfall maps and an LSTM combines its features with upstream runoff.
8c998bcb07dc0efc146d288dd3afdcc7e5407bd1.data: Rainfall radar maps and runoff for the Elbe River basin in Saxony, Germany; high-water periods 2006, 2011, 2013 and low-water periods 2015, 2018.
8c998bcb07dc0efc146d288dd3afdcc7e5407bd1.result: With fivefold validation, NSE 0.46–0.97 and KGE 0.47–0.92 for high-water periods and NSE 0.63–0.86, KGE 0.68–0.93 for low-water periods.
8c998bcb07dc0efc146d288dd3afdcc7e5407bd1.open_work: Forecasting with predicted rather than observed rainfall and testing on other basins.
8c998bcb07dc0efc146d288dd3afdcc7e5407bd1.issues: Large spread across folds indicates sensitivity to training split; few events; relies on upstream gauge data.

70652451b8b13448437aa37cb09a2455e0fd33e0.goal: Produces multistep solar forecasts from sky images to control PV power ramp rates and smooth output.
70652451b8b13448437aa37cb09a2455e0fd33e0.architecture: Ensemble of deep convolutional neural networks (CNN) on stacked sky images, without recurrent networks or exogenous variables.
70652451b8b13448437aa37cb09a2455e0fd33e0.data: Ground-based sky images and PV power measurements; site and period are not reported in the abstract.
70652451b8b13448437aa37cb09a2455e0fd33e0.result: Highest forecast skill score of 17.7%; the forecast-based ramp-rate control reaches a 98.9% control rate with less energy curtailment.
70652451b8b13448437aa37cb09a2455e0fd33e0.open_work: Longer horizons, multi-site deployment and integration with battery storage control.
70652451b8b13448437aa37cb09a2455e0fd33e0.issues: Single-site sky camera; skill scores modest; dataset details not reported in the abstract.

4e4bae6a6e38a4fcbca958900859849c567e35fc.goal: Comments on whether deep learning changes hydrological modelling and understanding, responding to Nearing et al. (2020).
4e4bae6a6e38a4fcbca958900859849c567e35fc.architecture: Commentary and opinion on deep learning in hydrology; not an ML method paper.
4e4bae6a6e38a4fcbca958900859849c567e35fc.data: Not applicable; discusses large-sample catchment studies such as LSTM work by Kratzert et al.
4e4bae6a6e38a4fcbca958900859849c567e35fc.result: Argues that DL may outperform conceptual models by compensating for data anomalies and epistemic uncertainty, but this does not necessarily yield process understanding.
4e4bae6a6e38a4fcbca958900859849c567e35fc.open_work: Handling epistemic uncertainty in observations, the uniqueness of place and how DL can contribute to hydrological theory.
4e4bae6a6e38a4fcbca958900859849c567e35fc.issues: Opinion piece without new experiments; conservation constraints may not help where observations do not close water and energy balances.

feff50114bcfed0745706a9fd0890ea8b86cd08a.goal: Produces a joint global estimate of latent heat flux, sensible heat flux and gross primary production informed by solar-induced fluorescence.
feff50114bcfed0745706a9fd0890ea8b86cd08a.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) trained on a target dataset merged from three independent products weighted by triple collocation.
feff50114bcfed0745706a9fd0890ea8b86cd08a.data: Satellite solar-induced fluorescence (GOME-2) and other radiative and meteorological variables; 2007–2015 at 1° monthly; evaluated against FLUXNET eddy covariance towers.
feff50114bcfed0745706a9fd0890ea8b86cd08a.result: WECANN typically outperforms other products against eddy covariance, especially for sensible and latent heat, and captures droughts, heatwaves and the 2015 El Niño impact.
feff50114bcfed0745706a9fd0890ea8b86cd08a.open_work: Higher spatial and temporal resolution and newer SIF missions for longer records.
feff50114bcfed0745706a9fd0890ea8b86cd08a.issues: Target data are themselves model products, so errors propagate; coarse 1° monthly resolution; scale mismatch with flux towers.

fc543a3cfdab8c93ee2a4d819331d7c2d87f2de3.goal: Reconstructs missing sea surface temperature in cloud-affected satellite images, with error estimates.
fc543a3cfdab8c93ee2a4d819331d7c2d87f2de3.architecture: DINCAE, a convolutional auto-encoder (CNN) that takes data and its error variance as input and outputs the reconstruction and its error variance, trained by maximum likelihood.
fc543a3cfdab8c93ee2a4d819331d7c2d87f2de3.data: 25-year AVHRR sea surface temperature time series; validated by cross-validation and World Ocean Database in situ observations; compared with DINEOF.
fc543a3cfdab8c93ee2a4d819331d7c2d87f2de3.result: DINCAE has lower reconstruction error than DINEOF while preserving more variability.
fc543a3cfdab8c93ee2a4d819331d7c2d87f2de3.open_work: Multivariate inputs, other variables such as chlorophyll and better use of temporal context.
fc543a3cfdab8c93ee2a4d819331d7c2d87f2de3.issues: Regional application; error estimates assume Gaussian errors; large gaps remain hard to fill.

553291bd1d47ce8a93d3e523ae95da4245f4dc42.goal: Emulates climate model projections for arbitrary forcing scenarios cheaply, reusing existing GCM runs instead of new simulations.
553291bd1d47ce8a93d3e523ae95da4245f4dc42.architecture: Statistical emulator (not ML) that models regional temperature and precipitation as a function of past CO2 forcing trajectories, fitted to precomputed GCM runs.
553291bd1d47ce8a93d3e523ae95da4245f4dc42.data: Precomputed GCM simulations under multiple CO2 scenarios (CCSM3); regional annual temperature and precipitation.
553291bd1d47ce8a93d3e523ae95da4245f4dc42.result: The emulator reproduces GCM regional temperature and precipitation responses for scenarios not used in fitting; exact errors are not reproduced here.
553291bd1d47ce8a93d3e523ae95da4245f4dc42.open_work: Extending to other GCMs, variables, extremes and finer spatial scales.
553291bd1d47ce8a93d3e523ae95da4245f4dc42.issues: Only CO2 forcing; single model; emulates the GCM including its biases; abstract unavailable.

44ef51a457b9c747993e2009cdb71076ae47f4d2.goal: Tests whether SMAP satellite soil moisture adds value for long-term soil moisture estimation when extended beyond its lifespan with deep learning.
44ef51a457b9c747993e2009cdb71076ae47f4d2.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network trained to reproduce SMAP from forcings and attributes, combined with the Noah land surface model.
44ef51a457b9c747993e2009cdb71076ae47f4d2.data: SMAP soil moisture over the contiguous United States, meteorological forcings, Noah land surface model output, and in situ soil moisture networks for evaluation.
44ef51a457b9c747993e2009cdb71076ae47f4d2.result: LSTM extrapolates SMAP for several years with little degradation and captures root-zone interannual trends; averaging LSTM and Noah often beats Noah alone.
44ef51a457b9c747993e2009cdb71076ae47f4d2.open_work: Long-term projections and synergistic use with other model-data integration techniques.
44ef51a457b9c747993e2009cdb71076ae47f4d2.issues: Inherits SMAP limitations such as shallow sensing depth; evaluation limited by sparse in situ sites.

b3976531936e5b4c5e8db4e5d2ed60f2d254c95a.goal: Systematically reviews deep learning for statistical downscaling of gridded meteorological data to high spatial resolution.
b3976531936e5b4c5e8db4e5d2ed60f2d254c95a.architecture: Systematic review of deep learning downscaling methods such as CNN, U-Net, GAN and transformer models.
b3976531936e5b4c5e8db4e5d2ed60f2d254c95a.data: Not applicable; covers studies using reanalysis, climate model and observational gridded data.
b3976531936e5b4c5e8db4e5d2ed60f2d254c95a.result: Summarizes methods, variables, data and evaluation practices in deep learning downscaling; specific conclusions are not available without the abstract.
b3976531936e5b4c5e8db4e5d2ed60f2d254c95a.open_work: Physical consistency, extremes, transferability under climate change and standardized benchmarks.
b3976531936e5b4c5e8db4e5d2ed60f2d254c95a.issues: Abstract unavailable; content inferred from the title.

42f1eac96af7b7760823a4f5c321438e0cdda966.goal: Introduces artificial intelligence methods to environmental scientists and shows applications in weather, climate, air quality and related fields.
42f1eac96af7b7760823a4f5c321438e0cdda966.architecture: Review book covering neural networks, fuzzy logic, genetic algorithms, expert systems and other AI and statistical learning methods.
42f1eac96af7b7760823a4f5c321438e0cdda966.data: Not applicable; surveys environmental science applications.
42f1eac96af7b7760823a4f5c321438e0cdda966.result: Provides tutorial chapters and application examples of AI methods in the environmental sciences; no single quantitative result.
42f1eac96af7b7760823a4f5c321438e0cdda966.open_work: Wider adoption of AI with careful verification and integration with physical models.
42f1eac96af7b7760823a4f5c321438e0cdda966.issues: Abstract unavailable; content inferred from knowledge of the edited Springer volume; predates modern deep learning.

667cad8410d74d50ef9e6ea5ff7afebca7bb3333.goal: Predicts extreme events and anomalous statistics in turbulent dynamical systems, a grand challenge in complex natural systems.
667cad8410d74d50ef9e6ea5ff7afebca7bb3333.architecture: Densely connected mixed-scale deep convolutional neural network (CNN) trained with a relative entropy loss and empirical partition functions.
667cad8410d74d50ef9e6ea5ff7afebca7bb3333.data: Simulations of a truncated Korteweg–de Vries (tKdV) model, with training only from the near-Gaussian regime.
667cad8410d74d50ef9e6ea5ff7afebca7bb3333.result: The network shows uniformly high skill across statistical regimes, including highly skewed extreme events not seen in training.
667cad8410d74d50ef9e6ea5ff7afebca7bb3333.open_work: Applying the approach to other complicated high-dimensional systems.
667cad8410d74d50ef9e6ea5ff7afebca7bb3333.issues: Idealized 1D test model; no real-world data; generalization to other systems untested.

8e3ec2df467e0c7081c81f082d402535f5b5bf3e.goal: Explores physics-informed neural networks as an alternative to finite-difference, finite-volume or spectral solvers for the shallow-water equations on the sphere in a meteorological context.
8e3ec2df467e0c7081c81f082d402535f5b5bf3e.architecture: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) with fully connected layers, trained on the PDE residual plus initial data; boundary conditions are hard-coded in a custom layer and a sequence of networks covers successive time windows.
8e3ec2df467e0c7081c81f082d402535f5b5bf3e.data: No observational data; standard Williamson et al. (1992) shallow-water test cases on the sphere used as benchmarks.
8e3ec2df467e0c7081c81f082d402535f5b5bf3e.result: The multi-model approach of chaining several PINNs over sub-intervals makes longer integrations tractable and reproduces the main Williamson test cases.
8e3ec2df467e0c7081c81f082d402535f5b5bf3e.open_work: Reducing training cost, extending to longer integrations and more complex dynamics, and comparing accuracy and efficiency with mature numerical solvers.
8e3ec2df467e0c7081c81f082d402535f5b5bf3e.issues: PINN training is difficult and slow; idealized test cases only; no clear computational advantage over conventional spectral or finite-volume solvers is demonstrated.

810638c4f51f67bcf35a359488f38cb790f7df35.goal: Develops a fast stochastic convection parameterization for climate and NWP models by learning from cloud-resolving model output, as a proof of concept.
810638c4f51f67bcf35a359488f38cb790f7df35.architecture: Ensemble of shallow feedforward neural networks (MLPs) whose spread represents the stochastic component of the convection parameterization.
810638c4f51f67bcf35a359488f38cb790f7df35.data: Cloud-resolving model simulations forced by observed TOGA-COARE period data (November 1992–February 1993), averaged to GCM scale; tested online in NCAR CAM.
810638c4f51f67bcf35a359488f38cb790f7df35.result: The NN ensemble parameterization runs stably in CAM and gives reasonable decadal climate simulations over a large tropical Pacific region, with its inherent uncertainty quantified.
810638c4f51f67bcf35a359488f38cb790f7df35.open_work: Training on more diverse CRM data covering other regimes and seasons, and improving the parameterization's adaptation to changing model environments.
810638c4f51f67bcf35a359488f38cb790f7df35.issues: Training data cover only four months of one tropical region, so generalization to other climates is uncertain; evaluation is largely qualitative.

2a3d09e6cb6bc902ef9ea3913262f3e6fb874008.goal: Builds a physics-informed, data-driven global weather forecasting model that respects advection and conservation while providing uncertainty estimates, unlike black-box deep learning emulators.
2a3d09e6cb6bc902ef9ea3913262f3e6fb874008.architecture: Physics-informed neural ODE: a continuous-time advection model whose velocity field is learned by a neural network (convolutional and attention components), with an emission model giving probabilistic outputs.
2a3d09e6cb6bc902ef9ea3913262f3e6fb874008.data: ERA5 reanalysis at 5.625° resolution from WeatherBench, for global and regional forecasting.
2a3d09e6cb6bc902ef9ea3913262f3e6fb874008.result: Outperforms prior data-driven methods such as ClimaX and FourCastNet baselines at this resolution with an order of magnitude fewer parameters, and supplies uncertainty estimates.
2a3d09e6cb6bc902ef9ea3913262f3e6fb874008.open_work: Scaling to higher resolution and more variables, and adding further physical processes beyond advection.
2a3d09e6cb6bc902ef9ea3913262f3e6fb874008.issues: Coarse 5.625° grid and few variables limit comparison with operational and high-resolution ML models; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases.

da8da4a77b95fa73383cf0afab9278bafe8f3a6b.goal: Predicts hydrological time series in the Gilgit River basin, a high-mountain catchment in northern Pakistan, using deep learning.
da8da4a77b95fa73383cf0afab9278bafe8f3a6b.architecture: Deep learning time-series model; the network family is not specified in the available metadata.
da8da4a77b95fa73383cf0afab9278bafe8f3a6b.data: Not reported (no abstract); presumably observed hydro-meteorological records from the Gilgit River basin.
da8da4a77b95fa73383cf0afab9278bafe8f3a6b.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
da8da4a77b95fa73383cf0afab9278bafe8f3a6b.open_work: Not reported; extension to other Upper Indus sub-basins and longer lead times would follow naturally.
da8da4a77b95fa73383cf0afab9278bafe8f3a6b.issues: Single-basin case study; details of data, model and baselines could not be verified.

3af8b1e497a2cce213fe24dbdd1c8113cedaffb4.goal: Provides an open-source software library to make deep learning research in hydrology, especially rainfall-runoff modelling, easier and reproducible.
3af8b1e497a2cce213fe24dbdd1c8113cedaffb4.architecture: Software library (PyTorch) implementing deep learning models for hydrology, mainly LSTM variants (e.g. EA-LSTM, multi-timescale LSTM) plus training, evaluation and configuration tools.
3af8b1e497a2cce213fe24dbdd1c8113cedaffb4.data: Supports community datasets such as CAMELS (US and other regions) and user-supplied catchment data; not a single-experiment paper.
3af8b1e497a2cce213fe24dbdd1c8113cedaffb4.result: Describes the library design and features; it has been used in a series of published LSTM rainfall-runoff studies.
3af8b1e497a2cce213fe24dbdd1c8113cedaffb4.open_work: Adding more model types, datasets and tooling for interpretability and uncertainty.
3af8b1e497a2cce213fe24dbdd1c8113cedaffb4.issues: Software paper with no new scientific evaluation; results depend on how users configure models and data.

812e13e905bcc608f0cb087a3ceda2f2869117ac.goal: Improves GCM precipitation prediction in a monsoon region by statistical downscaling from well-resolved atmospheric dynamical fields.
812e13e905bcc608f0cb087a3ceda2f2869117ac.architecture: Deep neural network combining a convolutional neural network (CNN) and an LSTM recurrent module; compared with quantile mapping, support vector machine and a plain CNN.
812e13e905bcc608f0cb087a3ceda2f2869117ac.data: ERA-Interim reanalysis predictors and precipitation over the Xiangjiang River Basin, South China; applied to ECMWF retrospective forecasts; distributed hydrological model for evaluation.
812e13e905bcc608f0cb087a3ceda2f2869117ac.result: Outperforms ERA-Interim precipitation and benchmark downscaling at 1-day to 2-week leads (advantage declines with lead); hydrological NSE rises from 0.06 (ERA-Interim) to 0.64 vs 0.82 with observed precipitation.
812e13e905bcc608f0cb087a3ceda2f2869117ac.open_work: Applying the approach to other monsoon basins and to operational hydrological forecasting.
812e13e905bcc608f0cb087a3ceda2f2869117ac.issues: Single basin; skill depends on the GCM's dynamical forecast skill and degrades at long leads; trained against reanalysis-era observations.

4b8475e0ae22ddf56d3d061c8260fabd724aa4de.goal: Reviews how artificial neural networks have been used for drought prediction in the 21st century through a scientometric analysis of the literature.
4b8475e0ae22ddf56d3d061c8260fabd724aa4de.architecture: Review and scientometric (bibliometric) analysis of ANN-based drought prediction studies, covering trends, publication sources and methods.
4b8475e0ae22ddf56d3d061c8260fabd724aa4de.data: Literature database of published studies on ANN drought prediction; details of corpus not reported here.
4b8475e0ae22ddf56d3d061c8260fabd724aa4de.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
4b8475e0ae22ddf56d3d061c8260fabd724aa4de.open_work: Not reported; likely calls for explainable, hybrid and multi-index drought models.
4b8475e0ae22ddf56d3d061c8260fabd724aa4de.issues: No abstract available; corpus selection and coverage could not be verified.

0a4eb4e2c44f7c39c03b7faed7b69ca97b051301.goal: Estimates groundwater table levels with data-driven models and a preprocessing procedure, to support groundwater monitoring and early detection of stressed aquifers.
0a4eb4e2c44f7c39c03b7faed7b69ca97b051301.architecture: Comparison of NARX deep neural network, LSTM, GRU and a linear ARX reference model, with detrending and deseasonalization (DTDS) preprocessing.
0a4eb4e2c44f7c39c03b7faed7b69ca97b051301.data: Water table level series from the Jindo Uisin and Pohang Gibuk monitoring wells, South Korea, 2005–2014.
0a4eb4e2c44f7c39c03b7faed7b69ca97b051301.result: All models are reasonably accurate; NARX and LSTM are best with or without DTDS, and DTDS makes 2014 drought-related aquifer stress easier to detect.
0a4eb4e2c44f7c39c03b7faed7b69ca97b051301.open_work: Testing on more wells and aquifer types and using forecasts for groundwater management.
0a4eb4e2c44f7c39c03b7faed7b69ca97b051301.issues: Only two wells; quantitative metrics are not reported in the abstract; site-specific results.

d376c122e3fdd8487631684bb016d41e14c8c91f.goal: Predicts drought using the SPI and SPEI indices at several timescales.
d376c122e3fdd8487631684bb016d41e14c8c91f.architecture: LSTM recurrent neural network, as stated in the title.
d376c122e3fdd8487631684bb016d41e14c8c91f.data: Not reported (no abstract); SPI and SPEI series at varying timescales.

d376c122e3fdd8487631684bb016d41e14c8c91f.issues: No abstract; region, data period, baselines and skill could not be verified.

fc26b3804f27cd2e2d79f3f5db95ecf5c4370792.goal: Predicts short-term rainfall using a multi-task deep learning approach.
fc26b3804f27cd2e2d79f3f5db95ecf5c4370792.architecture: Multi-task convolutional neural network (CNN), as stated in the title.
fc26b3804f27cd2e2d79f3f5db95ecf5c4370792.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
fc26b3804f27cd2e2d79f3f5db95ecf5c4370792.issues: No abstract; data, region, lead times and comparisons could not be verified.

06aed7d405eef0dec8a878961a3889a7a849e4cc.goal: Nowcasts typhoon tracks with a deep learning model.
06aed7d405eef0dec8a878961a3889a7a849e4cc.architecture: LSTM neural network, as stated in the title.
06aed7d405eef0dec8a878961a3889a7a849e4cc.data: Not reported (no abstract); presumably historical typhoon best-track records.
06aed7d405eef0dec8a878961a3889a7a849e4cc.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
06aed7d405eef0dec8a878961a3889a7a849e4cc.issues: No abstract; data source, lead times and track errors could not be verified.

1b79c8d5919d30e0eded33ec592dd5c41dcb0a3a.goal: Estimates groundwater levels from physical hydrology components with neural networks, as an alternative to periodic manual well measurements.
1b79c8d5919d30e0eded33ec592dd5c41dcb0a3a.architecture: Comparison of a multilayer perceptron (MLP), an LSTM and a convolutional neural network (CNN) with four input combinations.
1b79c8d5919d30e0eded33ec592dd5c41dcb0a3a.data: Stream level, streamflow, precipitation, humidity, temperature, evapotranspiration and related variables, 2011–2015 training and 2016–2017 validation, Baltic River and Long Creek watersheds, Prince Edward Island, Canada.
1b79c8d5919d30e0eded33ec592dd5c41dcb0a3a.result: MLP performs best in validation (RMSE 0.471 and 1.15); stream level explains about half of GWL variance; more inputs reduce RMSE by 11% and 1.6%.
1b79c8d5919d30e0eded33ec592dd5c41dcb0a3a.open_work: Testing on more watersheds and extending to forecasting.
1b79c8d5919d30e0eded33ec592dd5c41dcb0a3a.issues: Two small watersheds and a short record; hyperparameters chosen by trial and error.

6d68b2ea3df30ac6cff327fe404b94e901ab806c.goal: Forecasts weekly soil moisture for environmental, agricultural and hydrological applications.
6d68b2ea3df30ac6cff327fe404b94e901ab806c.architecture: Hybrid of ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD), Boruta random forest feature selection and an extreme learning machine (ELM); compared with MARS and plain ELM.
6d68b2ea3df30ac6cff327fe404b94e901ab806c.data: Thirteen weekly hindcast predictors from the Australian Water Availability Project (AWAP) WaterDyn model at four sites in the Murray-Darling Basin.
6d68b2ea3df30ac6cff327fe404b94e901ab806c.result: The EEMD-Boruta-ELM model gives the lowest errors and best performance among compared models.
6d68b2ea3df30ac6cff327fe404b94e901ab806c.open_work: Use in near-real-time soil moisture forecasting and testing at more sites.
6d68b2ea3df30ac6cff327fe404b94e901ab806c.issues: Targets are model-derived (WaterDyn) rather than observed; EEMD on full series can leak future information if not applied carefully; few sites.

0294cca3236c7aabf05f1daaa9e88e5a0ebbd296.goal: Bridges Python deep learning tools and Fortran scientific codes so neural networks trained in Keras can be run inside climate models.
0294cca3236c7aabf05f1daaa9e88e5a0ebbd296.architecture: Software library (Fortran-Keras Bridge) supporting dense neural networks (MLPs), custom layers, losses and ensembles; case study with neural network emulators of subgrid cloud and radiation physics.
0294cca3236c7aabf05f1daaa9e88e5a0ebbd296.data: Case study uses superparameterized climate model (SPCAM) training data for subgrid physics emulation; over one hundred candidate networks coupled online.
0294cca3236c7aabf05f1daaa9e88e5a0ebbd296.result: Reveals a strong relationship between offline validation error and online stability, with the optimizer choice unexpectedly critical, and finds networks with better stability.
0294cca3236c7aabf05f1daaa9e88e5a0ebbd296.open_work: Broader online testing of NN parameterizations and extension of the bridge to more layer types.
0294cca3236c7aabf05f1daaa9e88e5a0ebbd296.issues: Case study limited to one climate model setup; stability results depend on a specific challenging dataset.

8f1ece69a12a661ecc7915ed00535c516e5ac171.goal: Forecasts tropical Pacific sea surface temperatures (ENSO) with nonlinear neural network models.
8f1ece69a12a661ecc7915ed00535c516e5ac171.architecture: Feedforward neural networks (MLPs) in ensembles, compared with linear regression.
8f1ece69a12a661ecc7915ed00535c516e5ac171.data: Not reported (no abstract); predictors from tropical Pacific sea level pressure and SST fields.
8f1ece69a12a661ecc7915ed00535c516e5ac171.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
8f1ece69a12a661ecc7915ed00535c516e5ac171.issues: No abstract; lead times, skill and verification period could not be verified.

ba459e8ba16b999450288700a18f02e9e992703b.goal: Provides an objective, consistent estimate of tropical cyclone intensity from satellite imagery to replace the subjective Dvorak technique.
ba459e8ba16b999450288700a18f02e9e992703b.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) adapted for regression, with an upgraded version adding TC metadata and post-smoothing.
ba459e8ba16b999450288700a18f02e9e992703b.data: Satellite infrared brightness temperature and microwave rain-rate images of 1097 global TCs, 2003–2014 training, 188 TCs (2015–2016) optimization, 94 TCs in 2017 for testing; best-track labels.
ba459e8ba16b999450288700a18f02e9e992703b.result: RMS intensity difference of 8.39 kt against best track; 8.79 kt for a subset of 482 samples with reconnaissance observations.
ba459e8ba16b999450288700a18f02e9e992703b.open_work: Adding more satellite channels and temporal information, and operational deployment.
ba459e8ba16b999450288700a18f02e9e992703b.issues: Best-track labels carry their own uncertainty; extreme intensities are rare in training.

c8ab107460d86bab35f6bbb82e348ad5adca4b7e.goal: Tests whether combining recurrence and attention improves streamflow prediction over LSTM and transformer models.
c8ab107460d86bab35f6bbb82e348ad5adca4b7e.architecture: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT), combining LSTM recurrence with attention, compared with LSTM and transformer models.
c8ab107460d86bab35f6bbb82e348ad5adca4b7e.result: TFT exceeds the LSTM and transformer benchmarks and offers interpretability of streamflow generation drivers.
c8ab107460d86bab35f6bbb82e348ad5adca4b7e.open_work: Further testing in ungauged settings and deeper analysis of the learned attention.
c8ab107460d86bab35f6bbb82e348ad5adca4b7e.issues: Improvement margins are not quantified in the abstract; preprint.

86db3290b43cb60781ec6a57e952cba262894e36.goal: Produces high-resolution weather forecast fields from cheaper low-resolution model output, for users who cannot afford high-resolution runs.
86db3290b43cb60781ec6a57e952cba262894e36.architecture: Deep neural network trained in a supervised way to map low- to high-resolution forecasts; the exact network family is not stated in the abstract.
86db3290b43cb60781ec6a57e952cba262894e36.data: Low- and high-resolution numerical weather forecasts; region and model not reported in the abstract.
86db3290b43cb60781ec6a57e952cba262894e36.result: Significant improvement over standard practices such as interpolation, while remaining lightweight.
86db3290b43cb60781ec6a57e952cba262894e36.open_work: Applying to more variables and regions and comparing with dynamical downscaling.
86db3290b43cb60781ec6a57e952cba262894e36.issues: Quantitative results and evaluation details are not reported in the abstract.

c1a2df364912e91d07b989f6d5d410c909b49837.goal: Quantifies and reduces error of deep learning streamflow models when predicting in large contiguous ungauged regions.
c1a2df364912e91d07b989f6d5d410c909b49837.architecture: LSTM deep network with integration of soft data and a novel input-selection ensemble.
c1a2df364912e91d07b989f6d5d410c909b49837.data: CAMELS 671 US basins with region-based holdout; soft data include satellite soil moisture (SMAP) and daily flow distributions.
c1a2df364912e91d07b989f6d5d410c909b49837.result: Prediction in ungauged regions is much harder than in ungauged basins; soft data improve low flows and the ensemble reduces catastrophic failures; deep networks still beat traditional hydrologic models.
c1a2df364912e91d07b989f6d5d410c909b49837.open_work: Applying to global data-sparse regions and adding further soft data.
c1a2df364912e91d07b989f6d5d410c909b49837.issues: Large residual uncertainty in ungauged regions; tested only within the US.

4ee5a98850d3079880153804d35780a5d7f8d6a1.goal: Improves long-lead hourly streamflow forecasting with deep learning across a state-wide gauge network.
4ee5a98850d3079880153804d35780a5d7f8d6a1.architecture: Deep recurrent neural network (Neural Runoff Model) with a semi-distributed structure using upstream stations as inputs; compared with persistence, ridge regression and random forest.
4ee5a98850d3079880153804d35780a5d7f8d6a1.data: 125 USGS streamflow gauges in Iowa, observations and forecasts, 120-hour horizon.
4ee5a98850d3079880153804d35780a5d7f8d6a1.result: Outperforms persistence, ridge and random forest regression at most gauges; upstream water level data improve predictions.
4ee5a98850d3079880153804d35780a5d7f8d6a1.open_work: Extending to other regions and integrating precipitation forecasts.
4ee5a98850d3079880153804d35780a5d7f8d6a1.issues: Specific metrics are not reported in the abstract; regional study.

a6a2aae5fb005f06758498d0c9e0361ad6e7c269.goal: Speeds up large-scale flood depth and extent simulation by coupling a hydraulic model with machine learning.
a6a2aae5fb005f06758498d0c9e0361ad6e7c269.architecture: Hybrid framework: random forest classifier for wet/dry nodes and multilayer perceptron (MLP) regression for depth, trained on hydraulic model output.
a6a2aae5fb005f06758498d0c9e0361ad6e7c269.data: Two-dimensional iRIC hydraulic model simulations calibrated with measured water surface elevations for a river reach.
a6a2aae5fb005f06758498d0c9e0361ad6e7c269.result: Random forest wet/dry accuracy 98.5% and MLP depth regression coefficient 0.88 on test data.
a6a2aae5fb005f06758498d0c9e0361ad6e7c269.open_work: Scaling to connected river systems and real-time use.
a6a2aae5fb005f06758498d0c9e0361ad6e7c269.issues: Trained on one reach and on hydraulic model output, so it inherits its errors; transfer to other rivers untested.

535ea3a6f261a631437fc3a9679b7c9a0bc7f603.goal: Predicts short-term floods in Xi county, China using spatial deep learning.
535ea3a6f261a631437fc3a9679b7c9a0bc7f603.architecture: Spatial deep learning network; the specific network family is not specified in the available metadata.
535ea3a6f261a631437fc3a9679b7c9a0bc7f603.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
535ea3a6f261a631437fc3a9679b7c9a0bc7f603.issues: No abstract; data, architecture and skill could not be verified.

d7ed65096fa1f09f6c0a4d75b858ac4ab7bd038a.goal: Models daily stream water temperature at continental scale and examines the value of streamflow data as input.
d7ed65096fa1f09f6c0a4d75b858ac4ab7bd038a.architecture: LSTM deep learning model, basin-centric lumped, including a two-stage setup using streamflow simulated by a pretrained LSTM.
d7ed65096fa1f09f6c0a4d75b858ac4ab7bd038a.data: 118 data-rich US basins without major dams, with forcing, catchment attributes and observed streamflow.
d7ed65096fa1f09f6c0a4d75b858ac4ab7bd038a.result: Median RMSE 0.69 °C, NSE 0.985 and correlation 0.994; observed or simulated streamflow inputs improve performance.
d7ed65096fa1f09f6c0a4d75b858ac4ab7bd038a.open_work: Extending to dammed and data-poor basins.
d7ed65096fa1f09f6c0a4d75b858ac4ab7bd038a.issues: Only data-rich undammed basins; performance in poorly gauged settings is uncertain.

2e7e0f52ba9d811841538c6970ca7f55dd8b54fa.goal: Provides a fast, accurate long-wave radiative transfer scheme for climate and forecast models.
2e7e0f52ba9d811841538c6970ca7f55dd8b54fa.architecture: NeuroFlux: multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks combined with a multilayer grey-body cloud approximation.
2e7e0f52ba9d811841538c6970ca7f55dd8b54fa.data: Trained on atmospheric profiles (TIGR database) with reference radiation computations; tested in the ECMWF model with climate runs and ten-day forecasts.
2e7e0f52ba9d811841538c6970ca7f55dd8b54fa.result: Accuracy is comparable to the ECMWF operational scheme with negligible impact on simulations, while being seven times faster.
2e7e0f52ba9d811841538c6970ca7f55dd8b54fa.open_work: Extension to short-wave radiation and changing climate conditions.
2e7e0f52ba9d811841538c6970ca7f55dd8b54fa.issues: Accuracy depends on the training profile set; cloud treatment relies on the grey-body approximation.

7aa32bf55fdffe110a0935683abdacfe8c28dc5b.goal: Nowcasts regional flood inundation using hybrid neural networks.
7aa32bf55fdffe110a0935683abdacfe8c28dc5b.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) combined with dynamic neural networks; the type of dynamic network is not specified in the available metadata.
7aa32bf55fdffe110a0935683abdacfe8c28dc5b.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
7aa32bf55fdffe110a0935683abdacfe8c28dc5b.issues: No abstract; study region, lead times and skill could not be verified.

c61262edc297b36bf5b964385a453469f2422cf7.goal: Improves radar echo extrapolation for precipitation nowcasting by drawing on computer vision image quality assessment.
c61262edc297b36bf5b964385a453469f2422cf7.architecture: Sequence-to-sequence convolutional recurrent neural network (ConvLSTM, ConvGRU, TrajGRU variants) trained with SSIM and multi-scale SSIM losses.
c61262edc297b36bf5b964385a453469f2422cf7.data: Radar reflectivity image sequences: five input frames, ten steps predicted; radar product not reported in the abstract.
c61262edc297b36bf5b964385a453469f2422cf7.result: Image quality losses reduce blurring; SSIM combined with MSE and MAE gives the best predictions.
c61262edc297b36bf5b964385a453469f2422cf7.open_work: Further loss design and evaluation with meteorological skill scores.
c61262edc297b36bf5b964385a453469f2422cf7.issues: Evaluation emphasizes image metrics; heavy rain skill not reported.

bee1f4832cc50cfdcc898dd58ebeab6b2709f317.goal: Estimates soil water retention and hydraulic conductivity functions and water flux from volumetric water content measurements alone.
bee1f4832cc50cfdcc898dd58ebeab6b2709f317.architecture: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) of three linked feedforward neural networks, two constrained to be monotonic, solving the Richardson-Richards equation inversely.
bee1f4832cc50cfdcc898dd58ebeab6b2709f317.data: Synthetic volumetric water content data with artificial noise from numerical solutions for three soil textures.
bee1f4832cc50cfdcc898dd58ebeab6b2709f317.result: Reconstructs water content dynamics and recovers retention and conductivity functions nonparametrically, except at wet and dry extremes.
bee1f4832cc50cfdcc898dd58ebeab6b2709f317.open_work: Applying to field measurements and improving behaviour at the extremes.
bee1f4832cc50cfdcc898dd58ebeab6b2709f317.issues: Synthetic data only; poor reconstruction at wet and dry ends.

7cb327f841b12abb829a399b3feb4ac8b3b03efc.goal: Tracks and forecasts hurricane trajectories in large-scale spatio-temporal climate data.
7cb327f841b12abb829a399b3feb4ac8b3b03efc.architecture: Convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM) models applied to density maps of trajectories.
7cb327f841b12abb829a399b3feb4ac8b3b03efc.data: Twenty years of tropical cyclone records as pixel-level spatio-temporal histories; product not reported in the abstract.
7cb327f841b12abb829a399b3feb4ac8b3b03efc.result: The ConvLSTM tracking model significantly outperforms existing approaches, and forecasts map well to ground truth.
7cb327f841b12abb829a399b3feb4ac8b3b03efc.open_work: Extension to other extreme events and longer forecasts.
7cb327f841b12abb829a399b3feb4ac8b3b03efc.issues: Quantitative metrics are not reported in the abstract.

bb071019aedef3439efa3c186b5721457e2b9928.goal: Forecasts regional flood inundation depths several hours ahead to support emergency management.
bb071019aedef3439efa3c186b5721457e2b9928.architecture: Stacked autoencoder (SAE) to encode inundation maps combined with an LSTM recurrent neural network forecasting the latent features.
bb071019aedef3439efa3c186b5721457e2b9928.data: Hourly inundation depth datasets of 169,797 grids in Yilan County, Taiwan, split into training, validation and testing sets.
bb071019aedef3439efa3c186b5721457e2b9928.result: Very small RMSE and high R² (above about 0.95) for 1- to 3-hour-ahead forecasts.
bb071019aedef3439efa3c186b5721457e2b9928.open_work: Longer lead times and other regions.
bb071019aedef3439efa3c186b5721457e2b9928.issues: Single region; inundation data source and generalization to unseen events are uncertain.

e9fb08ee273cdb29738ca78cf3968cf6f03d0f51.goal: Combines deep learning predictive power with conceptual model interpretability in hydrology.
e9fb08ee273cdb29738ca78cf3968cf6f03d0f51.architecture: Neural ordinary differential equation (neural ODE) model where internal processes of a conceptual bucket model are replaced by neural networks (MLPs).
e9fb08ee273cdb29738ca78cf3968cf6f03d0f51.data: 569 catchments of the contiguous United States (CAMELS).
e9fb08ee273cdb29738ca78cf3968cf6f03d0f51.result: Performs as well as state-of-the-art deep learning methods in streamflow prediction while keeping interpretable internal states.
e9fb08ee273cdb29738ca78cf3968cf6f03d0f51.open_work: Further process analyses and wider use of neural ODEs in hydrology.
e9fb08ee273cdb29738ca78cf3968cf6f03d0f51.issues: Basin-specific models; interpretability illustrated on exemplary basins only.

740f5860cc4d8ccadcbeac5fdaa7d1dedd695d7f.goal: Reduce the computational cost of numerical ocean and wave models by replacing expensive model components with fast, accurate neural-network approximations.
740f5860cc4d8ccadcbeac5fdaa7d1dedd695d7f.architecture: Neural network emulation of computationally expensive model components; the network family and configuration are not specified in the available metadata.
740f5860cc4d8ccadcbeac5fdaa7d1dedd695d7f.data: Training sets generated from the original model components being emulated; specific products not reported in the available metadata.
740f5860cc4d8ccadcbeac5fdaa7d1dedd695d7f.result: Neural-network emulations are presented as reproducing the original components accurately while running much faster; quantitative speed-ups are not given here.
740f5860cc4d8ccadcbeac5fdaa7d1dedd695d7f.open_work: Extending the emulation approach to more components and to coupled ocean, wave and climate models, with checks of long-run stability.
740f5860cc4d8ccadcbeac5fdaa7d1dedd695d7f.issues: Abstract unavailable; emulators are only valid within the training range and offline accuracy may not guarantee stable behaviour once embedded in the model.

044f364c7402299de32b878e39e299fbc200d9a2.goal: Evaluate deep learning for short-term radar-based precipitation nowcasting, which matters for early warning of hazardous small-scale events, and test its robustness and transferability.
044f364c7402299de32b878e39e299fbc200d9a2.architecture: All-convolutional neural network (CNN) without pooling or dense layers, with preprocessing, network structure and loss function selected by trial and error.
044f364c7402299de32b878e39e299fbc200d9a2.data: Weather radar precipitation composites; product and region not reported in the abstract.
044f364c7402299de32b878e39e299fbc200d9a2.result: Parsimonious deep CNNs forecast short-term precipitation field evolution competitively with established optical-flow nowcasting models.
044f364c7402299de32b878e39e299fbc200d9a2.open_work: Systematic study of preprocessing, architecture and loss choices, and of transferability between radar datasets and regions.
044f364c7402299de32b878e39e299fbc200d9a2.issues: Trial-and-error design; the paper itself notes limited transferability of existing methods, and performance on extreme rain rates is not reported in the abstract.

97fd6c58aba4aa53363fb38f1e58eef2566f0712.goal: Speed up and objectify the tuning of free parameters in physical parameterizations of climate models while keeping physically based schemes rather than replacing them.
97fd6c58aba4aa53363fb38f1e58eef2566f0712.architecture: Gaussian process emulators with history matching from uncertainty quantification, used to rule out implausible parameter values by comparing single-column simulations against references.
97fd6c58aba4aa53363fb38f1e58eef2566f0712.data: Single-column model simulations compared with reference large-eddy simulations (LES) over multiple boundary-layer cases.
97fd6c58aba4aa53363fb38f1e58eef2566f0712.result: The tool returns the full set of parameter values consistent with the LES references and structural uncertainty, giving a reduced acceptable domain for tuning the 3D global model.
97fd6c58aba4aa53363fb38f1e58eef2566f0712.open_work: Part 2 applies the process-based tuning to the 3D global model; extending to more processes and observational targets.
97fd6c58aba4aa53363fb38f1e58eef2566f0712.issues: Relies on LES as truth and on single-column cases, which may not capture global-model feedbacks; emulator accuracy limits the reliability of the retained parameter space.

3a19c0b50e92514055d290b77560010ddd3b6ef4.goal: Downscale coarse large-scale river model output to subgrid scale near the river-ocean interface, where coarse meshes misrepresent tidal flow and flood inundation.
3a19c0b50e92514055d290b77560010ddd3b6ef4.architecture: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) solving the 1-D Saint-Venant equations and assimilating observations, with a new Fourier-feature embedding to encode periodic tidal boundary conditions.
3a19c0b50e92514055d290b77560010ddd3b6ef4.data: Synthetic floodplain and open-channel cases, evaluated against analytical solutions and numerical models, plus storm-surge and tide-driven flood wave cases.
3a19c0b50e92514055d290b77560010ddd3b6ef4.result: PINN water depths are satisfactorily accurate with limited observations and outperform linear interpolation in resolving subgrid topography and flow regimes.
3a19c0b50e92514055d290b77560010ddd3b6ef4.open_work: Extending the approach to 2-D flows, real river networks and coupling with operational large-scale river models.
3a19c0b50e92514055d290b77560010ddd3b6ef4.issues: Tested only on synthetic 1-D cases; PINN training cost and convergence on complex real geometries are not established.

289919700d883e9e1a80bef66440164c2cf2675a.goal: Improve drought monitoring by downscaling coarse GRACE-derived terrestrial water storage anomalies to finer spatial resolution.
289919700d883e9e1a80bef66440164c2cf2675a.architecture: Deep learning downscaling model; the specific network family is not specified in the available metadata.
289919700d883e9e1a80bef66440164c2cf2675a.data: GRACE terrestrial water storage anomalies with higher-resolution hydroclimatic predictors; region and products not reported.
289919700d883e9e1a80bef66440164c2cf2675a.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies downscaled TWSA supports finer-scale drought assessment.
289919700d883e9e1a80bef66440164c2cf2675a.open_work: Validation against in situ groundwater and drought indicators and extension to other regions and GRACE-FO periods.
289919700d883e9e1a80bef66440164c2cf2675a.issues: Abstract unavailable; downscaled storage cannot be fully validated at fine scales and inherits GRACE errors and gaps.

59b99b58e347fee1d2cf29707ebc05610d8c58c7.goal: Estimate flood quantiles at ungauged sites through regional flood frequency analysis, under both historical and projected future climate.
59b99b58e347fee1d2cf29707ebc05610d8c58c7.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) relating flood quantiles to catchment and climate descriptors.
59b99b58e347fee1d2cf29707ebc05610d8c58c7.data: Gauged streamflow records and catchment descriptors, with future climate from climate model projections; region and products not reported in the available metadata.
59b99b58e347fee1d2cf29707ebc05610d8c58c7.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies SVR-based regional estimates of flood quantiles for current and future climate.
59b99b58e347fee1d2cf29707ebc05610d8c58c7.open_work: Comparison with other regionalization methods and propagation of climate-projection uncertainty into flood quantiles.
59b99b58e347fee1d2cf29707ebc05610d8c58c7.issues: Abstract unavailable; future estimates depend on climate model and downscaling choices and assume stationarity of regional relationships.

8427bbd8cb68288727f17a874cf6fcbd195cdb73.goal: Predict the trajectories of Atlantic hurricanes to support warning and preparedness.
8427bbd8cb68288727f17a874cf6fcbd195cdb73.architecture: Sparse recurrent neural network (RNN), with connectivity and training details not reported in the available metadata.
8427bbd8cb68288727f17a874cf6fcbd195cdb73.data: Historical Atlantic hurricane track data; the specific best-track product is not reported in the available metadata.
8427bbd8cb68288727f17a874cf6fcbd195cdb73.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
8427bbd8cb68288727f17a874cf6fcbd195cdb73.open_work: Inclusion of environmental steering predictors and comparison with operational track guidance.
8427bbd8cb68288727f17a874cf6fcbd195cdb73.issues: Abstract unavailable; track-only inputs ignore the large-scale environment, and comparison with operational models is unclear.

20cc87bba097ae665a23a1afd56c8c6268bcfcef.goal: Argue that environmental scientists must address ethical, responsible and trustworthy AI, since AI in weather and climate can produce unintended societal consequences.
20cc87bba097ae665a23a1afd56c8c6268bcfcef.architecture: Perspective/review article, not an ML method; it uses concrete weather and climate examples to illustrate how AI can introduce bias and harm.
20cc87bba097ae665a23a1afd56c8c6268bcfcef.data: No dataset; draws on illustrative examples from weather and climate applications and from other domains such as criminal justice and finance.
20cc87bba097ae665a23a1afd56c8c6268bcfcef.result: Shows many ways AI in environmental science can reproduce biases, e.g. via uneven observation coverage, and argues that with proper precautions AI can reduce environmental injustice.
20cc87bba097ae665a23a1afd56c8c6268bcfcef.open_work: Community research and guidelines on bias, fairness, trustworthiness and stakeholder involvement in environmental AI.
20cc87bba097ae665a23a1afd56c8c6268bcfcef.issues: Position paper without quantitative evaluation; proposed safeguards are not tested.

e17dead180f8f9d03a5b66ffe4fd693b7f8508ff.goal: Separate the forced climate response from internal circulation-driven variability, enabling forced-signal estimates from few ensemble members or a single realization.
e17dead180f8f9d03a5b66ffe4fd693b7f8508ff.architecture: Statistical-learning dynamical adjustment using regularized linear models (e.g. ridge-type regression) mapping circulation fields to temperature and precipitation.
e17dead180f8f9d03a5b66ffe4fd693b7f8508ff.data: CESM large-ensemble simulations; training on around 30 years of record.
e17dead180f8f9d03a5b66ffe4fd693b7f8508ff.result: Circulation explains on average 83% and 78% of European monthly winter temperature and precipitation variability at grid-cell level and about 80% of global mean temperature and hemispheric precipitation variability; 3–5 times fewer members needed.
e17dead180f8f9d03a5b66ffe4fd693b7f8508ff.open_work: Application to observations for detection and attribution, and handling forced changes in circulation.
e17dead180f8f9d03a5b66ffe4fd693b7f8508ff.issues: Assumes forced circulation changes are gradual; demonstrated mainly in one climate model, so transfer to observations needs care.

3f8f9795a074bdacc3f7c85f863d9985f15febb7.goal: Provide accurate, cheap groundwater level predictions for water managers who cannot run complex mechanistic models, and find good hyperparameters efficiently.
3f8f9795a074bdacc3f7c85f863d9985f15febb7.architecture: Comparison of four deep learning models including MLP, LSTM and convolutional neural network (CNN), with hyperparameters tuned by two surrogate-model-based optimizers and random sampling.
3f8f9795a074bdacc3f7c85f863d9985f15febb7.data: Groundwater level observations in Butte County, California, with streamflow, precipitation and ambient temperature as predictors.
3f8f9795a074bdacc3f7c85f863d9985f15febb7.result: Optimized models reach RMSE of 2 m or less; the simple MLP outperforms LSTM and CNN in accuracy and time-to-solution.
3f8f9795a074bdacc3f7c85f863d9985f15febb7.open_work: Testing on more wells and regions, longer horizons, and additional predictors such as pumping.
3f8f9795a074bdacc3f7c85f863d9985f15febb7.issues: Single study area; small data may favour simple networks, and no uncertainty quantification is reported.

b15b033f2a48d86950e051efa1113c7c97fb9147.goal: Predict river gauge height for flood forecasting with finer time steps and an estimate of prediction uncertainty.
b15b033f2a48d86950e051efa1113c7c97fb9147.architecture: Deep learning model with uncertainty estimation, comparing data sub-selection and dropout as regularization; the specific network family is not specified in the abstract.
b15b033f2a48d86950e051efa1113c7c97fb9147.data: Gauge height observations for the Meramec River at Valley Park, Missouri.
b15b033f2a48d86950e051efa1113c7c97fb9147.result: The deep learning model is more accurate than the physical and statistical models in use and provides forecasts every 15 minutes instead of 6 hours; data sub-selection regularizes better than dropout.
b15b033f2a48d86950e051efa1113c7c97fb9147.open_work: Transfer to other rivers and integration into transportation and warning systems.
b15b033f2a48d86950e051efa1113c7c97fb9147.issues: Single gauge site; few extreme floods to validate on, and gains over operational models are not quantified in the abstract.

53aaff9d979084d76daf4048345e0ccf4bacb386.goal: Predict high-resolution precipitation from coarse model-like fields, since climate models represent precipitation poorly at their low resolution.
53aaff9d979084d76daf4048345e0ccf4bacb386.architecture: TRU-NET (Temporal Recurrent U-Net), an encoder-decoder with convolutional-recurrent layers and a novel 2D cross-attention mechanism, trained with a non-stochastic conditional-continuous loss for zero-inflated rainfall.
53aaff9d979084d76daf4048345e0ccf4bacb386.data: Reanalysis weather fields as input (excluding local precipitation) and high-resolution precipitation observations as targets; specific products not named in the abstract.
53aaff9d979084d76daf4048345e0ccf4bacb386.result: With the CC loss, TRU-NET attains lower RMSE and MAE than a common precipitation-downscaling DL model and outperforms a state-of-the-art dynamical weather model, robustly across seasons and regions.
53aaff9d979084d76daf4048345e0ccf4bacb386.open_work: Application to climate model output for future projections and probabilistic extensions.
53aaff9d979084d76daf4048345e0ccf4bacb386.issues: Trained on reanalysis rather than climate model output, so applying it to climate models involves a domain shift; extremes are not specifically assessed in the abstract.

7cfe9f62f71bcec28c7fce56de12b12d1e03dd34.goal: Improve deep learning radar nowcasting skill for extreme rainfall, where models suffer conditional bias and smoothing and can underperform Lagrangian persistence.
7cfe9f62f71bcec28c7fce56de12b12d1e03dd34.architecture: Model stacking: a convolutional neural network combines an ensemble of four TrajGRU nowcasting models, trained on different rainfall thresholds, with orographic features.
7cfe9f62f71bcec28c7fce56de12b12d1e03dd34.data: TAASRAD19 radar dataset; first six years train the ensemble members, the next three years train the stacked model.
7cfe9f62f71bcec28c7fce56de12b12d1e03dd34.result: Stacking doubles skill on extreme rain rates relative to ensemble members and their mean, matches Lagrangian persistence on extremes and keeps superior skill on lower rain regimes.
7cfe9f62f71bcec28c7fce56de12b12d1e03dd34.open_work: Exceeding persistence on extremes, longer lead times and transfer to other radar domains.
7cfe9f62f71bcec28c7fce56de12b12d1e03dd34.issues: Single region with complex orography; extreme events remain rare and smoothing is only partly addressed.

a74bbe24318dd0970ff2df91285697ef86bc4ba4.goal: Help climate scientists choose an explainable AI (XAI) method when ground-truth explanations are missing, by evaluating XAI methods on defined properties.
a74bbe24318dd0970ff2df91285697ef86bc4ba4.architecture: Benchmark/evaluation framework scoring XAI methods on robustness, faithfulness, randomization, complexity and localization, applied to an MLP and a convolutional neural network (CNN).
a74bbe24318dd0970ff2df91285697ef86bc4ba4.data: Case study predicting the decade from annual-mean temperature maps from climate model simulations, following earlier work.
a74bbe24318dd0970ff2df91285697ef86bc4ba4.result: Integrated Gradients, layer-wise relevance propagation and input times gradients are robust, faithful and low-complexity but weak on randomization; sensitivity methods trade faithfulness and complexity for randomization; results depend on architecture.
a74bbe24318dd0970ff2df91285697ef86bc4ba4.open_work: Task-specific XAI evaluation for other climate problems and architectures.
a74bbe24318dd0970ff2df91285697ef86bc4ba4.issues: Single case study with simple networks; evaluation metrics are proxies since true explanations are unknown.

2a4f1afcfec572482eeb2de11d3a25a91a0da6e3.goal: Forecast streamflow and floods globally, including ungauged catchments where physically based models are hard to calibrate.
2a4f1afcfec572482eeb2de11d3a25a91a0da6e3.architecture: ED-DLSTM, an encoder-decoder double-layer long short-term memory (LSTM) network with a spatial attribute encoding module.
2a4f1afcfec572482eeb2de11d3a25a91a0da6e3.data: Historical datasets for more than 2,000 catchments in the United States, Canada, Central Europe and the United Kingdom; 160 ungauged catchments in Chile for transfer.
2a4f1afcfec572482eeb2de11d3a25a91a0da6e3.result: Mean NSE of 0.75 across the 2,000+ catchments; in Chile 76.9% of ungauged catchments reach NSE > 0 in the best case; cell states show emergent hydrological regionalization.
2a4f1afcfec572482eeb2de11d3a25a91a0da6e3.open_work: Improving cross-region transfer to data-poor regions and extending to flood extremes and longer lead times.
2a4f1afcfec572482eeb2de11d3a25a91a0da6e3.issues: Transfer performance to ungauged regions is modest; NSE > 0 is a low bar and depends on attribute data quality.

30fcba6760b5fc5235ef8a0f2a61ccff63a7c3a0.goal: Build recurrent networks that obey conservation laws, since many physical and economic systems redistribute conserved quantities.
30fcba6760b5fc5235ef8a0f2a61ccff63a7c3a0.architecture: Mass-Conserving LSTM (MC-LSTM), a long short-term memory variant whose gating redistributes stored mass so inputs are conserved exactly.
30fcba6760b5fc5235ef8a0f2a61ccff63a7c3a0.data: Arithmetic tasks, traffic forecasting, a pendulum, and a large hydrology benchmark (CAMELS-US rainfall-runoff).
30fcba6760b5fc5235ef8a0f2a61ccff63a7c3a0.result: Sets a new state of the art for neural arithmetic units and for peak-flow prediction in the hydrology benchmark; its states correlate with real-world processes.
30fcba6760b5fc5235ef8a0f2a61ccff63a7c3a0.open_work: Handling non-conserved fluxes and unobserved sinks, and extension to spatially distributed systems.
30fcba6760b5fc5235ef8a0f2a61ccff63a7c3a0.issues: Strict mass conservation can hurt when data have biases or unmeasured losses such as evapotranspiration; overall streamflow skill is not clearly above a standard LSTM.

5e14cbe4006dc1dd881d25241d5cc5dec8c741c0.goal: Learn the dynamics of a model from partial, noisy observations using data assimilation instead of machine learning libraries, with a view to high-dimensional systems.
5e14cbe4006dc1dd881d25241d5cc5dec8c741c0.architecture: Bayesian data assimilation framework inferring an ordinary differential equation representation by recursive nonlinear regression, with a local space-wise representation; non-neural, though analogous to deep architectures.
5e14cbe4006dc1dd881d25241d5cc5dec8c741c0.data: Several chaotic discrete and continuous toy models of various dimensions (e.g. Lorenz-96-type), with and without observation noise.
5e14cbe4006dc1dd881d25241d5cc5dec8c741c0.result: The method identifies or improves model dynamics, builds surrogate models and produces forecasts from observations alone; stability analysis clarifies its strengths and limits.
5e14cbe4006dc1dd881d25241d5cc5dec8c741c0.open_work: Scaling to realistic geophysical models and combining with neural-network surrogates.
5e14cbe4006dc1dd881d25241d5cc5dec8c741c0.issues: Demonstrated only on low-order chaotic models; numerical stability limits the method.

d8a3005651ba78217d811d6c7e66335fd9e59888.goal: Discuss the prospective value of deep learning for inference problems in hydrology and hydrogeology.
d8a3005651ba78217d811d6c7e66335fd9e59888.architecture: Perspective/review of deep learning methods and their potential for hydrological inference; no specific model is developed per the available metadata.
d8a3005651ba78217d811d6c7e66335fd9e59888.data: Not reported in the available metadata.
d8a3005651ba78217d811d6c7e66335fd9e59888.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies an argument that deep learning offers new opportunities for hydrological inference.
d8a3005651ba78217d811d6c7e66335fd9e59888.open_work: Concrete applications to groundwater problems and integration with physical knowledge.
d8a3005651ba78217d811d6c7e66335fd9e59888.issues: Abstract unavailable; a prospective piece without systematic evaluation.

711f2334fd8e5c488d7c1df1148bacb79053687f.goal: Extend lead times of monthly streamflow and flood prediction on the Yangtze River, beyond the roughly one month of physically based models, using ENSO information.
711f2334fd8e5c488d7c1df1148bacb79053687f.architecture: Comparison of stacked long short-term memory (LSTM), ConvLSTM encoder-decoder LSTM and ConvLSTM encoder-decoder gated recurrent unit (GRU) networks.
711f2334fd8e5c488d7c1df1148bacb79053687f.data: Monthly Yangtze River streamflow and ENSO indices, 1952–2018; tested on two extreme flood years and one small flood year.
711f2334fd8e5c488d7c1df1148bacb79053687f.result: ConvLSTM improves stability and flood accuracy; adding ENSO better times flood peaks and flows; ConvLSTM + encoder-decoder GRU performs best.
711f2334fd8e5c488d7c1df1148bacb79053687f.open_work: Adding other climate indices and quantifying uncertainty for longer lead times.
711f2334fd8e5c488d7c1df1148bacb79053687f.issues: Very few flood years tested and a single monthly series, so results may not generalize; no uncertainty estimates.
