56ae95ed2263a92cae3745ae73476f11caa69e27.goal: Enforce energy and mass conservation in neural-network emulators of cloud processes so they can be used in long-term climate prediction.
56ae95ed2263a92cae3745ae73476f11caa69e27.architecture: Neural network (MLP) emulator with conservation enforced either through a penalty in the loss function or through architecture constraints with dedicated conservation layers.
56ae95ed2263a92cae3745ae73476f11caa69e27.data: Explicitly resolved cloud processes from a prototype multi-scale (superparameterized) climate model, including a warming scenario for generalization tests.
56ae95ed2263a92cae3745ae73476f11caa69e27.result: Architecture constraints enforce conservation laws to satisfactory numerical precision, and all constraints improve generalization to out-of-sample conditions such as global warming.
56ae95ed2263a92cae3745ae73476f11caa69e27.open_work: Testing constrained emulators in online coupled climate simulations and enforcing nonlinear constraints.
56ae95ed2263a92cae3745ae73476f11caa69e27.issues: Offline tests only; only linear conservation laws handled, and the prototype model is idealized.

2824e8f94cffe6d4969e96248e67aa228ac72278.goal: Predict in real time whether a convective storm will produce damaging straight-line wind, to support warning decisions.
2824e8f94cffe6d4969e96248e67aa228ac72278.architecture: Supervised machine learning on storm-object features, including tree ensembles such as random forests and gradient-boosted trees.
2824e8f94cffe6d4969e96248e67aa228ac72278.data: Radar-based storm tracks and radar statistics, near-storm environment soundings from a numerical model, and surface wind observations over the United States.
2824e8f94cffe6d4969e96248e67aa228ac72278.result: Models skilfully predict damaging-wind probability at short lead times; detailed scores are not given here.
2824e8f94cffe6d4969e96248e67aa228ac72278.open_work: Operational testing and use of convolutional networks on storm-centred radar images.
2824e8f94cffe6d4969e96248e67aa228ac72278.issues: Wind reports and observations are sparse and biased, so labels are noisy; damaging winds are rare events.

8b7392ce20fe07a8033822cee88fee846feb4257.goal: Nowcast precipitation from satellite data, a hard spatiotemporal problem where traditional methods rely on optical flow.
8b7392ce20fe07a8033822cee88fee846feb4257.architecture: Convcast, an embedded convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM) network predicting the next frame from ten consecutive frames, applied iteratively up to 150 minutes.
8b7392ce20fe07a8033822cee88fee846feb4257.data: NASA IMERG precipitation fields at 30-minute intervals.
8b7392ce20fe07a8033822cee88fee846feb4257.result: Overall accuracy 0.93 with RMSE 0.805 mm/h at 30 minutes and 0.87 with RMSE 1.389 mm/h at 150 minutes; outperforms optical-flow nowcasting algorithms.
8b7392ce20fe07a8033822cee88fee846feb4257.open_work: Longer lead times and on-board satellite processing of precipitation data.
8b7392ce20fe07a8033822cee88fee846feb4257.issues: Iterative frame prediction accumulates errors and blurs fields; IMERG's latency and retrieval errors limit real-time use.

b72380acd56d2a2808aeddd118a0e1fd6badb886.goal: Rapidly forecast urban flood inundation as a fast alternative to slow hydrodynamic simulation.
b72380acd56d2a2808aeddd118a0e1fd6badb886.architecture: Several machine learning models compared for inundation prediction; the specific model families are not specified in the available metadata.
b72380acd56d2a2808aeddd118a0e1fd6badb886.data: Not reported in the available metadata; training data for such surrogates usually come from hydrodynamic simulations of rainfall scenarios.
b72380acd56d2a2808aeddd118a0e1fd6badb886.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
b72380acd56d2a2808aeddd118a0e1fd6badb886.open_work: Transfer to other cities and real-time coupling with rainfall forecasts.
b72380acd56d2a2808aeddd118a0e1fd6badb886.issues: Abstract unavailable; surrogates trained on simulated scenarios inherit hydrodynamic model errors and may not generalize to unseen rainfall patterns.

425e9a9046e787cc7663fd0b3e6c0e0b6987eee6.goal: Predict 9 km daily surface soil moisture by learning from both satellite and in situ data, overcoming each source's coverage or accuracy limits.
425e9a9046e787cc7663fd0b3e6c0e0b6987eee6.architecture: Multiscale deep learning scheme trained simultaneously on satellite and in situ targets; the specific network family is not specified in the abstract.
425e9a9046e787cc7663fd0b3e6c0e0b6987eee6.data: SMAP 9 km soil moisture and in situ sites across the conterminous United States, 5 cm depth, with spatial cross-validation.
425e9a9046e787cc7663fd0b3e6c0e0b6987eee6.result: Median correlation 0.901 and RMSE 0.034 m3/m3; outperforms the SMAP 9 km product, DL trained on in situ alone, land surface models and 1 km downscaling products.
425e9a9046e787cc7663fd0b3e6c0e0b6987eee6.open_work: Extending to other regions, depths and variables with multi-scale data.
425e9a9046e787cc7663fd0b3e6c0e0b6987eee6.issues: In situ sites are unevenly distributed, so skill in sparse regions is uncertain; only surface (5 cm) moisture is predicted.

43ce562f8bbc0503625480a626312bb678807f13.goal: Predict flows in ungauged catchments by regionalizing flow information and testing model adequacy before prediction.
43ce562f8bbc0503625480a626312bb678807f13.architecture: Principal component analysis of flow indices, random forest regression with a residual error model for regionalization, and Bayesian conditioning of hydrological model parameters.
43ce562f8bbc0503625480a626312bb678807f13.data: 92 catchments in northern Spain, 16 treated as ungauged.
43ce562f8bbc0503625480a626312bb678807f13.result: A few PCs capture about 87% of flow-index variability; regionalization is adequate in 12 of 16 ungauged catchments but the hydrological model in only 1 of 16.
43ce562f8bbc0503625480a626312bb678807f13.open_work: Improving hydrological model structure and input data, and disentangling their effects.
43ce562f8bbc0503625480a626312bb678807f13.issues: Single region; adequacy tests are indicative but do not guarantee good flow time series prediction.

5999eea27a342bf056da0cbfa53aaab759278ec2.goal: Predict pluvial flooding in real time from spatially heterogeneous rainfall, beyond earlier fully connected networks limited to uniform rainfall.
5999eea27a342bf056da0cbfa53aaab759278ec2.architecture: floodGAN, a deep convolutional generative adversarial network (GAN) using image-to-image translation to map rainfall fields to 2D inundation maps.
5999eea27a342bf056da0cbfa53aaab759278ec2.data: Training data from a physically based hydrodynamic model; tests on synthetic events and a historic rainfall event.
5999eea27a342bf056da0cbfa53aaab759278ec2.result: floodGAN is up to 10^6 times faster than the hydrodynamic model with promising accuracy and generalizability.
5999eea27a342bf056da0cbfa53aaab759278ec2.open_work: Integration into end-to-end early warning systems and extension to other urban areas.
5999eea27a342bf056da0cbfa53aaab759278ec2.issues: Trained on simulations, so it inherits hydrodynamic model errors; site-specific and tested on a single historic event.

a16388f862ccb3e98e26d78d5a61a8cf225f7b9f.goal: Improve monthly runoff simulation by embedding machine learning inside a conceptual rainfall-runoff model and calibrating all parameters jointly.
a16388f862ccb3e98e26d78d5a61a8cf225f7b9f.architecture: Nested hybrid models embedding an artificial neural network (ANN, MLP-type) or support vector regression (SVR) in the dynamic water balance model (dynwbm), calibrated simultaneously.
a16388f862ccb3e98e26d78d5a61a8cf225f7b9f.data: Monthly hydrometeorological data at several locations in the Gediz River Basin, western Turkey.
a16388f862ccb3e98e26d78d5a61a8cf225f7b9f.result: Nested hybrids outperform standalone dynwbm, ANN and SVR and sequentially coupled variants for mean and high flows.
a16388f862ccb3e98e26d78d5a61a8cf225f7b9f.open_work: Application at daily time steps, other basins and other ML components.
a16388f862ccb3e98e26d78d5a61a8cf225f7b9f.issues: Single basin and monthly scale; joint calibration increases parameter equifinality risk.

5d1a4a529e0b05b047dcd8b9b321e898e6526cb5.goal: Provide a unifying framework for blending mechanistic models and machine learning to learn model error in dynamical systems from noisy, partial data.
5d1a4a529e0b05b047dcd8b9b321e898e6526cb5.architecture: Model-agnostic hybrid framework with random features and continuous-time recurrent neural networks (RNNs) linked to reservoir computing, in continuous and discrete time.
5d1a4a529e0b05b047dcd8b9b321e898e6526cb5.result: Proves error bounds decaying with training length and universal approximation for memory-dependent error; hybrid models are less data-hungry and more parameter-efficient than purely data-driven ones.
5d1a4a529e0b05b047dcd8b9b321e898e6526cb5.open_work: Better representation of memory and training of models learned with data assimilation from partial observations.
5d1a4a529e0b05b047dcd8b9b321e898e6526cb5.issues: Numerical tests on low-dimensional toy systems; training memory-dependent models remains challenging.

9d874861ec9f6b58166dcfcf05caf7a4a6bd032c.goal: Achieve high-resolution, high-quality data-driven medium-range weather forecasts that compete with operational NWP.
9d874861ec9f6b58166dcfcf05caf7a4a6bd032c.architecture: SwinRDM: an improved SwinRNN (Swin transformer-based recurrent network) forecasting at 1.40625° combined with a diffusion model for super-resolution to 0.25°.
9d874861ec9f6b58166dcfcf05caf7a4a6bd032c.data: ERA5 reanalysis; evaluated against IFS on Z500, T850, T2M and total precipitation.
9d874861ec9f6b58166dcfcf05caf7a4a6bd032c.result: Outperforms IFS on Z500, T850, T2M and TP at lead times up to 5 days at 0.25° resolution.
9d874861ec9f6b58166dcfcf05caf7a4a6bd032c.open_work: Longer lead times, probabilistic forecasting and operational deployment.
9d874861ec9f6b58166dcfcf05caf7a4a6bd032c.issues: Trained on reanalysis and inherits its biases; evaluated only to 5 days, with the two-step approach possibly adding inconsistencies.

9aba7b34eab63e448591071962e7c5356c6ec041.goal: Formulate a strong equivalence between machine learning and statistical data assimilation to transfer methods between the fields.
9aba7b34eab63e448591071962e7c5356c6ec041.architecture: Theoretical framework mapping network layers to time in data assimilation, including a continuous-layer "deepest learning" limit with Lagrangian and Hamiltonian formulations; not a specific network family.
9aba7b34eab63e448591071962e7c5356c6ec041.data: Simple illustrative models from both machine learning and data assimilation.
9aba7b34eab63e448591071962e7c5356c6ec041.result: Deeper networks correspond to finer temporal resolution; the Hamiltonian view justifies backpropagation, and data assimilation methods help find global minima.
9aba7b34eab63e448591071962e7c5356c6ec041.open_work: Applying the equivalence to large practical networks and geophysical data assimilation problems.
9aba7b34eab63e448591071962e7c5356c6ec041.issues: Mostly theoretical with simple numerical tests; practical benefits at scale are not shown.

b03dfd3500ed198ff5c42ecec3fcd07247baaae5.goal: Diagnoses why autoregressive neural operators accumulate error and become unstable over long rollouts, and seeks fixes that do not raise compute or memory cost.
b03dfd3500ed198ff5c42ecec3fcd07247baaae5.architecture: Neural operator models (Fourier neural operator family, including the AFNO-based FourCastNet weather model) with architectural modifications that control instability-inducing operations during autoregressive time stepping.
b03dfd3500ed198ff5c42ecec3fcd07247baaae5.data: Navier-Stokes fluid flow, rotating shallow water simulations, and a high-resolution global weather forecasting system trained on ERA5 reanalysis.
b03dfd3500ed198ff5c42ecec3fcd07247baaae5.result: The design changes give significantly lower long-term forecast errors and longer stable horizons without qualitative signs of divergence compared with the original models.
b03dfd3500ed198ff5c42ecec3fcd07247baaae5.open_work: Extending the stability principles to other operator architectures and to probabilistic or coupled long climate-length rollouts.
b03dfd3500ed198ff5c42ecec3fcd07247baaae5.issues: Stability is shown empirically on a few systems; no formal guarantee, and long rollouts are judged by absence of visible divergence rather than full physical consistency.

57201fdf404dbbd67ff4b22cafd13faba21e08d4.goal: Forecasting very large spatiotemporally chaotic systems, as in weather prediction, when both past data and an imperfect physics model are available, and learning subgrid-scale closure from data.
57201fdf404dbbd67ff4b22cafd13faba21e08d4.architecture: Hybrid scheme combining a knowledge-based model with parallel machine learning components based on reservoir computing (echo state networks), each covering a local spatial region.
57201fdf404dbbd67ff4b22cafd13faba21e08d4.data: Idealized chaotic test systems, including the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation and a multiscale model with unresolved small-scale dynamics.
57201fdf404dbbd67ff4b22cafd13faba21e08d4.result: The combined parallel-hybrid approach scales to very large systems with excellent forecasts, needs far less training data than non-parallel ML, and learns the effect of unresolved scales on resolved ones.
57201fdf404dbbd67ff4b22cafd13faba21e08d4.open_work: Application to realistic atmospheric models and real observations, and integration with data assimilation.
57201fdf404dbbd67ff4b22cafd13faba21e08d4.issues: Tested only on idealized low-complexity systems; transfer to full weather models with noisy, sparse observations is not demonstrated.

6991f511d7152048bbc27685694fbca1881f9226.goal: Replacing costly interactive atmospheric chemistry with a cheap ozone parameterization so climate sensitivity runs can include ozone changes consistent with the simulated climate.
6991f511d7152048bbc27685694fbca1881f9226.architecture: Simple linear machine learning regression (ridge regression) mapping the atmospheric temperature field to three-dimensional ozone distributions.
6991f511d7152048bbc27685694fbca1881f9226.data: Preindustrial control and abrupt 4xCO2 simulations of a chemistry-climate model (UM-UKCA), using temperature as the only predictor.
6991f511d7152048bbc27685694fbca1881f9226.result: The regression reliably predicts 3D ozone at monthly to daily intervals and greatly improves stratospheric ozone variability versus a fixed climatology, using a fraction of the usual simulation length for training.
6991f511d7152048bbc27685694fbca1881f9226.open_work: Coupling the parameterization interactively in climate runs, adding predictors and nonlinear methods, and extending to other scenarios.
6991f511d7152048bbc27685694fbca1881f9226.issues: Offline evaluation in idealized scenarios of one model; linear temperature-only mapping may miss chemistry not tied to temperature and may not transfer across models.

8188e5a650b0977e1efd48a3989c999d27cb3301.goal: Tests whether the Transformer, dominant in other sequence tasks, can surpass LSTM for daily streamflow prediction and what this reveals about the limits of hydrologic predictability.
8188e5a650b0977e1efd48a3989c999d27cb3301.architecture: Vanilla transformer and a proposed recurrence-free transformer variant, benchmarked against LSTM, including merging multiple meteorological forcing datasets.
8188e5a650b0977e1efd48a3989c999d27cb3301.data: CAMELS catchment dataset (US basins) with daily forcings and streamflow, the standard rainfall-runoff benchmark.
8188e5a650b0977e1efd48a3989c999d27cb3301.result: The vanilla transformer is not competitive with LSTM, lagging especially on high-flow metrics; the recurrence-free variant reaches mixed parity, matching LSTM Kling-Gupta efficiency.
8188e5a650b0977e1efd48a3989c999d27cb3301.open_work: Further transformer modifications and testing whether non-recurrent models gain from larger datasets and knowledge storage.
8188e5a650b0977e1efd48a3989c999d27cb3301.issues: Results tied to one benchmark; the authors link the lack of advantage to the Markovian nature of the problem, and current skill may already be near the dataset limit.

75670a8c9d0dd3ec1c629fe3751c0e73a26d09c0.goal: Assessing whether CNN-based perfect-prognosis downscaling can extrapolate to future climate and produce a multi-model ensemble of regional projections for CORDEX.
75670a8c9d0dd3ec1c629fe3751c0e73a26d09c0.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) perfect-prognosis downscaling model (DeepESD) applied to the output of multiple GCMs.
75670a8c9d0dd3ec1c629fe3751c0e73a26d09c0.data: Trained on reanalysis predictors (ERA-Interim) and E-OBS observations; applied to eight CMIP5 GCMs over the EUR-44 (0.5°) domain and compared with the EURO-CORDEX RCM ensemble.
75670a8c9d0dd3ec1c629fe3751c0e73a26d09c0.result: DeepESD reduces historical distributional biases, gives climate change signals broadly comparable to RCMs, preserves inter-model spread for temperature and reduces it for precipitation.
75670a8c9d0dd3ec1c629fe3751c0e73a26d09c0.open_work: Further evaluating extrapolation under strong warming and extending the approach to other domains and variables.
75670a8c9d0dd3ec1c629fe3751c0e73a26d09c0.issues: Perfect-prognosis assumptions and stationarity of learned links under future climate cannot be fully verified; reduced precipitation spread may be an artefact.

a17d9c50d989dff7957e8c1d220aca1ac34cc768.goal: Improving NCEP GFS forecasts of integrated vapor transport, the defining field of atmospheric rivers that deliver much of western US precipitation.
a17d9c50d989dff7957e8c1d220aca1ac34cc768.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) used as a postprocessing framework on the GFS IVT forecast field.
a17d9c50d989dff7957e8c1d220aca1ac34cc768.data: GFS IVT forecasts over the Eastern Pacific and western United States at leads from 3 hours to 7 days, verified against reanalysis-based IVT.
a17d9c50d989dff7957e8c1d220aca1ac34cc768.result: RMSE falls by 9-17% and correlation rises by 0.5-12% across leads, about a one- to two-day lead time gain; mainly random error and conditional biases are reduced.
a17d9c50d989dff7957e8c1d220aca1ac34cc768.open_work: Extending to precipitation impacts, probabilistic outputs and other forecast systems or regions.
a17d9c50d989dff7957e8c1d220aca1ac34cc768.issues: Deterministic postprocessing of a single model; gains in systematic error vanish after about five days, and extreme-event performance is not isolated.

0b0fb9823a797155be2716f7be688ef88e5755f3.goal: Estimating sea ice concentration from SAR imagery during freeze-up, when automated retrievals are difficult, to support ice charting.
0b0fb9823a797155be2716f7be688ef88e5755f3.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) on SAR image patches, compared with an MLP using hand-crafted features and with the ARTIST sea ice (ASI) passive microwave algorithm.
0b0fb9823a797155be2716f7be688ef88e5755f3.data: RADARSAT-2 SAR scenes over the Gulf of St. Lawrence during freeze-up, with image analysis ice charts as reference and passive microwave brightness temperatures for ASI.
0b0fb9823a797155be2716f7be688ef88e5755f3.result: The CNN gives less noisy estimates closer to the ice charts, with lower bias and RMS difference than the MLP or ASI; patch size, depth and incidence angle effects are reported.
0b0fb9823a797155be2716f7be688ef88e5755f3.open_work: Testing other seasons and regions and higher-resolution reference data.
0b0fb9823a797155be2716f7be688ef88e5755f3.issues: Single region and season; ice chart reference is itself coarse and subjective; little data and no uncertainty estimate.

e9c46542a757f5e5f21fa98fddecdbfd5a1754b2.goal: Studying how training data quantity, heterogeneity and catchment characteristics affect deep learning flood prediction in ungauged catchments.
e9c46542a757f5e5f21fa98fddecdbfd5a1754b2.architecture: Encoder-decoder LSTM (ED-LSTM) for 6-hour lead runoff prediction, trained as local, regional and prediction-in-ungauged-basins models.
e9c46542a757f5e5f21fa98fddecdbfd5a1754b2.data: Rainfall and runoff data from 35 mountainous catchments in China.
e9c46542a757f5e5f21fa98fddecdbfd5a1754b2.result: Both the number and the hydroclimatic heterogeneity of gauged training catchments improve ungauged prediction; performance is worst in more arid catchments.
e9c46542a757f5e5f21fa98fddecdbfd5a1754b2.open_work: Building representative training datasets and testing in other regions and lead times.
e9c46542a757f5e5f21fa98fddecdbfd5a1754b2.issues: Limited to 35 catchments in one country; poor skill in arid basins; short 6-hour lead only.

8e5a144667571360401cfd88a170fa0b019d262a.goal: Multisite statistical downscaling of temperature and precipitation that can predict at arbitrary locations, including sites without training data.
8e5a144667571360401cfd88a170fa0b019d262a.architecture: Convolutional conditional neural process (convCNP), a deep learning model for off-the-grid spatio-temporal data.
8e5a144667571360401cfd88a170fa0b019d262a.data: VALUE intercomparison experiment over Europe, with reanalysis (ERA-Interim) predictors and station observations.
8e5a144667571360401cfd88a170fa0b019d262a.result: The convCNP outperforms an ensemble of existing downscaling methods and a Gaussian-process interpolation baseline at unseen sites, with large gains for extreme precipitation.
8e5a144667571360401cfd88a170fa0b019d262a.open_work: Applying to GCM projections for climate impact studies and further deep learning downscaling research.
8e5a144667571360401cfd88a170fa0b019d262a.issues: Evaluated in the perfect-prognosis reanalysis setting; behaviour under future climate and GCM biases is untested.

556b84b86a17a1f41f569aca930b599fd0b83bdd.goal: Addressing poor reproducibility and inconsistent setups in ML for weather and climate by providing a standard open library.
556b84b86a17a1f41f569aca930b599fd0b83bdd.architecture: Benchmark library (ClimateLearn, PyTorch) with data pipelines, deep learning models such as transformers (ViT), ResNets and U-Nets plus baselines, and standard evaluation for forecasting and downscaling.
556b84b86a17a1f41f569aca930b599fd0b83bdd.data: ERA5 (including WeatherBench-style data), CMIP6 and PRISM datasets.
556b84b86a17a1f41f569aca930b599fd0b83bdd.result: Provides holistic pipelines and documentation and showcases comprehensive forecasting and downscaling experiments; described as the first large-scale open effort of its kind.
556b84b86a17a1f41f569aca930b599fd0b83bdd.open_work: Community growth, more tasks, models and datasets, and probabilistic evaluation.
556b84b86a17a1f41f569aca930b599fd0b83bdd.issues: A software resource rather than a new method; experiments are illustrative and at coarse resolution.

b41729e3ad7518e39b013d38b21524f9aff2035e.goal: Predicting photovoltaic power output when on-site weather measurements are unavailable by using numerical weather prediction data.
b41729e3ad7518e39b013d38b21524f9aff2035e.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) regression of PV power from temperature and solar irradiation inputs.
b41729e3ad7518e39b013d38b21524f9aff2035e.data: Power and weather monitoring from a PV installation in Puglia, southern Italy, and GDAS sflux model outputs, in three train/test scenarios.
b41729e3ad7518e39b013d38b21524f9aff2035e.result: NWP-driven ANN predicts PV output with less than 10% error even without in situ weather measurements.
b41729e3ad7518e39b013d38b21524f9aff2035e.open_work: Testing at more installations and with forecast rather than analysis weather data.
b41729e3ad7518e39b013d38b21524f9aff2035e.issues: Single installation; GDAS outputs are analyses, so operational forecast skill is not assessed.

0a38cf3122ba7930923de32489d0e980642f88b6.goal: Reducing the cost of radiative transfer in the super-parameterized E3SM by emulating it with neural networks.
0a38cf3122ba7930923de32489d0e980642f88b6.architecture: Deep neural networks emulating shortwave and longwave radiation parameterizations; layer type not specified in the abstract.
0a38cf3122ba7930923de32489d0e980642f88b6.data: Radiation inputs and outputs from SP-E3SM simulations for a specific set of initial conditions.
0a38cf3122ba7930923de32489d0e980642f88b6.result: Emulators reach 90-95% accuracy at 8-10 times lower cost, and differences from the original scheme are comparable to its internal variability.
0a38cf3122ba7930923de32489d0e980642f88b6.open_work: Generalizing to full model radiation and other parameterizations for seasonal and climate simulations.
0a38cf3122ba7930923de32489d0e980642f88b6.issues: Trained for specific initial conditions; long-term climate stability and generalization not shown.

3acc3415439737dd782439d7c0e12fda3046cfa7.goal: Improving imperfect physics-based models by learning to correct their errors each time step rather than replacing them with ML.
3acc3415439737dd782439d7c0e12fda3046cfa7.architecture: Machine learning empirical error correction of an imperfect dynamical model's tendencies; the abstract does not name the network family.
3acc3415439737dd782439d7c0e12fda3046cfa7.result: Corrected models are stable and improve both initialized prediction skill and long-term climate statistics, though climate gains are smaller than single-step tendency gains.
3acc3415439737dd782439d7c0e12fda3046cfa7.open_work: Methods targeting longer timescales and application to full weather and climate models.
3acc3415439737dd782439d7c0e12fda3046cfa7.issues: Idealized Lorenz-96 setting only; improvement in long-term statistics is limited.

2dca71259f12ee362af4f9e656c0c7c5e794874f.goal: Extending Indian Ocean Dipole prediction skill beyond the roughly three-month limit of current models.
2dca71259f12ee362af4f9e656c0c7c5e794874f.architecture: Multi-task deep learning model (MTL-NET); the specific network family is not stated in the abstract.
2dca71259f12ee362af4f9e656c0c7c5e794874f.data: Hindcasts of IOD events over the past four decades, compared with dynamical forecast models.
2dca71259f12ee362af4f9e656c0c7c5e794874f.result: MTL-NET predicts the IOD well up to 7 months ahead, outperforming most dynamical models compared, and identifies predictor importance and nonlinear links.
2dca71259f12ee362af4f9e656c0c7c5e794874f.open_work: Operational use and extension to other climate modes.
2dca71259f12ee362af4f9e656c0c7c5e794874f.issues: Few independent IOD events in four decades; risk of overfitting and sensitivity to predictor choice.

2cdaf09b91ef729e762a184457d5d4dc7e736783.goal: Learning stable and accurate subgrid-scale closures for large-eddy simulation when high-fidelity training data are scarce.
2cdaf09b91ef729e762a184457d5d4dc7e736783.architecture: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) with physics constraints: rotational data augmentation, group-equivariant convolutions (GCNN), and an enstrophy-transfer conservation loss.
2cdaf09b91ef729e762a184457d5d4dc7e736783.data: Several setups of forced 2D turbulence, with a 40-fold reduced training set for the small-data regime.
2cdaf09b91ef729e762a184457d5d4dc7e736783.result: Physics-agnostic CNNs degrade with little data; augmentation and GCNN each restore accurate stable closures, and GCNN plus conservation loss performs best a posteriori.
2cdaf09b91ef729e762a184457d5d4dc7e736783.open_work: Extension to 3D turbulence and geophysical flows.

4ad6db7460d8e8812486c772f95fd1f7a26c0fe7.goal: Producing reliable probabilistic subseasonal (weeks 1-4) precipitation forecasts over California, where NWP skill is low.
4ad6db7460d8e8812486c772f95fd1f7a26c0fe7.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) predicting category probability shifts relative to climatology, plus a convolutional neural network (CNN) extension using images of large-scale predictors.
4ad6db7460d8e8812486c772f95fd1f7a26c0fe7.data: ECMWF ensemble reforecasts and gridded observed 7-day precipitation accumulations over California, up to 4-week leads.
4ad6db7460d8e8812486c772f95fd1f7a26c0fe7.result: Both methods compare favorably with a state-of-the-art postprocessing technique, with positive skill everywhere, though skill is low at weeks 3 and 4.
4ad6db7460d8e8812486c772f95fd1f7a26c0fe7.open_work: Exploring additional sources of subseasonal predictability.
4ad6db7460d8e8812486c772f95fd1f7a26c0fe7.issues: Low week-3/4 skill; a single region.

260c4400b70772c11db774194a443ae81e26aebe.goal: Downscaling Indian summer monsoon rainfall to higher spatial resolution for model validation and local monitoring.
260c4400b70772c11db774194a443ae81e26aebe.architecture: Super-resolution convolutional neural networks (CNN): SRCNN, stacked SRCNN and DeepSD.
260c4400b70772c11db774194a443ae81e26aebe.data: IMD gridded rainfall and TRMM data downscaled up to 4x, plus ERA5 reanalysis rainfall as an application.
260c4400b70772c11db774194a443ae81e26aebe.result: All DL methods beat linear interpolation up to 4x; DeepSD gives the best spatial distribution and lowest RMSE, and downscaled ERA5 shows better spatial covariance and temporal variance.
260c4400b70772c11db774194a443ae81e26aebe.open_work: Developing an operational deep learning downscaling model for Indian monsoon rainfall.
260c4400b70772c11db774194a443ae81e26aebe.issues: Spatial discontinuities in rainfall limit skill; only interpolation as baseline.

496b621502292727681dec0df1a8567212d5e128.goal: Assessing and interpreting a spatiotemporal deep learning architecture for regional streamflow modelling.
496b621502292727681dec0df1a8567212d5e128.architecture: Convolutional long short-term memory network (ConvLSTM) with perturbation-based interpretation experiments.
496b621502292727681dec0df1a8567212d5e128.data: Gridded reanalysis climate forcing (ERA5) and observed daily streamflow at 226 gauges in southwestern Canada, 1980-2015.
496b621502292727681dec0df1a8567212d5e128.result: Median NSE 0.68 with 35% of stations above 0.8; the model focuses on in-basin inputs and responds physically to temperature perturbations, including glacier-dependent August sensitivity.
496b621502292727681dec0df1a8567212d5e128.open_work: Further interpretable deep learning hydrology and climate change scenario use.
496b621502292727681dec0df1a8567212d5e128.issues: Moderate median skill; sensitivity tests are not proof of physical process learning.

4682ccb94d5895e9fee6b5b5318dd641d83e075f.goal: Objectively defining global marine ecological provinces to tame complexity of ecosystem model output and community structure.
4682ccb94d5895e9fee6b5b5318dd641d83e075f.architecture: Unsupervised learning (SAGE method): t-SNE dimensionality reduction, DBSCAN clustering, and a connectivity graph to aggregate eco-provinces.
4682ccb94d5895e9fee6b5b5318dd641d83e075f.data: Plankton community structure and nutrient flux output from a global ecosystem model (the MIT Darwin model).
4682ccb94d5895e9fee6b5b5318dd641d83e075f.result: Over a hundred eco-provinces are identified and nested into robust aggregated eco-provinces, used to explore nutrient supply control on community structure.
4682ccb94d5895e9fee6b5b5318dd641d83e075f.open_work: Model intercomparison and monitoring of marine ecosystems with observations.
4682ccb94d5895e9fee6b5b5318dd641d83e075f.issues: Based on model output rather than observations; clustering depends on hyperparameter choices.

a3f065d517a85648944b23dbf3eaa707b536f2f9.goal: Reconstructing deep ocean current velocities from satellite surface observations.
a3f065d517a85648944b23dbf3eaa707b536f2f9.architecture: Iterative, modified self-organizing maps (SOM) exploiting local data-space correlations.
a3f065d517a85648944b23dbf3eaa707b536f2f9.data: Satellite surface velocity, sea surface height and sea surface temperature, with deep velocities from Argo floats at 1000 m.
a3f065d517a85648944b23dbf3eaa707b536f2f9.result: Speed RMSE of about 2.8 cm/s, more than a factor of two smaller than competing methods, with direction errors under 30°.
a3f065d517a85648944b23dbf3eaa707b536f2f9.open_work: Extending to other depths and regions.
a3f065d517a85648944b23dbf3eaa707b536f2f9.issues: Limited by Argo float coverage; single depth.

cb55413cf3e63dd643f2c565e9da4fd2cd734bfb.goal: Testing claims that data-driven weather models are unreliable for extreme events by comparing them with ECMWF's physics model.
cb55413cf3e63dd643f2c565e9da4fd2cd734bfb.architecture: Evaluation study comparing Pangu-Weather (transformer) and GraphCast (graph neural network) with the physics-based IFS HRES in a semi-operational setting.
cb55413cf3e63dd643f2c565e9da4fd2cd734bfb.data: Global near-surface temperature and wind speed forecasts at 1-10 day leads, with IFS HRES as the reference model.
cb55413cf3e63dd643f2c565e9da4fd2cd734bfb.result: Data-driven models mostly beat IFS HRES on global RMSE and compete on extremes in most regions, doing best for temperature extremes near the tropics at short leads.
cb55413cf3e63dd643f2c565e9da4fd2cd734bfb.open_work: Overcoming remaining challenges before operational implementation.
cb55413cf3e63dd643f2c565e9da4fd2cd734bfb.issues: Performance varies by region, extreme type and lead time; deterministic models only.

8d54b757e7ff99866a6cab1e5b0738e23009ad44.goal: Making the radiation calculation, the most expensive part of model physics, much faster in the NCEP Climate Forecast System via neural network emulation.
8d54b757e7ff99866a6cab1e5b0738e23009ad44.architecture: Neural network emulations (shallow multilayer perceptron, MLP) of the longwave and shortwave radiation parameterizations.
8d54b757e7ff99866a6cab1e5b0738e23009ad44.data: NCEP coupled Climate Forecast System with higher resolution and time-dependent CO2, validated by decadal climate simulation and seasonal predictions.
8d54b757e7ff99866a6cab1e5b0738e23009ad44.result: Emulations are on average 16x (longwave) and 60x (shortwave) faster, with differences within observation and reanalysis uncertainty and comparable to internal variability.
8d54b757e7ff99866a6cab1e5b0738e23009ad44.open_work: Practical use of full-radiation emulations in climate simulations and seasonal predictions.
8d54b757e7ff99866a6cab1e5b0738e23009ad44.issues: Emulation requires adjustments for model complexity; validity outside the training regime is not guaranteed.

80058584eb02a1f44e027a49bc45dbd76880c189.goal: Reducing the smoothing of ML weather forecasts at longer leads, which underestimates extreme weather intensity.
80058584eb02a1f44e027a49bc45dbd76880c189.architecture: Denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) applied to refine the surface output of the FuXi model (a transformer-based ML weather model).
80058584eb02a1f44e027a49bc45dbd76880c189.data: Five-day FuXi surface forecasts trained on ERA5 reanalysis, compared with ECMWF HRES; IBTrACS for tropical cyclone evaluation.
80058584eb02a1f44e027a49bc45dbd76880c189.result: FuXi-Extreme outperforms FuXi and HRES for extreme precipitation, 10 m wind and 2 m temperature; TC tracks better than HRES, but intensity worse.
80058584eb02a1f44e027a49bc45dbd76880c189.open_work: Improving tropical cyclone intensity forecasting and extending beyond 5 days.
80058584eb02a1f44e027a49bc45dbd76880c189.issues: TC intensity still inferior to HRES; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases.

484c923f4a8ec2716e27e56ad70cd8c66ed254a9.goal: Forecasting drought and explaining how input variables drive the forecasts.
484c923f4a8ec2716e27e56ad70cd8c66ed254a9.architecture: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model interpreted with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP).
484c923f4a8ec2716e27e56ad70cd8c66ed254a9.data: SPI-12 from monthly SILO rainfall, 1901-2018 (train 1901-2000, test 2001-2018), in four regions of New South Wales, Australia.
484c923f4a8ec2716e27e56ad70cd8c66ed254a9.result: SPI-12 forecasts at 3-month lead evaluated with R2, NSE and RMSE; SHAP shows variable impacts vary strongly in time and space, including during the Millennium Drought.
484c923f4a8ec2716e27e56ad70cd8c66ed254a9.open_work: Region- and period-specific interpretation of drought forecasting models.
484c923f4a8ec2716e27e56ad70cd8c66ed254a9.issues: Limited to four regions; SHAP explanations are model-dependent.

c1b529ea35d25ad349a045a5f09b1192bce50f11.goal: Using neural networks for data assimilation in streamflow forecasting by learning the mapping from streamflow to model states.
c1b529ea35d25ad349a045a5f09b1192bce50f11.architecture: Ensemble-based data assimilation with extreme learning machines (ELM) and multilayer perceptrons (MLP) applied to the GR4J lumped hydrological model.
c1b529ea35d25ad349a045a5f09b1192bce50f11.data: International testbed of four hydrologically dissimilar catchments.
c1b529ea35d25ad349a045a5f09b1192bce50f11.result: Neural network assimilation noticeably improves over OpenLoop simulation in all catchments, evaluated with CRPS.
c1b529ea35d25ad349a045a5f09b1192bce50f11.open_work: Applying to models with more state variables.
c1b529ea35d25ad349a045a5f09b1192bce50f11.issues: Proof of concept with only two state variables and four catchments.

ad911ba75e5791c1771148843a07ed9500283e9a.goal: Providing fast, nonlinear spatio-temporal climate change estimates for integrated assessment models as an alternative to pattern scaling.
ad911ba75e5791c1771148843a07ed9500283e9a.architecture: Non-neural statistical emulator: decomposition of climate change fields into dominant spatial patterns (principal components) with regression of their dependence on model inputs.
ad911ba75e5791c1771148843a07ed9500283e9a.data: Ensemble of simulations from an intermediate complexity AOGCM (GENIE-1) across greenhouse gas concentration profiles and model parameters.
ad911ba75e5791c1771148843a07ed9500283e9a.result: The emulator rapidly reconstructs a good approximation to simulated change for arbitrary concentration profiles without further simulation.
ad911ba75e5791c1771148843a07ed9500283e9a.open_work: Incorporating improved climate change calculations and location-dependent uncertainty into integrated assessment.
ad911ba75e5791c1771148843a07ed9500283e9a.issues: Inherits limitations of the intermediate complexity model.

291f050f7c66ee9c1605ac232fd2ab33d788a122.goal: Improving long-term streamflow prediction in a poorly gauged basin, as implied by the title.
291f050f7c66ee9c1605ac232fd2ab33d788a122.architecture: Attention-based deep learning compared with other models; specific network family not specified in the available metadata.
291f050f7c66ee9c1605ac232fd2ab33d788a122.data: Geo-spatiotemporal mesoscale data for a poorly gauged basin; details not available.
291f050f7c66ee9c1605ac232fd2ab33d788a122.result: Not reported; the title implies attention-based deep learning improves long-term streamflow prediction.
291f050f7c66ee9c1605ac232fd2ab33d788a122.open_work: Not reported; likely transfer to other poorly gauged basins.

f7d7c0b4db87f65a9819246689cda6b2395ae00e.goal: Updating NCAR's wind power forecasting system with Xcel Energy to cover short-term forecasting, uncertainty and extreme events alongside day-ahead prediction.
f7d7c0b4db87f65a9819246689cda6b2395ae00e.architecture: Operational system integrating NWP with machine learning power conversion, analog ensemble uncertainty, radar-based VDRAS and an expert system for ramps, and fuzzy logic for icing and high winds; ML family not specified.
f7d7c0b4db87f65a9819246689cda6b2395ae00e.data: NWP output and wind farm power and observation data from Xcel Energy operations.
f7d7c0b4db87f65a9819246689cda6b2395ae00e.result: Quantile-based data quality control improves power conversion accuracy; the system and its advances are described and assessed.
f7d7c0b4db87f65a9819246689cda6b2395ae00e.open_work: Further integration of ML and NWP components.
f7d7c0b4db87f65a9819246689cda6b2395ae00e.issues: System description; component-level evaluation details are limited.

1d5bf49e91ea6bbc81386cde994c5d6881eb2f66.goal: Weekly prediction of daily Pan-Arctic sea ice concentration during the melting season.
1d5bf49e91ea6bbc81386cde994c5d6881eb2f66.architecture: SICNet: encoder-decoder fully convolutional network (FCN) with a temporal-spatial attention module.
1d5bf49e91ea6bbc81386cde994c5d6881eb2f66.data: NSIDC satellite-derived SIC at 25 km, 1988-2015 training and 2016-2020 testing.
1d5bf49e91ea6bbc81386cde994c5d6881eb2f66.result: Weekly prediction MAE 2.67%, MAPE 8.67%, NSE 0.978; 28-day sea ice extent binary accuracy above 90%, beating persistence.
1d5bf49e91ea6bbc81386cde994c5d6881eb2f66.open_work: Extending to longer leads and other seasons.
1d5bf49e91ea6bbc81386cde994c5d6881eb2f66.issues: Melting season only; recursive prediction degrades with lead.

3ea0be3cdb4fcfe4c8d884ce51aada3e3275e4fe.goal: Reconstructing high-resolution weather and climate data from low-resolution simulations or observations.
3ea0be3cdb4fcfe4c8d884ce51aada3e3275e4fe.architecture: Multiple deep convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, including deconvolutional and error-predicting networks.
3ea0be3cdb4fcfe4c8d884ce51aada3e3275e4fe.data: Numerical simulation and observed meteorological data at various resolutions.
3ea0be3cdb4fcfe4c8d884ce51aada3e3275e4fe.result: Error-predicting networks are less suitable than deconvolutional networks for high-frequency fields like precipitation; the best architecture depends on the variable.
3ea0be3cdb4fcfe4c8d884ce51aada3e3275e4fe.open_work: Integrating convolutional downscaling into weather and climate analysis.
3ea0be3cdb4fcfe4c8d884ce51aada3e3275e4fe.issues: No single best architecture across variables.

88851b06349b27b322f4dc1e05ad1ca8a8d1b74c.goal: Tests whether neural networks can replace two-moment warm-rain microphysics parameterizations (autoconversion, accretion, self-collection) and what limits such emulators.
88851b06349b27b322f4dc1e05ad1ca8a8d1b74c.architecture: Neural networks trained separately for each warm-rain process rate; the specific network family is not stated in the abstract.
88851b06349b27b322f4dc1e05ad1ca8a8d1b74c.data: Benchmark process rates from Monte Carlo superdroplet solutions of the kinetic collection equation, which are reliable but noisy.
88851b06349b27b322f4dc1e05ad1ca8a8d1b74c.result: The networks predict process rates skillfully on test data, but solutions of the resulting ODE system are worse than an established warm-rain parameterization.
88851b06349b27b322f4dc1e05ad1ca8a8d1b74c.open_work: Use machine learning methods that include a notion of time derivatives, and revisit the possibly ill-posed formulation of two-moment warm-rain schemes.
88851b06349b27b322f4dc1e05ad1ca8a8d1b74c.issues: Good offline skill does not carry over to integrated ODE solutions; noisy training targets; idealized box-model setting without coupling to a full atmospheric model.

b9f96ba0e62911ff519853fca3c677aec3589fbf.goal: Corrects climate model biases beyond low-order statistics while keeping spatiotemporal consistency and dependence on the model's resolved dynamics.
b9f96ba0e62911ff519853fca3c677aec3589fbf.architecture: Regularized Adversarial Domain Adaptation (RADA): discriminative neural networks separate simulation from observation samples, guiding domain-adaptation networks regularized by cycle-consistent statistical and dynamical constraints, a GAN-style adversarial setup.
b9f96ba0e62911ff519853fca3c677aec3589fbf.data: Historical climate simulations and observations of daily precipitation over the contiguous United States at about 1° resolution; specific model and observation products are not named in the abstract.
b9f96ba0e62911ff519853fca3c677aec3589fbf.result: Corrects all considered moments of daily precipitation, preserves spatiotemporal consistency and inter-field correlations, and discriminates between dynamical conditions.
b9f96ba0e62911ff519853fca3c677aec3589fbf.open_work: Apply to other variables and regions and use it to disentangle parameterization biases from chaotic climate variability in projections.
b9f96ba0e62911ff519853fca3c677aec3589fbf.issues: Demonstrated on a single variable and region; correcting future projections assumes the learned bias mapping holds under climate change; adversarial training can be unstable.

4687b8de574c983e7e0afde9045c82f8f78cc7a6.goal: Reviews radar-based precipitation nowcasting (lead times under about two hours) and machine learning methods that could improve it, motivated by warning needs for heavy rain and flooding.
4687b8de574c983e7e0afde9045c82f8f78cc7a6.architecture: Review of extrapolation-based radar nowcasting from environmental science and of applicable statistical and machine learning techniques.
4687b8de574c983e7e0afde9045c82f8f78cc7a6.data: Review; covers methods built mainly on rainfall radar observations.
4687b8de574c983e7e0afde9045c82f8f78cc7a6.result: Finds that operational nowcasting relies largely on simple extrapolation of radar observations and identifies machine learning approaches that could be transferred to the problem.
4687b8de574c983e7e0afde9045c82f8f78cc7a6.open_work: Closer partnerships between environmental science and machine learning communities to develop and test new nowcasting methods.
4687b8de574c983e7e0afde9045c82f8f78cc7a6.issues: Written in 2020, before many diffusion and large generative nowcasting models; qualitative review without a common benchmark.

d85b1dca3f5b3f2f618a8cb694e850c7a44ff4fe.goal: Improves seasonal drought prediction over China by combining dynamical forecasts with a data-driven model, as implied by the title.
d85b1dca3f5b3f2f618a8cb694e850c7a44ff4fe.architecture: Hybrid of dynamical model forecasts and LSTM networks, as stated in the title; details of the coupling are not available.
d85b1dca3f5b3f2f618a8cb694e850c7a44ff4fe.data: Not reported (abstract missing); presumably seasonal dynamical forecasts and drought indices over China.
d85b1dca3f5b3f2f618a8cb694e850c7a44ff4fe.result: Not reported (abstract missing); the title implies the hybrid improves seasonal drought predictions over dynamical forecasts alone.
d85b1dca3f5b3f2f618a8cb694e850c7a44ff4fe.open_work: Not reported; extension to other regions and lead times and comparison with other hybrid designs would follow naturally.
d85b1dca3f5b3f2f618a8cb694e850c7a44ff4fe.issues: Abstract unavailable, so data, skill metrics and baselines cannot be verified from this record.

4a809d5d1bb84814216ef740feb6135022492170.goal: Makes super-parameterization affordable by integrating the small-scale equations data-drivenly, and studies generalization to more chaotic systems.
4a809d5d1bb84814216ef740feb6135022492170.architecture: Data-driven super-parameterization (DD-SP) using recurrent neural networks to advance small-scale variables, compared with data-driven parameterization and physics-based parameterized low-resolution models; transfer learning for generalization.
4a809d5d1bb84814216ef740feb6135022492170.data: Multiscale Lorenz 96 systems with varying scale separation and chaoticity.
4a809d5d1bb84814216ef740feb6135022492170.result: At equal cost DD-SP substantially beats parameterized low-resolution models and DD-P, matches full SP in long-term statistics, and is often comparable in short-term forecasts; transfer learning with little new data greatly improves generalization.
4a809d5d1bb84814216ef740feb6135022492170.open_work: Apply DD-SP and transfer learning to realistic weather and climate models.
4a809d5d1bb84814216ef740feb6135022492170.issues: Idealized Lorenz 96 testbed only; models trained on one system often fail to generalize to a more chaotic one without retraining.

7d6f322b49da8346c3fcc0d879ba2e77c5e22f55.goal: Asks whether transfer learning can improve hydrological predictions in data-limited Alpine regions, as implied by the title.
7d6f322b49da8346c3fcc0d879ba2e77c5e22f55.architecture: Transfer learning of a deep learning hydrological model; the network family is not specified in the available record.
7d6f322b49da8346c3fcc0d879ba2e77c5e22f55.data: Not reported (abstract missing); Alpine catchments implied by the title.
7d6f322b49da8346c3fcc0d879ba2e77c5e22f55.open_work: Not reported; testing transfer across more regions and hydrological variables would follow naturally.
7d6f322b49da8346c3fcc0d879ba2e77c5e22f55.issues: Abstract unavailable, so data, architecture and the size of any gain cannot be verified from this record.

d38ebbb21721b1392af500c7872fe20e7f162053.goal: Provides high-resolution regional climate information with uncertainty estimates, avoiding the cost of dynamical downscaling and the uncertainty of deterministic statistical downscaling.
d38ebbb21721b1392af500c7872fe20e7f162053.architecture: Diffusion probabilistic downscaling model (DPDM), a denoising diffusion model that samples ensembles of high-resolution fields.
d38ebbb21721b1392af500c7872fe20e7f162053.data: Surface variables over East Asia downscaled from 1° to 0.1°; source training products are not named in the abstract. Used to build a 180-year monthly dataset.
d38ebbb21721b1392af500c7872fe20e7f162053.result: Gives more accurate local detail than deterministic downscaling schemes and large ensembles for uncertainty; produces a 180-year monthly East Asian surface climate reconstruction.
d38ebbb21721b1392af500c7872fe20e7f162053.open_work: Extend to daily or sub-daily variables and other regions, and validate the long reconstruction against independent historical observations.
d38ebbb21721b1392af500c7872fe20e7f162053.issues: Long-period reconstruction assumes stationarity of the learned mapping; monthly variables only; quantitative skill numbers not given in the abstract.

94ee5f3f848a9d2bfbfb76ac5e2c06001e97a425.goal: Prospectus on how the end of Dennard scaling will change computational weather and climate science and the role machine learning may play.
94ee5f3f848a9d2bfbfb76ac5e2c06001e97a425.architecture: Perspective essay, not a new method; discusses data-driven pattern recognition versus learning that remains expressed in equations, and hybrids of the two.
94ee5f3f848a9d2bfbfb76ac5e2c06001e97a425.data: Not applicable; perspective drawing on the history of numerical weather prediction and climate modeling.
94ee5f3f848a9d2bfbfb76ac5e2c06001e97a425.result: Argues that steadily adding resolution and complexity is ending and that ML-based and equation-based approaches, or a synthesis, will reshape climate modeling.
94ee5f3f848a9d2bfbfb76ac5e2c06001e97a425.open_work: Developing methods that combine physical knowledge, computation and data, such as learned parameterizations and emulators that retain physical insight.
94ee5f3f848a9d2bfbfb76ac5e2c06001e97a425.issues: Qualitative outlook without quantitative evaluation; predictions about future computing are speculative.

6479cf67709aca31dd2e60747a231fe8311f8d82.goal: Prevents nonphysical predictions from neural network surrogates of atmospheric chemistry by enforcing conservation laws in the architecture.
6479cf67709aca31dd2e60747a231fe8311f8d82.architecture: Physics-constrained neural network with a physically interpretable hidden layer that predicts fluxes between species, which are then mapped to concentrations so atom balance holds by construction; compared with a naive neural network.
6479cf67709aca31dd2e60747a231fe8311f8d82.data: Simulations from a Julia-based photochemical box model (v0.2.0).
6479cf67709aca31dd2e60747a231fe8311f8d82.result: The surrogate conserves atoms to machine precision and outperforms a naive neural network in accuracy and non-negativity of concentrations.
6479cf67709aca31dd2e60747a231fe8311f8d82.open_work: Scale to larger chemical mechanisms and couple the surrogate into 3D air quality or chemistry-climate models.
6479cf67709aca31dd2e60747a231fe8311f8d82.issues: Tested on a box-model photochemical mechanism only; online stability and performance in a full chemical transport model are not shown.

975fcde2c2e21431bdad5a9f2fc2c80be1e5b6f4.goal: Makes LSTM streamflow models more interpretable by giving the architecture a structure analogous to a hydrological storage system.
975fcde2c2e21431bdad5a9f2fc2c80be1e5b6f4.architecture: HydroLSTM, a modified LSTM that updates a Markovian storage while gates access lagged historical inputs; compared with a standard LSTM.
975fcde2c2e21431bdad5a9f2fc2c80be1e5b6f4.data: 10 hydro-climatically varied catchments for performance comparison and 588 catchments across the USA for analysing lagged-input weights.
975fcde2c2e21431bdad5a9f2fc2c80be1e5b6f4.result: HydroLSTM needs fewer cell states for similar performance, and its lagged-input weights are interpretable and match regional regimes (snowmelt, recent rainfall, historical rainfall dominated).
975fcde2c2e21431bdad5a9f2fc2c80be1e5b6f4.open_work: Extend interpretable architectural modifications to multi-output models and other hydrological processes.
975fcde2c2e21431bdad5a9f2fc2c80be1e5b6f4.issues: Interpretability shown through weight patterns rather than independent process measurements; performance comparison on only 10 catchments.

dfc9c7dc9330193b3b19a6400fcf7d776e45791c.goal: Tests LSTM stream temperature prediction in unmonitored and dammed basins and how to assemble training sets by data availability.
dfc9c7dc9330193b3b19a6400fcf7d776e45791c.architecture: Basin-centric LSTM network with an input-selection ensemble.
dfc9c7dc9330193b3b19a6400fcf7d776e45791c.data: New benchmark of more than 400 basins across the contiguous United States grouped by daily sampling frequency, with and without major dams.
dfc9c7dc9330193b3b19a6400fcf7d776e45791c.result: In unmonitored basins RMSE is 1.129°C and R² 0.983; for unmonitored dammed basins median RMSE is 1.202°C and R² 0.984, far better than traditional models in spatial extrapolation.
dfc9c7dc9330193b3b19a6400fcf7d776e45791c.open_work: Add inputs describing latent processes such as geology and wetland cover, and represent reservoir operations explicitly.
dfc9c7dc9330193b3b19a6400fcf7d776e45791c.issues: Inputs miss influential latent processes; attribute overfitting is only moderately mitigated; limited to CONUS basins.

841015849a9bde6d95b60143dad2b9f429a08ae5.goal: Builds a task-independent stochastic model of atmospheric dynamics that serves many applications without task-specific training.
841015849a9bde6d95b60143dad2b9f429a08ae5.architecture: AtmoRep, a large-scale transformer-based representation-learning model with a self-supervised objective and an ensemble that samples stochastic variability.
841015849a9bde6d95b60143dad2b9f429a08ae5.data: ERA5 reanalysis as the historical trajectory; radar observations used for fine-tuning.
841015849a9bde6d95b60143dad2b9f429a08ae5.result: Skillful nowcasting, temporal interpolation, model correction and counterfactuals without task-specific training; improves with additional data such as radar and extends to downscaling.
841015849a9bde6d95b60143dad2b9f429a08ae5.open_work: Incorporate more observation types, extend to further downstream tasks, and scale model and data.
841015849a9bde6d95b60143dad2b9f429a08ae5.issues: Trained on reanalysis, so it inherits its biases; very high training cost; ensemble calibration and long-range forecast skill not fully established.

bdbac487a2662f203c7bc434409723cf2e4cd836.goal: Provides calibrated uncertainty for deep learning predictions of skewed, discrete-continuous variables such as precipitation in statistical downscaling.
bdbac487a2662f203c7bc434409723cf2e4cd836.architecture: Discrete-continuous Bayesian deep learning model with Gaussian and lognormal likelihoods, capturing aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, applied to DeepSD, a super-resolution CNN for statistical downscaling.
bdbac487a2662f203c7bc434409723cf2e4cd836.data: Precipitation downscaling over the United States; specific observation products are not named in the abstract.
bdbac487a2662f203c7bc434409723cf2e4cd836.result: Discrete-continuous models beat a basic Gaussian in accuracy and calibration, and the lognormal likelihood gives good uncertainty at the extremes.
bdbac487a2662f203c7bc434409723cf2e4cd836.open_work: Apply to other skewed variables and to downscaling of climate projections.
bdbac487a2662f203c7bc434409723cf2e4cd836.issues: Approximate Bayesian inference may misstate epistemic uncertainty; evaluation limited to precipitation.

0600a6b585e8b7f23d12ee1e3af52e7524f47aeb.goal: Explains how to re-train neural networks for out-of-distribution generalization and what physics they learn during transfer learning.
0600a6b585e8b7f23d12ee1e3af52e7524f47aeb.architecture: Convolutional neural networks for subgrid-scale closure, analysed with spectral (Fourier) analysis of both the flow and the learned kernels.
0600a6b585e8b7f23d12ee1e3af52e7524f47aeb.data: Several setups of 2D turbulence used for subgrid-scale modeling.
0600a6b585e8b7f23d12ee1e3af52e7524f47aeb.result: CNN kernels act as low-, high-, band-pass and Gabor filters; the shallowest convolution layers are best to re-train, contrary to common ML practice.
0600a6b585e8b7f23d12ee1e3af52e7524f47aeb.open_work: Extend the framework to 3D turbulence and climate models to guide explainable transfer learning.
0600a6b585e8b7f23d12ee1e3af52e7524f47aeb.issues: Demonstrated only on 2D turbulence; findings may not transfer to other architectures or realistic geophysical flows.

fd2e9437ef3ec1cccd9e10dce042e0bb6c3eb820.goal: Reviews research on trust and trustworthiness of AI in the environmental sciences and proposes a research agenda.
fd2e9437ef3ec1cccd9e10dce042e0bb6c3eb820.architecture: Review and synthesis of trust, risk communication and human-AI teaming research; no model is developed.
fd2e9437ef3ec1cccd9e10dce042e0bb6c3eb820.data: Not applicable; draws on literature and applied examples from environmental science.
fd2e9437ef3ec1cccd9e10dce042e0bb6c3eb820.result: Finds persisting ambiguity and measurement gaps in trust research and stresses engaging users and stakeholders and co-development of AI.
fd2e9437ef3ec1cccd9e10dce042e0bb6c3eb820.open_work: Reconcile performance-based trustworthiness standards with contextual notions of trust and study trust in operational AI use.
fd2e9437ef3ec1cccd9e10dce042e0bb6c3eb820.issues: Conceptual review without empirical tests of the agenda.

800c28e1e4b8ecae2d489628c3908315f2ca572b.goal: Models spatial dependence of climate extremes for risk assessment, overcoming limits of standard multivariate extreme value models and of plain GANs.
800c28e1e4b8ecae2d489628c3908315f2ca572b.architecture: evtGAN, a generative adversarial network combined with extreme value theory for marginals.
800c28e1e4b8ecae2d489628c3908315f2ca572b.data: A stationary 2000-year climate model simulation (EC-Earth large ensemble) of summer temperature maxima and winter precipitation maxima over western Europe.
800c28e1e4b8ecae2d489628c3908315f2ca572b.result: evtGAN beats classical GANs and standard statistical approaches; about 50 years of data already gives reasonable performance; temperature dependence is captured better than precipitation.
800c28e1e4b8ecae2d489628c3908315f2ca572b.open_work: Apply to other climate variables and use as an emulator of long climate model runs.
800c28e1e4b8ecae2d489628c3908315f2ca572b.issues: Validated on model data rather than observations; precipitation extremes are captured less well; assumes stationarity.

de05c5a26a013727d3c0bb7a1206b1ba82aa16a0.goal: Evaluates data-driven subgrid-scale closures for large eddy simulation of 2D Kraichnan turbulence in a priori tests.
de05c5a26a013727d3c0bb7a1206b1ba82aa16a0.architecture: Multilayer feedforward neural network (MLP) with point-to-point and stencil mappings, and a convolutional neural network on whole-domain snapshots; compared with the dynamic Smagorinsky model.
de05c5a26a013727d3c0bb7a1206b1ba82aa16a0.data: High-resolution simulations of 2D Kraichnan turbulence filtered to a coarse grid.
de05c5a26a013727d3c0bb7a1206b1ba82aa16a0.result: Data-driven closures are compared by correlation with true stresses and stress PDFs; an MLP that learns the dynamic Smagorinsky eddy viscosity gives computational savings.
de05c5a26a013727d3c0bb7a1206b1ba82aa16a0.open_work: A posteriori tests in coupled LES and extension to 3D and geophysical turbulence.
de05c5a26a013727d3c0bb7a1206b1ba82aa16a0.issues: A priori only, so stability when coupled online is untested; idealized 2D turbulence.

e8d1e3d897374af92ed687020e9ecd121658762d.goal: Turns single deterministic forecasts of atmospheric river vapor transport into reliable probabilistic forecasts with deep learning post-processing.
e8d1e3d897374af92ed687020e9ecd121658762d.architecture: Deep learning post-processing methods producing probabilistic IVT forecasts; the specific network family is not stated in the abstract. Compared with the Analog Ensemble and neural-network-calibrated GEFS.
e8d1e3d897374af92ed687020e9ecd121658762d.data: 34-year West-WRF reforecast of integrated vapor transport over the North American West Coast; GEFS as benchmark.
e8d1e3d897374af92ed687020e9ecd121658762d.result: DL methods match or beat calibrated GEFS at 0–48 h and 72–120 h for AR events in CRPSS and BSS, and roughly 10 years of hindcasts are needed to compete with GEFS.
e8d1e3d897374af92ed687020e9ecd121658762d.open_work: Extend to other variables such as precipitation and to longer leads, and test on operational systems.
e8d1e3d897374af92ed687020e9ecd121658762d.issues: Needs long reforecasts; skill gap around 48–72 h; probabilistic spread derived from a single deterministic member.

c63a7b0f7abeba90964ada0b1d2d7cf35b44be1f.goal: Tunes a global climate model systematically against process-level large-eddy simulation references to avoid error compensation from by-hand tuning.
c63a7b0f7abeba90964ada0b1d2d7cf35b44be1f.architecture: History matching with statistical emulators (Gaussian process emulators) of single-column model metrics to rule out implausible parameter regions; not a neural network method.
c63a7b0f7abeba90964ada0b1d2d7cf35b44be1f.data: Single-column LMDZ 6A configurations on boundary-layer and cloud test cases with reference LES, followed by global LMDZ simulations.
c63a7b0f7abeba90964ada0b1d2d7cf35b44be1f.result: Automatically reaches a tuning as good as the hand-tuned 6A version for a modified boundary layer and speeds up introduction of new parameterizations.
c63a7b0f7abeba90964ada0b1d2d7cf35b44be1f.open_work: Extend to more processes and to full coupled models, combining process-level and global targets.
c63a7b0f7abeba90964ada0b1d2d7cf35b44be1f.issues: Depends on available LES cases and chosen metrics; emulator accuracy limits how well the parameter space is constrained.

9cad471ae3685dcd10a461d08e378a2b08516969.goal: Shows that generative ML can solve atmospheric remote sensing problems by reconstructing 2D cloud vertical structure from passive imagery.
9cad471ae3685dcd10a461d08e378a2b08516969.architecture: Conditional generative adversarial network (CGAN) built from convolutional neural networks, with probabilistic outputs for uncertainty.
9cad471ae3685dcd10a461d08e378a2b08516969.data: CloudSat radar reflectivity profiles as targets and collocated MODIS measurements as inputs.
9cad471ae3685dcd10a461d08e378a2b08516969.result: Usually generates plausible cloud structures, including multilayer clouds, and estimates its own uncertainty; network sensitivity to each input is analysed.
9cad471ae3685dcd10a461d08e378a2b08516969.open_work: Apply GANs to other remote sensing and atmospheric problems with complex spatial structure.
9cad471ae3685dcd10a461d08e378a2b08516969.issues: Limited to the CloudSat-MODIS overlap track; generated structures are plausible rather than exact, especially for features not visible to MODIS.

9c0161ac8c3995be0ca1c224619b17e598205766.goal: Improves ENSO prediction with a hybrid neural network model combined with principal oscillation pattern analysis, as implied by the title.
9c0161ac8c3995be0ca1c224619b17e598205766.architecture: Hybrid neural network model with principal oscillation pattern (POP) analysis; the network family is not specified in the available record.
9c0161ac8c3995be0ca1c224619b17e598205766.data: Not reported (abstract missing); presumably tropical Pacific SST-related fields.
9c0161ac8c3995be0ca1c224619b17e598205766.open_work: Not reported; comparison with dynamical and deep learning ENSO models at longer leads would follow naturally.
9c0161ac8c3995be0ca1c224619b17e598205766.issues: Abstract unavailable, so data, lead times and skill cannot be verified from this record.

af814724d8ff40e68eb9b8c8bfcdc27b2d4e109f.goal: Reviews drought forecasting methods and argues for bottom-up AI and hybrid physical-statistical approaches to address persistent prediction gaps.
af814724d8ff40e68eb9b8c8bfcdc27b2d4e109f.architecture: Review and perspective on drought prediction, with an illustrative experiment on bottom-up, data-driven driver search; no single new model.
af814724d8ff40e68eb9b8c8bfcdc27b2d4e109f.data: Review; illustrative experiment on observed drought events (details not given in the abstract).
af814724d8ff40e68eb9b8c8bfcdc27b2d4e109f.result: Argues current approaches are top-down and that ML enables bottom-up models; recommends focusing on robustness and stability of uncertainty rather than goodness of fit.
af814724d8ff40e68eb9b8c8bfcdc27b2d4e109f.open_work: Develop bottom-up and hybrid dynamical-statistical drought models and metrics for uncertainty stability.
af814724d8ff40e68eb9b8c8bfcdc27b2d4e109f.issues: Perspective with a limited illustrative experiment; no systematic benchmark of methods.

c40714cbb62a4daeb3653e1d2bcff90c362bbbec.goal: Estimates ocean mesoscale eddy heat fluxes from sea surface height alone, which could enable monitoring from satellite altimetry.
c40714cbb62a4daeb3653e1d2bcff90c362bbbec.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network (CNN) mapping SSH snapshots to eddy heat fluxes, compared with conventional data-driven techniques.
c40714cbb62a4daeb3653e1d2bcff90c362bbbec.result: The CNN predicts up to 64% of eddy heat flux variance and significantly outperforms conventional data-driven methods.
c40714cbb62a4daeb3653e1d2bcff90c362bbbec.open_work: Apply to real satellite altimetry and more realistic ocean models for operational monitoring.
c40714cbb62a4daeb3653e1d2bcff90c362bbbec.issues: Trained and tested only on idealized QG simulations; real altimetry noise and resolution are not addressed.

123a86857303bba7be9e0a336bdebbb817b90e73.goal: Quantifies uncertainty of neural-network hydrological models using a dropout ensemble, as implied by the title.
123a86857303bba7be9e0a336bdebbb817b90e73.architecture: Neural network hydrological model with dropout-based ensemble (Monte Carlo dropout) for uncertainty; the network family is not specified in the available record.
123a86857303bba7be9e0a336bdebbb817b90e73.open_work: Not reported; comparison with other uncertainty methods such as deep ensembles and Bayesian networks would follow naturally.
123a86857303bba7be9e0a336bdebbb817b90e73.issues: Abstract unavailable; dropout ensembles may underestimate uncertainty, which cannot be checked from this record.

42c55ba708cbe9f535a8f5dc970b352e5191be64.goal: Book chapter surveying applications of deep learning in hydrology.
42c55ba708cbe9f535a8f5dc970b352e5191be64.architecture: Review chapter on deep learning in hydrology; specific coverage not available from this record.
42c55ba708cbe9f535a8f5dc970b352e5191be64.issues: Abstract unavailable, so scope and conclusions cannot be verified from this record.

1996c0424bb8e5b4a00e377bdf669a17603bb2a9.goal: Assesses the new NRCS operational water supply forecast model for the American West, an explainable, automated, ensemble AI system, as implied by the title.
1996c0424bb8e5b4a00e377bdf669a17603bb2a9.architecture: Ensemble AI forecasting system combining multiple data-driven models with explainability; component model families are not specified in the available record.
1996c0424bb8e5b4a00e377bdf669a17603bb2a9.data: Not reported (abstract missing); seasonal water supply forecasting in the western United States.
1996c0424bb8e5b4a00e377bdf669a17603bb2a9.result: Not reported (abstract missing); the title frames it as a challenging operational test.
1996c0424bb8e5b4a00e377bdf669a17603bb2a9.open_work: Not reported; operational evaluation over more basins and years would follow naturally.
1996c0424bb8e5b4a00e377bdf669a17603bb2a9.issues: Abstract unavailable, so skill and benchmark comparisons cannot be verified from this record.

a3143444aa1bada74fda4a846287f05ec2c91175.goal: Predicts daily Arctic sea ice concentration to support navigation in the Northeast Passage.
a3143444aa1bada74fda4a846287f05ec2c91175.architecture: Convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM) compared with convolutional neural networks (CNNs).
a3143444aa1bada74fda4a846287f05ec2c91175.data: Reanalysis sea ice concentration data for the Arctic (product not named in the abstract), with tests including December 2018.
a3143444aa1bada74fda4a846287f05ec2c91175.result: ConvLSTM beats CNNs in structural similarity, RMSE and correlation on the test set and in iterative multi-step predictability, notably near the East Siberian Sea.
a3143444aa1bada74fda4a846287f05ec2c91175.open_work: Longer lead times, additional predictors and comparison with dynamical sea ice forecasts.
a3143444aa1bada74fda4a846287f05ec2c91175.issues: Only compared against CNNs; quantitative scores not given in the abstract; trained on reanalysis, inheriting its biases.

cd5f1f6739c8834b7380008278c3836d7888c8ed.goal: Embeds deep learning process representations into a process-based hydrologic model to combine strengths of both approaches.
cd5f1f6739c8834b7380008278c3836d7888c8ed.architecture: Deep learning parameterizations of turbulent heat fluxes coupled into the SUMMA hydrologic model, one-way (inputs only) and two-way (with SUMMA states); network family not specified in the abstract.
cd5f1f6739c8834b7380008278c3836d7888c8ed.data: Turbulent heat flux observations from eddy-covariance (FLUXNET) sites with meteorological forcing.
cd5f1f6739c8834b7380008278c3836d7888c8ed.result: DL parameterizations outperform calibrated standalone SUMMA, and two-way coupling best simulates long-term latent heat flux.
cd5f1f6739c8834b7380008278c3836d7888c8ed.open_work: Represent further processes with DL inside process-based models and test at catchment scale.
cd5f1f6739c8834b7380008278c3836d7888c8ed.issues: Limited to site-scale heat fluxes; generalization to ungauged sites and effects on other water balance components need testing.

e32b1ca1e260ecf3fd3a5bfe0c6a6e90396a7cad.goal: Reviews machine learning and explainable AI for large-sample hydrology and sets out challenges and research avenues.
e32b1ca1e260ecf3fd3a5bfe0c6a6e90396a7cad.architecture: Review of ML models, explainable AI and interpretability methods in large-sample hydrology.
e32b1ca1e260ecf3fd3a5bfe0c6a6e90396a7cad.data: Review; large-sample catchment datasets spanning hundreds to thousands of basins.
e32b1ca1e260ecf3fd3a5bfe0c6a6e90396a7cad.result: Identifies challenges including variable interpretations across models and XAI methods, data-sparse and human-impacted regions, cascading uncertainty, multivariate prediction and causality.
e32b1ca1e260ecf3fd3a5bfe0c6a6e90396a7cad.open_work: Consistent XAI interpretation, predictions in human-impacted and data-sparse regions, uncertainty reduction and causal discovery.
e32b1ca1e260ecf3fd3a5bfe0c6a6e90396a7cad.issues: Review without new quantitative comparison of methods.

ac6f96a548da5f0503af7c0d699d0083460f9e7a.goal: Tests generative diffusion models for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting at 1–3 h lead times.
ac6f96a548da5f0503af7c0d699d0083460f9e7a.architecture: Generative Ensemble Diffusion (GED), a denoising diffusion model generating ensembles that are post-processed into one forecast; compared with U-Net models.
ac6f96a548da5f0503af7c0d699d0083460f9e7a.data: ERA5 hourly data over Central Europe, 2016–2021; comparison with CERRA forecasts.
ac6f96a548da5f0503af7c0d699d0083460f9e7a.result: About 25% lower mean squared error than recent deep learning models on the same problem.
ac6f96a548da5f0503af7c0d699d0083460f9e7a.open_work: Higher-resolution radar data, longer leads and evaluation of the ensemble's probabilistic calibration.
ac6f96a548da5f0503af7c0d699d0083460f9e7a.issues: ERA5 precipitation is coarse and model-derived rather than radar observations; evaluation emphasizes MSE of the merged forecast.

ebb5d27232033df6c8e25c79651a4b4d326621dd.goal: Downscales coarse CMIP6 Earth system and global climate models to 0.1° over the Iberian Peninsula to provide regional climate change information for adaptation.
ebb5d27232033df6c8e25c79651a4b4d326621dd.architecture: Four convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures for statistical downscaling, compared and then used to build a multi-model ensemble of downscaled projections.
ebb5d27232033df6c8e25c79651a4b4d326621dd.data: ERA5 predictors for training, Iberia01 observational gridded dataset (0.1°) as target and reference; seven CMIP6 ESGCMs under four SSP scenarios for 21st-century projections.
ebb5d27232033df6c8e25c79651a4b4d326621dd.result: Downscaled projections agree with the CMIP6 ensemble in magnitude for temperature and in sign of change for temperature and precipitation; warming of 2–6 °C and robust precipitation decreases in western and southwestern Iberia after 2040.
ebb5d27232033df6c8e25c79651a4b4d326621dd.open_work: Comparison with forthcoming EURO-CORDEX dynamical downscaling and extension to other variables, regions and extremes.
ebb5d27232033df6c8e25c79651a4b4d326621dd.issues: Trained in a perfect-prognosis setting on ERA5, so applying to GCM inputs assumes stationarity and transferability of the learned relationships; GCM biases are inherited.

ccb0a6cc0c6e0ed59a7fe573505623b1ee20f985.goal: Improves the accuracy of streamflow prediction by long short-term memory networks using transfer learning and integration of additional data, as implied by the title.
ccb0a6cc0c6e0ed59a7fe573505623b1ee20f985.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network combined with transfer learning techniques and data integration; details of the setup are not available (no abstract).
ccb0a6cc0c6e0ed59a7fe573505623b1ee20f985.data: Not reported (no abstract available); streamflow and related hydrometeorological records are implied.
ccb0a6cc0c6e0ed59a7fe573505623b1ee20f985.result: Not reported (no abstract available); the title implies transfer learning and data integration improve LSTM streamflow accuracy.
ccb0a6cc0c6e0ed59a7fe573505623b1ee20f985.open_work: Testing transferability across more basins and climates, and clarifying which source domains and data streams give the largest gains.
ccb0a6cc0c6e0ed59a7fe573505623b1ee20f985.issues: Evaluation details, basins and baselines unknown without the abstract; transfer-learning gains often depend strongly on similarity between source and target basins.

0f7c2aa96fa5a207be27c978603ff9d954fb76d3.goal: Provides a homogeneous comparison of five global machine-learning weather prediction models for East Asia and the Western Pacific, including typhoon forecasts.
0f7c2aa96fa5a207be27c978603ff9d954fb76d3.architecture: Benchmark evaluation of existing models: Pangu-Weather (transformer), FourCastNet v2 (spherical Fourier neural operator), GraphCast (graph neural network), FuXi and FengWu (transformer-based), plus a simple multi-model ensemble mean.
0f7c2aa96fa5a207be27c978603ff9d954fb76d3.data: All models initialised from identical ERA5 initial conditions; evaluation June–November 2023 over Eastern Asia and Western Pacific, including 11 typhoons of 2023 and a Typhoon Haikui case study.
0f7c2aa96fa5a207be27c978603ff9d954fb76d3.result: FengWu performs best, followed by FuXi and GraphCast, with FCN2 and Pangu-Weather lower; the five-model average rivals FengWu. FengWu gives the best typhoon tracks but the largest intensity errors.
0f7c2aa96fa5a207be27c978603ff9d954fb76d3.open_work: Longer evaluation periods, operational initial conditions, and better typhoon intensity prediction from AI models.
0f7c2aa96fa5a207be27c978603ff9d954fb76d3.issues: Single season of evaluation and few typhoons; ERA5 initial conditions are not available in real time; intensity is systematically underestimated by coarse AI models.

236f0fad8e2ba926e16a064dd452f5ee89784ba4.goal: Models the subgrid-scale scalar flux in 3D turbulent incompressible flow while preserving physical invariances that purely data-driven networks may violate.
236f0fad8e2ba926e16a064dd452f5ee89784ba4.architecture: Physics-informed neural network with hard and soft constraints enforcing transformation invariances and symmetries; compared with purely data-driven convolutional neural networks and classical parametric subgrid models.
236f0fad8e2ba926e16a064dd452f5ee89784ba4.data: Direct numerical simulation (DNS) data of three-dimensional turbulent scalar transport; a priori tests and a posteriori large-eddy simulation (LES) runs.
236f0fad8e2ba926e16a064dd452f5ee89784ba4.result: The transformation-invariant network outperforms data-driven and parametric subgrid models, gives distribution tails closer to DNS, improves LES stability and generalizes to unseen regimes.
236f0fad8e2ba926e16a064dd452f5ee89784ba4.open_work: Application to more complex, geophysical flows (e.g., stratification, rotation) and real-case LES.
236f0fad8e2ba926e16a064dd452f5ee89784ba4.issues: Idealized simulation-based experiments; the specific flow configuration may limit transfer to ocean or atmosphere models.

d2f1ad19d2379945a902db885eb914375e1138c1.goal: Predicts the occurrence of deep convection (thunderstorms) from reanalysis to improve understanding and possible triggering of convection in climate models.
d2f1ad19d2379945a902db885eb914375e1138c1.architecture: Comparison of logistic regression, random forests, gradient-boosted decision trees and deep neural networks (feed-forward classifiers) with feature-importance analysis.
d2f1ad19d2379945a902db885eb914375e1138c1.data: ERA5 reanalysis with up to 40 input variables; lightning data as labels for Central and Northern Europe (2012–2017) and Sri Lanka (2016–2017).
d2f1ad19d2379945a902db885eb914375e1138c1.result: Neural networks and gradient-boosted trees give more than twofold improvement in precision-recall skill over CAPE for 0–45 min thunderstorm occurrence in Europe; monthly area-mean correlations exceed 0.94.
d2f1ad19d2379945a902db885eb914375e1138c1.open_work: Using ML convection triggers in climate models and studying long-term trends in convective storms from reanalyses.
d2f1ad19d2379945a902db885eb914375e1138c1.issues: Lightning as proxy for deep convection and reanalysis predictors inherit ERA5 biases; limited regions and years.

1924c82acbbfad9d04c343ca9afdfe3ad6c3739c.goal: Provides rapid, low-cost extreme event attribution by generating counterfactual versions of historical events at different global mean temperature levels.
1924c82acbbfad9d04c343ca9afdfe3ad6c3739c.architecture: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) that learn the relationship between daily temperature, global mean temperature and daily meteorological conditions, then generate counterfactual events.
1924c82acbbfad9d04c343ca9afdfe3ad6c3739c.data: Climate model simulations for training and observation-based fields for application (CMIP6 and ERA5 per knowledge; spot-check); southcentral North America 2023 heat event and previously analysed historical events.
1924c82acbbfad9d04c343ca9afdfe3ad6c3739c.result: The 2023 southcentral North America event was 1.18–1.42 °C warmer due to global warming; similar events will occur 0.14–0.60 times per year at 2.0 °C warming. Results broadly agree with established attribution methods.
1924c82acbbfad9d04c343ca9afdfe3ad6c3739c.open_work: Extending to precipitation and other extremes and operational rapid attribution.
1924c82acbbfad9d04c343ca9afdfe3ad6c3739c.issues: Relies on climate-model-learned relationships, so model biases in forced response propagate; uncertainty quantification depends on training ensembles.

81b9d09c2bae32f01ec535f5edbb4d1f86067bb2.goal: Downscales coarse satellite and reanalysis precipitation products to 1 km for local water management.
