4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.architecture: Neural networks predicting eddy diffusivity profiles from forcing parameters, embedded online in the ocean model while preserving conservation.
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.data: Training on output from a second moment closure turbulence scheme; online tests in an ocean general circulation model (MOM6).
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.result: Stable online implementation reduces biases in mixed-layer depth and upper-ocean stratification compared with the predecessor scheme.
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.open_work: Training on higher-fidelity data such as LES and testing in coupled climate models.
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.issues: Trained on a closure scheme rather than observations or LES, so learns its assumptions; generalisation to unseen regimes uncertain.

adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.goal: Builds stable data-driven autoregressive surrogates of geophysical turbulence as a step towards data-driven climate models.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.architecture: Convolutional encoder-decoder with deep spatial transformer modules (equivariance preserving) predicting the upper-layer stream function autoregressively.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.data: Two-layer quasi-geostrophic turbulence simulations, upper-layer stream function only.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.result: Predicts up to about 9 days in the QG system, beating persistence and a standard convolutional encoder-decoder, and remains stable for multiple years.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.open_work: Extension to more complex climate models and real atmospheric data.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.issues: Idealized QG system; partial-state input only; long-run statistics not detailed in the abstract.

a60e4fddfb54ea0e0d17caccf2cbb5da4af944f5.goal: Forecasts rare sudden stratospheric warmings, computing event probability and lead time from short simulations instead of long integrations.
a60e4fddfb54ea0e0d17caccf2cbb5da4af944f5.architecture: Non-deep-learning data-driven method: transition operator estimation from short trajectories (dynamical Galerkin approximation) to compute committor probabilities and expected lead times.
a60e4fddfb54ea0e0d17caccf2cbb5da4af944f5.data: Short simulations of a stochastically forced Holton-Mass stratospheric model.
a60e4fddfb54ea0e0d17caccf2cbb5da4af944f5.result: Efficiently computes probability and lead time of SSWs and relates them to a few interpretable physical variables, suggesting optimal measurements.
a60e4fddfb54ea0e0d17caccf2cbb5da4af944f5.open_work: Applying to high-dimensional models and observations and to other rare events.
a60e4fddfb54ea0e0d17caccf2cbb5da4af944f5.issues: Highly idealized model; scalability to full atmospheric models not demonstrated.

c62b0356d61a7bd72695fda71a215ac6e6d91348.goal: Chooses informative environmental sensor placements in remote regions like Antarctica by minimising prediction uncertainty.
c62b0356d61a7bd72695fda71a215ac6e6d91348.architecture: Convolutional Gaussian neural process (ConvGNP): neural networks parameterise a joint Gaussian at arbitrary target locations.
c62b0356d61a7bd72695fda71a215ac6e6d91348.data: Simulated surface air temperature anomaly over Antarctica for training and sensor placement experiments.
c62b0356d61a7bd72695fda71a215ac6e6d91348.result: ConvGNP learns spatial and seasonal non-stationarity, outperforms a non-stationary GP baseline, and better predicts gains from new observations for sensor siting.
c62b0356d61a7bd72695fda71a215ac6e6d91348.open_work: Building an operational sensor placement recommendation system and environmental digital twins.
c62b0356d61a7bd72695fda71a215ac6e6d91348.issues: Simulated experiments only; single variable; real sensor deployment not tested.

43d3ad6078428cecc5991a606df8f0fc822f9975.goal: Identifies ocean eddies automatically from sea surface temperature maps using neural networks.
43d3ad6078428cecc5991a606df8f0fc822f9975.architecture: Neural network classifier for eddy detection; network family is not specified in the available metadata.
43d3ad6078428cecc5991a606df8f0fc822f9975.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); satellite SST maps implied by the title.
43d3ad6078428cecc5991a606df8f0fc822f9975.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
43d3ad6078428cecc5991a606df8f0fc822f9975.open_work: Not reported; naturally comparison with other eddy detection methods and altimetry.
43d3ad6078428cecc5991a606df8f0fc822f9975.issues: Abstract missing; method and evaluation cannot be verified from this record.

e183cdf52025014253817374dc36cd33107c09b2.goal: Improves snow water equivalent prediction by integrating lagged observations into an LSTM and uses this to diagnose error sources.
e183cdf52025014253817374dc36cd33107c09b2.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network with data integration of 30- or 7-day-lagged SWE or satellite snow cover fraction.
e183cdf52025014253817374dc36cd33107c09b2.data: Snow stations across the western US (SNOTEL) with meteorological forcing and satellite-observed snow cover fraction.
e183cdf52025014253817374dc36cd33107c09b2.result: 30-day-lagged SWE integration raises median NSE from 0.92 to 0.97 and cuts RMSE by 41% and peak SWE error by 57%; SCF helps only shallow-snow sites during melt.
e183cdf52025014253817374dc36cd33107c09b2.open_work: Using diagnosed error patterns to guide model and forcing improvements.
e183cdf52025014253817374dc36cd33107c09b2.issues: Lagged SWE integration ineffective for ephemeral snow; depends on availability of recent observations.

1932b3e34c2953e78a1ab4b8ff7ebe2a390ef9f1.goal: Improves surface-layer turbulent flux estimates beyond Monin-Obukhov similarity theory used in atmospheric models.
1932b3e34c2953e78a1ab4b8ff7ebe2a390ef9f1.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) and random forest models estimating momentum, sensible heat and moisture fluxes, with interpretability analysis.
1932b3e34c2953e78a1ab4b8ff7ebe2a390ef9f1.data: Several years of tower observations from the Cabauw mast (Netherlands) and the NOAA Field Research Division tower in Idaho.
1932b3e34c2953e78a1ab4b8ff7ebe2a390ef9f1.result: RF and ANN outperform MOST for all fluxes even when trained on one site and applied to the other; sensible heat and moisture fluxes improve most.
1932b3e34c2953e78a1ab4b8ff7ebe2a390ef9f1.open_work: Implementing ML surface-layer schemes in weather and LES models and testing more sites.
1932b3e34c2953e78a1ab4b8ff7ebe2a390ef9f1.issues: Two sites only; offline evaluation, not coupled to a numerical model.

96adc758447419d4f00c71b2fbe661fe3694a4b8.goal: Forecasts ENSO by learning global SST teleconnections among ocean basins.
96adc758447419d4f00c71b2fbe661fe3694a4b8.architecture: ENSO-GTC: graph neural network with probability graph convolution layers on an ocean-patch dynamics graph, with a graph total-variation loss penalty.
96adc758447419d4f00c71b2fbe661fe3694a4b8.data: Global SST fields over the Pacific, Indian and Atlantic oceans; training and validation datasets not reported in the abstract.
96adc758447419d4f00c71b2fbe661fe3694a4b8.result: Nino3.4 correlation skill of 0.79/0.66/0.51 at 6/12/18 months (iterative) and above 0.6 within 20 months (direct), outperforming other models; learned links match ENSO theory.
96adc758447419d4f00c71b2fbe661fe3694a4b8.open_work: Monitoring meridional modes and inter-basin teleconnections to further improve forecasts.
96adc758447419d4f00c71b2fbe661fe3694a4b8.issues: Short observational record and model training data limitations; skill claims depend on validation period.

ed5d4e3317115edf9aa15f0ba7bb3e06b43caaab.goal: Provides a native parallel Fortran neural network library for integration with Fortran scientific codes.
ed5d4e3317115edf9aa15f0ba7bb3e06b43caaab.architecture: neural-fortran framework for feed-forward neural networks (MLP) with stochastic gradient descent and Fortran 2018 collective parallelism.
ed5d4e3317115edf9aa15f0ba7bb3e06b43caaab.data: MNIST handwritten digit images for demonstration.
ed5d4e3317115edf9aa15f0ba7bb3e06b43caaab.result: Ease of use and computational performance similar to a popular ML framework in serial and parallel modes.
ed5d4e3317115edf9aa15f0ba7bb3e06b43caaab.open_work: Further development including more layer types and production use in Earth system models.
ed5d4e3317115edf9aa15f0ba7bb3e06b43caaab.issues: Only feed-forward networks; demonstration not on geoscience data.

d865e0d29a3e0ac00010599a8f6bb52979993efd.goal: Improve multi-season ENSO prediction by capturing long-range, basin-scale precursors that the local receptive field of convolutional networks struggles to represent.
d865e0d29a3e0ac00010599a8f6bb52979993efd.architecture: ENSO transformer (ENSOTR), a transformer model using self-attention over global ocean-atmosphere fields to predict the monthly Niño3.4 index, compared against a CNN baseline.
d865e0d29a3e0ac00010599a8f6bb52979993efd.data: Training and evaluation datasets are not reported in the abstract; evaluation includes historical events such as the 1997–1998 El Niño.
d865e0d29a3e0ac00010599a8f6bb52979993efd.result: Skillful Niño3.4 prediction up to about 18 months ahead, strong El Niño events such as 1997–1998 predicted more than a year in advance, and higher skill than the CNN.
d865e0d29a3e0ac00010599a8f6bb52979993efd.open_work: Assess robustness across decades and in the spring predictability barrier, interpret the attention patterns physically, and compare with operational dynamical forecasts.
d865e0d29a3e0ac00010599a8f6bb52979993efd.issues: Short letter with limited detail on data and validation; few strong El Niño events limit robust skill assessment, and no probabilistic or uncertainty information is given.

86fe740271bafd11676e22bd6057ed3c18c5d749.goal: Generate realistic high-resolution UK precipitation projections cheaply, since convection-permitting climate simulations needed for extreme rainfall are very computationally expensive.
86fe740271bafd11676e22bd6057ed3c18c5d749.architecture: Conditional diffusion model (score-based deep generative model) that samples high-resolution rainfall conditioned on low-resolution fields such as relative vorticity, with self-learnt location-specific inputs.
86fe740271bafd11676e22bd6057ed3c18c5d749.data: Met Office UK convection-permitting local-scale climate model (UKCP18 2.2 km) precipitation as target, conditioned on coarsened low-resolution variables from the same simulations.
86fe740271bafd11676e22bd6057ed3c18c5d749.result: First ML model shown to produce realistic high-resolution rainfall samples from a convection-resolving physical model; sample quantiles and time means match the high-resolution simulation well.
86fe740271bafd11676e22bd6057ed3c18c5d749.open_work: Condition on GCM output rather than coarsened CPM fields, add more predictors, and test the climate-change signal and extreme-event statistics more thoroughly.
86fe740271bafd11676e22bd6057ed3c18c5d749.issues: Early workshop-stage results in a perfect-model setting; transfer to real GCM inputs and preservation of future changes are not demonstrated, and sampling is costlier than deterministic emulators.

30f18dfcffa6281ef9612846488a34db75542317.goal: Perspective arguing that machine learning applications for weather and climate must focus more on extreme events, which matter most for impacts but are poorly represented in typical training and evaluation.
30f18dfcffa6281ef9612846488a34db75542317.architecture: Perspective/review article, not a new model; discusses how ML models are trained and evaluated and how extremes, rare events and out-of-sample conditions should be handled.
30f18dfcffa6281ef9612846488a34db75542317.data: No new data; draws on examples from ML weather forecasting, downscaling, parameterization and climate emulation literature.
30f18dfcffa6281ef9612846488a34db75542317.result: Argues that standard metrics such as mean squared error hide poor performance on extremes and that ML studies should explicitly evaluate and target extreme events.
30f18dfcffa6281ef9612846488a34db75542317.open_work: Develop extreme-focused evaluation protocols, loss functions and data strategies (e.g., large ensembles, physics constraints) to improve extrapolation to unprecedented events.
30f18dfcffa6281ef9612846488a34db75542317.issues: Opinion piece without quantitative results; recommendations are general and their effectiveness is not tested within the article.

9ba826358f2e7cfd0d3ecb1cbcf31d11fb75ed01.goal: Show that a hybrid ML-physics atmospheric model can capture dynamical processes that its low-resolution physics-based component does not resolve.
9ba826358f2e7cfd0d3ecb1cbcf31d11fb75ed01.architecture: Hybrid model combining a low-resolution atmospheric GCM (SPEEDY) with a reservoir computing machine learning component, extended with ML-based prognostic precipitation and sea surface temperature.
9ba826358f2e7cfd0d3ecb1cbcf31d11fb75ed01.data: Trained on ERA5 reanalysis; evaluated in decades-long free-running climate simulations against reanalysis climatology.
9ba826358f2e7cfd0d3ecb1cbcf31d11fb75ed01.result: The hybrid model produces sudden stratospheric warmings absent in the AGCM, and adding ML-based 6-hr precipitation and SST improves precipitation climatology and yields a realistic ENSO signal.
9ba826358f2e7cfd0d3ecb1cbcf31d11fb75ed01.open_work: Extend the approach to higher-resolution models, more coupled components and additional processes, and quantify long-term stability and climate-change response.
9ba826358f2e7cfd0d3ecb1cbcf31d11fb75ed01.issues: Physics component is very coarse; results are shown through selected examples, and the realism of ML-generated variability under changed climate is not established.

3f3e613da3f9863f790d8eb6f6b1b2b8a09258ff.goal: Provide a benchmark for global cloud-type classification at high spatial and temporal resolution, since cloud representation is a major source of climate projection uncertainty.
3f3e613da3f9863f790d8eb6f6b1b2b8a09258ff.architecture: Benchmark dataset, Cumulo, with a baseline using an invertible flow generative model (IResNet, invertible residual network) whose latent space is explored to discover cloud sub-classes.
3f3e613da3f9863f790d8eb6f6b1b2b8a09258ff.data: One year of 1 km MODIS hyperspectral imagery merged with pixel-wide CloudSat cloud-type label tracks.
3f3e613da3f9863f790d8eb6f6b1b2b8a09258ff.result: Provides the merged dataset, baseline classification performance and evaluation criteria emphasising both accuracy and physical realism of predicted cloud classes.
3f3e613da3f9863f790d8eb6f6b1b2b8a09258ff.open_work: Develop improved classifiers, semi-supervised methods exploiting unlabeled pixels, and extend coverage to more years and instruments.
3f3e613da3f9863f790d8eb6f6b1b2b8a09258ff.issues: Labels exist only along narrow CloudSat tracks, so training is sparse and spatially biased; one year limits temporal variability.

8a8ac2467aee4d70866a1b2410e59565ef6ae292.goal: Review the state of AI foundation models for weather and climate and set out criteria for building a generalizable weather foundation model.
8a8ac2467aee4d70866a1b2410e59565ef6ae292.architecture: Review of transformer and neural operator approaches, physics-informed ML and graph neural networks for weather and climate, with a perspective on foundation model design and implementation.
8a8ac2467aee4d70866a1b2410e59565ef6ae292.data: Literature review; discusses reanalysis and model datasets used by existing models but presents no new training data.
8a8ac2467aee4d70866a1b2410e59565ef6ae292.result: Argues current AI methods are mature enough to design a weather foundation model and identifies downstream tasks such as downscaling, wildfire conditions, hurricanes and atmospheric rivers.
8a8ac2467aee4d70866a1b2410e59565ef6ae292.open_work: Build and evaluate foundation models that transfer across scales and tasks, and define benchmarks and success criteria for them.
8a8ac2467aee4d70866a1b2410e59565ef6ae292.issues: Perspective and review with no new experiments; claims about foundation model readiness are not empirically demonstrated.

a84dbaefee2acac0eb6716044efcf5c503b9d2b3.goal: Assess whether a neural-network RCM-emulator can reproduce fine-scale daily precipitation, allowing cheap high-resolution ensembles of regional climate projections.
a84dbaefee2acac0eb6716044efcf5c503b9d2b3.architecture: Convolutional neural network RCM-emulator (U-Net-type architecture from Doury et al. 2023) trained with a novel asymmetric loss to reproduce the full precipitation distribution.
a84dbaefee2acac0eb6716044efcf5c503b9d2b3.data: Simulations of a 12 km CNRM regional climate model (ALADIN) driven by several GCMs, in a perfect-model framework; low-resolution predictors from upscaled RCM fields, then a GCM downscaling showcase.
a84dbaefee2acac0eb6716044efcf5c503b9d2b3.result: Excellent spatio-temporal correlation with the RCM, good dry-day counts and 99th quantiles, transferability across driving GCMs, and clear added value over GCMs for heavy precipitation structure.
a84dbaefee2acac0eb6716044efcf5c503b9d2b3.open_work: Establish a relevant evaluation framework for applying the emulator directly to GCM simulations and recover missing highest-frequency spatial details.
a84dbaefee2acac0eb6716044efcf5c503b9d2b3.issues: Evaluated mainly in perfect-model conditions; fine-scale details are smoothed and GCM application lacks a reference truth for validation.

a4465a45b45638d4720c53ee5986d75cc8151dfc.goal: Combine deep learning and process-based modeling to learn global hydrological dynamics, including unobserved latent variables, while keeping interpretability.
a4465a45b45638d4720c53ee5986d75cc8151dfc.architecture: End-to-end hybrid model coupling a dynamic neural network (specific network family not specified in the abstract) with a conceptual water balance model.
a4465a45b45638d4720c53ee5986d75cc8151dfc.data: Global observational water cycle products of evapotranspiration, runoff, snow water equivalent and terrestrial water storage variations; specific products not named in the abstract.
a4465a45b45638d4720c53ee5986d75cc8151dfc.result: Reproduces observed water cycle variations very well, and emergent runoff-generation relations are qualitatively consistent with hydrological understanding.
a4465a45b45638d4720c53ee5986d75cc8151dfc.open_work: Analyze learned latent processes more quantitatively and extend the hybrid approach to other components of the land water cycle.
a4465a45b45638d4720c53ee5986d75cc8151dfc.issues: Conference-length study; equifinality between the neural and conceptual parts and observational product uncertainties may affect the interpretability of latent variables.

c14fbadc35a2b78a723807a81b066e764e8cb376.goal: Obtain derivatives of Earth science simulators whose adjoints are unavailable, enabling forecasting, data assimilation, tuning and parameterization learning.
c14fbadc35a2b78a723807a81b066e764e8cb376.architecture: Deep emulator networks trained on simulation data to reproduce dynamics and provide derivatives via automatic differentiation (network family not specified in the abstract).
c14fbadc35a2b78a723807a81b066e764e8cb376.data: Simulations of the chaotic Lorenz-96 system with complete or partial system states and varying training set sizes.
c14fbadc35a2b78a723807a81b066e764e8cb376.result: Emulators reproduce dynamics and derivatives accurately as a function of integration time and data size, and emulator derivatives enable accurate 4D-Var data assimilation and closed-loop parametrization training.
c14fbadc35a2b78a723807a81b066e764e8cb376.open_work: Apply emulator-based differentiation to realistic, high-dimensional weather and climate simulators.
c14fbadc35a2b78a723807a81b066e764e8cb376.issues: Demonstrated only on Lorenz-96; scalability and derivative accuracy for complex models with many processes remain untested.

94ef80d7283bc0ba2d93a565889c78c73ef0653a.goal: Reduce blurriness in deep learning weather radar echo extrapolation, which arises from mean squared error losses and degrades short-term severe convection warnings.
94ef80d7283bc0ba2d93a565889c78c73ef0653a.architecture: Adversarial Extrapolation Neural Network (AENN), a generative adversarial network (GAN) with a conditional generator and frame-level and sequence-level discriminators.
94ef80d7283bc0ba2d93a565889c78c73ef0653a.data: Weather radar echo sequences; source radar and period not reported in the abstract. Evaluated for 0.5 h, 1 h and 1.5 h extrapolation.
94ef80d7283bc0ba2d93a565889c78c73ef0653a.result: AENN produces more realistic and accurate extrapolations and significantly outperforms other models; specific scores are not reported in the abstract.
94ef80d7283bc0ba2d93a565889c78c73ef0653a.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and evaluate on precipitation and severe-event detection metrics.
94ef80d7283bc0ba2d93a565889c78c73ef0653a.issues: Short conference paper; adversarial training can create plausible but incorrect details, and dataset scope is unclear.

7f60799fe1a17b51a2cda109a1286316fe538605.goal: Extend WeatherBench to probabilistic medium-range forecasting so that ML uncertainty estimates can be compared with standard metrics and an operational ensemble.
7f60799fe1a17b51a2cda109a1286316fe538605.architecture: Benchmark dataset with probabilistic metrics plus deep learning baselines (ResNet-type convolutional neural networks) using Monte Carlo dropout, parametric and categorical predictions.
7f60799fe1a17b51a2cda109a1286316fe538605.data: WeatherBench ERA5 reanalysis at coarse resolution; ECMWF IFS ensemble forecasts as operational baseline; CRPS, spread-skill ratio and rank histograms.
7f60799fe1a17b51a2cda109a1286316fe538605.result: Monte Carlo dropout severely underestimates uncertainty; parametric and categorical models are fairly reliable and similar, but none match the skill of the IFS ensemble.
7f60799fe1a17b51a2cda109a1286316fe538605.open_work: Develop stronger probabilistic ML methods, such as generative ensembles, and evaluate them with the benchmark.
7f60799fe1a17b51a2cda109a1286316fe538605.issues: Coarse resolution and limited variables; baselines are simple, and per-gridpoint distributions do not provide spatially coherent ensemble members.

3f2d696abba14ce0c2f872870a162148f8a19035.goal: Correct sea ice biases online in a global ice-ocean model using ML trained to predict data assimilation increments, for better initial conditions and S2S sea ice forecasts.
3f2d696abba14ce0c2f872870a162148f8a19035.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) predicting sea ice concentration DA increments, refined with a sea ice data augmentation approach that applies sequential CNN and DA corrections to generate new training data.
3f2d696abba14ce0c2f872870a162148f8a19035.data: GFDL global ice-ocean model simulations and sea ice concentration data assimilation increments derived from satellite observations.
3f2d696abba14ce0c2f872870a162148f8a19035.result: Initial online CNN correction systematically reduces SIC biases relative to the free-running model; data augmentation significantly reduces remaining large summertime errors.
3f2d696abba14ce0c2f872870a162148f8a19035.open_work: Use the correction for improved initial conditions and real-time bias correction in seasonal-to-subseasonal coupled sea ice forecasts.
3f2d696abba14ce0c2f872870a162148f8a19035.issues: Tested in an ice-ocean configuration without a fully coupled atmosphere; corrections target SIC biases and may not address other state variables or physical causes.

2bec7394904330deb37cdf70add9922bd50dd68c.goal: Provide a standard benchmark for ML emulation of atmospheric radiative transfer, which is expensive in weather and climate models and hard to compare across prior studies.
2bec7394904330deb37cdf70add9922bd50dd68c.architecture: Benchmark dataset, ClimART, with baselines including MLP, convolutional neural networks and graph neural networks for emulating radiative fluxes and heating rates.
2bec7394904330deb37cdf70add9922bd50dd68c.data: More than 10 million samples from present, pre-industrial and future climate conditions based on the Canadian Earth System Model radiation code, with multiple out-of-distribution test sets.
2bec7394904330deb37cdf70add9922bd50dd68c.result: Baselines reveal shortcomings of datasets and architectures used in prior work and highlight trade-offs between accuracy and inference speed.
2bec7394904330deb37cdf70add9922bd50dd68c.open_work: Develop emulators that generalize out of distribution, respect physical constraints, and remain stable when coupled online.
2bec7394904330deb37cdf70add9922bd50dd68c.issues: Offline benchmark only; emulators are not evaluated when coupled in a climate model, and data come from a single model's radiation scheme.

e8ad73b76aceaebfda2eca6c749f5329323dc1b8.goal: Emulate regional climate models cheaply with a hybrid statistical-dynamical downscaling method that avoids the stationarity assumption of conventional statistical downscaling.
e8ad73b76aceaebfda2eca6c749f5329323dc1b8.architecture: Non-ML statistical method: constructed analogues algorithm learned between low- and high-resolution climate projections, in GCM/RCM or RCM/RCM emulation modes.
e8ad73b76aceaebfda2eca6c749f5329323dc1b8.data: Large ensemble of regional climate projections over Western Europe (EURO-CORDEX-type GCM/RCM pairs) in a perfect-model framework.
e8ad73b76aceaebfda2eca6c749f5329323dc1b8.result: Reproduces climate change signals very well and outperforms conventional constructed-analogue downscaling; RCM/RCM mode retains the GCM large-scale signal whereas GCM/RCM mode does not.
e8ad73b76aceaebfda2eca6c749f5329323dc1b8.open_work: Determine whether large-scale differences between RCMs and driving GCMs reflect real RCM added value or other causes.
e8ad73b76aceaebfda2eca6c749f5329323dc1b8.issues: Results depend strongly on the GCM/RCM pair used for learning; evaluation is within a perfect-model framework.

55010d45d9d7a1bc9ce52900ca7083f9dddeebc7.goal: Improve prediction of extreme values in ML global weather forecasts, which are underestimated because of symmetric training losses and forecast uncertainty.
55010d45d9d7a1bc9ce52900ca7083f9dddeebc7.architecture: Exloss, an asymmetric loss emphasizing extremes, plus ExBooster, a training-free module generating multiple random samples to raise extreme-event hit rates, combined with an existing global ML forecast model.
55010d45d9d7a1bc9ce52900ca7083f9dddeebc7.data: Global medium-range weather data; datasets and the base forecast model are not detailed in the abstract.
55010d45d9d7a1bc9ce52900ca7083f9dddeebc7.result: State-of-the-art extreme weather prediction while overall forecast accuracy remains comparable to top medium-range ML models; proves symmetric losses such as MSE underestimate extremes.
55010d45d9d7a1bc9ce52900ca7083f9dddeebc7.open_work: Extend to more variables and longer leads and evaluate calibration of the sampling-based uncertainty.
55010d45d9d7a1bc9ce52900ca7083f9dddeebc7.issues: Asymmetric losses may trade off false alarms; ExBooster sampling is not a calibrated ensemble, and evaluation is against reanalysis-style targets.

c58c39c9ca7ba0c626e0e9db6365f95097510402.goal: Identify oceanic regions that provide decadal predictability of continental surface temperature, using explainable neural networks as a discovery tool.
c58c39c9ca7ba0c626e0e9db6365f95097510402.architecture: Neural networks (family not specified in the abstract) predicting continental surface temperature anomalies from SST anomalies, interpreted with layerwise relevance propagation (LRP).
c58c39c9ca7ba0c626e0e9db6365f95097510402.data: Output from a fully coupled Earth-system model simulation (internal variability); observations not used.
c58c39c9ca7ba0c626e0e9db6365f95097510402.result: North Atlantic and North Pacific regions provide the most predictability for surface temperature over continental North America on decadal timescales.
c58c39c9ca7ba0c626e0e9db6365f95097510402.open_work: Apply the approach to observational data and to other timescales of predictability.
c58c39c9ca7ba0c626e0e9db6365f95097510402.issues: Based on a single climate model, so results reflect its variability and biases; LRP attributions depend on network and explanation method choices.

7f97b7520414ec212f3ee8653f3392e756919b37.goal: Downscale annual maximum precipitation from multi-model CMIP6 ensembles to regional gridded data, preserving spatial structure that point-based losses miss.
7f97b7520414ec212f3ee8653f3392e756919b37.architecture: CliGAN, a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (GAN) with a convolutional encoder-dense decoder generator and similar critic, using adversarial, MS-SSIM structural and Nash-Sutcliffe content losses.
7f97b7520414ec212f3ee8653f3392e756919b37.data: Annual maximum precipitation from multiple CMIP6 atmosphere-ocean GCMs as input; regional gridded observational precipitation as target (region not reported in the abstract).
7f97b7520414ec212f3ee8653f3392e756919b37.result: Structural loss helps reproduce regional precipitation characteristics; point-based error functions alone are insufficient for realistic regional patterns.
7f97b7520414ec212f3ee8653f3392e756919b37.open_work: Use structural loss functions more widely in CNN-based downscaling and extend to other precipitation indices.
7f97b7520414ec212f3ee8653f3392e756919b37.issues: Targets only annual maxima; quantitative skill and performance under future climate extrapolation are not reported in the abstract.

a1d7885bf8aea568c7d9e5bdd6cd94e90d4da906.goal: Build fast, data-driven regional sea ice surrogate models that produce physically consistent ensemble forecasts without the smoothing of deterministic surrogates.
a1d7885bf8aea568c7d9e5bdd6cd94e90d4da906.architecture: Deep generative diffusion model (denoising diffusion) for multivariate regional surrogate forecasts at 12-hr lead, compared with a free-drift model and a stochastic deterministic surrogate.
a1d7885bf8aea568c7d9e5bdd6cd94e90d4da906.data: Simulations of the neXtSIM sea-ice model with initial conditions and atmospheric forcings, over a regional Arctic domain.
a1d7885bf8aea568c7d9e5bdd6cd94e90d4da906.result: Diffusion ensemble outperforms all other tested models, retains information at all scales, and nearly matches neXtSIM scaling properties consistent with observations.
a1d7885bf8aea568c7d9e5bdd6cd94e90d4da906.open_work: Extend to longer leads, larger domains, autoregressive use and coupling with data assimilation.
a1d7885bf8aea568c7d9e5bdd6cd94e90d4da906.issues: Single 12-hr lead and regional setup; trained on model output so inherits neXtSIM biases, and sampling cost exceeds deterministic surrogates.

7586c7eefa05759743adeadae23a1e85ccec834b.goal: Develop a transformer-based coupled ocean-atmosphere model for ENSO prediction and process studies (abstract not available).
7586c7eefa05759743adeadae23a1e85ccec834b.architecture: Transformer-based coupled ocean-atmosphere model for ENSO (related to the 3D-Geoformer of the same group); architecture details not available here.
7586c7eefa05759743adeadae23a1e85ccec834b.result: Not reported; the title implies the model is used for ENSO prediction and sensitivity studies.
7586c7eefa05759743adeadae23a1e85ccec834b.open_work: Not reported; physically interpreting the learned ocean-atmosphere coupling would follow naturally.
7586c7eefa05759743adeadae23a1e85ccec834b.issues: Details could not be verified without an abstract; data-driven coupling may inherit training data biases.

2d4f2debad3353d0c8c8ef8cc7b64a504f903a44.goal: Learn data-driven representations of chaotic dynamics from noisy, partial and irregularly sampled observations, where short-term prediction losses fail.
2d4f2debad3353d0c8c8ef8cc7b64a504f903a44.architecture: EM-like Bayesian inference combining neural-network ODE representations of dynamics with Ensemble Kalman Smoothers or LSTM-based variational approximations of the posterior.
2d4f2debad3353d0c8c8ef8cc7b64a504f903a44.data: Numerical experiments on the Lorenz-63 system with different noise levels and time sampling settings.
2d4f2debad3353d0c8c8ef8cc7b64a504f903a44.result: Recovers and reproduces hidden chaotic dynamics, including Lyapunov exponents, where classic ML approaches fail.
2d4f2debad3353d0c8c8ef8cc7b64a504f903a44.open_work: Scale the approach to higher-dimensional geophysical systems and real observations.
2d4f2debad3353d0c8c8ef8cc7b64a504f903a44.issues: Demonstrated only on the low-dimensional Lorenz-63 system; computational cost of iterative EM with assimilation may limit scalability.

7a056839fe032eb8a4341bf4297932d6a6bc3dc5.goal: Develop an ML parameterization of subgrid momentum transport, which is important for atmospheric circulation but neglected by most ML parameterizations.
7a056839fe032eb8a4341bf4297932d6a6bc3dc5.architecture: Neural-network parameterization (network family not specified in the abstract) predicting momentum fluxes, designed to conserve momentum and coupled online at coarse resolution.
7a056839fe032eb8a4341bf4297932d6a6bc3dc5.data: Coarse-grained output of a high-resolution idealized aquaplanet simulation with the System for Atmospheric Modeling (SAM).
7a056839fe032eb8a4341bf4297932d6a6bc3dc5.result: Skillful for convective momentum fluxes though less than for energy and moisture; online simulations are stable and tend to reduce wind biases, but over-correct in one configuration.
7a056839fe032eb8a4341bf4297932d6a6bc3dc5.open_work: Improve prediction of subgrid momentum fluxes and test in realistic configurations with land and topography.
7a056839fe032eb8a4341bf4297932d6a6bc3dc5.issues: Idealized aquaplanet only; lower skill for momentum fluxes and over-correction in one setup limit robustness.

437b2d4694b2b113d37c33005dc34fc1678620d0.goal: Improve a daily conceptual rainfall-runoff model by integrating artificial intelligence components.
437b2d4694b2b113d37c33005dc34fc1678620d0.architecture: Conceptual hydrological model integrated with an artificial neural network (ANN; type not specified) and a genetic algorithm (GA).
437b2d4694b2b113d37c33005dc34fc1678620d0.data: Daily rainfall-runoff data; catchment and period not reported in the truncated abstract.
437b2d4694b2b113d37c33005dc34fc1678620d0.result: Integration of ANN and GA enhances the performance of the conceptual model; quantitative gains are not reported in the available abstract.
437b2d4694b2b113d37c33005dc34fc1678620d0.open_work: Test across more catchments and compare with other hybrid or data-driven approaches.
437b2d4694b2b113d37c33005dc34fc1678620d0.issues: Abstract is truncated, so data, configuration and magnitude of improvement could not be verified.

85a54b144f354b4dfe7d7baad4184145fbc105f5.goal: Discuss how deep learning is changing the economics and organization of weather and climate prediction, including the role of technology companies and public services.
85a54b144f354b4dfe7d7baad4184145fbc105f5.architecture: Perspective/review article on deep learning in weather and climate prediction and its implications for computing, data and the prediction value chain; no new model.
85a54b144f354b4dfe7d7baad4184145fbc105f5.data: No new data; discusses reanalysis-trained ML forecast models and operational NWP systems.
85a54b144f354b4dfe7d7baad4184145fbc105f5.result: Argues ML is lowering the cost of prediction and shifting the landscape, requiring public-private cooperation, open data and continued physics-based systems.
85a54b144f354b4dfe7d7baad4184145fbc105f5.open_work: Define future roles of national services and private actors, and ensure data access and trustworthy ML forecasts.
85a54b144f354b4dfe7d7baad4184145fbc105f5.issues: Abstract unavailable; perspective piece without quantitative analysis.

2900246e7df63389f5d4305a9009d1bf7f8d3a47.goal: Scale AI foundation models for Earth system predictability beyond the size and data-integration limits of existing climate foundation models.
2900246e7df63389f5d4305a9009d1bf7f8d3a47.architecture: ORBIT, a vision transformer foundation model scaling to 113 billion parameters using a hybrid tensor-data orthogonal parallelism technique.
2900246e7df63389f5d4305a9009d1bf7f8d3a47.data: Climate model and reanalysis data (CMIP6 pretraining with ERA5 fine-tuning, per knowledge of the paper); scaling tests on the Frontier supercomputer.
2900246e7df63389f5d4305a9009d1bf7f8d3a47.result: Achieves 684 petaFLOPS to 1.6 exaFLOPS sustained throughput with 41–85% scaling efficiency on 49,152 AMD GPUs, a thousandfold larger than prior climate foundation models.
2900246e7df63389f5d4305a9009d1bf7f8d3a47.open_work: Demonstrate that scale translates into improved forecast skill across downstream Earth system tasks.
2900246e7df63389f5d4305a9009d1bf7f8d3a47.issues: Focus is computational scaling; forecast-skill gains from extreme model size are not quantified in the abstract.

fd3172c1a5b5c3e11c597d3f91389ea7e0372d4a.goal: Review deep learning approaches for parametrizing subgrid processes such as convection and clouds in climate models (book chapter; abstract not available).
fd3172c1a5b5c3e11c597d3f91389ea7e0372d4a.architecture: Review chapter on neural-network subgrid parameterizations learned from high-resolution or superparameterized simulations, including physical constraints and online coupling.
fd3172c1a5b5c3e11c597d3f91389ea7e0372d4a.data: Not reported; discusses training on high-resolution and superparameterized model output.
fd3172c1a5b5c3e11c597d3f91389ea7e0372d4a.result: Not reported; the chapter summarizes progress and challenges of ML parameterizations.
fd3172c1a5b5c3e11c597d3f91389ea7e0372d4a.open_work: Not reported; stability when coupled, generalization to new climates and physical consistency are natural open problems.
fd3172c1a5b5c3e11c597d3f91389ea7e0372d4a.issues: Abstract unavailable, so the content is inferred from the title and authors.

6a5cf86cbcc510847172db2cc923c34f2aec9b5d.goal: Improve super-resolution reconstruction of degraded weather radar echo images, preserving edge and texture detail lost by classical methods.
6a5cf86cbcc510847172db2cc923c34f2aec9b5d.architecture: Generative adversarial network (GAN) for super-resolution, compared with iterative back-projection (IBP) and nonlocal self-similarity sparse representation (NSSR).
6a5cf86cbcc510847172db2cc923c34f2aec9b5d.data: Authentic weather radar echo data; radar source and period not reported in the abstract.
6a5cf86cbcc510847172db2cc923c34f2aec9b5d.result: GAN produces perceptually superior reconstructions with higher PSNR and SSIM than the classical methods.
6a5cf86cbcc510847172db2cc923c34f2aec9b5d.open_work: Evaluate impacts on downstream forecasting and on meteorologically relevant metrics.
6a5cf86cbcc510847172db2cc923c34f2aec9b5d.issues: Image-quality metrics only; GAN-generated detail may not be physically accurate.

97657474769fdbdd29590451ed4ebf79dddd7aeb.goal: Fill data voids in remote sensing observations to improve data assimilation initial conditions for numerical weather prediction.
97657474769fdbdd29590451ed4ebf79dddd7aeb.architecture: Convolutional autoencoder (CAE) that reconstructs complete pseudo-observation fields from incomplete observations, combined with Ensemble Square Root Filter (EnSRF) assimilation.
97657474769fdbdd29590451ed4ebf79dddd7aeb.data: Barotropic vorticity equation model; long T63 simulation for training and a high-resolution benchmark simulation with about 30% missing streamfunction observations for testing.
97657474769fdbdd29590451ed4ebf79dddd7aeb.result: Reconstruction remains satisfactory with very sparse inputs; deep learning augmented DA greatly reduces analysis error, especially with sparse observations and small ensembles.
97657474769fdbdd29590451ed4ebf79dddd7aeb.open_work: Apply to realistic NWP models and real satellite radiance and radar observation gaps.
97657474769fdbdd29590451ed4ebf79dddd7aeb.issues: Idealized barotropic model; pseudo-observation errors are correlated with the CAE and real observation operators are not tested.

697d1f1fc91ab9a749a6fb8d27ed60139c0daaad.goal: Build a data assimilation system tailored to ML weather models, since initial fields from traditional DA are not optimal for them.
697d1f1fc91ab9a749a6fb8d27ed60139c0daaad.architecture: Ensemble 4DVar system integrated with the FuXi ML forecast model (a transformer-based model), using automatic differentiation for gradients instead of adjoint models.
697d1f1fc91ab9a749a6fb8d27ed60139c0daaad.data: Observations and experimental setup are not detailed in the abstract.
697d1f1fc91ab9a749a6fb8d27ed60139c0daaad.result: Gradients are shown equivalent to adjoint-based gradients; the analysis preserves physical balance, is flow-dependent and improves analysis accuracy.
697d1f1fc91ab9a749a6fb8d27ed60139c0daaad.open_work: Assimilate real, diverse observations operationally and run full cycling with ML forecasts.
697d1f1fc91ab9a749a6fb8d27ed60139c0daaad.issues: Abstract gives no quantitative scores; ML model errors and possible unphysical gradients may affect analyses.

1c5566a28af0a98637e2790047c928d1ddd10b2a.goal: Provide probabilistic high-resolution day-ahead solar irradiance forecasts, since current ML methods poorly model uncertainty in high-dimensional predictions.
1c5566a28af0a98637e2790047c928d1ddd10b2a.architecture: Score-based diffusion model that super-resolves coarse numerical weather predictions to high-resolution satellite observations, generating many samples for probabilistic forecasts.
1c5566a28af0a98637e2790047c928d1ddd10b2a.data: Coarse-resolution numerical weather predictions as input and high-resolution weather satellite irradiance observations as target; specific products not named in the abstract.
1c5566a28af0a98637e2790047c928d1ddd10b2a.result: Claims probabilistic forecasts at unprecedented resolution, speed and accuracy; quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
1c5566a28af0a98637e2790047c928d1ddd10b2a.open_work: Extend to other variables and regions and compare with operational solar forecasting systems.
1c5566a28af0a98637e2790047c928d1ddd10b2a.issues: Short preprint with limited quantitative evaluation; reliability of sample spread is not reported in the abstract.

1b35a352de35bd15303c843b41d24a60df92e6e7.goal: Assess the transferability and extrapolation of deep learning downscaling of climate projections when used as RCM emulators.
1b35a352de35bd15303c843b41d24a60df92e6e7.architecture: U-Net convolutional neural network (UNET) compared with interpolation and linear regression emulators in two pseudo-reality experiments.
1b35a352de35bd15303c843b41d24a60df92e6e7.data: RCA4 regional climate model at 0.11° over a complex Pyrenees domain driven by CNRM-CM5, with predictors from the upscaled RCM or the ESM; other ESMs for transfer tests.
1b35a352de35bd15303c843b41d24a60df92e6e7.result: UNET generalizes poorly to ESMs other than the training one, as does the linear method; under extrapolation it shows warm-extreme biases up to 5°C, larger than linear regression.
1b35a352de35bd15303c843b41d24a60df92e6e7.open_work: Develop training strategies with multiple ESMs and future climates to improve generalization and extrapolation.
1b35a352de35bd15303c843b41d24a60df92e6e7.issues: Single RCM and region and mainly temperature; results may not generalize to other variables or architectures.

1b4a7ebca543d1bf90bcb833537339ff87969845.goal: Replaces human-designed heating and moistening parameterizations in a coarse 200 km global atmosphere model with a data-driven scheme learned from a realistic-geography storm-resolving simulation.
1b4a7ebca543d1bf90bcb833537339ff87969845.architecture: Column-wise neural network predicting 3D heating and moistening rates from coarse temperature, humidity, surface fluxes, solar zenith angle, land-sea mask and geopotential; the network family is not specified in the abstract. Wind tendencies are not learned.
1b4a7ebca543d1bf90bcb833537339ff87969845.data: Coarse-grained 40-day realistic-geography global storm-resolving simulation (grid spacing under 5 km) as training targets; online tests in the coarse 200 km model.
1b4a7ebca543d1bf90bcb833537339ff87969845.result: Offline R2 of 0.4 to 0.8 at most levels and latitudes; online runs are stable for 35 days, with near-surface temperature and precipitation patterns comparable to or slightly better than the physics baseline.
1b4a7ebca543d1bf90bcb833537339ff87969845.open_work: Correcting tropical circulation and upper-tropospheric humidity, learning wind tendencies, and testing longer simulations and other climates.
1b4a7ebca543d1bf90bcb833537339ff87969845.issues: Only 40 days of training data; unrealistic tropical circulation and upper-tropospheric relative humidity online; runs limited to 35 days so climate drift and generalization are untested.

cd743fb83315c4c059cb20fd0f8af9709cd6089a.goal: Book chapter on using deep learning to parameterize unresolved turbulent ocean processes, chiefly mesoscale eddies, whose absence biases currents, stratification and heat and carbon uptake in coarse climate models.
cd743fb83315c4c059cb20fd0f8af9709cd6089a.architecture: Review-style chapter on data-driven subgrid parameterization of ocean mesoscale eddies, centred on convolutional neural networks and, per the authors' related work, equation discovery with relevance vector machines.
cd743fb83315c4c059cb20fd0f8af9709cd6089a.data: Discusses high-resolution ocean simulations and observations as training data; CMIP5 and CMIP6 ocean models (0.1 to 1 degree resolution) as the coarse targets for parameterization.
cd743fb83315c4c059cb20fd0f8af9709cd6089a.result: Argues that deep learning can extract spatio-temporal patterns from high-resolution data to improve eddy parameterizations beyond semi-empirical closures; no single headline number in the abstract.
cd743fb83315c4c059cb20fd0f8af9709cd6089a.open_work: Implementing learned closures online in coarse ocean models, ensuring physical constraints such as momentum conservation, and generalizing across regimes and resolutions.
cd743fb83315c4c059cb20fd0f8af9709cd6089a.issues: Chapter rather than original study; offline skill does not guarantee stable or improved coupled climate simulations, and training data come from models with their own biases.

5b44a8f3c2d62cdef33f840054332483f9b0d22c.goal: Tests whether a hybrid framework that drives data-driven hydrological models with seasonal reforecasts can give fast, flexible seasonal forecasts of discharge and surface water levels in the Netherlands.
5b44a8f3c2d62cdef33f840054332483f9b0d22c.architecture: Hybrid framework: five machine learning models of increasing complexity trained on historical observations, then forced with dynamical seasonal reforecasts; the individual model families are not named in the abstract.
5b44a8f3c2d62cdef33f840054332483f9b0d22c.data: Historical observations of discharge, precipitation, evaporation and sea level for Dutch stations; hindcasts forced with EFAS and ECMWF SEAS5 seasonal reforecasts; evaluated with ACC, CRPSS and BSS against climatology.
5b44a8f3c2d62cdef33f840054332483f9b0d22c.result: Outperforms climatological reference by roughly 60 % for discharge and 80 % for surface water level; skill at one month lead for all initializations, extending to 2 to 3 months in spring through snowmelt; model differences become minor in hindcast mode.
5b44a8f3c2d62cdef33f840054332483f9b0d22c.open_work: Adapting the framework to water managers' needs, for example inside model-predictive control, and improving the seasonal forcing inputs.
5b44a8f3c2d62cdef33f840054332483f9b0d22c.issues: Skill is limited by seasonal forecast uncertainty; models trained on observations but run on reforecast forcing, introducing input distribution shift; national single-country focus.

dba3418ab3f544d3a295505de8222eaa39a62435.goal: Builds an automated cloud-based framework for ingesting, predicting and visualizing snow water equivalent to support water management decisions on peak SWE and snowmelt timing.
dba3418ab3f544d3a295505de8222eaa39a62435.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network for SWE time-series prediction, deployed in a cloud site-monitoring platform with web interface and API.
dba3418ab3f544d3a295505de8222eaa39a62435.data: Daily NRCS SNOTEL station data (precipitation, air temperature, SWE, snow depth); historical years for training and current year for prediction.
dba3418ab3f544d3a295505de8222eaa39a62435.result: NSE ranges from 0.96 to 0.85 and RMSE from 0.038 to 0.07 depending on window size; the LSTM forecasts SWE time series, peak SWE and melt timing efficiently.
dba3418ab3f544d3a295505de8222eaa39a62435.open_work: Calibrating the window size per station and climate, and extending to more stations and operational stakeholder use.
dba3418ab3f544d3a295505de8222eaa39a62435.issues: Station-by-station point predictions; optimal window size is site-dependent; no uncertainty quantification or comparison with physically based snow models reported in the abstract.

1808e1cf454d13739a9107c127fec72048a0407a.goal: Examines offline versus online training of neural-network gravity-wave parameterizations when only little data is available, using a 1D quasi-biennial oscillation model as testbed.
1808e1cf454d13739a9107c127fec72048a0407a.architecture: 12-layer convolutional neural network predicting gravity-wave forcing from wind profiles; online re-training of two layers by ensemble Kalman inversion; Fourier analysis of kernels for explainability.
1808e1cf454d13739a9107c127fec72048a0407a.data: Synthetic data from a 1D QBO model with a physics gravity-wave scheme: 100-year (big data) and 18-month (small data) training sets; time-averaged QBO statistics for online re-training.
1808e1cf454d13739a9107c127fec72048a0407a.result: Big-data offline training yields realistic QBOs, small-data offline training does not, but EKI re-training of two layers on QBO statistics recovers realistic QBOs; kernels act as low-, high- and band-pass filters.
1808e1cf454d13739a9107c127fec72048a0407a.open_work: Applying the offline-online strategy to parameterizations in full GCMs and to other climate processes with scarce data.
1808e1cf454d13739a9107c127fec72048a0407a.issues: Idealized 1D model with a known physics scheme as truth; scalability of EKI re-training to high-dimensional models is untested.

39a79c4ab913be0ed137ecf84e0bedbf62c156a8.goal: Improves long-lead El Niño forecasts and their interpretability by learning spatiotemporal representations of global ocean fields.
39a79c4ab913be0ed137ecf84e0bedbf62c156a8.architecture: STANet: convolutional spatial encoder with enlarged receptive field combined with a stateful LSTM and trainable visual attention, trained multitask on Nino3.4 regression and calendar-month classification.
39a79c4ab913be0ed137ecf84e0bedbf62c156a8.data: Global sea surface temperature and ocean heat content fields; the specific training and validation products are not named in the abstract.
39a79c4ab913be0ed137ecf84e0bedbf62c156a8.result: Improves 12-month lead correlation by 5.8 % for Nino3.4 and 13 % for temporal classification over the prior state-of-the-art model; attention maps match known El Niño precursors.
39a79c4ab913be0ed137ecf84e0bedbf62c156a8.open_work: Testing on more recent independent periods and extending the attention approach to other climate modes.
39a79c4ab913be0ed137ecf84e0bedbf62c156a8.issues: Gains are relative to one previous deep learning baseline; limited number of strong El Niño events for evaluation; datasets not specified in the abstract.

741186b2853898e79aea156e5e1b71d9569b96d5.goal: Improves satellite passive-microwave precipitation retrieval with machine learning and examines whether the black-box model can be interpreted physically.
741186b2853898e79aea156e5e1b71d9569b96d5.architecture: Pipeline of a LinkNet segmentation network (convolutional encoder-decoder) for precipitation identification followed by a tree ensemble for rate and type estimation, with feature-importance analysis.
741186b2853898e79aea156e5e1b71d9569b96d5.data: AMSU observations from NOAA-18 and NOAA-19 as inputs; MRMS radar-based multi-sensor precipitation as reference.
741186b2853898e79aea156e5e1b71d9569b96d5.result: Systematic and instantaneous errors reduced by about a factor of two; precipitation identification cuts systematic error by 130 % and classification raises correlation by 32 %; 89 and 150 GHz channels rank most important.
741186b2853898e79aea156e5e1b71d9569b96d5.open_work: Extending to other microwave sensors and regions and using interpretability to guide retrieval physics.
741186b2853898e79aea156e5e1b71d9569b96d5.issues: Trained and evaluated over MRMS coverage (CONUS), so transfer to other climates and oceans is uncertain; feature importance is not causal attribution.

c767605d8366d7ff0eddeba7c209307cf366dd2b.goal: Bridges numerical and deep-learning weather prediction by embedding physical laws into a data-driven model that produces spatiotemporally continuous forecasts.
c767605d8366d7ff0eddeba7c209307cf366dd2b.architecture: DeepPhysiNet: per-variable physics networks based on multilayer perceptrons (MLP) taking coordinates as input, with PDE residuals in the loss (physics-informed), and deep-learning hyper-networks that generate part of their weights from meteorological data.
c767605d8366d7ff0eddeba7c209307cf366dd2b.data: Large meteorological datasets of temperature, pressure and wind; the specific product and period are not reported in the abstract.
c767605d8366d7ff0eddeba7c209307cf366dd2b.result: Improves forecast accuracy and yields continuous-resolution outputs while satisfying physical laws, which the authors say neither NWP nor pure deep learning achieves; no numbers given in the abstract.
c767605d8366d7ff0eddeba7c209307cf366dd2b.open_work: Scaling to more variables, longer leads and global high-resolution settings, and comparison with leading data-driven global models.
c767605d8366d7ff0eddeba7c209307cf366dd2b.issues: Abstract lacks quantitative metrics and baselines; enforcing PDE losses on coordinate networks can be costly to train and sensitive to loss weighting.

cef45520fc9f12cd70a1ac343125758c8b3fab15.goal: Provides practical guidance for writing custom loss functions so neural networks in environmental science optimize domain-relevant performance measures.
cef45520fc9f12cd70a1ac343125758c8b3fab15.architecture: Guide/tutorial on custom loss functions for neural networks: basics, pitfalls, fractions skill score as a loss, physical constraints, soft discretization, and focal, robust and adaptive losses; examples in Keras/TensorFlow.
cef45520fc9f12cd70a1ac343125758c8b3fab15.data: Not a data study; meteorological examples with code samples in a GitHub repository.
cef45520fc9f12cd70a1ac343125758c8b3fab15.result: Delivers a reference of loss-function recipes, including spatial verification metrics such as the fractions skill score, transferable to PyTorch and other environmental fields.
cef45520fc9f12cd70a1ac343125758c8b3fab15.open_work: Future versions to add more examples, frameworks and loss types.
cef45520fc9f12cd70a1ac343125758c8b3fab15.issues: Version 1 tutorial without systematic benchmarks of the losses; examples centred on meteorology and Keras.

e7c6f5d47b509a3173fea094dcbf1ff3a1d81687.goal: Estimates uncertain parameters of a convective-scale model with neural networks as an alternative to manual tuning or augmented-state data assimilation.
e7c6f5d47b509a3173fea094dcbf1ff3a1d81687.architecture: Bayesian neural networks and Bayesian approximations of point-estimate neural networks mapping observations or analyses to model parameters, combined with ensemble data assimilation; layer-wise relevance propagation for interpretation.
e7c6f5d47b509a3173fea094dcbf1ff3a1d81687.data: Perfect-model experiments with the one-dimensional modified shallow-water model, including sparse and noisy observations.
e7c6f5d47b509a3173fea094dcbf1ff3a1d81687.result: Both network types estimate parameters and their statistics; combining parameter estimation with DA reduces initial-state errors; LRP shows the networks focus on a few grid points with strong wind and rain.
e7c6f5d47b509a3173fea094dcbf1ff3a1d81687.open_work: Moving to more realistic convective-scale NWP models and real observations, and estimating more parameters jointly.
e7c6f5d47b509a3173fea094dcbf1ff3a1d81687.issues: Idealized 1D perfect-model setting; sensitivity to ensemble size, observation coverage and network size noted.

a68fead42cb5565f1e64d4a5d08a81ed361991e4.goal: Imposes mass conservation in ensemble data assimilation at low cost, since constrained methods such as the quadratic programming ensemble (QPEns) are too expensive for large systems.
a68fead42cb5565f1e64d4a5d08a81ed361991e4.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) trained to correct EnKF analyses toward QPEns analyses, forming a hybrid CNN-EnKF scheme.
a68fead42cb5565f1e64d4a5d08a81ed361991e4.data: Idealized setup with EnKF and QPEns analyses as training data; the abstract does not name the model, which is a simple idealized dynamical model.
a68fead42cb5565f1e64d4a5d08a81ed361991e4.result: The CNN-EnKF hybrid reduces analysis and background errors to the same level as QPEns while conserving mass.
a68fead42cb5565f1e64d4a5d08a81ed361991e4.open_work: Extending to other conserved quantities and higher-dimensional, more realistic prediction systems.
a68fead42cb5565f1e64d4a5d08a81ed361991e4.issues: Idealized experiments only; the CNN learns from QPEns outputs so it needs that expensive method for training data.

44ba12d5bb4eac3602752ee40c36cdbedecab949.goal: Develops lightweight daily operational sea ice concentration forecasts for Arctic marine operations, respecting real-time data availability.
44ba12d5bb4eac3602752ee40c36cdbedecab949.architecture: U-Net convolutional encoder-decoder trained in two regimes to forecast sea ice concentration up to 10 days ahead.
44ba12d5bb4eac3602752ee40c36cdbedecab949.data: Sea ice concentration observations plus additional weather data for the Barents, Labrador and Laptev Seas; specific products are not named in the abstract.
44ba12d5bb4eac3602752ee40c36cdbedecab949.result: U-Net outperforms simple baselines by a significant margin; adding weather data and multi-region training improves quality and generalization; an operational tool is produced.
44ba12d5bb4eac3602752ee40c36cdbedecab949.open_work: Extending to more regions, longer leads and probabilistic output.
44ba12d5bb4eac3602752ee40c36cdbedecab949.issues: Comparisons are against simple baselines rather than dynamical ice-ocean forecasts in the abstract; regional scope.

b7623e34e55f5d8ec27501c8d79d6a0ef3db6004.goal: Increases the efficiency of linear solvers in semi-implicit atmosphere and ocean models by learning the preconditioner.
b7623e34e55f5d8ec27501c8d79d6a0ef3db6004.architecture: Machine-learned preconditioner embedded in a Krylov-type linear solver; methods range from linear regression to deep feed-forward neural networks (MLP).
b7623e34e55f5d8ec27501c8d79d6a0ef3db6004.data: Shallow-water model with semi-implicit time-stepping designed to resemble atmospheric models.
b7623e34e55f5d8ec27501c8d79d6a0ef3db6004.result: The learned preconditioner is competitive with a conventional preconditioner and works even outside the dynamical range of training; the solver still guarantees accuracy.
b7623e34e55f5d8ec27501c8d79d6a0ef3db6004.open_work: Applying to full 3D atmosphere and ocean models and evaluating wall-clock speedups on modern hardware.
b7623e34e55f5d8ec27501c8d79d6a0ef3db6004.issues: Conference abstract on a shallow-water testbed; computational cost of the network inside the solver and scalability not quantified in the abstract.

ae58d9e252224a83d8c5694ef9e2e4d799e74311.goal: Extends skillful ENSO prediction to 18 to 24 month leads, where dynamical and statistical systems struggle.
ae58d9e252224a83d8c5694ef9e2e4d799e74311.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) system with separate parameters for each season and a modified loss function; CNN heatmaps for precursor analysis.
ae58d9e252224a83d8c5694ef9e2e4d799e74311.data: Training and evaluation datasets are not named in the abstract; compared with the SINTEX-F2 dynamical system and other statistical models.
ae58d9e252224a83d8c5694ef9e2e4d799e74311.result: Highly skillful ENSO prediction at 18 to 24 months, including extreme events, outperforming SINTEX-F2; overcomes the spring predictability barrier.
ae58d9e252224a83d8c5694ef9e2e4d799e74311.open_work: Physical understanding of identified precursors and verification on future independent periods.
ae58d9e252224a83d8c5694ef9e2e4d799e74311.issues: Limited number of observed ENSO events for robust long-lead validation; data sources not reported in the abstract.

1a696c2c84d1d04729ebaa458615884bb7ea2111.goal: Evaluates a mass-conserving LSTM for streamflow simulation across the contiguous United States, as the title states.
1a696c2c84d1d04729ebaa458615884bb7ea2111.architecture: Mass-conserving long short-term memory network (MC-LSTM); further design details are not available without the abstract.
1a696c2c84d1d04729ebaa458615884bb7ea2111.data: Basins across the contiguous United States; the specific dataset is not reported here.
1a696c2c84d1d04729ebaa458615884bb7ea2111.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
1a696c2c84d1d04729ebaa458615884bb7ea2111.open_work: Likely comparison with standard LSTM and process-based models across hydroclimates; not confirmed.
1a696c2c84d1d04729ebaa458615884bb7ea2111.issues: Abstract unavailable, so card is based on the title only.

dce0e2ac3f751783c4dfb14ad43ec16329bd3e34.goal: Reduces the cost of kilometre-scale dynamical downscaling of extreme convective precipitation by selecting only the GCM periods likely to produce extremes.
dce0e2ac3f751783c4dfb14ad43ec16329bd3e34.architecture: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) classifying large-scale circulation data to select a subset for dynamical downscaling (smart dynamical downscaling).
dce0e2ac3f751783c4dfb14ad43ec16329bd3e34.data: Circulation and precipitation data for three subtropical/tropical regions for training; tested on different reanalysis datasets.
dce0e2ac3f751783c4dfb14ad43ec16329bd3e34.result: CNNs retain 92 to 98 % of extreme events (above 99th percentile) while filtering out 88 to 95 % of data; skill drops modestly in the subtropics and sharply in the deep tropics on other reanalyses, worst case 62 % retained.
dce0e2ac3f751783c4dfb14ad43ec16329bd3e34.open_work: Improving generalization in the deep tropics and applying to GCM projections of future climate.
dce0e2ac3f751783c4dfb14ad43ec16329bd3e34.issues: Sensitivity to dataset shift, especially in the deep tropics; missed extremes bias downscaled statistics.

bfe7a2c7b49dd3743bc810ef96cf13e755459d0b.goal: Emulates convection and cloud processes from a superparameterized GCM with neural networks that generalize to warmer climates and run stably online.
bfe7a2c7b49dd3743bc810ef96cf13e755459d0b.architecture: ResCu-en: ensemble of 32-layer deep convolutional residual neural networks (ResNet, 1D convolutions) with convective memory, predicting temperature and moisture tendencies and cloud water/ice.
bfe7a2c7b49dd3743bc810ef96cf13e755459d0b.data: SPCAM simulations for training and 1-year offline validation, including a +4K SST climate; online coupling in CAM5 with real geography.
bfe7a2c7b49dd3743bc810ef96cf13e755459d0b.result: High offline accuracy in current and +4K climates; 5-year stable NCAM run with good mean precipitation, intensity and diurnal cycle; generalization attributed to convective memory and 1D convolutions.
bfe7a2c7b49dd3743bc810ef96cf13e755459d0b.open_work: Reducing high-latitude temperature and moisture biases and longer, climate-change online simulations.
bfe7a2c7b49dd3743bc810ef96cf13e755459d0b.issues: Large high-latitude temperature and moisture biases online; trained on SPCAM, inheriting its biases; only one ensemble member coupled online.

c011e4b02f3cd53f44a8fcddd6d517c3e73056cd.goal: Learns subgrid-scale stresses for large-eddy simulation of the convective atmospheric boundary layer without the eddy-viscosity assumption.
c011e4b02f3cd53f44a8fcddd6d517c3e73056cd.architecture: Supervised deep neural network mapping neighbouring coarse-grained velocities to SGS stresses; the layer type is not specified in the abstract.
c011e4b02f3cd53f44a8fcddd6d517c3e73056cd.data: Filtered direct numerical simulations of the convective boundary layer at friction Reynolds numbers up to 1243.
c011e4b02f3cd53f44a8fcddd6d517c3e73056cd.result: Higher correlation of SGS stresses than Smagorinsky and Smagorinsky-Bardina mixed models; generalizes across grid resolutions and stability from near neutral to very unstable; captures key statistics online in LES.
c011e4b02f3cd53f44a8fcddd6d517c3e73056cd.open_work: Testing at higher Reynolds numbers, stable conditions and complex terrain, and longer online runs.
c011e4b02f3cd53f44a8fcddd6d517c3e73056cd.issues: Trained on DNS at moderate Reynolds numbers far below real atmosphere; online evaluation limited to selected statistics.

851f3bb15167340ab499e7b6e5c3508925f4a89b.goal: Post-processes physically based sea ice forecasts with deep learning to improve short-term sea ice concentration forecasts for polar maritime operations.
851f3bb15167340ab499e7b6e5c3508925f4a89b.architecture: Supervised deep learning post-processing models for 1 to 10 day leads; the network family is not stated in the abstract.
851f3bb15167340ab499e7b6e5c3508925f4a89b.data: Predictors from TOPAZ4 sea ice forecasts, weather forecasts and sea ice concentration observations; evaluated against observed sea ice concentration.
851f3bb15167340ab499e7b6e5c3508925f4a89b.result: RMSE 41 % lower than TOPAZ4 and 29 % lower than persistence; ice-edge location improved similarly; 10-day prediction in about 4 minutes; observations most important predictors, weather forecasts more than sea ice forecasts.
851f3bb15167340ab499e7b6e5c3508925f4a89b.open_work: Adding uncertainty estimates and extending to longer leads and other sea ice variables.
851f3bb15167340ab499e7b6e5c3508925f4a89b.issues: Depends on TOPAZ4 and observation availability; deterministic output; evaluation period and regions limited.

2db3d1261e668bddaf5700feaf9012db8ee92b6e.goal: Shows that very small, local neural networks can serve as accurate, stable subgrid closures for 2D turbulence, improving training efficiency and interpretability.
2db3d1261e668bddaf5700feaf9012db8ee92b6e.architecture: Shallow 2-layer convolutional neural networks (CNN) with about 1000 parameters predicting the deviatoric SGS stress tensor from coarse velocity or vorticity and strain, trained with cyclical learning-rate annealing.
2db3d1261e668bddaf5700feaf9012db8ee92b6e.data: High-resolution simulations of sinusoidally forced 2D turbulence on the beta-plane at Re about 25,000, coarse-grained 16 times.
2db3d1261e668bddaf5700feaf9012db8ee92b6e.result: Stable, accurate long-term online LES solutions at 16x downscaling with networks two orders of magnitude smaller than prior 8 to 10 layer CNNs; SGS stresses depend only weakly on non-local fields.
2db3d1261e668bddaf5700feaf9012db8ee92b6e.open_work: Extending to 3D, stratified and ocean/atmosphere model settings and interpreting the learned closures.
2db3d1261e668bddaf5700feaf9012db8ee92b6e.issues: Idealized 2D forced turbulence; results depend on extensive hyperparameter search.

27ca81593562281f16b3f5ba9a6a6a6295df7f22.goal: Reports the WMO 2021 prize challenge assessing whether AI can improve sub-seasonal to seasonal forecasts of precipitation and 2 m temperature.
27ca81593562281f16b3f5ba9a6a6a6295df7f22.architecture: Competition report describing the top three AI post-processing submissions, based on calibration of ECMWF output or multi-model combination; the specific network families are not stated in the abstract.
27ca81593562281f16b3f5ba9a6a6a6295df7f22.data: S2S ensemble reforecasts and forecasts including ECMWF operational output; forecasts of weeks 3-4 and 5-6 for 2020 verified globally.
27ca81593562281f16b3f5ba9a6a6a6295df7f22.result: Top three submissions are significantly more skillful than bias-corrected ECMWF reference forecasts, especially for precipitation.
27ca81593562281f16b3f5ba9a6a6a6295df7f22.open_work: Operational adoption of AI post-processing and benefits for S2S applications.
27ca81593562281f16b3f5ba9a6a6a6295df7f22.issues: Single verification year (2020); gains over a bias-corrected reference may vary by region and season.

9a66ecee48b364cff83072e04bf03ae65f753abb.goal: Surveys emulators of Earth system model output that provide climate information much faster than full ESMs for climate and sustainability science.
9a66ecee48b364cff83072e04bf03ae65f753abb.architecture: Review of climate model emulators, from pattern scaling and statistical approaches of varying complexity to machine learning methods, including those simulating internal variability.
9a66ecee48b364cff83072e04bf03ae65f753abb.data: Not a data study; covers emulators trained on ESM output such as CMIP ensembles.
9a66ecee48b364cff83072e04bf03ae65f753abb.result: Categorizes emulators by method, inputs and outputs and discusses fitness for purpose and limitations.
9a66ecee48b364cff83072e04bf03ae65f753abb.open_work: Gaps include extremes, internal variability, compound events and validation under out-of-sample forcings.
9a66ecee48b364cff83072e04bf03ae65f753abb.issues: Review without new benchmarks; fitness-for-purpose depends heavily on use case.

968ca654e835ab5d821de518e0e91ebe4371e8a1.goal: Summarizes outcomes of the 2021 ESA-ECMWF workshop on machine learning for Earth system observation and prediction.
968ca654e835ab5d821de518e0e91ebe4371e8a1.architecture: Review/workshop report covering ML across observation processing, data assimilation, forecasting and post-processing; no single model.
968ca654e835ab5d821de518e0e91ebe4371e8a1.data: Not a data study; based on talks and participant feedback from over 30 speakers and 1100 registrants.
968ca654e835ab5d821de518e0e91ebe4371e8a1.result: Identifies limitations, opportunities and challenges in fusing ML with Earth system observation and prediction.
968ca654e835ab5d821de518e0e91ebe4371e8a1.open_work: Research directions highlighted for each thematic area of ML4ESOP.
968ca654e835ab5d821de518e0e91ebe4371e8a1.issues: Workshop summary reflecting participant views rather than systematic evaluation.

0d625d6b541803546abe03455b0e2655e1048948.goal: Assesses convolutional neural networks for statistical downscaling of daily temperatures over southern South America and their behaviour under climate change, as the title states.
0d625d6b541803546abe03455b0e2655e1048948.architecture: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) for statistical downscaling; further architectural details are not available without the abstract.
0d625d6b541803546abe03455b0e2655e1048948.data: Not reported here; likely large-scale predictors from reanalysis and GCM output with station or gridded temperature observations, but unconfirmed.
0d625d6b541803546abe03455b0e2655e1048948.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
0d625d6b541803546abe03455b0e2655e1048948.issues: Abstract unavailable; extrapolation of CNN downscaling to future warmer climates is a general concern for this approach.

2fc3720524b4add1ac2c270c88353b8e345a72cc.goal: Uses deep learning to understand ENSO dynamics, not just predict it, by making network results interpretable.
2fc3720524b4add1ac2c270c88353b8e345a72cc.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) with occlusion-like 'contribution map' and 'contribution sensitivity' interpretation methods.
2fc3720524b4add1ac2c270c88353b8e345a72cc.data: Long-term climate model simulations for training and analysis; specific models not named in the abstract.
2fc3720524b4add1ac2c270c88353b8e345a72cc.result: Correlation skill of about 0.82 at 9-month lead; three ENSO precursors identified with asymmetric roles for El Niño and La Niña.
2fc3720524b4add1ac2c270c88353b8e345a72cc.open_work: Applying the contribution methods to other climate phenomena and observational data.
2fc3720524b4add1ac2c270c88353b8e345a72cc.issues: Based on climate model simulations, so precursors may reflect model biases; perturbation-based attribution depends on chosen perturbations.

1801480078cc663a60f63fc8579d2947aea6bf76.goal: Discovers interpretable closed-form representations of structural model errors from sparse, possibly noisy observations.
1801480078cc663a60f63fc8579d2947aea6bf76.architecture: MEDIDA framework: non-neural method combining ensemble Kalman filter data assimilation with equation discovery by relevance vector machine (sparse Bayesian regression).
1801480078cc663a60f63fc8579d2947aea6bf76.data: Chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky system with synthetic noise-free and noisy sporadic observations.
1801480078cc663a60f63fc8579d2947aea6bf76.result: Accurately discovers different structural and parametric model errors representing missing physics, with both noise-free and noisy observations.
1801480078cc663a60f63fc8579d2947aea6bf76.open_work: Applying to higher-dimensional systems such as atmospheric and ocean models and real observations.
1801480078cc663a60f63fc8579d2947aea6bf76.issues: 1D idealized test case; requires an adequate library of candidate terms for sparse regression.

b51a758ca04678dfd732da5981d36d85d2e68a2d.goal: Accelerates variational data assimilation by training a neural network to approximate the 4DVar solution, avoiding costly online optimization.
b51a758ca04678dfd732da5981d36d85d2e68a2d.architecture: Neural network trained with a 4DVar-form loss using analysis fields instead of unavailable truths; the network family is not specified in the abstract.
b51a758ca04678dfd732da5981d36d85d2e68a2d.data: Lorenz-96 model experiments, including higher-dimensional configurations and observations with larger errors than in training.
b51a758ca04678dfd732da5981d36d85d2e68a2d.result: Produces better initial fields than most traditional DA methods at low computational cost; robust to out-of-distribution observation errors and larger systems.
b51a758ca04678dfd732da5981d36d85d2e68a2d.open_work: Scaling to realistic NWP models and real observations.
b51a758ca04678dfd732da5981d36d85d2e68a2d.issues: Tested only on Lorenz-96; training relies on analysis fields from conventional methods.

0057953c13129bc2cf923b0a0b5b39ea722a4b54.goal: Generates and characterizes a huge ensemble of ML weather hindcasts to sample extreme-weather tails and internal variability at low cost.
0057953c13129bc2cf923b0a0b5b39ea722a4b54.architecture: Spherical Fourier neural operator (SFNO) ensemble with bred-vector initial perturbations and multiple independently trained checkpoints as model perturbations.
0057953c13129bc2cf923b0a0b5b39ea722a4b54.data: SFNO models trained on ERA5 reanalysis (Part 1); 7424-member ensemble initialized each day of summer 2023.
0057953c13129bc2cf923b0a0b5b39ea722a4b54.result: HENS samples events 4 sigma from the ensemble mean, improves the skill of the best member, and reduces outlier events, giving better uncertainty quantification for extremes.
0057953c13129bc2cf923b0a0b5b39ea722a4b54.open_work: Using HENS as a dataset to study statistics and drivers of extremes and extending to other seasons.
0057953c13129bc2cf923b0a0b5b39ea722a4b54.issues: Only summer 2023 initializations; inherits ERA5 biases and ML model smoothing; massive storage and compute requirements.

f1d82cc4a8e77e58bc1b86f65ae02e3195dcffcb.goal: Provides a simple way to add heteroscedastic, asymmetric uncertainty estimates to neural network regression in the geosciences.
f1d82cc4a8e77e58bc1b86f65ae02e3195dcffcb.architecture: Neural network whose output layer predicts parameters of a general probability distribution (sinh-arcsinh-normal) trained with a negative log-likelihood loss; the network family is not otherwise specified.
f1d82cc4a8e77e58bc1b86f65ae02e3195dcffcb.data: Simple 1D synthetic dataset and synthetic climate data for a more complex regression task.
f1d82cc4a8e77e58bc1b86f65ae02e3195dcffcb.result: The modified output and loss produce well-behaved heteroscedastic and asymmetric uncertainty estimates in both examples.
f1d82cc4a8e77e58bc1b86f65ae02e3195dcffcb.open_work: Applying the method to real geoscience regression problems and comparing with other uncertainty methods.
f1d82cc4a8e77e58bc1b86f65ae02e3195dcffcb.issues: Demonstrated only on synthetic data; captures aleatoric but not epistemic uncertainty.

5f5d8005947e3e29d57bb7d9efce85e1e6c9f798.goal: Forecasts pan-Arctic and regional September sea ice extent with up to 3-month lead times for Arctic communities and stakeholders.
5f5d8005947e3e29d57bb7d9efce85e1e6c9f798.architecture: Complex network analysis to derive nodes and teleconnection links from sea ice concentration fields, fed into linear Gaussian process regression (Bayesian, non-neural).
5f5d8005947e3e29d57bb7d9efce85e1e6c9f798.data: Monthly mean satellite sea ice concentration fields for June, July and August; September sea ice extent from satellite observations.
5f5d8005947e3e29d57bb7d9efce85e1e6c9f798.result: Detrended pan-Arctic skill of 0.53, 0.62 and 0.81 at 3, 2 and 1 month leads; best regional skill in the Canadian Archipelago, Beaufort, Chukchi, East Siberian, Laptev and Kara Seas.
5f5d8005947e3e29d57bb7d9efce85e1e6c9f798.open_work: Adding other predictors such as ocean and atmosphere fields and handling non-stationary predictability.
5f5d8005947e3e29d57bb7d9efce85e1e6c9f798.issues: Regional skill changes over time; short satellite record limits training; linear GP may miss nonlinear relations.

5d37564df274debec7d3d505098aab32c9b82f33.goal: Investigates design principles for data-driven ocean climate emulators, focusing on the role of atmospheric forcing and on representing ocean variables that evolve on distinct timescales.
5d37564df274debec7d3d505098aab32c9b82f33.architecture: Data-driven neural network emulator of ocean surface fields; the specific network family is not specified in the abstract. Experiments vary atmospheric forcing inputs and timescale-aware variable handling.
5d37564df274debec7d3d505098aab32c9b82f33.data: Output from a high-resolution coupled climate model, used for training and testing in four regional domains of the globe.
5d37564df274debec7d3d505098aab32c9b82f33.result: Emulators produce stable predictions of ocean surface fields for over 8 years, and the study derives physically motivated guidelines for emulator design.
5d37564df274debec7d3d505098aab32c9b82f33.open_work: Extend from surface fields to full-depth, global ocean emulation and coupling with atmospheric emulators for accelerated coupled climate simulation.
5d37564df274debec7d3d505098aab32c9b82f33.issues: Trained and tested on a single climate model, regional domains only, surface fields only; no evaluation against observations.

bf4273a97ed17528cced8fb3fcff678ed6781fa0.goal: Tests whether deep learning can identify a known geophysical phenomenon, the Madden-Julian oscillation, and whether the learned patterns are interpretable for scientific inference.
bf4273a97ed17528cced8fb3fcff678ed6781fa0.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) classifying MJO state from spatial fields, combined with explainability analysis of the variables and spatial patterns it relies on.
bf4273a97ed17528cced8fb3fcff678ed6781fa0.data: Not reported in the abstract; spatial fields of tropical atmospheric variables (e.g. cloud-related fields) labelled by MJO state.
bf4273a97ed17528cced8fb3fcff678ed6781fa0.result: The CNN correctly identifies MJO state and its relevance maps highlight variables and spatial patterns consistent with known MJO structure, supporting interpretable deep learning for geoscience.
bf4273a97ed17528cced8fb3fcff678ed6781fa0.open_work: Apply the approach to phenomena whose mechanisms are less well understood, using explainability to discover new physical insight.
