bf4273a97ed17528cced8fb3fcff678ed6781fa0.issues: Proof-of-concept on a well-studied phenomenon with a predefined index; skill metrics, data and generalization are not detailed in the abstract.

fd1a3c57de28a8bce090b51500ae9952d51f08a8.goal: Replaces iterative Monin-Obukhov similarity theory calculations of surface-layer turbulent fluxes with a learned mapping, avoiding empirical stability-function fitting and iteration.
fd1a3c57de28a8bce090b51500ae9952d51f08a8.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) with six input variables and one hidden layer, trained with BFGS quasi-Newton backpropagation to predict scaling quantities u* and theta*; compared with multivariate linear regression.
fd1a3c57de28a8bce090b51500ae9952d51f08a8.data: Multi-year flux-tower data sets from seven grassland, forest and wetland sites worldwide, with six-fold cross validation; also tested inside a one-dimensional stand-alone land surface model.
fd1a3c57de28a8bce090b51500ae9952d51f08a8.result: The ANN matches or slightly beats the standard MOST method and clearly beats linear regression; results hold when embedded in the 1D land surface model, though no CPU time is saved there.
fd1a3c57de28a8bce090b51500ae9952d51f08a8.open_work: Implement the ANN in three-dimensional climate models with longer time steps, where computational savings may materialize.
fd1a3c57de28a8bce090b51500ae9952d51f08a8.issues: Only seven sites; no speed-up in the 1D model; generalization to other surface types and to coupled 3D models remains untested.

5abe6da62d9fc68d06aef756577fe70aaaf3ef6f.goal: Improves the lead time, robustness and interpretability of deep-learning ENSO forecasts, addressing concerns about overfitting and lack of physical explanation.
5abe6da62d9fc68d06aef756577fe70aaaf3ef6f.architecture: ResoNet, a hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) and transformer model capturing local SST anomalies and long-range inter-basin interactions, analysed with an explainability method.
5abe6da62d9fc68d06aef756577fe70aaaf3ef6f.data: Not reported in the abstract; global ocean fields such as sea surface temperature anomalies, with Nino-3.4 index as the predictand.
5abe6da62d9fc68d06aef756577fe70aaaf3ef6f.result: ResoNet predicts ENSO skilfully at 19-month lead, beyond existing approaches, relies on physically reasonable mechanisms (recharge oscillator, seasonal footprint, Indian Ocean capacitor) and captures El Nino/La Nina asymmetry.
5abe6da62d9fc68d06aef756577fe70aaaf3ef6f.open_work: Use AI models to discover and predict other climate phenomena; extend explainability to spatial pattern forecasts.
5abe6da62d9fc68d06aef756577fe70aaaf3ef6f.issues: Long-lead skill rests on limited observational record; training data and validation period are not given in the abstract; index-only target.

83facfcf2186103689fbd1c0b77c0c237a515dd9.goal: Develops neural network emulations of moist convection parameterization learned from cloud resolving model simulations, for use in climate and weather prediction models.
83facfcf2186103689fbd1c0b77c0c237a515dd9.architecture: Neural network emulations of a convection parameterization learned from cloud resolving model output; the network family and configuration are not specified in the available record (no abstract).
83facfcf2186103689fbd1c0b77c0c237a515dd9.data: Cloud resolving model simulations, per the title; forcing data, domain and period are not reported since the abstract is missing.
83facfcf2186103689fbd1c0b77c0c237a515dd9.open_work: Test with larger and more diverse CRM training sets and in fully coupled multi-year climate simulations.
83facfcf2186103689fbd1c0b77c0c237a515dd9.issues: Limited CRM training domain and regime coverage may restrict generalization; offline-to-online behavior and uncertainty are not addressed here.

e36ec5cde4d45f06dc096900b213a02d96d03992.goal: Forecasts El Nino-Southern Oscillation with deep learning to extend ENSO predictability beyond conventional methods.
e36ec5cde4d45f06dc096900b213a02d96d03992.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) and recurrent neural network models, as stated in the title; the recurrent cell type is not specified here.
e36ec5cde4d45f06dc096900b213a02d96d03992.data: Not reported (abstract missing); likely gridded ocean fields with a Nino index target, but sources are not stated.
e36ec5cde4d45f06dc096900b213a02d96d03992.open_work: Not reported; natural next steps include longer leads and interpretability of learned predictors.
e36ec5cde4d45f06dc096900b213a02d96d03992.issues: Abstract unavailable; details of data, evaluation and skill cannot be verified from the record.

4cc38f4edd1b71da0f24813131569c6270fa5dad.goal: Produces a global gap-filled atmospheric state directly from multi-modal satellite observations as a fast AI alternative to operational data assimilation.
4cc38f4edd1b71da0f24813131569c6270fa5dad.architecture: EarthNet, a multi-modal foundation model based on masked autoencoders that ingests a 12-hour sequence of satellite observations and learns to fill missing data across sensors.
4cc38f4edd1b71da0f24813131569c6270fa5dad.data: Multi-modal satellite observations; evaluated against MERRA2 and ERA5 reanalyses and Microwave integrated Retrieval System (MiRS) retrievals.
4cc38f4edd1b71da0f24813131569c6270fa5dad.result: Generates a 0.16 degree 3D temperature and humidity state in 5 minutes on one GPU (50x faster than operational systems); 3D humidity beats MERRA2 and ERA5 by 10-60% at 5-20 km but underperforms near the surface and for temperature.
4cc38f4edd1b71da0f24813131569c6270fa5dad.open_work: Use EarthNet for high-frequency data assimilation and as initial conditions for global weather forecasting.
4cc38f4edd1b71da0f24813131569c6270fa5dad.issues: Weaker near-surface and temperature performance; evaluated partly against retrievals; no dynamical consistency constraints or forecast-skill impact shown.

4c3b8dec9b7aefd91b3b44f7a05ba01778675b3b.goal: Enables AI-based data assimilation that can ingest observations at arbitrary and varying resolutions rather than a single fixed one.
4c3b8dec9b7aefd91b3b44f7a05ba01778675b3b.architecture: Fourier Neural Processes (FNP), a neural process framework with Fourier-based modules for resolution-agnostic assimilation of background forecasts and observations.
4c3b8dec9b7aefd91b3b44f7a05ba01778675b3b.data: Not reported in the abstract; global medium-range weather fields with observations at varying resolutions.
4c3b8dec9b7aefd91b3b44f7a05ba01778675b3b.result: FNP achieves state-of-the-art assimilation across resolutions, with growing advantage as resolution and observation amount increase, and generalizes to unseen resolutions and to observation reconstruction without fine-tuning.
4c3b8dec9b7aefd91b3b44f7a05ba01778675b3b.open_work: Test with real, irregular operational observations and in cycled assimilation-forecast systems.
4c3b8dec9b7aefd91b3b44f7a05ba01778675b3b.issues: Likely synthetic observations derived from gridded data; real observation operators, errors and cycling are not addressed in the abstract.

07f734853f61f003b5d8149d7df596a5e5f320a0.goal: Designs calibrated ensembles for neural weather models that represent both model and initial-condition uncertainty.
07f734853f61f003b5d8149d7df596a5e5f320a0.architecture: Ensemble of neural weather models with perturbed key model parameters for model uncertainty, plus breeding of growing modes for initial-condition perturbations; network family is not specified in the abstract.
07f734853f61f003b5d8149d7df596a5e5f320a0.data: Not reported in the abstract; benchmarked against the 50-member ECMWF IFS ensemble and a probabilistic NWM baseline.
07f734853f61f003b5d8149d7df596a5e5f320a0.result: The combined ensemble improves on a benchmark probabilistic NWM and is competitive with the IFS 50-member ensemble in error and calibration, especially over land for total column water vapor, surface wind and 2 m temperature.
07f734853f61f003b5d8149d7df596a5e5f320a0.open_work: Generate very large ensembles (>100 members) for extreme-event applications.
07f734853f61f003b5d8149d7df596a5e5f320a0.issues: Competitive rather than superior to IFS ENS; variable coverage and lead times are limited; reliance on reanalysis-trained models inherits their biases.

ad25799c5fda298ad2ef250a07df237f219c3ea1.goal: Tests whether feeding conceptual hydrological model outputs into an LSTM improves streamflow prediction while keeping some physical grounding.
ad25799c5fda298ad2ef250a07df237f219c3ea1.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network post-processing outputs of the calibrated SAC-SMA conceptual model with Snow-17, compared with a standalone LSTM.
ad25799c5fda298ad2ef250a07df237f219c3ea1.data: Not reported in the abstract; catchment streamflow data (likely a large-sample basin data set, not stated).
ad25799c5fda298ad2ef250a07df237f219c3ea1.result: Post-processing greatly improves SAC-SMA but only marginally improves on a standalone LSTM; gains are larger in snowy catchments and in long-term bias.
ad25799c5fda298ad2ef250a07df237f219c3ea1.open_work: Explore other hybrid strategies, e.g. mass-conserving architectures, to combine physical constraints with LSTM skill.
ad25799c5fda298ad2ef250a07df237f219c3ea1.issues: Small benefit over standalone LSTM; dataset and metrics are not detailed in the abstract; no conservation constraints in the LSTM.

302e5f4220e641cf02f88c1cef315435717e552b.goal: Replaces classical variational data assimilation with a neural network that directly learns the analysis functional, without requiring pre-existing analysis datasets.
302e5f4220e641cf02f88c1cef315435717e552b.architecture: AI-Var: a neural network trained to minimize the variational (3D-Var-type) cost function, mapping background and observations to an analysis; network family is not specified in the abstract.
302e5f4220e641cf02f88c1cef315435717e552b.data: Idealized test cases and real-world test cases with NWP backgrounds and observations; specific products are not reported in the abstract.
302e5f4220e641cf02f88c1cef315435717e552b.result: Proof of concept shows AI-Var can efficiently assimilate observations and produce accurate initial conditions for NWP.
302e5f4220e641cf02f88c1cef315435717e552b.open_work: Scale to full operational observation sets and integrate into fully data-driven NWP systems.
302e5f4220e641cf02f88c1cef315435717e552b.issues: Proof-of-concept only; quantitative comparisons with operational DA are not given; handling of complex observation operators and error covariances unclear.

2029a29bec902d78ee2969739cd467e14586f945.goal: Evaluates a global data-driven weather model against NWP models, with and without probabilistic post-processing, for station forecasts in Norway.
2029a29bec902d78ee2969739cd467e14586f945.architecture: Evaluation study of Pangu-Weather (a transformer-based model) versus ECMWF HRES, ECMWF ENS and MEPS (HARMONIE-AROME), with probabilistic statistical post-processing applied to all.
2029a29bec902d78ee2969739cd467e14586f945.data: 2 m temperature and 10 m wind speed at 183 Norwegian SYNOP stations, lead times up to +60 h; Pangu-Weather trained on ERA5 0.25 degree.
2029a29bec902d78ee2969739cd467e14586f945.result: Pangu-Weather is slightly better than ECMWF for temperature and slightly worse for wind; MEPS (2.5 km) is best; post-processing helps all models, most for coarse global ones.
2029a29bec902d78ee2969739cd467e14586f945.open_work: Assess more variables, longer leads and higher-resolution data-driven models for operational use.
2029a29bec902d78ee2969739cd467e14586f945.issues: Single region, two variables and short leads; coarse 0.25 degree resolution limits local skill before post-processing.

513856d305213e700f356bfcdc9ebac01b31192f.goal: Forecasts tropical cyclone trajectories and precipitation affordably with generative AI for vulnerable regions.
513856d305213e700f356bfcdc9ebac01b31192f.architecture: Cascaded generative diffusion models for three tasks: forecasting, super-resolution and precipitation modelling.
513856d305213e700f356bfcdc9ebac01b31192f.data: Satellite imagery, remote sensing and atmospheric data for 51 cyclones from six basins, January 2019 to March 2023.
513856d305213e700f356bfcdc9ebac01b31192f.result: Accurate predictions up to 36-hour rollout with SSIM above 0.5 and PSNR above 20 dB for all tasks; a 36-hour forecast takes about 30 minutes on a single GPU.
513856d305213e700f356bfcdc9ebac01b31192f.open_work: Larger cyclone samples, longer lead times and comparison with operational track and intensity forecasts.
513856d305213e700f356bfcdc9ebac01b31192f.issues: Small dataset of 51 storms; image-quality metrics rather than track/intensity errors; no operational benchmark.

86d95286411fb54a2f3e761525503251a9f84f20.goal: Improves seasonal Arctic sea-ice concentration forecasts by including atmospheric factors that most deep learning models ignore.
86d95286411fb54a2f3e761525503251a9f84f20.architecture: Atsicn, an attention-based convolutional long short-term memory (ConvLSTM) ensemble network for multi-step sea-ice concentration forecasting.
86d95286411fb54a2f3e761525503251a9f84f20.data: Not reported in the abstract; gridded Arctic sea-ice concentration plus atmospheric variables.
86d95286411fb54a2f3e761525503251a9f84f20.result: Atsicn outperforms state-of-the-art dynamical and statistical models and is reliable in extreme years; atmospheric influence is small for March-June forecasts, grows July-October and persists but diminishes November-February.
86d95286411fb54a2f3e761525503251a9f84f20.open_work: Further disentangle sea ice-atmosphere interactions and extend to other sea-ice variables or the Antarctic.
86d95286411fb54a2f3e761525503251a9f84f20.issues: Data sources and quantitative skill are not given in the abstract; possible reliance on reanalysis atmosphere inherits its biases.

e7190dcb05e578f77039e68c35072dd09ae3eed2.goal: Delivers km-scale AI precipitation forecasts over a region of interest at low computational cost, targeting atmospheric rivers and extremes.
e7190dcb05e578f77039e68c35072dd09ae3eed2.architecture: Stretched-grid autoregressive AI weather model with 6 km grid spacing over the Western United States and about 31 km elsewhere; network family is not specified in the abstract.
e7190dcb05e578f77039e68c35072dd09ae3eed2.data: Not reported in the abstract; evaluated against global and regional NWP systems and a lower-resolution AI model.
e7190dcb05e578f77039e68c35072dd09ae3eed2.result: The regional AI model reduces 24-h accumulated precipitation errors, performs competitively with the regional NWP model and captures atmospheric-river extremes that coarser global models underestimate.
e7190dcb05e578f77039e68c35072dd09ae3eed2.open_work: Address challenges for further development such as finer resolution, more regions and probabilistic output.
e7190dcb05e578f77039e68c35072dd09ae3eed2.issues: Deterministic forecasts; single region; training data and lead-time range not reported in the abstract.

378dfa9715c60314f7136a2ec5d76a0a88cb0929.goal: Provides scalable interpolation of non-stationary satellite altimetry data to produce complete sea ice freeboard and sea level anomaly maps.
378dfa9715c60314f7136a2ec5d76a0a88cb0929.architecture: GPSat, an open-source Python library using scalable local Gaussian process regression for spatiotemporal interpolation; not a neural network.
378dfa9715c60314f7136a2ec5d76a0a88cb0929.data: Satellite radar altimetry for Arctic sea ice freeboard (50 km and 5 km grids) and along-track sea level anomalies; validated against airborne data.
378dfa9715c60314f7136a2ec5d76a0a88cb0929.result: 504x speedup over a previous interpolation scheme with under 4 mm average freeboard difference; 5 km freeboards correlate 0.66 with airborne data; footprint-level SLA beats linear regression.
378dfa9715c60314f7136a2ec5d76a0a88cb0929.open_work: Apply GPSat to other altimetry interpolation tasks and short spatio-temporal scale studies of ocean and sea ice variability.
378dfa9715c60314f7136a2ec5d76a0a88cb0929.issues: Moderate agreement (r=0.66) with airborne data; Gaussian process assumptions on stationarity locally; Arctic-focused evaluation.

9c109b49db72e8aacc5a367127ba40957f4f1f7c.goal: Discovers interpretable structural and parametric model errors from sparse data assimilation increments, an alternative to opaque neural network nudging corrections.
9c109b49db72e8aacc5a367127ba40957f4f1f7c.architecture: MEDIDA: sparsity-promoting equation discovery on analysis increments, with a neural network interpolator augmented by a random Fourier feature layer to reduce spectral bias.
9c109b49db72e8aacc5a367127ba40957f4f1f7c.data: Two-layer quasi-geostrophic turbulence simulations with full and spatially sparse synthetic observations.
9c109b49db72e8aacc5a367127ba40957f4f1f7c.result: MEDIDA recovers linear and nonlinear model errors with full observations; plain neural network interpolators fail with sparse data due to spectral bias, but the random Fourier feature layer fixes this.
9c109b49db72e8aacc5a367127ba40957f4f1f7c.open_work: Scale MEDIDA to Earth system models and real observations.
9c109b49db72e8aacc5a367127ba40957f4f1f7c.issues: Idealized QG test case with synthetic observations; requires very accurate interpolation; real-data robustness untested.

8a83aedcd49526c472336ce791fb91e5b11db398.goal: Examines data imbalance, uncertainty quantification and climate generalization for neural network subgrid parameterizations, using gravity wave drag emulation as a test case.
8a83aedcd49526c472336ce791fb91e5b11db398.architecture: Neural network emulators of WACCM gravity wave parameterizations with resampling and weighted losses; UQ via Bayesian neural networks, variational autoencoders and dropout; transfer learning by re-training one layer.
8a83aedcd49526c472336ce791fb91e5b11db398.data: WACCM simulations with orographic, convective and frontal gravity wave parameterizations, including a 4xCO2 warmer climate.
8a83aedcd49526c472336ce791fb91e5b11db398.result: Resampling/weighted losses enable emulation of all three sources; the three UQ methods give spreads that track accuracy; skill drops in 4xCO2 but recovers by re-training one layer with about 1% new data.
8a83aedcd49526c472336ce791fb91e5b11db398.open_work: Apply these strategies to other processes and to online coupled simulations.
8a83aedcd49526c472336ce791fb91e5b11db398.issues: Emulates an existing parameterization rather than observations or high-resolution truth; mostly offline evaluation.

20c3a6dbc90aa3497d733815231643514d509d08.goal: Reviews how machine learning can improve understanding and modelling of the interactions between clouds and climate.
20c3a6dbc90aa3497d733815231643514d509d08.architecture: Review of physics-guided and explainable machine learning for cloud-related processes, including parameterization, detection and climate analysis.
20c3a6dbc90aa3497d733815231643514d509d08.data: Review; covers studies using observations and simulations (e.g. cloud-resolving model output and satellite data), without a single data set.
20c3a6dbc90aa3497d733815231643514d509d08.result: Synthesizes evidence that ML, combined with large datasets, physical constraints and explainability, can help model cloud processes and their climate feedbacks.
20c3a6dbc90aa3497d733815231643514d509d08.open_work: Improve physical consistency, generalization to unseen climates and trust in ML-based cloud representations.
20c3a6dbc90aa3497d733815231643514d509d08.issues: Chapter-length review with only key points available in the record; content details cannot be verified from the abstract.

2660ab4d5e035ee0ceb4f47e38d2920b02060bf2.goal: Turns deterministic data-driven weather models into ensemble systems that reduce random errors and cross-model systematic biases.
2660ab4d5e035ee0ceb4f47e38d2920b02060bf2.architecture: GenEPS, a generative ensemble prediction framework (plug-and-play generative perturbation of deterministic models) combining multiple data-driven models into a super-ensemble; generative model family not specified in the abstract.
2660ab4d5e035ee0ceb4f47e38d2920b02060bf2.data: Outputs from multiple data-driven weather models, compared with ECMWF ENS and ERA5 reanalysis.
2660ab4d5e035ee0ceb4f47e38d2920b02060bf2.result: GenEPS reaches Z500 ACC of 0.679 versus 0.646 for ECMWF ENS, rising to 0.683 with the ENS mean added; it improves extremes and energy spectra closer to ERA5.
2660ab4d5e035ee0ceb4f47e38d2920b02060bf2.open_work: Integrate further models and evaluate operational utility and probabilistic calibration in more detail.
2660ab4d5e035ee0ceb4f47e38d2920b02060bf2.issues: Lead time for the ACC numbers not stated in the abstract; depends on underlying models trained on ERA5; calibration details unclear.

103f598477d0595a0b0cbb6891c8c394af176f41.goal: Compares physics-based and data-driven probabilistic 24-hour precipitation forecasts over northern tropical Africa, where NWP has poor skill.
103f598477d0595a0b0cbb6891c8c394af176f41.architecture: Two-stage approach: a U-Net convolutional neural network (CNN) for deterministic rainfall forecasts followed by nonparametric EasyUQ to produce probabilistic forecasts; compared with logistic regression and other statistical models.
103f598477d0595a0b0cbb6891c8c394af176f41.data: IMERG gridded rainfall as ground truth, 2011-2019; predictors from IMERG and ERA5; ECMWF raw and postprocessed ensemble forecasts as benchmarks.
103f598477d0595a0b0cbb6891c8c394af176f41.result: CNN+EasyUQ clearly beats climatology, ECMWF ensembles and statistical methods for both occurrence and amount; hybrids with physics-based forecasts give slight further gains.
103f598477d0595a0b0cbb6891c8c394af176f41.open_work: Transfer to operations and to other tropical or extratropical regions.
103f598477d0595a0b0cbb6891c8c394af176f41.issues: One-day lead only; regional focus; IMERG used as truth carries its own retrieval errors.

acb4a2a6c50d155ed8502a7cac535d6963243581.goal: Systematically analyzes design choices in deep-learning weather forecasting systems to understand which ones matter.
acb4a2a6c50d155ed8502a7cac535d6963243581.architecture: Comparative study of fixed-grid architectures (U-Net, fully convolutional, transformer) and grid-invariant graph neural network and neural operator models, plus pretraining, losses, noise injection and fine-tuning; proposes a hybrid system.
acb4a2a6c50d155ed8502a7cac535d6963243581.data: Not reported in the abstract; global weather training data, with experiments varying dataset size.
acb4a2a6c50d155ed8502a7cac535d6963243581.result: Fixed-grid models outperform grid-invariant ones; multi-step fine-tuning is essential; pretraining objectives hurt versus supervised training; more data helps small models while large models mainly benefit from compute.
acb4a2a6c50d155ed8502a7cac535d6963243581.open_work: Develop better grid-invariant architectures such as neural operators.
acb4a2a6c50d155ed8502a7cac535d6963243581.issues: Conclusions may depend on compute budgets and dataset choices; data details not given in the abstract.

30b599e4978d74a5dd28205c5926048fb377ac83.goal: Post-processes and calibrates Earth system model ensemble forecasts while representing interactions between ensemble members.
30b599e4978d74a5dd28205c5926048fb377ac83.architecture: Self-attentive ensemble transformer, a member-by-member neural network post-processor using self-attention across ensemble members, inspired by ensemble data assimilation.
30b599e4978d74a5dd28205c5926048fb377ac83.data: Global ECMWF ensemble forecasts regressed onto ERA5 reanalysis 2-metre temperature fields.
30b599e4978d74a5dd28205c5926048fb377ac83.result: The transformer calibrates ensemble spread, extracts extra information from the ensemble and outputs multivariate, spatially coherent members.
30b599e4978d74a5dd28205c5926048fb377ac83.open_work: Extend to more variables, lead times and other nonparametric ensemble post-processing tasks.
30b599e4978d74a5dd28205c5926048fb377ac83.issues: Proof of concept on a single variable; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract.

f7e9c8d1056d8f56c94f19404ccabc913c326825.goal: Quantifies aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty of deep-learning soil moisture predictions, which previously lacked uncertainty estimates.
f7e9c8d1056d8f56c94f19404ccabc913c326825.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) networks with Monte Carlo dropout and an aleatoric loss term.
f7e9c8d1056d8f56c94f19404ccabc913c326825.data: Satellite soil moisture observations (SMAP in the authors' related work) with atmospheric forcing inputs over the conterminous United States.
f7e9c8d1056d8f56c94f19404ccabc913c326825.result: After tuning a hyperparameter on a representative training set, the combined uncertainty captures predictive error, and MC dropout uncertainty detects dissimilarity from training data.
f7e9c8d1056d8f56c94f19404ccabc913c326825.open_work: Test uncertainty behavior under stronger extrapolation and for other hydrological variables.
f7e9c8d1056d8f56c94f19404ccabc913c326825.issues: Requires hyperparameter tuning on representative data; calibration may degrade out of distribution.

4b50efc635a0c0050344147b71a493dd5aa409a8.goal: Facilitates community evaluation of AI weather prediction models by providing open access to their outputs.
4b50efc635a0c0050344147b71a493dd5aa409a8.architecture: Dataset and visualization resource: reforecast archive and real-time web display of FourCastNet v2-small, Pangu-Weather and GraphCast Operational alongside GFS and IFS.
4b50efc635a0c0050344147b71a493dd5aa409a8.data: Twice-daily 10-day reforecasts since September 2020 initialized from GFS and IFS initial conditions, hosted on Amazon S3 via NOAA's Open Data Dissemination program.
4b50efc635a0c0050344147b71a493dd5aa409a8.result: Delivers a growing three-year reforecast archive and a real-time comparison web page (aiweather.cira.colostate.edu).
4b50efc635a0c0050344147b71a493dd5aa409a8.open_work: Use the archive for feature-based verification of impactful phenomena and assess whether AIWP models belong in operations.
4b50efc635a0c0050344147b71a493dd5aa409a8.issues: Resource paper without verification results; limited to three models.

41b3fe288f62cb31267f8e31f9ede1750cfb04e8.goal: Builds a single-column machine-learned model of the marine boundary layer that reproduces reanalysis tendencies and cloud properties.
41b3fe288f62cb31267f8e31f9ede1750cfb04e8.architecture: Machine-Assisted Reanalysis Boundary Layer Emulation (MARBLE), an artificial neural network (family not further specified in the abstract) trained prognostically over 7-day forecasts rather than on instantaneous tendencies.
41b3fe288f62cb31267f8e31f9ede1750cfb04e8.data: ERA5 high-resolution reanalysis over the summertime northeast Pacific stratocumulus-to-trade-cumulus transition region, with withheld testing periods.
41b3fe288f62cb31267f8e31f9ede1750cfb04e8.result: MARBLE skillfully reproduces boundary layer structure, clouds and radiative heating in 7-day single-column runs and tracks reanalysis more closely than the underlying forecast model.
41b3fe288f62cb31267f8e31f9ede1750cfb04e8.open_work: Couple to 3D models and extend to other regions and seasons.
41b3fe288f62cb31267f8e31f9ede1750cfb04e8.issues: Single region and season; learns reanalysis, inheriting its biases; single-column setting only.

dfd3e92a6fa46c02ad7b077033dd1103ecb1e94e.goal: Forecasts global daily precipitation directly from satellite observations with a probabilistic generative model.
dfd3e92a6fa46c02ad7b077033dd1103ecb1e94e.architecture: DiffObs, an autoregressive generative diffusion model for day-ahead precipitation.
dfd3e92a6fa46c02ad7b077033dd1103ecb1e94e.data: A global satellite daily precipitation observational product (not named in the abstract).
dfd3e92a6fa46c02ad7b077033dd1103ecb1e94e.result: Stable for multi-month rollouts, generating realistic convectively coupled waves including MJO-like variability and moist Kelvin waves with approximately correct dispersion.
dfd3e92a6fa46c02ad7b077033dd1103ecb1e94e.open_work: Train global diffusion models on sparser and more direct observations for subseasonal and climate prediction.
dfd3e92a6fa46c02ad7b077033dd1103ecb1e94e.issues: Secondary issues and biases acknowledged; precipitation-only state; quantitative skill not given in the abstract.

eec79fb0008107537578e3c01a7318f667106d1b.goal: Uses existing AI weather prediction systems to perform global downscaling of low-resolution climate model output.
eec79fb0008107537578e3c01a7318f667106d1b.architecture: Off-the-shelf AI-NWP models run one day ahead from low-resolution initial conditions to produce high-resolution fields; specific models and network families are not specified in the abstract.
eec79fb0008107537578e3c01a7318f667106d1b.data: Smoothed ERA5 and low-resolution CMIP6 model fields as initial conditions; evaluated on 2-metre temperature over year-long periods.
eec79fb0008107537578e3c01a7318f667106d1b.result: AI-NWP produces detailed fields resembling training-data resolution after one-day lead and may bias-correct climate model output toward observations.
eec79fb0008107537578e3c01a7318f667106d1b.open_work: Use downscaled data for local climate information or as boundary conditions for dynamical downscaling.
eec79fb0008107537578e3c01a7318f667106d1b.issues: Only 2-metre temperature assessed; AI-NWP trained on present-day ERA5 may not represent future climates.

02d364ed55a1909f6d387b9a5b0d3a48e85d9c68.goal: Emulates an idealized baroclinic double-gyre ocean simulation cheaply with data-driven models.
02d364ed55a1909f6d387b9a5b0d3a48e85d9c68.architecture: Fourier neural operators (neural operator) trained at one resolution and applied to generate ensembles at another.
02d364ed55a1909f6d387b9a5b0d3a48e85d9c68.data: Idealized baroclinic double-gyre ocean model simulations.
02d364ed55a1909f6d387b9a5b0d3a48e85d9c68.result: The emulator learns double-gyre dynamics, supports resolution transfer for ensembles, and shows an intermediate time scale at which prediction skill is maximized.
02d364ed55a1909f6d387b9a5b0d3a48e85d9c68.open_work: Extend to realistic ocean configurations and longer stable rollouts.
02d364ed55a1909f6d387b9a5b0d3a48e85d9c68.issues: Idealized setting; quantitative skill and long-term stability not reported in the abstract.

fc81f672bbb0a0a49793b24228364f775d7edaaf.goal: Produces sub-daily (hourly) rainfall-runoff predictions at moderate computational cost by combining inputs at several temporal frequencies.
fc81f672bbb0a0a49793b24228364f775d7edaaf.architecture: Multi-frequency LSTM (MF-LSTM), a long short-term memory network handling different temporal frequencies and input dimensions in a single LSTM cell, processing older inputs at coarser resolution.
fc81f672bbb0a0a49793b24228364f775d7edaaf.result: MF-LSTM retains state-of-the-art performance with a simpler design and reduces processing time 5x versus training solely on hourly data.
fc81f672bbb0a0a49793b24228364f775d7edaaf.open_work: Apply to flood forecasting and to other regions and frequency combinations.
fc81f672bbb0a0a49793b24228364f775d7edaaf.issues: US basins only; specific accuracy metrics not given in the abstract.

fbf95ac07650fa2eda86bc3c2cad39046448ea5e.goal: Overcomes the cost of dynamical downscaling, which limits ensemble size, to characterise fine-scale future changes in rare precipitation extremes over New Zealand.
fbf95ac07650fa2eda86bc3c2cad39046448ea5e.architecture: Generative-AI downscaling emulator of a regional climate model; the specific generative network family is not specified in the abstract.
fbf95ac07650fa2eda86bc3c2cad39046448ea5e.data: Global climate model projections downscaled over New Zealand, trained against regional dynamical downscaling; exact GCM ensemble and RCM not reported in the abstract.
fbf95ac07650fa2eda86bc3c2cad39046448ea5e.result: End-of-century daily precipitation extremes increase about 5.6%/°C for annual extremes and 9%/°C for 100-year events; internal variability of extremes grows nearly twice Clausius-Clapeyron scaling and dominates uncertainty.
fbf95ac07650fa2eda86bc3c2cad39046448ea5e.open_work: Apply large AI-downscaled ensembles to other regions and variables, and quantify how many members are needed for robust fine-scale extreme projections.
fbf95ac07650fa2eda86bc3c2cad39046448ea5e.issues: Single region; conclusions depend on the emulator faithfully reproducing the regional model's extreme tails under warming beyond the training climate.

531ec520e90c86de4285432cb89bd6c73b28715b.goal: Establishes an intercomparison project for AI weather and climate models to identify how frameworks and architectures affect behaviour and to build trust through open data and evaluation.
531ec520e90c86de4285432cb89bd6c73b28715b.architecture: Benchmark and intercomparison protocol (AIMIP Phase 1) specifying a common AMIP-style experiment, output format and training constraints; participating models span several AI architectures.
531ec520e90c86de4285432cb89bd6c73b28715b.data: Models trained on historical reanalysis and forced with observed sea surface temperatures over 1979–2024; compared with a conventional physics-based atmosphere model; dataset publicly released.
531ec520e90c86de4285432cb89bd6c73b28715b.result: AI models simulate historical climate and response to forcing as well as a physics-based model, but some underestimate historical warming trends and predictions diverge in out-of-sample generalization tests.
531ec520e90c86de4285432cb89bd6c73b28715b.open_work: Later phases with more demanding forcing scenarios and further community evaluations of the released Phase 1 dataset.
531ec520e90c86de4285432cb89bd6c73b28715b.issues: Training on reanalysis restricts experiments to the historical period; out-of-sample warming tests reveal divergent and potentially unreliable extrapolation.

a759ed92a040f2f639db982a4b1394454996881c.goal: Accelerates an expensive, non-reproducible superparameterization of wave-induced sea ice floe fracture so stochastic wave–ice interaction can be used in climate models.
a759ed92a040f2f639db982a4b1394454996881c.architecture: Hybrid parameterization using a pair of neural networks that emulate the one-dimensional superparameterized wave fracture scheme; network family not specified in the abstract.
a759ed92a040f2f639db982a4b1394454996881c.data: Training data generated by the existing superparameterized wave–floe fracture scheme; implemented and evaluated in the CICE sea ice model.
a759ed92a040f2f639db982a4b1394454996881c.result: WIFF v1.0 in CICE reproduces global statistics of the full wave fracture code without increasing computational overhead and is bitwise reproducible.
a759ed92a040f2f639db982a4b1394454996881c.open_work: Incorporation into coupled climate models and evaluation of the marginal ice zone response against observations.
a759ed92a040f2f639db982a4b1394454996881c.issues: Emulator inherits the assumptions of the underlying one-dimensional scheme; validation is against the original code rather than observed floe size distributions.

d3619659317a952cfb04a70c918955fd7997a672.goal: Removes the polar distortion and wasted compute of vision transformers on latitude–longitude grids while avoiding the memory cost of graph-based weather models.
d3619659317a952cfb04a70c918955fd7997a672.architecture: HEAL-ViT: vision transformer operating on a spherical HEALPix mesh, combining attention efficiency of transformers with the spatial homogeneity of graph neural network mesh models.
d3619659317a952cfb04a70c918955fd7997a672.data: Global reanalysis for medium-range forecasting (ERA5 according to the paper); benchmarked against ECMWF IFS and other ML weather models; details not reported in the abstract.
d3619659317a952cfb04a70c918955fd7997a672.result: Outperforms ECMWF IFS on key metrics, with better bias accumulation and less blurring than other ML weather prediction models, at a lower compute footprint.
d3619659317a952cfb04a70c918955fd7997a672.open_work: Extending to the full suite of operational products and probabilistic forecasting.
d3619659317a952cfb04a70c918955fd7997a672.issues: Deterministic model; evaluation limited to headline metrics; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases.

f0245aca5888a55896eff266adf8fff855e2f3dc.goal: Tests whether cross-validation of principal component regression and PCR-like machine learning for seasonal water supply forecasting can be simplified without misestimating out-of-sample error.
f0245aca5888a55896eff266adf8fff855e2f3dc.architecture: Principal component regression and four PCR-like machine learning variants in which the regression step is replaced by nonlinear learners; specific ML model families not specified in the abstract.
f0245aca5888a55896eff266adf8fff855e2f3dc.data: 300 modeling experiments on the Truckee River (Sierra Nevada) and Rio Grande headwaters (southern Rockies) seasonal runoff volume, with operational water supply forecast predictors.
f0245aca5888a55896eff266adf8fff855e2f3dc.result: Applying cross-validation only to the final supervised learning step adequately estimates out-of-sample error, enabling streamlined algorithms and lower computation.
f0245aca5888a55896eff266adf8fff855e2f3dc.open_work: Testing the finding with more complex emerging architectures and externally sourced climate predictors in next-generation water supply forecast systems.
f0245aca5888a55896eff266adf8fff855e2f3dc.issues: Only two basins; result may depend on process-informed feature selection protocols that mitigate overtraining.

8233db784de04cd41a67161c22fd50a7aa6a469e.goal: Develops a regional high-resolution AI weather model forecasting directly from observations, removing the need for operational data assimilation and NWP-derived inputs.
8233db784de04cd41a67161c22fd50a7aa6a469e.architecture: OMG-HD, a deep learning end-to-end forecasting model ingesting surface station, radar and satellite observations; the network family is not specified in the abstract.
8233db784de04cd41a67161c22fd50a7aa6a469e.data: Surface stations, radar and satellite observations over the contiguous United States; benchmarked against IFS HRES and HRRR at lead times up to 12 hours.
8233db784de04cd41a67161c22fd50a7aa6a469e.result: Beats IFS HRES and HRRR up to 12 h; versus HRRR, RMSE improves up to 13% for 2 m temperature, 17% for 10 m wind, 48% for 2 m specific humidity and 32% for surface pressure.
8233db784de04cd41a67161c22fd50a7aa6a469e.open_work: Extending lead times, adding variables such as precipitation, and moving toward operational observation-driven forecasting.
8233db784de04cd41a67161c22fd50a7aa6a469e.issues: Short lead times only; regional CONUS domain; deterministic RMSE-focused evaluation that may favour smooth forecasts.

152c873d461d53f14d3be8e142da7259d2d0a870.goal: Quantifies parameter sensitivity of a sea ice melt pond parametrisation and tests whether data-driven emulators can replace it while preserving albedo accuracy.
152c873d461d53f14d3be8e142da7259d2d0a870.architecture: Sobol variance-based global sensitivity analysis plus emulators of the melt pond parametrisation built with linear regression and nonlinear neural networks; the network family is not specified in the abstract.
152c873d461d53f14d3be8e142da7259d2d0a870.data: Simulations of the Icepack thermodynamic column sea ice model with its advanced melt pond parametrisation.
152c873d461d53f14d3be8e142da7259d2d0a870.result: The model is very sensitive to uncertain melt pond parameters; linear regression emulators are insufficient, whereas neural networks emulate the scheme reliably and Icepack with them keeps the same long-term behaviour.
152c873d461d53f14d3be8e142da7259d2d0a870.open_work: Training on observations rather than model output and coupling the emulator in a full sea ice or climate model.
152c873d461d53f14d3be8e142da7259d2d0a870.issues: Emulator learns the original physics-based scheme, so it inherits its parameter uncertainty; single-column setting.

6620ce061e108ada1802dc41bd2dc8291426ceca.goal: Launches an open international competition to evaluate AI and ML methods for sub-seasonal forecasting under operational-like real-time conditions.
6620ce061e108ada1802dc41bd2dc8291426ceca.architecture: Benchmark competition description (AI Weather Quest by ECMWF with WMO support), not a single model; teams submit weekly probabilistic forecasts scored on live leaderboards.
6620ce061e108ada1802dc41bd2dc8291426ceca.data: Real-time weekly probabilistic forecasts of 2 m temperature, accumulated precipitation and mean sea level pressure, verified globally against ECMWF reference data.
6620ce061e108ada1802dc41bd2dc8291426ceca.result: Establishes the competition framework, submission tools and evaluation using global ranked probability skill scores; no competition results reported.
6620ce061e108ada1802dc41bd2dc8291426ceca.open_work: Reporting quarterly and yearly results and identifying which methods advance reliable sub-seasonal prediction.
6620ce061e108ada1802dc41bd2dc8291426ceca.issues: Describes the setup only; leaderboard metrics focus on RPSS for three variables and may not capture extremes or regional skill.

8b7ab25e4b8c9d857b3e44e130ce4801cc741a1d.goal: Quantifies parametric uncertainty in a machine learning parameterization of atmospheric gravity waves, offline and once coupled in a climate model.
8b7ab25e4b8c9d857b3e44e130ce4801cc741a1d.architecture: Ensemble of neural networks emulating an existing gravity wave parameterization, used for uncertainty quantification.
8b7ab25e4b8c9d857b3e44e130ce4801cc741a1d.data: Training data from an existing gravity wave parameterization in an atmospheric climate model; specific model not reported in the abstract.
8b7ab25e4b8c9d857b3e44e130ce4801cc741a1d.result: Online parametric uncertainty from the neural network ensemble is a significant source of uncertainty in climate model output after coupling.
8b7ab25e4b8c9d857b3e44e130ce4801cc741a1d.open_work: Extending uncertainty quantification to structural and data uncertainty and to parameterizations learned from high-resolution data or observations.
8b7ab25e4b8c9d857b3e44e130ce4801cc741a1d.issues: Emulates an existing parameterization rather than resolved gravity waves; covers only training-process (parametric) uncertainty.

79a574788b99f3a065cdc972c94497a921af5239.goal: Makes explicit the inductive biases built into deep learning weather prediction models and how they contribute to skill, efficiency and generalization.
79a574788b99f3a065cdc972c94497a921af5239.architecture: Review of state-of-the-art deep learning weather prediction models (CNNs, graph neural networks, transformers, neural operators) along data selection, learning objective, loss, architecture and optimisation.
79a574788b99f3a065cdc972c94497a921af5239.data: Literature on DLWP models, which are mostly trained on ERA5 reanalysis such as WeatherBench.
79a574788b99f3a065cdc972c94497a921af5239.result: Identifies the most important inductive biases and highlights avenues toward more efficient and probabilistic DLWP models.
79a574788b99f3a065cdc972c94497a921af5239.open_work: Systematic ablations isolating each inductive bias and designs for probabilistic, physically consistent models.
79a574788b99f3a065cdc972c94497a921af5239.issues: Qualitative review; contributions of individual biases are not measured in controlled experiments.

5d508c0d643311038ebcedd5b5440fed7d71dd9c.goal: Studies how to obtain calibrated probabilistic ensembles from large neural weather models, whose deterministic forecasts lack reliable uncertainty.
5d508c0d643311038ebcedd5b5440fed7d71dd9c.architecture: Ensemble generation and calibration methods for a large neural weather model; specific architecture and perturbation technique not available here.
5d508c0d643311038ebcedd5b5440fed7d71dd9c.data: Not reported (no abstract); large neural weather models are typically trained and verified on ERA5 reanalysis.
5d508c0d643311038ebcedd5b5440fed7d71dd9c.open_work: Systematic comparison of ensemble generation strategies for calibration of data-driven forecasts.
5d508c0d643311038ebcedd5b5440fed7d71dd9c.issues: Abstract unavailable; card is based on the title only and details should be checked.

ce934cf22172220e2aa99271dba9e3b29cab92b6.goal: Uses machine learning to target which satellite observations to assimilate, reducing the cost of ingesting very large satellite data volumes in data assimilation.
ce934cf22172220e2aa99271dba9e3b29cab92b6.architecture: Machine learning to identify regions or features of interest for targeted assimilation; the model family is not specified here.
ce934cf22172220e2aa99271dba9e3b29cab92b6.data: Satellite observations for NWP data assimilation; specific instruments and models not reported (no abstract).
ce934cf22172220e2aa99271dba9e3b29cab92b6.open_work: Demonstrating forecast impact of targeted assimilation in an operational data assimilation system.
ce934cf22172220e2aa99271dba9e3b29cab92b6.issues: Abstract unavailable; card is inferred from the title and should be checked.

3170ec54a7ef2b5c24787a63328e752eec28e697.goal: Investigates what internal representations the observation-only GraphDOP model learns about the Earth system state, dynamics and observing systems.
3170ec54a7ef2b5c24787a63328e752eec28e697.architecture: Interpretability study of GraphDOP, a graph neural network forecasting directly from observations, probing its latent state and learned observation operators.
3170ec54a7ef2b5c24787a63328e752eec28e697.data: Meteorological observations only (satellite radiances from multiple sensors, microwave sounders, visible and infrared imagery, in-situ measurements), no reanalysis or prior knowledge.
3170ec54a7ef2b5c24787a63328e752eec28e697.result: The network builds a unified latent state consistent across observation types, emulates viewing effects such as limb effects and sunglint, and from one infrared instrument infers jet streams, pressure patterns and air masses.
3170ec54a7ef2b5c24787a63328e752eec28e697.open_work: Using these insights to guide development of observation-driven forecasting models.
3170ec54a7ef2b5c24787a63328e752eec28e697.issues: Evidence is largely qualitative via case examples; representation quality is not quantified systematically.

4c5394e8b565e7e5f7180660ffd55cc44ba82055.goal: Translates greenhouse gas emission pathways rapidly into spatially resolved annual-mean temperature projections with forced response and natural variability uncertainty.
4c5394e8b565e7e5f7180660ffd55cc44ba82055.architecture: Chain of statistical emulators coupling the global-mean emissions-driven emulator MAGICC with the spatially resolved MESMER emulator; non-deep-learning statistical methods.
4c5394e8b565e7e5f7180660ffd55cc44ba82055.data: CMIP6 Earth System Model ensembles across multiple emission scenarios for training and validation; observational constraints applied via MAGICC.
4c5394e8b565e7e5f7180660ffd55cc44ba82055.result: Produces millions of emulated realizations for any emission pathway, extends CMIP6 sampling of strong mitigation scenarios, and MESMER validates well across multiple pathways.
4c5394e8b565e7e5f7180660ffd55cc44ba82055.open_work: Extending to other variables such as precipitation and to seasonal or sub-annual time scales.
4c5394e8b565e7e5f7180660ffd55cc44ba82055.issues: Annual-mean temperature only; emulator assumptions about forced response and variability may not hold for all pathways.

057899f35c515d83786da1780c8439149e57a9f3.goal: Tests whether the ACE2 AI climate emulator reproduces sea surface temperature Green's functions of the E3SMv3 atmosphere model at much lower cost.
057899f35c515d83786da1780c8439149e57a9f3.architecture: ACE2 (Ai2 Climate Emulator version 2), a spherical Fourier neural operator based autoregressive atmosphere emulator.
057899f35c515d83786da1780c8439149e57a9f3.data: Trained on EAMv3 (E3SMv3 atmosphere) historical AMIP simulations; evaluated with GFMIP SST patch experiments.
057899f35c515d83786da1780c8439149e57a9f3.result: ACE2 reproduces TOA radiative response patterns and reconstructs historical global TOA flux reasonably, about 100 times faster than EAMv3, but shows significant discrepancies for some patches, notably the subtropical northeast Pacific.
057899f35c515d83786da1780c8439149e57a9f3.open_work: Training with more diverse SST patterns and applying emulators to other computationally intensive climate problems.
057899f35c515d83786da1780c8439149e57a9f3.issues: Discrepancies likely from limited SST diversity in AMIP training data; emulates one model rather than the real climate.

45f88b5f9f20a82208fd6f058834bceddadd9bbf.goal: Generates ensemble forecasts with good error–spread relationships from deterministic neural network weather forecasts.
45f88b5f9f20a82208fd6f058834bceddadd9bbf.architecture: Ensemble generation for a neural network weather forecast model by perturbing initial conditions along singular vectors computed with singular value decomposition of the network's Jacobian; the network family is not specified in the truncated abstract.
45f88b5f9f20a82208fd6f058834bceddadd9bbf.data: Reanalysis data (ERA5 at coarse resolution in the related journal version); details not given in the truncated abstract.
45f88b5f9f20a82208fd6f058834bceddadd9bbf.result: Singular-value-decomposition-based perturbations produce better-calibrated ensembles than simple random initial perturbations.
45f88b5f9f20a82208fd6f058834bceddadd9bbf.open_work: Comparing with other ensemble strategies such as retraining or dropout and applying to higher-resolution models.
45f88b5f9f20a82208fd6f058834bceddadd9bbf.issues: Abstract truncated; idealized low-resolution setting; spread-skill improvements may not transfer to state-of-the-art models.

6fc75f24d139049230593d58af85f0c1223a0c91.goal: Creates a worldwide labeled dataset of tropical and extratropical cyclones to train deep learning detection networks.
6fc75f24d139049230593d58af85f0c1223a0c91.architecture: Rule-based heuristic labeling using time, pressure, vorticity and gradient thresholds without terrain cut-off; not an ML model itself, the labels are intended for deep learning training.
6fc75f24d139049230593d58af85f0c1223a0c91.data: Gridded meteorological fields for labeling, applied to GOES-15 water vapor imagery to build the training dataset.
6fc75f24d139049230593d58af85f0c1223a0c91.result: Outputs cyclone centers and regions of interest per time stamp as a global labeled dataset for deep learning applications.
6fc75f24d139049230593d58af85f0c1223a0c91.open_work: Training and evaluating deep learning cyclone detectors on the labeled imagery.
6fc75f24d139049230593d58af85f0c1223a0c91.issues: Labels depend on hand-tuned thresholds; no validation against best-track or expert-labeled datasets reported in the abstract.

fec4dd93fc590487787cb99525b2d0b724f67226.goal: Produces temporally consistent, realistic hourly forecasts from 6-hourly data-driven forecasting systems, avoiding error accumulation of direct hourly forecasting.
fec4dd93fc590487787cb99525b2d0b724f67226.architecture: HourGlass, a probabilistic data-driven temporal downscaling model trained with CRPS-variant losses; network family not specified in the abstract.
fec4dd93fc590487787cb99525b2d0b724f67226.data: Trained on forecast trajectories of ECMWF AIFS-Single and AIFS-ENS (global) and MET Norway's Bris stretched-grid ensemble (regional); verified against observations.
fec4dd93fc590487787cb99525b2d0b724f67226.result: Retains the skill of the underlying systems while producing temporally coherent hourly forecasts with realistic small-scale variability; precipitation extremes remain underestimated.
fec4dd93fc590487787cb99525b2d0b724f67226.open_work: Improving hourly precipitation extremes and operational deployment for regional and global products.
fec4dd93fc590487787cb99525b2d0b724f67226.issues: Underestimates the most intense precipitation; skill bounded by the parent 6-hourly forecasts.

5f4bfad9a6e49e47760f53faa59fdbee60ea6ea1.goal: Emulates the costly radiation parameterization of an Earth system model with machine learning and checks whether the emulator learns physically meaningful relations.
5f4bfad9a6e49e47760f53faa59fdbee60ea6ea1.architecture: Bidirectional LSTM over the vertical column, compared with a multilayer perceptron (MLP), interpreted with SHAP (Shapley Additive exPlanations).
5f4bfad9a6e49e47760f53faa59fdbee60ea6ea1.data: ICON model simulations with the RTE+RRTMGP radiation code providing atmospheric state and heating rate targets.
5f4bfad9a6e49e47760f53faa59fdbee60ea6ea1.result: Accurately emulates shortwave and longwave heating rates; SHAP shows physically consistent use of local temperature and cloud reflection, whereas the MLP relies on spurious correlations.
5f4bfad9a6e49e47760f53faa59fdbee60ea6ea1.open_work: Online coupling of the emulator in ICON and testing stability and climate drift.
5f4bfad9a6e49e47760f53faa59fdbee60ea6ea1.issues: Offline evaluation only; error values not legible in the abstract; trained on a single model configuration.

cb4680a38d9da569c97617c509616e2c8655c942.goal: Forecasts El Niño-Southern Oscillation by combining complex network analysis with recurrent neural networks.
cb4680a38d9da569c97617c509616e2c8655c942.architecture: LSTM neural networks combined with complex network analysis of climate data, as stated in the title.
cb4680a38d9da569c97617c509616e2c8655c942.data: Not reported (no abstract); presumably ENSO indices and climate fields.
cb4680a38d9da569c97617c509616e2c8655c942.open_work: Not reported; extending lead time and comparing with dynamical ENSO forecasts would follow naturally.
cb4680a38d9da569c97617c509616e2c8655c942.issues: Abstract unavailable; card is based on the title only and should be checked.

d57e84e559bccf6764039d3a4c55260a1b179391.goal: Forecasts electric utility load (hourly load, daily peak and total daily load) because conventional statistical forecasters struggle with the nonlinear load–weather relationship.
d57e84e559bccf6764039d3a4c55260a1b179391.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (feedforward artificial neural network) trained with backpropagation, using temperature and past load as inputs.
d57e84e559bccf6764039d3a4c55260a1b179391.data: Historical load and temperature records from a US electric utility (Puget Sound Power and Light).
d57e84e559bccf6764039d3a4c55260a1b179391.result: The neural network forecasts give lower errors than the utility's conventional forecasting method in the reported tests.
d57e84e559bccf6764039d3a4c55260a1b179391.open_work: Handling of holidays and weekends, adaptive retraining as load patterns change, and broader weather inputs.
d57e84e559bccf6764039d3a4c55260a1b179391.issues: Single utility and limited test period; no uncertainty estimates; performance depends on temperature forecasts in operational use.

5ff135450ae462855df27f44ad76872de5f1d1ea.goal: Automatically detects oil spills in satellite synthetic aperture radar images to reduce the manual screening burden.
5ff135450ae462855df27f44ad76872de5f1d1ea.architecture: Machine-learning classification pipeline on segmented dark regions, including a learner tailored to highly imbalanced classes (the SHRINK approach) compared with standard classifiers such as decision trees and nearest neighbour.
5ff135450ae462855df27f44ad76872de5f1d1ea.data: Spaceborne SAR images (RADARSAT and ERS-1) with a small number of labeled oil slicks and many look-alike dark patches.
5ff135450ae462855df27f44ad76872de5f1d1ea.result: Shows that class imbalance and image-batched data strongly affect learning, and that imbalance-aware learning and suitable evaluation metrics give a usable detector.
5ff135450ae462855df27f44ad76872de5f1d1ea.open_work: More labeled images, better handling of look-alikes and transfer across sensors and image batches.
5ff135450ae462855df27f44ad76872de5f1d1ea.issues: Very few positive examples; evaluation on a small image set; accuracy metrics misleading under imbalance.

302bec14b38dc3375c0a3be2a30d08b03dad6962.goal: Estimates rainfall rate from satellite infrared imagery to provide precipitation fields where gauges and radar are sparse (the PERSIANN system).
302bec14b38dc3375c0a3be2a30d08b03dad6962.architecture: Modified counterpropagation artificial neural network: a self-organizing feature map that classifies inputs followed by a Grossberg linear output layer, with adaptive online updating of parameters.
302bec14b38dc3375c0a3be2a30d08b03dad6962.data: Geostationary infrared brightness temperatures with surface-derived input features, trained and validated against rain gauge and radar rainfall over test regions.
302bec14b38dc3375c0a3be2a30d08b03dad6962.result: The network produces rainfall estimates at hourly and fine spatial resolution that compare favorably with other satellite techniques and improve when parameters are updated with ground observations.
302bec14b38dc3375c0a3be2a30d08b03dad6962.open_work: Incorporation of microwave data, global extension and continued adaptive calibration.
302bec14b38dc3375c0a3be2a30d08b03dad6962.issues: Infrared signals relate only indirectly to surface rain; skill depends on regime and on availability of ground truth for updating.

dcb04f0844a4029e0576e576df7f4e31f4ab07bd.goal: Resamples hydrologic time series by bootstrap while preserving their dependence structure, without assuming linear dependence or Gaussian distributions.
dcb04f0844a4029e0576e576df7f4e31f4ab07bd.architecture: Nonparametric k-nearest neighbour bootstrap based on multivariate nearest neighbour probability density estimation; related to Markov processes; not a neural network.
dcb04f0844a4029e0576e576df7f4e31f4ab07bd.data: Monthly streamflow records and synthetic series from linear and nonlinear autoregressive models.
dcb04f0844a4029e0576e576df7f4e31f4ab07bd.result: The method reproduces the behavior of linear and nonlinear autoregressive series and handles monthly streamflow with asymmetric and bimodal marginal densities.
dcb04f0844a4029e0576e576df7f4e31f4ab07bd.open_work: Choice of neighbourhood size and embedding, and extension to multisite and longer-memory settings.
dcb04f0844a4029e0576e576df7f4e31f4ab07bd.issues: Resampling cannot generate values outside the historical record; sensitivity to the number of neighbours and lag structure.

2f9fe328ea28436791055b0496f6300808a9e0a0.goal: Compares short-term electric load forecasting techniques to guide utilities in choosing a method.
2f9fe328ea28436791055b0496f6300808a9e0a0.architecture: Comparison of five techniques: multiple linear regression, time series (Box-Jenkins), general exponential smoothing, state space (Kalman filter) and a knowledge-based expert system (rule-based) approach.
2f9fe328ea28436791055b0496f6300808a9e0a0.data: Historical load and weather data from a US electric utility.
2f9fe328ea28436791055b0496f6300808a9e0a0.result: Reports relative forecast errors of the five methods across seasons; no single technique dominates in every condition.
2f9fe328ea28436791055b0496f6300808a9e0a0.open_work: Hybrid methods and better handling of weather-sensitive and special-day loads.
2f9fe328ea28436791055b0496f6300808a9e0a0.issues: Single utility and limited periods; results depend on implementation details of each method.

5e3f5d7f8bd4dac10199cf89f2cf72505defd600.goal: Forecasts rainfall fields in space and time one hour ahead, testing whether neural networks can learn complex rainfall dynamics.
5e3f5d7f8bd4dac10199cf89f2cf72505defd600.architecture: Three-layer feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron) trained with backpropagation, mapping current rainfall fields to future fields.
5e3f5d7f8bd4dac10199cf89f2cf72505defd600.data: Synthetic space–time rainfall fields generated by a stochastic rainfall simulation model.
5e3f5d7f8bd4dac10199cf89f2cf72505defd600.result: The network learns the space–time rainfall evolution and outperforms simple benchmarks such as persistence in the idealized tests.
5e3f5d7f8bd4dac10199cf89f2cf72505defd600.open_work: Application to observed radar rainfall and inclusion of meteorological predictors.
5e3f5d7f8bd4dac10199cf89f2cf72505defd600.issues: Trained and tested only on simulated rainfall; network size and training choices are ad hoc.

3821476fd30b7396a25c7e788139a975a02596cd.goal: Tests artificial neural networks as rainfall-runoff models for flood forecasting in small catchments.
3821476fd30b7396a25c7e788139a975a02596cd.architecture: Multilayer perceptron trained by backpropagation compared with a radial basis function network.
3821476fd30b7396a25c7e788139a975a02596cd.data: Rainfall and flow records at 15-minute resolution from two UK catchments (Rivers Amber and Mole).
3821476fd30b7396a25c7e788139a975a02596cd.result: The neural networks forecast flows several hours ahead with reasonable accuracy; the multilayer perceptron generally performs better than the radial basis function network.
3821476fd30b7396a25c7e788139a975a02596cd.open_work: Guidelines for input selection, network design and extrapolation to extreme floods.
3821476fd30b7396a25c7e788139a975a02596cd.issues: Two catchments only; limited ability to extrapolate beyond training range; no uncertainty.

95ff62f0024f117c30a6463cae2b4c61999e4724.goal: Derives operating rules for multireservoir water supply systems that perform well over many hydrologic conditions.
95ff62f0024f117c30a6463cae2b4c61999e4724.architecture: Genetic algorithm searching parameterized release and storage-balancing rules, evaluated by simulating the reservoir system.
95ff62f0024f117c30a6463cae2b4c61999e4724.data: Simulated operation of example multireservoir systems driven by historical or synthetic inflow sequences.
95ff62f0024f117c30a6463cae2b4c61999e4724.result: The genetic algorithm finds operating policies that improve system performance compared with initial rules.
95ff62f0024f117c30a6463cae2b4c61999e4724.open_work: Multiple objectives, larger systems and robustness to inflow uncertainty.
95ff62f0024f117c30a6463cae2b4c61999e4724.issues: Computational cost of simulation-based search; rules restricted to an assumed parametric form.

357e554deee9107669b077968c591b06f1b13272.goal: Calibrates conceptual rainfall-runoff model parameters automatically, avoiding local optima that trap traditional search methods.
357e554deee9107669b077968c591b06f1b13272.architecture: Genetic algorithm used as a global optimizer of model parameters; non-neural method.
357e554deee9107669b077968c591b06f1b13272.data: Applied to calibrate the Xinanjiang conceptual rainfall-runoff model; details of catchment data not reported here.
357e554deee9107669b077968c591b06f1b13272.result: The genetic algorithm reliably locates the global optimum of the calibration objective in repeated runs.
357e554deee9107669b077968c591b06f1b13272.open_work: Efficiency for higher-dimensional problems and comparison with other global optimizers.
357e554deee9107669b077968c591b06f1b13272.issues: Many model evaluations are required; parameter identifiability is not addressed.

4e8489520885ecfb108b3752a959b8ad05b963c4.goal: Forecasts streamflow a short time ahead for hydropower and flood operations in a large river system.
4e8489520885ecfb108b3752a959b8ad05b963c4.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) with different input configurations and hidden-layer sizes.
4e8489520885ecfb108b3752a959b8ad05b963c4.data: Flow, precipitation and temperature records from a basin in the Winnipeg River system, Canada.
4e8489520885ecfb108b3752a959b8ad05b963c4.result: The neural networks outperform a conventional forecasting model at the tested lead times.
4e8489520885ecfb108b3752a959b8ad05b963c4.open_work: Systematic selection of inputs and network structure, and testing in other basins.
4e8489520885ecfb108b3752a959b8ad05b963c4.issues: Single basin; network design by trial and error; no uncertainty estimates.

8bb2f83bb84043c2b721a1dc4b1addae5a1a2eba.goal: Evaluates neural networks for daily rainfall-runoff modelling against established black-box models.
8bb2f83bb84043c2b721a1dc4b1addae5a1a2eba.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (feedforward neural network) with different input scenarios including rainfall indices and seasonal flow information.
8bb2f83bb84043c2b721a1dc4b1addae5a1a2eba.data: Daily rainfall and discharge records from six catchments of different climates.
8bb2f83bb84043c2b721a1dc4b1addae5a1a2eba.result: The neural network generally matches or outperforms simple linear and linear perturbation models, depending on inputs used.
8bb2f83bb84043c2b721a1dc4b1addae5a1a2eba.open_work: Combination with other models and better use of input information.
8bb2f83bb84043c2b721a1dc4b1addae5a1a2eba.issues: Black-box model with limited physical interpretability; performance varies between catchments.

5a801eca16e41f4848f5331e8362f9a986a69cc5.goal: Forecasts short-term electric load using utility operators' heuristics captured in an automated system.
5a801eca16e41f4848f5331e8362f9a986a69cc5.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) encoding relationships between weather, day type and load.
5a801eca16e41f4848f5331e8362f9a986a69cc5.data: Historical load and weather data from electric utility sites.
5a801eca16e41f4848f5331e8362f9a986a69cc5.result: The rule-based approach produces forecasts with errors comparable to conventional statistical methods.
5a801eca16e41f4848f5331e8362f9a986a69cc5.open_work: Automatic rule updating and site transferability.
5a801eca16e41f4848f5331e8362f9a986a69cc5.issues: Rules need expert elicitation and manual tuning; limited validation.

6c05e0409b3b3aa22c4be0a0b2078aa54f625627.goal: Classifies snow cover and precipitation from passive microwave observations to support global monitoring.
6c05e0409b3b3aa22c4be0a0b2078aa54f625627.architecture: Physically based decision tree (threshold-based screening) classification using microwave brightness temperatures; not a learned model.
6c05e0409b3b3aa22c4be0a0b2078aa54f625627.data: DMSP Special Sensor Microwave/Imager (SSM/I) brightness temperatures at multiple frequencies.
6c05e0409b3b3aa22c4be0a0b2078aa54f625627.result: Develops a decision-tree classifier that separates snow cover, precipitation and other surfaces such as cold deserts and frozen ground.
6c05e0409b3b3aa22c4be0a0b2078aa54f625627.open_work: Quantitative snow and rain retrieval and better handling of ambiguous surfaces.
6c05e0409b3b3aa22c4be0a0b2078aa54f625627.issues: Confusion with surfaces of similar scattering signatures; thresholds may be region dependent.

4ea71119313b16451d66456b561c26e21e023752.goal: Maps inundation extent and vegetation type on the Amazon floodplain, important for wetland hydrology and methane studies.
4ea71119313b16451d66456b561c26e21e023752.architecture: Decision tree classification of multifrequency, multipolarization radar backscatter.
4ea71119313b16451d66456b561c26e21e023752.data: SIR-C L- and C-band synthetic aperture radar imagery over the central Amazon floodplain, with field observations.
4ea71119313b16451d66456b561c26e21e023752.result: Inundated and non-inundated forest, macrophytes and open water are separated with high accuracy, with L-band most useful under forest canopy.
4ea71119313b16451d66456b561c26e21e023752.open_work: Multitemporal mapping across flood seasons and larger regions.
4ea71119313b16451d66456b561c26e21e023752.issues: Limited image dates and ground truth; thresholds specific to sensor and site.

3da699499802110080316e2cdee8cdf75c0cc3ba.goal: Predicts river flow with neural networks as an alternative to analytical and statistical models.
3da699499802110080316e2cdee8cdf75c0cc3ba.architecture: Cascade-correlation neural network that grows its hidden units during training, compared with an analytical power model.
3da699499802110080316e2cdee8cdf75c0cc3ba.data: Daily streamflow records from gauges on the Huron River, Michigan, USA.
3da699499802110080316e2cdee8cdf75c0cc3ba.result: The neural network predicts flows better than the power model, including at sites with limited data.
3da699499802110080316e2cdee8cdf75c0cc3ba.open_work: Extension to other rivers and inclusion of precipitation inputs.
3da699499802110080316e2cdee8cdf75c0cc3ba.issues: Single river system; limited physical interpretability and extrapolation to extremes.

1fdac911870e33a9ace463102d0212fe63fd72f4.goal: Forecasts river stage during floods several hours ahead to support warning systems.
1fdac911870e33a9ace463102d0212fe63fd72f4.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) using rainfall and upstream water level inputs.
1fdac911870e33a9ace463102d0212fe63fd72f4.data: Hourly rain gauge and water level records from the Tagliamento River basin, Italy.
1fdac911870e33a9ace463102d0212fe63fd72f4.result: The network forecasts flood water levels several hours ahead with good accuracy, degrading with increasing lead time.
1fdac911870e33a9ace463102d0212fe63fd72f4.open_work: Longer lead times, coupling with rainfall forecasts and application to other basins.
1fdac911870e33a9ace463102d0212fe63fd72f4.issues: Few large flood events for training; limited extrapolation beyond observed extremes.

f90dcd5a777915ab84e2b92dcfc675606a75dded.goal: Models daily rainfall-runoff with neural networks and examines sensitivity to the amount and climatic character of training data.
f90dcd5a777915ab84e2b92dcfc675606a75dded.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) compared with regression and simple conceptual models.
f90dcd5a777915ab84e2b92dcfc675606a75dded.data: Daily precipitation, temperature and snowmelt equivalent with streamflow for the Little Patuxent River watershed, Maryland, USA.
f90dcd5a777915ab84e2b92dcfc675606a75dded.result: The neural network gives more accurate runoff predictions than the comparison models, and training data covering wet, average and dry conditions improve performance.
f90dcd5a777915ab84e2b92dcfc675606a75dded.open_work: Testing in other watersheds and better input selection.
f90dcd5a777915ab84e2b92dcfc675606a75dded.issues: Single watershed; black-box structure; extrapolation beyond training conditions is uncertain.

524002ced6b400ca598ef07c055c7e293c9534da.goal: Compares neural networks with regression for daily maximum ozone forecasting in air-quality management.
524002ced6b400ca598ef07c055c7e293c9534da.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network compared with multiple linear regression.
524002ced6b400ca598ef07c055c7e293c9534da.data: Meteorological variables and observed ozone concentrations from several US cities.
524002ced6b400ca598ef07c055c7e293c9534da.result: Neural networks are somewhat better than regression, but the gain is modest and not consistent across cities.
524002ced6b400ca598ef07c055c7e293c9534da.open_work: Better predictors and hybrid models for high ozone episodes.
524002ced6b400ca598ef07c055c7e293c9534da.issues: Limited improvement over regression; peak events remain hard to predict.

f2bb0acacfcb12ae94f8121f35aa68b9b15b9aa7.goal: Simulates daily precipitation and other weather variables for impact studies while preserving their joint dependence without parametric assumptions.
f2bb0acacfcb12ae94f8121f35aa68b9b15b9aa7.architecture: k-nearest neighbour resampling weather generator conditioned on the previous day's state; nonparametric, not a neural network.
f2bb0acacfcb12ae94f8121f35aa68b9b15b9aa7.data: Daily weather records (precipitation, solar radiation, maximum and minimum temperature, dew point, wind speed) at Salt Lake City, Utah.
f2bb0acacfcb12ae94f8121f35aa68b9b15b9aa7.result: The simulator reproduces key statistics and cross-correlations of the observed variables comparably to or better than a parametric generator.
f2bb0acacfcb12ae94f8121f35aa68b9b15b9aa7.open_work: Multisite extension and conditioning on climate signals.
f2bb0acacfcb12ae94f8121f35aa68b9b15b9aa7.issues: Cannot produce values outside the historical record; depends on choice of k and record length.

eeedf82a53b95619549cda81a7e4663db4a15357.goal: Reconstructs European climate at the Last Glacial Maximum, about 18,000 years before present, from fossil pollen.
eeedf82a53b95619549cda81a7e4663db4a15357.architecture: Modern analogue (nearest-neighbour) technique based on plant functional type scores, constrained by vegetation modelling; not a neural network.
eeedf82a53b95619549cda81a7e4663db4a15357.data: Fossil pollen records from European sites and a modern pollen dataset with climate.
eeedf82a53b95619549cda81a7e4663db4a15357.result: Indicates a much colder and drier glacial climate in Europe than today, with strong cooling in winter temperature.
eeedf82a53b95619549cda81a7e4663db4a15357.open_work: Comparison with climate model simulations and more sites.
eeedf82a53b95619549cda81a7e4663db4a15357.issues: Lack of good modern analogues for glacial vegetation; sparse site coverage; CO2 effects on vegetation.

d905abb6284718d723c542afb462e8ae6848a8e7.goal: Improves neural-network short-term electric load forecasting through better network design and training data selection.
d905abb6284718d723c542afb462e8ae6848a8e7.architecture: Neural network with linear and nonlinear terms, trained on cases selected by a minimum distance criterion.
d905abb6284718d723c542afb462e8ae6848a8e7.data: Historical load and weather data from a US electric utility.
d905abb6284718d723c542afb462e8ae6848a8e7.result: The proposed design improves forecast accuracy over earlier neural network approaches.
d905abb6284718d723c542afb462e8ae6848a8e7.open_work: Handling special days and adaptive retraining.
d905abb6284718d723c542afb462e8ae6848a8e7.issues: Single utility; limited comparison with statistical methods.

dde749bc43da3e20f5ec086dfb8c40bbf27fafff.goal: Forecasts hourly electric load for the next day for the Greek interconnected power system.
dde749bc43da3e20f5ec086dfb8c40bbf27fafff.architecture: Fully connected feedforward artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) with load and temperature inputs and day-type handling.
dde749bc43da3e20f5ec086dfb8c40bbf27fafff.data: Historical hourly loads and temperatures for the Greek power system.
dde749bc43da3e20f5ec086dfb8c40bbf27fafff.result: The neural network produces next-day forecasts with lower errors than the conventional method used by the utility.
dde749bc43da3e20f5ec086dfb8c40bbf27fafff.open_work: Better treatment of holidays and integration of weather forecast uncertainty.
dde749bc43da3e20f5ec086dfb8c40bbf27fafff.issues: Errors increase on holidays and unusual days; single system.

37a52b918288f19610b704c01dd6fa619ffe26c8.goal: Forecasts short-term wind power output to support integration of wind farms into an autonomous island power system.
37a52b918288f19610b704c01dd6fa619ffe26c8.architecture: Recurrent neural networks (advanced neural network models) compared with persistence and other methods.
37a52b918288f19610b704c01dd6fa619ffe26c8.data: Wind speed and power time series from wind installations on the Greek island of Crete.
37a52b918288f19610b704c01dd6fa619ffe26c8.result: The recurrent neural networks improve on persistence for short-term horizons.
37a52b918288f19610b704c01dd6fa619ffe26c8.open_work: Inclusion of numerical weather prediction inputs and longer horizons.
37a52b918288f19610b704c01dd6fa619ffe26c8.issues: Gains over persistence are modest at very short horizons; site-specific training.

a80a41bc5b53910760af41e4d7d78730e89a46de.goal: Forecasts reservoir inflow and derives operating rules to improve reservoir management.
a80a41bc5b53910760af41e4d7d78730e89a46de.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) for inflow forecasting and for releases, compared with time series models.
a80a41bc5b53910760af41e4d7d78730e89a46de.data: Inflow and operation records of the Indravati reservoir, India.
a80a41bc5b53910760af41e4d7d78730e89a46de.result: The neural network forecasts inflows better than conventional time series models, notably for high flows, and helps model operation rules.
a80a41bc5b53910760af41e4d7d78730e89a46de.open_work: Integration with optimization and broader validation.
a80a41bc5b53910760af41e4d7d78730e89a46de.issues: Single reservoir; network design by trial and error.

932c768d0f2b0e64a17de4e04ec5a4ee1803c939.goal: Estimates global solar radiation at locations lacking measurements, for solar energy applications.
932c768d0f2b0e64a17de4e04ec5a4ee1803c939.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (feedforward backpropagation neural network) using geographic and sunshine inputs.
932c768d0f2b0e64a17de4e04ec5a4ee1803c939.data: Monthly mean data from meteorological stations in Saudi Arabia (latitude, longitude, altitude, sunshine duration), split into training and testing stations.
932c768d0f2b0e64a17de4e04ec5a4ee1803c939.result: The network estimates global solar radiation at withheld stations more accurately than a regression-type model.
932c768d0f2b0e64a17de4e04ec5a4ee1803c939.open_work: More inputs and stations, and daily resolution.
932c768d0f2b0e64a17de4e04ec5a4ee1803c939.issues: Monthly means only; limited stations; spatial generalization uncertain.

ec3247d70374013dd3c4133b58d60cae4256e367.goal: Forecasts ocean wave heights a few hours ahead in real time for coastal and offshore operations.
ec3247d70374013dd3c4133b58d60cae4256e367.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) using recent observed wave heights.
ec3247d70374013dd3c4133b58d60cae4256e367.data: Observed wave height time series from a buoy off the west coast of India.
ec3247d70374013dd3c4133b58d60cae4256e367.result: The neural networks give satisfactory forecasts for short leads, with accuracy decreasing as lead time increases.
ec3247d70374013dd3c4133b58d60cae4256e367.open_work: Use of wind inputs and longer lead times.
ec3247d70374013dd3c4133b58d60cae4256e367.issues: Univariate inputs; single site; skill falls at longer leads.

9413997941655a6a5860c5c18f0a318bf1ea634e.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed and wind power to support power system operation.
9413997941655a6a5860c5c18f0a318bf1ea634e.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting models, including use of spatial correlation with upstream sites, compared with persistence.
9413997941655a6a5860c5c18f0a318bf1ea634e.data: Wind speed measurements from sites in Greece.
9413997941655a6a5860c5c18f0a318bf1ea634e.result: The neural network approach improves on persistence, especially when using data from upstream stations.
9413997941655a6a5860c5c18f0a318bf1ea634e.issues: Site-specific; modest gains at short horizons.

0cdf1aba1307027be168307ca54efd044ab5363a.goal: Explores neural networks as rainfall-runoff models, predicting peak discharge and full hydrographs.
0cdf1aba1307027be168307ca54efd044ab5363a.architecture: Feedforward backpropagation neural network (multilayer perceptron); hydrographs represented through Fourier series coefficients.
0cdf1aba1307027be168307ca54efd044ab5363a.data: Synthetic rainfall-runoff data generated on a grid of cells representing a watershed.
0cdf1aba1307027be168307ca54efd044ab5363a.result: The network predicts peak discharge and timing and reconstructs hydrographs well for the synthetic cases.
0cdf1aba1307027be168307ca54efd044ab5363a.open_work: Application to real watersheds with observed data.
0cdf1aba1307027be168307ca54efd044ab5363a.issues: Synthetic data only; idealized watershed representation.

dd54e736750996aad1da4fe8624353ae8008f2ee.goal: Estimates how long an observational record is needed to find good atmospheric analogues for analogue forecasting.
dd54e736750996aad1da4fe8624353ae8008f2ee.architecture: Analysis of analogue (nearest-neighbour) forecasting based on the dimensionality of atmospheric states; non-ML statistical method.
dd54e736750996aad1da4fe8624353ae8008f2ee.data: Historical atmospheric analyses of Northern Hemisphere circulation fields.
dd54e736750996aad1da4fe8624353ae8008f2ee.result: Finding close analogues for the full hemispheric state would require an impractically long record, on the order of 10^30 years, so analogues are only useful in small domains or few dimensions.
