77916f3082bdbef70d8c1a35ef01bb97f7dd76d2.result: The neural network reproduces storm hydrographs reasonably well; numbers not reported here.
77916f3082bdbef70d8c1a35ef01bb97f7dd76d2.open_work: Testing on more storms and catchments.
77916f3082bdbef70d8c1a35ef01bb97f7dd76d2.issues: Small dataset and limited validation; extrapolation to extreme storms is uncertain.

ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.goal: Supports avalanche hazard forecasting by formalising expert knowledge.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) for regional avalanche forecasting.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.data: Snow, weather and avalanche observations from the Swiss Alps.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.result: The expert system produces avalanche danger assessments in good agreement with observed avalanche activity and human forecasts; exact rates not reported here.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.open_work: Refining rules and combining with statistical methods.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.issues: Rule base depends on expert input; verification is difficult due to sparse avalanche records.

3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.goal: Estimates ocean chlorophyll concentration from satellite ocean colour reflectance.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.architecture: Feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron) mapping remote sensing reflectances to chlorophyll.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.data: In situ bio-optical data with chlorophyll and water-leaving reflectances; details not reported here.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.result: The neural network improves chlorophyll estimates over standard band-ratio algorithms.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.open_work: Application to SeaWiFS imagery and coastal waters.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.issues: Training data limited; performance in optically complex waters uncertain.

ec7e38fc37b3fa1bf28c090a9ce5daf5ae937c62.goal: Investigates radial basis function neural networks for simulating runoff discharge from a small catchment.
ec7e38fc37b3fa1bf28c090a9ce5daf5ae937c62.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) neural network with nonlinearity only in the hidden layer and two-step parameter estimation, compared with a multilayer perceptron (MLP).
ec7e38fc37b3fa1bf28c090a9ce5daf5ae937c62.data: Rainfall and runoff data from a small catchment; details not reported in the abstract.
ec7e38fc37b3fa1bf28c090a9ce5daf5ae937c62.result: RBF network models predict runoff with accuracy comparable to MLP models while being easier and much faster to develop.
ec7e38fc37b3fa1bf28c090a9ce5daf5ae937c62.open_work: Testing on larger catchments and other hydrological variables.
ec7e38fc37b3fa1bf28c090a9ce5daf5ae937c62.issues: Single small catchment; no quantitative uncertainty or extreme event analysis.

3cd4fd10519576745473fb4d46c570edfda8a3bc.goal: Calibrates the runoff component of the Storm Water Management Model (SWMM) using encoded expert knowledge.
3cd4fd10519576745473fb4d46c570edfda8a3bc.architecture: Knowledge-based expert system (rule-based) guiding SWMM parameter adjustment.
3cd4fd10519576745473fb4d46c570edfda8a3bc.data: Observed rainfall-runoff events from an urban catchment; details not reported here.
3cd4fd10519576745473fb4d46c570edfda8a3bc.result: The knowledge-based system calibrates SWMM runoff parameters efficiently, matching observed hydrographs; numbers not reported here.
3cd4fd10519576745473fb4d46c570edfda8a3bc.open_work: Combining with automatic optimisation and extending to other model components.
3cd4fd10519576745473fb4d46c570edfda8a3bc.issues: Rule quality depends on expert knowledge; limited catchments tested.

1a9d3e14768420131b0630e5689ff02ef1e53d5d.goal: Models rainfall-runoff transformation with neural networks.
1a9d3e14768420131b0630e5689ff02ef1e53d5d.data: Rainfall and runoff data from a study catchment; details not reported here.
1a9d3e14768420131b0630e5689ff02ef1e53d5d.result: Neural networks simulate runoff reasonably well compared with conceptual models; numbers not reported here.
1a9d3e14768420131b0630e5689ff02ef1e53d5d.open_work: Testing on longer records and forecast mode.
1a9d3e14768420131b0630e5689ff02ef1e53d5d.issues: Single catchment; black-box with limited extrapolation.

f805e140af0b73145be78207a620fed0d8d55e7a.goal: Predicts all-India summer monsoon rainfall seasonally from predictor parameters.
f805e140af0b73145be78207a620fed0d8d55e7a.architecture: Feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron) trained with error back-propagation.
f805e140af0b73145be78207a620fed0d8d55e7a.data: Historical all-India summer monsoon rainfall and predictors from India Meteorological Department records.
f805e140af0b73145be78207a620fed0d8d55e7a.result: The neural network gives better prediction skill than statistical regression models; numbers not reported here.
f805e140af0b73145be78207a620fed0d8d55e7a.open_work: Updating predictors and testing in operational forecasting.
f805e140af0b73145be78207a620fed0d8d55e7a.issues: Short record and predictor stationarity issues; overfitting risk.

a7309695e6c261726ed70fac3ff8b0a55a875b9f.goal: Determines sea ice thickness categories automatically from synthetic aperture radar imagery.
a7309695e6c261726ed70fac3ff8b0a55a875b9f.architecture: Automated image-analysis pipeline with segmentation and knowledge-based classification of ice types mapped to thickness.
a7309695e6c261726ed70fac3ff8b0a55a875b9f.data: ERS-1 SAR imagery of sea ice; details not reported here.
a7309695e6c261726ed70fac3ff8b0a55a875b9f.result: The automated approach classifies ice types and infers thickness categories consistent with expert interpretation.
a7309695e6c261726ed70fac3ff8b0a55a875b9f.open_work: Validation with in situ thickness and other SAR sensors.
a7309695e6c261726ed70fac3ff8b0a55a875b9f.issues: Thickness inferred indirectly from ice type; limited ground truth.

7b8aea723d24c0e00489848f02c4ee21d6978a84.goal: Predicts surface ozone concentrations at sites in the United Kingdom from meteorological conditions, to support air-quality forecasting.
7b8aea723d24c0e00489848f02c4ee21d6978a84.architecture: Artificial neural network relating meteorological predictors to surface ozone; details of the network configuration are not available here.
7b8aea723d24c0e00489848f02c4ee21d6978a84.data: Surface ozone monitoring and meteorological observations at UK sites; exact stations and period not reported.
7b8aea723d24c0e00489848f02c4ee21d6978a84.result: The neural network is presented as a viable tool for ozone prediction; quantitative skill is not reported here.
7b8aea723d24c0e00489848f02c4ee21d6978a84.open_work: Testing at more sites and seasons and comparison with other statistical models would establish generality.
7b8aea723d24c0e00489848f02c4ee21d6978a84.issues: Site-specific statistical model with no physical chemistry; transferability and performance during high-ozone episodes are uncertain.

24610ccc7171076d535d4512613aefb04b840969.goal: Forecasts river flow rate during low-flow periods, when water management decisions depend on reliable predictions of discharge several days ahead.
24610ccc7171076d535d4512613aefb04b840969.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting flow from antecedent rainfall and discharge observations.
24610ccc7171076d535d4512613aefb04b840969.data: Hydrometeorological records (rainfall and river flow) for an Italian river basin; exact gauges and period not reported here.
24610ccc7171076d535d4512613aefb04b840969.result: The neural network provides useful low-flow forecasts several days ahead; specific error statistics are not reported here.
24610ccc7171076d535d4512613aefb04b840969.open_work: Extending lead times and testing on other basins and drier years would clarify robustness.
24610ccc7171076d535d4512613aefb04b840969.issues: Data-driven model for a single basin; low-flow regimes outside the training range may be poorly reproduced.

62c23fe44f3b9f3c13075478728cca96f245e924.goal: Develops statistical seasonal prediction of summer rainfall over South Africa from predictors available before the rainy season.
62c23fe44f3b9f3c13075478728cca96f245e924.architecture: Empirical statistical prediction from large-scale climate indices, comparing linear regression with a neural network approach.
62c23fe44f3b9f3c13075478728cca96f245e924.data: South African summer rainfall index with preceding circulation and sea surface temperature indices (including ENSO-related indicators); exact period not reported here.
62c23fe44f3b9f3c13075478728cca96f245e924.result: Pre-season indices give useful skill for summer rainfall prediction; quantitative skill measures are not reported here.
62c23fe44f3b9f3c13075478728cca96f245e924.open_work: Operational testing on independent seasons and refined predictor selection are natural next steps.
62c23fe44f3b9f3c13075478728cca96f245e924.issues: Short records limit training and validation; statistical relationships may be non-stationary.

175eb26c9d19f704dcfc0cb71b02e96ae1d48e25.goal: Forecasts electric load for multiple utility sites with different climates, where a single generic technique would reduce the need for site-specific models.
175eb26c9d19f704dcfc0cb71b02e96ae1d48e25.architecture: Expert system (rule-based, knowledge-based) load forecasting technique using weather and calendar information.
175eb26c9d19f704dcfc0cb71b02e96ae1d48e25.data: Historical load and weather data from several utility sites; specific utilities and periods not reported here.
175eb26c9d19f704dcfc0cb71b02e96ae1d48e25.result: The expert-system approach produces short-term load forecasts with acceptable accuracy across the sites; numbers not reported here.
175eb26c9d19f704dcfc0cb71b02e96ae1d48e25.open_work: Automating rule acquisition and adapting to new sites would reduce manual tuning.
175eb26c9d19f704dcfc0cb71b02e96ae1d48e25.issues: Rules depend on expert knowledge and may need retuning for unusual weather or changing load patterns.

f075a92d9332ebef3768c3045fe8d5a84c28e8d9.goal: Provides short-term forecasts of ozone concentrations to support air-quality alerts in a polluted urban area.
f075a92d9332ebef3768c3045fe8d5a84c28e8d9.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting ozone from recent ozone and meteorological data.
f075a92d9332ebef3768c3045fe8d5a84c28e8d9.data: Urban air-quality monitoring data (ozone and meteorological variables); site and period not reported here.
f075a92d9332ebef3768c3045fe8d5a84c28e8d9.result: The neural network gives skillful short-term ozone forecasts; quantitative results are not reported here.
f075a92d9332ebef3768c3045fe8d5a84c28e8d9.open_work: Comparison with statistical and photochemical models and longer forecast horizons would be useful.
f075a92d9332ebef3768c3045fe8d5a84c28e8d9.issues: Single-location statistical model; no explicit chemistry, and performance on extreme episodes is uncertain.

85425163bc4aad96bdc0a73f14a2a7fa9f106f06.goal: Compares neural network types with simpler statistical methods for short-range river flow forecasting in a flood-prone catchment.
85425163bc4aad96bdc0a73f14a2a7fa9f106f06.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) and radial basis function (RBF) networks compared with stepwise multiple linear regression and zero-order (persistence) forecasts.
85425163bc4aad96bdc0a73f14a2a7fa9f106f06.data: 15-minute rainfall-runoff data for the River Mole, a tributary of the River Thames, UK; winter and spring test seasons with cross-validation.
85425163bc4aad96bdc0a73f14a2a7fa9f106f06.result: The MLP is the most skillful model for 6-hour-ahead flow forecasts; the RBF is only marginally better than regression and persistence.
85425163bc4aad96bdc0a73f14a2a7fa9f106f06.open_work: Application to real-time flood forecasting and other catchments is suggested.
85425163bc4aad96bdc0a73f14a2a7fa9f106f06.issues: Single catchment and two seasons; inputs restricted to antecedent rainfall and discharge, with no uncertainty estimates.

fec858fa99732a7030dec25eff9fae6e82def35d.goal: Retrieves ocean surface wind speed from satellite passive microwave data, aiming to improve on regression algorithms, especially in cloudy conditions.
fec858fa99732a7030dec25eff9fae6e82def35d.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks (multilayer perceptron) mapping brightness temperatures to wind speed, with separate networks for different atmospheric conditions.
fec858fa99732a7030dec25eff9fae6e82def35d.data: SSM/I brightness temperatures collocated with in situ buoy wind observations.
fec858fa99732a7030dec25eff9fae6e82def35d.result: Neural network retrievals are more accurate than conventional regression algorithms; specific error statistics are not reported here.
fec858fa99732a7030dec25eff9fae6e82def35d.open_work: Extending retrievals to wind direction and heavier precipitation conditions is a natural continuation.
fec858fa99732a7030dec25eff9fae6e82def35d.issues: Depends on collocation data quality and representativeness; performance degrades in rain.

5a6bf3ad34f028ee26bc73606cf3ee9c4674b8fb.goal: Forecasts temperature time series of oceanographic water masses in real time and extracts models of their thermal structure.
5a6bf3ad34f028ee26bc73606cf3ee9c4674b8fb.architecture: Unsupervised Negative Feedback Artificial Neural Network, compared with linear regression and ARIMA models.
5a6bf3ad34f028ee26bc73606cf3ee9c4674b8fb.data: Oceanographic temperature time series of water masses; source and period not reported in the abstract.
5a6bf3ad34f028ee26bc73606cf3ee9c4674b8fb.result: The negative feedback network extracts the underlying model of the data and forecasts competitively with linear regression and ARIMA; numbers not reported.
5a6bf3ad34f028ee26bc73606cf3ee9c4674b8fb.open_work: Further evaluation on other oceanographic variables and longer horizons is implied.
5a6bf3ad34f028ee26bc73606cf3ee9c4674b8fb.issues: Limited description of data and quantitative skill; univariate time-series approach without ocean physics.

69e4695529ce1265f3a567d4a5c7c54db686343a.goal: Models the rainfall-runoff relationship as a time-series problem to forecast river discharge.
69e4695529ce1265f3a567d4a5c7c54db686343a.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network trained by backpropagation for rainfall-runoff time-series modelling.
69e4695529ce1265f3a567d4a5c7c54db686343a.data: Rainfall and runoff records for a river catchment; details not reported here.
69e4695529ce1265f3a567d4a5c7c54db686343a.result: The neural network reproduces runoff dynamics with useful accuracy; quantitative results are not reported here.
69e4695529ce1265f3a567d4a5c7c54db686343a.open_work: Testing on other catchments and comparison with conceptual hydrological models would be informative.
69e4695529ce1265f3a567d4a5c7c54db686343a.issues: Single-catchment, data-driven model with limited ability to extrapolate beyond observed conditions.

eaccd996c2671a9c46729ec74d552c41a041441e.goal: Estimates rainfall from spaceborne passive microwave observations, where the radiance-rainfall relationship is highly nonlinear.
eaccd996c2671a9c46729ec74d552c41a041441e.architecture: Feed-forward neural network mapping microwave brightness temperatures to rain rate.
eaccd996c2671a9c46729ec74d552c41a041441e.data: Satellite passive microwave brightness temperatures (SSM/I-type frequencies) with rainfall reference data; specific datasets not reported here.
eaccd996c2671a9c46729ec74d552c41a041441e.result: The neural network provides rainfall estimates competitive with conventional retrieval approaches; numbers not reported here.
eaccd996c2671a9c46729ec74d552c41a041441e.open_work: Validation over more regimes and against independent ground radar would strengthen the method.
eaccd996c2671a9c46729ec74d552c41a041441e.issues: Retrievals depend on the representativeness of training data and beam-filling assumptions.

a4af10fedd97e6d7da972d64290da0bf1cb2db9d.goal: Predicts leaf wetness, a key driver of plant disease infection, to support disease forecasting from weather data.
a4af10fedd97e6d7da972d64290da0bf1cb2db9d.architecture: Generalized regression neural network (GRNN) relating meteorological variables to leaf wetness.
a4af10fedd97e6d7da972d64290da0bf1cb2db9d.data: Field weather observations and leaf wetness measurements; site and period not reported here.
a4af10fedd97e6d7da972d64290da0bf1cb2db9d.result: The GRNN predicts leaf wetness with useful accuracy for disease forecasting; quantitative results are not reported here.
a4af10fedd97e6d7da972d64290da0bf1cb2db9d.open_work: Testing across locations and crops and coupling with disease models are natural next steps.
a4af10fedd97e6d7da972d64290da0bf1cb2db9d.issues: Local data-driven model; transferability to other climates and canopies is uncertain.

84b8ee5c8cf1b36e44bfedc1880b752a468a991b.goal: Models and forecasts monthly electric energy consumption in eastern Saudi Arabia, where demand depends strongly on weather.
84b8ee5c8cf1b36e44bfedc1880b752a468a991b.architecture: Abductive networks (polynomial self-organizing networks, GMDH-type) using weather and demographic predictors, compared with regression.
84b8ee5c8cf1b36e44bfedc1880b752a468a991b.data: Monthly electricity consumption with weather (e.g. temperature, humidity, solar radiation) and population data for eastern Saudi Arabia; exact period not reported here.
84b8ee5c8cf1b36e44bfedc1880b752a468a991b.result: Abductive network models forecast monthly consumption with good accuracy; specific error values are not reported here.
84b8ee5c8cf1b36e44bfedc1880b752a468a991b.open_work: Updating models with new data and forecasting further ahead are natural extensions.
84b8ee5c8cf1b36e44bfedc1880b752a468a991b.issues: Short record of monthly data; forecasts require future weather predictors.

805d501b1de98f5ae94951b963b101bf784cd11b.goal: Predicts rainfall amounts at unsampled locations from a subset of gauge observations, as part of a spatial interpolation comparison.
805d501b1de98f5ae94951b963b101bf784cd11b.architecture: Artificial neural networks, using radial basis function networks for part of the domain and linear regression elsewhere.
805d501b1de98f5ae94951b963b101bf784cd11b.data: Daily rainfall from a Swiss gauge network (Spatial Interpolation Comparison 97 data), with a subset of stations used for training.
805d501b1de98f5ae94951b963b101bf784cd11b.result: The neural network approach gives reasonable rainfall estimates at unsampled stations; quantitative results are not reported here.
805d501b1de98f5ae94951b963b101bf784cd11b.open_work: Inclusion of elevation and other covariates and comparison with geostatistical methods are natural next steps.
805d501b1de98f5ae94951b963b101bf784cd11b.issues: Few training stations and a single day's field; spatial interpolation, not temporal forecasting.

1c914b7dbc7c3bf6024fd36ccda7aadaf9d88be6.goal: Estimates rainfall rates from geostationary satellite imagery, which offers broad coverage but only indirect cloud-top information.
1c914b7dbc7c3bf6024fd36ccda7aadaf9d88be6.architecture: Pattern recognition technique classifying visible and infrared image features (e.g. brightness and texture) into rain-rate categories; not a neural network.
1c914b7dbc7c3bf6024fd36ccda7aadaf9d88be6.data: GOES visible and infrared images with radar-derived rainfall for training and verification.
1c914b7dbc7c3bf6024fd36ccda7aadaf9d88be6.result: The pattern recognition method yields rain rate estimates that agree reasonably with radar; specific statistics not reported here.
1c914b7dbc7c3bf6024fd36ccda7aadaf9d88be6.open_work: Application to other regions and storm types would test generality.
1c914b7dbc7c3bf6024fd36ccda7aadaf9d88be6.issues: Indirect relationship between cloud-top properties and surface rain; limited training cases.

edb11079f37d75a0b8f65ab087b90daecf8699f8.goal: Applies backpropagation neural networks to forecasting hydrological time series such as river flows.
edb11079f37d75a0b8f65ab087b90daecf8699f8.architecture: Feed-forward neural network trained by backpropagation, with inputs informed by classical time-series (Box-Jenkins) analysis, compared with ARMA-type models.
edb11079f37d75a0b8f65ab087b90daecf8699f8.data: Hydrological time series (river flow records); specific series not reported here.
edb11079f37d75a0b8f65ab087b90daecf8699f8.result: Neural networks perform comparably to or better than conventional time-series models; quantitative results not reported here.
edb11079f37d75a0b8f65ab087b90daecf8699f8.open_work: Systematic methods for choosing network structure and inputs are needed.
edb11079f37d75a0b8f65ab087b90daecf8699f8.issues: Short series limit network training; results may depend on the series studied.

790d5ea382303545a52c2d8a8e7c49285d210856.goal: Compares methods for training feed-forward neural networks for forecasting river salinity, to guide practical model development.
790d5ea382303545a52c2d8a8e7c49285d210856.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks (multilayer perceptron) trained with various algorithms, including backpropagation variants with different parameters and second-order methods.
790d5ea382303545a52c2d8a8e7c49285d210856.data: River salinity, flow and level time series for the River Murray, South Australia, with a multi-week forecast horizon.
790d5ea382303545a52c2d8a8e7c49285d210856.result: Training methods differ mainly in training speed, while generalization ability is broadly similar; specific numbers not reported here.
790d5ea382303545a52c2d8a8e7c49285d210856.open_work: Guidance on network geometry and input selection is needed alongside training methods.
790d5ea382303545a52c2d8a8e7c49285d210856.issues: Single river case study; findings on training algorithms may not transfer to other problems.

8f7cc538a80956bd0ca932fabc27f9c83d437686.goal: Forecasts stream flows during storms in real time to support operational flood management.
8f7cc538a80956bd0ca932fabc27f9c83d437686.architecture: Neural networks trained with error backpropagation, conjugate gradient and cascade correlation, using past flood values as inputs.
8f7cc538a80956bd0ca932fabc27f9c83d437686.data: Sequences of past observed flood values at a specific river location; site details not reported in the abstract.
8f7cc538a80956bd0ca932fabc27f9c83d437686.result: Flood forecasts with lead times of one or more hours are satisfactory, especially at the shortest warning times.
8f7cc538a80956bd0ca932fabc27f9c83d437686.open_work: Longer lead times and inclusion of rainfall inputs are natural extensions.
8f7cc538a80956bd0ca932fabc27f9c83d437686.issues: Uses only past flow values at one location; skill declines with lead time and no uncertainty is provided.

a34fe42e566fda2eeb078c834e4d3d8a41a0c29f.goal: Segments clouds in AVHRR satellite imagery, a prerequisite for surface and cloud retrievals.
a34fe42e566fda2eeb078c834e4d3d8a41a0c29f.architecture: Neural network classifier (feed-forward) applied to AVHRR image features for cloud segmentation.
a34fe42e566fda2eeb078c834e4d3d8a41a0c29f.data: NOAA AVHRR multispectral imagery with labelled cloud and clear-sky samples; regions not reported here.
a34fe42e566fda2eeb078c834e4d3d8a41a0c29f.result: The neural network segments clouds effectively compared with conventional methods; quantitative results not reported here.
a34fe42e566fda2eeb078c834e4d3d8a41a0c29f.open_work: Testing across seasons, regions and surface types would assess robustness.
a34fe42e566fda2eeb078c834e4d3d8a41a0c29f.issues: Dependent on labelled training samples; performance over difficult surfaces such as snow and sunglint is uncertain.

bff74407dc7f2539a08dcb70d4b7fa93d6b20dea.goal: Segments satellite imagery into cloud and surface regions as a step toward automated cloud classification.
bff74407dc7f2539a08dcb70d4b7fa93d6b20dea.architecture: Hierarchical thresholding combined with a neural network classifier for image segmentation.
bff74407dc7f2539a08dcb70d4b7fa93d6b20dea.data: Satellite imagery (e.g. AVHRR); specific scenes not reported here.
bff74407dc7f2539a08dcb70d4b7fa93d6b20dea.result: The combined thresholding and neural network approach yields usable segmentations; quantitative results not reported here.
bff74407dc7f2539a08dcb70d4b7fa93d6b20dea.open_work: Integration into automated cloud classification systems is the natural next step.
bff74407dc7f2539a08dcb70d4b7fa93d6b20dea.issues: Thresholds and training samples are scene-dependent; limited evaluation.

0f55e79af2cb039fc6aeda2b4058c491c832fcf2.goal: Forecasts the space-time variability of sea surface temperature in the Alboran Sea using a nonlinear data-driven technique.
0f55e79af2cb039fc6aeda2b4058c491c832fcf2.architecture: Genetic algorithm combined with empirical orthogonal function (EOF) analysis; the genetic algorithm finds equations describing each EOF temporal amplitude.
0f55e79af2cb039fc6aeda2b4058c491c832fcf2.data: Sea surface temperature fields of the Alboran Sea (satellite-derived); period not reported in the abstract.
0f55e79af2cb039fc6aeda2b4058c491c832fcf2.result: The method enables global forecasting of the future SST variability of the basin; quantitative skill not reported in the abstract.
0f55e79af2cb039fc6aeda2b4058c491c832fcf2.open_work: Application to other variables and regions and comparison with dynamical models are natural extensions.
0f55e79af2cb039fc6aeda2b4058c491c832fcf2.issues: Truncated EOF basis limits resolved variability; evolved equations are fitted to a short record and may not generalize.

628196f3259b51de64af845823729daa2c3b4e23.goal: Predicts rainfall patterns at long range, a key need for agriculture and water planning in monsoon regions.
628196f3259b51de64af845823729daa2c3b4e23.architecture: Novel neural network design for long-range rainfall prediction; configuration details are not available here.
628196f3259b51de64af845823729daa2c3b4e23.data: Historical rainfall records, likely for India; specific data not reported here.
628196f3259b51de64af845823729daa2c3b4e23.result: The network is reported to capture long-range rainfall variations; quantitative skill is not reported here.
628196f3259b51de64af845823729daa2c3b4e23.open_work: Independent verification over more years is needed.
628196f3259b51de64af845823729daa2c3b4e23.issues: Short climate records risk overfitting; skill on independent data is uncertain.

e953ffddb470d6a1534920eae0d6c8267d40e289.goal: Calibrates a hydrologic model automatically, balancing several objectives such as volume and peak flow errors.
e953ffddb470d6a1534920eae0d6c8267d40e289.architecture: Genetic algorithm combined with multi-objective programming for parameter optimisation of a hydrologic model.
e953ffddb470d6a1534920eae0d6c8267d40e289.data: Observed rainfall and streamflow for a watershed; details not reported here.
e953ffddb470d6a1534920eae0d6c8267d40e289.result: The genetic algorithm finds parameter sets that fit observed hydrographs well under multiple objectives; numbers not reported here.
e953ffddb470d6a1534920eae0d6c8267d40e289.open_work: Testing with other models and catchments and analysis of parameter uncertainty are natural next steps.
e953ffddb470d6a1534920eae0d6c8267d40e289.issues: Calibration quality depends on objective weighting; equifinality of parameters is not resolved.

36dbd07f93c287734261e17007c89e76693ddba1.goal: Downscales large-scale atmospheric information to local daily precipitation in Australia for climate impact studies.
36dbd07f93c287734261e17007c89e76693ddba1.architecture: Weather classification by recursive partitioning (classification and regression tree, CART) linking circulation states to station precipitation, with a stochastic precipitation model conditioned on weather states.
36dbd07f93c287734261e17007c89e76693ddba1.data: Daily station precipitation in Australia with large-scale atmospheric circulation data (observations and GCM output); periods not reported here.
36dbd07f93c287734261e17007c89e76693ddba1.result: The weather-type approach reproduces key precipitation statistics at stations; specifics not reported here.
36dbd07f93c287734261e17007c89e76693ddba1.open_work: Application to GCM climate change simulations depends on GCM realism of circulation.
36dbd07f93c287734261e17007c89e76693ddba1.issues: Assumes stationary weather-type-precipitation relationships; GCM circulation biases propagate to downscaled results.

895d972aabc3584ff509e9658e7ea2d3af38b03c.goal: Analyses polar clouds from satellite imagery, where cloud detection over snow and ice is difficult.
895d972aabc3584ff509e9658e7ea2d3af38b03c.architecture: Pattern recognition classification using spectral and textural features into surface and cloud classes, followed by a statistical cloud analysis scheme to estimate cloud fraction; not a neural network.
895d972aabc3584ff509e9658e7ea2d3af38b03c.data: AVHRR multispectral imagery over Arctic and Antarctic regions.
895d972aabc3584ff509e9658e7ea2d3af38b03c.result: The pattern recognition approach identifies polar surface and cloud types and estimates cloud amounts reasonably; numbers not reported here.
895d972aabc3584ff509e9658e7ea2d3af38b03c.open_work: Validation against surface observations and extension to more seasons are natural next steps.
895d972aabc3584ff509e9658e7ea2d3af38b03c.issues: Cloud-surface contrast over snow and ice remains challenging; limited independent validation.

f6230db34716c103d5e53c359f4574d37e25f902.goal: Retrieves ocean properties such as chlorophyll concentration from satellite ocean colour reflectances, improving on empirical band-ratio algorithms.
f6230db34716c103d5e53c359f4574d37e25f902.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network mapping marine reflectances to chlorophyll concentration.
f6230db34716c103d5e53c359f4574d37e25f902.data: Simulated and/or in situ ocean colour reflectance data for SeaWiFS-type bands; details not reported here.
f6230db34716c103d5e53c359f4574d37e25f902.result: The neural network inverts reflectances accurately and compares favourably with polynomial algorithms; numbers not reported here.
f6230db34716c103d5e53c359f4574d37e25f902.open_work: Application to real satellite imagery and coastal waters are natural extensions.
f6230db34716c103d5e53c359f4574d37e25f902.issues: Dependent on the bio-optical model or training data representativeness; atmospheric correction errors are not addressed.

f6ea5bef87df7f932f83ebd518024292956e3bea.goal: Predicts which radar-detected circulations will produce damaging winds, to improve severe weather warnings.
f6ea5bef87df7f932f83ebd518024292956e3bea.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (multilayer perceptron) classifying radar-derived attributes, compared with traditional statistical classifiers.
f6ea5bef87df7f932f83ebd518024292956e3bea.data: Attributes from the NSSL mesocyclone detection algorithm applied to WSR-88D Doppler radar data, verified against damaging wind reports.
f6ea5bef87df7f932f83ebd518024292956e3bea.result: The neural network outperforms traditional statistical methods in discriminating damaging wind events; specific skill scores not reported here.
f6ea5bef87df7f932f83ebd518024292956e3bea.open_work: Combining with other detection algorithms and real-time operational testing are natural next steps.
f6ea5bef87df7f932f83ebd518024292956e3bea.issues: Verification relies on incomplete storm reports; limited sample of events.

b6f9c5037ed7d0fb1ee1d5f64936b8ac497048dd.goal: Detects and identifies clouds in satellite imagery by exploiting spatial context, not only per-pixel spectral information.
b6f9c5037ed7d0fb1ee1d5f64936b8ac497048dd.architecture: Contextual pattern recognition (statistical contextual classifier) for cloud detection and identification; not a neural network.
b6f9c5037ed7d0fb1ee1d5f64936b8ac497048dd.data: Satellite multispectral imagery; sensor and scenes not reported here.
b6f9c5037ed7d0fb1ee1d5f64936b8ac497048dd.result: Using contextual information improves cloud classification accuracy over per-pixel classification; numbers not reported here.
b6f9c5037ed7d0fb1ee1d5f64936b8ac497048dd.open_work: Extension to more cloud classes and operational settings is natural.
b6f9c5037ed7d0fb1ee1d5f64936b8ac497048dd.issues: Requires training statistics for each class; tested on limited scenes.

3bd87466652e99916049b087abfa61d9814dbd4e.goal: Derives ocean surface specific humidity and air temperature from satellite data, needed to estimate turbulent air-sea heat fluxes.
3bd87466652e99916049b087abfa61d9814dbd4e.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) mapping satellite observations to near-surface specific humidity and air temperature.
3bd87466652e99916049b087abfa61d9814dbd4e.data: SSM/I microwave observations (with sea surface temperature) collocated with in situ ship and buoy measurements.
3bd87466652e99916049b087abfa61d9814dbd4e.result: The neural network retrieves specific humidity and air temperature more accurately than earlier statistical methods; numbers not reported here.
3bd87466652e99916049b087abfa61d9814dbd4e.open_work: Global application to compute surface heat fluxes is the natural next step.
3bd87466652e99916049b087abfa61d9814dbd4e.issues: Limited by collocation data coverage; air temperature is only weakly constrained by satellite radiances.

988d81e3ae2521f93ffb067851e9166190953702.goal: Evaluates genetic algorithm schemes for automatic calibration of conceptual rainfall-runoff models.
988d81e3ae2521f93ffb067851e9166190953702.architecture: Comparison of several genetic algorithm (GA) schemes and settings for parameter optimisation of a conceptual rainfall-runoff model.
988d81e3ae2521f93ffb067851e9166190953702.data: Synthetic and observed rainfall-runoff data for calibration tests; details not reported here.
988d81e3ae2521f93ffb067851e9166190953702.result: Performance depends on the GA scheme and settings; GA can locate good parameter sets but efficiency varies; numbers not reported here.
988d81e3ae2521f93ffb067851e9166190953702.open_work: Hybrid schemes with local search and analysis of parameter identifiability are natural next steps.
988d81e3ae2521f93ffb067851e9166190953702.issues: Computationally demanding; parameter interaction and equifinality are not resolved by optimisation alone.

2aa7edd366d393bb9c58c699df4217b20ec7c613.goal: Predicts river runoff from rainfall, an alternative to conceptual hydrological models for flood forecasting.
2aa7edd366d393bb9c58c699df4217b20ec7c613.architecture: Artificial neural network for rainfall-runoff prediction; configuration details are not available here.
2aa7edd366d393bb9c58c699df4217b20ec7c613.data: Rainfall and runoff records for a river basin, likely in Japan; details not reported here.
2aa7edd366d393bb9c58c699df4217b20ec7c613.result: The neural network predicts runoff with useful accuracy; quantitative results are not reported here.
2aa7edd366d393bb9c58c699df4217b20ec7c613.open_work: Testing on more events and basins and inclusion of physical knowledge are natural next steps.
2aa7edd366d393bb9c58c699df4217b20ec7c613.issues: Data-driven model limited by training records; extreme floods may be poorly predicted.

d2a5357405e6a03a2b8b6f86f88bd09fe551f4fb.goal: Examines how microclimatic conditions modify visible ozone injury in subterranean clover, to relate ozone exposure to crop damage better than exposure indices alone.
d2a5357405e6a03a2b8b6f86f88bd09fe551f4fb.architecture: Artificial neural network relating ozone exposure and microclimate variables to leaf injury, used to explore the influence of each variable.
d2a5357405e6a03a2b8b6f86f88bd09fe551f4fb.data: Experimental observations of ozone exposure, microclimate and leaf injury in clover; sites and periods not reported in the available metadata.
d2a5357405e6a03a2b8b6f86f88bd09fe551f4fb.result: The networks indicate that microclimatic factors alongside ozone exposure influence injury; quantitative skill not reported in the available metadata.
d2a5357405e6a03a2b8b6f86f88bd09fe551f4fb.open_work: Testing on independent sites and species and linking to flux-based ozone dose metrics follow naturally.
d2a5357405e6a03a2b8b6f86f88bd09fe551f4fb.issues: Small experimental dataset and limited interpretability of early neural networks; generality beyond the studied conditions is uncertain.

c8797fdbb9e5e8faec0fd3844ed38beafb7aac37.goal: Develops a data-driven model of subsurface-drained farmland hydrology, such as water table depth and drain outflow, as a fast alternative to process-based drainage models.
c8797fdbb9e5e8faec0fd3844ed38beafb7aac37.architecture: Artificial neural network driven by weather and field variables; network details not reported in the available metadata.
c8797fdbb9e5e8faec0fd3844ed38beafb7aac37.data: Drainage field or drainage-model data; sites, periods and inputs not reported in the available metadata.
c8797fdbb9e5e8faec0fd3844ed38beafb7aac37.result: The neural network reproduces the drainage-system response with reasonable accuracy; quantitative scores not reported in the available metadata.
c8797fdbb9e5e8faec0fd3844ed38beafb7aac37.open_work: Validation across soils, climates and drainage designs, and use in drainage design or water-table management.
c8797fdbb9e5e8faec0fd3844ed38beafb7aac37.issues: Site-specific training limits transferability; behaviour outside the training range is not guaranteed.

9e804fe90493d99dd542a5a09494f4a09053c6f1.goal: Automates classification of sky and cloud types from ground-based whole-sky imager photographs, to replace subjective human cloud observations.
9e804fe90493d99dd542a5a09494f4a09053c6f1.architecture: Pattern-recognition classifier using spectral and texture features of sky images, based on binary decision trees.
9e804fe90493d99dd542a5a09494f4a09053c6f1.data: Whole-sky imager images from a ground site (ARM program context); exact site and period not reported in the available metadata.
9e804fe90493d99dd542a5a09494f4a09053c6f1.result: The automated classifier separates major cloud types with moderate accuracy; exact accuracy figures not reported here.
9e804fe90493d99dd542a5a09494f4a09053c6f1.open_work: More cloud classes, larger labelled image sets and combination with other sensors such as ceilometers or radiometers.
9e804fe90493d99dd542a5a09494f4a09053c6f1.issues: Single-site imagery, subjective human labels as reference and confusion between similar cloud types.

072a2cf2c4fc9f3cabaacedc5ab3e978c6f5f966.goal: Investigates how to choose network architecture and forecasting inputs for neural network rainfall-runoff models, avoiding trial-and-error design.
072a2cf2c4fc9f3cabaacedc5ab3e978c6f5f966.architecture: Multilayer perceptron rainfall-runoff model whose structure and inputs are optimised by network pruning algorithms and a genetic algorithm.
072a2cf2c4fc9f3cabaacedc5ab3e978c6f5f966.data: Hourly river flow and rainfall records from a UK catchment; exact catchment and period not reported in the available metadata.
072a2cf2c4fc9f3cabaacedc5ab3e978c6f5f966.result: Pruning and genetic-algorithm optimisation yield smaller networks with comparable or better forecast skill than hand-designed ones.
072a2cf2c4fc9f3cabaacedc5ab3e978c6f5f966.open_work: Comparison of optimisation strategies across catchments and lead times, and links to physical interpretation of selected inputs.
072a2cf2c4fc9f3cabaacedc5ab3e978c6f5f966.issues: Results depend on one catchment and on random initialisation; optimisation is computationally expensive for the period.

f96a1b1adf2e85f5cabaababb8eaccf0677ea4fc.goal: Estimates rainfall from satellite observations, supporting operational heavy-rainfall and flash-flood analysis.
f96a1b1adf2e85f5cabaababb8eaccf0677ea4fc.architecture: Artificial neural network group, an ensemble of neural networks (including higher-order or polynomial networks) combined to estimate rainfall.
f96a1b1adf2e85f5cabaababb8eaccf0677ea4fc.data: Satellite imagery and associated rainfall estimates from the NOAA/NESDIS satellite rainfall estimation context; details not reported in the available metadata.
f96a1b1adf2e85f5cabaababb8eaccf0677ea4fc.result: The neural network group gives lower rainfall-estimation error than single networks or conventional techniques; exact figures not reported here.
f96a1b1adf2e85f5cabaababb8eaccf0677ea4fc.open_work: Wider testing over more storms and regions and integration into operational estimation workflows.
f96a1b1adf2e85f5cabaababb8eaccf0677ea4fc.issues: Limited cases and reference data; transferability to other regions and satellite sensors is unclear.

ca1ad04a3d1f085829eda55535accd5cfee8ac8e.goal: Retrieves the vertical distribution of atmospheric water vapour from TOVS satellite sounder observations, for climate and weather studies.
ca1ad04a3d1f085829eda55535accd5cfee8ac8e.architecture: Neural network (multilayer perceptron) retrieval of layer precipitable water from TOVS radiances, trained on a radiative-transfer-simulated atmospheric profile database.
ca1ad04a3d1f085829eda55535accd5cfee8ac8e.data: TOVS (HIRS/MSU) radiances, TIGR atmospheric profile database with simulated radiances, and radiosonde observations for validation.
ca1ad04a3d1f085829eda55535accd5cfee8ac8e.result: Retrieved layer water vapour agrees well with radiosondes, with errors comparable to or better than previous TOVS methods.
ca1ad04a3d1f085829eda55535accd5cfee8ac8e.open_work: Application to long TOVS records for water vapour climatology and to newer sounders.
ca1ad04a3d1f085829eda55535accd5cfee8ac8e.issues: Accuracy degrades in cloudy and upper-tropospheric conditions; radiosonde validation has its own humidity biases.

b6a32bae0707df3487c3517b3e88fe6025115409.goal: Corrects numerical weather prediction forecasts using the newest observations available after model initialisation, to improve short-range local guidance.
b6a32bae0707df3487c3517b3e88fe6025115409.architecture: Artificial neural network that combines numerical model output with newly arrived observations to produce modified forecasts.
b6a32bae0707df3487c3517b3e88fe6025115409.data: Numerical model forecasts from the Japan Meteorological Agency and surface observations in Japan; exact variables and periods not reported here.
b6a32bae0707df3487c3517b3e88fe6025115409.result: The neural network correction improves forecast skill over the raw model guidance; quantitative scores not reported in the available metadata.
b6a32bae0707df3487c3517b3e88fe6025115409.open_work: Extension to more variables and stations and comparison with statistical post-processing such as MOS.
b6a32bae0707df3487c3517b3e88fe6025115409.issues: Gains depend on the stability of model biases; network retraining is needed after model changes.

7bd33c51ada9acb32dd72142c146fa751893b723.goal: Supports operational avalanche risk forecasting by automating expert assessment of snowpack stability.
7bd33c51ada9acb32dd72142c146fa751893b723.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) named MEPRA that applies avalanche-expert rules to simulated snow-cover stratigraphy to estimate instability and risk.
7bd33c51ada9acb32dd72142c146fa751893b723.data: Snowpack profiles simulated by the CROCUS snow model driven by meteorological analyses in the French Alps (Météo-France).
7bd33c51ada9acb32dd72142c146fa751893b723.result: MEPRA produces avalanche risk estimates consistent with forecaster judgement and becomes part of the Météo-France avalanche forecasting chain.
7bd33c51ada9acb32dd72142c146fa751893b723.open_work: Formal verification against observed avalanche activity and refinement of rules for more snow types.
7bd33c51ada9acb32dd72142c146fa751893b723.issues: Depends on simulated snowpack quality; rules encode expert knowledge that is hard to validate objectively.

c9e8d69674cbd1c72c1fe8b13c99ff0737e843be.goal: Models global solar radiation at the Earth's surface, comparing physically based atmospheric models with data-driven intelligent techniques.
c9e8d69674cbd1c72c1fe8b13c99ff0737e843be.architecture: Comparison of deterministic atmospheric radiation models and artificial neural network data-driven models.
c9e8d69674cbd1c72c1fe8b13c99ff0737e843be.data: Ground measurements of global solar radiation and meteorological variables in Athens, Greece.
c9e8d69674cbd1c72c1fe8b13c99ff0737e843be.result: The neural network models reproduce measured solar radiation with accuracy comparable to or better than the deterministic models.
c9e8d69674cbd1c72c1fe8b13c99ff0737e843be.open_work: Testing at other climates and stations and hybrid physical and data-driven schemes.
c9e8d69674cbd1c72c1fe8b13c99ff0737e843be.issues: Single-site data limit generalisation; data-driven models need long local records.

1cc3856cb456ca0b2cd54cb6b3c58857acff1b72.goal: Estimates atmospheric temperature and humidity profiles from microwave radiometric measurements, improving on linear statistical inversion.
1cc3856cb456ca0b2cd54cb6b3c58857acff1b72.architecture: Natural orthogonal functions (EOF) compression of profiles combined with a neural network (multilayer perceptron) for the inversion.
1cc3856cb456ca0b2cd54cb6b3c58857acff1b72.data: Simulated microwave brightness temperatures computed from radiosonde profiles; specific stations and radiometer channels not reported here.
1cc3856cb456ca0b2cd54cb6b3c58857acff1b72.result: The combined EOF and neural network method retrieves profiles more accurately than linear regression inversion.
1cc3856cb456ca0b2cd54cb6b3c58857acff1b72.open_work: Application to real radiometer data and to additional channels or sensors.
1cc3856cb456ca0b2cd54cb6b3c58857acff1b72.issues: Evaluation largely on simulated radiances; real instrument noise and calibration errors may reduce gains.

cb0d31794720d50c05e52fd87bbf9a97268270fb.goal: Provides real-time flood forecasting with a learning model that adapts its structure to incoming data.
cb0d31794720d50c05e52fd87bbf9a97268270fb.architecture: Self-organizing neural network algorithm (radial basis function type) that builds its hidden structure automatically for flow forecasting.
cb0d31794720d50c05e52fd87bbf9a97268270fb.data: Hourly rainfall and streamflow records from typhoon floods in a Taiwanese river basin; exact basin and events not reported here.
cb0d31794720d50c05e52fd87bbf9a97268270fb.result: The self-organizing network gives accurate one- to few-hour-ahead flood forecasts; exact metrics not reported in the available metadata.
cb0d31794720d50c05e52fd87bbf9a97268270fb.open_work: Longer lead times, more basins and coupling with rainfall forecasts.
cb0d31794720d50c05e52fd87bbf9a97268270fb.issues: Few flood events for training and testing; skill falls with lead time.

e491f6e418cb362ddc9bb6d7940d5de0d2988e36.goal: Retrieves oceanic constituents such as chlorophyll, suspended sediment and yellow substance from ocean colour reflectances expected from the MERIS sensor.
e491f6e418cb362ddc9bb6d7940d5de0d2988e36.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) inversion of water-leaving reflectance to constituent concentrations.
e491f6e418cb362ddc9bb6d7940d5de0d2988e36.data: Simulated MERIS-band reflectances from a bio-optical radiative transfer model (pre-launch study).
e491f6e418cb362ddc9bb6d7940d5de0d2988e36.result: The neural network retrieves constituent concentrations accurately from simulated data, including in optically complex waters.
e491f6e418cb362ddc9bb6d7940d5de0d2988e36.open_work: Validation with in situ data and real MERIS observations after launch, including atmospheric correction effects.
e491f6e418cb362ddc9bb6d7940d5de0d2988e36.issues: Trained and tested on simulations only; bio-optical model assumptions and sensor noise limit realism.

794f57dfdcff58ae035dd90b530d533e987eedae.goal: Forecasts sea surface temperature anomalies over equatorial Pacific Niño regions with neural networks, to improve ENSO prediction at long leads.
794f57dfdcff58ae035dd90b530d533e987eedae.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) ensembles, averaging 20 runs with random initial weights; one model type uses sea level pressure and another wind stress as predictors.
794f57dfdcff58ae035dd90b530d533e987eedae.data: Tropical Pacific sea level pressure, wind stress and SST anomalies; cross-validation over 1952–1993 and out-of-sample forecasts for 1982–1993.
794f57dfdcff58ae035dd90b530d533e987eedae.result: SLP-based models show usable skill to 12-month lead and beat wind-stress models at 9–12 months; Niño 3.5 out-of-sample correlations are 0.78, 0.80 and 0.75 at 9, 12 and 15 months.
794f57dfdcff58ae035dd90b530d533e987eedae.open_work: Improving skill in eastern boundary regions and adding ocean predictors such as heat content follow naturally.
794f57dfdcff58ae035dd90b530d533e987eedae.issues: Short record for training nonlinear models; skill is lower in the eastern Pacific and forecasts are deterministic without uncertainty.

de8a8651cea5fe2606bccb53aed2128f687292b3.goal: Models and forecasts ambient air temperature time series, useful for building energy and climate applications.
de8a8651cea5fe2606bccb53aed2128f687292b3.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) trained on past temperature values for time-series prediction.
de8a8651cea5fe2606bccb53aed2128f687292b3.data: Hourly or daily air temperature records from Athens, Greece; periods not reported in the available metadata.
de8a8651cea5fe2606bccb53aed2128f687292b3.result: The neural networks reproduce and predict air temperature with good accuracy; exact error statistics not reported here.
de8a8651cea5fe2606bccb53aed2128f687292b3.open_work: Multi-station testing and inclusion of other meteorological predictors.
de8a8651cea5fe2606bccb53aed2128f687292b3.issues: Single-site data; autoregressive network may not handle unusual conditions or long horizons.

33843ab4ea8afae2a74ba40acb5c05c5b6df3f91.goal: Classifies sea ice types in polarimetric synthetic aperture radar images, to support ice mapping.
33843ab4ea8afae2a74ba40acb5c05c5b6df3f91.architecture: Artificial neural network classifier using polarimetric SAR features; network details not reported in the available metadata.
33843ab4ea8afae2a74ba40acb5c05c5b6df3f91.data: Airborne polarimetric SAR imagery of sea ice (e.g. JPL AIRSAR); scenes and ground truth not reported here.
33843ab4ea8afae2a74ba40acb5c05c5b6df3f91.result: The neural network separates the main sea ice types in polarimetric SAR imagery; accuracy figures not reported in the available metadata.
33843ab4ea8afae2a74ba40acb5c05c5b6df3f91.open_work: Application to spaceborne SAR and additional ice classes and seasons.
33843ab4ea8afae2a74ba40acb5c05c5b6df3f91.issues: Few scenes and limited ground truth; seasonal changes in backscatter may limit transfer.

ebf11b646d40267247daf1c6cc31b3fa67cf5f55.goal: Compares two neural network types for flood forecasting from hydrological time series.
ebf11b646d40267247daf1c6cc31b3fa67cf5f55.architecture: Multilayer perceptron versus radial basis function network for river flow or stage forecasting.
ebf11b646d40267247daf1c6cc31b3fa67cf5f55.data: Rainfall and river flow records from a catchment; specific catchment and periods not reported in the available metadata.
ebf11b646d40267247daf1c6cc31b3fa67cf5f55.result: Both network types give useful flood forecasts; their relative accuracy and training cost are compared, with specific scores not reported in the available metadata.
ebf11b646d40267247daf1c6cc31b3fa67cf5f55.open_work: Tests on more catchments and longer lead times.
ebf11b646d40267247daf1c6cc31b3fa67cf5f55.issues: Limited data and events; results may be catchment-specific.

fa8e5de2f6199092ea2d4bbaaa700a6a7717a340.goal: Improves retrieval of atmospheric temperature and humidity profiles from microwave radiometric measurements.
fa8e5de2f6199092ea2d4bbaaa700a6a7717a340.architecture: Nonlinear principal component analysis implemented with an autoassociative neural network, combined with a multilayer perceptron inversion network.
fa8e5de2f6199092ea2d4bbaaa700a6a7717a340.data: Radiosonde profiles and corresponding simulated microwave brightness temperatures; stations and channels not reported here.
fa8e5de2f6199092ea2d4bbaaa700a6a7717a340.result: Nonlinear PCA compression with neural network inversion is reported to improve retrieval accuracy over linear approaches; exact errors not reported here.
fa8e5de2f6199092ea2d4bbaaa700a6a7717a340.open_work: Application to real radiometer measurements and other sensors.
fa8e5de2f6199092ea2d4bbaaa700a6a7717a340.issues: Mostly simulated radiances; real noise and calibration may reduce gains.

7bdb566ea9d4f6eed8a31aefdd9bc0f6f0949b2b.goal: Retrieves atmospheric carbon monoxide total columns from high-resolution nadir infrared radiances quickly enough for operational satellite processing.
7bdb566ea9d4f6eed8a31aefdd9bc0f6f0949b2b.architecture: Neural network (multilayer perceptron) inversion algorithm trained on simulated spectra.
7bdb566ea9d4f6eed8a31aefdd9bc0f6f0949b2b.data: Radiances from the IMG instrument on ADEOS and radiative-transfer simulations for training.
7bdb566ea9d4f6eed8a31aefdd9bc0f6f0949b2b.result: The neural network retrieves CO total columns with accuracy comparable to standard inversion methods at much lower computational cost.
7bdb566ea9d4f6eed8a31aefdd9bc0f6f0949b2b.open_work: Application to future sounders such as IASI and validation with ground and aircraft measurements.
7bdb566ea9d4f6eed8a31aefdd9bc0f6f0949b2b.issues: Training relies on simulations; sensitivity to clouds and surface properties is a caveat.

1810cd957edd7305e5a39471ae56389d37525fd7.goal: Explores artificial neural networks for land drainage engineering problems such as predicting water table depth in drained fields.
1810cd957edd7305e5a39471ae56389d37525fd7.architecture: Artificial neural network models for drainage system response; network details not reported in the available metadata.
1810cd957edd7305e5a39471ae56389d37525fd7.data: Drainage-model simulations or field data; specifics not reported in the available metadata.
1810cd957edd7305e5a39471ae56389d37525fd7.result: Neural networks reproduce drainage behaviour accurately and run faster than process models; quantitative results not reported here.
1810cd957edd7305e5a39471ae56389d37525fd7.open_work: Field validation and broader application across soils and climates.
1810cd957edd7305e5a39471ae56389d37525fd7.issues: Transferability beyond training conditions is uncertain.

8719b974e9479bd4b057704b83523672d7b9caee.goal: Forecasts carbon monoxide concentrations near a sheltered road intersection, linking traffic and weather to local air quality.
8719b974e9479bd4b057704b83523672d7b9caee.architecture: Artificial neural network using traffic counts from video surveillance and meteorological variables as inputs.
8719b974e9479bd4b057704b83523672d7b9caee.data: Video-derived traffic data, meteorological observations and CO monitoring near one urban intersection.
8719b974e9479bd4b057704b83523672d7b9caee.result: The neural network predicts short-term CO concentrations with useful accuracy; exact metrics not reported in the available metadata.
8719b974e9479bd4b057704b83523672d7b9caee.open_work: Extension to other sites and pollutants and real-time traffic management use.
8719b974e9479bd4b057704b83523672d7b9caee.issues: Single-site study; results depend on local geometry and data period.

0552a28ec752a6c6aa6386ba787536ffab8912cd.goal: Tracks and recognises features such as clouds between successive satellite images, for example for cloud motion estimation.
0552a28ec752a6c6aa6386ba787536ffab8912cd.architecture: Hopfield neural network formulated as an optimisation for matching features between images.
0552a28ec752a6c6aa6386ba787536ffab8912cd.data: Satellite sensor images; specific sensor and scenes not reported in the available metadata.
0552a28ec752a6c6aa6386ba787536ffab8912cd.result: The Hopfield network successfully matches and tracks features; quantitative comparison not reported here.
0552a28ec752a6c6aa6386ba787536ffab8912cd.open_work: Larger datasets, comparison with correlation-based tracking and operational wind derivation.
0552a28ec752a6c6aa6386ba787536ffab8912cd.issues: Few test cases; Hopfield networks can converge to poor local minima.

76d750fe36b6eadb1c4952dc90cea6d445e459a6.goal: Develops intelligent decision support for reservoir management and operation, combining models with expert knowledge.
76d750fe36b6eadb1c4952dc90cea6d445e459a6.architecture: Intelligent decision support system combining an expert system (rule-based) with reservoir operation models.
76d750fe36b6eadb1c4952dc90cea6d445e459a6.data: Reservoir system data for an example application; details not reported in the available metadata.
76d750fe36b6eadb1c4952dc90cea6d445e459a6.result: The prototype demonstrates how expert knowledge and models can be integrated for operational decisions.
76d750fe36b6eadb1c4952dc90cea6d445e459a6.open_work: Field deployment and evaluation with operators.

c798562eaa93482bb987821f09f1b773815a78b2.goal: Provides operational guidance to water managers during droughts, capturing expert drought-response knowledge.
c798562eaa93482bb987821f09f1b773815a78b2.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) combined with water supply simulation for drought operations.
c798562eaa93482bb987821f09f1b773815a78b2.data: Seattle municipal water supply system data and operator knowledge.
c798562eaa93482bb987821f09f1b773815a78b2.result: The expert system offers consistent drought-management recommendations and helps transfer expert knowledge.
c798562eaa93482bb987821f09f1b773815a78b2.open_work: Extension to other systems and integration with forecasts.
c798562eaa93482bb987821f09f1b773815a78b2.issues: Knowledge base is system-specific; validation is qualitative.

88eec778fbe58e61735665d073eee7d2a806cfe7.goal: Tests artificial neural networks for reconstructing past climate from tree rings, compared with traditional regression.
88eec778fbe58e61735665d073eee7d2a806cfe7.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) versus linear regression for transfer functions from tree-ring chronologies to climate.
88eec778fbe58e61735665d073eee7d2a806cfe7.data: Tree-ring chronologies and instrumental precipitation records from the Front Range, Colorado, USA.
88eec778fbe58e61735665d073eee7d2a806cfe7.result: Neural network reconstructions perform broadly similarly to regression-based ones; exact calibration and verification scores not reported here.
88eec778fbe58e61735665d073eee7d2a806cfe7.open_work: Testing in other regions and with more predictors.
88eec778fbe58e61735665d073eee7d2a806cfe7.issues: Short calibration periods favour overfitting; little gain over regression.

790813041bdf4691e1ca95b5ec7ee8bb3090f560.goal: Forecasts weather-dependent electric load over medium horizons, comparing AI and statistical methods.
790813041bdf4691e1ca95b5ec7ee8bb3090f560.architecture: Enhanced artificial neural network and fuzzy neural network compared with statistical techniques such as ARIMA and regression.
790813041bdf4691e1ca95b5ec7ee8bb3090f560.data: Electric load and weather data from a utility; specifics not reported in the available metadata.
790813041bdf4691e1ca95b5ec7ee8bb3090f560.result: The enhanced neural and fuzzy neural networks are reported to forecast load more accurately than the statistical techniques; exact errors not reported here.
790813041bdf4691e1ca95b5ec7ee8bb3090f560.issues: Single-system study; depends on weather forecast quality.

fa7570c0b51150ebcffee28394d157decaa277a8.goal: Examines how uncertainty in weather forecast inputs affects neural network electric load forecasts.
fa7570c0b51150ebcffee28394d157decaa277a8.architecture: Artificial neural network load forecasting model with probabilistic weather inputs.
fa7570c0b51150ebcffee28394d157decaa277a8.data: Utility load and temperature data; specifics not reported in the available metadata.
fa7570c0b51150ebcffee28394d157decaa277a8.result: Accounting for weather-forecast uncertainty gives a distribution of load forecasts and expected errors; numbers not reported here.
fa7570c0b51150ebcffee28394d157decaa277a8.issues: Assumes input error distributions; single-utility data.

214c5fa18ccd5dcc0fab2f1ba42290e15194597b.goal: Models seasonality and long-term trends in daily rainfall occurrence and amount, to characterise climate variation.
214c5fa18ccd5dcc0fab2f1ba42290e15194597b.architecture: Neural network (multilayer perceptron) whose outputs parameterise a mixed distribution of rain occurrence and gamma-distributed amount.
214c5fa18ccd5dcc0fab2f1ba42290e15194597b.data: Long daily rainfall station records; station details not reported in the available metadata.
214c5fa18ccd5dcc0fab2f1ba42290e15194597b.result: The model captures seasonal cycles and trends in rainfall probability and amount.
214c5fa18ccd5dcc0fab2f1ba42290e15194597b.open_work: Extension to multiple stations and spatial dependence.
214c5fa18ccd5dcc0fab2f1ba42290e15194597b.issues: Single-station analysis and no spatial dependence.

4d29acbb1ec27a99a86a57aa6ca12446354c017d.goal: Develops automated detection of low-altitude wind shear hazards such as microbursts and gust fronts for airport safety.
4d29acbb1ec27a99a86a57aa6ca12446354c017d.architecture: Automated rule-based and feature-recognition detection algorithms applied to Doppler radar velocity fields; not a learning method.
4d29acbb1ec27a99a86a57aa6ca12446354c017d.data: Doppler weather radar data from FAA terminal Doppler weather radar testbed operations.
4d29acbb1ec27a99a86a57aa6ca12446354c017d.result: The automated system detects microbursts with high probability of detection and low false alarm rates in operational tests.
4d29acbb1ec27a99a86a57aa6ca12446354c017d.open_work: Deployment at airports and integration with other wind shear sensors.
4d29acbb1ec27a99a86a57aa6ca12446354c017d.issues: Performance varies with storm type and radar viewing geometry.

a50933405317181fa48bdf49407a7ec2579416fd.goal: Estimates daily soil water evaporation from weather and soil variables in arid conditions.
a50933405317181fa48bdf49407a7ec2579416fd.architecture: Artificial neural network relating meteorological and soil moisture inputs to soil evaporation.
a50933405317181fa48bdf49407a7ec2579416fd.data: Field measurements of soil evaporation and weather in a dry region; specifics not reported in the available metadata.
a50933405317181fa48bdf49407a7ec2579416fd.result: The neural network estimates daily evaporation with good accuracy; exact metrics not reported here.
a50933405317181fa48bdf49407a7ec2579416fd.open_work: Testing on other soils and climates.

df1b274d682408eecc1574b928f1e8abfdd640fb.goal: Maps potential adaptation zones of temperate pasture species as constrained by climate, guiding pasture selection.
df1b274d682408eecc1574b928f1e8abfdd640fb.architecture: Knowledge-based logical modelling approach, an expert system (rule-based) encoding climatic tolerances of species.
df1b274d682408eecc1574b928f1e8abfdd640fb.data: Climate surfaces and species tolerance knowledge for Australia; specifics not reported in the available metadata.
df1b274d682408eecc1574b928f1e8abfdd640fb.result: The model delineates zones suitable for each species consistent with known distributions.
df1b274d682408eecc1574b928f1e8abfdd640fb.open_work: Validation with field trials and inclusion of soil factors.
df1b274d682408eecc1574b928f1e8abfdd640fb.issues: Relies on expert knowledge; validation is qualitative.

a12c4814cb7304fbeb0e257efaebe96e9e93c4ff.goal: Classifies radiance spectra measured by the Ocean Color and Temperature Scanner (OCTS) on ADEOS, to separate surface and atmospheric types in ocean-colour imagery.

a12c4814cb7304fbeb0e257efaebe96e9e93c4ff.data: OCTS radiance imagery from the ADEOS satellite; scenes and period not reported here.

a12c4814cb7304fbeb0e257efaebe96e9e93c4ff.open_work: Extending the classification to other ocean-colour sensors and validating classes against in situ observations.

2bf29d1ffb19cd1346863c789913eeb208bdc5f3.goal: Develops an inversion method to retrieve atmospheric water vapour, cloud liquid and ice from multifrequency microwave radiometer measurements.
2bf29d1ffb19cd1346863c789913eeb208bdc5f3.architecture: Neural network-based inversion mapping microwave brightness temperatures to vapour, liquid and ice amounts; network details not reported here.
2bf29d1ffb19cd1346863c789913eeb208bdc5f3.data: Microwave radiometric brightness temperatures; whether training uses radiative-transfer simulations or observations is not reported here.
2bf29d1ffb19cd1346863c789913eeb208bdc5f3.result: Not reported in the abstract; Part I presents the development of the neural network inversion method.
2bf29d1ffb19cd1346863c789913eeb208bdc5f3.open_work: Part II-style application to observed radiometer data and validation against independent measurements.
2bf29d1ffb19cd1346863c789913eeb208bdc5f3.issues: No abstract available; ice retrieval from passive microwave is weakly constrained, and accuracy and generalization cannot be assessed from the record.

f6d74dc4dea6f01f0f1bfeffa4d8a6586a4c22b2.goal: Automatically generates readable weather forecast texts from formatted forecast data, to reduce the manual effort of writing routine bulletins.
f6d74dc4dea6f01f0f1bfeffa4d8a6586a4c22b2.architecture: Rule-based natural language generation system (RAREAS) producing English and French marine forecasts; a linguistic, non-machine-learning method.
f6d74dc4dea6f01f0f1bfeffa4d8a6586a4c22b2.data: Formatted marine forecast data supplied by forecasters at Environment Canada; no training data in the statistical sense.
f6d74dc4dea6f01f0f1bfeffa4d8a6586a4c22b2.result: Demonstrates that bilingual marine weather bulletins can be synthesized from structured data with a sublanguage grammar, producing text comparable in style to human-written forecasts.
f6d74dc4dea6f01f0f1bfeffa4d8a6586a4c22b2.open_work: Extending coverage to other forecast types and regions and evaluating generated texts operationally with forecasters.
f6d74dc4dea6f01f0f1bfeffa4d8a6586a4c22b2.issues: Hand-written grammar and rules tied to a narrow sublanguage; quantitative evaluation of text quality is limited.

2b4e98460e43e33ff081a3d5d8a7a21c0738d2b5.goal: Provides an objective aid for forecasting thunderstorms, severe thunderstorms and tornadoes in Australia, where forecasters needed a systematic decision procedure.
2b4e98460e43e33ff081a3d5d8a7a21c0738d2b5.architecture: Expert-designed decision tree (rule-based, built from physical reasoning on instability, moisture and wind shear), not a machine-learned tree.
2b4e98460e43e33ff081a3d5d8a7a21c0738d2b5.data: Upper-air soundings and synoptic observations from New South Wales, Australia; verification against reported thunderstorm and severe weather events.
2b4e98460e43e33ff081a3d5d8a7a21c0738d2b5.result: The decision tree discriminates thunderstorm and severe-thunderstorm days with useful skill; detailed verification scores are not reproduced here.
2b4e98460e43e33ff081a3d5d8a7a21c0738d2b5.open_work: Coupling the decision tree with NWP model forecasts to supply predicted rather than observed sounding parameters.
2b4e98460e43e33ff081a3d5d8a7a21c0738d2b5.issues: Thresholds are subjective and region-specific; severe-weather reports are sparse and biased toward populated areas.

2f95f29f60c881c365b80ca9fab801e957b38eba.goal: Compares palaeoclimate model simulations with proxy-based reconstructions in a way that accounts for the uncertainties of both.
2f95f29f60c881c365b80ca9fab801e957b38eba.architecture: Fuzzy logic comparison method using membership functions to measure agreement between simulated and reconstructed climate variables; non-neural method.
2f95f29f60c881c365b80ca9fab801e957b38eba.data: Mid-Holocene (6 ka) climate model simulations and pollen-based palaeoclimate reconstructions, mainly over Europe.
2f95f29f60c881c365b80ca9fab801e957b38eba.result: Fuzzy-logic distances give a more nuanced, uncertainty-aware assessment of model-data agreement than crisp comparisons; specific scores are not reproduced here.
2f95f29f60c881c365b80ca9fab801e957b38eba.open_work: Applying the approach to more models, periods and proxy types, and to model evaluation in multi-model intercomparisons.
2f95f29f60c881c365b80ca9fab801e957b38eba.issues: Results depend on the chosen membership functions and on proxy reconstruction uncertainties; spatial coverage of proxies is uneven.

3b56739b245761de492f180a035ad71e6da470c1.goal: Produces objective forecasts of severe thunderstorm environments by driving an existing forecast decision tree with operational NWP output.
3b56739b245761de492f180a035ad71e6da470c1.architecture: Expert-designed decision tree (rule-based, Colquhoun 1987) applied to fields from an operational regional NWP model; not machine learning.
3b56739b245761de492f180a035ad71e6da470c1.data: Operational regional NWP forecasts from the Australian Bureau of Meteorology; verification against Australian severe thunderstorm reports.
3b56739b245761de492f180a035ad71e6da470c1.result: Preliminary results show the NWP-driven decision tree identifies severe thunderstorm environments with useful skill.
3b56739b245761de492f180a035ad71e6da470c1.open_work: Longer verification periods, calibration of thresholds to model biases and probabilistic output.
3b56739b245761de492f180a035ad71e6da470c1.issues: Preliminary evaluation over a limited period; inherits NWP model biases and sparse, population-biased severe weather reports.

83526faa4dad0fb3ea4ddf5c81729d6b3bfada78.goal: Develops nonparametric nearest neighbour prediction for time series and applies it to rainfall-runoff forecasting.
83526faa4dad0fb3ea4ddf5c81729d6b3bfada78.architecture: k-nearest neighbour nonparametric regression for Markov-type time series, with theoretical consistency arguments.
83526faa4dad0fb3ea4ddf5c81729d6b3bfada78.data: Rainfall and river runoff time series; catchment and period not reported here.
83526faa4dad0fb3ea4ddf5c81729d6b3bfada78.result: Nearest neighbour forecasts are shown to be a viable, assumption-light alternative to parametric rainfall-runoff models; quantitative skill not reproduced here.
83526faa4dad0fb3ea4ddf5c81729d6b3bfada78.open_work: Choice of neighbourhood size and embedding, and comparison with conceptual hydrological models on more catchments.
83526faa4dad0fb3ea4ddf5c81729d6b3bfada78.issues: Requires long records to find analogues; cannot extrapolate beyond observed conditions such as unprecedented floods.

07a0324c585726e4c06874455b64f42f31d24066.goal: Forecasts all-India summer monsoon rainfall at long range, where linear regression models have limited skill.
07a0324c585726e4c06874455b64f42f31d24066.architecture: Hybrid principal component neural network: principal components of predictors are fed to a feed-forward neural network.
07a0324c585726e4c06874455b64f42f31d24066.data: Seasonal monsoon rainfall and long-range predictors from India Meteorological Department records; exact period not reported here.
07a0324c585726e4c06874455b64f42f31d24066.result: The hybrid model is reported to forecast Indian summer monsoon rainfall with skill comparable to or better than operational regression models; numbers not reproduced here.
07a0324c585726e4c06874455b64f42f31d24066.open_work: Testing on more independent years and updating predictors whose relationships with the monsoon change over time.
07a0324c585726e4c06874455b64f42f31d24066.issues: Short record (a few decades of seasons) for training a neural network risks overfitting; predictor relationships are non-stationary.

cb681d5b633828ab3837b645ecae937929b3be8d.goal: Forecasts river flow by exploiting low-dimensional nonlinear dynamics in streamflow time series.
cb681d5b633828ab3837b645ecae937929b3be8d.architecture: Nonlinear dynamics forecasting based on phase-space reconstruction of the flow series; non-neural method.
cb681d5b633828ab3837b645ecae937929b3be8d.data: River flow time series; river and period not reported here.
cb681d5b633828ab3837b645ecae937929b3be8d.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies nonlinear dynamical forecasts of river flow with some predictive skill.
cb681d5b633828ab3837b645ecae937929b3be8d.open_work: Comparison with linear stochastic models and testing for genuine low-dimensional chaos in streamflow.
cb681d5b633828ab3837b645ecae937929b3be8d.issues: No abstract available; evidence for low-dimensional dynamics in hydrological series is debated and noise-sensitive.

44515b7ad4be0476329ec2a47b0548b839486a52.goal: Objectively classifies Atlantic hurricanes into physically distinct groups to support climate studies of hurricane activity.
44515b7ad4be0476329ec2a47b0548b839486a52.architecture: Cluster analysis of hurricane characteristics such as genesis and maximum-intensity locations; statistical, non-neural method.
44515b7ad4be0476329ec2a47b0548b839486a52.data: Atlantic hurricane best-track records (HURDAT) over several decades.
44515b7ad4be0476329ec2a47b0548b839486a52.result: Identifies tropical-only and baroclinically enhanced hurricane groups with different genesis regions and climate relationships.
44515b7ad4be0476329ec2a47b0548b839486a52.open_work: Relating the groups to climate drivers such as ENSO and the West African monsoon, and improving seasonal forecasts.
44515b7ad4be0476329ec2a47b0548b839486a52.issues: Classification depends on chosen variables and on best-track data quality, especially in the pre-satellite era.

6e6d59de8c8564ac1265bf933a1f1749fec233f5.goal: Explores how artificial neural networks can support urban storm drainage tasks such as rainfall and flow prediction and system control.
6e6d59de8c8564ac1265bf933a1f1749fec233f5.architecture: Review and case applications of artificial neural networks (feed-forward networks) in urban drainage.
6e6d59de8c8564ac1265bf933a1f1749fec233f5.data: Urban rainfall and sewer flow measurements; specific systems not reported here.
6e6d59de8c8564ac1265bf933a1f1749fec233f5.result: Not reported in the abstract; the paper presents neural networks as a promising tool for urban storm drainage problems.
6e6d59de8c8564ac1265bf933a1f1749fec233f5.open_work: Operational real-time control applications and comparison with physically based sewer models.
6e6d59de8c8564ac1265bf933a1f1749fec233f5.issues: No abstract available; early-stage demonstrations with limited data and validation.

3fe4484060f8786af5c2439135d522593f3b308e.goal: Automates cloud classification in satellite imagery over both land and ocean backgrounds, which is hard with threshold methods.
3fe4484060f8786af5c2439135d522593f3b308e.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (multilayer perceptron trained by backpropagation) using spectral and textural features.
3fe4484060f8786af5c2439135d522593f3b308e.data: AVHRR multispectral satellite imagery with expert-labelled cloud samples.
3fe4484060f8786af5c2439135d522593f3b308e.result: The neural network classifier separates cloud types over land and ocean with good accuracy relative to expert labels; numbers not reproduced here.
3fe4484060f8786af5c2439135d522593f3b308e.open_work: Extending to more cloud classes, other sensors and night-time scenes.
3fe4484060f8786af5c2439135d522593f3b308e.issues: Depends on subjective expert labels; generalization to other regions and seasons is uncertain.

66428951ebcde98a960add23095f97695e5b53bc.goal: Predicts frost events to help protect citrus crops from frost damage.
66428951ebcde98a960add23095f97695e5b53bc.architecture: Neural network system forecasting frost occurrence or minimum temperature; architecture details not reported here.
66428951ebcde98a960add23095f97695e5b53bc.data: Local meteorological observations from citrus-growing areas; location and period not reported here.
66428951ebcde98a960add23095f97695e5b53bc.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies a neural network frost warning system for citrus growers.
66428951ebcde98a960add23095f97695e5b53bc.open_work: Operational deployment and integration with frost-protection actions.
66428951ebcde98a960add23095f97695e5b53bc.issues: No abstract available; site-specific training limits transfer to other orchards.

60d636ad1651ec53d7137937400a07b9795aee96.goal: Estimates missing daily rainfall at a gauge from neighbouring gauges to fill gaps in precipitation records.
60d636ad1651ec53d7137937400a07b9795aee96.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (backpropagation) compared with conventional interpolation and regression methods.
60d636ad1651ec53d7137937400a07b9795aee96.data: Daily rain gauge records from a regional network; region and period not reported here.
60d636ad1651ec53d7137937400a07b9795aee96.result: Not reported in the abstract; the neural network is expected to give competitive estimates of missing rainfall compared with simpler methods.

60d636ad1651ec53d7137937400a07b9795aee96.issues: No abstract available; performance on heavy rainfall days and zero-rain days is typically weaker.

fe077253e3f7f787148decf4593c6499279911c8.goal: Forecasts catchment runoff from rainfall with a data-driven model as an alternative to conceptual hydrological models.
fe077253e3f7f787148decf4593c6499279911c8.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) for rainfall-runoff forecasting.
fe077253e3f7f787148decf4593c6499279911c8.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a catchment; location and period not reported here.
fe077253e3f7f787148decf4593c6499279911c8.result: Not reported in the abstract; the network forecasts runoff with skill presumably compared with conventional models.
fe077253e3f7f787148decf4593c6499279911c8.open_work: Testing on other catchments and longer lead times.
