44e44dc3a8a78d681fc1d6ab14a20e46aec584ea.goal: Develops a neural network model to support water table management, i.e. controlled drainage and subirrigation, on agricultural fields.
44e44dc3a8a78d681fc1d6ab14a20e46aec584ea.architecture: Artificial neural network predicting water table depth from hydrological and weather inputs; detailed configuration is not reported in the available record.
44e44dc3a8a78d681fc1d6ab14a20e46aec584ea.data: Not reported in the available record. The study concerns agricultural fields with water table management in Canada.
44e44dc3a8a78d681fc1d6ab14a20e46aec584ea.result: Shows that the neural network reproduces water table behaviour well enough to support management decisions; specific statistics are not reported in the available record.
44e44dc3a8a78d681fc1d6ab14a20e46aec584ea.open_work: Field validation across sites and soils and coupling with real-time control of drainage structures.
44e44dc3a8a78d681fc1d6ab14a20e46aec584ea.issues: Site-specific training; generalisation to different soils and climates is uncertain.

fdd61f0ac960b305630adc33e9dff86e7cf26d90.goal: Inverts ocean acoustic tomography measurements to recover the ocean sound-speed structure, a nonlinear inverse problem.
fdd61f0ac960b305630adc33e9dff86e7cf26d90.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (multilayered neural network) trained to map acoustic observables to parameters of the sound-speed field.
fdd61f0ac960b305630adc33e9dff86e7cf26d90.data: Simulated acoustic tomography data generated from ocean sound-speed profiles with an acoustic propagation model; details are not reported in the available record.
fdd61f0ac960b305630adc33e9dff86e7cf26d90.result: Shows that multilayer networks can perform the tomographic inversion efficiently and with accuracy comparable to classical inversion; numbers not reported in the available record.
fdd61f0ac960b305630adc33e9dff86e7cf26d90.open_work: Application to real tomography experiments and handling of measurement noise and range-dependent environments.
fdd61f0ac960b305630adc33e9dff86e7cf26d90.issues: Likely trained and tested on simulations; performance on real ocean data and outside the training distribution is uncertain.

d1358407f69e0a7b29ba079163ee901569c8b126.goal: Classifies meteorological features in satellite imagery by fusing multiple data channels with neural networks.
d1358407f69e0a7b29ba079163ee901569c8b126.architecture: Neural network data fusion classifier combining multiple satellite image inputs; detailed architecture is not reported in the available record.
d1358407f69e0a7b29ba079163ee901569c8b126.data: Meteorological satellite imagery with multiple channels; specific satellite and labelled samples are not reported in the available record.

d1358407f69e0a7b29ba079163ee901569c8b126.issues: Early study with limited training data and evaluation; dependence on expert labelling.

9b5d794864d5a9ecd2ae5da352e39062fc6b1f12.goal: Forecasts ocean thermal structure ahead of a moving research vessel by mining past examples rather than running a physical model.
9b5d794864d5a9ecd2ae5da352e39062fc6b1f12.architecture: Example-based methods: case-based reasoning combined with a radial basis function neural network that adapts retrieved cases to produce forecasts.
9b5d794864d5a9ecd2ae5da352e39062fc6b1f12.data: Oceanographic temperature measurements recorded along research cruise tracks in the Atlantic; exact cruises and sample sizes are not reported in the available record.
9b5d794864d5a9ecd2ae5da352e39062fc6b1f12.result: Shows the hybrid case-based reasoning and neural network system forecasts water temperature more accurately than the compared statistical and single-method approaches.
9b5d794864d5a9ecd2ae5da352e39062fc6b1f12.open_work: Extending the system to other variables and regions and automating case base maintenance.
9b5d794864d5a9ecd2ae5da352e39062fc6b1f12.issues: Forecasts are short-range and local to the ship track; performance depends on the coverage of past cases.

992c5782b6c15252751ce9908fddd13e9360d31f.goal: Develops a forecasting system for inflow into a dam to support hydropower and reservoir operation.
992c5782b6c15252751ce9908fddd13e9360d31f.architecture: Hybrid of artificial neural networks and fuzzy logic (fuzzy theory) used to forecast dam inflow from rainfall and flow observations.
992c5782b6c15252751ce9908fddd13e9360d31f.data: Observed rainfall and inflow records for Japanese dam catchments; periods and sites not reported in the available record.

992c5782b6c15252751ce9908fddd13e9360d31f.issues: Limited number of flood events; site-specific calibration; no probabilistic output.

b60cc2d16f3b04adea1df4e25c7337395ec5c73f.goal: Extracts nonlinear modes of variability from climate data, which linear principal component analysis cannot represent compactly.
b60cc2d16f3b04adea1df4e25c7337395ec5c73f.architecture: Nonlinear principal component analysis implemented with an autoassociative (bottleneck) neural network, compared with linear PCA/EOF analysis.

b60cc2d16f3b04adea1df4e25c7337395ec5c73f.issues: Autoassociative networks are prone to overfitting and local minima; modes can be hard to interpret.

5932f91c72bdf222f5a080af59f1e69c86db121d.goal: Provides decision support for irrigation and nutrient management of malting barley.
5932f91c72bdf222f5a080af59f1e69c86db121d.architecture: Knowledge-based system (expert system, rule-based) encoding agronomic expertise on water and nutrient management.
5932f91c72bdf222f5a080af59f1e69c86db121d.data: Agronomic knowledge from specialists and crop management literature; this is not a data-driven model, so no training data apply.
5932f91c72bdf222f5a080af59f1e69c86db121d.result: Delivers a working advisory system for barley water and nutrient decisions; field evaluation results not reported in the available record.

5932f91c72bdf222f5a080af59f1e69c86db121d.issues: Rule base reflects specific region and expert opinions; maintaining and updating rules is laborious.

bd1e7a2d36a36d69510ad1fc9165c53549f7adf5.goal: Supports regional avalanche danger forecasting by finding past days with weather and snow conditions similar to the current day.
bd1e7a2d36a36d69510ad1fc9165c53549f7adf5.architecture: K-nearest neighbour (nearest neighbours) analogue method that retrieves the most similar past days and reports their observed avalanche activity.
bd1e7a2d36a36d69510ad1fc9165c53549f7adf5.data: Historical daily weather, snowpack and avalanche occurrence records from Swiss Alpine observation stations; period not reported in the available record.

bd1e7a2d36a36d69510ad1fc9165c53549f7adf5.issues: Analogue method limited by the length and quality of the historical record; rare large avalanche situations have few neighbours.

04d94fc8ca53ecb2f1373e908b9f94ed915558d7.goal: Identifies cloud types or cloud regions in satellite imagery efficiently using evolutionary search.
04d94fc8ca53ecb2f1373e908b9f94ed915558d7.architecture: Genetic algorithm for cloud identification executed on massively parallel computing hardware.

04d94fc8ca53ecb2f1373e908b9f94ed915558d7.issues: Limited evaluation; genetic algorithm results depend on fitness design and parameter tuning.

f8525fc58eaf366337af393d28c7d1225c12a9a0.goal: Automates classification of cloud types from satellite images.

225d004bb1308e52c7515454504b05299b2a5cf5.goal: Simulates runoff hydrographs from rainfall for a Korean catchment with a neural network.
225d004bb1308e52c7515454504b05299b2a5cf5.architecture: Artificial neural network rainfall-runoff model; detailed configuration not reported in the available record.

225d004bb1308e52c7515454504b05299b2a5cf5.issues: Few events and a single catchment; no uncertainty quantification.

aa7ea5d965e3dc38dfab2b4b4e7b681894922c1d.goal: Extracts ocean features from satellite altimeter data, where signals are noisy and sampled along tracks.

aa7ea5d965e3dc38dfab2b4b4e7b681894922c1d.issues: Relies on along-track sampling and filtering choices; validation against in situ data not described in the available record.

986b270f5991be9555b78bbb0fe45251725cd4d1.goal: Forecasts the time variation of inflow rate into a dam for a hydropower plant.
986b270f5991be9555b78bbb0fe45251725cd4d1.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting model for dam inflow; detailed architecture not reported in the available record.

c9a36ae5e1cb418f33f95d656378cb3fccf8e78e.goal: Classifies sea ice types by combining active and passive microwave observations.

92ec4f752d8cd86cec832e8f72bb0b07a10a8fe0.goal: Improves rainfall estimation from meteorological data, which single backpropagation networks handle poorly because of interference between sub-tasks.

7bd0c5c00a4752c408e67bebe32dc2f00717c9b5.goal: Forecasts river water levels up to 3 hours ahead at about 100 flood monitoring sites in Saitama prefecture, Japan.

7bd0c5c00a4752c408e67bebe32dc2f00717c9b5.issues: Accuracy degrades with lead time because of precipitation forecast errors; no uncertainty estimates.

ff2aa9ba59c89fb620f3f3a1d51a68381475c7bb.goal: Recognises the content of weather charts automatically so that chart information can be processed by computer.

d21e5b2f73b1430d8622cf3af3b2bf648cea0731.goal: Develops a sea ice flag for NSCAT scatterometer data so that wind retrievals over ice-covered areas can be excluded.

d21e5b2f73b1430d8622cf3af3b2bf648cea0731.issues: Short NSCAT mission limits training data; ambiguity near ice edges.

7e3ce6d42dc7a1f037dd7bdb9881d574a40f4e4f.goal: Retrieves consistent ocean surface wind fields from scatterometer data while handling the directional ambiguities of local inversions.
7e3ce6d42dc7a1f037dd7bdb9881d574a40f4e4f.architecture: Bayesian framework combining neural network local models of the scatterometer inverse problem (mixture density networks) with a Gaussian process prior on wind fields.

7e3ce6d42dc7a1f037dd7bdb9881d574a40f4e4f.issues: Multimodal posteriors are hard to explore; training winds from NWP introduce model biases.

f50c9af5b45d2a19e373290e5c6b819ba8fa3bd6.goal: Investigates climate sensitivity by using neural networks to analyse relationships between climate variables or forcings and responses.

f50c9af5b45d2a19e373290e5c6b819ba8fa3bd6.issues: Neural network sensitivities may reflect statistical associations rather than causal physical responses.

2ae0097081a45ec20633eec74e3400c654ceb1d0.goal: Analyses cloud types and their spatial distribution over the Upper Rhine Valley.

d46b138c588d2a00ff959e39bb150b504f1f96e8.architecture: Benchmark evaluation of six systems: three expert systems, a linear model augmented by a small expert system, an analogue-based system, and a judgment analysis system.

d46b138c588d2a00ff959e39bb150b504f1f96e8.open_work: Larger evaluations and combining the strengths of different knowledge-based approaches.
d46b138c588d2a00ff959e39bb150b504f1f96e8.issues: One season and region; limited number of severe events; verification relies on observer reports.

023f9be278540377fae6ffb49a02b9729888268f.goal: Forecasts water levels (Wasserstandsvorhersage) with neural networks, as a data-driven alternative or complement to conventional water-level prediction methods.
023f9be278540377fae6ffb49a02b9729888268f.architecture: Artificial neural network; the specific network type, inputs and training scheme are not reported in the available metadata.
023f9be278540377fae6ffb49a02b9729888268f.data: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies observed water-level time series, but the gauges, region and period are unknown.
023f9be278540377fae6ffb49a02b9729888268f.result: Not reported in the abstract; no quantitative skill is available from the metadata.
023f9be278540377fae6ffb49a02b9729888268f.open_work: Comparison against operational hydrodynamic or statistical forecasts and extension to longer lead times and extreme water levels would follow naturally.
023f9be278540377fae6ffb49a02b9729888268f.issues: German-language report with no abstract; data, lead times and evaluation are unknown, and early neural networks of this era were typically small and trained on limited records.

b67c2a380ef32bc830f004e2fedeedc7cd5e03c4.goal: Predicts minimum air temperature in an agricultural area with artificial neural networks, motivated by frost warning and crop protection.
b67c2a380ef32bc830f004e2fedeedc7cd5e03c4.architecture: Artificial neural network; the network type is not specified in the available metadata.
b67c2a380ef32bc830f004e2fedeedc7cd5e03c4.data: Not reported in the abstract; presumably local meteorological station observations from the agricultural area, but the site and period are unknown.
b67c2a380ef32bc830f004e2fedeedc7cd5e03c4.open_work: Testing at other sites and seasons and comparing with statistical frost-forecast methods would follow naturally.
b67c2a380ef32bc830f004e2fedeedc7cd5e03c4.issues: No abstract available; network design, data volume and evaluation are unknown, and results from a single area may not generalise.

3b46373e1f0eafbb3317aa8ec1f6652f50f4523f.goal: Supports reservoir operation decisions with an expert system that encodes operating rules and operator knowledge.
3b46373e1f0eafbb3317aa8ec1f6652f50f4523f.architecture: Expert system (rule-based knowledge base with inference engine); details of the rules and reasoning scheme are not reported in the available metadata.
3b46373e1f0eafbb3317aa8ec1f6652f50f4523f.data: Not reported in the abstract; the reservoir system, inflow records and operating constraints used are unknown.
3b46373e1f0eafbb3317aa8ec1f6652f50f4523f.open_work: Integration with inflow forecasts and optimization models and testing on other reservoir systems would follow naturally.
3b46373e1f0eafbb3317aa8ec1f6652f50f4523f.issues: No abstract available; rule-based systems depend on elicited expert knowledge and are hard to validate or transfer, and performance relative to optimization methods is unknown.

2283f4e94bbd2a31ac30126e3cbde5f2ba892b29.goal: Improves automated classification of sea ice in summer marginal ice zone imagery by exploiting temporal information from image sequences, since summer melt makes single-scene ice types ambiguous.
2283f4e94bbd2a31ac30126e3cbde5f2ba892b29.architecture: Automated image classification using temporal information across scenes; the classifier type (the authors' related work uses knowledge-based, rule-driven classification) is not reported in the available metadata.
2283f4e94bbd2a31ac30126e3cbde5f2ba892b29.data: Not reported in the abstract; satellite imagery of the summer marginal ice zone, most likely synthetic aperture radar, with sensor and region unconfirmed.
2283f4e94bbd2a31ac30126e3cbde5f2ba892b29.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies temporal information improves classification of summer ice conditions.
2283f4e94bbd2a31ac30126e3cbde5f2ba892b29.open_work: Extending the approach to other seasons and regions and validating against ice charts or in situ observations would follow naturally.
2283f4e94bbd2a31ac30126e3cbde5f2ba892b29.issues: No abstract available; accuracy figures, sensor and validation data are unknown, and dependence on repeat coverage limits applicability.

a21d9f09e4873b325cf7886daaeee27130cdec65.goal: Couples the SOYGRO soybean crop growth model with the DRAINMOD field water management model through an expert system, to evaluate drainage and water management effects on crop yield.
a21d9f09e4873b325cf7886daaeee27130cdec65.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) used as the coupling and decision framework linking two process-based simulation models (SOYGRO and DRAINMOD).
a21d9f09e4873b325cf7886daaeee27130cdec65.data: Not reported in the abstract; inputs would include weather, soil and management data required by SOYGRO and DRAINMOD, but sites and periods are unknown.
a21d9f09e4873b325cf7886daaeee27130cdec65.open_work: Field validation of the coupled system and extension to other crops and water management practices would follow naturally.
a21d9f09e4873b325cf7886daaeee27130cdec65.issues: No abstract available; coupled-model accuracy depends on both process models and their calibration, and validation details are unknown.

3f10baea4301154dfdaed0e65c4acbb1cf3f9c28.goal: Predicts rainfall in real time from weather radar data, combining a neural network with a genetic algorithm to improve short-term rainfall forecasting.
3f10baea4301154dfdaed0e65c4acbb1cf3f9c28.architecture: Artificial neural network combined with a genetic algorithm; the configuration is not specified in the available metadata.
3f10baea4301154dfdaed0e65c4acbb1cf3f9c28.data: Weather radar rainfall observations; the radar, region, period and lead times are not reported in the available metadata.
3f10baea4301154dfdaed0e65c4acbb1cf3f9c28.open_work: Comparison with extrapolation-based nowcasting and testing on more storm events and longer lead times would follow naturally.
3f10baea4301154dfdaed0e65c4acbb1cf3f9c28.issues: No abstract available; event sample size, lead times and verification scores are unknown, and radar rainfall estimation errors propagate into forecasts.

9957817bf8ee72a72768cb4303ddcfc9ed1227b6.goal: Reviews and critically evaluates the use of artificial neural networks for short-term electric load forecasting, where weather drives much of the demand variability.
9957817bf8ee72a72768cb4303ddcfc9ed1227b6.architecture: Review of neural network load-forecasting studies, mostly multilayer perceptron (MLP) models, examining their design, implementation and validation practices.
9957817bf8ee72a72768cb4303ddcfc9ed1227b6.data: Published studies from the 1990s on neural network short-term load forecasting; no new dataset.
9957817bf8ee72a72768cb4303ddcfc9ed1227b6.result: Finds that many reviewed MLP models are heavily overparameterized and tested in ways that leave their advantage over standard methods unconvincing, while noting promising results.
9957817bf8ee72a72768cb4303ddcfc9ed1227b6.open_work: Calls for more rigorous, standardized testing against benchmark methods and better control of model complexity.
9957817bf8ee72a72768cb4303ddcfc9ed1227b6.issues: Literature-based assessment; conclusions reflect the quality of the reviewed studies and predate modern deep learning.

998008ee20402f68ebd9041989e156b3bbef143a.goal: Surveys methods for optimizing the operation of multireservoir water systems, a problem complicated by nonlinearity, stochastic inflows and multiple objectives.
998008ee20402f68ebd9041989e156b3bbef143a.architecture: Review of reservoir optimization methods: linear, nonlinear and dynamic programming, simulation-optimization, and heuristic approaches such as genetic algorithms, artificial neural networks and fuzzy rule-based systems.
998008ee20402f68ebd9041989e156b3bbef143a.data: Published studies and applications of multireservoir operation; no new dataset.
998008ee20402f68ebd9041989e156b3bbef143a.result: Concludes that despite many methods, real-world adoption of optimization models by reservoir operators remains limited; heuristic and AI methods are promising for implicit operating rules.
998008ee20402f68ebd9041989e156b3bbef143a.open_work: Bridging the gap between research optimization models and operational practice, including decision support systems.
998008ee20402f68ebd9041989e156b3bbef143a.issues: Review; quantitative comparison across methods is not provided.

4d53d8e239d02cf85ad8581b9163058ac296f751.goal: Evaluates the PERSIANN satellite rainfall estimation system over the tropics to assess the accuracy of neural-network-based precipitation estimates.
4d53d8e239d02cf85ad8581b9163058ac296f751.architecture: PERSIANN neural network (modified counterpropagation network with a self-organizing feature map layer) mapping geostationary infrared brightness temperatures to rain rate, adaptively updated with microwave rainfall.
4d53d8e239d02cf85ad8581b9163058ac296f751.data: Geostationary infrared imagery with TRMM microwave rainfall for adjustment; validation against TRMM products, radar and rain-gauge observations in the tropics.
4d53d8e239d02cf85ad8581b9163058ac296f751.result: PERSIANN estimates agree reasonably with independent observations, with accuracy improving at coarser space and time aggregation.
4d53d8e239d02cf85ad8581b9163058ac296f751.open_work: Improving fine-scale accuracy and extending evaluation to other regions and seasons.
4d53d8e239d02cf85ad8581b9163058ac296f751.issues: Infrared-based estimates relate only indirectly to surface rain; detailed error statistics are not given here.

eb3f6bbb68aa039d6b9e33e91f8ba9882749e21c.goal: Produces high-quality gridded climate maps over complex terrain by encoding expert knowledge of how climate varies with physiography.
eb3f6bbb68aa039d6b9e33e91f8ba9882749e21c.architecture: Non-ML knowledge-based statistical method (PRISM): local climate-elevation regression with station weights for distance, elevation, coastal proximity, topographic facet and atmospheric layer.
eb3f6bbb68aa039d6b9e33e91f8ba9882749e21c.data: Station climate observations and digital elevation models, primarily for the United States.
eb3f6bbb68aa039d6b9e33e91f8ba9882749e21c.result: PRISM produces detailed climate maps that capture orographic and coastal effects better than simpler interpolation approaches.
eb3f6bbb68aa039d6b9e33e91f8ba9882749e21c.open_work: Refining the knowledge base and weighting schemes and extending to other regions and variables.
eb3f6bbb68aa039d6b9e33e91f8ba9882749e21c.issues: Not a machine learning method; relies on expert-set parameters and station density.

af8d474288595d6bb7b1b90e530c16ca17d647c8.goal: Reviews methods for detecting marine oil spills from satellite remote sensing, important for environmental monitoring and enforcement.
af8d474288595d6bb7b1b90e530c16ca17d647c8.architecture: Review of oil spill detection: dark-spot segmentation, feature extraction and classification (statistical classifiers and neural networks) applied mainly to SAR imagery.
af8d474288595d6bb7b1b90e530c16ca17d647c8.data: Spaceborne SAR (e.g. ERS, RADARSAT, ENVISAT ASAR) and optical sensors as discussed in the literature.
af8d474288595d6bb7b1b90e530c16ca17d647c8.result: Summarizes the state of automatic and semi-automatic SAR oil spill detection and the difficulty of separating oil from look-alikes.
af8d474288595d6bb7b1b90e530c16ca17d647c8.open_work: Better discrimination of look-alikes, use of wind information and operational integration.

1ca1b47bef84aad4680f48a4d8748e93a3cf13ef.goal: Reviews applications of artificial neural networks across hydrology to assess their usefulness for hydrologic modelling.
1ca1b47bef84aad4680f48a4d8748e93a3cf13ef.architecture: Review of artificial neural network applications, mainly feedforward multilayer perceptrons, in rainfall-runoff, streamflow, groundwater, water quality and precipitation estimation.
1ca1b47bef84aad4680f48a4d8748e93a3cf13ef.data: Published hydrologic ANN studies; no new dataset.
1ca1b47bef84aad4680f48a4d8748e93a3cf13ef.result: Concludes that ANNs are useful hydrologic modelling tools, often matching or exceeding conventional methods, though not a substitute for physical understanding.
1ca1b47bef84aad4680f48a4d8748e93a3cf13ef.open_work: Better physical interpretability, guidelines for network design and training, and handling of extrapolation.
1ca1b47bef84aad4680f48a4d8748e93a3cf13ef.issues: Review from the ASCE task committee; early-era methods and limited quantitative synthesis.

441616a66e57fde2a23db3c9b15f49c4cb9ac1d8.goal: Reviews the use of artificial neural networks in hydrological modelling, especially rainfall-runoff and flow forecasting.
441616a66e57fde2a23db3c9b15f49c4cb9ac1d8.architecture: Review of artificial neural networks in hydrology, mainly multilayer perceptrons trained by backpropagation and radial basis function networks, including data preprocessing and model selection.
441616a66e57fde2a23db3c9b15f49c4cb9ac1d8.data: Published hydrological ANN studies; no new dataset.
441616a66e57fde2a23db3c9b15f49c4cb9ac1d8.result: Finds ANNs perform well but notes a lack of standard protocols for model development and evaluation.
441616a66e57fde2a23db3c9b15f49c4cb9ac1d8.open_work: Calls for consistent development protocols, physical interpretation and comparison with conventional models.
441616a66e57fde2a23db3c9b15f49c4cb9ac1d8.issues: Review; quantitative comparison across studies is limited.

bcf1ee46b898bfa4d0f4eca0e1bc5fd723d4bb84.goal: Predicts daily wind speed for wind energy assessment and compares support vector machines with neural networks.
bcf1ee46b898bfa4d0f4eca0e1bc5fd723d4bb84.architecture: Support vector machine regression compared with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network.
bcf1ee46b898bfa4d0f4eca0e1bc5fd723d4bb84.data: Daily mean wind speed records from a station in Madinah, Saudi Arabia.
bcf1ee46b898bfa4d0f4eca0e1bc5fd723d4bb84.result: The SVM gives lower mean squared error than the MLP across the tested model orders.
bcf1ee46b898bfa4d0f4eca0e1bc5fd723d4bb84.open_work: Testing at more sites, longer horizons and with additional meteorological predictors.
bcf1ee46b898bfa4d0f4eca0e1bc5fd723d4bb84.issues: Single site, univariate inputs and short-horizon evaluation.

54660311a46976720bf05fc113776a14cbe5a0b5.goal: Forecasts daily maximum electric load for the next 31 days (EUNITE 2001 competition) using climate and past load information.
54660311a46976720bf05fc113776a14cbe5a0b5.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector regression) model, the winning entry of the competition, with time-series style inputs.
54660311a46976720bf05fc113776a14cbe5a0b5.data: EUNITE 2001 competition data: past electricity load, temperature and calendar information.
54660311a46976720bf05fc113776a14cbe5a0b5.result: SVM won the competition; temperature or other climate information may not help mid-term load forecasting, while time-series concepts improve forecasts.
54660311a46976720bf05fc113776a14cbe5a0b5.open_work: Further study of input selection and time-series formulations for mid-term load forecasting.
54660311a46976720bf05fc113776a14cbe5a0b5.issues: Single competition dataset; conclusions about climate inputs may not generalize to other regions.

9d7ed0b159828069933102a575554abff16fe2fe.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels with artificial neural networks to support aquifer management under declining water tables.
9d7ed0b159828069933102a575554abff16fe2fe.architecture: Comparison of several neural network types, including feedforward multilayer perceptrons with different training algorithms, Elman recurrent and radial basis function networks.
9d7ed0b159828069933102a575554abff16fe2fe.data: Monthly groundwater level, precipitation, temperature and streamflow data from the Messara Valley, Crete, Greece.
9d7ed0b159828069933102a575554abff16fe2fe.result: A feedforward network trained with Levenberg-Marquardt gives the most accurate forecasts, up to about 18 months ahead.
9d7ed0b159828069933102a575554abff16fe2fe.open_work: Extending to other aquifers and including pumping data.
9d7ed0b159828069933102a575554abff16fe2fe.issues: Single aquifer, limited data length and no uncertainty quantification.

38bf65cfb44796dd9cabb479836f2f87aaf706c8.goal: Models hydrological time series (river flow) with a neuro-fuzzy approach for better forecasting.
38bf65cfb44796dd9cabb479836f2f87aaf706c8.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) compared with artificial neural network and ARMA models.
38bf65cfb44796dd9cabb479836f2f87aaf706c8.data: River flow series from the Baitarani River basin, India.
38bf65cfb44796dd9cabb479836f2f87aaf706c8.result: ANFIS preserves flow statistics and performs comparably to or better than ANN and ARMA models.
38bf65cfb44796dd9cabb479836f2f87aaf706c8.open_work: Applications to other basins and longer lead times.

cee00738001467792bf02eebeb8e12f494b1d9d4.goal: Introduces self-organizing maps as a tool for synoptic climatology, i.e. classifying atmospheric circulation patterns.
cee00738001467792bf02eebeb8e12f494b1d9d4.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) neural network used for unsupervised classification of synoptic circulation fields.
cee00738001467792bf02eebeb8e12f494b1d9d4.data: Gridded circulation fields such as sea level pressure from reanalysis, with example applications to regional climate.
cee00738001467792bf02eebeb8e12f494b1d9d4.result: SOMs give a continuum of synoptic states that captures circulation variability and links to surface climate more flexibly than discrete classifications.
cee00738001467792bf02eebeb8e12f494b1d9d4.open_work: Use of SOMs for downscaling and for evaluating climate model circulation.
cee00738001467792bf02eebeb8e12f494b1d9d4.issues: Results depend on SOM size and training choices; exact datasets and periods are not reported here.

49547770de194de78bf43c60a8e7a729e83e1fc2.goal: Compares time series methods for forecasting solar radiation at high temporal resolutions for solar power applications.
49547770de194de78bf43c60a8e7a729e83e1fc2.architecture: Comparison of regressions in logs, ARIMA, unobserved components, transfer functions, neural networks and hybrid models.
49547770de194de78bf43c60a8e7a729e83e1fc2.data: Several solar radiation datasets at resolutions of minutes to an hour.
49547770de194de78bf43c60a8e7a729e83e1fc2.result: ARIMA models in logs generally perform best, with neural networks and hybrids not consistently superior.
49547770de194de78bf43c60a8e7a729e83e1fc2.open_work: Including cloud and meteorological information and longer horizons.
49547770de194de78bf43c60a8e7a729e83e1fc2.issues: Purely statistical, short horizons; results depend on site and resolution.

7fa3a40a05d4cc76932f04b5e27d3a6a6e502f90.goal: Forecasts building energy consumption and compares a detailed physical simulation with a neural network.
7fa3a40a05d4cc76932f04b5e27d3a6a6e502f90.architecture: Detailed building simulation (EnergyPlus) compared with a feedforward artificial neural network.
7fa3a40a05d4cc76932f04b5e27d3a6a6e502f90.data: Measured energy consumption and climate data for an administration building at the University of São Paulo, Brazil.
7fa3a40a05d4cc76932f04b5e27d3a6a6e502f90.result: Both approaches forecast consumption with comparable accuracy; the ANN is simpler to set up while the simulation offers physical insight.
7fa3a40a05d4cc76932f04b5e27d3a6a6e502f90.open_work: Testing on other building types and climates.
7fa3a40a05d4cc76932f04b5e27d3a6a6e502f90.issues: Single building; detailed error figures not given here.

4f203c7d26e9991f880932e9a455babc1c84e21d.goal: Forecasts wind farm power output from meteorological predictions using statistical and artificial intelligence techniques.
4f203c7d26e9991f880932e9a455babc1c84e21d.architecture: Statistical method combining artificial intelligence components; the specific neural network type is not specified here.
4f203c7d26e9991f880932e9a455babc1c84e21d.data: Numerical weather prediction forecasts of wind speed and direction with measured wind farm power.
4f203c7d26e9991f880932e9a455babc1c84e21d.result: The method improves over persistence and simpler statistical models in the reported tests.
4f203c7d26e9991f880932e9a455babc1c84e21d.open_work: Extension to more farms and probabilistic forecasting.
4f203c7d26e9991f880932e9a455babc1c84e21d.issues: Details of horizons, sites and error statistics are not reported here.

82a58024ba90d38ae348bead0b35c8f92a4ad999.goal: Forecasts daily reservoir inflow with neural networks while avoiding overfitting.
82a58024ba90d38ae348bead0b35c8f92a4ad999.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network trained with early stopping (stopped training).
82a58024ba90d38ae348bead0b35c8f92a4ad999.data: Daily inflow and meteorological data for a hydropower reservoir in Quebec, Canada.
82a58024ba90d38ae348bead0b35c8f92a4ad999.result: Stopped training improves generalization and gives accurate short-range inflow forecasts.
82a58024ba90d38ae348bead0b35c8f92a4ad999.open_work: Comparing with other regularization methods and longer lead times.

94b295e711ec744583597432c19749a5cd61038e.goal: Develops multicategory support vector machines and applies them to classification problems including satellite radiance data.
94b295e711ec744583597432c19749a5cd61038e.architecture: Multicategory support vector machine (SVM) theory and algorithms, with tuning methods.
94b295e711ec744583597432c19749a5cd61038e.data: Microarray gene expression data and satellite radiance data (MODIS) for cloud classification.
94b295e711ec744583597432c19749a5cd61038e.result: The multicategory SVM performs well and handles multiple classes in a single framework.
94b295e711ec744583597432c19749a5cd61038e.open_work: Feature selection and extensions to nonstandard settings.
94b295e711ec744583597432c19749a5cd61038e.issues: Thesis-style preprint; atmospheric results limited to one cloud classification application.

fa4e73d8fef3bd1f40a3cf101ef97dcff25a8eba.goal: Forecasts river flood stage in real time for flood warning.
fa4e73d8fef3bd1f40a3cf101ef97dcff25a8eba.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) with systematic parameter calibration.
fa4e73d8fef3bd1f40a3cf101ef97dcff25a8eba.data: Hourly stage and rainfall data from typhoon events in the Lan-Yang River basin, Taiwan.
fa4e73d8fef3bd1f40a3cf101ef97dcff25a8eba.result: SVR gives accurate flood stage forecasts for lead times of 1–6 hours.
fa4e73d8fef3bd1f40a3cf101ef97dcff25a8eba.open_work: Longer lead times and use of rainfall forecasts.
fa4e73d8fef3bd1f40a3cf101ef97dcff25a8eba.issues: Limited number of events; single basin.

c9f0c25a69bd0dbe6b15dc5713d6f490b8a10771.goal: Forecasts long-term (up to about 72 h) wind speed and power at a wind park using meteorological predictions.
c9f0c25a69bd0dbe6b15dc5713d6f490b8a10771.architecture: Local recurrent neural networks (multilayer perceptrons with internal feedback, IIR and lattice synapses) trained with recursive prediction-error algorithms.
c9f0c25a69bd0dbe6b15dc5713d6f490b8a10771.data: Numerical weather prediction forecasts at nearby nodes and measured wind speed and power at a wind park in Greece.
c9f0c25a69bd0dbe6b15dc5713d6f490b8a10771.result: Local recurrent networks outperform static networks and persistence for long-range wind forecasts.
c9f0c25a69bd0dbe6b15dc5713d6f490b8a10771.open_work: Extension to more wind parks and probabilistic forecasting.
c9f0c25a69bd0dbe6b15dc5713d6f490b8a10771.issues: Single site; dependence on NWP quality.

9e257a6cf55d0a51f67105019cc118f3bc64bd88.goal: Reviews methods for selecting inputs to neural network models in water resources, an often neglected step.
9e257a6cf55d0a51f67105019cc118f3bc64bd88.architecture: Review and methodology for input determination: model-based and model-free approaches, including partial mutual information, self-organizing maps and genetic algorithm-general regression neural network.
9e257a6cf55d0a51f67105019cc118f3bc64bd88.data: Synthetic and literature-based examples; applications appear in Part 2.
9e257a6cf55d0a51f67105019cc118f3bc64bd88.result: Highlights shortcomings of ad hoc input selection and presents methods that handle nonlinear dependence and redundancy.
9e257a6cf55d0a51f67105019cc118f3bc64bd88.open_work: Testing the methods on real case studies, as done in the companion paper.
9e257a6cf55d0a51f67105019cc118f3bc64bd88.issues: Methodological; quantitative performance is in the companion paper.

566278b7c98ffffa240acfb0c60a6b4889b629af.goal: Retrieves water constituents from MERIS reflectances in optically complex coastal (Case 2) waters.
566278b7c98ffffa240acfb0c60a6b4889b629af.architecture: Inverse multilayer perceptron neural networks trained on radiative transfer simulations, with a forward network to check out-of-scope spectra.
566278b7c98ffffa240acfb0c60a6b4889b629af.data: Bio-optical radiative transfer simulations of water-leaving reflectance; Envisat MERIS observations.
566278b7c98ffffa240acfb0c60a6b4889b629af.result: The algorithm retrieves absorption and scattering coefficients and derived chlorophyll, suspended matter and yellow substance concentrations as an operational MERIS product.
566278b7c98ffffa240acfb0c60a6b4889b629af.open_work: Validation with in situ data and regional adaptation of the bio-optical model.
566278b7c98ffffa240acfb0c60a6b4889b629af.issues: Accuracy depends on the assumed bio-optical model and atmospheric correction.

e9fcbaecadd9a294f4e51522dc6d16de869eb5d7.goal: Compares short-term rainfall prediction models as inputs to real-time flood forecasting.
e9fcbaecadd9a294f4e51522dc6d16de869eb5d7.architecture: Comparison of ARMA models, artificial neural networks and k-nearest neighbour methods for rainfall prediction, fed to a rainfall-runoff model.
e9fcbaecadd9a294f4e51522dc6d16de869eb5d7.data: Rainfall and flow data from the Sieve River basin, Italy.
e9fcbaecadd9a294f4e51522dc6d16de869eb5d7.result: Neural networks give the best improvement in flood forecasts relative to no rainfall prediction.
e9fcbaecadd9a294f4e51522dc6d16de869eb5d7.open_work: Using radar or NWP information for rainfall prediction.
e9fcbaecadd9a294f4e51522dc6d16de869eb5d7.issues: Single basin; univariate rainfall histories only.

8d4266312df25f2acda0cd05a868e9137c89867a.goal: Predicts wind speed and wind park power from upwind measurements using spatial correlation.
8d4266312df25f2acda0cd05a868e9137c89867a.architecture: Fuzzy model trained with a genetic algorithm.
8d4266312df25f2acda0cd05a868e9137c89867a.data: Wind speed and direction measurements from multiple stations around wind parks in Greece.
8d4266312df25f2acda0cd05a868e9137c89867a.result: The fuzzy model outperforms persistence for horizons from about 30 minutes to a few hours.
8d4266312df25f2acda0cd05a868e9137c89867a.open_work: Extending to longer horizons with NWP inputs.
8d4266312df25f2acda0cd05a868e9137c89867a.issues: Depends on station network layout; site-specific.

5192a72c342d14d711960ca498766e23cf863c27.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from climate variables with a neural network.
5192a72c342d14d711960ca498766e23cf863c27.architecture: Feedforward multilayer perceptron neural network trained by backpropagation.
5192a72c342d14d711960ca498766e23cf863c27.data: Daily climate data (CIMIS station, Davis, California) with lysimeter or Penman-Monteith reference values.
5192a72c342d14d711960ca498766e23cf863c27.result: The ANN estimates evapotranspiration more accurately than conventional empirical methods.
5192a72c342d14d711960ca498766e23cf863c27.open_work: Testing with fewer inputs and in other climates.

b521a77b56b7a9aaf47b897098f17fcac2aa17d2.goal: Predicts next-day ozone concentrations for air quality forecasting.
b521a77b56b7a9aaf47b897098f17fcac2aa17d2.architecture: Multiple linear regression and feedforward neural network (MLP) models using principal components as inputs.
b521a77b56b7a9aaf47b897098f17fcac2aa17d2.data: Hourly ozone, other pollutant and meteorological measurements from Oporto, Portugal.
b521a77b56b7a9aaf47b897098f17fcac2aa17d2.result: Principal-component-based feedforward neural networks give the best ozone predictions.
b521a77b56b7a9aaf47b897098f17fcac2aa17d2.open_work: Other sites and pollutants; longer horizons.
b521a77b56b7a9aaf47b897098f17fcac2aa17d2.issues: Single urban area; statistical models without chemistry.

609037d3e70acc7e5b01bfb85cc2f3a9a5a7f414.goal: Downscales GCM precipitation projections over South Africa to assess consensus in regional climate change.
609037d3e70acc7e5b01bfb85cc2f3a9a5a7f414.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) based empirical downscaling of precipitation from large-scale circulation and humidity.
609037d3e70acc7e5b01bfb85cc2f3a9a5a7f414.data: NCEP reanalysis and multiple GCM simulations; station precipitation over South Africa.
609037d3e70acc7e5b01bfb85cc2f3a9a5a7f414.result: Downscaled projections from different GCMs show more consensus than raw GCM precipitation, with robust regional change patterns.
609037d3e70acc7e5b01bfb85cc2f3a9a5a7f414.open_work: More GCMs and variables; assessment of stationarity.
609037d3e70acc7e5b01bfb85cc2f3a9a5a7f414.issues: Assumes statistical relationships remain stationary under climate change.

38e99613ac1648285e754769fe17fef28237890f.goal: Describes a hydrometeor classification algorithm for the polarimetric WSR-88D radar network.
38e99613ac1648285e754769fe17fef28237890f.architecture: Fuzzy logic classification of radar echoes into hydrometeor and non-meteorological classes.
38e99613ac1648285e754769fe17fef28237890f.data: Polarimetric radar data (KOUN, Oklahoma) for a mesoscale convective system.
38e99613ac1648285e754769fe17fef28237890f.result: The algorithm discriminates about ten classes and produces plausible microphysical structure for the MCS.
38e99613ac1648285e754769fe17fef28237890f.open_work: Validation against in situ observations and operational implementation.
38e99613ac1648285e754769fe17fef28237890f.issues: Membership functions are prescribed; limited verification.

c51c48bdbcc93c6f9547cefdbca1a5f892fca742.goal: Improves electricity load forecasting by using ensemble weather forecasts as inputs.
c51c48bdbcc93c6f9547cefdbca1a5f892fca742.architecture: Neural network (MLP) load model fed with ensemble weather predictions.
c51c48bdbcc93c6f9547cefdbca1a5f892fca742.data: ECMWF ensemble forecasts and load data for England and Wales.
c51c48bdbcc93c6f9547cefdbca1a5f892fca742.result: Using the ensemble mean improves load forecasts over a single forecast, and the ensemble provides load forecast uncertainty up to about 10 days.
c51c48bdbcc93c6f9547cefdbca1a5f892fca742.issues: Single power system; ensemble spread may be underdispersive.

0f529dc2b2b2bad22394454d4cba79e2c319f0b0.goal: Predicts burned area of forest fires from meteorological data to support firefighting resource management.
0f529dc2b2b2bad22394454d4cba79e2c319f0b0.architecture: Comparison of five data mining techniques including support vector machines (SVM), random forest, neural network, decision tree and multiple regression.
0f529dc2b2b2bad22394454d4cba79e2c319f0b0.data: Real-world fire and weather data from the Montesinho natural park, northeast Portugal.
0f529dc2b2b2bad22394454d4cba79e2c319f0b0.result: SVM with temperature, relative humidity, rain and wind gives the best configuration, predicting small fires well.
0f529dc2b2b2bad22394454d4cba79e2c319f0b0.open_work: Better prediction of large, rare fires.
0f529dc2b2b2bad22394454d4cba79e2c319f0b0.issues: Small dataset; large fires poorly predicted.

987a0c3eb495f712e3ec493631b9ff07a95b4113.goal: Improves hydrologic time series forecasting by combining conventional time series models with neural networks to capture both linear and nonlinear components of streamflow.
987a0c3eb495f712e3ec493631b9ff07a95b4113.architecture: Hybrid models combining conventional linear time series (autoregressive-type) models with artificial neural networks, compared with standalone versions.
987a0c3eb495f712e3ec493631b9ff07a95b4113.data: Monthly streamflow time series (Colorado River, USA).
987a0c3eb495f712e3ec493631b9ff07a95b4113.result: Hybrid models that let the neural network model the residual nonlinear part outperform standalone conventional and neural network models.
987a0c3eb495f712e3ec493631b9ff07a95b4113.open_work: Testing on other rivers, time scales and forecast horizons.
987a0c3eb495f712e3ec493631b9ff07a95b4113.issues: Few series tested; error statistics and uncertainty are not detailed here.

8c71370067992aee5a7f2906c8dc65b2f3162967.goal: Forecasts drought, represented by the Palmer Drought Severity Index, to support water management in a semi-arid basin.
8c71370067992aee5a7f2906c8dc65b2f3162967.architecture: Conjunction model of wavelet transforms (decomposing the index into scales) and artificial neural networks (feedforward MLP), compared with standalone neural networks.
8c71370067992aee5a7f2906c8dc65b2f3162967.data: Palmer Drought Severity Index series for the Conchos River basin, Mexico.
8c71370067992aee5a7f2906c8dc65b2f3162967.result: The wavelet-neural network conjunction model gives better drought forecasts than single neural networks, especially at longer lead times.
8c71370067992aee5a7f2906c8dc65b2f3162967.open_work: Extending to other drought indices, basins and longer lead times.
8c71370067992aee5a7f2906c8dc65b2f3162967.issues: Single basin; wavelet decomposition choices and possible boundary effects can influence results.

e93ef49d8fbd22263042236347d7a006568c5248.goal: Reconstructs Last Glacial Maximum sea surface temperatures from planktonic foraminifera assemblages with consistent, cross-checked statistical techniques.
e93ef49d8fbd22263042236347d7a006568c5248.architecture: Multi-technique transfer-function approach including artificial neural networks, modern analogue technique, revised analogue method and SIMMAX, with geographically constrained calibration sets.
e93ef49d8fbd22263042236347d7a006568c5248.data: Core-top planktonic foraminifera calibration datasets and glacial assemblages from Atlantic and Pacific Ocean sediment cores.
e93ef49d8fbd22263042236347d7a006568c5248.result: The techniques produce broadly consistent glacial SST estimates; combining them with regional calibration improves robustness of the reconstructions.
e93ef49d8fbd22263042236347d7a006568c5248.open_work: Better treatment of no-analogue glacial assemblages and fuller uncertainty quantification.
e93ef49d8fbd22263042236347d7a006568c5248.issues: Reconstructions depend on calibration coverage and assume stable species-temperature relationships.

c8eb5d15c0625b674b141c44537f74ac8c6c78ee.goal: Provides a systematic, data-driven way to choose inputs when building neural network rainfall-runoff models, instead of trial and error.
c8eb5d15c0625b674b141c44537f74ac8c6c78ee.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward MLP) rainfall-runoff model with input selection based on statistical cross-, auto- and partial autocorrelation analysis.
c8eb5d15c0625b674b141c44537f74ac8c6c78ee.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a river basin in India; specific periods not reported here.
c8eb5d15c0625b674b141c44537f74ac8c6c78ee.result: The statistically guided input selection yields parsimonious networks with accurate runoff simulation compared with ad hoc input choices.
c8eb5d15c0625b674b141c44537f74ac8c6c78ee.open_work: Testing in other basins and incorporating nonlinear dependence measures for input selection.
c8eb5d15c0625b674b141c44537f74ac8c6c78ee.issues: Linear correlation measures may miss nonlinear relationships; single case study.

9679af2bee04b7b7f74bc12479a3e7d639154b3c.goal: Improves monthly streamflow prediction by coupling data-driven models with data-preprocessing techniques.
9679af2bee04b7b7f74bc12479a3e7d639154b3c.architecture: Comparison of ARMA, k-nearest neighbour (KNN) and artificial neural network models, coupled with moving average, singular spectrum analysis and wavelet multiresolution preprocessing.
9679af2bee04b7b7f74bc12479a3e7d639154b3c.data: Monthly streamflow series from several catchments in China.
9679af2bee04b7b7f74bc12479a3e7d639154b3c.result: Data preprocessing improves forecasts substantially, with the neural network combined with moving average preprocessing performing best.
9679af2bee04b7b7f74bc12479a3e7d639154b3c.open_work: Assessing other preprocessing methods and the practical lag introduced by smoothing.
9679af2bee04b7b7f74bc12479a3e7d639154b3c.issues: Preprocessing with centred filters can leak future information and introduce lags; limited sites.

5683c47a64984f2cecde98762bdf4553a4a80ed1.goal: Forecasts daily particulate matter (PM10) concentrations in Temuco, Chile, a city with severe wood-smoke pollution, to support air quality episode management.
5683c47a64984f2cecde98762bdf4553a4a80ed1.architecture: Hybrid model combining ARIMA and an artificial neural network, compared with ARIMA, neural network and linear regression alone.
5683c47a64984f2cecde98762bdf4553a4a80ed1.data: Daily PM10 and meteorological observations from Temuco, Chile.
5683c47a64984f2cecde98762bdf4553a4a80ed1.result: The hybrid ARIMA-ANN model forecasts PM10 and exceedance episodes more accurately than the individual models.
5683c47a64984f2cecde98762bdf4553a4a80ed1.open_work: Application to other cities and pollutants, and longer forecast horizons.
5683c47a64984f2cecde98762bdf4553a4a80ed1.issues: Single city and monitoring setup; emissions changes not modelled explicitly.

997844b88e5234a33e8d62f729fed90b65538936.goal: Models and forecasts water table depth fluctuations in an aquifer to support groundwater management in a data-scarce region.
997844b88e5234a33e8d62f729fed90b65538936.architecture: Comparison of input delay neural networks, recurrent neural networks and radial basis function networks.
997844b88e5234a33e8d62f729fed90b65538936.data: Water table depth, precipitation and temperature records from the Gondo aquifer, Burkina Faso.
997844b88e5234a33e8d62f729fed90b65538936.result: Neural networks reproduce water table fluctuations well, with the recurrent network giving the most accurate forecasts.
997844b88e5234a33e8d62f729fed90b65538936.open_work: Testing longer horizons and other aquifers, and including pumping information.
997844b88e5234a33e8d62f729fed90b65538936.issues: Short records from one aquifer; no uncertainty estimates.

fb6274b8c5f78a7052f50159b55c5fcbe4a6f7e2.goal: Tests model trees as an interpretable alternative to neural networks for rainfall-runoff forecasting.
fb6274b8c5f78a7052f50159b55c5fcbe4a6f7e2.architecture: M5 model trees (piecewise linear regression trees) compared with artificial neural networks (MLP).
fb6274b8c5f78a7052f50159b55c5fcbe4a6f7e2.data: Hourly rainfall and discharge data from the Sieve catchment, Italy, with forecasts several hours ahead.
fb6274b8c5f78a7052f50159b55c5fcbe4a6f7e2.result: Model trees achieve accuracy similar to neural networks while being faster to train and more transparent.
fb6274b8c5f78a7052f50159b55c5fcbe4a6f7e2.open_work: Testing on other catchments and longer lead times.
fb6274b8c5f78a7052f50159b55c5fcbe4a6f7e2.issues: Single catchment; performance degrades for longer horizons as for ANNs.

17ad2cc34b6dff3729cdd12ece47b2c83c471a3a.goal: Forecasts hourly solar radiation for solar energy applications using univariate and multivariate artificial intelligence models.
17ad2cc34b6dff3729cdd12ece47b2c83c471a3a.architecture: Artificial intelligence techniques including feedforward neural networks, recurrent neural networks, radial basis function networks and an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system, compared with linear models.
17ad2cc34b6dff3729cdd12ece47b2c83c471a3a.data: Hourly solar radiation series, with additional meteorological variables in the multivariate case; site details not reported here.
17ad2cc34b6dff3729cdd12ece47b2c83c471a3a.result: Artificial intelligence models outperform conventional linear forecasting, and adding meteorological variables further improves accuracy.
17ad2cc34b6dff3729cdd12ece47b2c83c471a3a.open_work: Testing at other sites and longer horizons.
17ad2cc34b6dff3729cdd12ece47b2c83c471a3a.issues: Single dataset; exact error figures not reported here.

a9331e956b2caff53a085e34669dbf8ac3de3883.goal: Classifies hydrometeor types from polarimetric radar measurements and verifies the classification with in situ observations.
a9331e956b2caff53a085e34669dbf8ac3de3883.architecture: Fuzzy logic classification system and a neuro-fuzzy system (a neural network trained to tune fuzzy membership functions).
a9331e956b2caff53a085e34669dbf8ac3de3883.data: Polarimetric radar observations from the CSU-CHILL radar, with in situ aircraft observations for verification.
a9331e956b2caff53a085e34669dbf8ac3de3883.result: The fuzzy and neuro-fuzzy classifiers produce hydrometeor classes consistent with in situ observations.
a9331e956b2caff53a085e34669dbf8ac3de3883.open_work: More extensive verification datasets and adaptation to other radars and climates.
a9331e956b2caff53a085e34669dbf8ac3de3883.issues: Limited verification cases; membership functions depend on radar frequency and calibration.

ff4c17c713de7c9aa84c963569e2a6bad0d46f68.goal: Compares forecasting techniques for mean hourly wind speed, relevant to wind power integration.
ff4c17c713de7c9aa84c963569e2a6bad0d46f68.architecture: Comparison of linear time series models (e.g. ARIMA) with artificial intelligence methods including feedforward and recurrent neural networks, radial basis function networks and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference systems.
ff4c17c713de7c9aa84c963569e2a6bad0d46f68.data: Mean hourly wind speed time series; site and period not reported here.
ff4c17c713de7c9aa84c963569e2a6bad0d46f68.result: Neural network based models give lower errors than linear models, with differences among the nonlinear methods being modest.
ff4c17c713de7c9aa84c963569e2a6bad0d46f68.open_work: Including meteorological inputs and testing longer horizons.
ff4c17c713de7c9aa84c963569e2a6bad0d46f68.issues: Univariate single-site analysis; error figures not reported here.

4950e212041ab6a16f120fef326e1874d0edbbb8.goal: Estimates missing daily precipitation records at rain gauges, a common gap-filling problem for hydrological analysis.
4950e212041ab6a16f120fef326e1874d0edbbb8.architecture: Compares improved inverse-distance and correlation-based weighting schemes with data-driven models, including an artificial neural network (MLP) and kriging-type stochastic interpolation.
4950e212041ab6a16f120fef326e1874d0edbbb8.data: Long-term daily precipitation records from a rain gauge network in Kentucky, USA.
4950e212041ab6a16f120fef326e1874d0edbbb8.result: Modified weighting methods and the neural network improve on the classical inverse distance weighting method for filling missing records.
4950e212041ab6a16f120fef326e1874d0edbbb8.open_work: Testing in other climates and gauge densities and handling of dry/wet day classification remain open.
4950e212041ab6a16f120fef326e1874d0edbbb8.issues: Single regional gauge network; performance depends on correlation between neighbouring stations and may degrade for extremes.

1447db549472214ca8e9f1880de453c402ccc7d8.goal: Calibrates a conceptual runoff model against several output variables to obtain reliable simulations of internal catchment processes and reduce parameter uncertainty.
1447db549472214ca8e9f1880de453c402ccc7d8.architecture: Non-ML optimisation: a genetic algorithm combined with local optimisation for automatic single- and multi-criteria calibration of the HBV conceptual runoff model.
1447db549472214ca8e9f1880de453c402ccc7d8.data: Observed runoff and groundwater level time series in two catchments with different geology, plus a synthetic error-free test case.
1447db549472214ca8e9f1880de453c402ccc7d8.result: The algorithm usually recovers true parameters in the synthetic case; calibrating on runoff and groundwater levels together constrains parameters much more than runoff alone, and motivated a model-structure change in one catchment.
1447db549472214ca8e9f1880de453c402ccc7d8.open_work: Extending multi-criteria calibration to other internal variables and catchments, and refining model structure where calibration reveals inconsistencies.
1447db549472214ca8e9f1880de453c402ccc7d8.issues: Only two catchments; parameter equifinality remains when only runoff is used; groundwater data are point measurements compared with a lumped storage.

72d905475e7b822e90b02b96b89db42259615812.goal: Predicts next-day atmospheric (maximum) temperature from past observations as an alternative to conventional statistical forecasting.
72d905475e7b822e90b02b96b89db42259615812.architecture: Support vector machine regression with a nonlinear kernel, compared against a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network trained with backpropagation.
72d905475e7b822e90b02b96b89db42259615812.data: Daily temperature records from a single weather station, using the previous few days as inputs.
72d905475e7b822e90b02b96b89db42259615812.result: The support vector machine gives lower errors than the MLP for one-day-ahead temperature prediction.
72d905475e7b822e90b02b96b89db42259615812.open_work: Adding other meteorological predictors, longer lead times and more stations would test generality.
72d905475e7b822e90b02b96b89db42259615812.issues: Single station and short horizon; univariate inputs; no comparison with numerical weather prediction or persistence baselines reported.

79beca7af27c6847db2ad224da92c5b138efc085.goal: Improves 24-hour weather forecasting of temperature, wind speed and relative humidity by combining several neural network models.
79beca7af27c6847db2ad224da92c5b138efc085.architecture: Ensemble of neural networks: multilayer perceptron (MLP), Elman recurrent network, radial basis function network and Hopfield model, combined into an ensemble forecast.
79beca7af27c6847db2ad224da92c5b138efc085.data: Hourly surface weather observations from southern Saskatchewan (Regina area), Canada, split by season.
79beca7af27c6847db2ad224da92c5b138efc085.result: The ensemble of neural networks is more accurate than the individual networks, with the radial basis function network the strongest single model.
79beca7af27c6847db2ad224da92c5b138efc085.open_work: Extending to more variables, longer lead times and other sites, and weighting ensemble members adaptively.
79beca7af27c6847db2ad224da92c5b138efc085.issues: Single location; point forecasts only, no probabilistic output; no comparison against numerical weather prediction.

efeb033071db9e64b1284451eb1a27ebcba16a26.goal: Assesses whether artificial neural networks can model precipitation-runoff as well as conceptual hydrological models.
efeb033071db9e64b1284451eb1a27ebcba16a26.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) compared with conceptual rainfall-runoff models such as the Sacramento soil moisture accounting model.
efeb033071db9e64b1284451eb1a27ebcba16a26.data: Precipitation, temperature and streamflow records from three US watersheds (Fraser River, Colorado; Raccoon Creek, Iowa; Little Patuxent River, Maryland).
efeb033071db9e64b1284451eb1a27ebcba16a26.result: The neural networks give comparable or better runoff simulations than the conceptual models.
efeb033071db9e64b1284451eb1a27ebcba16a26.open_work: Combining physical understanding with neural networks and testing generalisation to other basins.
efeb033071db9e64b1284451eb1a27ebcba16a26.issues: Black-box model with limited physical interpretability; performance on extremes and outside the training range is uncertain.

340738541f6b145aa2471ccd66bee3ebfe7643f7.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels in a shallow unconfined aquifer to support water management.
340738541f6b145aa2471ccd66bee3ebfe7643f7.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation, using past groundwater levels, rainfall and canal releases as inputs.
340738541f6b145aa2471ccd66bee3ebfe7643f7.data: Observation-well groundwater levels with rainfall and canal release data from the Central Godavari Delta, Andhra Pradesh, India.
340738541f6b145aa2471ccd66bee3ebfe7643f7.result: The neural network forecasts groundwater levels with reasonable accuracy up to several months ahead.
340738541f6b145aa2471ccd66bee3ebfe7643f7.open_work: Extending to more wells, spatial forecasting and coupling with physically based groundwater models.
340738541f6b145aa2471ccd66bee3ebfe7643f7.issues: Site-specific wells; data-driven model cannot represent aquifer physics or changing pumping regimes.

dbfc376c4614ee72da0e486a33bcb29d9bc50812.goal: Estimates global solar radiation where pyranometer measurements are missing, using commonly measured meteorological variables.
dbfc376c4614ee72da0e486a33bcb29d9bc50812.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with different input combinations of air temperature, relative humidity and day of year.
dbfc376c4614ee72da0e486a33bcb29d9bc50812.data: Daily meteorological and global solar radiation measurements from Abha, Saudi Arabia.
dbfc376c4614ee72da0e486a33bcb29d9bc50812.result: Using both air temperature and relative humidity as inputs gives the lowest errors in estimating global solar radiation.
dbfc376c4614ee72da0e486a33bcb29d9bc50812.open_work: Testing at more sites and climates and adding sunshine duration or cloud information.
dbfc376c4614ee72da0e486a33bcb29d9bc50812.issues: Single station; no spatial generalisation tested; limited set of inputs.

fac0c932260f6dcbc22dfeb1bd6ff67a3ac19e05.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff modelling by capturing multiscale features of the input time series.
fac0c932260f6dcbc22dfeb1bd6ff67a3ac19e05.architecture: Hybrid wavelet-ANN: discrete wavelet transform decomposes rainfall and runoff series into subseries that feed a multivariate artificial neural network (MLP).
fac0c932260f6dcbc22dfeb1bd6ff67a3ac19e05.data: Rainfall and runoff records from the Ligvanchai watershed near Tabriz, Iran.
fac0c932260f6dcbc22dfeb1bd6ff67a3ac19e05.result: The wavelet-ANN model outperforms a plain neural network and a linear ARIMAX-type model, especially for peak flows.
fac0c932260f6dcbc22dfeb1bd6ff67a3ac19e05.open_work: Choice of wavelet type and decomposition level and extension to other catchments.
fac0c932260f6dcbc22dfeb1bd6ff67a3ac19e05.issues: Single small watershed; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if not applied causally; extremes are few.

837651555277f857c74eaa5d421d6172942c90f4.goal: Predicts wind farm power output over short horizons to support grid integration.
837651555277f857c74eaa5d421d6172942c90f4.architecture: Data-mining approach comparing several algorithms; a neural network (MLP) gives the best performance among the tested models.
837651555277f857c74eaa5d421d6172942c90f4.data: Wind farm SCADA data (wind speed and power) recorded at short intervals.
837651555277f857c74eaa5d421d6172942c90f4.result: Data-mining models predict wind farm power with useful accuracy for short horizons, with accuracy decreasing as the horizon grows.
837651555277f857c74eaa5d421d6172942c90f4.open_work: Integrating weather forecast inputs to extend the horizon and updating models online.
837651555277f857c74eaa5d421d6172942c90f4.issues: Single wind farm; accuracy deteriorates quickly with lead time; no probabilistic forecasts.

290c4f0c543cd427ae8b9ccbe34869f99802217d.goal: Analyses and predicts wind energy production of wind farms as a case study for planning.
290c4f0c543cd427ae8b9ccbe34869f99802217d.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation, with wind speed, relative humidity and generation hours as inputs.
290c4f0c543cd427ae8b9ccbe34869f99802217d.data: Monthly data from seven wind farms in the Muppandal region, Tamil Nadu, India.
290c4f0c543cd427ae8b9ccbe34869f99802217d.result: The neural network predicts wind farm energy output with low mean square error.
290c4f0c543cd427ae8b9ccbe34869f99802217d.open_work: Using longer records and additional meteorological inputs, and testing at other sites.
290c4f0c543cd427ae8b9ccbe34869f99802217d.issues: Small dataset from one region; monthly aggregation limits operational use.

32c3d16962ade0891fe5e43f868d7986b4751d58.goal: Compares data-driven flood forecasting models for a large river to identify accurate and practical options.
32c3d16962ade0891fe5e43f868d7986b4751d58.architecture: Compares linear regression, an artificial neural network (MLP), a genetic-algorithm-trained neural network and an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS).
32c3d16962ade0891fe5e43f868d7986b4751d58.data: Water level or discharge records from stations in the middle reaches of the Yangtze River, China.
32c3d16962ade0891fe5e43f868d7986b4751d58.result: The genetic-algorithm-based neural network and ANFIS outperform the linear model and standard neural network, with ANFIS needing fewer parameters.
32c3d16962ade0891fe5e43f868d7986b4751d58.open_work: Testing longer lead times and other reaches and combining with hydrodynamic models.
32c3d16962ade0891fe5e43f868d7986b4751d58.issues: Single river reach; limited number of flood events; short lead times.

945b31493b1be8631e2386212054012946a7e9e0.goal: Estimates wind turbine power generation from wind measurements, i.e. modelling the turbine power curve.
945b31493b1be8631e2386212054012946a7e9e0.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) mapping wind speed and direction to turbine power output.
945b31493b1be8631e2386212054012946a7e9e0.data: Measured wind and power data from wind turbines at a wind farm site.
945b31493b1be8631e2386212054012946a7e9e0.result: The neural network estimates turbine power output more accurately than a simple power curve approach.
945b31493b1be8631e2386212054012946a7e9e0.open_work: Extending to whole-farm forecasting and future wind predictions.
945b31493b1be8631e2386212054012946a7e9e0.issues: Estimates power from concurrent wind data rather than forecasting; site-specific.

8512522ef92cefbefeb8a93a166faab59420f252.goal: Forecasts drought indices months ahead to support drought early warning.
8512522ef92cefbefeb8a93a166faab59420f252.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) predicting the Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) and Effective Drought Index (EDI) from past rainfall, index values and climate indices such as SOI and NAO.
8512522ef92cefbefeb8a93a166faab59420f252.data: Rainfall records from stations in Tehran Province, Iran, with SOI and NAO indices.
8512522ef92cefbefeb8a93a166faab59420f252.result: The neural networks forecast drought indices with useful skill at lead times up to about 12 months, with EDI better predicted than SPI.
8512522ef92cefbefeb8a93a166faab59420f252.open_work: Including more large-scale climate predictors and extending to other regions.
8512522ef92cefbefeb8a93a166faab59420f252.issues: Limited station set; skill decreases with lead time; relatively few drought events.

978b39dbeb8b337612ec7d53f38a74950bfcde18.goal: Forecasts urban air pollutant (NO2) concentrations and tests whether removing periodic components helps neural network models.
978b39dbeb8b337612ec7d53f38a74950bfcde18.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) and self-organizing map (SOM) models, combined with or without periodic (Fourier-type) component removal.
978b39dbeb8b337612ec7d53f38a74950bfcde18.data: Hourly NO2 concentrations and meteorological data from Stuttgart, Germany.
978b39dbeb8b337612ec7d53f38a74950bfcde18.result: The MLP applied directly to the original data gives the best forecasts; removing periodic components brings little benefit.
978b39dbeb8b337612ec7d53f38a74950bfcde18.open_work: Testing other pollutants and sites and adding meteorological forecast inputs.
978b39dbeb8b337612ec7d53f38a74950bfcde18.issues: Single city; short-term forecasts only; models do not represent emissions or transport explicitly.

3eadf226d3561378ba5885fe091de062ecac77e4.goal: Compares chaos-based and neural network approaches for forecasting daily river flow.
3eadf226d3561378ba5885fe091de062ecac77e4.architecture: Phase-space reconstruction with local approximation (nonlinear dynamics, non-ML) compared with a feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP).
3eadf226d3561378ba5885fe091de062ecac77e4.data: Daily river flow series from the Chao Phraya River, Thailand.
3eadf226d3561378ba5885fe091de062ecac77e4.result: Phase-space reconstruction gives better flow forecasts than the neural network at the tested lead times.
3eadf226d3561378ba5885fe091de062ecac77e4.open_work: Combining both approaches and testing other rivers and time scales.
3eadf226d3561378ba5885fe091de062ecac77e4.issues: Single river; univariate inputs; conclusions sensitive to embedding parameter choices.

06340d8c14ecd2ffa41cf78547bda58facfc4f39.goal: Compares training methods for neural network rainfall-runoff models to improve their accuracy.
06340d8c14ecd2ffa41cf78547bda58facfc4f39.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network trained by backpropagation versus a real-coded genetic algorithm, among other training approaches.
06340d8c14ecd2ffa41cf78547bda58facfc4f39.data: Daily rainfall and streamflow data from the Kentucky River basin, USA.
06340d8c14ecd2ffa41cf78547bda58facfc4f39.result: Genetic-algorithm training gives better rainfall-runoff models than backpropagation, especially for high flows.
06340d8c14ecd2ffa41cf78547bda58facfc4f39.open_work: Testing hybrid and evolutionary training schemes on more catchments.
06340d8c14ecd2ffa41cf78547bda58facfc4f39.issues: Single basin; computational cost of genetic training; limited assessment of uncertainty.

2ffc8d745e150783e064e4e33c12bc1bcb4b417f.goal: Determines optimal input lags and spatial inputs for neural network short-term rainfall forecasting.
2ffc8d745e150783e064e4e33c12bc1bcb4b417f.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with varying temporal lags and numbers of neighbouring gauges as inputs.
2ffc8d745e150783e064e4e33c12bc1bcb4b417f.data: 15-minute rainfall records from a gauge network in the Upper Parramatta River catchment, Sydney, Australia.
2ffc8d745e150783e064e4e33c12bc1bcb4b417f.result: Networks with fewer, well-chosen lags and spatial inputs forecast better than those with many inputs; the optimal lag relates to rainfall autocorrelation.
2ffc8d745e150783e064e4e33c12bc1bcb4b417f.open_work: Applying the input selection to longer horizons and other catchments.
2ffc8d745e150783e064e4e33c12bc1bcb4b417f.issues: Single catchment; very short horizons; rainfall forecasting from gauges alone is limited.

b5d8a6468c63188d88bcc3ff3ea0be415cf168eb.goal: Forecasts flood stage at a river location to improve flood warning.
b5d8a6468c63188d88bcc3ff3ea0be415cf168eb.architecture: Support vector machine regression compared with an artificial neural network (MLP).
b5d8a6468c63188d88bcc3ff3ea0be415cf168eb.data: Daily water level records from gauging stations upstream of and at Dhaka, Bangladesh.
b5d8a6468c63188d88bcc3ff3ea0be415cf168eb.result: The support vector machine forecasts flood stage accurately for lead times of up to about seven days and outperforms the neural network.
b5d8a6468c63188d88bcc3ff3ea0be415cf168eb.open_work: Kernel and parameter selection and extension to other river systems.
b5d8a6468c63188d88bcc3ff3ea0be415cf168eb.issues: Single river system; skill decreases with lead time; no uncertainty estimates.

582e48b447639b1f6c226709ca501b8e252e74be.goal: Reviews wind forecasting technology used worldwide to support wind power integration.
582e48b447639b1f6c226709ca501b8e252e74be.architecture: Review of wind speed and power forecasting methods, covering physical (NWP-based), statistical, artificial neural network and hybrid approaches.
582e48b447639b1f6c226709ca501b8e252e74be.data: Literature on operational and research wind forecasting systems; no new dataset.
582e48b447639b1f6c226709ca501b8e252e74be.result: Hybrid methods combining physical and statistical models are highlighted as promising for short-term wind forecasting.
582e48b447639b1f6c226709ca501b8e252e74be.open_work: Improving accuracy at longer horizons and developing probabilistic forecasts.
582e48b447639b1f6c226709ca501b8e252e74be.issues: Descriptive review without quantitative benchmarking of methods.

2276df6aef7814cbef250bfc3477a80ae7da3c65.goal: Examines how data are divided into training, testing and validation sets for neural network models in water resources.
2276df6aef7814cbef250bfc3477a80ae7da3c65.architecture: Data-division methods using a genetic algorithm and a self-organizing map (SOM) to create statistically similar subsets for MLP neural network models.
2276df6aef7814cbef250bfc3477a80ae7da3c65.data: Salinity forecasting case study for the River Murray, South Australia, plus a synthetic data example.
2276df6aef7814cbef250bfc3477a80ae7da3c65.result: Both the genetic algorithm and SOM-based divisions produce representative subsets and improve the reliability of neural network performance evaluation compared with arbitrary splits.
2276df6aef7814cbef250bfc3477a80ae7da3c65.open_work: Testing on more applications and accounting for temporal dependence in division.
2276df6aef7814cbef250bfc3477a80ae7da3c65.issues: Random-like splits of time series can inflate apparent skill; results tied to one case study.

d05129805e6da37e6261339a083b7f077d751077.goal: Improves the training of neural networks for river stage prediction.
d05129805e6da37e6261339a083b7f077d751077.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network trained with particle swarm optimization instead of backpropagation.
d05129805e6da37e6261339a083b7f077d751077.data: Water level records from the Shing Mun River, Hong Kong.
d05129805e6da37e6261339a083b7f077d751077.result: Particle swarm optimization training converges faster and gives more accurate stage predictions than backpropagation.
d05129805e6da37e6261339a083b7f077d751077.open_work: Applying swarm-based training to other networks and hydrological problems.
d05129805e6da37e6261339a083b7f077d751077.issues: Single river; short lead times; limited comparison with other optimisers.

5972dee596c86270442ed4f1cf838c10d0c8eaff.goal: Predicts watershed precipitation by capturing multiscale behaviour of rainfall series.
5972dee596c86270442ed4f1cf838c10d0c8eaff.architecture: Hybrid wavelet-ANN: wavelet decomposition of precipitation series feeding a feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP).
5972dee596c86270442ed4f1cf838c10d0c8eaff.data: Precipitation records from gauges in the Ligvanchai watershed, Tabriz, Iran.
5972dee596c86270442ed4f1cf838c10d0c8eaff.result: The wavelet-ANN model forecasts precipitation better than an ANN without wavelet preprocessing, for both short- and long-term behaviour.
5972dee596c86270442ed4f1cf838c10d0c8eaff.open_work: Choice of wavelet and decomposition levels and adding climate predictors.
5972dee596c86270442ed4f1cf838c10d0c8eaff.issues: Single small watershed; wavelet preprocessing may introduce boundary effects or information leakage if applied non-causally.

0fc5064d322e87a4bf3d3dbe9113d2c43731cfd6.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed at a major wind energy site in Mexico.
0fc5064d322e87a4bf3d3dbe9113d2c43731cfd6.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) with different numbers of layers and neurons, using past wind speed as input.
0fc5064d322e87a4bf3d3dbe9113d2c43731cfd6.data: Hourly wind speed measurements from La Venta, Oaxaca, Mexico.
0fc5064d322e87a4bf3d3dbe9113d2c43731cfd6.result: Simple neural networks forecast short-term wind speed with good accuracy.
0fc5064d322e87a4bf3d3dbe9113d2c43731cfd6.open_work: Adding other meteorological inputs and comparing with statistical models.
0fc5064d322e87a4bf3d3dbe9113d2c43731cfd6.issues: Single site; univariate inputs; short horizons only.

be18b41a763997e7e3aca065749442394569e0d2.goal: Develops neural network models for short-term rainfall forecasting in an urban catchment.
be18b41a763997e7e3aca065749442394569e0d2.architecture: Compares three artificial neural network types: multilayer feed-forward network (MLP), Elman partial recurrent network and time-delay neural network.
be18b41a763997e7e3aca065749442394569e0d2.data: 15-minute rainfall data from a gauge network in the Upper Parramatta River catchment, Sydney, Australia.
be18b41a763997e7e3aca065749442394569e0d2.result: All three network types give similar, reasonable forecasts; networks with fewer inputs perform comparably with more complex ones.
be18b41a763997e7e3aca065749442394569e0d2.open_work: Longer lead times and use of radar or meteorological inputs.
be18b41a763997e7e3aca065749442394569e0d2.issues: Very short lead times; gauge-only inputs; single catchment.

5802f1f7e59cfa385831111602040a82c7545edf.goal: Compares data-driven models for flood forecasting in a Chinese river basin.
5802f1f7e59cfa385831111602040a82c7545edf.architecture: M5 model trees (piecewise linear regression trees) compared with artificial neural networks (MLP).
5802f1f7e59cfa385831111602040a82c7545edf.data: Daily rainfall and discharge records from the upper reach of the Huai River, China.
5802f1f7e59cfa385831111602040a82c7545edf.result: M5 model trees and neural networks give similar forecast accuracy, with model trees being more transparent and faster to train.
5802f1f7e59cfa385831111602040a82c7545edf.open_work: Combining models in committees or modular schemes and extending lead times.
5802f1f7e59cfa385831111602040a82c7545edf.issues: Single basin; short lead times; few extreme flood events in the record.

5f8efcdd8765109e28c69c107f074cbc6dc5673c.goal: Models the water level-discharge (rating curve) relationship, including hysteresis effects, using data-driven methods.
5f8efcdd8765109e28c69c107f074cbc6dc5673c.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) and M5 model trees compared with conventional rating curves.
5f8efcdd8765109e28c69c107f074cbc6dc5673c.data: Stage and discharge measurements from a river gauging station in India.
5f8efcdd8765109e28c69c107f074cbc6dc5673c.result: Both neural networks and M5 model trees reproduce discharge more accurately than the traditional rating curve.
5f8efcdd8765109e28c69c107f074cbc6dc5673c.open_work: Applying to other stations and including additional hydraulic inputs.
5f8efcdd8765109e28c69c107f074cbc6dc5673c.issues: Single station; limited high-flow measurements; data-driven models may extrapolate poorly.

bb35432e484a8e38990878167ae5403caad7ebc1.goal: Forecasts next-day daily average PM10 concentrations in Belgium for operational air quality warnings.
bb35432e484a8e38990878167ae5403caad7ebc1.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) using meteorological predictors and PM10 observations as inputs.
bb35432e484a8e38990878167ae5403caad7ebc1.data: PM10 monitoring network data in Belgium with meteorological forecast variables such as boundary layer height.
bb35432e484a8e38990878167ae5403caad7ebc1.result: Boundary layer height is the most important input; the neural network improves on persistence and is used operationally.
bb35432e484a8e38990878167ae5403caad7ebc1.open_work: Better meteorological inputs and handling of episodes with transboundary transport.
bb35432e484a8e38990878167ae5403caad7ebc1.issues: Skill for high-concentration episodes remains limited; depends on quality of meteorological forecasts.

4ce5a434a94ca8d69a02bd35fb5642d2aac52c6d.goal: Forecasts monthly river flow with neural networks as an alternative to stochastic time series models.
4ce5a434a94ca8d69a02bd35fb5642d2aac52c6d.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) compared with autoregressive (AR) time series models.
4ce5a434a94ca8d69a02bd35fb5642d2aac52c6d.data: Monthly river flow records from a river in Turkey.
4ce5a434a94ca8d69a02bd35fb5642d2aac52c6d.result: The neural network gives better monthly flow forecasts than the AR models.
4ce5a434a94ca8d69a02bd35fb5642d2aac52c6d.open_work: Testing other network types and inputs such as precipitation.
4ce5a434a94ca8d69a02bd35fb5642d2aac52c6d.issues: Single river; univariate inputs; limited record length.

11a070e4893374b0f1c27ca6f12014a7159db808.goal: Forecasts coastal wind speeds at daily, weekly and monthly scales for marine and coastal engineering.
11a070e4893374b0f1c27ca6f12014a7159db808.architecture: Feed-forward and recurrent artificial neural networks compared with ARIMA statistical time series models.
11a070e4893374b0f1c27ca6f12014a7159db808.data: Wind speed records from coastal sites in India.
11a070e4893374b0f1c27ca6f12014a7159db808.result: Neural networks give more accurate wind forecasts than ARIMA models, with better performance at weekly and monthly scales than daily.
11a070e4893374b0f1c27ca6f12014a7159db808.open_work: Extending to hourly forecasts and other locations.
11a070e4893374b0f1c27ca6f12014a7159db808.issues: Few sites; univariate time series inputs; no comparison with meteorological model forecasts.

f69d0db69d973d6251402b74cf02dcda9d9221e9.goal: Forecasts ocean wave height and period from wind information as an alternative to empirical and numerical wave models.
f69d0db69d973d6251402b74cf02dcda9d9221e9.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with different learning algorithms, using wind speed as input.
f69d0db69d973d6251402b74cf02dcda9d9221e9.data: Wind and wave measurements from an offshore location; exact dataset not reported here.
