f69d0db69d973d6251402b74cf02dcda9d9221e9.result: Neural networks forecast significant wave height and average wave period with satisfactory accuracy.
f69d0db69d973d6251402b74cf02dcda9d9221e9.open_work: Including fetch, wind direction and duration and testing at other sites.
f69d0db69d973d6251402b74cf02dcda9d9221e9.issues: Site-specific training; cannot represent swell from distant sources; limited data.

d70620d74666d93c9bcfaf4c555e4e38ef2216a5.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration where full meteorological data for FAO-56 Penman-Monteith are unavailable.
d70620d74666d93c9bcfaf4c555e4e38ef2216a5.architecture: Several artificial neural network (MLP) configurations with different meteorological inputs compared with empirical and semi-empirical equations (e.g., Hargreaves, Priestley-Taylor).
d70620d74666d93c9bcfaf4c555e4e38ef2216a5.data: Daily meteorological data from agrometeorological stations in the Basque Country, northern Spain, with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith as reference.
d70620d74666d93c9bcfaf4c555e4e38ef2216a5.result: Neural networks outperform the empirical and semi-empirical equations that use the same inputs.
d70620d74666d93c9bcfaf4c555e4e38ef2216a5.open_work: Testing transferability across climates and stations.
d70620d74666d93c9bcfaf4c555e4e38ef2216a5.issues: Regional data; reference values are themselves model-based (Penman-Monteith), not lysimeter measurements.

44542310b131d76a0421f760bb9d4eb2087bca14.goal: Models daily rainfall-runoff in large catchments with neural networks.
44542310b131d76a0421f760bb9d4eb2087bca14.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) coupled with a simple linear model to represent the rainfall-runoff relationship.
44542310b131d76a0421f760bb9d4eb2087bca14.data: Daily rainfall and runoff data from catchments in India (including the Narmada basin) and catchments in other countries.
44542310b131d76a0421f760bb9d4eb2087bca14.result: The coupled neural network model simulates daily runoff well, including during flood events.
44542310b131d76a0421f760bb9d4eb2087bca14.open_work: Testing for longer lead times and ungauged catchments.
44542310b131d76a0421f760bb9d4eb2087bca14.issues: Black-box model; performance may degrade outside training conditions.

096b74e1f0e48dd2ba58285280b07b84d1a19e2b.goal: Improves quantitative rainfall forecasts over the São Paulo region by post-processing numerical model output.
096b74e1f0e48dd2ba58285280b07b84d1a19e2b.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) used for statistical downscaling of Eta regional model output, compared with multiple linear regression.
096b74e1f0e48dd2ba58285280b07b84d1a19e2b.data: Eta model forecast fields and rain gauge observations over the São Paulo region, Brazil.
096b74e1f0e48dd2ba58285280b07b84d1a19e2b.result: The neural network rainfall forecasts outperform multiple linear regression and the raw Eta model.
096b74e1f0e48dd2ba58285280b07b84d1a19e2b.open_work: Applying to other seasons and regions and to probabilistic forecasts.
096b74e1f0e48dd2ba58285280b07b84d1a19e2b.issues: Dependent on Eta model biases; limited validation period; heavy rainfall events are few.

1cb5bf0f83575ebdf50cea6eee82fdc81e4e6d29.goal: Develops a wavelet network model to improve prediction of hydrological time series.
1cb5bf0f83575ebdf50cea6eee82fdc81e4e6d29.architecture: Wavelet network: wavelet decomposition of the time series combined with an artificial neural network.
1cb5bf0f83575ebdf50cea6eee82fdc81e4e6d29.data: Hydrological time series; specific datasets not reported here.
1cb5bf0f83575ebdf50cea6eee82fdc81e4e6d29.result: The wavelet network model gives better predictions than a conventional neural network for the tested series.
1cb5bf0f83575ebdf50cea6eee82fdc81e4e6d29.open_work: Testing on more hydrological variables and choosing wavelet parameters systematically.
1cb5bf0f83575ebdf50cea6eee82fdc81e4e6d29.issues: Details of data and validation not available here; wavelet preprocessing can introduce leakage if not causal.

ab1aed1aad007588a6ccfe758c1cf29f6f5fd177.goal: Estimates global solar radiation and compares neural networks with the classical Ångström regression.
ab1aed1aad007588a6ccfe758c1cf29f6f5fd177.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with different input combinations compared with Ångström-type linear regression on sunshine duration.
ab1aed1aad007588a6ccfe758c1cf29f6f5fd177.data: Measured global solar radiation, sunshine duration and temperature at a station in Cyprus (Athalassa).
ab1aed1aad007588a6ccfe758c1cf29f6f5fd177.result: Neural networks estimate global solar radiation more accurately than Ångström's method.
ab1aed1aad007588a6ccfe758c1cf29f6f5fd177.open_work: Testing at other stations and climates.
ab1aed1aad007588a6ccfe758c1cf29f6f5fd177.issues: Single station; inputs require sunshine duration measurements.

99666b861f197efda26efbbe5027e3ce2b53354d.goal: Estimates and forecasts daily suspended sediment concentrations, which are costly to measure.
99666b861f197efda26efbbe5027e3ce2b53354d.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network compared with sediment rating curves and multiple linear regression.
99666b861f197efda26efbbe5027e3ce2b53354d.data: Daily streamflow and suspended sediment data from rivers in the USA.
99666b861f197efda26efbbe5027e3ce2b53354d.result: The MLP estimates and forecasts suspended sediment better than rating curves and regression.
99666b861f197efda26efbbe5027e3ce2b53354d.open_work: Adding rainfall and other inputs and testing on more rivers.
99666b861f197efda26efbbe5027e3ce2b53354d.issues: Limited extrapolation for extreme sediment events; few rivers.

6104c2a1d3c086526e4ec57f9a090afa2ec906e0.goal: Forecasts short-term water demand for a campus water supply system.
6104c2a1d3c086526e4ec57f9a090afa2ec906e0.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) compared with regression and time series models.
6104c2a1d3c086526e4ec57f9a090afa2ec906e0.data: Weekly water demand, rainfall and maximum air temperature data at IIT Kanpur, India.
6104c2a1d3c086526e4ec57f9a090afa2ec906e0.result: The neural networks forecast water demand better than regression and time series models; demand depends mainly on past demand rather than climate inputs.
6104c2a1d3c086526e4ec57f9a090afa2ec906e0.open_work: Testing for daily or hourly demand and other cities.

296d76aea0dc2628fd4bde4d900ae233d9aaa8bb.goal: Simulates daily precipitation and temperature simultaneously at many sites for hydrological impact studies in the Rhine basin.
296d76aea0dc2628fd4bde4d900ae233d9aaa8bb.architecture: Non-parametric nearest-neighbour (k-NN) resampling weather generator (non-deep statistical method).
296d76aea0dc2628fd4bde4d900ae233d9aaa8bb.data: Daily precipitation and temperature records from multiple stations in the Rhine basin.
296d76aea0dc2628fd4bde4d900ae233d9aaa8bb.result: Nearest-neighbour resampling reproduces spatial correlation and many daily statistics, but some variability of multi-day precipitation totals is underestimated.
296d76aea0dc2628fd4bde4d900ae233d9aaa8bb.open_work: Improving reproduction of long-term variability and extremes, and climate change scenarios.
296d76aea0dc2628fd4bde4d900ae233d9aaa8bb.issues: Resampling cannot generate values outside the observed record; underestimates variability at longer time scales.

5cd5d29fd061453f8488fc878b833e7122d6787a.goal: Compares neural network and ARMA models for continuous river flow forecasting in contrasting catchments.
5cd5d29fd061453f8488fc878b833e7122d6787a.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) compared with autoregressive moving average (ARMA) time series models.
5cd5d29fd061453f8488fc878b833e7122d6787a.data: Hourly river flow records from the River Wye (Wales) and River Ouse (Yorkshire), UK.
5cd5d29fd061453f8488fc878b833e7122d6787a.result: Neural networks perform as well as or better than ARMA models, with differences depending on catchment characteristics.
5cd5d29fd061453f8488fc878b833e7122d6787a.open_work: Testing longer lead times and adding rainfall inputs.
5cd5d29fd061453f8488fc878b833e7122d6787a.issues: Two catchments; univariate flow inputs; short lead times.

5485b08384e760e27712ff1ab9a0ae90a9892c71.goal: Combines forecasts from several rainfall-runoff models to obtain better discharge forecasts.
5485b08384e760e27712ff1ab9a0ae90a9892c71.architecture: First-order Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy system combining outputs of several rainfall-runoff models, compared with simple average, weighted average and neural network combination methods.
5485b08384e760e27712ff1ab9a0ae90a9892c71.data: Daily rainfall-runoff data from multiple catchments worldwide.
5485b08384e760e27712ff1ab9a0ae90a9892c71.result: The Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy combination performs comparably to the neural network combination and better than simple averaging.
5485b08384e760e27712ff1ab9a0ae90a9892c71.open_work: Testing combinations under changing conditions and for longer horizons.
5485b08384e760e27712ff1ab9a0ae90a9892c71.issues: Gains depend on diversity of member models; combination does not correct shared model biases.

7a9a829eba35fb60323f4ad55bc9d1c399f675dc.goal: Predicts streamflow at multiple time scales (seasonal volumes and short-term hourly flows) to support water-management decisions in a semi-arid basin.
7a9a829eba35fb60323f4ad55bc9d1c399f675dc.architecture: Support vector machine regression, chosen for its sparse, well-generalizing structure and compared with a neural network benchmark.
7a9a829eba35fb60323f4ad55bc9d1c399f675dc.data: Streamflow and related hydrological records from the Sevier River basin, Utah; exact periods and inputs not stated here.
7a9a829eba35fb60323f4ad55bc9d1c399f675dc.result: Support vector machines give accurate predictions at both seasonal and hourly scales with compact models, performing comparably to or better than the neural network benchmark.
7a9a829eba35fb60323f4ad55bc9d1c399f675dc.open_work: Testing on other basins, adding uncertainty quantification and exploring kernel and input selection systematically.
7a9a829eba35fb60323f4ad55bc9d1c399f675dc.issues: Single-basin application; no abstract available, so quantitative skill and comparison details are not reported here.

61b9fb971630ab734cd7d1e8e4705bf9a9c683bd.goal: Forecasts hourly ozone and nitrogen dioxide levels in the Bilbao area to support air-quality warnings.
61b9fb971630ab734cd7d1e8e4705bf9a9c683bd.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks compared with multiple linear regression models.
61b9fb971630ab734cd7d1e8e4705bf9a9c683bd.data: Hourly air-quality, meteorological and traffic variables from monitoring stations in the Bilbao area, Spain.
61b9fb971630ab734cd7d1e8e4705bf9a9c683bd.result: The MLP models outperform linear regression for most forecast horizons and stations, and traffic variables add useful information.
61b9fb971630ab734cd7d1e8e4705bf9a9c683bd.open_work: Extending to other pollutants and sites and using meteorological forecasts as inputs for operational use.
61b9fb971630ab734cd7d1e8e4705bf9a9c683bd.issues: Local station-based models with limited transferability; no abstract available, so quantitative scores are not reported here.

1bd1a99a2bc5412b3028dd36b4eed38c4f04d33e.goal: Improves daily streamflow forecasting by accounting for the seasonal and regime-dependent behaviour of river flow.
1bd1a99a2bc5412b3028dd36b4eed38c4f04d33e.architecture: Hybrid artificial neural network models: threshold-based ANN, cluster-based ANN using fuzzy C-means, and periodic ANN, compared with a standard MLP neural network.
1bd1a99a2bc5412b3028dd36b4eed38c4f04d33e.data: Daily streamflow records from the upper Yellow River (Tangnaihai station), China.
1bd1a99a2bc5412b3028dd36b4eed38c4f04d33e.result: Hybrid models outperform a single global ANN, with the periodic ANN giving the best daily forecasts.
1bd1a99a2bc5412b3028dd36b4eed38c4f04d33e.open_work: Adding exogenous inputs such as precipitation and temperature and testing on other rivers.
1bd1a99a2bc5412b3028dd36b4eed38c4f04d33e.issues: Univariate flow inputs at a single station; performance in extreme floods and transferability are not established.

df39cde260011ae83c477e971071aad910e7c5fd.goal: Develops a short-term flood forecasting model that combines the learning ability of neural networks with interpretable fuzzy rules.
df39cde260011ae83c477e971071aad910e7c5fd.architecture: Neurofuzzy model (adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system type), compared with neural network and conventional approaches.
df39cde260011ae83c477e971071aad910e7c5fd.data: Hourly river flow and rainfall data from an Indian river basin; details not reported here.
df39cde260011ae83c477e971071aad910e7c5fd.result: The neurofuzzy model forecasts flood hydrographs with good accuracy at short lead times and preserves the statistical properties of the flows.
df39cde260011ae83c477e971071aad910e7c5fd.open_work: Extending lead times, handling peak-flow underestimation and testing in other basins.
df39cde260011ae83c477e971071aad910e7c5fd.issues: No abstract available; accuracy at longer leads and for the largest peaks is not reported here.

99ea815251860942a0e3ea4faa5ced0e2e2937e3.goal: Estimates actual crop evapotranspiration when only limited climatic variables are available, avoiding costly lysimeter measurements.
99ea815251860942a0e3ea4faa5ced0e2e2937e3.architecture: Artificial neural network; the network type is not specified here.
99ea815251860942a0e3ea4faa5ced0e2e2937e3.data: Limited climatic data and lysimeter-measured actual evapotranspiration from an Indian site; details not reported here.
99ea815251860942a0e3ea4faa5ced0e2e2937e3.result: The neural network estimates actual evapotranspiration from few climatic inputs with accuracy comparable to or better than conventional methods.
99ea815251860942a0e3ea4faa5ced0e2e2937e3.open_work: Validation at other sites and crops and analysis of input importance.
99ea815251860942a0e3ea4faa5ced0e2e2937e3.issues: Single-site data; no abstract available, so error statistics and the exact inputs are not reported here.

25fdb44acbb2ea283e075a0147ff213954baf7dd.goal: Estimates solar radiation at locations without radiation measurements from routinely observed meteorological and geographical variables.
25fdb44acbb2ea283e075a0147ff213954baf7dd.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) and multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks, compared with a regression model.
25fdb44acbb2ea283e075a0147ff213954baf7dd.data: Measured solar radiation and meteorological data from stations in Oman.
25fdb44acbb2ea283e075a0147ff213954baf7dd.result: Both neural networks estimate the clearness index and solar radiation well, with the RBF network performing slightly better than the MLP.
25fdb44acbb2ea283e075a0147ff213954baf7dd.open_work: Extending to more stations and climates and to daily rather than monthly estimates.
25fdb44acbb2ea283e075a0147ff213954baf7dd.issues: Small station network; no abstract available, so error figures are not reported here.

1964023bfa0d8d6281d48fc95fe3ca71799b53bb.goal: Forecasts daily total solar radiation for sizing and operating photovoltaic systems.
1964023bfa0d8d6281d48fc95fe3ca71799b53bb.architecture: Adaptive wavelet network (wavelet neural network) combining wavelet decomposition with a neural network.
1964023bfa0d8d6281d48fc95fe3ca71799b53bb.data: Daily total solar radiation records from a site in Algeria; period not reported here.
1964023bfa0d8d6281d48fc95fe3ca71799b53bb.result: The adaptive wavelet network forecasts daily solar radiation more accurately than conventional neural network and time-series models.
1964023bfa0d8d6281d48fc95fe3ca71799b53bb.open_work: Testing at other sites and coupling forecasts to photovoltaic system sizing.
1964023bfa0d8d6281d48fc95fe3ca71799b53bb.issues: Single-site, univariate series; no abstract available, so error statistics are not reported here.

32d75d8d221c43cc5f10e3b809f7e7c4d9c2d0d1.goal: Studies how data preprocessing affects neural-network river flow forecasting.
32d75d8d221c43cc5f10e3b809f7e7c4d9c2d0d1.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural networks with inputs preprocessed by discrete wavelet transforms and with different data-partitioning schemes.
32d75d8d221c43cc5f10e3b809f7e7c4d9c2d0d1.data: River flow records from the Tirso basin, Sardinia, Italy.
32d75d8d221c43cc5f10e3b809f7e7c4d9c2d0d1.result: Wavelet-decomposed inputs and continuous data partitioning improve forecast accuracy over networks trained on raw flows.
32d75d8d221c43cc5f10e3b809f7e7c4d9c2d0d1.open_work: Generalizing preprocessing guidelines across basins and forecast horizons.
32d75d8d221c43cc5f10e3b809f7e7c4d9c2d0d1.issues: Single basin; wavelet decomposition of the whole series can leak future information if not done causally.

97d30200ad12b152631d2654def7de8962905446.goal: Predicts wind speed at a target station from measurements at nearby reference stations, for wind-energy resource assessment.
97d30200ad12b152631d2654def7de8962905446.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer feedforward) using reference-station wind speeds as inputs.
97d30200ad12b152631d2654def7de8962905446.data: Monthly mean wind speeds from meteorological stations in the eastern Mediterranean region of Turkey.
97d30200ad12b152631d2654def7de8962905446.result: The neural network predicts target-station monthly wind speeds with low mean absolute percentage errors.
97d30200ad12b152631d2654def7de8962905446.open_work: Applying to shorter time scales and to wind power estimation at candidate sites.
97d30200ad12b152631d2654def7de8962905446.issues: Monthly means only; skill depends on correlation between stations; no abstract available.

5fbf34672e7d86a0202d9661299f5d3c256c039e.goal: Provides real-time streamflow prediction for flood warning with a fast-learning hybrid network.
5fbf34672e7d86a0202d9661299f5d3c256c039e.architecture: Counterpropagation fuzzy-neural network combining a counterpropagation neural network with fuzzy inference.
5fbf34672e7d86a0202d9661299f5d3c256c039e.data: Hourly rainfall and streamflow from a river basin in Taiwan; details not reported here.
5fbf34672e7d86a0202d9661299f5d3c256c039e.result: The counterpropagation fuzzy-neural network learns quickly and gives accurate one- to few-hour-ahead streamflow predictions.
5fbf34672e7d86a0202d9661299f5d3c256c039e.open_work: Extending lead time and testing on more flood events and basins.
5fbf34672e7d86a0202d9661299f5d3c256c039e.issues: Limited events and single basin; no abstract available, so quantitative skill is not reported here.

a15c23ccf78d11854830de33aea489881fda8aef.goal: Improves tornado detection from Doppler radar to reduce false alarms and missed tornadoes.
a15c23ccf78d11854830de33aea489881fda8aef.architecture: Support vector machines, compared with neural networks and other classifiers.
a15c23ccf78d11854830de33aea489881fda8aef.data: Attributes from the WSR-88D mesocyclone detection algorithm for radar-observed circulations.
a15c23ccf78d11854830de33aea489881fda8aef.result: Support vector machines outperform the neural network and the baseline in skill scores for discriminating tornadic from non-tornadic circulations.
a15c23ccf78d11854830de33aea489881fda8aef.open_work: Larger datasets, feature selection and probabilistic outputs for operational warning.
a15c23ccf78d11854830de33aea489881fda8aef.issues: Rare-event class imbalance and limited sample size; offline evaluation only.

87644ba54b99a5fc06b2fdb469c297a7908239a4.goal: Forecasts daily electric load profiles of an urban area using weather information to support utility operations.
87644ba54b99a5fc06b2fdb469c297a7908239a4.architecture: Artificial neural network; the network type is not specified here.
87644ba54b99a5fc06b2fdb469c297a7908239a4.data: Measured electric load and meteorological data for an urban area in Italy (Palermo); details not reported here.
87644ba54b99a5fc06b2fdb469c297a7908239a4.result: The neural network reproduces daily load profiles with useful accuracy using weather inputs.
87644ba54b99a5fc06b2fdb469c297a7908239a4.open_work: Testing over more years and seasons and using weather forecasts rather than observations as inputs.
87644ba54b99a5fc06b2fdb469c297a7908239a4.issues: Single urban area; no abstract available, so error figures are not reported here.

c274cdcece97d53321167d763dcbffb0ccef13ec.goal: Estimates T-year flood events and the index flood at ungauged catchments, where gauge-based flood frequency analysis is not possible.
c274cdcece97d53321167d763dcbffb0ccef13ec.architecture: Artificial neural networks (type not specified in the abstract), compared with multiple regression and the FEH empirical model.
c274cdcece97d53321167d763dcbffb0ccef13ec.data: Catchment descriptors and annual maximum flood data for 850 UK catchments from the Flood Estimation Handbook (FEH) dataset.
c274cdcece97d53321167d763dcbffb0ccef13ec.result: ANNs give improved flood estimates over multiple regression models; spatial patterns in residuals show geographical factors influence performance.
c274cdcece97d53321167d763dcbffb0ccef13ec.open_work: Incorporating geographical information to reduce spatially structured residuals and quantifying estimate uncertainty.
c274cdcece97d53321167d763dcbffb0ccef13ec.issues: Residuals show spatial bias; no uncertainty on the estimates; results tied to UK catchment descriptors.

cce0e44a4a3db1f11463d8b03f3873ca38e44283.goal: Generates plausible regional daily climate scenarios for impact studies without running a climate model.
cce0e44a4a3db1f11463d8b03f3873ca38e44283.architecture: K-nearest neighbor resampling weather generator with conditional selection to produce shifted scenarios (e.g. warmer or wetter); a non-parametric statistical method.
cce0e44a4a3db1f11463d8b03f3873ca38e44283.data: Multi-station daily weather observations (precipitation and temperature) for a US region; details not reported here.
cce0e44a4a3db1f11463d8b03f3873ca38e44283.result: The nearest-neighbor approach produces scenarios that preserve spatial and cross-variable correlations while shifting climate statistics as specified.
cce0e44a4a3db1f11463d8b03f3873ca38e44283.open_work: Linking scenario shifts to climate-model projections and generating values outside the historical record.
cce0e44a4a3db1f11463d8b03f3873ca38e44283.issues: Resampling cannot produce values outside the observed range; scenarios are user-specified rather than physically derived.

381780c78757ad6ab52ce68f7cb34bc8d01e200e.goal: Forecasts short-term (weekly peak) municipal water demand to support operation of water supply systems.
381780c78757ad6ab52ce68f7cb34bc8d01e200e.architecture: Artificial neural network compared with regression and time-series models.
381780c78757ad6ab52ce68f7cb34bc8d01e200e.data: Municipal water demand and climatic data for a Canadian city (Ottawa); period not reported here.
381780c78757ad6ab52ce68f7cb34bc8d01e200e.result: The neural network models give more accurate short-term demand forecasts than regression and time-series models.
381780c78757ad6ab52ce68f7cb34bc8d01e200e.open_work: Daily or hourly forecasting and including socio-economic drivers.
381780c78757ad6ab52ce68f7cb34bc8d01e200e.issues: Single city; no abstract available, so error statistics are not reported here.

8dab02ec71511bd2cbbb0c0d1b16d1b9e54a81ed.goal: Integrates wind power forecasts and their uncertainty into unit commitment scheduling of power systems.
8dab02ec71511bd2cbbb0c0d1b16d1b9e54a81ed.architecture: Artificial neural network for wind power estimation, coupled to a unit commitment optimization that accounts for forecast uncertainty.
8dab02ec71511bd2cbbb0c0d1b16d1b9e54a81ed.data: Wind and wind-farm power data and a test power system; details not reported here.
8dab02ec71511bd2cbbb0c0d1b16d1b9e54a81ed.result: Accounting for wind forecast uncertainty in unit commitment yields more reliable and economical scheduling than ignoring it.
8dab02ec71511bd2cbbb0c0d1b16d1b9e54a81ed.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts and larger systems with high wind penetration.
8dab02ec71511bd2cbbb0c0d1b16d1b9e54a81ed.issues: No abstract available; forecast accuracy and system details are not reported here.

b601fc4e3902d3cba09ef71176ea9e3c038e58d1.goal: Estimates monthly average daily global solar irradiation where pyranometer data are lacking.
b601fc4e3902d3cba09ef71176ea9e3c038e58d1.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward) using meteorological and geographical inputs.
b601fc4e3902d3cba09ef71176ea9e3c038e58d1.data: Meteorological records (sunshine duration, temperature, cloud cover) and irradiation measurements from stations in Uganda.
b601fc4e3902d3cba09ef71176ea9e3c038e58d1.result: The neural network estimates monthly average daily global irradiation with good agreement against measurements and outperforms empirical models.
b601fc4e3902d3cba09ef71176ea9e3c038e58d1.open_work: More stations and validation in other tropical climates.
b601fc4e3902d3cba09ef71176ea9e3c038e58d1.issues: Few stations and monthly averages only; no abstract available, so error figures are not reported here.

e79d6abd564f32454c3951f2c66b0e5085c0f5cb.goal: Proposes a wind speed forecasting strategy for wind energy applications with lower computational cost.
e79d6abd564f32454c3951f2c66b0e5085c0f5cb.architecture: Artificial neural networks and fuzzy logic models applied to preprocessed wind speed series.
e79d6abd564f32454c3951f2c66b0e5085c0f5cb.data: Wind speed time series; site and period not reported here.
e79d6abd564f32454c3951f2c66b0e5085c0f5cb.result: The proposed strategy improves forecast accuracy and reduces computation time compared with classic neural network forecasting.
e79d6abd564f32454c3951f2c66b0e5085c0f5cb.open_work: Testing at multiple sites and forecast horizons.
e79d6abd564f32454c3951f2c66b0e5085c0f5cb.issues: No abstract available; site, horizons and error statistics are not reported here.

1b79bc5c1606a1bb3ccaca0bbc95019586ae934d.goal: Investigates the large-scale circulation and humidity patterns associated with extreme wintertime precipitation in the Balkans.
1b79bc5c1606a1bb3ccaca0bbc95019586ae934d.architecture: Self-organizing maps (SOM) used to classify daily atmospheric circulation and humidity patterns.
1b79bc5c1606a1bb3ccaca0bbc95019586ae934d.data: NCEP reanalysis daily circulation and humidity fields and station precipitation in the Balkans, winter seasons.
1b79bc5c1606a1bb3ccaca0bbc95019586ae934d.result: SOMs identify a continuum of synoptic patterns and link extreme precipitation events to specific circulation and moisture configurations.
1b79bc5c1606a1bb3ccaca0bbc95019586ae934d.open_work: Applying the classification to climate-model output for downscaling and future extremes.
1b79bc5c1606a1bb3ccaca0bbc95019586ae934d.issues: Diagnostic study; results depend on SOM size and reanalysis quality.

9a19a942437c8e0e2878128de45ad890fdcf06b4.goal: Overcomes training difficulties of conventional neural networks for hydrologic prediction while giving insight into underlying processes.
9a19a942437c8e0e2878128de45ad890fdcf06b4.architecture: Self-organizing linear output map (SOLO): a self-organizing map classification layer combined with local linear regression outputs.
9a19a942437c8e0e2878128de45ad890fdcf06b4.data: Classic rainfall-runoff forecasting case (Leaf River basin, Mississippi, daily data).
9a19a942437c8e0e2878128de45ad890fdcf06b4.result: SOLO estimates structure and parameters rapidly and precisely and performs competitively against multilayer feedforward ANNs, linear time-series and conceptual rainfall-runoff models.
9a19a942437c8e0e2878128de45ad890fdcf06b4.open_work: Applying SOLO to other hydrologic variables and exploiting its interpretability for process studies.
9a19a942437c8e0e2878128de45ad890fdcf06b4.issues: Demonstrated on a single classic basin; no uncertainty estimates.

57303f057f6209120658ce922932601cb1f3430e.goal: Forecasts drought conditions at several lead times to support drought preparedness.
57303f057f6209120658ce922932601cb1f3430e.architecture: Hybrid model combining a linear stochastic ARIMA model with an artificial neural network.
57303f057f6209120658ce922932601cb1f3430e.data: Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) series derived from rainfall in the Kansabati River basin, India.
57303f057f6209120658ce922932601cb1f3430e.result: The hybrid stochastic-neural model forecasts SPI more accurately than either ARIMA or ANN alone, especially at longer leads.
57303f057f6209120658ce922932601cb1f3430e.open_work: Including climate indices as predictors and probabilistic forecasts.
57303f057f6209120658ce922932601cb1f3430e.issues: Single basin and SPI-only inputs; skill decreases with lead time.

a30036c3f77b47603c0b5cdc93bf878830216ef0.goal: Estimates solar radiation at locations without measurements for solar energy applications.
a30036c3f77b47603c0b5cdc93bf878830216ef0.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward) compared with empirical correlation models.
a30036c3f77b47603c0b5cdc93bf878830216ef0.data: Meteorological and solar radiation data from stations in India.
a30036c3f77b47603c0b5cdc93bf878830216ef0.result: The neural network estimates monthly mean daily and hourly global radiation more accurately than the correlation models.
a30036c3f77b47603c0b5cdc93bf878830216ef0.open_work: More stations and climates; generalization to unseen locations.
a30036c3f77b47603c0b5cdc93bf878830216ef0.issues: No abstract available; error statistics are not reported here.

f31eaf066bc755f7e8b53923dc265514d4c9c201.goal: Retrieves atmospheric water vapor, cloud liquid water path, surface temperature and microwave emissivities over land, where variable surface emissivity hampers retrievals.
f31eaf066bc755f7e8b53923dc265514d4c9c201.architecture: Neural network inversion that uses a first-guess estimate as additional input to regularize the retrieval.
f31eaf066bc755f7e8b53923dc265514d4c9c201.data: SSM/I satellite microwave observations with first-guess information from ancillary datasets (e.g. ISCCP and TOVS-type products).
f31eaf066bc755f7e8b53923dc265514d4c9c201.result: Including the first guess substantially improves retrieval accuracy over land compared with a network without it.
f31eaf066bc755f7e8b53923dc265514d4c9c201.open_work: Applying to other sensors and global, long-term processing.
f31eaf066bc755f7e8b53923dc265514d4c9c201.issues: Accuracy depends on first-guess quality; training relies on simulated or ancillary data with their own biases.

f6d90737e835e7e6728961f79a3b2bbfa00ae197.goal: Tests neural networks for estimating, forecasting and extrapolating river flows.
f6d90737e835e7e6728961f79a3b2bbfa00ae197.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward), compared with conventional stochastic models.
f6d90737e835e7e6728961f79a3b2bbfa00ae197.data: River flow records from rivers in Turkey.
f6d90737e835e7e6728961f79a3b2bbfa00ae197.result: Neural networks estimate and forecast flows better than stochastic models, but extrapolation beyond the training range is limited.
f6d90737e835e7e6728961f79a3b2bbfa00ae197.open_work: Methods to improve extrapolation to extreme flows.
f6d90737e835e7e6728961f79a3b2bbfa00ae197.issues: Poor extrapolation beyond observed ranges; no abstract available, so error figures are not reported here.

58071c0e99069c983b1b6a10aa88ec47845a534c.goal: Compares rain gauge, radar and satellite mean areal precipitation estimates and their value for hydrologic forecasting.
58071c0e99069c983b1b6a10aa88ec47845a534c.architecture: Not an ML method itself: comparison study that evaluates the PERSIANN neural-network satellite precipitation product and drives the SAC-SMA conceptual hydrologic model.
58071c0e99069c983b1b6a10aa88ec47845a534c.data: Gauge MAP (MAPG), radar/gauge multisensor MAP (MAPX) and PERSIANN satellite MAP (MAPS), March 2000 to November 2003, seven basins in the southeastern United States.
58071c0e99069c983b1b6a10aa88ec47845a534c.result: Agreement between datasets varies strongly across basins and in time; PERSIANN-driven flows depend on calibration, with recalibration on satellite data improving simulations.
58071c0e99069c983b1b6a10aa88ec47845a534c.open_work: Bias correction of satellite estimates and assessment in more basins and climates.
58071c0e99069c983b1b6a10aa88ec47845a534c.issues: Short record; satellite estimates show basin-dependent biases; lumped model only.

6a4f5c6e6ebb2a19065bd91eae39f9ef4e34453c.goal: Compares the generalization of support vector machines and neural networks for runoff modeling.
6a4f5c6e6ebb2a19065bd91eae39f9ef4e34453c.architecture: Support vector machine regression compared with artificial neural networks.
6a4f5c6e6ebb2a19065bd91eae39f9ef4e34453c.data: Rainfall and runoff data from a river basin in Iran (Bakhtiyari); details not reported here.
6a4f5c6e6ebb2a19065bd91eae39f9ef4e34453c.result: Support vector machines generalize better than neural networks for runoff prediction.
6a4f5c6e6ebb2a19065bd91eae39f9ef4e34453c.open_work: Testing on more basins and with longer records.
6a4f5c6e6ebb2a19065bd91eae39f9ef4e34453c.issues: No abstract available; single basin and error statistics not reported here.

7a908ec26b679edb49c79c49321dffa948a2c4ed.goal: Models and estimates daily global solar radiation from meteorological data at a site lacking radiation measurements.
7a908ec26b679edb49c79c49321dffa948a2c4ed.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) models with different input combinations.
7a908ec26b679edb49c79c49321dffa948a2c4ed.data: Daily meteorological and global solar radiation data from Al-Madinah, Saudi Arabia.
7a908ec26b679edb49c79c49321dffa948a2c4ed.result: The best ANN model uses sunshine duration and air temperature as inputs and agrees well with measurements, outperforming empirical models.
7a908ec26b679edb49c79c49321dffa948a2c4ed.open_work: Testing at other Saudi sites and different climates.
7a908ec26b679edb49c79c49321dffa948a2c4ed.issues: Single site; no abstract available, so error statistics are not reported here.

9f6464cfc5ec7ba2d442f950e4f13f73344e5465.goal: Automatically detects and removes non-precipitating echoes (ground clutter, anomalous propagation) from weather radar data.
9f6464cfc5ec7ba2d442f950e4f13f73344e5465.architecture: Rule-based (non-ML) algorithm using three-dimensional reflectivity structure (echo depth, vertical gradient and spatial variability) with decision thresholds.
9f6464cfc5ec7ba2d442f950e4f13f73344e5465.data: Volume-scan reflectivity data from WSR-88D weather radars.
9f6464cfc5ec7ba2d442f950e4f13f73344e5465.result: The algorithm effectively removes anomalous-propagation and clutter echoes while retaining precipitation.
9f6464cfc5ec7ba2d442f950e4f13f73344e5465.open_work: Combining with Doppler velocity and polarimetric information.
9f6464cfc5ec7ba2d442f950e4f13f73344e5465.issues: Threshold-based rules may misclassify shallow precipitation or embedded clutter.

1cb875f67cd95e9e81501c8741e9320753be061b.goal: Improves statistical models of surface ozone by capturing non-linear relationships with meteorology.
1cb875f67cd95e9e81501c8741e9320753be061b.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks compared with linear regression and regression tree (CART) models.
1cb875f67cd95e9e81501c8741e9320753be061b.data: Hourly surface ozone and meteorological data from UK monitoring sites.
1cb875f67cd95e9e81501c8741e9320753be061b.result: The MLP captures non-linear ozone-meteorology relationships and outperforms linear regression and regression trees.
1cb875f67cd95e9e81501c8741e9320753be061b.open_work: Use in forecasting and trend analysis with meteorological adjustment.
1cb875f67cd95e9e81501c8741e9320753be061b.issues: Site-specific models; no abstract available, so scores are not reported here.

d46a38425384f61f8af45029b6a86f370d9d9205.goal: Assesses support vector machines for forecasting ambient air pollutant trends.
d46a38425384f61f8af45029b6a86f370d9d9205.architecture: Support vector machine regression compared with a radial basis function neural network.
d46a38425384f61f8af45029b6a86f370d9d9205.data: Air pollutant monitoring data from Hong Kong.
d46a38425384f61f8af45029b6a86f370d9d9205.result: The support vector machine forecasts pollutant levels better than the RBF network and generalizes well.
d46a38425384f61f8af45029b6a86f370d9d9205.open_work: Systematic parameter selection and multi-station application.
d46a38425384f61f8af45029b6a86f370d9d9205.issues: Limited sites; no abstract available, so error figures are not reported here.

1a69ed5dd8a5d137c8dd19569a9ede1bb99f13e1.goal: Forecasts nonstationary hydrological time series such as streamflow and lake levels.
1a69ed5dd8a5d137c8dd19569a9ede1bb99f13e1.architecture: Recurrent neural network (dynamic, nonlinear) compared with other nonlinear and linear models.
1a69ed5dd8a5d137c8dd19569a9ede1bb99f13e1.data: Nonstationary hydrological series (streamflow and lake water levels); sites not reported here.
1a69ed5dd8a5d137c8dd19569a9ede1bb99f13e1.result: Dynamic recurrent networks forecast nonstationary series better than the comparison models.
1a69ed5dd8a5d137c8dd19569a9ede1bb99f13e1.open_work: Longer lead times and uncertainty estimation.
1a69ed5dd8a5d137c8dd19569a9ede1bb99f13e1.issues: No abstract available; data sets and scores are not reported here.

6ff980489e68bffada2747ecca0a42ab133c42b1.goal: Forecasts monthly river flows for reservoir operation.
6ff980489e68bffada2747ecca0a42ab133c42b1.architecture: Recurrent neural network compared with a feedforward neural network.
6ff980489e68bffada2747ecca0a42ab133c42b1.data: Monthly river flow records from a river in India (Hemavathi); details not reported here.
6ff980489e68bffada2747ecca0a42ab133c42b1.result: The recurrent network forecasts monthly flows better than the feedforward network.
6ff980489e68bffada2747ecca0a42ab133c42b1.open_work: Extending to longer horizons and other rivers.
6ff980489e68bffada2747ecca0a42ab133c42b1.issues: No abstract available; single river and error figures are not reported here.

1a105b9b4129d03c12cea42b080aaf261d9726d5.goal: Downscales monthly precipitation to a river basin in India under IPCC SRES scenarios.
1a105b9b4129d03c12cea42b080aaf261d9726d5.architecture: Support vector machine regression (least-squares SVM) statistical downscaling model.
1a105b9b4129d03c12cea42b080aaf261d9726d5.data: NCEP/NCAR reanalysis predictors for calibration and CGCM2 GCM output for SRES scenarios; Malaprabha basin, India.
1a105b9b4129d03c12cea42b080aaf261d9726d5.result: The SVM downscaling reproduces observed precipitation well and projects changes in basin precipitation under the SRES scenarios.
1a105b9b4129d03c12cea42b080aaf261d9726d5.open_work: Using multiple GCMs and addressing downscaling uncertainty.
1a105b9b4129d03c12cea42b080aaf261d9726d5.issues: Single GCM; stationarity of predictor-predictand relations assumed.

20b691d0cca49c803141dcc8f27de3f1bbfee400.goal: Evaluates a high-resolution satellite rainfall product over complex terrain in the North American Monsoon region.
20b691d0cca49c803141dcc8f27de3f1bbfee400.architecture: Not an ML method itself: evaluation of PERSIANN-CCS, a neural-network-based cloud-classification satellite rainfall algorithm.
20b691d0cca49c803141dcc8f27de3f1bbfee400.data: PERSIANN-CCS estimates and the NAME event rain gauge network over the Sierra Madre Occidental, Mexico, 2004 monsoon.
20b691d0cca49c803141dcc8f27de3f1bbfee400.result: PERSIANN-CCS captures the diurnal cycle and spatial patterns but shows elevation-dependent biases, underestimating at high elevations.
20b691d0cca49c803141dcc8f27de3f1bbfee400.open_work: Terrain-aware corrections and combining with gauge data.
20b691d0cca49c803141dcc8f27de3f1bbfee400.issues: Single season and region; gauge representativeness limits evaluation.

91f597dc0e013db8242532e5c2906c1e049b2d98.goal: Extracts patterns of ocean current variability on the West Florida Shelf.
91f597dc0e013db8242532e5c2906c1e049b2d98.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) applied to current velocity profiles, compared with EOF analysis.
91f597dc0e013db8242532e5c2906c1e049b2d98.data: Moored ADCP velocity time series on the West Florida Shelf.
91f597dc0e013db8242532e5c2906c1e049b2d98.result: The SOM identifies asymmetric upwelling and downwelling current patterns and their links to wind forcing better than EOF analysis.
91f597dc0e013db8242532e5c2906c1e049b2d98.open_work: Applying SOMs to other shelf regions and model outputs.
91f597dc0e013db8242532e5c2906c1e049b2d98.issues: Diagnostic study; results depend on SOM size choices.

28f0777a50c408e061d6ee7d195866b80af2fe61.goal: Demonstrates self-organizing maps for identifying patterns in satellite imagery time series.
28f0777a50c408e061d6ee7d195866b80af2fe61.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) applied to sequences of satellite images.
28f0777a50c408e061d6ee7d195866b80af2fe61.data: Satellite sea-surface temperature imagery of the Benguela upwelling system off southern Africa.
28f0777a50c408e061d6ee7d195866b80af2fe61.result: The SOM extracts characteristic SST patterns and their temporal occurrence, revealing upwelling variability.
28f0777a50c408e061d6ee7d195866b80af2fe61.open_work: Extending to multivariate and other ocean colour or wind imagery.
28f0777a50c408e061d6ee7d195866b80af2fe61.issues: Exploratory pattern analysis; SOM configuration choices affect patterns.

c8369fd475331217a6e8b4a0bc925269d2acbf53.goal: Models real-time reservoir operation decisions using intelligent control.
c8369fd475331217a6e8b4a0bc925269d2acbf53.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) to derive reservoir release rules.
c8369fd475331217a6e8b4a0bc925269d2acbf53.data: Historical operation records of Shihmen Reservoir, Taiwan.
c8369fd475331217a6e8b4a0bc925269d2acbf53.result: The neuro-fuzzy model reproduces operator decisions and provides effective real-time release guidance.
c8369fd475331217a6e8b4a0bc925269d2acbf53.open_work: Inclusion of forecasts and multi-objective operation.
c8369fd475331217a6e8b4a0bc925269d2acbf53.issues: Learned from historical operation, so it inherits past operating practice.

105fcd199906f44037a9ce6001674e3adc4f92fb.goal: Forecasts rainfall using machine learning models.
105fcd199906f44037a9ce6001674e3adc4f92fb.architecture: Recurrent support vector regression with chaotic particle swarm optimization for parameter selection.
105fcd199906f44037a9ce6001674e3adc4f92fb.data: Rainfall records from Taiwan; details not reported here.
105fcd199906f44037a9ce6001674e3adc4f92fb.result: The proposed model forecasts rainfall more accurately than the comparison models.
105fcd199906f44037a9ce6001674e3adc4f92fb.open_work: Testing at more sites and lead times.
105fcd199906f44037a9ce6001674e3adc4f92fb.issues: No abstract available; data and error figures are not reported here.

28b0fb146c693a39a0ad54ad49ceb59a1d9745f3.goal: Improves air pollution time series forecasting by automating neural network design.
28b0fb146c693a39a0ad54ad49ceb59a1d9745f3.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network with a genetic algorithm to select inputs and architecture.
28b0fb146c693a39a0ad54ad49ceb59a1d9745f3.data: Hourly NO2 concentrations and meteorological data from an urban station in Helsinki, Finland.
28b0fb146c693a39a0ad54ad49ceb59a1d9745f3.result: Genetic algorithm-evolved MLPs give competitive forecasts while reducing manual design effort.
28b0fb146c693a39a0ad54ad49ceb59a1d9745f3.open_work: Multi-objective optimization and faster evolutionary search.

a7c798f3813799b0a391430a86647a80ced7d898.goal: Describes a ground-based multichannel microwave radiometric profiler for temperature, humidity and cloud liquid profiles.
a7c798f3813799b0a391430a86647a80ced7d898.architecture: Instrument description; profiles are retrieved from radiometer brightness temperatures with neural network retrieval trained on radiosonde data.
a7c798f3813799b0a391430a86647a80ced7d898.data: Radiometer brightness temperatures with radiosonde data for training and comparison.
a7c798f3813799b0a391430a86647a80ced7d898.result: The profiler provides continuous temperature, humidity and cloud liquid profiles in reasonable agreement with radiosondes.
a7c798f3813799b0a391430a86647a80ced7d898.open_work: Combining with other sensors and data assimilation.
a7c798f3813799b0a391430a86647a80ced7d898.issues: Vertical resolution degrades with height; retrievals depend on climatological training data.

fe05938b3fcc18e19355852a8326479c40c990da.goal: Simulates suspended sediment load in a river from hydrometeorological data, since sediment transport is hard to describe physically and rating curves are often inaccurate.
fe05938b3fcc18e19355852a8326479c40c990da.architecture: Compares two artificial neural network types: a feedforward backpropagation MLP and a radial basis function (RBF) network, using rainfall and flow as inputs.
fe05938b3fcc18e19355852a8326479c40c990da.data: Daily rainfall, river flow and suspended sediment records from a river basin in the USA (Juniata River basin); exact periods not reported here.
fe05938b3fcc18e19355852a8326479c40c990da.result: Both neural networks simulate sediment load satisfactorily and outperform conventional approaches such as sediment rating curves and regression; the RBF network trains without iterative weight optimization.
fe05938b3fcc18e19355852a8326479c40c990da.open_work: Testing on more basins, longer lead times and extreme sediment events, and hybridizing with physically based sediment models.
fe05938b3fcc18e19355852a8326479c40c990da.issues: Single-basin daily data; peak sediment events are few and tend to be underestimated; no uncertainty quantification; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

02b934a2ed8bfca1bfc244d7ed08fb2a18657d54.goal: Forecasts river stages in Bangladesh several days ahead to support flood warning in a large, flood-prone delta river system.
02b934a2ed8bfca1bfc244d7ed08fb2a18657d54.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation, using water levels at upstream gauging stations as inputs; sensitivity analysis is used to reduce the number of input stations.
02b934a2ed8bfca1bfc244d7ed08fb2a18657d54.data: Daily water level records from gauging stations on the Bangladesh river network (Dhaka region forecast point); exact periods not reported here.
02b934a2ed8bfca1bfc244d7ed08fb2a18657d54.result: The network forecasts stages with high accuracy at short lead times, with accuracy decreasing for longer horizons up to about a week; few key upstream stations suffice as inputs.
02b934a2ed8bfca1bfc244d7ed08fb2a18657d54.open_work: Including rainfall and upstream transboundary information, and extending to multiple forecast points and longer lead times.
02b934a2ed8bfca1bfc244d7ed08fb2a18657d54.issues: Single forecast location and station-based inputs only; performance degrades with lead time; no probabilistic output; abstract unavailable.

c5319c399d9619952d2c89a242fbcbc1b47c5952.goal: Builds effective and efficient rainfall-runoff models by combining conceptual (deterministic) components with data-driven learning, aiming to better reproduce both low and high flows.
c5319c399d9619952d2c89a242fbcbc1b47c5952.architecture: Hybrid approach integrating deterministic/conceptual modelling, a real-coded genetic algorithm for training, and artificial neural networks (feedforward MLP); compared with backpropagation-trained ANNs and conceptual models.
c5319c399d9619952d2c89a242fbcbc1b47c5952.data: Daily rainfall and streamflow from the Kentucky River basin, USA; exact training and testing periods not reported here.
c5319c399d9619952d2c89a242fbcbc1b47c5952.result: The integrated models, particularly ANNs trained with real-coded genetic algorithms, improve the simulation of low-magnitude flows relative to backpropagation-trained networks while keeping good peak-flow performance.
c5319c399d9619952d2c89a242fbcbc1b47c5952.open_work: Decomposing the hydrograph into segments with separate models and testing the integration in other basins and with uncertainty estimates.
c5319c399d9619952d2c89a242fbcbc1b47c5952.issues: Single basin; genetic-algorithm training is computationally heavier; deterministic components embed simplifying assumptions; no uncertainty quantification; abstract unavailable.

98830b1a7d7cf83d2afee5fe60c2ed42f20c7398.goal: Monitors wind farm power output by building reference power curve models whose deviations can flag abnormal turbine or farm behaviour.
98830b1a7d7cf83d2afee5fe60c2ed42f20c7398.architecture: Data-driven power curve models, including parametric fits and a nonparametric k-nearest neighbour model, combined with statistical process control charts on the residuals for monitoring.
98830b1a7d7cf83d2afee5fe60c2ed42f20c7398.data: SCADA data (wind speed and power) collected at a commercial wind farm; exact period not reported here.
98830b1a7d7cf83d2afee5fe60c2ed42f20c7398.result: The nonparametric k-nearest neighbour model fits the farm power curve better than the parametric models, and residual-based control charts detect abnormal power output.
98830b1a7d7cf83d2afee5fe60c2ed42f20c7398.open_work: Turbine-level monitoring, use of additional SCADA variables and online model updating.
98830b1a7d7cf83d2afee5fe60c2ed42f20c7398.issues: Single wind farm; power curve depends on site and season; fault labels for validation are limited; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

f03b48add85bc6d697cdd8aaf4bfa34a78af5f08.goal: Applies neural networks to hydrological forecasting of river flows or stages in real time, as an alternative to physically based or statistical models.
f03b48add85bc6d697cdd8aaf4bfa34a78af5f08.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural networks (MLP); training algorithm details are not reported here.
f03b48add85bc6d697cdd8aaf4bfa34a78af5f08.data: Observed hydrological time series from an Indian river basin; details not reported in the available metadata.
f03b48add85bc6d697cdd8aaf4bfa34a78af5f08.result: Neural networks produce forecasts of satisfactory accuracy for short lead times, comparable or superior to traditional statistical approaches.
f03b48add85bc6d697cdd8aaf4bfa34a78af5f08.open_work: Longer lead times, comparison of training schemes and integration of rainfall inputs.
f03b48add85bc6d697cdd8aaf4bfa34a78af5f08.issues: Abstract unavailable; data, lead times and metrics are not reported here; card is a general assessment.

08c4eef2c60258adc2d99fa14f0e797caec4942e.goal: Compares static-feedforward and dynamic-feedback neural networks for rainfall-runoff modelling, to see which handles limited data and flood dynamics better.
08c4eef2c60258adc2d99fa14f0e797caec4942e.architecture: Static feedforward networks (MLP) trained with standard backpropagation and conjugate gradient, versus a dynamic recurrent neural network trained by real-time recurrent learning (RTRL).
08c4eef2c60258adc2d99fa14f0e797caec4942e.data: Hourly rainfall and streamflow from flood events in the Lan-Yang River basin, Taiwan.
08c4eef2c60258adc2d99fa14f0e797caec4942e.result: Conjugate gradient trains static networks more efficiently and accurately than standard backpropagation; the recurrent network gives better forecasts when training data are scarce.
08c4eef2c60258adc2d99fa14f0e797caec4942e.open_work: Extending to longer lead times and more basins, and combining recurrent structures with improved training algorithms.
08c4eef2c60258adc2d99fa14f0e797caec4942e.issues: Limited number of flood events; single basin; deterministic forecasts only; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

68dfe605f21f6b1dd31d5ad1c028934d9169b54f.goal: Assesses and predicts tropospheric (ground-level) ozone concentrations and the relative influence of meteorological conditions and precursor pollutants.
68dfe605f21f6b1dd31d5ad1c028934d9169b54f.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation, with connection-weight analysis used to rank input importance.
68dfe605f21f6b1dd31d5ad1c028934d9169b54f.data: Hourly ozone, precursor pollutant (NOx, CO, hydrocarbons) and meteorological measurements from a monitoring station in Kuwait.
68dfe605f21f6b1dd31d5ad1c028934d9169b54f.result: The neural network predicts ozone levels well and shows that both meteorological factors and precursor pollutants contribute substantially to ozone formation.
68dfe605f21f6b1dd31d5ad1c028934d9169b54f.open_work: Combining with input-selection methods and testing at other stations and seasons.
68dfe605f21f6b1dd31d5ad1c028934d9169b54f.issues: Single monitoring site; input importance from network weights is approximate; no uncertainty estimates; abstract unavailable.

8da408701de427af0c8236c488c6659402ecab65.goal: Investigates how to identify suitable support vector machine configurations for rainfall-runoff modelling, a then-new technique in hydrology.
8da408701de427af0c8236c488c6659402ecab65.architecture: Support vector machine regression (SVR), exploring kernel functions, model parameters and input structures for runoff prediction.
8da408701de427af0c8236c488c6659402ecab65.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a single test catchment; details not reported in the available metadata.
8da408701de427af0c8236c488c6659402ecab65.result: SVMs can model runoff well, but performance is sensitive to kernel and parameter choice and input structure, so a systematic identification procedure is needed.
8da408701de427af0c8236c488c6659402ecab65.open_work: Automatic parameter selection and comparison with neural networks across many catchments.
8da408701de427af0c8236c488c6659402ecab65.issues: Single catchment; parameter tuning by trial; computationally demanding search; abstract unavailable.

78f02553e7098ee07ff98d7cc5cb032fe30eca5d.goal: Examines whether hidden units of a rainfall-runoff artificial neural network represent recognizable conceptual hydrological processes, to address the black-box criticism.
78f02553e7098ee07ff98d7cc5cb032fe30eca5d.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) rainfall-runoff model whose hidden-node outputs are analysed and compared with conceptual model components.
78f02553e7098ee07ff98d7cc5cb032fe30eca5d.data: Daily rainfall, evaporation and streamflow from a UK catchment (River Test basin); exact periods not reported here.
78f02553e7098ee07ff98d7cc5cb032fe30eca5d.result: Individual hidden nodes show behaviour resembling baseflow, quickflow and seasonal soil-moisture components, suggesting the network implicitly captures conceptual runoff processes.
78f02553e7098ee07ff98d7cc5cb032fe30eca5d.open_work: More rigorous interpretation methods and application to catchments with contrasting hydrological regimes.
78f02553e7098ee07ff98d7cc5cb032fe30eca5d.issues: Interpretation is qualitative and depends on network size and training; single catchment; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

de4d98c85ca03d579c528cbe0c213c085e688f0b.goal: Forecasts reference evapotranspiration (ET0) for irrigation planning using neural networks instead of meteorological equations that require future weather data.
de4d98c85ca03d579c528cbe0c213c085e688f0b.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) neural network trained sequentially (adaptively) for time-series forecasting of ET0, compared with ARIMA models.
de4d98c85ca03d579c528cbe0c213c085e688f0b.data: Monthly ET0 computed with the FAO Penman-Monteith equation from meteorological records at Niš, Serbia.
de4d98c85ca03d579c528cbe0c213c085e688f0b.result: The RBF network forecasts monthly ET0 more accurately than ARIMA models.
de4d98c85ca03d579c528cbe0c213c085e688f0b.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates, and shorter time steps such as daily forecasts.
de4d98c85ca03d579c528cbe0c213c085e688f0b.issues: Single station; target is a computed ET0 rather than measured evapotranspiration; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

c04e3bff709a9b187313e18a842116bae4f9bfbb.goal: Compares neural network types for rainfall-runoff modelling to guide the choice of architecture.
c04e3bff709a9b187313e18a842116bae4f9bfbb.architecture: Compares a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) with a recurrent neural network (RNN) for flow forecasting.
c04e3bff709a9b187313e18a842116bae4f9bfbb.data: Rainfall and runoff records from an Indian river basin; details not reported in the available metadata.
c04e3bff709a9b187313e18a842116bae4f9bfbb.result: Both network types model runoff adequately; the recurrent network performs better, especially for multi-step-ahead forecasts.
c04e3bff709a9b187313e18a842116bae4f9bfbb.open_work: Broader comparisons with other dynamic architectures and basins, and longer lead times.
c04e3bff709a9b187313e18a842116bae4f9bfbb.issues: Single basin; limited comparison of network types; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

0ad2cc7903192da979beb9a2a78dd836e61a3fff.goal: Predicts watershed runoff by combining specialized neural networks, aiming to capture different runoff-generation regimes better than a single network.
0ad2cc7903192da979beb9a2a78dd836e61a3fff.architecture: Modular neural network: several expert feedforward networks combined through a gating network, with Bayesian concepts used to weight expert outputs; compared with single MLPs.
0ad2cc7903192da979beb9a2a78dd836e61a3fff.data: Monthly rainfall, temperature and runoff for three medium-sized watersheds in Kansas, USA.
0ad2cc7903192da979beb9a2a78dd836e61a3fff.result: The modular network predicts runoff better than single feedforward networks, with experts specializing on low, medium and high flow conditions.
0ad2cc7903192da979beb9a2a78dd836e61a3fff.open_work: Applying modular networks at finer time steps and with explicit predictive uncertainty.
0ad2cc7903192da979beb9a2a78dd836e61a3fff.issues: Monthly scale only; few watersheds; more parameters to train; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

8bbdbc04bb5e1d182fb0d18a01e71649740dad4c.goal: Estimates the uncertainty of wind power forecasts so that operators and market participants can manage risk.
8bbdbc04bb5e1d182fb0d18a01e71649740dad4c.architecture: Statistical methods, not primarily machine learning: adaptive resampling to produce probabilistic intervals around point forecasts, and risk indices derived from ensemble weather forecasts; doctoral thesis.
8bbdbc04bb5e1d182fb0d18a01e71649740dad4c.data: Wind power measurements and point forecasts from wind farms in Europe, plus numerical weather prediction ensemble forecasts.
8bbdbc04bb5e1d182fb0d18a01e71649740dad4c.result: Adaptive resampling yields reliable, sharp prediction intervals, and ensemble-based risk indices indicate the expected forecast error level.
8bbdbc04bb5e1d182fb0d18a01e71649740dad4c.open_work: Use of uncertainty information in operational decision-making and trading, and spatio-temporal dependence of errors.
8bbdbc04bb5e1d182fb0d18a01e71649740dad4c.issues: Focused on specific wind farms and forecast systems; methodology largely non-ML; abstract unavailable.

50fb52552fd0a83276f33081992e50068c0e8e03.goal: Predicts Houston's daily maximum ozone concentrations to support air-quality warnings and compliance with ozone standards.
50fb52552fd0a83276f33081992e50068c0e8e03.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) compared with Box-Jenkins ARIMA and multiple regression models.
50fb52552fd0a83276f33081992e50068c0e8e03.data: Daily maximum ozone and meteorological variables measured in Houston, Texas.
50fb52552fd0a83276f33081992e50068c0e8e03.result: The neural network predicts daily maximum ozone better than the ARIMA and regression models.
50fb52552fd0a83276f33081992e50068c0e8e03.open_work: Extending to other cities, exceedance forecasting and use of forecast rather than observed meteorology.
50fb52552fd0a83276f33081992e50068c0e8e03.issues: Single city; small dataset; deterministic predictions; abstract unavailable.

dd8b40e65c618cc1d11aca1157716199c430ae54.goal: Estimates hourly diffuse solar radiation at the surface in São Paulo, Brazil, where diffuse measurements are scarce.
dd8b40e65c618cc1d11aca1157716199c430ae54.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) using global solar radiation and other surface meteorological variables as inputs, compared with empirical regression.
dd8b40e65c618cc1d11aca1157716199c430ae54.data: Hourly radiation and meteorological measurements from a surface station in the city of São Paulo.
dd8b40e65c618cc1d11aca1157716199c430ae54.result: The neural network reproduces hourly diffuse radiation better than regression-based correlation models.
dd8b40e65c618cc1d11aca1157716199c430ae54.open_work: Application to other urban sites and use of satellite-derived inputs.
dd8b40e65c618cc1d11aca1157716199c430ae54.issues: Single station; depends on measured global radiation as input; abstract unavailable.

58fddf4509b76f36c74478841c193a550b6ba446.goal: Improves river flow prediction with neural networks by better use of limited training data.
58fddf4509b76f36c74478841c193a550b6ba446.architecture: Feedforward neural networks (MLP) trained with three backpropagation variants (gradient descent, conjugate gradient, Levenberg-Marquardt) combined with k-fold partitioning of the training data.
58fddf4509b76f36c74478841c193a550b6ba446.data: Daily streamflow records from rivers in Turkey; exact stations not reported here.
58fddf4509b76f36c74478841c193a550b6ba446.result: K-fold partitioning of training data improves flow prediction compared with conventional training, and Levenberg-Marquardt trains fastest.
58fddf4509b76f36c74478841c193a550b6ba446.open_work: Testing on more rivers and comparison with other data-driven models.
58fddf4509b76f36c74478841c193a550b6ba446.issues: Limited number of stations; no uncertainty estimates; abstract unavailable.

3ad44a7e43dcccdf858d2094105615918cedebe7.goal: Forecasts wind farm generation up to 48 hours ahead using meteorological forecast information.
3ad44a7e43dcccdf858d2094105615918cedebe7.architecture: Two-stage hybrid: Bayesian clustering by dynamics partitions input data into regimes, then support vector regression (SVR) models fitted to each cluster.
3ad44a7e43dcccdf858d2094105615918cedebe7.data: Wind farm generation records and numerical weather prediction meteorological forecasts for a wind farm; exact period not reported here.
3ad44a7e43dcccdf858d2094105615918cedebe7.result: The two-stage model forecasts wind generation more accurately than single-stage models such as a single SVR or neural network.
3ad44a7e43dcccdf858d2094105615918cedebe7.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and application to multiple farms.
3ad44a7e43dcccdf858d2094105615918cedebe7.issues: Single wind farm; depends on NWP quality; deterministic forecasts only; abstract unavailable.

af409f728ef64912538dec82b533b8167e3035e5.goal: Models nonlinear pan evaporation and evapotranspiration processes from meteorological data where physical estimation is difficult.
af409f728ef64912538dec82b533b8167e3035e5.architecture: Generalized regression neural network (GRNN) with model parameters optimized by a genetic algorithm, compared with other neural networks and empirical equations.
af409f728ef64912538dec82b533b8167e3035e5.data: Daily meteorological data and pan evaporation/alfalfa reference evapotranspiration from stations in South Korea.
af409f728ef64912538dec82b533b8167e3035e5.result: The genetic-algorithm-optimized GRNN models evaporation and evapotranspiration more accurately than the compared empirical methods.
af409f728ef64912538dec82b533b8167e3035e5.open_work: Testing in other climates and including uncertainty analysis.
af409f728ef64912538dec82b533b8167e3035e5.issues: Few stations; target alfalfa ET derived from equations; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

c290c86a82f607784f7f5aef159d1a20b098d81b.goal: Forecasts river flow with artificial neural networks and compares them with a conceptual rainfall-runoff model.
c290c86a82f607784f7f5aef159d1a20b098d81b.architecture: Feedforward neural networks: multilayer perceptron (MLP) and radial basis function (RBF) networks, compared with a conceptual rainfall-runoff model.
c290c86a82f607784f7f5aef159d1a20b098d81b.data: Daily rainfall and river flow from a catchment in the Apure River basin, Venezuela.
c290c86a82f607784f7f5aef159d1a20b098d81b.result: Neural networks perform slightly better than the conceptual model for daily river flow forecasting.
c290c86a82f607784f7f5aef159d1a20b098d81b.open_work: Combining data-driven and conceptual models and extending lead times.
c290c86a82f607784f7f5aef159d1a20b098d81b.issues: Single catchment; deterministic forecasts; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

0efcfaff6878718cd472de2354460413701fdd41.goal: Assesses surface fine particulate matter (PM2.5) air quality by integrating satellite aerosol retrievals with meteorological and surface data.
0efcfaff6878718cd472de2354460413701fdd41.architecture: Statistical and machine learning estimation, including multiple regression and a feedforward neural network relating satellite aerosol optical depth and meteorology to PM2.5.
0efcfaff6878718cd472de2354460413701fdd41.data: MODIS aerosol optical depth, meteorological analysis fields and ground-based PM2.5 measurements over the southeastern United States.
0efcfaff6878718cd472de2354460413701fdd41.result: Combining satellite AOD with meteorological variables improves PM2.5 estimates over AOD alone, with the neural network outperforming regression.
0efcfaff6878718cd472de2354460413701fdd41.open_work: Extending to other regions and seasons and to finer satellite products.
0efcfaff6878718cd472de2354460413701fdd41.issues: Satellite retrieval gaps under clouds; regional training; abstract unavailable and the exact part of the two-part study is uncertain.

9b49005605b5f451541c86ea283d28b0ae4be78c.goal: Estimates solar radiation over Turkey where ground measurements are sparse, using satellite information.
9b49005605b5f451541c86ea283d28b0ae4be78c.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) using satellite-derived and geographical inputs, compared with a physical model.
9b49005605b5f451541c86ea283d28b0ae4be78c.data: Satellite data and ground solar radiation measurements at stations across Turkey.
9b49005605b5f451541c86ea283d28b0ae4be78c.result: The neural network estimates solar radiation more accurately than the physical method.
9b49005605b5f451541c86ea283d28b0ae4be78c.open_work: Mapping solar radiation across Turkey and using longer satellite records.
9b49005605b5f451541c86ea283d28b0ae4be78c.issues: Limited number of stations; abstract unavailable.

58799545c8f5f782df07abb65ec981adf7eb81a1.goal: Forecasts wind speed on the south coast of Oaxaca, Mexico, a region with large wind energy potential.
58799545c8f5f782df07abb65ec981adf7eb81a1.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward MLP) applied to wind speed time series.
58799545c8f5f782df07abb65ec981adf7eb81a1.data: Wind speed measurements from a site in the La Venta area of Oaxaca, Mexico.
58799545c8f5f782df07abb65ec981adf7eb81a1.result: Simple neural networks forecast wind speed with acceptable accuracy using few input lags.
58799545c8f5f782df07abb65ec981adf7eb81a1.open_work: Comparison with statistical time-series models and longer forecast horizons.
58799545c8f5f782df07abb65ec981adf7eb81a1.issues: Single site; limited inputs; abstract unavailable.

290418b6f4361332f62f68ebbad23ede176c80cc.goal: Explores one-step-ahead daily streamflow forecasting, a challenging task central to water resources system control.
290418b6f4361332f62f68ebbad23ede176c80cc.architecture: Self-Organizing Radial Basis (SORB) function network: a Gaussian radial basis function architecture combined with a self-organizing feature map (SOM); compared with a multilayer feedforward network (MLP), SOLO and linear regression.
290418b6f4361332f62f68ebbad23ede176c80cc.data: Daily streamflow from the semi-arid Salt River basin, Arizona; cross-validation compared with split-sample testing.
290418b6f4361332f62f68ebbad23ede176c80cc.result: SORB outperforms the MLP and SOLO networks for daily streamflow; linear regression is unreliable; cross-validation confirms the nonlinear input-output relationship.
290418b6f4361332f62f68ebbad23ede176c80cc.open_work: Extending to multi-step forecasts and other basins.
290418b6f4361332f62f68ebbad23ede176c80cc.issues: Single basin; one-step-ahead only; deterministic forecasts.

c7818aa379a22dbb5d45ec34a3cb4229801a06f7.goal: Applies support vector machines to flood forecasting and examines their strengths and weaknesses compared with established methods.
c7818aa379a22dbb5d45ec34a3cb4229801a06f7.architecture: Support vector machine regression (SVR) for flood flow forecasting, compared with benchmark models.
c7818aa379a22dbb5d45ec34a3cb4229801a06f7.data: Rainfall and flow records from the Bird Creek catchment, USA.
c7818aa379a22dbb5d45ec34a3cb4229801a06f7.result: SVMs forecast floods well at short lead times but are sensitive to parameter selection and input choice, and performance degrades at longer lead times.
c7818aa379a22dbb5d45ec34a3cb4229801a06f7.open_work: Better parameter selection and handling of longer lead times.
c7818aa379a22dbb5d45ec34a3cb4229801a06f7.issues: Single catchment; limited extreme events; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

ae1e506030fcb53e93d577a84d5282f3b1c0181a.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels in space and time in an aquifer where water level data are sparse.
ae1e506030fcb53e93d577a84d5282f3b1c0181a.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) for temporal forecasting at observation wells, combined with geostatistical interpolation (kriging) for spatial estimation.
ae1e506030fcb53e93d577a84d5282f3b1c0181a.data: Groundwater level, rainfall and related data from observation wells in a plain in Iran.
ae1e506030fcb53e93d577a84d5282f3b1c0181a.result: The ANN-based model forecasts groundwater levels accurately and, combined with spatial interpolation, provides spatiotemporal maps.
ae1e506030fcb53e93d577a84d5282f3b1c0181a.open_work: Including pumping and other hydrogeological inputs and testing in other aquifers.
ae1e506030fcb53e93d577a84d5282f3b1c0181a.issues: Single aquifer; spatial accuracy limited by well density; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

9bcebec4a44160feff49f0fc3fecfed56e052aff.goal: Estimates flood quantiles at ungauged sites through regional flood frequency analysis.
9bcebec4a44160feff49f0fc3fecfed56e052aff.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), compared with artificial neural networks and regression-based regional methods.
9bcebec4a44160feff49f0fc3fecfed56e052aff.data: Flood quantiles and physiographic/climatic characteristics for gauging stations in Quebec, Canada.
9bcebec4a44160feff49f0fc3fecfed56e052aff.result: ANFIS estimates flood quantiles at ungauged sites more accurately than the compared ANN and regression methods.
9bcebec4a44160feff49f0fc3fecfed56e052aff.open_work: Extension to other regions and inclusion of uncertainty in quantile estimates.
9bcebec4a44160feff49f0fc3fecfed56e052aff.issues: Regional dataset; quantile targets come from at-site fits; abstract unavailable.

72191304075714bd8e997cb10fbab2e1b4453822.goal: Estimates solar potential across Turkey from meteorological and geographical data where radiation measurements are missing.
72191304075714bd8e997cb10fbab2e1b4453822.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with several backpropagation algorithms using latitude, longitude, altitude, month, sunshine duration and temperature.
72191304075714bd8e997cb10fbab2e1b4453822.data: Meteorological and solar radiation data from stations of the Turkish State Meteorological Service.
72191304075714bd8e997cb10fbab2e1b4453822.result: The neural network estimates solar radiation with good accuracy, supporting mapping of solar potential in Turkey.
72191304075714bd8e997cb10fbab2e1b4453822.open_work: Using satellite-derived inputs, denser station networks and finer time resolution to map solar potential.
72191304075714bd8e997cb10fbab2e1b4453822.issues: Limited number of stations; monthly mean values only; inputs such as sunshine duration must themselves be measured; abstract unavailable.

6e12d10eec04c7fe2593d89e1351e65c535638b4.goal: Infills missing daily weather records (precipitation and temperature) needed for hydrological modelling.
6e12d10eec04c7fe2593d89e1351e65c535638b4.architecture: Compares several neural network types, including multilayer perceptron (MLP), time-lagged feedforward networks, recurrent neural networks and radial basis function networks.
6e12d10eec04c7fe2593d89e1351e65c535638b4.data: Daily precipitation and maximum/minimum temperature records from weather stations in a watershed in Canada.
6e12d10eec04c7fe2593d89e1351e65c535638b4.result: Neural networks infill missing records well, with MLP and time-lagged networks generally performing best; temperature infilling is more accurate than precipitation.
6e12d10eec04c7fe2593d89e1351e65c535638b4.open_work: Infilling longer gaps, other variables and data-sparse regions, and quantifying the uncertainty of infilled values.
6e12d10eec04c7fe2593d89e1351e65c535638b4.issues: Precipitation infilling remains less accurate than temperature; single region; infilled values carry no uncertainty; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

c8ddc7f3b5e9fe33acc49c7dbb18335b90e4427c.goal: Provides probabilistic climate change projections, addressing large uncertainties and expert-based uncertainty estimates.
c8ddc7f3b5e9fe33acc49c7dbb18335b90e4427c.architecture: Neural network (MLP) based climate model substitute (emulator) for large ensemble runs, with ensemble members constrained by observations.
c8ddc7f3b5e9fe33acc49c7dbb18335b90e4427c.data: Observed surface warming over the industrial period, estimates of global ocean heat uptake, and carbon cycle model outputs.
c8ddc7f3b5e9fe33acc49c7dbb18335b90e4427c.result: The NN substitute speeds up ensembles by at least an order of magnitude; indirect aerosol forcing below about -1.2 W m-2 is excluded; almost half of members exceed the IPCC warming range.
c8ddc7f3b5e9fe33acc49c7dbb18335b90e4427c.open_work: Adding further observational constraints, regional projections and more emission scenarios to narrow projection uncertainty.
c8ddc7f3b5e9fe33acc49c7dbb18335b90e4427c.issues: The emulator inherits the structure and limitations of the underlying intermediate-complexity climate model; projections depend strongly on the assumed upper limit of climate sensitivity.

aab40e767306d2c56dde7eeebf2a1f6f59a7bf39.goal: Estimates and forecasts daily suspended sediment load using wavelet decomposition to improve neural network performance.
aab40e767306d2c56dde7eeebf2a1f6f59a7bf39.architecture: Wavelet-neural network: discrete wavelet transform decomposes flow series into subseries that feed a feedforward neural network (MLP), compared with a conventional ANN and sediment rating curve.
aab40e767306d2c56dde7eeebf2a1f6f59a7bf39.data: Daily river flow and suspended sediment records from US rivers; exact stations not reported here.
aab40e767306d2c56dde7eeebf2a1f6f59a7bf39.result: The wavelet-neural network estimates sediment better than the conventional ANN and rating curve, especially for peak values.
aab40e767306d2c56dde7eeebf2a1f6f59a7bf39.open_work: Systematic selection of wavelet type and decomposition level, and testing on more rivers and multi-step forecasts.
aab40e767306d2c56dde7eeebf2a1f6f59a7bf39.issues: Few stations; results depend on wavelet choice and decomposition level; no uncertainty estimates; abstract unavailable.

79a97c71e5ba33a4d9ddb1490780f49ed4d614fd.goal: Compares self-organizing maps and principal component analysis for extracting climate patterns, testing whether SOMs avoid the mixing artefacts of PCA.
79a97c71e5ba33a4d9ddb1490780f49ed4d614fd.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) compared with principal component analysis on synthetic climatological data with known patterns.
79a97c71e5ba33a4d9ddb1490780f49ed4d614fd.data: Synthetic climatological data with known patterns and added noise, in a polar climate context.
79a97c71e5ba33a4d9ddb1490780f49ed4d614fd.result: SOM extracts known patterns more reliably than PCA, especially with nonlinear or noisy data.
79a97c71e5ba33a4d9ddb1490780f49ed4d614fd.open_work: Applying SOM-based pattern extraction to real climatological and ice-core-related datasets in polar regions.
79a97c71e5ba33a4d9ddb1490780f49ed4d614fd.issues: Conclusions rest on synthetic data with known patterns; SOM results depend on map size and training choices; abstract unavailable.

06f691f436a26681fe7482d31c9b261514b79d81.goal: Forecasts flood water levels in the River Arno to support flood warning for the city of Florence, Italy.
06f691f436a26681fe7482d31c9b261514b79d81.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) for water level forecasting.
06f691f436a26681fe7482d31c9b261514b79d81.data: Rainfall and water level data from the River Arno basin, Italy.
06f691f436a26681fe7482d31c9b261514b79d81.result: The neural network forecasts water levels with good accuracy for short lead times.
06f691f436a26681fe7482d31c9b261514b79d81.open_work: Extending lead times, adding rainfall forecasts and testing on other flood-prone basins.
06f691f436a26681fe7482d31c9b261514b79d81.issues: Single basin; few major flood events for training and validation; deterministic forecasts only; abstract unavailable.

ca22b4847fbd818d9c99e2633c719c03f69599ce.goal: Improves ground-level ozone prediction by combining principal component regression with neural networks to handle correlated inputs and nonlinearity.
ca22b4847fbd818d9c99e2633c719c03f69599ce.architecture: Principal component regression for input selection combined with a feedforward artificial neural network (MLP).
ca22b4847fbd818d9c99e2633c719c03f69599ce.data: Ozone, precursor pollutant and meteorological data from a monitoring station in Kuwait.
ca22b4847fbd818d9c99e2633c719c03f69599ce.result: The combined model predicts ozone better than PCR or regression alone.
ca22b4847fbd818d9c99e2633c719c03f69599ce.open_work: Testing the combined approach at other sites and seasons and for forecasting rather than simulation.
ca22b4847fbd818d9c99e2633c719c03f69599ce.issues: Single monitoring site; no uncertainty estimates; abstract unavailable.

44f35257a943082b9d23dbdfb0324e84640747b6.goal: Models rainfall-runoff relationships in a semi-arid mountain basin with artificial neural networks as an alternative to conceptual models.
44f35257a943082b9d23dbdfb0324e84640747b6.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP), compared with regression models.
44f35257a943082b9d23dbdfb0324e84640747b6.data: Rainfall and runoff data from the Ourika basin, Morocco.
44f35257a943082b9d23dbdfb0324e84640747b6.result: The neural network simulates runoff better than regression approaches.
44f35257a943082b9d23dbdfb0324e84640747b6.open_work: Testing on more basins, at different time steps and against conceptual models.
44f35257a943082b9d23dbdfb0324e84640747b6.issues: Single semi-arid mountain basin; limited data length; abstract unavailable.

9f4e5039a7338c012bece0cfc2701d590f37a0bf.goal: Reconstructs Last Glacial Maximum sea surface temperatures in the Mediterranean to understand ice-age climate and provide boundary conditions for models.
9f4e5039a7338c012bece0cfc2701d590f37a0bf.architecture: Transfer functions relating planktonic foraminiferal assemblages to temperature, including artificial neural networks; the exact set of transfer-function methods is not reported here.
9f4e5039a7338c012bece0cfc2701d590f37a0bf.data: Planktonic foraminiferal census counts from Mediterranean sediment cores and core-top calibration datasets.
9f4e5039a7338c012bece0cfc2701d590f37a0bf.result: Reconstructed glacial sea surface temperatures show cooling relative to present with marked spatial differences across the basin; specific values are not reported here.
9f4e5039a7338c012bece0cfc2701d590f37a0bf.open_work: Comparing with other temperature proxies and with glacial climate model simulations.
