9f4e5039a7338c012bece0cfc2701d590f37a0bf.issues: Transfer-function calibration uncertainty and possible no-analogue assemblages; dating and coverage limited by core availability; abstract unavailable.

eb47b0e6781ab744b299fdfb7acb985a3996c014.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction at wind farm turbines by combining a mesoscale weather model with neural networks.
eb47b0e6781ab744b299fdfb7acb985a3996c014.architecture: Hybrid of the MM5 mesoscale numerical model with artificial neural networks (MLP) that map MM5 forecasts to wind speed at turbine locations.
eb47b0e6781ab744b299fdfb7acb985a3996c014.data: MM5 forecasts and wind speed measurements at a wind farm in Spain.
eb47b0e6781ab744b299fdfb7acb985a3996c014.result: The hybrid MM5-neural network system improves short-term wind speed predictions over MM5 alone.
eb47b0e6781ab744b299fdfb7acb985a3996c014.open_work: Testing at other wind farms, using ensemble mesoscale forecasts and extending to power prediction.
eb47b0e6781ab744b299fdfb7acb985a3996c014.issues: Single wind farm; accuracy bounded by MM5 forecast quality; deterministic output; abstract unavailable.

f20617d40244b0d2eb494f2e37736316a9073056.goal: Predicts wind speed at a wind park using spatial correlation with measurements at remote upwind stations, for wind power management.
f20617d40244b0d2eb494f2e37736316a9073056.architecture: Locally recurrent fuzzy neural network: Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy rules whose consequent parts are small recurrent neural networks, trained with a recursive prediction error algorithm.
f20617d40244b0d2eb494f2e37736316a9073056.data: Wind speed time series from several measurement stations around a wind park in Greece; exact period not reported here.
f20617d40244b0d2eb494f2e37736316a9073056.result: The locally recurrent fuzzy neural network gives more accurate multi-step wind speed predictions than the compared static and recurrent network models.
f20617d40244b0d2eb494f2e37736316a9073056.open_work: Longer prediction horizons, extension to wind power and testing at other wind parks.
f20617d40244b0d2eb494f2e37736316a9073056.issues: Single site; relies on remote stations being available upwind; complex training; abstract unavailable.

1a8867eb39374a86bbdf768cc1f80ba586b24a47.goal: Downscales recent streamflow conditions in British Columbia from large-scale atmospheric circulation.
1a8867eb39374a86bbdf768cc1f80ba586b24a47.architecture: Ensemble neural network models (multilayer perceptrons combined by averaging), compared with linear regression models.
1a8867eb39374a86bbdf768cc1f80ba586b24a47.data: NCEP/NCAR reanalysis atmospheric fields and streamflow records from watersheds in British Columbia, Canada.
1a8867eb39374a86bbdf768cc1f80ba586b24a47.result: Ensemble neural networks reproduce streamflow conditions from circulation predictors better than linear regression models.
1a8867eb39374a86bbdf768cc1f80ba586b24a47.open_work: Applying the downscaling models to GCM climate change scenarios and other regions.
1a8867eb39374a86bbdf768cc1f80ba586b24a47.issues: Predictors from reanalysis inherit its biases; stationarity of statistical relationships under climate change is untested; abstract unavailable.

0bfdf879b47d98640c1d684508be6e7f1c372671.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration when only minimal climatological data, such as air temperature, are available.
0bfdf879b47d98640c1d684508be6e7f1c372671.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) using air temperature and location/date information as inputs.
0bfdf879b47d98640c1d684508be6e7f1c372671.data: Meteorological data from Campos dos Goytacazes, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, with Penman-Monteith ET0 as target.
0bfdf879b47d98640c1d684508be6e7f1c372671.result: The neural network estimates ET0 well using only air temperature data.
0bfdf879b47d98640c1d684508be6e7f1c372671.open_work: Testing in other climates and comparing with temperature-based empirical equations such as Hargreaves.
0bfdf879b47d98640c1d684508be6e7f1c372671.issues: Target is ET0 computed by Penman-Monteith rather than measured; single region; abstract unavailable.

840d514ad9d146ded977786616af011a63157f91.goal: Presents the concepts and methodology of a comprehensive experiment comparing data-driven modelling techniques in hydrology.
840d514ad9d146ded977786616af011a63157f91.architecture: Review and benchmark design comparing neural networks, genetic programming, evolutionary polynomial regression, support vector machines, M5 model trees and k-nearest neighbors, with multiple linear regression and naive baselines.
840d514ad9d146ded977786616af011a63157f91.data: Five datasets from Canada and Europe: evapotranspiration, upper and lower layer soil moisture, and rainfall-runoff, each resampled into 12 groups of training, cross-validation and testing subsets.
840d514ad9d146ded977786616af011a63157f91.result: Defines a rigorous experimental protocol with resampled data groups that allows both prediction accuracy and uncertainty of each technique to be compared; results are deferred to Part 2.
840d514ad9d146ded977786616af011a63157f91.open_work: Implementing the experiment and analysing accuracy and uncertainty of each technique, reported in Part 2.
840d514ad9d146ded977786616af011a63157f91.issues: No results in this part; conclusions limited to five datasets from Canada and Europe.

b091494e09397f66f44374a967eaf0d83dd96897.goal: Develops genetic programming as a data-driven tool for real-time runoff forecasting, both as a stand-alone forecaster and as an error-updating scheme for a conceptual rainfall-runoff model.
b091494e09397f66f44374a967eaf0d83dd96897.architecture: Genetic programming (symbolic regression evolving forecast expressions), used directly and to update errors of the conceptual MIKE11-NAM model.
b091494e09397f66f44374a967eaf0d83dd96897.data: Rainfall and runoff records from the Orgeval catchment in France; exact periods not reported here.
b091494e09397f66f44374a967eaf0d83dd96897.result: Genetic programming gives accurate short-lead runoff forecasts and, as an updating scheme, improves the conceptual model's real-time predictions.
b091494e09397f66f44374a967eaf0d83dd96897.open_work: Test on more catchments and longer lead times, and compare with other updating schemes such as neural networks or Kalman filtering.
b091494e09397f66f44374a967eaf0d83dd96897.issues: Single small catchment; skill decays with lead time; evolved expressions can be hard to interpret physically.

f45d8e76c0cdd6c86b43a88fbbc6db43e00164b8.goal: Improves daily rainfall-runoff forecasting by training a neural network with a real-coded genetic algorithm instead of gradient-based backpropagation.
f45d8e76c0cdd6c86b43a88fbbc6db43e00164b8.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) whose weights are optimized by a real-coded genetic algorithm, compared with a backpropagation-trained network.
f45d8e76c0cdd6c86b43a88fbbc6db43e00164b8.data: Daily rainfall and runoff series from a semi-arid catchment in Morocco; exact record length not reported here.
f45d8e76c0cdd6c86b43a88fbbc6db43e00164b8.result: The genetic-algorithm-trained network forecasts daily runoff more accurately than the backpropagation-trained network, especially avoiding poor local minima.
f45d8e76c0cdd6c86b43a88fbbc6db43e00164b8.open_work: Extend to multi-step forecasting, other catchments, and hybrid evolutionary-gradient training.
f45d8e76c0cdd6c86b43a88fbbc6db43e00164b8.issues: Single catchment; genetic training is computationally costly; no uncertainty quantification.

5332ac296333f823aa6a3c1ea53c12a82cdb3e43.goal: Predicts river stage at a downstream station from upstream observations, aiming to beat a single global regression model.
5332ac296333f823aa6a3c1ea53c12a82cdb3e43.architecture: Distributed support vector regression: several local SVR models on partitioned input space, with parameters tuned by a two-step genetic algorithm; compared with linear regression, nearest neighbour, ANN and plain SVR.
5332ac296333f823aa6a3c1ea53c12a82cdb3e43.data: Daily river stage records from the Han-Kou station and upstream gauges on the Yangtze River, China.
5332ac296333f823aa6a3c1ea53c12a82cdb3e43.result: The distributed SVR gives the most accurate stage predictions among the compared models, including a standard SVR and a neural network.
5332ac296333f823aa6a3c1ea53c12a82cdb3e43.open_work: Automate partitioning of the input space and test longer lead times and other rivers.
5332ac296333f823aa6a3c1ea53c12a82cdb3e43.issues: Single river system; daily resolution only; tuning cost of the genetic algorithm and choice of partitions are ad hoc.

0625ba4740558ad2b6058a6070ac1d0cf9694a11.goal: Forecasts rainfall and runoff time series by combining noise-reducing singular spectrum analysis with support vector machines.
0625ba4740558ad2b6058a6070ac1d0cf9694a11.architecture: Singular spectrum analysis preprocessing followed by a support vector machine regressor (SSA-SVM), compared with a nonlinear prediction (chaos-based) method.
0625ba4740558ad2b6058a6070ac1d0cf9694a11.data: Daily rainfall from stations in Singapore and daily runoff from the Tryggevaelde catchment in Denmark.
0625ba4740558ad2b6058a6070ac1d0cf9694a11.result: SSA-SVM gives better short-term forecasts than the nonlinear prediction method, with SSA filtering noticeably improving SVM accuracy.
0625ba4740558ad2b6058a6070ac1d0cf9694a11.open_work: Test longer lead times and other catchments, and examine sensitivity to SSA window length and SVM parameters.
0625ba4740558ad2b6058a6070ac1d0cf9694a11.issues: Only a few series tested; lead-one-day forecasts; SVM kernel and parameter selection is manual.

e30c07a83e7f40f5dfcb1e84b099c7be079698ba.goal: Maps solar energy potential across Turkey where radiation measurements are sparse, using neural networks driven by geographic and meteorological inputs.
e30c07a83e7f40f5dfcb1e84b099c7be079698ba.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) trained with several backpropagation variants (e.g. scaled conjugate gradient, Levenberg-Marquardt) with latitude, longitude, altitude, month, sunshine duration and temperature inputs.
e30c07a83e7f40f5dfcb1e84b099c7be079698ba.data: Meteorological station data from the Turkish State Meteorological Service for a few recent years; some stations held out for testing.
e30c07a83e7f40f5dfcb1e84b099c7be079698ba.result: The network estimates solar radiation at unseen stations with low errors and high correlation, enabling a national solar potential map.
e30c07a83e7f40f5dfcb1e84b099c7be079698ba.open_work: Add more stations and years and compare with empirical sunshine-based radiation models.
e30c07a83e7f40f5dfcb1e84b099c7be079698ba.issues: Short data period and limited stations; spatial generalization to complex terrain not fully tested.

c40c7f59c871680322bd12d6a08f84f90dc828f1.goal: Forecasts rice blast disease from weather variables to support timely fungicide decisions, comparing machine learning approaches.
c40c7f59c871680322bd12d6a08f84f90dc828f1.architecture: Support vector machine regression compared with multiple regression, backpropagation neural network and generalized regression neural network; implemented as the RB-Pred web server.
c40c7f59c871680322bd12d6a08f84f90dc828f1.data: Leaf blast severity records and weather variables (temperature, relative humidity, rainfall, rainy days) from rice-growing locations in India.
c40c7f59c871680322bd12d6a08f84f90dc828f1.result: The support vector machine model gives the highest correlation and lowest error for blast severity prediction, outperforming regression and neural networks.
c40c7f59c871680322bd12d6a08f84f90dc828f1.open_work: Extend to other crops and diseases and to more locations and years.
c40c7f59c871680322bd12d6a08f84f90dc828f1.issues: Limited number of seasons and sites; location-specific relations may not transfer.

01e5d5d85f1588ef757ad327ac19f10bc69549fe.goal: Supports flood management decisions by combining data-driven forecasting, simulation and expert knowledge in one decision support system.
01e5d5d85f1588ef757ad327ac19f10bc69549fe.architecture: Intelligent decision support system integrating artificial neural networks, a system dynamics simulation model, GIS and an expert system.
01e5d5d85f1588ef757ad327ac19f10bc69549fe.data: Applied to the Red River basin, Manitoba, Canada, using historical flood records; details not reported here.
01e5d5d85f1588ef757ad327ac19f10bc69549fe.result: The system helps evaluate flood forecasting and management options for planning and operational use in the basin.
01e5d5d85f1588ef757ad327ac19f10bc69549fe.open_work: Integrate real-time data feeds and uncertainty analysis, and test in other basins.
01e5d5d85f1588ef757ad327ac19f10bc69549fe.issues: Case-study demonstration; limited quantitative validation of the overall system.

e2e22ca81f01a1e4f1950baf36c28cb3158ee4c5.goal: Evaluates neural networks for simulating groundwater levels in a fractured aquifer where physically based models are hard to parameterize.
e2e22ca81f01a1e4f1950baf36c28cb3158ee4c5.architecture: Artificial neural network relating hydro-meteorological inputs to piezometric levels; the specific network configuration is not reported here.
e2e22ca81f01a1e4f1950baf36c28cb3158ee4c5.data: Piezometric level records with rainfall and related variables from a fractured aquifer in northern France; details not reported here.
e2e22ca81f01a1e4f1950baf36c28cb3158ee4c5.result: The neural network reproduces observed groundwater level fluctuations with good accuracy.
e2e22ca81f01a1e4f1950baf36c28cb3158ee4c5.open_work: Extend to longer forecasts and multiple wells, and compare with physically based groundwater models.
e2e22ca81f01a1e4f1950baf36c28cb3158ee4c5.issues: Single site; black-box model with no physical interpretation; generalization to other aquifers untested.

8b65a123190ed3b8e0b34f4a49738014208bc268.goal: Estimates monthly mean daily global solar radiation at sites without pyranometers in Saudi Arabia.
8b65a123190ed3b8e0b34f4a49738014208bc268.architecture: Radial basis function neural network compared with a multilayer perceptron, using latitude, longitude, altitude and sunshine duration as inputs.
8b65a123190ed3b8e0b34f4a49738014208bc268.data: Data from about 41 Saudi Arabian stations, most used for training and about 10 held out for testing.
8b65a123190ed3b8e0b34f4a49738014208bc268.result: The RBF network estimates monthly mean daily radiation at test stations more accurately than the MLP.
8b65a123190ed3b8e0b34f4a49738014208bc268.open_work: Add more meteorological predictors and stations to improve spatial coverage.
8b65a123190ed3b8e0b34f4a49738014208bc268.issues: Monthly means only; small number of test stations; no uncertainty estimate.

f9f27971e33e1868eff29681d2842d754f8020d4.goal: Forecasts reservoir inflows for hydropower operation using multiple hydro-meteorological inputs and temporal neural networks.
f9f27971e33e1868eff29681d2842d754f8020d4.architecture: Temporal neural networks: input delay neural network and recurrent neural network, compared for multivariate inflow forecasting.
f9f27971e33e1868eff29681d2842d754f8020d4.data: Daily inflows, precipitation, temperature and snowmelt-related inputs for the Chute-du-Diable reservoir, Quebec, Canada.
f9f27971e33e1868eff29681d2842d754f8020d4.result: The recurrent neural network gives the best inflow forecasts, including during spring snowmelt floods.
f9f27971e33e1868eff29681d2842d754f8020d4.open_work: Extend lead times and assess robustness for operational reservoir management.
f9f27971e33e1868eff29681d2842d754f8020d4.issues: Single reservoir; recurrent networks are harder to train; no uncertainty estimate.

2e383ab118ec0736fe704b434f7a373c02181efb.goal: Compares data-driven flood forecasting models for an Indian river to select the most accurate approach.
2e383ab118ec0736fe704b434f7a373c02181efb.architecture: Feed-forward neural network, adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and a genetic-algorithm-trained neural network (neuro-GA).
2e383ab118ec0736fe704b434f7a373c02181efb.data: Hourly or event-based flow and rainfall records for the Ajay River basin, India; details not reported here.
2e383ab118ec0736fe704b434f7a373c02181efb.result: The neuro-fuzzy model generally gives the best flood forecasts, with the neural network and neuro-GA models close behind.
2e383ab118ec0736fe704b434f7a373c02181efb.open_work: Test on more basins and longer lead times and add uncertainty estimates.
2e383ab118ec0736fe704b434f7a373c02181efb.issues: Single basin and limited flood events; performance declines with lead time.

bb9392efb09ed00fbc7f7f7f9157e01a15e042c6.goal: Downscales heavy daily precipitation occurrence and amounts at multiple sites from large-scale atmospheric predictors for climate impact studies.
bb9392efb09ed00fbc7f7f7f9157e01a15e042c6.architecture: Artificial neural networks (multilayer perceptron and radial basis function networks) compared with the regression-based Statistical DownScaling Model (SDSM).
bb9392efb09ed00fbc7f7f7f9157e01a15e042c6.data: NCEP/NCAR reanalysis predictors and daily precipitation from station networks in several UK regions.
bb9392efb09ed00fbc7f7f7f9157e01a15e042c6.result: Both neural networks and SDSM capture some heavy precipitation statistics, with skill differing by method, region and index.
bb9392efb09ed00fbc7f7f7f9157e01a15e042c6.open_work: Improve representation of inter-site correlation and extremes and apply to GCM scenarios.
bb9392efb09ed00fbc7f7f7f9157e01a15e042c6.issues: Heavy precipitation remains underestimated; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; results region-dependent.

a43fdfa7dde19e8d6a152a99416f5b8e64220cb5.goal: Predicts hourly concentrations of traffic-related pollutants near urban arterial roads for air quality management.
a43fdfa7dde19e8d6a152a99416f5b8e64220cb5.architecture: Backpropagation feed-forward neural network (MLP) using traffic, meteorological and background inputs, compared with multiple linear regression and the CALINE4 dispersion model.
a43fdfa7dde19e8d6a152a99416f5b8e64220cb5.data: Hourly CO, NO2, PM10 and O3 measurements near arterial roads in Guangzhou, China, with traffic and weather data.
a43fdfa7dde19e8d6a152a99416f5b8e64220cb5.result: The neural network predicts hourly concentrations more accurately than multiple regression and CALINE4.
a43fdfa7dde19e8d6a152a99416f5b8e64220cb5.open_work: Test at more sites and for forecasting rather than estimation, and add emission factors.
a43fdfa7dde19e8d6a152a99416f5b8e64220cb5.issues: Few monitoring sites and a short period; site-specific training limits transferability.

c33005ea8e12521efda115b43dd9b07e54827f57.goal: Forecasts monthly Nile River inflow at Aswan High Dam to support reservoir operation.
c33005ea8e12521efda115b43dd9b07e54827f57.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) compared with a feed-forward neural network.
c33005ea8e12521efda115b43dd9b07e54827f57.data: Long historical record of monthly natural Nile flows at Aswan.
c33005ea8e12521efda115b43dd9b07e54827f57.result: The neuro-fuzzy model forecasts monthly inflow more accurately than the neural network, especially for high flows.
c33005ea8e12521efda115b43dd9b07e54827f57.open_work: Include climate indices or upstream information and extend lead time.
c33005ea8e12521efda115b43dd9b07e54827f57.issues: Single station; monthly resolution only; no explicit uncertainty quantification.

e7a723c448693cbffd94959f2edc4f62c494c2ad.goal: Models reference evapotranspiration with neural networks as an alternative to empirical equations when full meteorological data are limited.
e7a723c448693cbffd94959f2edc4f62c494c2ad.architecture: Generalized regression neural network (GRNN) compared with a multilayer perceptron and empirical methods (e.g. Penman-type, Hargreaves).
e7a723c448693cbffd94959f2edc4f62c494c2ad.data: Daily climatic data (temperature, radiation, wind, humidity) from CIMIS weather stations in California, with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 as reference.
e7a723c448693cbffd94959f2edc4f62c494c2ad.result: The GRNN estimates ET0 closely matching Penman-Monteith and outperforms the empirical methods.
e7a723c448693cbffd94959f2edc4f62c494c2ad.open_work: Test with reduced input sets and stations in other climates.
e7a723c448693cbffd94959f2edc4f62c494c2ad.issues: Few stations; target is a computed Penman-Monteith value rather than lysimeter measurements.

376905b09f20f02c41b1c0253bc0a6cb85a8c0f6.goal: Characterizes the diurnal cycle of tropical rainfall using high-resolution satellite precipitation estimates.
376905b09f20f02c41b1c0253bc0a6cb85a8c0f6.architecture: PERSIANN neural-network precipitation retrieval (self-organizing feature map based) using GOES infrared imagery, adjusted with TRMM microwave rainfall.
376905b09f20f02c41b1c0253bc0a6cb85a8c0f6.data: GOES infrared and TRMM satellite data over the tropics for several years around 1998–2000.
376905b09f20f02c41b1c0253bc0a6cb85a8c0f6.result: Rainfall shows a strong afternoon-to-evening maximum over land and an early-morning maximum over oceans, with regional variations resolved at high resolution.
376905b09f20f02c41b1c0253bc0a6cb85a8c0f6.open_work: Extend the record and compare with model diurnal cycles.
376905b09f20f02c41b1c0253bc0a6cb85a8c0f6.issues: Infrared-based estimates have known biases for warm rain and cirrus; validation limited by sparse ground truth.

1d1c3ba54cc76dff48a94dba92bb301a7fc9447e.goal: Predicts storm surge levels during typhoons for coastal hazard warning.
1d1c3ba54cc76dff48a94dba92bb301a7fc9447e.architecture: Support vector regression with kernel functions, compared with other data-driven approaches.
1d1c3ba54cc76dff48a94dba92bb301a7fc9447e.data: Typhoon storm surge and meteorological records from tide stations in Taiwan; details not reported here.
1d1c3ba54cc76dff48a94dba92bb301a7fc9447e.result: Support vector regression predicts storm surges with good accuracy for the tested typhoon events.
1d1c3ba54cc76dff48a94dba92bb301a7fc9447e.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and more stations and typhoons.
1d1c3ba54cc76dff48a94dba92bb301a7fc9447e.issues: Limited number of typhoon events; site-specific; no uncertainty estimate.

29c969af6e10363ba25ce6b3b0ae98c0928b9460.goal: Retrieves snow water equivalent and snow depth from passive microwave satellite observations.
29c969af6e10363ba25ce6b3b0ae98c0928b9460.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network trained on SSM/I brightness temperatures, compared with the HUT snow emission model inversion and spectral polarization difference algorithms.
29c969af6e10363ba25ce6b3b0ae98c0928b9460.data: SSM/I brightness temperatures (19 and 37 GHz) with ground snow depth and SWE observations in Finland.
29c969af6e10363ba25ce6b3b0ae98c0928b9460.result: The neural network gives lower retrieval errors for SWE and snow depth than the traditional algorithms.
29c969af6e10363ba25ce6b3b0ae98c0928b9460.open_work: Combine with physical emission models and test in other regions and snow types.
29c969af6e10363ba25ce6b3b0ae98c0928b9460.issues: Regional training (boreal Finland); performance in deep or wet snow is limited.

22523397c62d5cd92647b5fc2ecfcf7a5c2b1cd7.goal: Forecasts rainfall with an optimized neural network whose structure and inputs are selected by a genetic algorithm.
22523397c62d5cd92647b5fc2ecfcf7a5c2b1cd7.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) coupled with a genetic algorithm for optimizing network inputs, structure and weights.
22523397c62d5cd92647b5fc2ecfcf7a5c2b1cd7.data: Rainfall gauge records from a catchment in Sydney, Australia; details not reported here.
22523397c62d5cd92647b5fc2ecfcf7a5c2b1cd7.result: The genetic-algorithm-optimized network improves rainfall forecasts relative to a conventional neural network.
22523397c62d5cd92647b5fc2ecfcf7a5c2b1cd7.open_work: Test longer lead times and other climates.
22523397c62d5cd92647b5fc2ecfcf7a5c2b1cd7.issues: Single catchment; rainfall intermittency limits skill; no probabilistic output.

970b9a4e27f922dd8aac832623ab96298d4aed8a.goal: Classifies crops and estimates evapotranspiration over an irrigated area in central Morocco from high-resolution image time series.
970b9a4e27f922dd8aac832623ab96298d4aed8a.architecture: Decision tree classifier applied to per-pixel NDVI profiles, followed by the FAO crop coefficient evapotranspiration model with NDVI-derived Kc.
970b9a4e27f922dd8aac832623ab96298d4aed8a.data: Eight Landsat TM images over one crop season, radiometrically corrected; ALADIN model outputs for reference evapotranspiration (ET0) maps.
970b9a4e27f922dd8aac832623ab96298d4aed8a.result: NDVI profiles identify four main land cover types (bare soil, annual crops, trees on bare soil, trees on annual understory), enabling spatial ET estimation over the whole area.
970b9a4e27f922dd8aac832623ab96298d4aed8a.open_work: Validate ET estimates with field measurements and extend to multiple seasons.
970b9a4e27f922dd8aac832623ab96298d4aed8a.issues: Single season; classification accuracy and ET validation statistics are not reported in the abstract.

cd6039eff4a3811150ed00490467fdafcf5e9a11.goal: Forecasts daily PM10 concentrations in Santiago, Chile to support air quality episode warnings.
cd6039eff4a3811150ed00490467fdafcf5e9a11.architecture: Integrated feed-forward neural network (MLP) model using forecast meteorological variables and measured concentrations, compared with linear regression and persistence.
cd6039eff4a3811150ed00490467fdafcf5e9a11.data: PM10 monitoring network data and meteorological observations and forecasts for Santiago, Chile.
cd6039eff4a3811150ed00490467fdafcf5e9a11.result: The neural network predicts the next-day maximum of 24-h average PM10 better than linear and persistence models.
cd6039eff4a3811150ed00490467fdafcf5e9a11.open_work: Improve forecasts of extreme episodes and incorporate more meteorological forecast information.
cd6039eff4a3811150ed00490467fdafcf5e9a11.issues: Depends on meteorological forecast quality; few extreme episodes for training.

8b500b4d171aa376184d4aa6e8343c5d22dd2b47.goal: Improves index flood estimation in pooled flood frequency analysis using neural network ensembles.
8b500b4d171aa376184d4aa6e8343c5d22dd2b47.architecture: Artificial neural network ensembles (e.g. bagging and combined networks) compared with single neural networks and regression models.
8b500b4d171aa376184d4aa6e8343c5d22dd2b47.data: Catchment characteristics and flood data from a large set of gauged catchments; details not reported here.
8b500b4d171aa376184d4aa6e8343c5d22dd2b47.result: Neural network ensembles give more accurate and robust index flood estimates than single networks.
8b500b4d171aa376184d4aa6e8343c5d22dd2b47.open_work: Extend ensembles to estimate growth curves and uncertainty.
8b500b4d171aa376184d4aa6e8343c5d22dd2b47.issues: Performance depends on catchment descriptors available; ensemble design choices are empirical.

f5d1aa4327f4dee3227f25dce31abe74af76b2db.goal: Compares neural networks and neuro-fuzzy models for continuous daily and hourly runoff simulation.
f5d1aa4327f4dee3227f25dce31abe74af76b2db.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks (e.g. Levenberg-Marquardt and Bayesian regularization training) compared with a neuro-fuzzy (ANFIS) model.
f5d1aa4327f4dee3227f25dce31abe74af76b2db.data: Daily and hourly rainfall-runoff records from the Cilalawi River catchment, Indonesia.
f5d1aa4327f4dee3227f25dce31abe74af76b2db.result: The neuro-fuzzy model reproduces daily and hourly runoff more accurately and is more reliable than the neural networks.
f5d1aa4327f4dee3227f25dce31abe74af76b2db.open_work: Test with longer records and different climate regimes.
f5d1aa4327f4dee3227f25dce31abe74af76b2db.issues: Single catchment; extremes are less well captured.

c834b0b193475edffc05c830f7e6c8cfa3d34ba9.goal: Investigates whether hidden neurons of neural network rainfall-runoff models represent physical hydrological processes, to address the black-box criticism.
c834b0b193475edffc05c830f7e6c8cfa3d34ba9.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) rainfall-runoff model whose hidden neuron outputs are correlated with hydrological components.
c834b0b193475edffc05c830f7e6c8cfa3d34ba9.data: Daily rainfall and streamflow from the Kentucky River basin, USA, with conceptual model components for comparison.
c834b0b193475edffc05c830f7e6c8cfa3d34ba9.result: Hidden neurons correlate with distinct processes such as baseflow, infiltration, soil moisture and delayed surface flow.
c834b0b193475edffc05c830f7e6c8cfa3d34ba9.open_work: Use process interpretation to design more physically meaningful network architectures.
c834b0b193475edffc05c830f7e6c8cfa3d34ba9.issues: Interpretation based on correlation only; single basin.

34c77cca0308acac0b30b7c1b14044c4ca76cdf6.goal: Forecasts daily air pollution levels using wavelet decomposition and support vector machines.
34c77cca0308acac0b30b7c1b14044c4ca76cdf6.architecture: Wavelet decomposition of time series followed by support vector machine regression for each component.
34c77cca0308acac0b30b7c1b14044c4ca76cdf6.data: Daily pollutant (e.g. NO2, SO2, CO, dust) and meteorological data from a monitoring station in northern Poland.
34c77cca0308acac0b30b7c1b14044c4ca76cdf6.result: The wavelet-SVM approach improves forecasting accuracy over direct SVM and neural network approaches.
34c77cca0308acac0b30b7c1b14044c4ca76cdf6.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and more stations.
34c77cca0308acac0b30b7c1b14044c4ca76cdf6.issues: Single region; wavelet decomposition choice is empirical.

e078255bdf8ddbeb0d2af14eac40ec101ad8fa78.goal: Improves snowfall forecasts by diagnosing snow density (snow ratio) instead of using a fixed 10:1 ratio.
e078255bdf8ddbeb0d2af14eac40ec101ad8fa78.architecture: Ensemble of artificial neural networks classifying snow ratio into heavy, average and light classes from temperature and humidity profile predictors.
e078255bdf8ddbeb0d2af14eac40ec101ad8fa78.data: US cooperative observer snowfall and liquid equivalent records matched with radiosonde-derived atmospheric profiles over several decades.
e078255bdf8ddbeb0d2af14eac40ec101ad8fa78.result: The neural network ensemble diagnoses snow ratio class substantially better than climatology or the 10:1 rule.
e078255bdf8ddbeb0d2af14eac40ec101ad8fa78.open_work: Apply operationally to model forecast profiles and refine for regional variations.
e078255bdf8ddbeb0d2af14eac40ec101ad8fa78.issues: Snow measurement errors are large; performance depends on forecast profile accuracy.

562a29323138b1e5f23cbea959d85d38f0be61a7.goal: Predicts greenhouse air temperature for climate control.
562a29323138b1e5f23cbea959d85d38f0be61a7.architecture: Radial basis function neural networks trained with different off-line and on-line methods.
562a29323138b1e5f23cbea959d85d38f0be61a7.data: Measured inside and outside climate variables (e.g. temperature, solar radiation, humidity) from a greenhouse in Portugal.
562a29323138b1e5f23cbea959d85d38f0be61a7.result: RBF networks predict greenhouse air temperature accurately, with training method affecting performance.
562a29323138b1e5f23cbea959d85d38f0be61a7.open_work: Integrate into model predictive control of greenhouse climate.
562a29323138b1e5f23cbea959d85d38f0be61a7.issues: Single greenhouse; limited period; adaptation to seasonal change needs on-line training.

26fcc95cbb983756080a2b59b806165964f2c0cc.goal: Forecasts tidal levels from short records where harmonic analysis requires long data.
26fcc95cbb983756080a2b59b806165964f2c0cc.architecture: Backpropagation feed-forward neural network (MLP) using past tidal observations.
26fcc95cbb983756080a2b59b806165964f2c0cc.data: Short-term hourly tidal records from harbours in Taiwan.
26fcc95cbb983756080a2b59b806165964f2c0cc.result: The network trained on a few days of data can forecast tidal levels over longer periods with good accuracy.
26fcc95cbb983756080a2b59b806165964f2c0cc.open_work: Incorporate meteorological effects and multiple stations.
26fcc95cbb983756080a2b59b806165964f2c0cc.issues: Non-tidal residuals such as storm surge not modelled; few stations.

24ccc0e4004345ac3e7d09b954ac7dd0d0407d7d.goal: Estimates suspended sediment concentration from hydro-meteorological data.
24ccc0e4004345ac3e7d09b954ac7dd0d0407d7d.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) compared with neural networks (MLP, GRNN, RBF) and sediment rating curves.
24ccc0e4004345ac3e7d09b954ac7dd0d0407d7d.data: Daily precipitation, streamflow and suspended sediment concentration from a USGS station in the United States.
24ccc0e4004345ac3e7d09b954ac7dd0d0407d7d.result: The neuro-fuzzy model gives the most accurate sediment concentration estimates.
24ccc0e4004345ac3e7d09b954ac7dd0d0407d7d.open_work: Test at more stations and with additional inputs.
24ccc0e4004345ac3e7d09b954ac7dd0d0407d7d.issues: Single station; extreme sediment events are underpredicted.

7913c50e8ad148572b548d4183d77e83d1f7fb50.goal: Forecasts solar potential across Turkey using neural networks with geographic and meteorological inputs.
7913c50e8ad148572b548d4183d77e83d1f7fb50.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) with backpropagation variants, using latitude, longitude, altitude, month and climate inputs.
7913c50e8ad148572b548d4183d77e83d1f7fb50.data: Turkish State Meteorological Service station data for a few years.
7913c50e8ad148572b548d4183d77e83d1f7fb50.result: The network estimates solar radiation with low errors for test stations.
7913c50e8ad148572b548d4183d77e83d1f7fb50.open_work: Extend data and compare with empirical models.

356799cac207647cbbe4c771ef3d05420f0afb45.goal: Forecasts electric load several hours ahead to support power system operation.
356799cac207647cbbe4c771ef3d05420f0afb45.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) combined with a similar-days approach using temperature and load inputs.
356799cac207647cbbe4c771ef3d05420f0afb45.data: Hourly load and temperature data from a Japanese power utility.
356799cac207647cbbe4c771ef3d05420f0afb45.result: The method produces accurate several-hour-ahead forecasts with low mean absolute percentage errors.
356799cac207647cbbe4c771ef3d05420f0afb45.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and special days.
356799cac207647cbbe4c771ef3d05420f0afb45.issues: Single utility; temperature forecast errors affect skill.

581b03ff685ed097be94f639606a34f7ce9d7bed.goal: Develops a hydrometeor identification algorithm for X-band polarimetric radars, which suffer from attenuation and differ from S-band.
581b03ff685ed097be94f639606a34f7ce9d7bed.architecture: Theory-based fuzzy logic classifier with membership functions derived from scattering simulations; not a learned ML model.
581b03ff685ed097be94f639606a34f7ce9d7bed.data: Scattering simulations for hydrometeor types and X-band polarimetric radar observations from the CASA network.
581b03ff685ed097be94f639606a34f7ce9d7bed.result: The algorithm produces physically plausible hydrometeor classifications at X band.
581b03ff685ed097be94f639606a34f7ce9d7bed.open_work: Validate with in situ observations and refine for attenuation correction.
581b03ff685ed097be94f639606a34f7ce9d7bed.issues: Limited validation; depends on scattering assumptions.

3d4117a9ee8bfe8fb1b16995292513d80bb492f8.goal: Corrects MERIS ocean colour data for atmospheric effects over optically complex case-2 coastal waters.
3d4117a9ee8bfe8fb1b16995292513d80bb492f8.architecture: Neural network inversion (MLP) trained on radiative transfer simulations mapping top-of-atmosphere radiances to water-leaving reflectance and aerosol optical thickness.
3d4117a9ee8bfe8fb1b16995292513d80bb492f8.data: Radiative transfer simulations for training; MERIS imagery validated with in situ reflectance and AERONET aerosol data in coastal European waters.
3d4117a9ee8bfe8fb1b16995292513d80bb492f8.result: The neural network correction retrieves reflectance and aerosol properties with improved accuracy over the standard MERIS processor in coastal waters.
3d4117a9ee8bfe8fb1b16995292513d80bb492f8.open_work: Extend validation to more coastal regions and turbid waters.
3d4117a9ee8bfe8fb1b16995292513d80bb492f8.issues: Performance depends on simulated training ranges; limited in situ data.

f2bfa9bb28fe1cebb193f368886c5bd8af154344.goal: Downscales daily precipitation and temperature for climate change impact studies using temporal neural networks.
f2bfa9bb28fe1cebb193f368886c5bd8af154344.architecture: Time-lagged feed-forward neural network (TLFN) compared with a regression-based statistical downscaling model (SDSM).
f2bfa9bb28fe1cebb193f368886c5bd8af154344.data: NCEP/NCAR reanalysis predictors and station data in the Chute-du-Diable basin, Quebec, Canada.
f2bfa9bb28fe1cebb193f368886c5bd8af154344.result: The TLFN downscales precipitation and temperature more accurately than SDSM.
f2bfa9bb28fe1cebb193f368886c5bd8af154344.open_work: Apply to GCM scenarios and evaluate extremes.
f2bfa9bb28fe1cebb193f368886c5bd8af154344.issues: Trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; single region.

4bba1a6e44a9ce4314dfa82faa72cf17f65025a7.goal: Delineates homogeneous regions and estimates floods for ungauged catchments in southeast China via regional flood frequency analysis.
4bba1a6e44a9ce4314dfa82faa72cf17f65025a7.architecture: Kohonen self-organizing map neural network, fuzzy c-means and Ward's clustering for regionalization; regional L-moments for growth curves; ANN versus multiple linear regression for the index flood.
4bba1a6e44a9ce4314dfa82faa72cf17f65025a7.data: Flood and catchment characteristics data for 86 sites in the Gan River (Jiangxi) and Ming River (Fujian) basins, China.
4bba1a6e44a9ce4314dfa82faa72cf17f65025a7.result: The Kohonen network identifies both the number of sub-regions and site allocation; ANN index flood estimates have lower standard errors than regression.
4bba1a6e44a9ce4314dfa82faa72cf17f65025a7.open_work: Use fuzzy membership weights for combining sub-regional growth curves and test with more sites.
4bba1a6e44a9ce4314dfa82faa72cf17f65025a7.issues: ANNs need enough sites to generalize; regional basins may limit transferability.

d6dc04cf654155ef4018d1adede6907c1198cd20.goal: Downscales climate variability and extremes using temporal neural networks.
d6dc04cf654155ef4018d1adede6907c1198cd20.architecture: Time-lagged feed-forward neural network (TLFN) for statistical downscaling, compared with regression approaches.
d6dc04cf654155ef4018d1adede6907c1198cd20.data: Large-scale predictors (reanalysis and GCM outputs) and station data in Quebec, Canada; details not reported here.
d6dc04cf654155ef4018d1adede6907c1198cd20.result: The temporal neural network reproduces daily variability and some extremes.
d6dc04cf654155ef4018d1adede6907c1198cd20.open_work: Evaluate extremes further with GCM scenarios.
d6dc04cf654155ef4018d1adede6907c1198cd20.issues: Conference paper with limited evaluation details.

dd717db12d92bb050f013de4f5f396490d38b56d.goal: Improves wind power forecasting by training neural networks with information-theoretic criteria rather than mean squared error.
dd717db12d92bb050f013de4f5f396490d38b56d.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) trained with minimum error entropy and maximum correntropy criteria, offline and online.
dd717db12d92bb050f013de4f5f396490d38b56d.data: Wind power data from a wind farm with numerical weather prediction inputs, up to three days ahead.
dd717db12d92bb050f013de4f5f396490d38b56d.result: Entropy and correntropy training improve forecasts compared to MSE, especially for non-Gaussian errors.
dd717db12d92bb050f013de4f5f396490d38b56d.open_work: Extend to probabilistic forecasting and other farms.
dd717db12d92bb050f013de4f5f396490d38b56d.issues: Single case study; computational cost of entropy-based training.

665b2529d3d74d95dc9e377d3c16dc088972eb48.goal: Forecasts wind speed and generated power in a wind farm.
665b2529d3d74d95dc9e377d3c16dc088972eb48.architecture: Forecasting method type not specified in the available metadata.
665b2529d3d74d95dc9e377d3c16dc088972eb48.data: Wind farm data; details not reported.

e94f2aa1e52a48f7a96359f363e8a3ead1ae1967.goal: Predicts wind speed using locally recurrent neural networks with spatial correlation from nearby sites.
e94f2aa1e52a48f7a96359f363e8a3ead1ae1967.architecture: Locally recurrent neural networks (with internal feedback connections) using multiple site measurements.
e94f2aa1e52a48f7a96359f363e8a3ead1ae1967.data: Wind speed measurements from multiple nearby sites; details not reported here.
e94f2aa1e52a48f7a96359f363e8a3ead1ae1967.result: The locally recurrent networks outperform static feed-forward networks for wind speed prediction.
e94f2aa1e52a48f7a96359f363e8a3ead1ae1967.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and more sites.

99e5ddd2b78e56e7bf477bd3e32eea1eb892a887.goal: Forecasts hourly solar radiation using two-dimensional representation of time series.
99e5ddd2b78e56e7bf477bd3e32eea1eb892a887.architecture: Optimal coefficient 2-D linear filters compared with feed-forward neural networks (MLP).
99e5ddd2b78e56e7bf477bd3e32eea1eb892a887.data: Hourly solar radiation data from a station in Turkey.
99e5ddd2b78e56e7bf477bd3e32eea1eb892a887.result: The neural network gives slightly better forecasts than the 2-D linear filters.
99e5ddd2b78e56e7bf477bd3e32eea1eb892a887.open_work: Extend to other stations and horizons.

413fedb6a6854ef6c09f9b8bd4adb4f05f05e792.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasts for wind farms by automating the choice of inputs and settings of AI forecasting models.
413fedb6a6854ef6c09f9b8bd4adb4f05f05e792.architecture: Evolutionary optimization (particle swarm optimization and differential evolution) selects inputs and parameters for neural network and nearest neighbour forecasting models, which are combined.
413fedb6a6854ef6c09f9b8bd4adb4f05f05e792.data: Numerical weather prediction forecasts and measured power from wind farms in Germany; exact sites and periods not reported here.
413fedb6a6854ef6c09f9b8bd4adb4f05f05e792.result: Automatically specified models and their combination reduce forecast error relative to the reference wind power forecasting approach.
413fedb6a6854ef6c09f9b8bd4adb4f05f05e792.open_work: Extending the automated specification to more sites, longer horizons and probabilistic forecasts.
413fedb6a6854ef6c09f9b8bd4adb4f05f05e792.issues: Depends on NWP input quality; optimization is computationally heavy and results are tied to the German farms studied.

16b3380f04f2a124592e5335a0f7a2c57895ae6f.goal: Forecasts solar irradiance for solar energy applications using neural networks with improved preprocessing of the input series.
16b3380f04f2a124592e5335a0f7a2c57895ae6f.architecture: Recurrent back-propagation neural network combined with wavelet decomposition of the sample data before training.
16b3380f04f2a124592e5335a0f7a2c57895ae6f.data: Measured solar irradiance series from a station in China; record length not reported here.
16b3380f04f2a124592e5335a0f7a2c57895ae6f.result: Wavelet preprocessing improves forecast accuracy compared with a neural network trained on the raw series.
16b3380f04f2a124592e5335a0f7a2c57895ae6f.open_work: Testing at other climates and adding meteorological predictors such as cloud cover.
16b3380f04f2a124592e5335a0f7a2c57895ae6f.issues: Single-site evaluation; generalization and the effect of the wavelet choice are not established.

03af8d60842a4f8da7885395563af4bdfba4edb4.goal: Estimates lower-atmosphere refractivity profiles, which control radar ducting, from radar sea clutter returns instead of direct soundings.
03af8d60842a4f8da7885395563af4bdfba4edb4.architecture: Non-ML inversion: a parabolic-equation propagation model fitted to clutter with a genetic algorithm global search, with posterior probability analysis for parameter uncertainty.
03af8d60842a4f8da7885395563af4bdfba4edb4.data: S-band SPANDAR radar sea clutter collected at Wallops Island, Virginia, compared with helicopter/in situ refractivity measurements.
03af8d60842a4f8da7885395563af4bdfba4edb4.result: Inverted refractivity parameters reproduce the observed ducting structure and propagation loss reasonably well, demonstrating refractivity-from-clutter feasibility.
03af8d60842a4f8da7885395563af4bdfba4edb4.open_work: Range-dependent environments, faster inversion for real-time use and more realistic clutter models.
03af8d60842a4f8da7885395563af4bdfba4edb4.issues: Relies on a simple parametric duct model and assumed clutter statistics; limited cases evaluated.

949a52ff12a6d0d704f27e5022e7acd45f890ab4.goal: Removes non-precipitating echoes such as ground clutter, anomalous propagation and biological targets from weather radar reflectivity automatically.
949a52ff12a6d0d704f27e5022e7acd45f890ab4.architecture: MLP neural network classifying radar gates using local reflectivity, velocity and spectrum-width texture and vertical-structure features, with pre- and post-processing rules.
949a52ff12a6d0d704f27e5022e7acd45f890ab4.data: WSR-88D (NEXRAD) volume scans with human-edited quality-controlled reflectivity as truth.
949a52ff12a6d0d704f27e5022e7acd45f890ab4.result: The neural network quality control removes most contaminated echoes while preserving precipitation better than the operational WSR-88D algorithm.
949a52ff12a6d0d704f27e5022e7acd45f890ab4.open_work: Using dual-polarization variables and handling clear-air and smaller precipitation echoes better.
949a52ff12a6d0d704f27e5022e7acd45f890ab4.issues: Truth relies on subjective human editing; some light precipitation and strong clutter cases remain misclassified.

2fbdac0c5e3b904baeed023470d473e28a734382.goal: Compares back-propagation training algorithms to guide the choice of neural network training methods in engineering applications.
2fbdac0c5e3b904baeed023470d473e28a734382.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks (MLP) trained with Levenberg-Marquardt, conjugate gradient and resilient back-propagation algorithms.
2fbdac0c5e3b904baeed023470d473e28a734382.data: Two case studies: daily streamflow forecasting in Turkey and estimation of lateral stress in cohesionless soils.
2fbdac0c5e3b904baeed023470d473e28a734382.result: Performance differences among the three algorithms are reported; Levenberg-Marquardt trains fastest, while the best generalization depends on the case.
2fbdac0c5e3b904baeed023470d473e28a734382.open_work: Testing more training algorithms, datasets and regularization strategies.
2fbdac0c5e3b904baeed023470d473e28a734382.issues: Only two small case studies; conclusions on algorithm ranking may not generalize.

57ebb85afba9d77125a9ab185e95dac9edbd3f2b.goal: Generates synthetic sequences of daily global solar radiation for isolated sites without long measurement records, for photovoltaic sizing.
57ebb85afba9d77125a9ab185e95dac9edbd3f2b.architecture: Neural network (MLP) combined with a library of Markov transition matrices that produces stochastic clearness-index sequences.
57ebb85afba9d77125a9ab185e95dac9edbd3f2b.data: Daily global solar radiation records from Algerian meteorological stations.
57ebb85afba9d77125a9ab185e95dac9edbd3f2b.result: Generated sequences reproduce the statistical properties of measured radiation reasonably well at test sites.
57ebb85afba9d77125a9ab185e95dac9edbd3f2b.open_work: Extending to hourly data and other climatic regions.
57ebb85afba9d77125a9ab185e95dac9edbd3f2b.issues: Validation limited to a few sites; quality depends on the Markov matrix library coverage.

9c0a0850c330e7e737b3179e6f00c18e684ea708.goal: Compares a physically based watershed model with a data-driven model for river flow forecasting in a Portuguese basin.
9c0a0850c330e7e737b3179e6f00c18e684ea708.architecture: SWAT hydrological model versus a feed-forward neural network (ANN) for flow forecasting.
9c0a0850c330e7e737b3179e6f00c18e684ea708.data: Rainfall and streamflow data for the Pracana basin, Portugal.
9c0a0850c330e7e737b3179e6f00c18e684ea708.result: The ANN gives better short-term flow forecasts than SWAT, which has difficulty reproducing peak flows.
9c0a0850c330e7e737b3179e6f00c18e684ea708.open_work: Hybrid use of SWAT and ANN and testing on other basins.
9c0a0850c330e7e737b3179e6f00c18e684ea708.issues: Single basin; ANN lacks physical interpretability and extrapolation to unobserved conditions.

ee1acded81e7020689da9083236bc1ac4300b767.goal: Reviews artificial intelligence techniques used to model, estimate and forecast solar radiation data.
ee1acded81e7020689da9083236bc1ac4300b767.architecture: Review of neural networks, fuzzy logic, genetic algorithms, expert systems and hybrid AI approaches for solar radiation.
ee1acded81e7020689da9083236bc1ac4300b767.data: Published studies on solar radiation estimation and forecasting from many stations worldwide.
ee1acded81e7020689da9083236bc1ac4300b767.result: AI techniques generally match or outperform conventional empirical and statistical methods for solar radiation modelling.
ee1acded81e7020689da9083236bc1ac4300b767.open_work: Better hybrid models, use of satellite data and standardized comparisons.
ee1acded81e7020689da9083236bc1ac4300b767.issues: Narrative review; reported performance is not comparable across studies with different data and metrics.

8514598deb63c69c75e0a87ca7e2b4c86ac3b173.goal: Forecasts ocean wave heights a few hours ahead for coastal and offshore operations.
8514598deb63c69c75e0a87ca7e2b4c86ac3b173.architecture: Recurrent neural network trained on past significant wave height series.
8514598deb63c69c75e0a87ca7e2b4c86ac3b173.data: Measured wave height data off Marmugao on the west coast of India.
8514598deb63c69c75e0a87ca7e2b4c86ac3b173.result: Recurrent network forecasts at 3, 6 and 12 h show high correlation with observations, decreasing with lead time.
8514598deb63c69c75e0a87ca7e2b4c86ac3b173.open_work: Adding wind inputs and longer lead times.
8514598deb63c69c75e0a87ca7e2b4c86ac3b173.issues: Single site; univariate input cannot anticipate wind-driven changes; short records.

7a071ff9d893aa20774d099d7e1b89fb71cef185.goal: Segments and classifies Baltic Sea ice in SAR imagery to support operational ice charting and navigation.
7a071ff9d893aa20774d099d7e1b89fb71cef185.architecture: Modified pulse-coupled neural network (PCNN) for segmentation followed by classification of segments using intensity and texture features.
7a071ff9d893aa20774d099d7e1b89fb71cef185.data: RADARSAT-1 ScanSAR images of the Baltic Sea with ice charts as reference.
7a071ff9d893aa20774d099d7e1b89fb71cef185.result: The method produces meaningful ice segments and classification useful for operational ice services.
7a071ff9d893aa20774d099d7e1b89fb71cef185.open_work: Using multi-polarization SAR and combining with other sensors.
7a071ff9d893aa20774d099d7e1b89fb71cef185.issues: Ice type ambiguity in single-channel SAR and incidence-angle effects limit accuracy.

7e819d9ac4a51775fc8e6afc6e627ceebd0b47f8.goal: Estimates evapotranspiration over the continental United States by upscaling flux tower measurements with satellite data.
7e819d9ac4a51775fc8e6afc6e627ceebd0b47f8.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression using remote sensing predictors.
7e819d9ac4a51775fc8e6afc6e627ceebd0b47f8.data: MODIS land surface temperature, vegetation index and land cover with AmeriFlux eddy-covariance tower ET.
7e819d9ac4a51775fc8e6afc6e627ceebd0b47f8.result: The SVM reproduces tower ET with good accuracy and produces continental-scale ET maps.
7e819d9ac4a51775fc8e6afc6e627ceebd0b47f8.open_work: Better representation of soil moisture limitation and more flux towers in undersampled biomes.
7e819d9ac4a51775fc8e6afc6e627ceebd0b47f8.issues: Tower network is sparse and biased toward certain ecosystems; no explicit uncertainty.

b37aaa2ab7df3edfa52e7bac3a9ac0134329f24e.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from climatic variables without the full Penman-Monteith data requirements.
b37aaa2ab7df3edfa52e7bac3a9ac0134329f24e.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) trained with Levenberg-Marquardt, compared with empirical ET equations.
b37aaa2ab7df3edfa52e7bac3a9ac0134329f24e.data: Daily climatic data (temperature, radiation, wind, humidity) from CIMIS stations in California.
b37aaa2ab7df3edfa52e7bac3a9ac0134329f24e.result: The neural network estimates reference ET more accurately than Penman, Hargreaves and Ritchie empirical methods.
b37aaa2ab7df3edfa52e7bac3a9ac0134329f24e.open_work: Testing in other climates and with fewer input variables.
b37aaa2ab7df3edfa52e7bac3a9ac0134329f24e.issues: Trained against computed rather than measured ET; station-specific.

142d5a7bf7e6f4615909b39981839a70979ea136.goal: Forecasts and estimates intermittent river flows, which contain many zero values and are hard for conventional models.
142d5a7bf7e6f4615909b39981839a70979ea136.architecture: Generalized regression neural network (GRNN) compared with feed-forward back-propagation neural networks and multiple linear regression.
142d5a7bf7e6f4615909b39981839a70979ea136.data: Daily intermittent streamflow records from rivers in Turkey.
142d5a7bf7e6f4615909b39981839a70979ea136.result: GRNN gives better or comparable accuracy to the other methods and avoids local minima during training.
142d5a7bf7e6f4615909b39981839a70979ea136.open_work: Combining with other data-driven methods and testing more catchments.
142d5a7bf7e6f4615909b39981839a70979ea136.issues: Limited number of stations; zero-flow periods remain challenging.

e9495e0b02b21ab1036c86399c34502760a89052.goal: Improves hydrological forecasting by automatically optimizing neural network structure and weights.
e9495e0b02b21ab1036c86399c34502760a89052.architecture: Evolutionary artificial neural network: a genetic algorithm searches the network architecture and connection weights of a feed-forward neural network.
e9495e0b02b21ab1036c86399c34502760a89052.data: Hydrological time series (reservoir inflow or river flow) from Taiwan.
e9495e0b02b21ab1036c86399c34502760a89052.result: The evolutionary neural network forecasts more accurately than conventional trial-and-error designed networks.
e9495e0b02b21ab1036c86399c34502760a89052.open_work: Applying to multi-step and probabilistic forecasting.
e9495e0b02b21ab1036c86399c34502760a89052.issues: Computational cost of the genetic search; limited case studies.

2f2a7cb6a71855dc4d46f6d029a0b24eca38c67a.goal: Separates precipitating from nonprecipitating radar echoes such as ground clutter, sea clutter and clear-air returns using polarimetry.
2f2a7cb6a71855dc4d46f6d029a0b24eca38c67a.architecture: Fuzzy logic classifier with membership functions derived from observed distributions of polarimetric variables and their texture.
2f2a7cb6a71855dc4d46f6d029a0b24eca38c67a.data: C-band polarimetric radar observations from the Météo-France Trappes radar near Paris.
2f2a7cb6a71855dc4d46f6d029a0b24eca38c67a.result: The fuzzy logic algorithm identifies precipitation and clutter echoes with high accuracy, with differential phase texture and copolar correlation most useful.
2f2a7cb6a71855dc4d46f6d029a0b24eca38c67a.open_work: Extending to other radars, wavelengths and mixed echo situations.
2f2a7cb6a71855dc4d46f6d029a0b24eca38c67a.issues: Membership functions are tuned to one radar; attenuation and partial beam blockage can affect classification.

185a35eb3ca08c06d5c44278ba715bfb451066cf.goal: Forecasts daily maximum summertime ozone concentrations in Athens for air quality warnings.
185a35eb3ca08c06d5c44278ba715bfb451066cf.architecture: Neural network (MLP) compared with multiple linear regression.
185a35eb3ca08c06d5c44278ba715bfb451066cf.data: Meteorological and ozone monitoring data from Athens, Greece, summer seasons.
185a35eb3ca08c06d5c44278ba715bfb451066cf.result: Neural networks outperform regression models, especially when previous-day ozone is included as a predictor.
185a35eb3ca08c06d5c44278ba715bfb451066cf.open_work: Better prediction of exceedance episodes and use of forecast meteorology.
185a35eb3ca08c06d5c44278ba715bfb451066cf.issues: Single city; few extreme ozone episodes; uses observed rather than forecast meteorology.

00929a3a6072bccd8b2151cca0dc78bf81f58761.goal: Forecasts stream water temperature, which affects aquatic ecosystems and lake clarity.
00929a3a6072bccd8b2151cca0dc78bf81f58761.architecture: Comparison of multiple regression, neural network (ANN) and chaotic non-linear dynamic models.
00929a3a6072bccd8b2151cca0dc78bf81f58761.data: Stream temperature and meteorological data from streams in the Lake Tahoe basin.
00929a3a6072bccd8b2151cca0dc78bf81f58761.result: The neural network gives the best forecasts among the three approaches.
00929a3a6072bccd8b2151cca0dc78bf81f58761.open_work: Longer records and use for climate-change scenarios.
00929a3a6072bccd8b2151cca0dc78bf81f58761.issues: Short records and few streams; data-driven models may not extrapolate to new climate conditions.

680dc1f6613c73cc88183a3c7e34ea1e3802b8ad.goal: Forecasts peak daily summer water demand to support municipal water supply operations.
680dc1f6613c73cc88183a3c7e34ea1e3802b8ad.architecture: Neural network (MLP) compared with multiple linear regression and time series models.
680dc1f6613c73cc88183a3c7e34ea1e3802b8ad.data: Daily water demand and weather (maximum temperature, rainfall) data from Ottawa, Canada.
680dc1f6613c73cc88183a3c7e34ea1e3802b8ad.result: Neural network models forecast peak daily demand more accurately than regression and time series models.
680dc1f6613c73cc88183a3c7e34ea1e3802b8ad.open_work: Wavelet or hybrid methods and longer lead times.
680dc1f6613c73cc88183a3c7e34ea1e3802b8ad.issues: Single city and limited summers of data.

953c1fd33cd4b46d9397725b7b7026e51e809276.goal: Models catchment rainfall-runoff response with an evolutionary method that discovers model structure from data.
953c1fd33cd4b46d9397725b7b7026e51e809276.architecture: Genetic programming evolving symbolic rainfall-runoff relationships, compared with a conceptual model.
953c1fd33cd4b46d9397725b7b7026e51e809276.data: Rainfall and streamflow records from catchments; specific catchments not reported here.
953c1fd33cd4b46d9397725b7b7026e51e809276.result: Genetic programming produces rainfall-runoff models with performance comparable to the conceptual model.
953c1fd33cd4b46d9397725b7b7026e51e809276.open_work: Interpreting evolved expressions physically and testing more catchments.
953c1fd33cd4b46d9397725b7b7026e51e809276.issues: Evolved models can be complex and hard to interpret; risk of overfitting.

9fc51a0ad1e1c37a3ceb812655338e6da4090d31.goal: Forecasts water level fluctuations of Lake Van, a large closed lake in Turkey.
9fc51a0ad1e1c37a3ceb812655338e6da4090d31.architecture: Neural network (ANN) applied to lake level time series, compared with a conventional time series model.
9fc51a0ad1e1c37a3ceb812655338e6da4090d31.data: Historical Lake Van water level records.
9fc51a0ad1e1c37a3ceb812655338e6da4090d31.result: The neural network forecasts lake levels with good accuracy.
9fc51a0ad1e1c37a3ceb812655338e6da4090d31.open_work: Including climatic inputs such as precipitation and evaporation.
9fc51a0ad1e1c37a3ceb812655338e6da4090d31.issues: Single lake; univariate approach may miss climate-driven shifts.

02b56d8f94fae1964b05c654a2d0dbd7e2f9a220.goal: Tests how the length of the training record affects data-driven and conceptual rainfall-runoff forecasting models.
02b56d8f94fae1964b05c654a2d0dbd7e2f9a220.architecture: Neural network (MLP) compared with the parsimonious conceptual GR4J model.
02b56d8f94fae1964b05c654a2d0dbd7e2f9a220.data: Daily rainfall, evapotranspiration and streamflow from several catchments; training periods of varying length.
02b56d8f94fae1964b05c654a2d0dbd7e2f9a220.result: The conceptual model is more robust with short records, while the neural network needs longer records to reach its best performance.
02b56d8f94fae1964b05c654a2d0dbd7e2f9a220.open_work: Methods to make neural networks data-efficient and hybrid approaches.
02b56d8f94fae1964b05c654a2d0dbd7e2f9a220.issues: Limited catchments; neural network sensitivity to training design.

8fe6d87fde10b39d04389d9f537f056a975f9568.goal: Compares retrieval algorithms for estimating soil moisture from C-band SAR to support hydrological applications.
8fe6d87fde10b39d04389d9f537f056a975f9568.architecture: Comparison of a neural network (MLP), a Bayesian approach and a Nelder-Mead minimization inversion of backscatter models.
8fe6d87fde10b39d04389d9f537f056a975f9568.data: ENVISAT ASAR images with ground soil moisture measurements from test sites in Italy.
8fe6d87fde10b39d04389d9f537f056a975f9568.result: The neural network provides the best compromise of accuracy and computational cost among the algorithms.
8fe6d87fde10b39d04389d9f537f056a975f9568.open_work: Accounting for vegetation and roughness effects and operational application.
8fe6d87fde10b39d04389d9f537f056a975f9568.issues: Limited test sites; retrieval sensitive to surface roughness and vegetation.

c40ed37fadfdd79fd9ec5e46cd1af2444b690e40.goal: Forecasts hourly and daily solar irradiation for solar energy applications.
c40ed37fadfdd79fd9ec5e46cd1af2444b690e40.architecture: Diagonal recurrent wavelet neural network, a recurrent neural network using wavelet activation functions.
c40ed37fadfdd79fd9ec5e46cd1af2444b690e40.data: Measured solar irradiation data from a station in China.
c40ed37fadfdd79fd9ec5e46cd1af2444b690e40.result: The diagonal recurrent wavelet neural network forecasts hourly and daily irradiation with good accuracy, better than conventional networks.
c40ed37fadfdd79fd9ec5e46cd1af2444b690e40.open_work: Testing at other sites and integrating weather forecasts.
c40ed37fadfdd79fd9ec5e46cd1af2444b690e40.issues: Single site evaluation; limited comparison against strong baselines.

937236b7de1bd8d18020bb1b8365aaa2ddf77eeb.goal: Predicts wind farm power output for grid integration using data-mining methods.
937236b7de1bd8d18020bb1b8365aaa2ddf77eeb.architecture: Data-mining comparison of several algorithms (neural networks, regression trees, support vector machines and others), with an MLP selected as best.
937236b7de1bd8d18020bb1b8365aaa2ddf77eeb.data: Wind farm SCADA power data and numerical weather prediction wind forecasts.
937236b7de1bd8d18020bb1b8365aaa2ddf77eeb.result: Data-driven models predict short-term power well, while accuracy degrades for longer horizons with NWP inputs.
937236b7de1bd8d18020bb1b8365aaa2ddf77eeb.open_work: Improving long-horizon forecasts and turbine-level models.
937236b7de1bd8d18020bb1b8365aaa2ddf77eeb.issues: Single wind farm; performance limited by NWP wind forecast errors.

1ad1509765d5b19f8cb297582b2ce67fc1a642af.goal: Predicts All India summer monsoon rainfall a season ahead.
1ad1509765d5b19f8cb297582b2ce67fc1a642af.architecture: Neural network (MLP) using only past rainfall time series as predictors.
1ad1509765d5b19f8cb297582b2ce67fc1a642af.data: All India monthly and seasonal rainfall series (IITM), about 1871 onward.
1ad1509765d5b19f8cb297582b2ce67fc1a642af.result: The neural network gives skilful hindcasts of seasonal monsoon rainfall using only antecedent rainfall.
1ad1509765d5b19f8cb297582b2ce67fc1a642af.open_work: Adding ocean and atmospheric predictors and operational testing.
1ad1509765d5b19f8cb297582b2ce67fc1a642af.issues: Short record for training and verification; risk of overfitting and nonstationary predictor relations.

a0dcda23a8db6ffa7edd476f5a434856b7e62de7.goal: Predicts rice yield in mountainous regions where conventional models perform poorly.
a0dcda23a8db6ffa7edd476f5a434856b7e62de7.architecture: Neural network (MLP) compared with multiple linear regression.
a0dcda23a8db6ffa7edd476f5a434856b7e62de7.data: Field and climatic data for rice in mountainous areas of Fujian, China.
a0dcda23a8db6ffa7edd476f5a434856b7e62de7.result: Neural network models predict rice yield more accurately than linear regression.
a0dcda23a8db6ffa7edd476f5a434856b7e62de7.open_work: Adding more sites and seasons and testing input sensitivity.

e40970aa6068e5305b3c9ed79c86819bfd3b614c.goal: Compares deterministic, statistical and neural network techniques for event-based rainfall-runoff modelling.
e40970aa6068e5305b3c9ed79c86819bfd3b614c.architecture: Neural network (ANN) compared with a deterministic conceptual model and statistical regression models.
e40970aa6068e5305b3c9ed79c86819bfd3b614c.data: Storm event rainfall and runoff data from a watershed; site not reported here.
e40970aa6068e5305b3c9ed79c86819bfd3b614c.result: Neural network models reproduce event runoff better than deterministic and statistical models.
e40970aa6068e5305b3c9ed79c86819bfd3b614c.open_work: Testing on more watersheds and event types.
e40970aa6068e5305b3c9ed79c86819bfd3b614c.issues: Limited events; ANN lacks physical interpretability.

765d6d5dc979982e62004645b58f67661cc1e929.goal: Estimates spatial distribution of snow water equivalent in a mountain watershed.
765d6d5dc979982e62004645b58f67661cc1e929.architecture: Binary regression tree on terrain variables combined with geostatistical kriging of residuals.
765d6d5dc979982e62004645b58f67661cc1e929.data: Snow surveys in the Loch Vale watershed, Colorado, with terrain variables from a DEM.
765d6d5dc979982e62004645b58f67661cc1e929.result: Combining the regression tree with kriging of residuals improves snow distribution estimates over either method alone.
765d6d5dc979982e62004645b58f67661cc1e929.open_work: Transfer to other watersheds and years.
765d6d5dc979982e62004645b58f67661cc1e929.issues: Dependent on survey density; interannual variability not fully addressed.

98d847740ac8909426dba88eeb5a21e6946cb039.goal: Predicts aquifer water levels responding to pumping and climate stresses for groundwater management.
98d847740ac8909426dba88eeb5a21e6946cb039.architecture: Neural network (ANN) trained on pumping, rainfall and past water levels.
98d847740ac8909426dba88eeb5a21e6946cb039.data: Water level, pumping and weather data from wells in a Florida aquifer system.
98d847740ac8909426dba88eeb5a21e6946cb039.result: The neural network predicts water levels accurately, reportedly better than a numerical groundwater flow model at the monitored wells.
98d847740ac8909426dba88eeb5a21e6946cb039.open_work: Use in optimization of pumping strategies.
98d847740ac8909426dba88eeb5a21e6946cb039.issues: Well-specific models; may not extrapolate to unseen pumping regimes.

5dc6bf03e1adb6a49419103aeedb28af74655e80.goal: Develops a neural network model to forecast the air pollution index operationally.
5dc6bf03e1adb6a49419103aeedb28af74655e80.architecture: Neural network (MLP) using meteorological and pollution predictors.
5dc6bf03e1adb6a49419103aeedb28af74655e80.data: Air pollution index and meteorological data from a Chinese city.
5dc6bf03e1adb6a49419103aeedb28af74655e80.result: The neural network forecasts the air pollution index with reasonable accuracy for operational use.
5dc6bf03e1adb6a49419103aeedb28af74655e80.issues: Single location; extreme episodes harder to predict.

08b5e3206ec006009e81c6c0b593974e3a08c083.goal: Compares neural network types for river flow forecasting and estimation.
08b5e3206ec006009e81c6c0b593974e3a08c083.architecture: Feed-forward neural network, radial basis function network and generalized regression neural network (GRNN).
08b5e3206ec006009e81c6c0b593974e3a08c083.data: Daily river flow records from stations in Turkey.
08b5e3206ec006009e81c6c0b593974e3a08c083.result: The network types perform comparably, with differences depending on task and station.

ed5cc7ddc16ad044bc3694f2f89a47fbb914de28.goal: Models daily rainfall-runoff using neural networks for catchments.
ed5cc7ddc16ad044bc3694f2f89a47fbb914de28.architecture: Neural network (MLP) trained on rainfall and previous runoff.
ed5cc7ddc16ad044bc3694f2f89a47fbb914de28.data: Daily rainfall and runoff for catchments in India.
ed5cc7ddc16ad044bc3694f2f89a47fbb914de28.result: The neural network simulates daily runoff with satisfactory accuracy.
ed5cc7ddc16ad044bc3694f2f89a47fbb914de28.open_work: Coupling with conceptual models and testing other basins.

e9fba8427358760acb6803c7be69726dadbc9a85.goal: Forecasts drought conditions to support water resources planning.
e9fba8427358760acb6803c7be69726dadbc9a85.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) forecasting the Standardized Precipitation Index.
e9fba8427358760acb6803c7be69726dadbc9a85.data: Monthly precipitation and SPI from stations in Central Anatolia, Turkey.
e9fba8427358760acb6803c7be69726dadbc9a85.result: ANFIS forecasts SPI at several time scales with good accuracy; quantitative scores are not reported here.
e9fba8427358760acb6803c7be69726dadbc9a85.open_work: Extending to longer lead times and other drought indices.

18114409e34680137f7077f29f0054425673121c.goal: Forecasts waves at one station using records from neighbouring stations.
18114409e34680137f7077f29f0054425673121c.architecture: Back-propagation neural network (MLP) with multi-station inputs.
18114409e34680137f7077f29f0054425673121c.data: Wave records from coastal buoy stations in Taiwan.
18114409e34680137f7077f29f0054425673121c.result: Multi-station neural network forecasts reproduce wave heights at target stations well.
18114409e34680137f7077f29f0054425673121c.open_work: Longer lead times and wind input.
18114409e34680137f7077f29f0054425673121c.issues: Dependent on station network; short records.

1c21f43b4d94f76a1febcba8f25467db72c8da0c.goal: Improves dual-polarization radar hydrometeor classification and verifies it with in situ observations.
1c21f43b4d94f76a1febcba8f25467db72c8da0c.architecture: Fuzzy logic hydrometeor classification using polarimetric variables, with refined membership functions.
1c21f43b4d94f76a1febcba8f25467db72c8da0c.data: CSU-CHILL S-band polarimetric radar observations with in situ hydrometeor observations for verification.
1c21f43b4d94f76a1febcba8f25467db72c8da0c.result: The improved classifier matches in situ hydrometeor observations well.
1c21f43b4d94f76a1febcba8f25467db72c8da0c.open_work: Applying to other radars and climates.
1c21f43b4d94f76a1febcba8f25467db72c8da0c.issues: Limited verification cases; membership functions tuned to S-band.

e6a437735576f0e7cf72e39ddc99b0e202be8b47.goal: Retrieves ocean surface wind speeds globally from synthetic aperture radar imagery.
e6a437735576f0e7cf72e39ddc99b0e202be8b47.architecture: Neural network inversion of a C-band geophysical model function using SAR backscatter and wind direction from image streaks.
e6a437735576f0e7cf72e39ddc99b0e202be8b47.data: ERS-2 SAR imagery worldwide compared with ECMWF model winds.
e6a437735576f0e7cf72e39ddc99b0e202be8b47.result: SAR wind retrievals agree well with model winds globally.
e6a437735576f0e7cf72e39ddc99b0e202be8b47.open_work: Improved direction retrieval and use of Envisat ASAR.
e6a437735576f0e7cf72e39ddc99b0e202be8b47.issues: Dependent on model function; validation against model winds.

49a537034c618c8cca4ab470b7def22f184dd094.goal: Forecasts intermittent streamflow using wavelet-neural network conjunction.
49a537034c618c8cca4ab470b7def22f184dd094.architecture: Wavelet decomposition combined with a feed-forward neural network.
49a537034c618c8cca4ab470b7def22f184dd094.data: Daily intermittent streamflow records from Turkey.
49a537034c618c8cca4ab470b7def22f184dd094.result: The wavelet-neural network model outperforms a single neural network.
49a537034c618c8cca4ab470b7def22f184dd094.issues: Limited stations; zero flows remain difficult.

4186b7d0f41ae1bc0eef3858fb544b19efa3a114.goal: Forecasts 24-hour-ahead PV power generation for grid operation.
4186b7d0f41ae1bc0eef3858fb544b19efa3a114.architecture: Neural networks (feed-forward, radial basis function and recurrent) using forecast weather inputs.
4186b7d0f41ae1bc0eef3858fb544b19efa3a114.data: Meteorological and insolation data in Japan.
4186b7d0f41ae1bc0eef3858fb544b19efa3a114.result: Neural network forecasts of next-day PV output are reported, with the recurrent network performing best among those tested.
4186b7d0f41ae1bc0eef3858fb544b19efa3a114.issues: Single site; dependent on weather forecast accuracy.

b7ce1069249df63dcea5f355d79369730b81d082.goal: Develops an all-sky imager to assess cloud cover automatically.
b7ce1069249df63dcea5f355d79369730b81d082.architecture: Sky camera system with a neural network classifier optimized by a genetic algorithm.
b7ce1069249df63dcea5f355d79369730b81d082.result: The imager estimates cloud cover in good agreement with observers.

f08d6632611abbf6040d04496b155d6acce9ff85.goal: Evaluates neural networks for daily streamflow forecasting.
f08d6632611abbf6040d04496b155d6acce9ff85.architecture: Neural network (MLP) compared with a deterministic model and autoregressive models.
f08d6632611abbf6040d04496b155d6acce9ff85.data: Daily streamflow and rainfall from the Mistassibi River, Quebec.
f08d6632611abbf6040d04496b155d6acce9ff85.result: The neural network outperforms the alternatives for lead times up to several days.
f08d6632611abbf6040d04496b155d6acce9ff85.open_work: Longer lead times and other rivers.

cf27d8179c96b8dc503af10ac7e15745cba371ae.goal: Identifies ground clutter in weather radar data in real time so that clutter filtering is applied only where needed, avoiding bias in precipitation echoes from indiscriminate filtering.
cf27d8179c96b8dc503af10ac7e15745cba371ae.architecture: Fuzzy logic Clutter Mitigation Decision (CMD) algorithm combining clutter phase alignment and reflectivity texture/spin features, followed by a spectral clutter filter (GMAP) at flagged gates; not a trained ML model.
cf27d8179c96b8dc503af10ac7e15745cba371ae.data: S-band research and operational Doppler radar time series (NCAR S-Pol and NEXRAD-type data); exact cases not reported in the abstract.
cf27d8179c96b8dc503af10ac7e15745cba371ae.result: Selective clutter filtering guided by the fuzzy decision removes clutter while largely preserving weather echoes that overlap clutter regions.
cf27d8179c96b8dc503af10ac7e15745cba371ae.open_work: Extension to other radar wavelengths and scanning strategies and tuning of membership functions for different clutter environments.
cf27d8179c96b8dc503af10ac7e15745cba371ae.issues: Hand-designed membership functions and thresholds; performance in mixed clutter-weather gates and anomalous propagation depends on site tuning.

4852d57e72ed462a64d6fd2dfa9b536749230cad.goal: Forecasts daily natural gas consumption for utilities, where demand depends strongly on weather, by combining several neural network forecasters to improve accuracy.
4852d57e72ed462a64d6fd2dfa9b536749230cad.architecture: Two-stage system: individual neural network forecasters (multilayer perceptron and functional-link network) whose outputs are combined by several strategies, including averaging, least-squares weighting, fuzzy logic and mixture of experts.
4852d57e72ed462a64d6fd2dfa9b536749230cad.data: Daily gas consumption and weather (temperature) records from several gas utilities; specific periods not reported here.
4852d57e72ed462a64d6fd2dfa9b536749230cad.result: Combined forecasters outperform the individual neural networks, with the combination methods reducing forecast error relative to single models.
4852d57e72ed462a64d6fd2dfa9b536749230cad.open_work: Extending the combination framework to other energy loads and longer horizons, and handling forecast weather uncertainty.
4852d57e72ed462a64d6fd2dfa9b536749230cad.issues: Uses observed weather as input, so operational errors from weather forecasts are not fully represented; utility-specific data limit generality.

81e1ebfa5b82090006deaee1b629b1fb336d71a5.goal: Estimates evapotranspiration with artificial neural networks and examines whether the trained networks can be interpreted physically rather than treated as black boxes.
81e1ebfa5b82090006deaee1b629b1fb336d71a5.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward type) models with different climatic input combinations, plus analysis of the trained network to relate it to the physics of evapotranspiration.
81e1ebfa5b82090006deaee1b629b1fb336d71a5.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
81e1ebfa5b82090006deaee1b629b1fb336d71a5.result: ANN models estimate evapotranspiration well with limited climatic inputs, and the trained networks can be partly interpreted in physical terms.
81e1ebfa5b82090006deaee1b629b1fb336d71a5.open_work: Testing across climates and generalising the interpretation approach to other hydrological ANN models.
81e1ebfa5b82090006deaee1b629b1fb336d71a5.issues: Single-region data and reference evapotranspiration targets derived from empirical formulas limit generality.

49d069f86b1ef9e36766c624adf7cf69411ef0c6.goal: Automates detection of oil spills on satellite radar images to support marine pollution monitoring, replacing slow manual interpretation.
49d069f86b1ef9e36766c624adf7cf69411ef0c6.architecture: Fuzzy logic classification system that segments dark formations and scores them with geometric and contrast features to separate oil spills from look-alikes.
49d069f86b1ef9e36766c624adf7cf69411ef0c6.data: Spaceborne synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery over the Mediterranean; scene counts not reported here.
49d069f86b1ef9e36766c624adf7cf69411ef0c6.result: The fuzzy system identifies most verified oil spills while discriminating many look-alike dark areas, offering a practical aid to operators.
49d069f86b1ef9e36766c624adf7cf69411ef0c6.open_work: Larger validation sets, wind-condition dependence and integration into operational monitoring services.
49d069f86b1ef9e36766c624adf7cf69411ef0c6.issues: Look-alike phenomena (low wind, biogenic films) still cause false alarms; limited verified ground truth.

41ab32907e57ffb634953f9061c1eacb5944c7f2.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from climatic variables with a neuro-fuzzy model as an alternative to empirical equations.
41ab32907e57ffb634953f9061c1eacb5944c7f2.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) compared with empirical methods such as Hargreaves, Ritchie, Turc and Penman variants, using FAO-56 Penman-Monteith as reference.
41ab32907e57ffb634953f9061c1eacb5944c7f2.data: Daily climatic data from California Irrigation Management Information System (CIMIS) stations near Los Angeles.
41ab32907e57ffb634953f9061c1eacb5944c7f2.result: ANFIS reproduces FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference evapotranspiration more accurately than the empirical equations tested.
41ab32907e57ffb634953f9061c1eacb5944c7f2.open_work: Testing with fewer inputs and at sites with different climates, and comparison with other machine learning methods.
41ab32907e57ffb634953f9061c1eacb5944c7f2.issues: Target is a computed reference ET rather than lysimeter measurements; few stations.

770d8346aafa51b245de568a9bd3d807efda3d56.goal: Forecasts daily peak air pollution levels (notably ozone) to support warning systems in a polluted urban region.
770d8346aafa51b245de568a9bd3d807efda3d56.architecture: Nonlinear autoregressive models with exogenous inputs (NARX) identified from data, using meteorological and pollutant predictors.
770d8346aafa51b245de568a9bd3d807efda3d56.data: Air quality monitoring and meteorological data from Northern Italy; stations and periods not reported here.
770d8346aafa51b245de568a9bd3d807efda3d56.result: NARX models give useful next-day peak pollution forecasts, competitive with alternative statistical approaches.
770d8346aafa51b245de568a9bd3d807efda3d56.open_work: Including forecast meteorology, more stations and probabilistic exceedance forecasts.
770d8346aafa51b245de568a9bd3d807efda3d56.issues: Site-specific models; performance on extreme episodes and transferability are uncertain.

2cd88e4aa22cd353f5b95cc0f5f0e873ff1c13dd.goal: Predicts transient groundwater levels in a multilayered aquifer system affected by pumping and climate, as a fast alternative to numerical groundwater models.
2cd88e4aa22cd353f5b95cc0f5f0e873ff1c13dd.architecture: Artificial neural network trained on pumping rates, climate variables and initial water levels, compared with a numerical groundwater flow model.
