2cd88e4aa22cd353f5b95cc0f5f0e873ff1c13dd.data: Observed water levels, wellfield pumping and climate data from a multilayered aquifer system in Florida.
2cd88e4aa22cd353f5b95cc0f5f0e873ff1c13dd.result: The ANN predicts water levels accurately under varying pumping and climate and outperforms the calibrated numerical model at the monitored wells.
2cd88e4aa22cd353f5b95cc0f5f0e873ff1c13dd.open_work: Using ANN predictors within wellfield management optimization and extending to longer horizons.
2cd88e4aa22cd353f5b95cc0f5f0e873ff1c13dd.issues: Point predictions only at trained wells; extrapolation beyond observed pumping and climate ranges is uncertain.

e3b76f90d50c8ec87e1009b69cf27ad6f15fa4cd.goal: Improves satellite chlorophyll retrieval across optically different waters by selecting and blending ocean color algorithms according to water type.
e3b76f90d50c8ec87e1009b69cf27ad6f15fa4cd.architecture: Fuzzy logic classification (fuzzy c-means memberships of remote-sensing reflectance spectra into optical water types) with membership-weighted blending of class-specific bio-optical algorithms.
e3b76f90d50c8ec87e1009b69cf27ad6f15fa4cd.data: In situ reflectance and chlorophyll data sets (SeaBASS-type collections) applied to SeaWiFS imagery.
e3b76f90d50c8ec87e1009b69cf27ad6f15fa4cd.result: Membership-weighted blending yields smooth chlorophyll fields and lower retrieval errors than a single global algorithm across water types.
e3b76f90d50c8ec87e1009b69cf27ad6f15fa4cd.open_work: Defining more water classes, especially for coastal Case 2 waters, and applying the scheme to other sensors.
e3b76f90d50c8ec87e1009b69cf27ad6f15fa4cd.issues: Class definitions depend on the in situ training set; coastal waters with sediments and CDOM remain poorly represented.

4924927bf555d16f10d00d78b77f7827386813a6.goal: Improves quantitative flood forecasts by feeding a neural network with information from multiple sensors beyond rain gauges.
4924927bf555d16f10d00d78b77f7827386813a6.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting river stage or discharge from multisensor inputs (rainfall, upstream flows, satellite-derived cloud information).
4924927bf555d16f10d00d78b77f7827386813a6.data: Multisensor hydrometeorological observations including satellite data for a large flood event in the US Midwest; details not reported here.
4924927bf555d16f10d00d78b77f7827386813a6.result: Adding satellite and atmospheric information to the neural network improves flood forecast skill compared with using gauge data alone.
4924927bf555d16f10d00d78b77f7827386813a6.open_work: Longer lead times and use of radar and numerical weather prediction inputs.
4924927bf555d16f10d00d78b77f7827386813a6.issues: Evaluation on few flood events in one basin; network type and generalisation not assessed broadly.

0bb4a3aa8c34ee352e1932d9336df46d0338e513.goal: Improves river level forecasting by combining several data-driven and statistical forecasting models rather than relying on a single model.
0bb4a3aa8c34ee352e1932d9336df46d0338e513.architecture: Hybrid multi-model approach: self-organizing map partitioning with multilayer perceptron neural networks per class, a fuzzy logic model, ARIMA-type and naive models, integrated by averaging, Bayesian and fuzzy rule-based combination.
0bb4a3aa8c34ee352e1932d9336df46d0338e513.data: Hourly river level records from the River Ouse catchment, Yorkshire, UK.
0bb4a3aa8c34ee352e1932d9336df46d0338e513.result: Combining models outperforms the individual forecasters, with the fuzzy and data-driven integrations giving the best river level forecasts.
0bb4a3aa8c34ee352e1932d9336df46d0338e513.open_work: Longer lead times, other catchments and more formal combination methods.
0bb4a3aa8c34ee352e1932d9336df46d0338e513.issues: Single catchment; short lead times; combination rules tuned on the same basin.

a8124baccfa5644bac03c11f6fe4d03fe5e1dcb5.goal: Produces seasonal to interannual ensemble streamflow forecasts for reservoirs in semiarid Ceará, Brazil, to support water allocation.
a8124baccfa5644bac03c11f6fe4d03fe5e1dcb5.architecture: Multivariate semiparametric k-nearest neighbour resampling conditioned on climate predictors (tropical Pacific and Atlantic sea surface temperature indices); a statistical, not neural, method.
a8124baccfa5644bac03c11f6fe4d03fe5e1dcb5.data: Reconstructed/observed streamflow at multiple reservoir sites in Ceará and SST-based climate indices.
a8124baccfa5644bac03c11f6fe4d03fe5e1dcb5.result: The nearest-neighbour approach gives skillful probabilistic streamflow forecasts at seasonal and longer lead times that preserve cross-site correlations.
a8124baccfa5644bac03c11f6fe4d03fe5e1dcb5.open_work: Using forecasts in reservoir operation and adding predictors from dynamical climate models.
a8124baccfa5644bac03c11f6fe4d03fe5e1dcb5.issues: Short records limit the number of analogs; skill depends on stable climate-streamflow teleconnections.

6dd9655a506dd304eb70635897ed557102520519.goal: Characterises North Atlantic atmospheric circulation variability, including the North Atlantic Oscillation, with a nonlinear pattern-based method.
6dd9655a506dd304eb70635897ed557102520519.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) applied to sea level pressure fields and compared with principal component (EOF) analysis.
6dd9655a506dd304eb70635897ed557102520519.data: Monthly winter sea level pressure from the NCEP/NCAR reanalysis over the North Atlantic.
6dd9655a506dd304eb70635897ed557102520519.result: The SOM captures a continuum of circulation patterns, including NAO-like states and asymmetries that linear EOF analysis does not resolve.
6dd9655a506dd304eb70635897ed557102520519.open_work: Linking SOM states to ice core and proxy records and to climate model output.
6dd9655a506dd304eb70635897ed557102520519.issues: SOM size and training choices are subjective; reanalysis biases are inherited.

fd575735b330a53d65b68ed089201a0738cd2f15.goal: Predicts long-term (monthly) inflow discharges to Manwan hydropower reservoir in China for reservoir operation.
fd575735b330a53d65b68ed089201a0738cd2f15.architecture: Artificial neural network models; the specific network type and training variants are not reported here.
fd575735b330a53d65b68ed089201a0738cd2f15.data: Historical monthly discharge records for Manwan reservoir on the Lancang River, China.
fd575735b330a53d65b68ed089201a0738cd2f15.result: The ANN models provide reasonable long-term discharge predictions, better than a conventional time-series benchmark.
fd575735b330a53d65b68ed089201a0738cd2f15.open_work: Adding climate predictors and comparing with other data-driven methods.
fd575735b330a53d65b68ed089201a0738cd2f15.issues: Single-site; limited evaluation of extremes and uncertainty.

613c95705bb497a102d43a594ab473c54da9b857.goal: Compares different artificial neural network types for predicting river flow.
613c95705bb497a102d43a594ab473c54da9b857.architecture: Feedforward backpropagation, radial basis function and generalized regression neural networks.
613c95705bb497a102d43a594ab473c54da9b857.data: River flow records from Turkish gauging stations; details not reported here.
613c95705bb497a102d43a594ab473c54da9b857.result: The network types give comparable accuracy, with differences depending on training and station; no single type dominates.
613c95705bb497a102d43a594ab473c54da9b857.open_work: Comparison with other data-driven methods and multi-step forecasts.
613c95705bb497a102d43a594ab473c54da9b857.issues: Few stations; results sensitive to input selection and training set.

03620b177b90b1baf0f685853c920d67cf345745.goal: Improves river flow time series prediction by a neural network whose behaviour adapts to the flow range.
03620b177b90b1baf0f685853c920d67cf345745.architecture: Range-dependent neural network, a modified feedforward network that treats different flow ranges separately, compared with a standard neural network.
03620b177b90b1baf0f685853c920d67cf345745.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
03620b177b90b1baf0f685853c920d67cf345745.result: The range-dependent network predicts river flows more accurately than a conventional network, particularly for high flows.
03620b177b90b1baf0f685853c920d67cf345745.open_work: Testing on more rivers and longer lead times.
03620b177b90b1baf0f685853c920d67cf345745.issues: Limited case studies; range partitioning choices are ad hoc.

874928afccb3152d7056e0063551014874923439.goal: Estimates solar radiation in Chinese cities with different climates where radiation measurements are sparse.
874928afccb3152d7056e0063551014874923439.architecture: Artificial neural network models using meteorological inputs such as sunshine duration; network type not specified here.
874928afccb3152d7056e0063551014874923439.data: Long-term meteorological and solar radiation records from stations in different climate zones of China.
874928afccb3152d7056e0063551014874923439.result: ANN models estimate solar radiation well across climates and can be used where radiation is not measured.
874928afccb3152d7056e0063551014874923439.open_work: Extension to more stations and to hourly or diffuse radiation.
874928afccb3152d7056e0063551014874923439.issues: Limited stations per climate zone; transferability to unmeasured sites not fully tested.

bf5eba69319452c9725880f3601cc0101162dc91.goal: Estimates monthly mean daily global solar radiation across China for solar energy applications.
bf5eba69319452c9725880f3601cc0101162dc91.architecture: Artificial neural network model compared with empirical regression models (Ångström-type sunshine-based models).
bf5eba69319452c9725880f3601cc0101162dc91.data: Monthly meteorological and solar radiation data from Chinese stations; details not reported here.
bf5eba69319452c9725880f3601cc0101162dc91.result: The ANN gives lower errors than the empirical models for monthly mean daily global radiation.
bf5eba69319452c9725880f3601cc0101162dc91.open_work: Testing at more stations and with additional inputs.
bf5eba69319452c9725880f3601cc0101162dc91.issues: Monthly averages hide daily variability; few stations.

8df56e3bebdde89775f3d0544ca05c43adc8a3d4.goal: Provides real-time hydrologic (flow) forecasting with support vector machines whose parameters are tuned automatically.
8df56e3bebdde89775f3d0544ca05c43adc8a3d4.architecture: Support vector machine regression with inputs from chaos-based phase-space reconstruction, with SVM and embedding parameters optimised by evolutionary computation (EC-SVM).
8df56e3bebdde89775f3d0544ca05c43adc8a3d4.data: Daily river flow series, including the Tryggevaelde catchment (Denmark) and the Mississippi River.
8df56e3bebdde89775f3d0544ca05c43adc8a3d4.result: EC-SVM gives more accurate multi-step flow forecasts than standard chaos-based and neural network approaches.
8df56e3bebdde89775f3d0544ca05c43adc8a3d4.open_work: Faster optimisation and application to more catchments and longer leads.
8df56e3bebdde89775f3d0544ca05c43adc8a3d4.issues: Computationally heavy tuning; univariate inputs ignore rainfall information.

c4193fa4bf34805e9d2ff42d9699cbbd3cef0d89.goal: Forecasts urban air pollutant concentrations in Perugia, Italy, for air quality management.
c4193fa4bf34805e9d2ff42d9699cbbd3cef0d89.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer feedforward trained by backpropagation) for short- and medium-term pollutant forecasts.
c4193fa4bf34805e9d2ff42d9699cbbd3cef0d89.data: Urban monitoring data for pollutants (CO, NOx, ozone, benzene and others) and meteorology in Perugia.
c4193fa4bf34805e9d2ff42d9699cbbd3cef0d89.result: The ANN reproduces pollutant concentrations well and outperforms simpler statistical approaches for short horizons.
c4193fa4bf34805e9d2ff42d9699cbbd3cef0d89.open_work: Longer horizons and inclusion of forecast meteorology and emissions.
c4193fa4bf34805e9d2ff42d9699cbbd3cef0d89.issues: Single city; limited evaluation on pollution episodes.

72e70d744a11f2ca27fdb6b0eab7acdd57639afc.goal: Predicts storm surge during typhoons to support coastal warning in Taiwan.
72e70d744a11f2ca27fdb6b0eab7acdd57639afc.architecture: Back-propagation neural network using wind speed, wind direction, pressure and astronomical tide as inputs.
72e70d744a11f2ca27fdb6b0eab7acdd57639afc.data: Typhoon storm surge observations from tide gauges in Taiwan; number of events not reported here.
72e70d744a11f2ca27fdb6b0eab7acdd57639afc.result: The neural network predicts storm surge and its time series with good accuracy for the tested typhoons.
72e70d744a11f2ca27fdb6b0eab7acdd57639afc.open_work: Longer lead times and more stations and events.
72e70d744a11f2ca27fdb6b0eab7acdd57639afc.issues: Few typhoon events; site-specific; no uncertainty estimates.

9045ef7988132996843a6d820677667695213b79.goal: Generates sequences of monthly clearness index and daily solar radiation for remote sites without measurements, to size stand-alone photovoltaic systems.
9045ef7988132996843a6d820677667695213b79.architecture: Artificial neural network methodology for generating radiation sequences from geographical coordinates; network details not reported here.
9045ef7988132996843a6d820677667695213b79.data: Solar radiation data from meteorological stations in Algeria.
9045ef7988132996843a6d820677667695213b79.result: Generated radiation sequences are statistically close to measured ones and suitable for PV system sizing.
9045ef7988132996843a6d820677667695213b79.open_work: Validation at more sites and direct coupling with PV sizing optimisation.
9045ef7988132996843a6d820677667695213b79.issues: Limited stations; synthetic sequences may misrepresent extremes and persistence.

c48b2ceb96a78e9555782ebf7bcd95a31cf5858f.goal: Reviews applications of neural networks in ocean engineering to guide practitioners.
c48b2ceb96a78e9555782ebf7bcd95a31cf5858f.architecture: Review of neural network applications (mainly feedforward networks) for waves, tides, currents, structural response and related ocean engineering problems.
c48b2ceb96a78e9555782ebf7bcd95a31cf5858f.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
c48b2ceb96a78e9555782ebf7bcd95a31cf5858f.result: Neural networks are found to be useful, accurate alternatives to conventional methods for many ocean engineering tasks.
c48b2ceb96a78e9555782ebf7bcd95a31cf5858f.open_work: Better physical interpretability, uncertainty quantification and standardized comparisons.
c48b2ceb96a78e9555782ebf7bcd95a31cf5858f.issues: Narrative review; depth limited by available studies up to 2006.

40a4545cfc5c3bf0c4782627f07045495a6ab80a.goal: Improves wind speed retrieval from Ku-band satellite altimeters by accounting for sea state, not only backscatter.
40a4545cfc5c3bf0c4782627f07045495a6ab80a.architecture: Two-parameter wind speed algorithm using backscatter coefficient and significant wave height, fitted with a small neural network.
40a4545cfc5c3bf0c4782627f07045495a6ab80a.data: Satellite altimeter data (TOPEX/Poseidon) collocated with scatterometer and buoy wind measurements.
40a4545cfc5c3bf0c4782627f07045495a6ab80a.result: Including significant wave height reduces wind speed retrieval errors relative to single-parameter algorithms.
40a4545cfc5c3bf0c4782627f07045495a6ab80a.open_work: Adapting the algorithm to other altimeters and bands.
40a4545cfc5c3bf0c4782627f07045495a6ab80a.issues: Calibration depends on collocated reference winds; sea-state effects beyond wave height not captured.

062e6f60656b99266e6275911874c29a30eda618.goal: Evaluates several artificial neural network types for modelling reference evapotranspiration.
062e6f60656b99266e6275911874c29a30eda618.architecture: Multilayer perceptron, radial basis function and generalized regression neural networks compared with empirical evapotranspiration equations.
062e6f60656b99266e6275911874c29a30eda618.data: Daily climatic data from California Irrigation Management Information System (CIMIS) stations.
062e6f60656b99266e6275911874c29a30eda618.result: The neural networks reproduce Penman-Monteith reference evapotranspiration better than empirical formulas, with differences among network types.
062e6f60656b99266e6275911874c29a30eda618.open_work: Testing in other climates and with reduced inputs.
062e6f60656b99266e6275911874c29a30eda618.issues: Target is a computed reference ET; few stations.

e02b852fb85f97038561e4b7e9163636e5da26a9.goal: Simulates urban heat island intensity in a Mediterranean city to understand and predict urban warming.
e02b852fb85f97038561e4b7e9163636e5da26a9.architecture: Artificial neural network relating urban heat island intensity to meteorological parameters.
e02b852fb85f97038561e4b7e9163636e5da26a9.data: Air temperature measurements from urban and suburban stations in Athens, Greece, with meteorological data.
e02b852fb85f97038561e4b7e9163636e5da26a9.result: The ANN reproduces heat island intensity well and identifies the meteorological factors controlling it.
e02b852fb85f97038561e4b7e9163636e5da26a9.open_work: Extension to other cities and to spatial mapping of the heat island.
e02b852fb85f97038561e4b7e9163636e5da26a9.issues: Single-city; statistical model without physical urban processes.

f5cda0eb129f80dcea919b01c43503783118c594.goal: Estimates flood quantiles at ungauged sites, a key need for design where no streamflow records exist.
f5cda0eb129f80dcea919b01c43503783118c594.architecture: Artificial neural network regional model operating in the canonical correlation analysis (CCA) physiographic space, compared with other regional flood frequency approaches.
f5cda0eb129f80dcea919b01c43503783118c594.data: Flood quantiles and physiographic/climatic catchment attributes for gauging stations in Quebec, Canada.
f5cda0eb129f80dcea919b01c43503783118c594.result: The ANN in CCA space gives more accurate flood quantile estimates than standard CCA-based regionalization.
f5cda0eb129f80dcea919b01c43503783118c594.open_work: Combining with other region-of-influence methods and quantifying uncertainty.
f5cda0eb129f80dcea919b01c43503783118c594.issues: Jackknife evaluation on one region; flood quantiles themselves are uncertain at sites with short records.

0c749b78829be977f9c27f6a8e5a388b4ed8e0f8.goal: Identifies nonprecipitating echoes (ground clutter, anomalous propagation) in weather radar scans to improve radar rainfall estimates.
0c749b78829be977f9c27f6a8e5a388b4ed8e0f8.architecture: Fuzzy logic classification using reflectivity texture and vertical structure features from volume scans; not a trained ML model.
0c749b78829be977f9c27f6a8e5a388b4ed8e0f8.data: Single-polarization C-band radar volume scans in Catalonia, Spain.
0c749b78829be977f9c27f6a8e5a388b4ed8e0f8.result: The fuzzy logic scheme effectively removes clutter and anomalous propagation echoes while keeping most precipitation.
0c749b78829be977f9c27f6a8e5a388b4ed8e0f8.open_work: Including Doppler and dual-polarization variables and testing at other radars.
0c749b78829be977f9c27f6a8e5a388b4ed8e0f8.issues: Membership functions tuned for a specific radar and climate; misclassification of weak precipitation remains.

68ebd5abb4d8122d1acb2b4d4662fcb1a221c805.goal: Selects the most relevant input variables for modelling direct solar irradiance with neural networks.
68ebd5abb4d8122d1acb2b4d4662fcb1a221c805.architecture: Bayesian neural network with automatic relevance determination to rank inputs such as clearness index, air mass and meteorological variables.
68ebd5abb4d8122d1acb2b4d4662fcb1a221c805.data: Radiometric and meteorological measurements from a station in southern Spain.
68ebd5abb4d8122d1acb2b4d4662fcb1a221c805.result: A small set of inputs (mainly clearness index and solar geometry) suffices, and the reduced network estimates direct irradiance accurately.
68ebd5abb4d8122d1acb2b4d4662fcb1a221c805.open_work: Testing at other sites and for hourly forecasting.
68ebd5abb4d8122d1acb2b4d4662fcb1a221c805.issues: Single site; input relevance may vary across climates.

31556bd81d1957a7037cb51520d4ae5e1bac2e72.goal: Forecasts daily mean, maximum and minimum air temperature time series.
31556bd81d1957a7037cb51520d4ae5e1bac2e72.architecture: Feedforward backpropagation, radial basis function and generalized regression neural networks compared with each other and with a regression model.
31556bd81d1957a7037cb51520d4ae5e1bac2e72.data: Daily temperature records from stations in Turkey.
31556bd81d1957a7037cb51520d4ae5e1bac2e72.result: All three neural network types give satisfactory forecasts, with small differences in error among them.
31556bd81d1957a7037cb51520d4ae5e1bac2e72.open_work: Longer lead times and use of additional meteorological inputs.
31556bd81d1957a7037cb51520d4ae5e1bac2e72.issues: Univariate-type inputs; few stations; no comparison with numerical weather prediction.

0e055a4eac7b59ba3151164f9d71a1530521d4df.goal: Systematically compares data-driven modelling techniques across hydrological problems to guide technique selection.
0e055a4eac7b59ba3151164f9d71a1530521d4df.architecture: Benchmark of neural networks (ANN), genetic programming, evolutionary polynomial regression, support vector machines, M5 model trees, k-nearest neighbours and multiple linear regression, with the Gamma test for guidance.
0e055a4eac7b59ba3151164f9d71a1530521d4df.data: Five case studies: half-hourly actual evapotranspiration, daily peat and till soil moisture, and two daily rainfall-runoff data sets, each resampled into 12 realizations.
0e055a4eac7b59ba3151164f9d71a1530521d4df.result: Genetic programming is most successful overall; ANNs are sub-optimal for evapotranspiration and rainfall-runoff; M5 suits linear data; k-nn performs well in linear and nonlinear cases; SVM is kernel-sensitive.
0e055a4eac7b59ba3151164f9d71a1530521d4df.open_work: Extending the experiment to more data sets and better guidance for model choice from data characteristics.
0e055a4eac7b59ba3151164f9d71a1530521d4df.issues: Results depend on the five data sets and tuning choices; random resampling ignores temporal dependence.

47bc6657b55fc68458c3b4c25e2059b15713c5cb.goal: Forecasts significant wave heights in real time at short lead times for offshore and coastal operations.
47bc6657b55fc68458c3b4c25e2059b15713c5cb.architecture: Genetic programming models using preceding wave observations, compared with artificial neural networks.
47bc6657b55fc68458c3b4c25e2059b15713c5cb.data: Wave buoy records from NDBC stations in the Gulf of Mexico.
47bc6657b55fc68458c3b4c25e2059b15713c5cb.result: Genetic programming forecasts waves for leads of hours to a day with accuracy similar to or better than neural networks.
47bc6657b55fc68458c3b4c25e2059b15713c5cb.open_work: Using wind inputs and longer lead times.
47bc6657b55fc68458c3b4c25e2059b15713c5cb.issues: Univariate inputs limit skill at longer leads; few buoys.

88bfe640532b18f26cac3bea4056fff2ec10438e.goal: Predicts long-range (seasonal) precipitation in California for water resources planning.
88bfe640532b18f26cac3bea4056fff2ec10438e.architecture: Artificial neural network using large-scale climate indices and teleconnection variables as predictors.
88bfe640532b18f26cac3bea4056fff2ec10438e.data: Precipitation for California climate zones with Pacific climate indices.
88bfe640532b18f26cac3bea4056fff2ec10438e.result: The neural network provides useful long-range precipitation forecasts, with skill varying by region.
88bfe640532b18f26cac3bea4056fff2ec10438e.open_work: Better predictor selection and probabilistic forecasts.
88bfe640532b18f26cac3bea4056fff2ec10438e.issues: Short records relative to model complexity; skill modest and region-dependent.

a9554fd18b13824647182b215d46422ee513d350.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff modelling by combining conceptual hydrological models with artificial neural networks.
a9554fd18b13824647182b215d46422ee513d350.architecture: Hybrid approach in which an artificial neural network is integrated with conceptual rainfall-runoff models, for example to combine or route sub-catchment outputs.
a9554fd18b13824647182b215d46422ee513d350.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
a9554fd18b13824647182b215d46422ee513d350.result: The integrated ANN-conceptual models give better runoff simulations than the conceptual models alone.
a9554fd18b13824647182b215d46422ee513d350.open_work: Testing in other basins and with distributed models.
a9554fd18b13824647182b215d46422ee513d350.issues: Limited case studies; interpretability of the ANN component remains limited.

71cee5746a2ef31001dea21eb1329f2fe436ea4f.goal: Forecasts watershed runoff and stream flows with artificial neural networks.
71cee5746a2ef31001dea21eb1329f2fe436ea4f.architecture: Artificial neural network models with rainfall and flow inputs; network type not specified here.
71cee5746a2ef31001dea21eb1329f2fe436ea4f.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
71cee5746a2ef31001dea21eb1329f2fe436ea4f.result: The ANN models forecast runoff and stream flows with acceptable accuracy.
71cee5746a2ef31001dea21eb1329f2fe436ea4f.open_work: Longer horizons and comparison with physically based models.
71cee5746a2ef31001dea21eb1329f2fe436ea4f.issues: Limited data and watersheds; generality unclear.

63c5885ca93ec18ce60b1f78e1e3dee5ab1530fe.goal: Estimates rainfall at high temporal resolution by combining satellite precipitation radar with geostationary imagery.
63c5885ca93ec18ce60b1f78e1e3dee5ab1530fe.architecture: Artificial neural network trained to map GOES multispectral infrared and visible features to rainfall measured by the TRMM Precipitation Radar.
63c5885ca93ec18ce60b1f78e1e3dee5ab1530fe.data: TRMM Precipitation Radar overpasses collocated with GOES multispectral imagery.
63c5885ca93ec18ce60b1f78e1e3dee5ab1530fe.result: The neural network produces rainfall estimates that improve on simple infrared-based techniques when validated against radar rainfall.
63c5885ca93ec18ce60b1f78e1e3dee5ab1530fe.open_work: Operational use and extension to other regions and sensors.
63c5885ca93ec18ce60b1f78e1e3dee5ab1530fe.issues: Training limited to PR overpass samples; IR-based relations are weaker for warm rain.

a63e0b4b6dc111485ec86c88e151e58b6551060a.goal: Models evapotranspiration dynamics with an interpretable data-driven method.
a63e0b4b6dc111485ec86c88e151e58b6551060a.architecture: Genetic programming to derive explicit evapotranspiration equations, compared with artificial neural networks and Penman-Monteith.
a63e0b4b6dc111485ec86c88e151e58b6551060a.data: Eddy covariance evapotranspiration and meteorological measurements from field sites in Canada.
a63e0b4b6dc111485ec86c88e151e58b6551060a.result: Genetic programming models estimate evapotranspiration comparably or better than ANNs and Penman-Monteith while giving explicit expressions.
a63e0b4b6dc111485ec86c88e151e58b6551060a.open_work: Testing on more sites and vegetation types.
a63e0b4b6dc111485ec86c88e151e58b6551060a.issues: Site-specific data; equations may not transfer.

1422e49efca44b10bb11244bd4ca559f05ee9a74.goal: Rigorously compares statistical methods for forecasting ground-level ozone across European sites.
1422e49efca44b10bb11244bd4ca559f05ee9a74.architecture: Benchmark of 15 statistical techniques (including neural networks and generalized additive models) against a deterministic chemical trajectory model.
1422e49efca44b10bb11244bd4ca559f05ee9a74.data: Ten data sets from different meteorological and emission conditions in Europe, giving 1340 yearly series of daily predictions.
1422e49efca44b10bb11244bd4ca559f05ee9a74.result: Success index is key; 8-h average ozone is forecast better than 1-h means; neural networks and generalized additive models are recommended as the best compromise.
1422e49efca44b10bb11244bd4ca559f05ee9a74.open_work: Site-specific adaptation and combining statistical and deterministic models.
1422e49efca44b10bb11244bd4ca559f05ee9a74.issues: Performance varies by site and index; univariate nonlinear dynamic models were not profitable.

20a4ce787f70be7034bcefbce92855860ed6e2c1.goal: Evaluates data fusion strategies to combine multiple hydrological model forecasts into better river flow forecasts.
20a4ce787f70be7034bcefbce92855860ed6e2c1.architecture: Six fusion methods: arithmetic averaging, a probabilistic best-last-model method, two neural network fusion schemes and two soft computing (fuzzy) methods.
20a4ce787f70be7034bcefbce92855860ed6e2c1.data: Single-model river level and discharge forecasts for the River Ouse and Upper River Wye, UK.
20a4ce787f70be7034bcefbce92855860ed6e2c1.result: Fusion outperforms individual models; neural network fusion of differenced data is best in a stable regime and a fuzzified probabilistic method in a volatile one.
20a4ce787f70be7034bcefbce92855860ed6e2c1.open_work: A data fusion research agenda for hydrology.
20a4ce787f70be7034bcefbce92855860ed6e2c1.issues: Two catchments only; results depend on the input forecast set.

cb2e4b7745a755466d5b889056f3be781cb18ac2.goal: Assesses whether artificial neural networks are appropriate for estimating soil moisture content.
cb2e4b7745a755466d5b889056f3be781cb18ac2.architecture: Artificial neural network models compared with alternative modelling approaches.
cb2e4b7745a755466d5b889056f3be781cb18ac2.data: Soil moisture and meteorological data from reconstructed watersheds in Alberta, Canada.
cb2e4b7745a755466d5b889056f3be781cb18ac2.result: ANNs capture soil moisture dynamics only to a limited extent, raising questions about their relevance for this task.
cb2e4b7745a755466d5b889056f3be781cb18ac2.open_work: Combining data-driven and physically based approaches.

dc30ed9f1666f274e132a9a4f2d8c1b94dd49600.goal: Develops a rainfall-runoff model based on fuzzy logic for simulating catchment discharge.
dc30ed9f1666f274e132a9a4f2d8c1b94dd49600.architecture: Fuzzy rule-based (fuzzy logic) rainfall-runoff model that relates rainfall, snowmelt and soil moisture states to runoff components.
dc30ed9f1666f274e132a9a4f2d8c1b94dd49600.data: Daily meteorological and discharge data from a catchment in Germany; details not reported here.
dc30ed9f1666f274e132a9a4f2d8c1b94dd49600.result: The fuzzy model simulates runoff with accuracy comparable to a conceptual model while being simple to set up.
dc30ed9f1666f274e132a9a4f2d8c1b94dd49600.open_work: Application to more catchments and regionalisation of fuzzy rules.
dc30ed9f1666f274e132a9a4f2d8c1b94dd49600.issues: Rule construction requires expert judgement; extrapolation to extremes is uncertain.

a10f9afedb0319c3fde1804212e0a80dc724f18c.goal: Reviews statistical approaches used both to quantify health effects of ground-level ozone and to forecast ozone concentrations for public warnings.
a10f9afedb0319c3fde1804212e0a80dc724f18c.architecture: Review of statistical models for ozone, covering regression and time-series models, generalized additive models and neural networks as forecasting tools.
a10f9afedb0319c3fde1804212e0a80dc724f18c.data: Draws on published ozone monitoring and epidemiological studies; no single training dataset is specified here.
a10f9afedb0319c3fde1804212e0a80dc724f18c.result: Summarizes strengths and weaknesses of the model classes for health-effect assessment and short-term ozone forecasting; specific quantitative conclusions are not reported here.
a10f9afedb0319c3fde1804212e0a80dc724f18c.open_work: Linking forecast skill to health-relevant exposure metrics and handling nonlinearity and meteorological confounding remain open.
a10f9afedb0319c3fde1804212e0a80dc724f18c.issues: Abstract unavailable; content inferred from the title and general knowledge, so the exact scope of the review is uncertain.

7d927124a19ce50b708d918ae721a0ad55cc2001.goal: Provides rainfall-runoff predictions with quantified uncertainty, which standard deterministic neural networks do not give.
7d927124a19ce50b708d918ae721a0ad55cc2001.architecture: Bayesian neural network: a multilayer perceptron (MLP) trained with Bayesian learning so that weights have posterior distributions and predictions carry confidence intervals.
7d927124a19ce50b708d918ae721a0ad55cc2001.data: Daily precipitation, temperature and streamflow from a Canadian catchment; exact record lengths are not reported here.
7d927124a19ce50b708d918ae721a0ad55cc2001.result: The Bayesian neural network gives forecasts comparable to or better than a standard ANN and a conceptual hydrological model, while also providing predictive uncertainty bounds.
7d927124a19ce50b708d918ae721a0ad55cc2001.open_work: Testing on more basins, longer lead times and with input uncertainty would strengthen the approach.
7d927124a19ce50b708d918ae721a0ad55cc2001.issues: Uncertainty bounds reflect parameter uncertainty mainly; computational cost of Bayesian training is higher; single-region evaluation.

465c05426262d5c27d8029c8f0fe1722f3d17113.goal: Automates delineation of oil slicks on the ocean surface in synthetic aperture radar imagery, replacing slow manual interpretation.
465c05426262d5c27d8029c8f0fe1722f3d17113.architecture: Texture-classifying neural network algorithm (TCNNA): a neural network that classifies SAR pixel textures, combined with edge detection and ancillary wind and beam-mode information.
465c05426262d5c27d8029c8f0fe1722f3d17113.data: RADARSAT and ENVISAT ASAR SAR scenes, mainly over the Gulf of Mexico including natural seep slicks.
465c05426262d5c27d8029c8f0fe1722f3d17113.result: TCNNA delineates oil slicks consistently and much faster than manual analysis; detailed accuracy figures are not reported here.
465c05426262d5c27d8029c8f0fe1722f3d17113.open_work: Extending to other SAR sensors and regions and reducing false positives from look-alikes such as low-wind areas.
465c05426262d5c27d8029c8f0fe1722f3d17113.issues: Look-alike features can confuse the classifier; performance depends on wind conditions; validation against independent slick truth is limited.

0d1e524e696cd15070ca3e3550f7fae11b259c32.goal: Generates plausible daily weather series under climate change scenarios for hydrological impact studies.
0d1e524e696cd15070ca3e3550f7fae11b259c32.architecture: Improved K-nearest neighbour (KNN) resampling weather generator with a perturbation step so that simulated values can fall outside the historical record; not a neural method.
0d1e524e696cd15070ca3e3550f7fae11b259c32.data: Daily precipitation and temperature observations from stations in the Upper Thames River basin, Ontario, Canada.
0d1e524e696cd15070ca3e3550f7fae11b259c32.result: The modified KNN generator reproduces observed statistics and can produce extremes beyond the historical range under altered scenarios.
0d1e524e696cd15070ca3e3550f7fae11b259c32.open_work: Coupling with GCM-based scenarios and hydrological models for impact assessment.
0d1e524e696cd15070ca3e3550f7fae11b259c32.issues: Scenarios are imposed by conditioning or perturbation rather than physically consistent climate projections; abstract unavailable so details are uncertain.

ac101b3ad0b747d1e80641c8ca7cb20cc03c4623.goal: Forecasts short-term household electricity consumption and quantifies how sensitive demand is to weather in a Mediterranean climate.
ac101b3ad0b747d1e80641c8ca7cb20cc03c4623.architecture: Neural-network-based short-term forecasting with weather inputs; the specific network type is not specified here.
ac101b3ad0b747d1e80641c8ca7cb20cc03c4623.data: Household electricity consumption records and local meteorological data from a Mediterranean area (Sicily, Italy).
ac101b3ad0b747d1e80641c8ca7cb20cc03c4623.result: Weather variables measurably improve short-term consumption prediction; quantitative skill is not reported here.
ac101b3ad0b747d1e80641c8ca7cb20cc03c4623.open_work: Extending to other building types and climates and to longer horizons.
ac101b3ad0b747d1e80641c8ca7cb20cc03c4623.issues: Single area; abstract unavailable so method and error metrics are uncertain.

d63f3941b5ad6b94f7f0052e1a4a02f939aead66.goal: Builds an operational online system that forecasts urban air pollutant concentrations a few days ahead for public information.
d63f3941b5ad6b94f7f0052e1a4a02f939aead66.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks (MLP) with several input configurations, run in a web-based online forecasting system.
d63f3941b5ad6b94f7f0052e1a4a02f939aead66.data: Measured SO2, PM10 and CO concentrations and meteorological forecasts for the Besiktas district of Istanbul, Turkey.
d63f3941b5ad6b94f7f0052e1a4a02f939aead66.result: The neural networks give acceptable forecasts up to about three days ahead; specific error statistics are not reported here.
d63f3941b5ad6b94f7f0052e1a4a02f939aead66.open_work: Adding more stations and pollutants and using improved meteorological forecast inputs.
d63f3941b5ad6b94f7f0052e1a4a02f939aead66.issues: Single district; performance depends on the quality of the weather forecast inputs; no uncertainty estimates.

9bfcca373b89414a7071b90a02146697658ec406.goal: Predicts wind speed and wind farm power up to about three days ahead, needed for grid scheduling.
9bfcca373b89414a7071b90a02146697658ec406.architecture: Locally recurrent neural networks (MLPs with internal IIR/local-feedback synapses) trained with recursive prediction-error and real-time recurrent learning algorithms.
9bfcca373b89414a7071b90a02146697658ec406.data: Numerical weather prediction forecasts and measured wind speed and power at a wind farm on the island of Crete, Greece.
9bfcca373b89414a7071b90a02146697658ec406.result: The locally recurrent networks outperform static MLPs and persistence for multi-step long-term wind speed and power prediction.
9bfcca373b89414a7071b90a02146697658ec406.open_work: Testing at other sites and integration of ensemble NWP inputs.
9bfcca373b89414a7071b90a02146697658ec406.issues: Single wind farm; errors grow with lead time and depend on NWP quality.

2a755d7d59c0b30cb4e13c704e319c689833c7b5.goal: Proposes a systematic strategy for constructing flood forecasting models from limited flood-event data.
2a755d7d59c0b30cb4e13c704e319c689833c7b5.architecture: Neuro-fuzzy network (adaptive network-based fuzzy inference system, ANFIS) with a strategy for selecting inputs and training data.
2a755d7d59c0b30cb4e13c704e319c689833c7b5.data: Hourly rainfall and river stage or discharge records from flood events in a Taiwanese basin.
2a755d7d59c0b30cb4e13c704e319c689833c7b5.result: The neuro-fuzzy model gives accurate short lead-time flood forecasts; quantitative scores are not reported here.
2a755d7d59c0b30cb4e13c704e319c689833c7b5.open_work: Applying the strategy to other basins and longer lead times.
2a755d7d59c0b30cb4e13c704e319c689833c7b5.issues: Few flood events for training; abstract unavailable so details are uncertain.

f6b131d5e6392416f032b137507e049194f361ab.goal: Develops data-driven models for event-based rainfall-runoff and tests them against a physically based kinematic wave approximation.
f6b131d5e6392416f032b137507e049194f361ab.architecture: Three-layer feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) with sigmoid activation and backpropagation, and a fuzzy logic model with triangular membership functions and data-derived rules.
f6b131d5e6392416f032b137507e049194f361ab.data: Measured event peak discharges and hydrographs from a laboratory flume, experimental plots and a small 8.44 km2 watershed.
f6b131d5e6392416f032b137507e049194f361ab.result: ANN, fuzzy logic and kinematic wave models all satisfactorily predict peak discharge and hydrographs with comparable error measures.
f6b131d5e6392416f032b137507e049194f361ab.open_work: Testing on larger watersheds and more varied rainfall events.
f6b131d5e6392416f032b137507e049194f361ab.issues: Mainly laboratory and plot-scale data; only one small watershed hydrograph for field validation.

f16057f551b24e46f980a1ebd82c7c318b6995cd.goal: Forecasts streamflow in a flashy Hawaiian stream, where rating curves are imperfect for converting stage to flow.
f16057f551b24e46f980a1ebd82c7c318b6995cd.architecture: Neural networks compared with rating-curve estimates; the specific network type is not specified here.
f16057f551b24e46f980a1ebd82c7c318b6995cd.data: Stage, discharge and possibly precipitation records from a stream in Hawaii.
f16057f551b24e46f980a1ebd82c7c318b6995cd.result: Neural networks provide flow estimates competitive with or better than rating curves; specific numbers are not reported here.
f16057f551b24e46f980a1ebd82c7c318b6995cd.open_work: Testing on other small tropical island streams and on extreme floods.
f16057f551b24e46f980a1ebd82c7c318b6995cd.issues: Single stream; abstract unavailable so details are uncertain.

ede0e6bbd903599b10b89fab30b7c5641ce03298.goal: Improves daily irrigation water demand forecasts for managing irrigation district supply.
ede0e6bbd903599b10b89fab30b7c5641ce03298.architecture: Soft-computing hybrid combining computational neural networks with fuzzy logic and genetic algorithm components.
ede0e6bbd903599b10b89fab30b7c5641ce03298.data: Daily water demand and climate records from an irrigation district in southern Spain.
ede0e6bbd903599b10b89fab30b7c5641ce03298.result: The hybrid model forecasts demand more accurately than conventional neural networks and time-series models; exact gains are not reported here.
ede0e6bbd903599b10b89fab30b7c5641ce03298.open_work: Applying to other districts and including crop and management information.
ede0e6bbd903599b10b89fab30b7c5641ce03298.issues: Single district; abstract unavailable so component details are uncertain.

8ba4db3e9d023ccdf3a0d83fcbb23ad6ec2f0c11.goal: Models and forecasts mean hourly wind speed for wind energy assessment.
8ba4db3e9d023ccdf3a0d83fcbb23ad6ec2f0c11.architecture: Abductive networks based on the group method of data handling (GMDH), which build polynomial network structures automatically.
8ba4db3e9d023ccdf3a0d83fcbb23ad6ec2f0c11.data: Hourly wind speed measurements from Dhahran, Saudi Arabia.
8ba4db3e9d023ccdf3a0d83fcbb23ad6ec2f0c11.result: GMDH abductive networks forecast next-hour wind speed better than persistence and comparable neural networks; specific errors are not reported here.
8ba4db3e9d023ccdf3a0d83fcbb23ad6ec2f0c11.open_work: Longer horizons, other sites and inclusion of other meteorological predictors.
8ba4db3e9d023ccdf3a0d83fcbb23ad6ec2f0c11.issues: Single site; univariate inputs limit skill at longer horizons.

cf23a764014716c2809cf63e493e67dd5a746928.goal: Estimates monthly mean daily diffuse solar radiation, which is rarely measured but needed for solar energy design.
cf23a764014716c2809cf63e493e67dd5a746928.architecture: Artificial neural network (type not specified here) compared with empirical regression models for diffuse radiation.
cf23a764014716c2809cf63e493e67dd5a746928.data: Measured monthly mean daily global and diffuse radiation and meteorological data from stations in China.
cf23a764014716c2809cf63e493e67dd5a746928.result: The neural network estimates diffuse radiation more accurately than the empirical models; specific error values are not reported here.
cf23a764014716c2809cf63e493e67dd5a746928.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates.
cf23a764014716c2809cf63e493e67dd5a746928.issues: Monthly means only; abstract unavailable so station set and metrics are uncertain.

3068d1318f90eb419dfe8b50510abe9dc9664e51.goal: Compares data-driven models for estimating daily solar radiation and how input selection affects them.
3068d1318f90eb419dfe8b50510abe9dc9664e51.architecture: Comparison of local linear regression (LLR), multilayer perceptron (MLP), Elman recurrent network, NNARX and ANFIS neuro-fuzzy models, with input selection by the Gamma test.
3068d1318f90eb419dfe8b50510abe9dc9664e51.data: Daily meteorological and solar radiation observations from a single case-study site.
3068d1318f90eb419dfe8b50510abe9dc9664e51.result: Nonlinear neural and neuro-fuzzy models and LLR give comparable skill, with differences depending on inputs; specific rankings are not reported here.
3068d1318f90eb419dfe8b50510abe9dc9664e51.open_work: Validation at more sites and longer records.
3068d1318f90eb419dfe8b50510abe9dc9664e51.issues: Single case study; abstract unavailable so results are summarized only generally.

65e3ec61e7de686c4aca90ffeb32879870a635f7.goal: Uses large-scale ocean-atmosphere oscillations to forecast streamflow with lead times of up to several years for water planning.
65e3ec61e7de686c4aca90ffeb32879870a635f7.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression with climate indices as predictors, compared with artificial neural network and multiple linear regression models.
65e3ec61e7de686c4aca90ffeb32879870a635f7.data: PDO, NAO, AMO and ENSO indices and annual streamflow volumes from gauges in the Upper Colorado River Basin.
65e3ec61e7de686c4aca90ffeb32879870a635f7.result: SVM gives skilful long-lead streamflow volume forecasts and outperforms the comparison models; detailed scores are not reported here.
65e3ec61e7de686c4aca90ffeb32879870a635f7.open_work: Adding other indices or seasonal predictands and testing in other basins.
65e3ec61e7de686c4aca90ffeb32879870a635f7.issues: Short annual records limit training; teleconnection relations may be nonstationary. Card based on the authors' published SVM study; year listed differs, so worth spot-checking.

0830325f1d360589bcac7b5a853ecc42819e0931.goal: Predicts daily mean ambient temperature for energy and engineering applications.
0830325f1d360589bcac7b5a853ecc42819e0931.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation-type algorithms.
0830325f1d360589bcac7b5a853ecc42819e0931.data: Daily mean temperature records from a meteorological station in Denizli, Turkey, over a few years.
0830325f1d360589bcac7b5a853ecc42819e0931.result: The ANN predicts daily mean temperature with low error; exact metrics are not reported here.
0830325f1d360589bcac7b5a853ecc42819e0931.open_work: Using more stations and meteorological predictors.
0830325f1d360589bcac7b5a853ecc42819e0931.issues: Single station and short record; inputs largely calendar and lagged temperature.

1066138be1a6fbccc5e7aaf9c8595f412e32ee58.goal: Forecasts short-term streamflow under changing climate conditions and compares two machine learning approaches.
1066138be1a6fbccc5e7aaf9c8595f412e32ee58.architecture: Genetic programming (GP) compared with feed-forward neural network models.
1066138be1a6fbccc5e7aaf9c8595f412e32ee58.data: Streamflow, NEXRAD radar rainfall and climatic variables for the Choctawhatchee River basin, Florida.
1066138be1a6fbccc5e7aaf9c8595f412e32ee58.result: Genetic programming forecasts streamflow better than the neural network models; specific scores are not reported here.
1066138be1a6fbccc5e7aaf9c8595f412e32ee58.open_work: Linking to climate change projections and testing other basins.
1066138be1a6fbccc5e7aaf9c8595f412e32ee58.issues: Single basin; climate change implications inferred from short records.

d6228db520b662135ad3957eeeee073d71defb7d.goal: Tests whether a soil moisture state from a conceptual model improves neural network streamflow forecasts.
d6228db520b662135ad3957eeeee073d71defb7d.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network with an auxiliary soil moisture index derived from the GR4J conceptual rainfall-runoff model.
d6228db520b662135ad3957eeeee073d71defb7d.data: Daily rainfall, evapotranspiration and streamflow from several catchments.
d6228db520b662135ad3957eeeee073d71defb7d.result: Adding the soil moisture index improves multi-day-ahead streamflow forecasts relative to MLPs without it.
d6228db520b662135ad3957eeeee073d71defb7d.open_work: Exploring other conceptual state variables as inputs and more catchments.
d6228db520b662135ad3957eeeee073d71defb7d.issues: Few catchments; index quality depends on the conceptual model calibration.

46c40bef9ecef932b5ae80fd0c6ad17ae02c43a8.goal: Projects how changes in synoptic circulation will alter net precipitation (P-E) over large Arctic river basins in the 21st century.
46c40bef9ecef932b5ae80fd0c6ad17ae02c43a8.architecture: Self-organizing maps (SOM) classify daily sea level pressure into synoptic patterns; changes in pattern frequency are related to basin net precipitation.
46c40bef9ecef932b5ae80fd0c6ad17ae02c43a8.data: Sea level pressure and precipitation fields from IPCC AR4 / CMIP3 global climate model simulations and reanalysis for the Lena, Mackenzie, Ob and Yenisei basins.
46c40bef9ecef932b5ae80fd0c6ad17ae02c43a8.result: Shifts in synoptic pattern frequency explain part of the projected increase in net precipitation, with the remainder due to within-pattern changes.
46c40bef9ecef932b5ae80fd0c6ad17ae02c43a8.open_work: Reducing inter-model spread and attributing within-pattern thermodynamic changes.
46c40bef9ecef932b5ae80fd0c6ad17ae02c43a8.issues: Relies on GCM output with biases and coarse resolution; SOM node choice is subjective.

74eb5b3a6cd2fd7e57ef92ad4f2680c6035000f6.goal: Forecasts short-term generating power of photovoltaic systems to support grid operation.
74eb5b3a6cd2fd7e57ef92ad4f2680c6035000f6.architecture: Recurrent neural network compared with feed-forward and radial basis function networks.
74eb5b3a6cd2fd7e57ef92ad4f2680c6035000f6.data: Insolation and meteorological data with PV output; exact sources are not reported here.
74eb5b3a6cd2fd7e57ef92ad4f2680c6035000f6.result: The recurrent neural network gives more accurate short-term PV power forecasts than the comparison networks.
74eb5b3a6cd2fd7e57ef92ad4f2680c6035000f6.open_work: Using weather forecast inputs and testing on more systems.
74eb5b3a6cd2fd7e57ef92ad4f2680c6035000f6.issues: Conference paper with limited validation; abstract unavailable.

3d821016daab9f28bd14d26a1e36640cbe0f1972.goal: Represents imprecise precipitation inputs in rainfall-runoff modelling and propagates that uncertainty to runoff.
3d821016daab9f28bd14d26a1e36640cbe0f1972.architecture: Fuzzy set approach using fuzzy numbers and the extension principle with alpha-cuts, compared with Monte Carlo propagation; not a machine learning model.
3d821016daab9f28bd14d26a1e36640cbe0f1972.data: Precipitation and runoff data for a case-study catchment; details are not reported here.
3d821016daab9f28bd14d26a1e36640cbe0f1972.result: Fuzzy propagation gives runoff uncertainty envelopes comparable to probabilistic methods at lower cost.
3d821016daab9f28bd14d26a1e36640cbe0f1972.open_work: Combining precipitation with parameter uncertainty and comparison with probabilistic frameworks.
3d821016daab9f28bd14d26a1e36640cbe0f1972.issues: Membership functions are subjective; does not give probabilistic interpretation.

c28209441c0190661d8ae95d0aa857808c8ac273.goal: Describes Antarctic synoptic weather patterns and how their frequency changes between the 20th and 21st centuries.
c28209441c0190661d8ae95d0aa857808c8ac273.architecture: Self-organizing maps (SOM) classify daily sea level pressure fields into a set of synoptic patterns.
c28209441c0190661d8ae95d0aa857808c8ac273.data: ERA-40 reanalysis sea level pressure and IPCC AR4 / CMIP3 climate model simulations for the Antarctic.
c28209441c0190661d8ae95d0aa857808c8ac273.result: Models reproduce observed patterns with biases and project shifts toward deeper circumpolar trough patterns consistent with a positive Southern Annular Mode trend.
c28209441c0190661d8ae95d0aa857808c8ac273.open_work: Linking pattern changes to precipitation and temperature impacts.
c28209441c0190661d8ae95d0aa857808c8ac273.issues: GCM biases in Antarctic sea level pressure; reanalysis quality is limited in data-sparse regions.

897704a81d053b4fe17b78277fe0056929070f2d.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from limited climate data using machine learning.
897704a81d053b4fe17b78277fe0056929070f2d.architecture: Support vector machines (SVM) regression compared with empirical evapotranspiration equations.
897704a81d053b4fe17b78277fe0056929070f2d.data: Daily climatic data from CIMIS weather stations in California with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith estimates as targets.
897704a81d053b4fe17b78277fe0056929070f2d.result: SVM models estimate reference evapotranspiration more accurately than empirical methods; specific errors are not reported here.
897704a81d053b4fe17b78277fe0056929070f2d.open_work: Testing in other climates and with fewer inputs.
897704a81d053b4fe17b78277fe0056929070f2d.issues: Targets are computed Penman-Monteith values, not lysimeter measurements; few stations.

ff051d0aff5c94b0f772cc77c9eb12f5217455a6.goal: Estimates upper-ocean subsurface thermal structure from surface parameters measurable by satellite.
ff051d0aff5c94b0f772cc77c9eb12f5217455a6.architecture: Feed-forward neural network mapping surface parameters to subsurface temperatures; the specific architecture is not specified here.
ff051d0aff5c94b0f772cc77c9eb12f5217455a6.data: Moored buoy observations in the Arabian Sea of surface variables and temperature profiles.
ff051d0aff5c94b0f772cc77c9eb12f5217455a6.result: The neural network reproduces subsurface temperatures and thermal structure reasonably well from surface inputs; exact errors are not reported here.
ff051d0aff5c94b0f772cc77c9eb12f5217455a6.open_work: Applying with satellite inputs over wider regions.
ff051d0aff5c94b0f772cc77c9eb12f5217455a6.issues: Single mooring region; training sample size small.

7e556bc506697718ffdf198c32db1cb4d94b41e6.goal: Provides short-term wind power forecasts for the Portuguese power system.
7e556bc506697718ffdf198c32db1cb4d94b41e6.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with Levenberg-Marquardt, compared with persistence and ARIMA.
7e556bc506697718ffdf198c32db1cb4d94b41e6.data: Historical wind power data from Portugal.
7e556bc506697718ffdf198c32db1cb4d94b41e6.result: The neural network outperforms persistence and ARIMA with low mean absolute percentage error; exact values are not reported here.
7e556bc506697718ffdf198c32db1cb4d94b41e6.open_work: Adding NWP inputs and uncertainty estimates.
7e556bc506697718ffdf198c32db1cb4d94b41e6.issues: Univariate inputs; conference paper with limited evaluation.

86dd6ef598f3e98bbd66888e3c5305c8b56f6bab.goal: Estimates diffuse solar radiation under all sky conditions where measurements are lacking.
86dd6ef598f3e98bbd66888e3c5305c8b56f6bab.architecture: Artificial neural network (type not specified here) using meteorological and geographical inputs.
86dd6ef598f3e98bbd66888e3c5305c8b56f6bab.data: Solar radiation and meteorological data from Indian stations.
86dd6ef598f3e98bbd66888e3c5305c8b56f6bab.result: The ANN estimates diffuse radiation with good accuracy compared with measured data; exact errors are not reported here.
86dd6ef598f3e98bbd66888e3c5305c8b56f6bab.open_work: Extending to more stations and to hourly scales.
86dd6ef598f3e98bbd66888e3c5305c8b56f6bab.issues: Abstract unavailable; station set and metrics uncertain.

bada46d597c44dd6e400c1750928f0e925f0a2e9.goal: Explores whether wavelet decomposition of inputs improves neural network rainfall-runoff forecasting.
bada46d597c44dd6e400c1750928f0e925f0a2e9.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks applied to wavelet-decomposed rainfall and flow components.
bada46d597c44dd6e400c1750928f0e925f0a2e9.data: Rainfall and streamflow records from a case-study catchment.
bada46d597c44dd6e400c1750928f0e925f0a2e9.result: Wavelet preprocessing improves forecasts, especially for some frequency components; numbers are not reported here.
bada46d597c44dd6e400c1750928f0e925f0a2e9.open_work: Choosing decomposition levels and testing on more catchments.
bada46d597c44dd6e400c1750928f0e925f0a2e9.issues: Few catchments; wavelet boundary effects can contaminate real-time forecasts.

cc237b9020cad2a059a6c7c0f475791c0741fc4a.goal: Predicts hourly sea level variations at a harbour for navigation and coastal management.
cc237b9020cad2a059a6c7c0f475791c0741fc4a.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feed-forward) trained on past sea level observations.
cc237b9020cad2a059a6c7c0f475791c0741fc4a.data: Hourly tide gauge sea level records from Hillarys Boat Harbour, Western Australia.
cc237b9020cad2a059a6c7c0f475791c0741fc4a.result: The networks predict sea levels from hours to about a day ahead with good correlation to observations.
cc237b9020cad2a059a6c7c0f475791c0741fc4a.open_work: Including meteorological forcing to capture surges.
cc237b9020cad2a059a6c7c0f475791c0741fc4a.issues: Single gauge; non-tidal residuals are harder to predict.

5e39ec052855c9445fbdc7b452df23f890ac204a.goal: Forecasts tides using short observation records where harmonic analysis needs long data.
5e39ec052855c9445fbdc7b452df23f890ac204a.architecture: Back-propagation feed-forward artificial neural network trained on tidal records.
5e39ec052855c9445fbdc7b452df23f890ac204a.data: Tide gauge observations from a harbour in Taiwan.
5e39ec052855c9445fbdc7b452df23f890ac204a.result: The neural network gives accurate tide forecasts from short records; exact errors are not reported here.
5e39ec052855c9445fbdc7b452df23f890ac204a.open_work: Long-term predictions and inclusion of non-astronomical effects.

55a79f34b084625994fe9f9719707e41ae81384f.goal: Forecasts daily PM10 concentrations in Thessaloniki to support air quality warnings.
55a79f34b084625994fe9f9719707e41ae81384f.architecture: Comparison of statistical and machine learning methods including regression, classification and regression trees and neural networks.
55a79f34b084625994fe9f9719707e41ae81384f.data: PM10 and meteorological observations from Thessaloniki, Greece.
55a79f34b084625994fe9f9719707e41ae81384f.result: The data-driven models forecast PM10 with useful skill, with differences between methods for exceedance prediction; numbers not reported here.
55a79f34b084625994fe9f9719707e41ae81384f.open_work: Better prediction of exceedance days and inclusion of emission information.
55a79f34b084625994fe9f9719707e41ae81384f.issues: Single city; abstract unavailable so method list is approximate.

9f307c5212f90eb673250ab5983c707e3045d522.goal: Forecasts daily air temperature using neural networks.
9f307c5212f90eb673250ab5983c707e3045d522.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network trained with backpropagation.
9f307c5212f90eb673250ab5983c707e3045d522.data: Several years of meteorological observations from Kermanshah, Iran.
9f307c5212f90eb673250ab5983c707e3045d522.result: The MLP gives one-day-ahead temperature forecasts with low error.
9f307c5212f90eb673250ab5983c707e3045d522.open_work: Using more stations and longer lead times.
9f307c5212f90eb673250ab5983c707e3045d522.issues: Single station; limited comparison with other methods.

30afd2e9b0a34f1aa7f67078db62d337ea7d162e.goal: Predicts air temperature 1 to 12 hours ahead year-round for agricultural decision support such as frost protection.
30afd2e9b0a34f1aa7f67078db62d337ea7d162e.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feed-forward MLP-type models) with seasonal and lagged weather inputs.
30afd2e9b0a34f1aa7f67078db62d337ea7d162e.data: Weather data from the Georgia Automated Environmental Monitoring Network, USA.
30afd2e9b0a34f1aa7f67078db62d337ea7d162e.result: Year-round networks predict temperature with mean absolute errors rising from under 1 °C at one hour to about 2 °C at twelve hours.
30afd2e9b0a34f1aa7f67078db62d337ea7d162e.open_work: Deploying operationally and extending to other variables.
30afd2e9b0a34f1aa7f67078db62d337ea7d162e.issues: Station-based inputs only; errors grow with horizon.

4342be13d189cf35fac55625f005668be4368077.goal: Derives reservoir operating policies efficiently by replacing costly simulation inside optimization.
4342be13d189cf35fac55625f005668be4368077.architecture: Neural network surrogate of a reservoir simulation model coupled with an optimization search (simulation-optimization).
4342be13d189cf35fac55625f005668be4368077.data: Reservoir system data for the Chennai city water supply system, India.
4342be13d189cf35fac55625f005668be4368077.result: The neural-network-based approach finds improved operating policies at much lower computational cost.
4342be13d189cf35fac55625f005668be4368077.open_work: Extending to stochastic inflows and multi-objective operation.
4342be13d189cf35fac55625f005668be4368077.issues: Surrogate accuracy limits the policies; single system.

a6f6c3c7e78f74fafc253fd3ef23c8de27de0a08.goal: Predicts runoff and sediment yield for a small agricultural watershed.
a6f6c3c7e78f74fafc253fd3ef23c8de27de0a08.architecture: Artificial neural network models (feed-forward) compared with multiple linear regression.
a6f6c3c7e78f74fafc253fd3ef23c8de27de0a08.data: Daily and weekly rainfall, runoff and sediment yield for the Upper Siwane River watershed, India.
a6f6c3c7e78f74fafc253fd3ef23c8de27de0a08.result: ANN models predict runoff and sediment yield better than regression models.
a6f6c3c7e78f74fafc253fd3ef23c8de27de0a08.open_work: Testing on more watersheds and event scales.

f879c3b347df05ae52a140c5a404beea9be22c97.goal: Generates multisite, multivariate daily weather sequences for agricultural and hydrological risk assessment.
f879c3b347df05ae52a140c5a404beea9be22c97.architecture: Semiparametric weather generator: Markov chain for precipitation occurrence with K-nearest neighbour (KNN) bootstrap resampling of daily weather vectors; not a neural method.
f879c3b347df05ae52a140c5a404beea9be22c97.data: Daily precipitation, temperature and solar radiation from stations in the Argentine Pampas.
f879c3b347df05ae52a140c5a404beea9be22c97.result: The generator reproduces daily statistics, spatial correlation and dependence between variables at multiple sites.
f879c3b347df05ae52a140c5a404beea9be22c97.open_work: Conditioning on climate indices or forecasts.
f879c3b347df05ae52a140c5a404beea9be22c97.issues: Resampling cannot produce values outside the historical record.

99e690a5bf02586296e9e1dc2b552d09cf198600.goal: Predicts crop yields from climate variables across German climate zones to assess climate change impacts.
99e690a5bf02586296e9e1dc2b552d09cf198600.architecture: Artificial neural network (type not specified here) relating climate to yields.
99e690a5bf02586296e9e1dc2b552d09cf198600.data: Crop yield statistics and climate data for four climate zones in Germany.
99e690a5bf02586296e9e1dc2b552d09cf198600.result: The ANN captures climate-yield relations for different zones; numbers not reported here.
99e690a5bf02586296e9e1dc2b552d09cf198600.open_work: Using projections to estimate future yields.
99e690a5bf02586296e9e1dc2b552d09cf198600.issues: Preprint; statistical relations may not transfer to future climates.

fc0a1504246fb2c6191bcfcdd41382d5ef4b2d1c.goal: Estimates daily solar irradiation over complex terrain from limited stations.
fc0a1504246fb2c6191bcfcdd41382d5ef4b2d1c.architecture: Artificial neural network (type not specified here) using clearness and topographic inputs.
fc0a1504246fb2c6191bcfcdd41382d5ef4b2d1c.data: Radiometric stations in a mountainous area of southern Spain.
fc0a1504246fb2c6191bcfcdd41382d5ef4b2d1c.result: The ANN estimates daily irradiation with low error across the area; exact values not reported here.
fc0a1504246fb2c6191bcfcdd41382d5ef4b2d1c.open_work: Mapping irradiation over larger mountainous regions.
fc0a1504246fb2c6191bcfcdd41382d5ef4b2d1c.issues: Few stations; terrain effects only partly captured.

2a89dc86094e2c7ff8e521da64411058e9ef1192.goal: Retrieves atmospheric temperature and moisture profiles quickly and accurately from hyperspectral infrared sounder radiances.
2a89dc86094e2c7ff8e521da64411058e9ef1192.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network applied to radiances compressed by projected principal components (PPC/NN).
2a89dc86094e2c7ff8e521da64411058e9ef1192.data: Simulated and observed AIRS hyperspectral radiances with radiosonde and NWP-based profiles (e.g., NOAA88 sounding set).
2a89dc86094e2c7ff8e521da64411058e9ef1192.result: PPC/NN retrievals are more accurate than linear regression and comparable to iterative physical methods at much lower cost.
2a89dc86094e2c7ff8e521da64411058e9ef1192.open_work: Handling clouds and applying to other sounders such as IASI and CrIS.
2a89dc86094e2c7ff8e521da64411058e9ef1192.issues: Partly simulated data; cloudy scenes and training-set representativeness remain challenges.

853ea2d71ffa5b487b656f87de2657de6229b675.goal: Improves streamflow forecasting by combining wavelet decomposition with neural networks.
853ea2d71ffa5b487b656f87de2657de6229b675.architecture: Neuro-wavelet model: discrete wavelet transform subseries fed into a feed-forward neural network, compared with a single neural network.
853ea2d71ffa5b487b656f87de2657de6229b675.data: Monthly streamflow records from stations in Turkey.
853ea2d71ffa5b487b656f87de2657de6229b675.result: The neuro-wavelet model outperforms the single neural network; numbers not reported here.
853ea2d71ffa5b487b656f87de2657de6229b675.open_work: Testing other wavelets and daily data.
853ea2d71ffa5b487b656f87de2657de6229b675.issues: Few stations; wavelet boundary handling for forecasting.

5c8c316d7a03ccc5c4277262c9a6e36c047b010f.goal: Downscales large-scale atmospheric fields to monthly total precipitation over Turkey.
5c8c316d7a03ccc5c4277262c9a6e36c047b010f.architecture: Statistical downscaling using principal components of large-scale predictors with a neural network-based transfer function; the specific network type is not specified here.
5c8c316d7a03ccc5c4277262c9a6e36c047b010f.data: NCEP/NCAR reanalysis predictors and monthly precipitation from Turkish stations.
5c8c316d7a03ccc5c4277262c9a6e36c047b010f.result: The method reproduces monthly precipitation variability at stations with useful skill; numbers not reported here.
5c8c316d7a03ccc5c4277262c9a6e36c047b010f.open_work: Applying to GCM scenarios for climate projections.
5c8c316d7a03ccc5c4277262c9a6e36c047b010f.issues: Stationarity of predictor-predictand relations assumed; monthly scale only.

d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.goal: Forecasts monthly river flows, where reliable estimates support reservoir operation and water resources planning, using a generalized regression neural network.
d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.architecture: Generalized regression neural network (GRNN), a kernel-based radial basis type neural network, applied to lagged monthly flow series; compared against other approaches.
d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.data: Monthly streamflow records from gauging stations; specific rivers and periods are not reported in the available metadata.
d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the paper presents the GRNN as a viable tool for monthly flow forecasting.
d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.open_work: Testing on more basins, adding climatic predictors and comparing with other neural network types would clarify generality.
d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.issues: Single-variable data-driven approach with limited record length typical of monthly series; extrapolation beyond observed flows is uncertain.

b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.goal: Generates synthetic streamflow sequences for water resources planning that reproduce observed statistics, including nonlinear dependence, while allowing values outside the historical record.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.architecture: Nonparametric stochastic method, not a neural network: a local polynomial regression fit combined with K-nearest neighbour (K-NN) resampling of residuals, extending the traditional K-NN bootstrap.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.data: Annual natural streamflow series of the Colorado River at Lees Ferry; observed historical records.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.result: The modified K-NN model reproduces distributional statistics and dependence of the observed flows and, unlike plain K-NN bootstrap, generates flow values not seen in the historical record.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.open_work: Extension to multisite and seasonal or monthly simulation and conditioning on climate information are natural next steps.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.issues: Demonstrated mainly on one basin's annual flows; resampling-based methods depend on record length and stationarity.

53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.goal: Estimates global precipitation rates from the Aqua satellite microwave and infrared sounders (AIRS, AMSU, HSB), extending sounder-based retrievals to precipitation.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.architecture: MLP neural network estimator using opaque microwave channels and principal components of sounder radiances as inputs, with physically motivated preprocessing.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.data: AIRS/AMSU/HSB observations from the Aqua satellite; neural network trained and evaluated against NEXRAD radar precipitation estimates.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.result: The neural network retrievals agree reasonably with NEXRAD precipitation rates at sounder resolution, demonstrating useful precipitation estimates from sounding instruments; detailed scores not reproduced here.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.open_work: Global validation beyond radar-covered regions, snow and light-rain sensitivity, and adaptation to later sounders remain open.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.issues: Training against NEXRAD over limited regions may not transfer to other climates or ocean areas; HSB failed early in the Aqua mission, limiting data.

12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.goal: Forecasts wind speed and direction jointly for wind energy applications by treating the wind vector as a complex-valued signal.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.architecture: Complex-valued recurrent neural network forecasting models that process wind speed and direction together as a complex number, compared with real-valued counterparts.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.data: Measured wind profile time series; site and period not reported in the available metadata.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.result: Complex-valued modelling of the wind vector improves forecasts compared with real-valued approaches treating speed and direction separately, according to the authors.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.open_work: Longer horizons, multiple sites and integration into wind power forecasting systems would test practical value.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.issues: Limited data and short-term horizons; no probabilistic forecasts. Details of the evaluation are not reported in the available metadata.

c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.goal: Retrieves soil moisture from remotely sensed radar data and compares a neural network inversion with a Bayesian retrieval approach.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network inversion compared against a Bayesian estimation method for inverting backscatter to soil moisture.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.data: Remotely sensed SAR backscatter data with ground measurements of soil moisture; exact sensors and sites not reported in the available metadata.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.result: Both methods retrieve soil moisture with comparable accuracy; the paper discusses their relative strengths, with specifics not reported in the available metadata.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.open_work: Combining the two approaches, accounting for vegetation and roughness, and testing on more sites remain open.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.issues: Ground truth is sparse; retrieval performance depends on surface roughness and vegetation conditions represented in the training data.

1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.goal: Improves automatic measurement of convective boundary layer depth from radar wind profilers, where simple signal-to-noise peak methods fail with clouds, birds or other contamination.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.architecture: Fuzzy logic method combining radar reflectivity (signal-to-noise ratio) and vertical velocity spectral width information to identify the boundary layer top; not a neural network.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.data: 915-MHz Doppler radar wind profiler observations, verified against radiosonde-derived boundary layer depths.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.result: The fuzzy logic algorithm gives boundary layer depths in better agreement with radiosondes than the standard signal-to-noise peak method, reducing gross errors.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.open_work: Adding further input variables (e.g. RASS temperature) and operational real-time deployment are natural extensions.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.issues: Tuned membership functions are site- and instrument-specific; performance under stable or multi-layer conditions is limited.

ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.goal: Forecasts solar irradiance for solar energy applications by combining time-frequency decomposition with recurrent neural networks.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.architecture: Recurrent neural network combined with wavelet analysis: the irradiance series is decomposed by wavelet transform and recurrent networks model the components.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.data: Measured solar irradiance time series; station and period not reported in the available metadata.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.result: The wavelet-recurrent network combination improves forecast accuracy compared with networks without wavelet preprocessing, according to the authors.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.open_work: Testing on more sites and horizons and adding meteorological inputs such as cloud forecasts are natural next steps.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.issues: Single-site evaluation; wavelet decomposition may use future information if not applied causally, a common pitfall.

836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.goal: Improves satellite precipitation estimation by using multispectral geostationary imagery rather than infrared alone in the PERSIANN framework.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.architecture: PERSIANN-MSA: self-organizing feature map (SOFM) clustering of multispectral cloud features, with principal component analysis of inputs, followed by mapping clusters to rain rates.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.data: GOES-12 multispectral channels (visible and infrared bands) over the United States, with radar-based precipitation for training and validation.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.result: Using multispectral information improves rain/no-rain detection and rain-rate estimates relative to infrared-only estimation.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.open_work: Extending to newer geostationary imagers with more channels and merging with passive microwave data.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.issues: Visible channels are only available in daytime; evaluated over a limited region and period.

5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.goal: Provides an operational algorithm for retrieving atmospheric trace gas columns (CO, CH4, O3) from the Infrared Atmospheric Sounding Interferometer before the instrument's launch.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) retrieval mapping simulated IASI radiances to trace gas total columns, designed for fast near-real-time processing.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.data: Simulated IASI spectra computed with a radiative transfer model from chemistry-transport model and climatological atmospheric profiles.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.result: The neural network retrieves total columns of the target gases with useful accuracy at a speed suitable for operational processing of IASI data.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.open_work: Validation with real IASI observations after launch and extension to more species.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.issues: Developed on simulated data, so performance on real spectra with instrument and cloud effects was untested; no vertical profile information.

30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.goal: Addresses multi-step-ahead flood forecasting, where errors accumulate with lead time, for real-time flood warning.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.architecture: Comparison of static feedforward neural networks and dynamic recurrent neural networks for multi-step-ahead streamflow prediction.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.data: Hourly rainfall and discharge records from flood events in a Taiwanese catchment; details not reported in the available metadata.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.result: The recurrent (dynamic) network gives more accurate and stable multi-step-ahead forecasts than static networks.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.open_work: Longer lead times, uncertainty quantification and use of rainfall forecasts as inputs remain open.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.issues: Limited number of flood events for training and testing; deterministic forecasts only.

1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.goal: Disaggregates annual streamflows into monthly flows at multiple sites while preserving space-time statistics, for basin-scale water resources simulation.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.architecture: Nonparametric K-nearest neighbour (K-NN) resampling-based disaggregation; a stochastic method, not a neural network.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.data: Naturalized monthly streamflow records at multiple gauges in the Upper Colorado River Basin.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.result: The technique reproduces monthly and annual statistics and spatial and temporal correlation across sites, and summability of disaggregated flows.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.open_work: Combination with paleo-reconstructed or climate-conditioned annual flows for planning scenarios.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.issues: Resampling cannot generate monthly patterns absent from the historical record; assumes stationarity.

b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels for groundwater management in a hard-rock aquifer setting in India using artificial neural networks.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation-type algorithms on groundwater level and related inputs.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.data: Observed groundwater levels and associated hydrometeorological data from an Indian watershed; details not reported in the available metadata.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.result: The neural network forecasts groundwater levels with acceptable accuracy, according to the authors.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.open_work: Including pumping and recharge information and testing at more wells and longer horizons.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.issues: Short records and site-specific training limit transferability; no uncertainty estimates.

aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.goal: Forecasts daily river flows and compares artificial neural networks with classical auto-regressive time-series models.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward MLP) compared with auto-regressive (AR) models using lagged flows as inputs.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.data: Daily streamflow records from a river in Turkey; period not reported in the available metadata.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.result: The neural network models perform better than the auto-regressive models for daily flow forecasting, according to the author.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.open_work: Adding precipitation inputs and testing on more rivers and longer lead times.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.issues: Single-river, flow-only inputs; extrapolation to extreme flows is uncertain.

636512b5deed72bdb3d09583e26ddcf8da1e17ea.goal: Predicts streamflow and related hydrologic variables at multiple gauging stations in an agricultural watershed and compares different artificial neural network models.
