77c86573ea6899295ce9eba709db97072bd7dc3e.goal: Forecasts weekly reference evapotranspiration for irrigation scheduling.
77c86573ea6899295ce9eba709db97072bd7dc3e.architecture: ARIMA time series models compared with artificial neural network models; the network type is not specified here.
77c86573ea6899295ce9eba709db97072bd7dc3e.data: Weekly evapotranspiration derived from meteorological station data in the Basque Country, Spain; periods not reported here.
77c86573ea6899295ce9eba709db97072bd7dc3e.result: Neural network forecasts are slightly better than ARIMA, and both beat climatological weekly means; numbers not reported here.
77c86573ea6899295ce9eba709db97072bd7dc3e.open_work: Longer lead times and use of weather forecast inputs.
77c86573ea6899295ce9eba709db97072bd7dc3e.issues: Small improvements over ARIMA; limited stations.

2c95facbbbe4ad1f72a29369f42d6af2a239cc99.goal: Assesses support vector regression for rainfall forecasting, a nonlinear problem poorly handled by linear models.
2c95facbbbe4ad1f72a29369f42d6af2a239cc99.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) with parameter selection, compared against conventional forecasting models.
2c95facbbbe4ad1f72a29369f42d6af2a239cc99.data: Rainfall records in Taiwan; stations and periods not reported here.
2c95facbbbe4ad1f72a29369f42d6af2a239cc99.result: SVR forecasts rainfall more accurately than the benchmark models; numbers not reported here.
2c95facbbbe4ad1f72a29369f42d6af2a239cc99.open_work: Hybrid parameter optimization and additional meteorological predictors.
2c95facbbbe4ad1f72a29369f42d6af2a239cc99.issues: Limited data and stations; parameter tuning sensitivity.

b193b59a64213be2b0eb7ad005f908459332bb2c.goal: Estimates wind velocity at sites without measurements from surrounding stations for wind energy assessment.
b193b59a64213be2b0eb7ad005f908459332bb2c.architecture: Artificial neural network for spatial estimation of wind velocity from surrounding stations; the network type is not specified here.
b193b59a64213be2b0eb7ad005f908459332bb2c.data: Wind velocity records from meteorological stations in Turkey; periods not reported here.
b193b59a64213be2b0eb7ad005f908459332bb2c.result: The neural network estimates wind velocity at target stations with acceptable errors; numbers not reported here.
b193b59a64213be2b0eb7ad005f908459332bb2c.open_work: Inclusion of topographic predictors and denser networks.
b193b59a64213be2b0eb7ad005f908459332bb2c.issues: Sparse station network; terrain effects not explicitly modelled.

be75cd2df3a871bdcbc1a76baf407d9dd7f7fe36.goal: Estimates and forecasts precipitation from radar observations, improving quantitative precipitation estimation for flood warning.
be75cd2df3a871bdcbc1a76baf407d9dd7f7fe36.architecture: Dynamic (recurrent) artificial neural network compared with static feed-forward networks.
be75cd2df3a871bdcbc1a76baf407d9dd7f7fe36.data: Radar reflectivity and rain gauge data during storm events in Taiwan; periods not reported here.
be75cd2df3a871bdcbc1a76baf407d9dd7f7fe36.result: The dynamic network gives more accurate precipitation estimates and short-term forecasts than the static network; numbers not reported here.
be75cd2df3a871bdcbc1a76baf407d9dd7f7fe36.open_work: Longer lead times and more events.
be75cd2df3a871bdcbc1a76baf407d9dd7f7fe36.issues: Limited events; radar errors propagate into estimates.

4b00e0e9f6195210a6cee5808efe28bf0ed767a9.goal: Generates synthetic daily weather sequences for hydrologic studies, overcoming the inability of plain K-nearest neighbour resampling to produce unobserved values.
4b00e0e9f6195210a6cee5808efe28bf0ed767a9.architecture: Nonparametric K-nearest neighbour (KNN) resampling weather generator with a perturbation step that generates values outside the historical record.
4b00e0e9f6195210a6cee5808efe28bf0ed767a9.data: Daily precipitation and temperature records from stations in the Upper Thames River basin, Ontario, Canada.
4b00e0e9f6195210a6cee5808efe28bf0ed767a9.result: The improved generator preserves statistics of historical data while producing new extreme values not present in the record.
4b00e0e9f6195210a6cee5808efe28bf0ed767a9.open_work: Coupling with climate change scenarios and hydrologic models.
4b00e0e9f6195210a6cee5808efe28bf0ed767a9.issues: Perturbation scheme parameters are subjective; spatial correlation preservation depends on station configuration.

d9be63131ea824f782a1c989029a31faf3f747e0.goal: Improves short-term electric load forecasting by combining forecasts that use multiple sources of meteorological information.
d9be63131ea824f782a1c989029a31faf3f747e0.architecture: Comprehensive combination of individual load forecasting models driven by different meteorological inputs; individual model types not specified here.
d9be63131ea824f782a1c989029a31faf3f747e0.data: Utility load and multi-source meteorological data; utility and periods not reported here.
d9be63131ea824f782a1c989029a31faf3f747e0.result: The combined forecast is more accurate and robust than individual forecasts; numbers not reported here.
d9be63131ea824f782a1c989029a31faf3f747e0.issues: Depends on weather forecast quality; single-system evaluation.

a053aafd4e366c4c02c043603b8b04ef4df81039.goal: Reduces bias in satellite precipitation estimates by adjusting them with gauge measurements over the southwestern United States.
a053aafd4e366c4c02c043603b8b04ef4df81039.architecture: Statistical bias adjustment of neural network-based PERSIANN satellite precipitation estimates using gauge data (non-ML adjustment step).
a053aafd4e366c4c02c043603b8b04ef4df81039.data: PERSIANN satellite precipitation estimates and ground gauge measurements over the southwestern United States.
a053aafd4e366c4c02c043603b8b04ef4df81039.result: Gauge-based adjustment reduces bias and improves agreement of satellite precipitation with ground observations; numbers not reported here.
a053aafd4e366c4c02c043603b8b04ef4df81039.open_work: Real-time adjustment and extension to other regions and gauge densities.
a053aafd4e366c4c02c043603b8b04ef4df81039.issues: Depends on gauge density and quality; complex terrain affects both gauges and satellite.

7be10af7304fafebf24b81de46de5e6508d4c66b.goal: Predicts river levels for flood warning while optimizing network structure and selecting relevant inputs.
7be10af7304fafebf24b81de46de5e6508d4c66b.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) with structural optimisation of connections and input selection.
7be10af7304fafebf24b81de46de5e6508d4c66b.data: River level and rainfall records from an Irish catchment; periods not reported here.
7be10af7304fafebf24b81de46de5e6508d4c66b.result: Optimised and pruned networks predict river levels as well as or better than full networks with fewer parameters; numbers not reported here.
7be10af7304fafebf24b81de46de5e6508d4c66b.open_work: Applying to more catchments and longer lead times.
7be10af7304fafebf24b81de46de5e6508d4c66b.issues: Single catchment; optimisation procedure computationally intensive.

0d8519f5a1032b498923f0314e48749179a46588.goal: Predicts groundwater levels in an arid region to support water resources management.
0d8519f5a1032b498923f0314e48749179a46588.architecture: Two prediction models compared: an artificial neural network and a time series model; the network type is not specified here.
0d8519f5a1032b498923f0314e48749179a46588.data: Groundwater level observations in Western Jilin Province, China; periods not reported here.
0d8519f5a1032b498923f0314e48749179a46588.result: Both models predict groundwater levels, with the neural network giving higher accuracy in the reported comparison; numbers not reported here.
0d8519f5a1032b498923f0314e48749179a46588.open_work: Inclusion of pumping and climate drivers and longer horizons.
0d8519f5a1032b498923f0314e48749179a46588.issues: Limited wells and record length; extrapolation under changing extraction uncertain.

0adf759f449435bc8343c9a8a2a25ad5bb63e5b8.goal: Predicts corn and soybean yields county by county across the US corn belt using satellite data for food supply and trade planning.
0adf759f449435bc8343c9a8a2a25ad5bb63e5b8.architecture: Artificial neural network trained with the SCE-UA global optimization algorithm, compared with multivariate linear regression.
0adf759f449435bc8343c9a8a2a25ad5bb63e5b8.data: Historical county yield statistics and long NDVI time series from AVHRR and MODIS over the Midwestern and Great Plains United States.
0adf759f449435bc8343c9a8a2a25ad5bb63e5b8.result: The SCE-UA-trained neural network trains effectively and reaches prediction accuracy up to 85 percent, outperforming multivariate linear regression.
0adf759f449435bc8343c9a8a2a25ad5bb63e5b8.open_work: Including weather inputs and finer spatial units.
0adf759f449435bc8343c9a8a2a25ad5bb63e5b8.issues: Accuracy metric definition unclear; NDVI-only inputs miss weather shocks.

e4b76873c01ad310f5662c662f8f83b03000d017.goal: Characterizes climate variability in the southern Indian Ocean, including subtropical dipole patterns and their changes.
e4b76873c01ad310f5662c662f8f83b03000d017.architecture: Self-organizing maps (SOM) applied to ocean-atmosphere anomaly fields to extract nonlinear patterns.
e4b76873c01ad310f5662c662f8f83b03000d017.data: Observational sea surface temperature and atmospheric datasets over the southern Indian Ocean; exact products not reported here.
e4b76873c01ad310f5662c662f8f83b03000d017.result: The SOM identifies subtropical dipole-like SST patterns and reveals asymmetries and changes not captured by linear EOF analysis.
e4b76873c01ad310f5662c662f8f83b03000d017.open_work: Examining mechanisms and model representation of the identified patterns.
e4b76873c01ad310f5662c662f8f83b03000d017.issues: Descriptive analysis; SOM size choice subjective.

018e73d94ba4c71e76e0fe2701ac756b66f7e9d4.goal: Classifies surface soil freeze/thaw state over China from passive microwave data for land surface and climate monitoring.
018e73d94ba4c71e76e0fe2701ac756b66f7e9d4.architecture: Decision tree classification using brightness temperature indicators such as scattering index, 37 GHz brightness temperature and spectral gradient.
018e73d94ba4c71e76e0fe2701ac756b66f7e9d4.data: SSM/I brightness temperatures and ground station soil temperature observations over China.
018e73d94ba4c71e76e0fe2701ac756b66f7e9d4.result: The decision tree classifies frozen, thawed and other surface states with good accuracy against station data; numbers not reported here.
018e73d94ba4c71e76e0fe2701ac756b66f7e9d4.open_work: Applying to AMSR-E and long-term freeze/thaw climatology.
018e73d94ba4c71e76e0fe2701ac756b66f7e9d4.issues: Coarse resolution; confusion with desert, snow and precipitation scattering signals.

effa46924de5ad351891f53d179eee2a7e6681ee.goal: Improves hydrological forecasts by fusing outputs of several individual forecasting models.
effa46924de5ad351891f53d179eee2a7e6681ee.architecture: Multi-model data fusion combining individual forecasting models (neural networks and other methods) via averaging, Bayesian, fuzzy logic and neural network fusion strategies.
effa46924de5ad351891f53d179eee2a7e6681ee.data: River level or flow records from a UK river catchment; periods not reported here.
effa46924de5ad351891f53d179eee2a7e6681ee.result: Fused forecasts outperform individual models, with neural network-based fusion among the best; numbers not reported here.
effa46924de5ad351891f53d179eee2a7e6681ee.open_work: Adaptive fusion for changing flow regimes.
effa46924de5ad351891f53d179eee2a7e6681ee.issues: Single catchment; fusion gains depend on diversity of base models.

56425cc19ca59ac2e5c05176eeff6e07e8fab749.goal: Detects decadal changes in ENSO patterns and evolution in the tropical Pacific.
56425cc19ca59ac2e5c05176eeff6e07e8fab749.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) neural network classification of tropical Pacific SST anomaly patterns.
56425cc19ca59ac2e5c05176eeff6e07e8fab749.data: Observed tropical Pacific sea surface temperature anomalies over several decades; product not reported here.
56425cc19ca59ac2e5c05176eeff6e07e8fab749.result: The SOM reveals changes in ENSO spatial patterns and evolution across decades, notably around the late-1970s climate shift.
56425cc19ca59ac2e5c05176eeff6e07e8fab749.open_work: Evaluate ENSO changes in climate models with the same approach.
56425cc19ca59ac2e5c05176eeff6e07e8fab749.issues: Limited number of ENSO events per decade restricts statistical significance.

505c48a6356d7ee554a28fb081dbd7101b7fd928.goal: Routes flood waves in natural channels with a data-driven alternative to Muskingum-type methods.
505c48a6356d7ee554a28fb081dbd7101b7fd928.architecture: Genetic programming (symbolic regression) deriving flood routing relations, compared with conventional Muskingum routing.
505c48a6356d7ee554a28fb081dbd7101b7fd928.data: Upstream and downstream flood hydrographs from natural river reaches; reaches not reported here.
505c48a6356d7ee554a28fb081dbd7101b7fd928.result: Genetic programming routes floods accurately and competes with or exceeds Muskingum methods; numbers not reported here.
505c48a6356d7ee554a28fb081dbd7101b7fd928.open_work: Inclusion of lateral inflow and multiple reaches.
505c48a6356d7ee554a28fb081dbd7101b7fd928.issues: Few flood events; evolved expressions may lack physical meaning.

38e6af589dacdba5b1499e5a72fc67dce594eaac.goal: Evaluates neural network streamflow forecasting systematically over many watersheds to assess robustness of performance.
38e6af589dacdba5b1499e5a72fc67dce594eaac.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks for daily streamflow forecasting, with different input configurations.
38e6af589dacdba5b1499e5a72fc67dce594eaac.data: Daily rainfall and streamflow from 47 watersheds in France and the United States.
38e6af589dacdba5b1499e5a72fc67dce594eaac.result: Neural network performance varies across watersheds; inputs from soil moisture accounting improve forecasts; numbers not reported here.
38e6af589dacdba5b1499e5a72fc67dce594eaac.issues: Daily one-step forecasts; transferability to ungauged basins not addressed.

76c66bb819f9ce9eed97896ea4a031bbc006976f.goal: Forecasts hourly typhoon rainfall for flood warning in Taiwan.
76c66bb819f9ce9eed97896ea4a031bbc006976f.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector regression) model, compared with multilayer perceptron neural networks.
76c66bb819f9ce9eed97896ea4a031bbc006976f.data: Hourly rainfall and typhoon characteristics for typhoon events affecting a Taiwanese watershed; periods not reported here.
76c66bb819f9ce9eed97896ea4a031bbc006976f.result: The SVM-based model forecasts hourly typhoon rainfall more accurately and robustly than the MLP benchmarks; numbers not reported here.
76c66bb819f9ce9eed97896ea4a031bbc006976f.open_work: Longer lead times and incorporation of radar data.
76c66bb819f9ce9eed97896ea4a031bbc006976f.issues: Limited typhoon sample; accuracy declines with lead time.

ed7afcb2d9228025de792d5cf13afe366f9a417f.goal: Forecasts ozone concentrations and high-ozone episodes for public warnings.
ed7afcb2d9228025de792d5cf13afe366f9a417f.architecture: Fuzzy expert system combined with artificial neural network forecasting models.
ed7afcb2d9228025de792d5cf13afe366f9a417f.data: Ozone and meteorological monitoring data from an urban area in Korea (Seoul); periods not reported here.
ed7afcb2d9228025de792d5cf13afe366f9a417f.result: The combined fuzzy expert and neural network system forecasts ozone and high-ozone episodes better than separate models; numbers not reported here.
ed7afcb2d9228025de792d5cf13afe366f9a417f.open_work: Extending to more sites and longer lead times.
ed7afcb2d9228025de792d5cf13afe366f9a417f.issues: Episodes are rare; rule base designed for local conditions.

d8c5359dca265225a9de9d3b507048e5295786f5.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from limited climate data for irrigation planning.
d8c5359dca265225a9de9d3b507048e5295786f5.architecture: Artificial neural network models compared with climate-based empirical methods (such as Penman-Monteith-type references).
d8c5359dca265225a9de9d3b507048e5295786f5.data: Climate data from a site in India; periods not reported here.
d8c5359dca265225a9de9d3b507048e5295786f5.result: Neural network estimates match reference evapotranspiration better than empirical methods with reduced inputs; numbers not reported here.

a8dfa7f9aae064108f1557fa8b46ff8dc7a4c4b4.goal: Predicts flash flood discharge and associated water quality in a mountainous stream to support monitoring.
a8dfa7f9aae064108f1557fa8b46ff8dc7a4c4b4.architecture: Artificial neural network predicting discharge and water-quality parameters; the network type is not specified here.
a8dfa7f9aae064108f1557fa8b46ff8dc7a4c4b4.data: Stream discharge, rainfall and water-quality monitoring data from a stream on Oahu, Hawaii; periods not reported here.
a8dfa7f9aae064108f1557fa8b46ff8dc7a4c4b4.result: The neural network reproduces flash flood flows and several water-quality variables reasonably; numbers not reported here.
a8dfa7f9aae064108f1557fa8b46ff8dc7a4c4b4.issues: Few flash flood events; water-quality data are sparse.

8cdd446bea620598e73077768dbf1c76681d04df.goal: Reconstructs cool-season precipitation in the southwestern USA back to AD 1000 from tree-ring chronologies, testing whether nonlinear techniques improve on linear regression for paleoclimate reconstruction.
8cdd446bea620598e73077768dbf1c76681d04df.architecture: Compares multiple linear regression with a nonlinear artificial neural network (feedforward MLP) transfer function from tree-ring predictors to seasonal precipitation.
8cdd446bea620598e73077768dbf1c76681d04df.data: Tree-ring width chronologies from the southwestern USA as predictors; instrumental climate-division cool-season precipitation for calibration and verification.
8cdd446bea620598e73077768dbf1c76681d04df.result: Both approaches yield skilful reconstructions with broadly similar verification statistics; the reconstruction documents multi-decadal droughts and wet periods over the past millennium.
8cdd446bea620598e73077768dbf1c76681d04df.open_work: Extend nonlinear calibration to larger tree-ring networks and quantify reconstruction uncertainty for extremes.
8cdd446bea620598e73077768dbf1c76681d04df.issues: Short instrumental calibration period limits nonlinear model training; the nonlinear method's added value is modest and stationarity of the tree-ring–climate relation is assumed.

4c1c989ddc6d3b29982e769b78f7ae29b63408f4.goal: Improves artificial neural network river flow forecasting when observed records are short by augmenting training data.
4c1c989ddc6d3b29982e769b78f7ae29b63408f4.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) trained with additional synthetic flow series generated by an ARMA stochastic model, compared with ANN trained on observed data only.
4c1c989ddc6d3b29982e769b78f7ae29b63408f4.data: Observed river flow records; ARMA-generated synthetic series used to extend the training set. Station details not reported in the available information.
4c1c989ddc6d3b29982e769b78f7ae29b63408f4.result: Training the ANN with ARMA-generated synthetic data improves flow forecasting performance relative to training on the short observed record alone.
4c1c989ddc6d3b29982e769b78f7ae29b63408f4.open_work: Test other stochastic generators and longer forecast horizons, and assess benefits for extreme flows.
4c1c989ddc6d3b29982e769b78f7ae29b63408f4.issues: Synthetic data inherit the linear ARMA structure and may not represent nonlinear extremes; evaluation limited to few river records.

19047345351288fe0b971c4f04c2e167b7310b8d.goal: Forecasts daily PM10 concentrations in an urban area to support air-quality warnings, testing whether a simple neural network suffices.
19047345351288fe0b971c4f04c2e167b7310b8d.architecture: Simple feedforward neural network (MLP) compared with a radial basis function network and a multivariate linear regression model.
19047345351288fe0b971c4f04c2e167b7310b8d.data: Urban PM10 monitoring and meteorological data from Italy; exact stations and period not reported in the available information.
19047345351288fe0b971c4f04c2e167b7310b8d.result: The simple feedforward network gives the best PM10 forecasts among the three approaches, outperforming the RBF network and linear regression.
19047345351288fe0b971c4f04c2e167b7310b8d.open_work: Add more predictors such as forecast meteorology and test transferability to other sites.
19047345351288fe0b971c4f04c2e167b7310b8d.issues: Single-area study; performance on high-concentration exceedance days and uncertainty not reported in the available information.

3334c37ae9241381620ed7f562de0c3786013d65.goal: Models and forecasts hydrological time series such as river flow using an adaptive neuro-fuzzy approach as an alternative to conventional neural networks.
3334c37ae9241381620ed7f562de0c3786013d65.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) with antecedent flow inputs, compared with neural network and conventional time-series models.
3334c37ae9241381620ed7f562de0c3786013d65.data: Monthly river flow records from a Turkish river basin; exact period not reported in the available information.
3334c37ae9241381620ed7f562de0c3786013d65.result: ANFIS reproduces the flow series well and performs at least as well as the comparison models.
3334c37ae9241381620ed7f562de0c3786013d65.open_work: Include exogenous inputs such as rainfall and test longer lead times and other basins.
3334c37ae9241381620ed7f562de0c3786013d65.issues: Single-basin case study; input selection is empirical and no uncertainty quantification.

d61495abe3d25bf8a366ad086f471cd1fff17483.goal: Forecasts local rainfall by statistically downscaling large-scale atmospheric variables, aiming to improve rainfall prediction in a monsoon region.
d61495abe3d25bf8a366ad086f471cd1fff17483.architecture: Artificial neural networks (specific type not specified in the available information) mapping large-scale atmospheric predictors to local rainfall amounts or occurrence categories.
d61495abe3d25bf8a366ad086f471cd1fff17483.data: Large-scale atmospheric fields from reanalysis and rain-gauge observations in southern Japan (Kyushu) during the rainy season.
d61495abe3d25bf8a366ad086f471cd1fff17483.result: The neural networks capture rainfall occurrence and intensity categories with useful skill, better for classification of rainy versus dry conditions than for amounts.
d61495abe3d25bf8a366ad086f471cd1fff17483.open_work: Apply the downscaling to forecast model output and refine predictor selection.
d61495abe3d25bf8a366ad086f471cd1fff17483.issues: Rainfall amounts, especially extremes, are poorly reproduced; trained on reanalysis predictors so operational skill depends on forecast quality.

949ae28acbccbe22d21ac3dcf8ca7a5e1599b100.goal: Presents the state of the art in applying neural networks to hydrological modelling for researchers and practitioners.
949ae28acbccbe22d21ac3dcf8ca7a5e1599b100.architecture: Review and edited book covering neural network types (MLP, RBF, self-organizing maps, hybrid and modular networks) for hydrological modelling.
949ae28acbccbe22d21ac3dcf8ca7a5e1599b100.data: Review; chapters draw on many case studies of rainfall-runoff, river flow and water quality modelling.
949ae28acbccbe22d21ac3dcf8ca7a5e1599b100.result: Synthesizes methods, applications and practical guidance, showing neural networks as competitive data-driven tools in hydrology.
949ae28acbccbe22d21ac3dcf8ca7a5e1599b100.open_work: Improving physical interpretability, uncertainty estimation, generalization and integration with conceptual models.
949ae28acbccbe22d21ac3dcf8ca7a5e1599b100.issues: Snapshot of the field around 2004; no unified benchmark across chapters.

65f7464a1d295ea843c29aabf0ee263bf4d28303.goal: Forecasts regional annual runoff using indices of low-frequency climate variability to support long-term water resource planning.
65f7464a1d295ea843c29aabf0ee263bf4d28303.architecture: Recurrent neural network using climate indices (such as ENSO, NAO and PNA indices) as inputs, compared with simpler models.
65f7464a1d295ea843c29aabf0ee263bf4d28303.data: Annual runoff records from catchments in Quebec, Canada, and indices of low-frequency climatic variability.
65f7464a1d295ea843c29aabf0ee263bf4d28303.result: The recurrent network using climate indices forecasts annual runoff with useful skill, outperforming simpler reference approaches.
65f7464a1d295ea843c29aabf0ee263bf4d28303.open_work: Test additional teleconnection indices and other regions, and quantify forecast uncertainty.
65f7464a1d295ea843c29aabf0ee263bf4d28303.issues: Short annual series limit training data; relations between indices and runoff may be nonstationary.

82d964d4eb02b8891e0160735d60a40066ca738d.goal: Forecasts solar irradiation for solar energy applications, handling weather variability with fuzzy preprocessing.
82d964d4eb02b8891e0160735d60a40066ca738d.architecture: Diagonal recurrent wavelet neural network (recurrent network with wavelet activation functions) combined with a fuzzy technique to treat weather-type inputs.
82d964d4eb02b8891e0160735d60a40066ca738d.data: Not reported in the available information.
82d964d4eb02b8891e0160735d60a40066ca738d.result: The hybrid approach gives accurate solar irradiation forecasts and improves on comparison networks according to the authors.
82d964d4eb02b8891e0160735d60a40066ca738d.open_work: Validation at more sites and seasons, and integration into PV power forecasting.
82d964d4eb02b8891e0160735d60a40066ca738d.issues: Details of data, horizon and baselines not available here; limited site validation likely.

bace2751cdb2835eda1e3bc838272162ca90d824.goal: Simulates runoff and sediment yield in a catchment to support soil and water management where physically based models are data-demanding.
bace2751cdb2835eda1e3bc838272162ca90d824.architecture: Feedforward neural networks (MLP, backpropagation) at daily, weekly and monthly time scales, compared with linear models.
bace2751cdb2835eda1e3bc838272162ca90d824.data: Rainfall, runoff and sediment observations from a river basin in India; exact basin and period not confirmed here.
bace2751cdb2835eda1e3bc838272162ca90d824.result: The neural networks simulate runoff and sediment yield satisfactorily and generally better than the linear models.
bace2751cdb2835eda1e3bc838272162ca90d824.open_work: Test at other basins and include land-use and erosion drivers.
bace2751cdb2835eda1e3bc838272162ca90d824.issues: Single-catchment empirical model; sediment observations are sparse and extremes may be underestimated.

48de97ece12a154b6a580316f8c135382228115f.goal: Validates hail detection with dual-polarization radar to assess its benefit over the operational single-polarization WSR-88D hail detection algorithm.
48de97ece12a154b6a580316f8c135382228115f.architecture: Fuzzy logic polarimetric hydrometeor classification algorithm (hail designation) compared with the legacy WSR-88D hail detection algorithm; not a learned model.
48de97ece12a154b6a580316f8c135382228115f.data: Polarimetric KOUN S-band radar observations in Oklahoma during the Joint Polarization Experiment, verified against surface hail reports.
48de97ece12a154b6a580316f8c135382228115f.result: Polarimetric hail detection outperforms the WSR-88D hail detection algorithm, with higher detection skill and lower false alarm rates.
48de97ece12a154b6a580316f8c135382228115f.open_work: Discriminate hail size and extend validation to other climates before national dual-polarization deployment.
48de97ece12a154b6a580316f8c135382228115f.issues: Limited number of storms and reliance on spotter hail reports with sampling biases.

19e68a6a867265705aeb21e9c08c7ed35f83bf58.goal: Simulates and forecasts total solar radiation time series in Athens for solar energy and building applications.
19e68a6a867265705aeb21e9c08c7ed35f83bf58.architecture: Artificial neural networks (specific type not specified in the available information) using past radiation values and meteorological variables.
19e68a6a867265705aeb21e9c08c7ed35f83bf58.data: Long-term measurements of total solar radiation and meteorological parameters in Athens, Greece.
19e68a6a867265705aeb21e9c08c7ed35f83bf58.result: The neural networks reproduce the solar radiation series with good accuracy.
19e68a6a867265705aeb21e9c08c7ed35f83bf58.open_work: Extend to other sites and to forecasting under variable cloud cover.
19e68a6a867265705aeb21e9c08c7ed35f83bf58.issues: Single-site study; no comparison with satellite-based estimates and no uncertainty quantification.

de9f13d3af70a1720372e5d20547a5cf03d33f04.goal: Retrieves temperature, water vapour and ozone profiles simultaneously from IASI hyperspectral infrared radiances quickly and accurately.
de9f13d3af70a1720372e5d20547a5cf03d33f04.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network applied to principal-component-compressed IASI spectra, retrieving all three profiles jointly.
de9f13d3af70a1720372e5d20547a5cf03d33f04.data: Simulated IASI radiances from radiative transfer computations over a climatological atmospheric profile database (TIGR).
de9f13d3af70a1720372e5d20547a5cf03d33f04.result: The neural retrieval gives accurate profiles of temperature, water vapour and ozone, with joint retrieval exploiting correlations between variables.
de9f13d3af70a1720372e5d20547a5cf03d33f04.open_work: Apply to real IASI observations and add first-guess information and error characterization.
de9f13d3af70a1720372e5d20547a5cf03d33f04.issues: Evaluated on simulated data; clear-sky assumption and dependence on representativeness of the training database.

ca7651fda228f30e4e7d8e4b42abab86e8637423.goal: Predicts coastal water levels at a station using data from nearby stations, for gap filling and forecasting in coastal engineering.
ca7651fda228f30e4e7d8e4b42abab86e8637423.architecture: Regional artificial neural network (specific type not specified in the available information) using water level data from neighbouring stations as inputs.
ca7651fda228f30e4e7d8e4b42abab86e8637423.data: Coastal water level records from NOAA tide stations in a US coastal region.
ca7651fda228f30e4e7d8e4b42abab86e8637423.result: The regional neural network reproduces and predicts water levels at the target station with high correlation to observations.
ca7651fda228f30e4e7d8e4b42abab86e8637423.open_work: Test on storm surge events and longer prediction horizons.
ca7651fda228f30e4e7d8e4b42abab86e8637423.issues: Depends on availability of nearby stations; performance during extreme events not established.

207467838d1cb7922c0146d8ecb2a42242e71dc3.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration from limited meteorological data with an explicit empirical formula.
207467838d1cb7922c0146d8ecb2a42242e71dc3.architecture: Genetic programming producing explicit equations, compared with conventional empirical ET0 methods.
207467838d1cb7922c0146d8ecb2a42242e71dc3.data: Daily meteorological data from weather stations (California CIMIS network), with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 as reference.
207467838d1cb7922c0146d8ecb2a42242e71dc3.result: The genetic programming formula estimates ET0 closely matching Penman-Monteith and better than several empirical methods.
207467838d1cb7922c0146d8ecb2a42242e71dc3.open_work: Test the derived equations in other climates.
207467838d1cb7922c0146d8ecb2a42242e71dc3.issues: Equations may not transfer to other climates; reference is a model estimate rather than lysimeter measurements.

24fd94fad05d9be14fb1b4407250fdb15c653ca5.goal: Downscales GCM simulations of Senegal rainfall through daily weather types to improve simulation of local rainfall characteristics.
24fd94fad05d9be14fb1b4407250fdb15c653ca5.architecture: Weather-typing via k-means clustering of atmospheric patterns combined with stochastic rainfall simulation; statistical downscaling, not a neural network.
24fd94fad05d9be14fb1b4407250fdb15c653ca5.data: Daily station rainfall over Senegal, reanalysis circulation fields and ensemble GCM (ECHAM4.5) simulations forced by observed SST.
24fd94fad05d9be14fb1b4407250fdb15c653ca5.result: Weather-type-based downscaling improves interannual rainfall amount and occurrence simulation over raw GCM output.
24fd94fad05d9be14fb1b4407250fdb15c653ca5.open_work: Apply to seasonal forecasts and climate change projections.
24fd94fad05d9be14fb1b4407250fdb15c653ca5.issues: Skill limited by GCM circulation biases and the weak predictability of Sahelian rainfall.

2e53c2cfd707507186c4fef643a854e8178edbe9.goal: Forecasts hourly air temperature for next-hour and next-day applications such as energy load forecasting.
2e53c2cfd707507186c4fef643a854e8178edbe9.architecture: Abductive networks (GMDH-based polynomial networks), compared with neural network models.
2e53c2cfd707507186c4fef643a854e8178edbe9.data: Hourly temperature records from a single site; years and location not reported in the available information.
2e53c2cfd707507186c4fef643a854e8178edbe9.result: Abductive networks give accurate hourly temperature forecasts, comparable to or better than neural networks, with automatic model synthesis.
2e53c2cfd707507186c4fef643a854e8178edbe9.open_work: Include more meteorological predictors and test at other sites.
2e53c2cfd707507186c4fef643a854e8178edbe9.issues: Single-site univariate setting; errors grow for next-day forecasts.

256f274b8c4b0a5b22e95e2e3cfc1c6d50a2f45d.goal: Examines whether Northern Hemisphere atmospheric variability is organized in regimes and how these change under global warming.
256f274b8c4b0a5b22e95e2e3cfc1c6d50a2f45d.architecture: Nonlinear principal component analysis implemented with an autoassociative neural network.
256f274b8c4b0a5b22e95e2e3cfc1c6d50a2f45d.data: Northern Hemisphere fields from control and greenhouse-warming integrations of the CCCma coupled climate model.
256f274b8c4b0a5b22e95e2e3cfc1c6d50a2f45d.result: Nonlinear modes reveal regime-like behaviour; under warming, regime occupancy shifts, reflecting changes in the Arctic Oscillation-like variability.
256f274b8c4b0a5b22e95e2e3cfc1c6d50a2f45d.open_work: Confirm regime changes in observations and other models.
256f274b8c4b0a5b22e95e2e3cfc1c6d50a2f45d.issues: Single climate model; NLPCA results sensitive to overfitting and network choices.

92a9d5c1bad1f922fde39ac3861269e19302bc56.goal: Estimates wind turbine power curves more accurately for wind energy yield assessment.
92a9d5c1bad1f922fde39ac3861269e19302bc56.architecture: Fuzzy logic model built from cluster centres (subtractive clustering-based fuzzy modelling), compared with conventional power curve methods.
92a9d5c1bad1f922fde39ac3861269e19302bc56.data: Measured wind speed and power output from a wind turbine site; details not reported in the available information.
92a9d5c1bad1f922fde39ac3861269e19302bc56.result: The cluster-centre fuzzy model represents the power curve better than conventional methods.
92a9d5c1bad1f922fde39ac3861269e19302bc56.open_work: Validate on more turbines and include wind direction and turbulence effects.
92a9d5c1bad1f922fde39ac3861269e19302bc56.issues: Limited data set; site-specific power curve.

ac2da733f04e637e6df0aaa395142cf223ee2365.goal: Improves multi-step streamflow forecasting with recurrent networks for flood warning.
ac2da733f04e637e6df0aaa395142cf223ee2365.architecture: Recurrent neural network trained with real-time recurrent learning to forecast two steps ahead, compared with a feedforward network.
ac2da733f04e637e6df0aaa395142cf223ee2365.data: Streamflow and rainfall records from a river in Taiwan.
ac2da733f04e637e6df0aaa395142cf223ee2365.result: The two-step-ahead recurrent network forecasts streamflow more accurately than the comparison models.
ac2da733f04e637e6df0aaa395142cf223ee2365.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and other catchments.
ac2da733f04e637e6df0aaa395142cf223ee2365.issues: Single-basin study; performance on extreme floods not quantified.

cef6c74fa43453b9e386c30b63dbcfb95cf82931.goal: Compares generalisation techniques for neural network streamflow models to give practitioners guidelines for building models that infer behaviour beyond the training data.
cef6c74fa43453b9e386c30b63dbcfb95cf82931.architecture: Multi-layer perceptron neural networks trained by Levenberg-Marquardt, with five generalisation approaches: stop training, Bayesian regularisation, stacking, bagging and boosting.
cef6c74fa43453b9e386c30b63dbcfb95cf82931.data: Streamflow modelling in six catchments with diverse hydrological behaviours.
cef6c74fa43453b9e386c30b63dbcfb95cf82931.result: All approaches beat standard networks; stacking, bagging and boosting improve most, stacking slightly best but inconsistent across catchments.
cef6c74fa43453b9e386c30b63dbcfb95cf82931.open_work: Authors recommend combining stop training or Bayesian regularisation with bagging or boosting; further testing in other catchments remains.
cef6c74fa43453b9e386c30b63dbcfb95cf82931.issues: Gains from stacking are small and catchment-dependent; ensemble methods increase computational cost.

42e4a112c0da4d6f71e8e091910d2fe8841014b5.goal: Retrieves optically active seawater constituents from hyperspectral remote sensing data in optically complex waters.
42e4a112c0da4d6f71e8e091910d2fe8841014b5.architecture: Generalized radial basis function neural networks mapping reflectance spectra to chlorophyll, suspended sediment and yellow substance concentrations.
42e4a112c0da4d6f71e8e091910d2fe8841014b5.data: Hyperspectral water reflectance spectra; whether simulated or measured, the sensor and in situ data are not reported in the available information.
42e4a112c0da4d6f71e8e091910d2fe8841014b5.result: The generalized RBF networks retrieve constituent concentrations accurately and robustly to noise.
42e4a112c0da4d6f71e8e091910d2fe8841014b5.open_work: Validate on real hyperspectral imagery with in situ matchups.
42e4a112c0da4d6f71e8e091910d2fe8841014b5.issues: Dependence on the bio-optical model used for training; real-data validation limited.

a206f26cd499b5190d337a30f52ce569a6318b43.goal: Extracts physically interpretable knowledge from trained neural network river flow models to address their black-box nature.
a206f26cd499b5190d337a30f52ce569a6318b43.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) river flow models analysed with sensitivity and input-contribution techniques.
a206f26cd499b5190d337a30f52ce569a6318b43.data: River flow and rainfall records from a catchment; details not reported in the available information.
a206f26cd499b5190d337a30f52ce569a6318b43.result: The analysis shows the trained networks capture physically plausible relations between inputs and flow.
a206f26cd499b5190d337a30f52ce569a6318b43.open_work: Develop general interpretability methods for hydrological neural networks.
a206f26cd499b5190d337a30f52ce569a6318b43.issues: Interpretation techniques are approximate and case-specific.

79b708b81d465037f43fe8d89dc74f0c74453e5a.goal: Derives real-time reservoir release rules for flood control in a multipurpose multireservoir system.
79b708b81d465037f43fe8d89dc74f0c74453e5a.architecture: Decision tree models learning release rules from optimal releases computed by an optimization model.
79b708b81d465037f43fe8d89dc74f0c74453e5a.data: Historical typhoon flood events and multireservoir operation data from a river basin in Taiwan.
79b708b81d465037f43fe8d89dc74f0c74453e5a.result: Tree-based release rules approximate optimal operations and reduce flood peaks compared with conventional rules.
79b708b81d465037f43fe8d89dc74f0c74453e5a.open_work: Incorporate forecast uncertainty in inflows and test on new events.
79b708b81d465037f43fe8d89dc74f0c74453e5a.issues: Limited number of flood events for rule learning; performance depends on optimization targets.

460f943de2b54945b2d5525c4f327c0470bdfd53.goal: Models real-time reservoir operation decisions by learning from operating rule curves.
460f943de2b54945b2d5525c4f327c0470bdfd53.architecture: Artificial neural network (specific type not specified in the available information) incorporating reservoir operating rule curves; part II of a study on intelligent control.
460f943de2b54945b2d5525c4f327c0470bdfd53.data: Reservoir operation records from a reservoir in Taiwan.
460f943de2b54945b2d5525c4f327c0470bdfd53.result: The neural network with rule curves reproduces operator decisions and improves operation performance.
460f943de2b54945b2d5525c4f327c0470bdfd53.open_work: Combine with inflow forecasts and multi-objective optimization.
460f943de2b54945b2d5525c4f327c0470bdfd53.issues: Single reservoir; learned rules reflect historical operating practice.

1ead01141e661003386afebf7e9082d096e7002d.goal: Estimates wind speed at a site using measurements from neighbouring stations to support wind resource assessment.
1ead01141e661003386afebf7e9082d096e7002d.architecture: Neural network models relating wind speed series of neighbouring stations, guided by cross-correlation analysis; type not specified in the available information.
1ead01141e661003386afebf7e9082d096e7002d.data: Wind speed measurements from neighbouring meteorological stations in Greece.
1ead01141e661003386afebf7e9082d096e7002d.result: Wind speed at the target site is estimated well when station correlation is high.
1ead01141e661003386afebf7e9082d096e7002d.open_work: Apply to longer distances and complex terrain.
1ead01141e661003386afebf7e9082d096e7002d.issues: Accuracy depends on inter-station correlation and terrain similarity.

1c4d47ef6ebdc9502311e6735d9077008fad975c.goal: Predicts ground-level ozone exceedances where high-ozone days are rare, addressing class imbalance.
1c4d47ef6ebdc9502311e6735d9077008fad975c.architecture: Support vector machine classification with a cost-sensitive scheme penalizing misclassification of rare high-ozone events.
1c4d47ef6ebdc9502311e6735d9077008fad975c.data: Air pollutant and meteorological monitoring data from Hong Kong.
1c4d47ef6ebdc9502311e6735d9077008fad975c.result: The cost-sensitive SVM improves detection of high-ozone episodes compared with standard SVM classification.
1c4d47ef6ebdc9502311e6735d9077008fad975c.open_work: Test other imbalance-handling methods and sites.
1c4d47ef6ebdc9502311e6735d9077008fad975c.issues: Limited station data; trade-off between hit rate and false alarms.

fe7337d32f733d0c478a25c61a63ef6e6da5c31e.goal: Simulates monthly runoff by comparing and combining a conceptual model and neural networks.
fe7337d32f733d0c478a25c61a63ef6e6da5c31e.architecture: Conceptual HBV model compared with artificial neural networks, and hybrid combinations using conceptual-model outputs as network inputs.
fe7337d32f733d0c478a25c61a63ef6e6da5c31e.data: Monthly precipitation, temperature and runoff for catchments in Scandinavia (Norway and Sweden).
fe7337d32f733d0c478a25c61a63ef6e6da5c31e.result: Combining the conceptual model with a neural network performs best, better than either model alone.
fe7337d32f733d0c478a25c61a63ef6e6da5c31e.open_work: Extend hybrid approaches to daily scales and other climates.
fe7337d32f733d0c478a25c61a63ef6e6da5c31e.issues: Small number of catchments; neural networks extrapolate poorly beyond training range.

4f29ebe94584da007c2b4bb2b67003a30a9fc14e.goal: Applies neural networks to rainfall-runoff modelling of the Blue Nile catchment where data are scarce.
4f29ebe94584da007c2b4bb2b67003a30a9fc14e.architecture: Artificial neural network rainfall-runoff model (specific type not specified in the available information), compared with conventional modelling approaches.
4f29ebe94584da007c2b4bb2b67003a30a9fc14e.data: Rainfall and discharge records for the Blue Nile catchment.
4f29ebe94584da007c2b4bb2b67003a30a9fc14e.result: The neural network simulates runoff with good accuracy for the case study.
4f29ebe94584da007c2b4bb2b67003a30a9fc14e.open_work: Improve rainfall inputs and test for climate change scenarios.

4621783c7b3f50160b438daa45df0acc6da6ae84.goal: Compares artificial intelligence methods for daily river flow forecasting to identify the most suitable approach.
4621783c7b3f50160b438daa45df0acc6da6ae84.architecture: ANFIS compared with generalized regression neural networks (GRNN), feedforward neural networks (MLP) and auto-regressive models.
4621783c7b3f50160b438daa45df0acc6da6ae84.data: Daily river flow (Seyhan River) and daily flow plus rainfall (Cine River), Turkey, split into training, testing and verification sets.
4621783c7b3f50160b438daa45df0acc6da6ae84.result: ANFIS outperforms GRNN and FFNN models and provides high accuracy and reliability for daily river flow forecasting.
4621783c7b3f50160b438daa45df0acc6da6ae84.open_work: Test at more stations and longer lead times.
4621783c7b3f50160b438daa45df0acc6da6ae84.issues: Two stations only; performance on extremes not discussed in the abstract.

6ebb317f053fc10e94b808710296610800039698.goal: Forecasts monthly precipitation in Jordan, a water-scarce country.
6ebb317f053fc10e94b808710296610800039698.architecture: Neural networks (feedforward back-propagation and radial basis function) compared with multiple linear regression.
6ebb317f053fc10e94b808710296610800039698.data: Monthly precipitation records from stations in Jordan.
6ebb317f053fc10e94b808710296610800039698.result: Neural network models give better monthly precipitation forecasts than linear regression.
6ebb317f053fc10e94b808710296610800039698.open_work: Add large-scale climate predictors and test longer horizons.
6ebb317f053fc10e94b808710296610800039698.issues: Monthly precipitation in arid areas is highly variable; skill likely limited.

45eaf2aeac17372f7ffd7bdd8ef2086b0a9ff8dc.goal: Evaluates statistical procedures for radar-based short-term quantitative precipitation forecasting over a large sample of events.
45eaf2aeac17372f7ffd7bdd8ef2086b0a9ff8dc.architecture: Statistical nowcasting methods, including advection-based extrapolation and neural networks.
45eaf2aeac17372f7ffd7bdd8ef2086b0a9ff8dc.data: WSR-88D radar rainfall data from Oklahoma (Tulsa radar) over many storms.
45eaf2aeac17372f7ffd7bdd8ef2086b0a9ff8dc.result: Advection-based extrapolation provides most of the skill; neural networks give only modest improvements.
45eaf2aeac17372f7ffd7bdd8ef2086b0a9ff8dc.issues: Short lead times only; limited gains from statistical methods.

91ec2d28a768e00d72bd5a16ae96e741eac07ac7.goal: Forecasts 24-hour-ahead solar power generation of a 20 kW PV system for microgrid energy management.
91ec2d28a768e00d72bd5a16ae96e741eac07ac7.architecture: MLP, radial basis function and recurrent neural networks and an ensemble of bagged neural networks.
91ec2d28a768e00d72bd5a16ae96e741eac07ac7.data: Measurements from a 20 kW photovoltaic system.
91ec2d28a768e00d72bd5a16ae96e741eac07ac7.result: All networks achieve acceptable accuracy; the bagged ensemble is most precise due to diversity.
91ec2d28a768e00d72bd5a16ae96e741eac07ac7.open_work: Integrate weather forecast inputs and test other sites.
91ec2d28a768e00d72bd5a16ae96e741eac07ac7.issues: Single PV system; limited evaluation period.

6e258ba7ba570c88235bdc00ed67398e951bafaa.goal: Predicts daily precipitation by combining wavelet decomposition with neural networks.
6e258ba7ba570c88235bdc00ed67398e951bafaa.architecture: Wavelet-neural network: discrete wavelet transform subseries as inputs to a feedforward neural network (MLP).
6e258ba7ba570c88235bdc00ed67398e951bafaa.data: Daily precipitation records from stations in Turkey.
6e258ba7ba570c88235bdc00ed67398e951bafaa.result: The wavelet-neural network improves daily precipitation predictions over a conventional neural network.
6e258ba7ba570c88235bdc00ed67398e951bafaa.open_work: Test with exogenous inputs and longer horizons.
6e258ba7ba570c88235bdc00ed67398e951bafaa.issues: Wavelet decomposition must avoid future information; extreme events remain hard to predict.

b2cec66cbee98229d9b1654c8007c0bf46260077.goal: Accounts for uncertainty in conceptual rainfall-runoff models using fuzzy approaches.
b2cec66cbee98229d9b1654c8007c0bf46260077.architecture: Fuzzy conceptual rainfall-runoff models based on fuzzy regression; not a neural network.
b2cec66cbee98229d9b1654c8007c0bf46260077.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a catchment.
b2cec66cbee98229d9b1654c8007c0bf46260077.result: Fuzzy conceptual models represent prediction uncertainty with performance comparable to deterministic calibration.
b2cec66cbee98229d9b1654c8007c0bf46260077.open_work: Extend to multi-objective calibration and other catchments.
b2cec66cbee98229d9b1654c8007c0bf46260077.issues: Small catchment set; choice of fuzzy membership functions is subjective.

534057883977473ea793ccd0fdaae04a8b8bfa8f.goal: Reviews neural networks for emulating complex mappings in atmospheric and oceanic sciences.
534057883977473ea793ccd0fdaae04a8b8bfa8f.architecture: Review of MLP neural network emulations for satellite retrieval algorithms and numerical model physics.
534057883977473ea793ccd0fdaae04a8b8bfa8f.data: Review; covers satellite retrievals (e.g., SSM/I ocean surface wind speed) and model physics such as NCAR CAM radiation.
534057883977473ea793ccd0fdaae04a8b8bfa8f.result: NN emulations accelerate computations by orders of magnitude while preserving accuracy.
534057883977473ea793ccd0fdaae04a8b8bfa8f.open_work: Uncertainty estimation, extrapolation and stability when coupled to models.

49ee84a1449ef0bc6361ca8608e4fc369a92546d.goal: Predicts spatial distribution of air pollution in GIS.
49ee84a1449ef0bc6361ca8608e4fc369a92546d.architecture: Fuzzy genetic linear membership kriging: kriging with fuzzy membership functions optimized by a genetic algorithm.
49ee84a1449ef0bc6361ca8608e4fc369a92546d.data: Air pollution monitoring station data in Tehran, Iran.
49ee84a1449ef0bc6361ca8608e4fc369a92546d.result: The method improves spatial prediction accuracy over standard kriging.

a6ff187887db578aff9d2dbdc8cc2c9f1cddf3fc.goal: Models and predicts rainfall using artificial neural networks and ARIMA.
a6ff187887db578aff9d2dbdc8cc2c9f1cddf3fc.architecture: Artificial neural network compared with ARIMA time-series models.
a6ff187887db578aff9d2dbdc8cc2c9f1cddf3fc.data: Rainfall records; location not reported in the available information.
a6ff187887db578aff9d2dbdc8cc2c9f1cddf3fc.result: Comparison of the ANN and ARIMA predictions; result not reported in the available information.
a6ff187887db578aff9d2dbdc8cc2c9f1cddf3fc.open_work: Not reported in the available information.

1f979ea7bd67d1d9408af50f3bbc1867ece0a6ce.goal: Assesses eight real-time updating models for daily discharge forecasts on the Brosna River, Ireland.
1f979ea7bd67d1d9408af50f3bbc1867ece0a6ce.architecture: Updating models incl. AR, neural network updating (NNU), linear transfer function and neural NARX models, applied to SMAR conceptual model output.
1f979ea7bd67d1d9408af50f3bbc1867ece0a6ce.data: Daily rainfall, evaporation and discharge from the Brosna catchment (1207 km2), Ireland.
1f979ea7bd67d1d9408af50f3bbc1867ece0a6ce.result: All models give good 1-day forecasts (R2 near 90%+); only NARXM, LTF and NNU remain suitable at 6-day lead.
1f979ea7bd67d1d9408af50f3bbc1867ece0a6ce.open_work: Use actual rainfall forecasts instead of perfect forecasts.
1f979ea7bd67d1d9408af50f3bbc1867ece0a6ce.issues: Perfect forecast of input assumption; single catchment.

a3245d4e40ec72d73cd6029893e73a7204001a3e.goal: Interpolates monthly climatic variables over complex terrain.
a3245d4e40ec72d73cd6029893e73a7204001a3e.architecture: Artificial neural networks (specific type not specified in the available information) using geographic coordinates, altitude and time as inputs.
a3245d4e40ec72d73cd6029893e73a7204001a3e.data: Monthly meteorological station data over Croatia.
a3245d4e40ec72d73cd6029893e73a7204001a3e.result: Neural networks interpolate climatic variables with good accuracy across complex terrain.
a3245d4e40ec72d73cd6029893e73a7204001a3e.open_work: Add terrain-derived predictors and compare with geostatistics.
a3245d4e40ec72d73cd6029893e73a7204001a3e.issues: Station density limits accuracy in mountains.

08cc5d56f1502b90ec55085ee8f86dd8b3ee6f75.goal: Identifies synoptic patterns causing heavy rainfall in the Japanese rainy season.
08cc5d56f1502b90ec55085ee8f86dd8b3ee6f75.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) clustering of synoptic atmospheric fields.
08cc5d56f1502b90ec55085ee8f86dd8b3ee6f75.data: Reanalysis atmospheric fields and rainfall observations in Japan (Kyushu) during the Baiu season.
08cc5d56f1502b90ec55085ee8f86dd8b3ee6f75.result: The SOM identifies typical patterns associated with heavy rainfall, linked to moisture flux.
08cc5d56f1502b90ec55085ee8f86dd8b3ee6f75.open_work: Use the patterns for heavy rainfall forecasting from model output.
08cc5d56f1502b90ec55085ee8f86dd8b3ee6f75.issues: Pattern identification is descriptive; sensitivity to SOM size.

2623b4fd15222707fbfe0b581d892e1e1cdadc9f.goal: Downscales multisite daily rainfall occurrence from large-scale atmospheric predictors while preserving spatial dependence between stations.
2623b4fd15222707fbfe0b581d892e1e1cdadc9f.architecture: Nonhomogeneous hidden Markov model whose state and occurrence probabilities are estimated nonparametrically (kernel-density based) instead of parametric distributions; a statistical non-deep-learning method.
2623b4fd15222707fbfe0b581d892e1e1cdadc9f.data: Multisite daily rain-gauge records with reanalysis-derived atmospheric predictors; the station network and period are not reported here.
2623b4fd15222707fbfe0b581d892e1e1cdadc9f.result: The nonparametric NHMM reproduces at-site and spatial rainfall occurrence statistics comparably to or better than parametric alternatives; detailed scores are not reported here.
2623b4fd15222707fbfe0b581d892e1e1cdadc9f.open_work: Extending the framework to rainfall amounts and applying it to GCM predictors for climate change projections.
2623b4fd15222707fbfe0b581d892e1e1cdadc9f.issues: Covers occurrences only; nonparametric estimation needs long records and may extrapolate poorly under predictors outside the observed range.

5ec4d331e620ec57c61976eb74a083130e880792.goal: Predicts the persistence and transitions of large-scale atmospheric weather regimes, testing whether statistical learning can extend regime predictability.
5ec4d331e620ec57c61976eb74a083130e880792.architecture: Statistical learning classifiers, including random forests and nearest-neighbour (analogue) methods, applied to regime prediction.
5ec4d331e620ec57c61976eb74a083130e880792.data: Long simulations of a quasi-geostrophic atmospheric model with identified weather regimes; observational validation details are not reported here.
5ec4d331e620ec57c61976eb74a083130e880792.result: Statistical learning gives some skill in predicting regime breaks and transitions beyond climatology; quantitative scores are not reported here.
5ec4d331e620ec57c61976eb74a083130e880792.open_work: Applying the approach to reanalysis data and operational models and identifying physical precursors of regime transitions.
5ec4d331e620ec57c61976eb74a083130e880792.issues: Working-paper version; skill mainly demonstrated in an idealized model, so transfer to the real atmosphere is uncertain.

9d02c2739908da156d7ed6cc3ec7f37a2e307d45.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed and wind farm power generation to support grid operation with wind energy.
9d02c2739908da156d7ed6cc3ec7f37a2e307d45.architecture: Fuzzy expert system (fuzzy rule-based model) mapping recent wind measurements to future wind speed and power; learning details not reported here.
9d02c2739908da156d7ed6cc3ec7f37a2e307d45.data: Wind speed and power records from wind farm sites; locations and periods are not reported here.
9d02c2739908da156d7ed6cc3ec7f37a2e307d45.result: The fuzzy system improves short-term forecasts over persistence according to the title's framing; quantitative results are not reported here.
9d02c2739908da156d7ed6cc3ec7f37a2e307d45.open_work: Longer horizons, inclusion of NWP inputs and testing at more sites.
9d02c2739908da156d7ed6cc3ec7f37a2e307d45.issues: Conference paper with limited site coverage; no uncertainty quantification reported.

71a393d57496b55f06ecc9b2ebd6a7904dfd0fe3.goal: Forecasts short-term reservoir or river inflow to support real-time water management and flood operations.
71a393d57496b55f06ecc9b2ebd6a7904dfd0fe3.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward type) relating antecedent rainfall and flow to future inflow; configuration details not reported here.
71a393d57496b55f06ecc9b2ebd6a7904dfd0fe3.data: Hydrological records of rainfall and inflow for a catchment; site and period not reported here.
71a393d57496b55f06ecc9b2ebd6a7904dfd0fe3.result: The ANN provides useful short-term inflow forecasts; quantitative comparison with other models is not reported here.
71a393d57496b55f06ecc9b2ebd6a7904dfd0fe3.open_work: Longer lead times, quantitative precipitation forecast inputs and comparison with conceptual models.
71a393d57496b55f06ecc9b2ebd6a7904dfd0fe3.issues: Single-catchment, data-driven model with limited physical interpretability and uncertain extrapolation to extreme events.

70c688bd7c5ad5b612e65647f28289ab113f618b.goal: Estimates daily solar radiation from routinely measured meteorological variables and identifies the best input combination and training length.
70c688bd7c5ad5b612e65647f28289ab113f618b.architecture: Gamma test used for input and data-length selection, followed by data-driven models such as artificial neural networks and local linear regression.
70c688bd7c5ad5b612e65647f28289ab113f618b.data: Daily meteorological and solar radiation records from the Brue catchment, southwest England.
70c688bd7c5ad5b612e65647f28289ab113f618b.result: The gamma test efficiently identifies informative inputs and adequate training length, giving accurate solar radiation estimates; numbers not reported here.
70c688bd7c5ad5b612e65647f28289ab113f618b.open_work: Testing the gamma test selection procedure in other climates and for other hydrometeorological variables.
70c688bd7c5ad5b612e65647f28289ab113f618b.issues: Single catchment in a temperate climate; generality of selected inputs is unproven.

c070945d98bb5d3e0a83811f5adf403b5d660c8d.goal: Models river suspended sediment concentration or load, which is costly to measure, from flow data.
c070945d98bb5d3e0a83811f5adf403b5d660c8d.architecture: Fuzzy logic (fuzzy rule-based) model compared with conventional sediment rating curves.
c070945d98bb5d3e0a83811f5adf403b5d660c8d.data: Observed streamflow and suspended sediment records from gauging stations; sites not reported here.
c070945d98bb5d3e0a83811f5adf403b5d660c8d.result: The fuzzy logic approach estimates suspended sediment better than rating curves according to the comparison; numbers not reported here.
c070945d98bb5d3e0a83811f5adf403b5d660c8d.open_work: Comparison with neural networks and neuro-fuzzy models and testing at more rivers.
c070945d98bb5d3e0a83811f5adf403b5d660c8d.issues: Fuzzy rules and membership functions are partly subjective; single-site calibration limits transferability.

8fb0fc247595027e91a386d9d584ec010c82f6ac.goal: Simulates flood flows along a river reach and improves the ability of neural networks to generalize and extrapolate beyond the range of training data.
8fb0fc247595027e91a386d9d584ec010c82f6ac.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) trained by backpropagation with Levenberg-Marquardt; different activation functions tested for generalization.
8fb0fc247595027e91a386d9d584ec010c82f6ac.data: Three flood events on the Neckar River, Germany: observed station flows plus 1-D hydrodynamic model simulations where no measurements exist.
8fb0fc247595027e91a386d9d584ec010c82f6ac.result: A suitably configured ANN can extend simulation capability to some extent beyond the range of the calibrated data.
8fb0fc247595027e91a386d9d584ec010c82f6ac.open_work: More flood events, systematic extrapolation tests and coupling with hydrodynamic models.
8fb0fc247595027e91a386d9d584ec010c82f6ac.issues: Only three events; extrapolation is limited and partly relies on simulated rather than observed flows.

03ab821b2443d4dbeb4380020f40ca383641cf6b.goal: Compares statistical and machine learning methodologies for probabilistic quantitative precipitation forecasts from NWP output.
03ab821b2443d4dbeb4380020f40ca383641cf6b.architecture: Linear regression, logistic regression, artificial neural network and a classifier system used as MOS-type post-processing methods.
03ab821b2443d4dbeb4380020f40ca383641cf6b.data: NWP model output and station precipitation observations over the United States; exact model and station set not detailed here.
03ab821b2443d4dbeb4380020f40ca383641cf6b.result: Logistic regression performs better than linear regression for probability of precipitation exceeding thresholds, with neural network and classifier system competitive; numbers not reported here.
03ab821b2443d4dbeb4380020f40ca383641cf6b.open_work: Testing with other NWP models, more thresholds and longer lead times.
03ab821b2443d4dbeb4380020f40ca383641cf6b.issues: Single-period comparison; results depend on predictor selection and the NWP model used.

f54b04b072cf965871e2436eb5a061b7833aa9bc.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from pan evaporation in a semi-arid environment where full Penman-Monteith inputs may be lacking.
f54b04b072cf965871e2436eb5a061b7833aa9bc.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) relating pan evaporation and meteorological variables to reference evapotranspiration, compared with pan-coefficient methods.
f54b04b072cf965871e2436eb5a061b7833aa9bc.data: Pan evaporation and meteorological records from semi-arid stations; reference values from FAO-56 Penman-Monteith; sites not reported here.
f54b04b072cf965871e2436eb5a061b7833aa9bc.result: The ANN estimates reference evapotranspiration more accurately than empirical pan-coefficient equations; numbers not reported here.
f54b04b072cf965871e2436eb5a061b7833aa9bc.open_work: Validation in other climates and with fewer input variables.
f54b04b072cf965871e2436eb5a061b7833aa9bc.issues: Limited sites in one climate; targets are themselves Penman-Monteith estimates, not lysimeter measurements.

9523e9f9f8073530e0a5404d0dcdd031c1eb3593.goal: Tests whether nonlinear neural networks add skill over linear methods for seasonal prediction of equatorial Pacific SST.
9523e9f9f8073530e0a5404d0dcdd031c1eb3593.architecture: Feed-forward neural network compared with canonical correlation analysis and linear regression.
9523e9f9f8073530e0a5404d0dcdd031c1eb3593.data: Equatorial Pacific SST indices (Nino1+2, Nino3, Nino3.4, Nino4) with large-scale predictor fields; cross-validated evaluation.
9523e9f9f8073530e0a5404d0dcdd031c1eb3593.result: Neural network skill is comparable to linear regression and CCA; differences are not significant at the 5% level, suggesting nearly linear seasonal dynamics.
9523e9f9f8073530e0a5404d0dcdd031c1eb3593.open_work: Exploring nonlinear methods at other time scales and with longer records where nonlinearity may matter.
9523e9f9f8073530e0a5404d0dcdd031c1eb3593.issues: Short records limit neural network training and the power of significance tests.

0f817a77a96eca93be09e06eeea4e9cf96d17e91.goal: Classifies cloud types in satellite imagery automatically to support weather analysis.
0f817a77a96eca93be09e06eeea4e9cf96d17e91.architecture: Multifeature texture analysis (several texture feature sets) with self-organizing map neural networks and k-nearest neighbour classifiers, including combinations of classifiers.
0f817a77a96eca93be09e06eeea4e9cf96d17e91.data: Meteosat satellite images with expert-labelled cloud types, mainly over the eastern Mediterranean region.
0f817a77a96eca93be09e06eeea4e9cf96d17e91.result: Combining multiple texture feature sets improves cloud classification accuracy over single feature sets; exact accuracies not reported here.
0f817a77a96eca93be09e06eeea4e9cf96d17e91.open_work: Adding spectral channels and larger labelled datasets for more cloud classes.
0f817a77a96eca93be09e06eeea4e9cf96d17e91.issues: Small expert-labelled sample and texture-only features; class confusion among similar cloud types.

69804816498dc6ef9656405c4a71c295749e6451.goal: Forecasts storm surge sea levels to support coastal flood warning.
69804816498dc6ef9656405c4a71c295749e6451.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) relating meteorological and sea-level predictors to future surge; configuration not reported here.
69804816498dc6ef9656405c4a71c295749e6451.data: Tide gauge sea-level and meteorological records from the southern Baltic Polish coast.
69804816498dc6ef9656405c4a71c295749e6451.result: The ANN gives useful storm surge forecasts; quantitative skill not reported here.
69804816498dc6ef9656405c4a71c295749e6451.open_work: Longer lead times and use of NWP wind and pressure forecasts as inputs.
69804816498dc6ef9656405c4a71c295749e6451.issues: Few extreme surge events available for training; single-region model.

525d770d2b4624790a80a48fdea6f6c20ea13b7a.goal: Predicts air pollutant levels in central Hong Kong to support air quality forecasting.
525d770d2b4624790a80a48fdea6f6c20ea13b7a.architecture: Feed-forward neural network trained with particle swarm optimization instead of backpropagation.
525d770d2b4624790a80a48fdea6f6c20ea13b7a.data: Monitoring station records of air pollutants and meteorological variables in central Hong Kong.
525d770d2b4624790a80a48fdea6f6c20ea13b7a.result: PSO-trained networks converge faster and predict pollutant levels more accurately than backpropagation-trained networks; numbers not reported here.
525d770d2b4624790a80a48fdea6f6c20ea13b7a.open_work: Testing other pollutants, stations and longer horizons.
525d770d2b4624790a80a48fdea6f6c20ea13b7a.issues: Single urban area; limited evaluation of extreme pollution episodes.

4e5a9cf229a839eb9d3191430d7895b5087723b6.goal: Simulates runoff in a humid forested catchment where physical models are data-demanding.
4e5a9cf229a839eb9d3191430d7895b5087723b6.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) relating rainfall and antecedent conditions to runoff.
4e5a9cf229a839eb9d3191430d7895b5087723b6.data: Rainfall and runoff observations from a humid forest catchment in Japan.
4e5a9cf229a839eb9d3191430d7895b5087723b6.result: The ANN reproduces runoff behaviour of the catchment well; numbers not reported here.
4e5a9cf229a839eb9d3191430d7895b5087723b6.open_work: Comparison with conceptual models and analysis of what the network learned about runoff processes.
4e5a9cf229a839eb9d3191430d7895b5087723b6.issues: Single small catchment; black-box model with limited physical insight.

f72e49ce9651cc450d6db88ab91b8bdaad35bd44.goal: Constrains climate model response to greenhouse gas forcing (climate sensitivity) using a perturbed-physics ensemble and identifies key subgrid-scale parameters.
f72e49ce9651cc450d6db88ab91b8bdaad35bd44.architecture: Neural network emulator of model climatology and response as a function of perturbed parameters, combined with comparison to observations.
f72e49ce9651cc450d6db88ab91b8bdaad35bd44.data: Perturbed-physics ensemble from the climateprediction.net project (HadSM3 slab model) and observational climatologies.
f72e49ce9651cc450d6db88ab91b8bdaad35bd44.result: Observational constraints narrow plausible climate sensitivity, with subgrid-scale parameters such as entrainment strongly controlling the response; exact ranges not reported here.
f72e49ce9651cc450d6db88ab91b8bdaad35bd44.open_work: Extending to fully coupled models and more parameters and observations.
f72e49ce9651cc450d6db88ab91b8bdaad35bd44.issues: Results tied to one model structure; emulator error and choice of observational metrics affect constraints.

994f0957c934145b151b0d8208e5372619b42a46.goal: Quantifies uncertainty in streamflow simulation with data-driven models.
994f0957c934145b151b0d8208e5372619b42a46.architecture: Bayesian neural networks with posterior sampling by Markov chain Monte Carlo (evolutionary Monte Carlo) to produce predictive intervals.
994f0957c934145b151b0d8208e5372619b42a46.data: Daily streamflow and meteorological data from US watersheds; comparison against a process-based model; details not reported here.
994f0957c934145b151b0d8208e5372619b42a46.result: Bayesian neural networks give accurate streamflow simulations with reasonable uncertainty intervals; numbers not reported here.
994f0957c934145b151b0d8208e5372619b42a46.open_work: Separating input, parameter and structural uncertainty and applying to forecasting.
994f0957c934145b151b0d8208e5372619b42a46.issues: Computationally demanding sampling; intervals depend on priors and network size.

96fe009d7e400eaba6a18bcb5d33ca7a597d4f7b.goal: Recognizes cloud types automatically from ground-based sky images.
96fe009d7e400eaba6a18bcb5d33ca7a597d4f7b.architecture: Texture feature extraction methods (e.g. co-occurrence, autocorrelation, edge frequency) with k-nearest neighbour and neural network classifiers.
96fe009d7e400eaba6a18bcb5d33ca7a597d4f7b.data: Ground-based digital sky images labelled by cloud type; size of dataset not reported here.
96fe009d7e400eaba6a18bcb5d33ca7a597d4f7b.result: Texture features allow automated discrimination of cloud types with moderate accuracy; numbers not reported here.
96fe009d7e400eaba6a18bcb5d33ca7a597d4f7b.open_work: Larger image sets and more cloud classes; combining colour and texture.
96fe009d7e400eaba6a18bcb5d33ca7a597d4f7b.issues: Small dataset and visual labels; sensitivity to illumination conditions.

4f4ac05ab9ed10617382624ea35291cde220d781.goal: Develops long-lead operational drought forecasts for the Murray-Darling Basin, Australia.
4f4ac05ab9ed10617382624ea35291cde220d781.architecture: Self-organizing maps to identify climate patterns and wavelet analysis, combined with artificial neural networks for forecasting drought index values.
4f4ac05ab9ed10617382624ea35291cde220d781.data: Standardized Precipitation Index over the Murray-Darling Basin with sea surface temperature and climate index predictors.
4f4ac05ab9ed10617382624ea35291cde220d781.result: The approach yields skillful drought forecasts at long leads (up to about a year); quantitative scores not reported here.
4f4ac05ab9ed10617382624ea35291cde220d781.open_work: Operational implementation and extension to other basins and drought indices.
4f4ac05ab9ed10617382624ea35291cde220d781.issues: Short observational records for training at long leads; risk of overfitting predictor patterns.

0e54b531adbf423a87e0d7e42224203d17b0495a.goal: Simulates regional groundwater levels affected by pumping and irrigation in an arid basin.
0e54b531adbf423a87e0d7e42224203d17b0495a.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward, backpropagation) with human activity variables as inputs.
0e54b531adbf423a87e0d7e42224203d17b0495a.data: Groundwater level, pumping and climate records from an arid inland basin in northwest China (Minqin).
0e54b531adbf423a87e0d7e42224203d17b0495a.result: The ANN simulates groundwater level changes well and can assess impacts of human activities; numbers not reported here.
0e54b531adbf423a87e0d7e42224203d17b0495a.open_work: Scenario analysis of water management options and coupling with physically based models.
0e54b531adbf423a87e0d7e42224203d17b0495a.issues: Data-driven extrapolation under new management scenarios is uncertain; regional, single-basin study.

53f7fec39f06460a61dad80e399ec73c26f03562.goal: Estimates runoff coefficients and runoff from rainfall using fuzzy logic instead of fixed coefficients.
53f7fec39f06460a61dad80e399ec73c26f03562.architecture: Fuzzy logic (fuzzy rule-based) model compared with classical approaches.
53f7fec39f06460a61dad80e399ec73c26f03562.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a catchment; details not reported here.
53f7fec39f06460a61dad80e399ec73c26f03562.result: The fuzzy approach estimates runoff better than conventional methods; numbers not reported here.
53f7fec39f06460a61dad80e399ec73c26f03562.open_work: Testing on more catchments and with additional inputs.
53f7fec39f06460a61dad80e399ec73c26f03562.issues: Subjective rule and membership design; limited validation.

670e1cba750a8f2f5b760116608eaf7e407f0abb.goal: Identifies when satellite ocean colour inputs lie outside the range of the data used to build empirical bio-optical algorithms, flagging unreliable retrievals.
670e1cba750a8f2f5b760116608eaf7e407f0abb.architecture: Novelty detection technique estimating the data density of the training set to define the range of applicability of empirical (including neural network) ocean colour algorithms.
670e1cba750a8f2f5b760116608eaf7e407f0abb.data: In situ bio-optical measurements (e.g. from the northern Adriatic Sea) and SeaWiFS remote sensing reflectances.
670e1cba750a8f2f5b760116608eaf7e407f0abb.result: Novelty detection effectively flags inputs outside the training domain where algorithm errors are larger; numbers not reported here.
670e1cba750a8f2f5b760116608eaf7e407f0abb.open_work: Operational application to global satellite data and use for guiding new in situ data collection.
670e1cba750a8f2f5b760116608eaf7e407f0abb.issues: Depends on representativeness of in situ datasets; threshold choice affects flagging.

80cfc524ef0a1df540c6d0c7aa5726aee8ad9ef3.goal: Examines how the amount and type of calibration data affects multistep-ahead streamflow forecasting with conceptual and neural network models.
80cfc524ef0a1df540c6d0c7aa5726aee8ad9ef3.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural networks compared with a conceptual rainfall-runoff model.
80cfc524ef0a1df540c6d0c7aa5726aee8ad9ef3.data: Hourly rainfall and streamflow from an Italian catchment (Sieve River) with calibration sets of different lengths.
80cfc524ef0a1df540c6d0c7aa5726aee8ad9ef3.result: ANNs perform well with long calibration records but degrade more than the conceptual model when calibration data are short; numbers not reported here.
80cfc524ef0a1df540c6d0c7aa5726aee8ad9ef3.open_work: Hybrid conceptual and data-driven approaches for data-scarce basins.
80cfc524ef0a1df540c6d0c7aa5726aee8ad9ef3.issues: Single catchment; conclusions depend on the specific conceptual model used.

6a7383375f3c47d3a576ef33fee3cfad4a9bf46f.goal: Estimates river flow at a downstream site from upstream flow records, useful for infilling or forecasting.
6a7383375f3c47d3a576ef33fee3cfad4a9bf46f.architecture: Artificial intelligence methods including artificial neural networks; exact variants compared are not specified here.
6a7383375f3c47d3a576ef33fee3cfad4a9bf46f.data: Upstream and downstream flow records from gauging stations in Turkey; details not reported here.
6a7383375f3c47d3a576ef33fee3cfad4a9bf46f.result: Artificial intelligence methods give accurate downstream flow estimates; numbers not reported here.
6a7383375f3c47d3a576ef33fee3cfad4a9bf46f.open_work: Testing in other river systems and with additional inputs.
6a7383375f3c47d3a576ef33fee3cfad4a9bf46f.issues: Limited stations and no uncertainty estimates.

d38fb4407a04cc25fb7c10b0dc4fb2d2d8a38729.goal: Infills missing streamflow records, needed for hydrological analysis and design.
d38fb4407a04cc25fb7c10b0dc4fb2d2d8a38729.architecture: Groups-based (pattern/grouping) infilling procedures and artificial neural network based infilling.
d38fb4407a04cc25fb7c10b0dc4fb2d2d8a38729.data: Streamflow records with artificially created gaps from Canadian rivers; details not reported here.
d38fb4407a04cc25fb7c10b0dc4fb2d2d8a38729.result: Both procedures reconstruct missing flows reasonably, with ANN-based infilling performing well; numbers not reported here.
d38fb4407a04cc25fb7c10b0dc4fb2d2d8a38729.open_work: Handling long gaps and multiple-station inputs.
d38fb4407a04cc25fb7c10b0dc4fb2d2d8a38729.issues: Evaluation on synthetic gaps; performance for extreme flows uncertain.

4303ce28933fc1f5ca8e95e342edc051f42bea0f.goal: Forecasts typhoon-induced storm surges along the Taiwan coast for coastal hazard warning.
4303ce28933fc1f5ca8e95e342edc051f42bea0f.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward, backpropagation) using typhoon characteristics as inputs.
4303ce28933fc1f5ca8e95e342edc051f42bea0f.data: Typhoon parameters (e.g. pressure, wind, position) and tide gauge surge records in Taiwan.
4303ce28933fc1f5ca8e95e342edc051f42bea0f.result: The ANN forecasts surge heights with useful accuracy a few hours ahead; numbers not reported here.
4303ce28933fc1f5ca8e95e342edc051f42bea0f.open_work: More typhoon events and longer lead times.
4303ce28933fc1f5ca8e95e342edc051f42bea0f.issues: Limited number of typhoons for training; surge extremes poorly sampled.

fdc703f03b78b8da70316f49a27cfe44162e279d.goal: Assesses uncertainty of statistical downscaling methods for daily precipitation and temperature.
fdc703f03b78b8da70316f49a27cfe44162e279d.architecture: Comparison of SDSM (regression-based), LARS-WG (stochastic weather generator) and an artificial neural network downscaling model.
fdc703f03b78b8da70316f49a27cfe44162e279d.data: Station observations in northern Quebec, Canada (Chute-du-Diable basin), with NCEP reanalysis and CGCM1 predictors.
fdc703f03b78b8da70316f49a27cfe44162e279d.result: SDSM reproduces observed statistics with least uncertainty, while the ANN shows larger deviations especially for precipitation; numbers not reported here.
fdc703f03b78b8da70316f49a27cfe44162e279d.open_work: Including more GCMs and downscaling methods to characterise total uncertainty.
fdc703f03b78b8da70316f49a27cfe44162e279d.issues: One basin and one GCM; uncertainty assessed mainly through statistic reproduction.

6c95432f6e90eb0fef410bc251bff70f055a4ea0.goal: Designs global precipitation retrievals from millimeter-wave satellite sounders using a cloud-resolving NWP model as training truth.
6c95432f6e90eb0fef410bc251bff70f055a4ea0.architecture: Neural network retrieval estimators trained on simulated radiances and precipitation.
6c95432f6e90eb0fef410bc251bff70f055a4ea0.data: MM5 cloud-resolving simulations of about 122 global storms with radiative transfer for AMSU-A/B (and AMSU-like) channels.
6c95432f6e90eb0fef410bc251bff70f055a4ea0.result: The trained networks retrieve precipitation rate and related variables with good agreement with model truth; numbers not reported here.
6c95432f6e90eb0fef410bc251bff70f055a4ea0.open_work: Validation against observations (Part II) and extension to other sensors.
6c95432f6e90eb0fef410bc251bff70f055a4ea0.issues: Training truth is model-based, so retrievals inherit model microphysics biases.

c0471efe8b38b86d7aa1fe4bf08be77ed61ca11b.goal: Predicts monthly total solar irradiation at sites without radiation measurements.
c0471efe8b38b86d7aa1fe4bf08be77ed61ca11b.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) using meteorological and geographic inputs.
c0471efe8b38b86d7aa1fe4bf08be77ed61ca11b.data: Meteorological data (e.g. sunshine duration, temperature, cloud cover) and solar irradiation measurements from stations in Uganda.
c0471efe8b38b86d7aa1fe4bf08be77ed61ca11b.result: The ANN predicts solar irradiation with high correlation to measurements; numbers not reported here.
c0471efe8b38b86d7aa1fe4bf08be77ed61ca11b.open_work: Expanding station network and testing at daily scale.

a7b561258ed3ff1757f9d76e2a7a7bcccbe44ba9.goal: Estimates daily suspended sediment in natural streams, which is expensive to measure.
a7b561258ed3ff1757f9d76e2a7a7bcccbe44ba9.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) compared with conventional methods.
a7b561258ed3ff1757f9d76e2a7a7bcccbe44ba9.data: Daily hydrometeorological and suspended sediment data from natural streams; sites not reported here.
a7b561258ed3ff1757f9d76e2a7a7bcccbe44ba9.result: The ANN estimates daily suspended sediment more accurately than conventional approaches; numbers not reported here.
a7b561258ed3ff1757f9d76e2a7a7bcccbe44ba9.open_work: Testing at more rivers and including additional hydrological predictors.
a7b561258ed3ff1757f9d76e2a7a7bcccbe44ba9.issues: Limited data; extreme sediment events poorly represented.

4c7ee73bf4024fef1d5cf8df976062b7076225aa.goal: Models rainfall-runoff transformation in a typical urban basin.
