4c7ee73bf4024fef1d5cf8df976062b7076225aa.architecture: Artificial neural networks and genetic programming compared.
4c7ee73bf4024fef1d5cf8df976062b7076225aa.data: Rainfall and runoff records from an urban basin; details not reported here.
4c7ee73bf4024fef1d5cf8df976062b7076225aa.result: Both methods reproduce runoff, with genetic programming yielding explicit expressions; comparative numbers not reported here.
4c7ee73bf4024fef1d5cf8df976062b7076225aa.open_work: Further validation on more storms and basins.

4e214db7076f9ea6948c3577efc1f4897cd62697.goal: Improves daily reservoir inflow forecasts by combining multiple models.
4e214db7076f9ea6948c3577efc1f4897cd62697.architecture: Model combination of a nearest-neighbour model, a conceptual hydrological model and an artificial neural network with weighted averaging.
4e214db7076f9ea6948c3577efc1f4897cd62697.data: Daily inflow and meteorological data for a hydropower reservoir in Quebec, Canada.
4e214db7076f9ea6948c3577efc1f4897cd62697.result: Combined forecasts outperform each individual model; numbers not reported here.
4e214db7076f9ea6948c3577efc1f4897cd62697.open_work: Adaptive combination weights and probabilistic combination.
4e214db7076f9ea6948c3577efc1f4897cd62697.issues: One reservoir system; static weights may not suit changing conditions.

0a8805005a8ff0b4662af9ca13f23257abb0e6f3.goal: Compares ARIMA time series models and neural networks for short-term wind speed forecasting.
0a8805005a8ff0b4662af9ca13f23257abb0e6f3.architecture: ARIMA statistical model compared with feed-forward neural networks.
0a8805005a8ff0b4662af9ca13f23257abb0e6f3.data: Wind speed measurements from a wind monitoring site; details not reported here.
0a8805005a8ff0b4662af9ca13f23257abb0e6f3.result: ARIMA models perform as well as or better than neural networks for short horizons; numbers not reported here.
0a8805005a8ff0b4662af9ca13f23257abb0e6f3.issues: Single site and short period; conference-level evaluation.

a9cc129c552a4b236d941f126bca69718619cf75.goal: Forecasts daily water demand in irrigation districts equipped with telemetry systems to support operation.
a9cc129c552a4b236d941f126bca69718619cf75.architecture: Linear regression models compared with neural network approaches (feed-forward neural networks, including hybrid variants).
a9cc129c552a4b236d941f126bca69718619cf75.data: Daily water demand and climatic records from irrigation districts in southern Spain with telemetry.
a9cc129c552a4b236d941f126bca69718619cf75.result: Neural approaches forecast irrigation water demand more accurately than linear regressions; numbers not reported here.
a9cc129c552a4b236d941f126bca69718619cf75.open_work: Inclusion of crop and weather forecast information.
a9cc129c552a4b236d941f126bca69718619cf75.issues: Limited districts and seasons; demand depends on management decisions not captured.

d36a090c5cb44625528c779a1848481b2f37d7a3.goal: Provides probabilistic local weather (precipitation) forecasts that capture spatial dependencies among stations.
d36a090c5cb44625528c779a1848481b2f37d7a3.architecture: Bayesian networks learned from data, encoding dependencies among station variables and atmospheric predictors, with probabilistic inference.
d36a090c5cb44625528c779a1848481b2f37d7a3.data: Daily precipitation records from a network of stations in Spain with large-scale atmospheric predictors; details not reported here.
d36a090c5cb44625528c779a1848481b2f37d7a3.result: Bayesian networks produce skilful probabilistic forecasts and consistent spatial patterns; numbers not reported here.
d36a090c5cb44625528c779a1848481b2f37d7a3.open_work: Larger networks, more variables and operational use with NWP outputs.
d36a090c5cb44625528c779a1848481b2f37d7a3.issues: Learning structure is costly; discretization of variables loses information.

c20ad828315b15ee91d7bf7ef1626e7f08ee993d.goal: Extracts characteristic sea surface temperature patterns on the West Florida Shelf and their seasonal and interannual variability.
c20ad828315b15ee91d7bf7ef1626e7f08ee993d.architecture: Growing hierarchical self-organizing maps (GHSOM), an unsupervised neural network.
c20ad828315b15ee91d7bf7ef1626e7f08ee993d.data: Satellite AVHRR SST imagery over the West Florida Shelf.
c20ad828315b15ee91d7bf7ef1626e7f08ee993d.result: GHSOM identifies hierarchical SST patterns related to seasonal cycle and anomalies more flexibly than standard SOM; numbers not reported here.
c20ad828315b15ee91d7bf7ef1626e7f08ee993d.open_work: Linking patterns to forcing such as winds and heat flux.
c20ad828315b15ee91d7bf7ef1626e7f08ee993d.issues: Patterns depend on map size choices; cloud gaps in AVHRR data.

0c37df5c944f0b98b642a11f13b0c001e226c02d.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from climatic data with neural networks.
0c37df5c944f0b98b642a11f13b0c001e226c02d.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks (Levenberg-Marquardt) compared with empirical evapotranspiration equations.
0c37df5c944f0b98b642a11f13b0c001e226c02d.data: Daily climatic data from weather stations (California CIMIS network).
0c37df5c944f0b98b642a11f13b0c001e226c02d.result: Feed-forward neural networks estimate evapotranspiration better than empirical methods; numbers not reported here.
0c37df5c944f0b98b642a11f13b0c001e226c02d.open_work: Testing with fewer inputs and in other climates.
0c37df5c944f0b98b642a11f13b0c001e226c02d.issues: Few stations; targets are estimated values.

cb97c40a11a09aa01b7349c229ca36709ec289e0.goal: Generates synthetic streamflow sequences for water resources planning.
cb97c40a11a09aa01b7349c229ca36709ec289e0.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) compared with stochastic models such as Thomas-Fiering and ARMA.
cb97c40a11a09aa01b7349c229ca36709ec289e0.data: Monthly streamflow records from a river in India.
cb97c40a11a09aa01b7349c229ca36709ec289e0.result: The ANN reproduces streamflow statistics comparably or better than stochastic models; numbers not reported here.
cb97c40a11a09aa01b7349c229ca36709ec289e0.open_work: Multisite generation and preserving long-term persistence.

804a4d5e0fbf40d647d3675d9a4a34fbaa30d649.goal: Studies how missing data affects learning algorithms for hydrologic prediction and proposes an imputation technique.
804a4d5e0fbf40d647d3675d9a4a34fbaa30d649.architecture: Artificial neural networks and support vector machines compared; SVM-based imputation of missing data.
804a4d5e0fbf40d647d3675d9a4a34fbaa30d649.data: Hydrologic time series (soil moisture) with simulated missing data; details not reported here.
804a4d5e0fbf40d647d3675d9a4a34fbaa30d649.result: Missing data degrades performance and the proposed imputation restores much of the accuracy; numbers not reported here.
804a4d5e0fbf40d647d3675d9a4a34fbaa30d649.open_work: Testing imputation on other hydrologic variables.
804a4d5e0fbf40d647d3675d9a4a34fbaa30d649.issues: Synthetic missing-data scenarios may not reflect real gaps.

c4ba298e5adc7a16964a2a7e6fae8c6bc45d64dd.goal: Predicts flood events using time series data mining of river stage records.
c4ba298e5adc7a16964a2a7e6fae8c6bc45d64dd.architecture: Time series data mining (TSDM) identifying temporal patterns that precede events; a data mining method rather than a neural network.
c4ba298e5adc7a16964a2a7e6fae8c6bc45d64dd.data: River discharge or stage time series from the Mississippi River and other sites.
c4ba298e5adc7a16964a2a7e6fae8c6bc45d64dd.result: TSDM identifies precursor patterns that predict flood events with reasonable accuracy; numbers not reported here.
c4ba298e5adc7a16964a2a7e6fae8c6bc45d64dd.open_work: Longer lead times and more basins.
c4ba298e5adc7a16964a2a7e6fae8c6bc45d64dd.issues: Event definition thresholds affect results; limited validation.

7e0703e76ff886d430823b0f8a592f5396082003.goal: Analyzes nonlinear coupled variability of tropical Pacific SST and sea level pressure.
7e0703e76ff886d430823b0f8a592f5396082003.architecture: Nonlinear canonical correlation analysis (NLCCA) implemented with neural networks.
7e0703e76ff886d430823b0f8a592f5396082003.data: Tropical Pacific SST and sea level pressure anomaly fields.
7e0703e76ff886d430823b0f8a592f5396082003.result: NLCCA reveals nonlinear asymmetric modes between El Nino and La Nina not captured by linear CCA; numbers not reported here.
7e0703e76ff886d430823b0f8a592f5396082003.open_work: Applying NLCCA to forecasting and other climate fields.
7e0703e76ff886d430823b0f8a592f5396082003.issues: Neural network nonlinear methods are prone to overfitting with short records.

cae65ef18e96bef547836415153a610f4f949073.goal: Forecasts physical ocean parameters in real time in a complex, dynamic environment where the governing rules are unknown or fuzzy, aiming to beat purely connectionist or purely symbolic predictors.
cae65ef18e96bef547836415153a610f4f949073.architecture: Hybrid system that integrates a case-based reasoning system with a radial basis function (RBF) artificial neural network that adapts the retrieved cases into forecasts.
cae65ef18e96bef547836415153a610f4f949073.data: Real-time oceanographic measurements collected while the system operated at sea; specific instruments, regions and periods are not detailed in the abstract.
cae65ef18e96bef547836415153a610f4f949073.result: The hybrid case-based reasoning plus RBF network forecasts more effectively than either the connectionist or the symbolic technique used separately in real-time experiments.
cae65ef18e96bef547836415153a610f4f949073.open_work: Testing in more ocean regions and over longer deployments, and quantifying skill against physical ocean models, would establish generality.
cae65ef18e96bef547836415153a610f4f949073.issues: Evaluation details and error statistics are not given in the abstract; performance depends on case-base coverage of conditions seen before.

0a35956c9be41f75171be80eef5d282ef79d797c.goal: Develops a hybrid drought index that combines several drought indicators and predicts it to support drought monitoring and water management in a case-study region.
0a35956c9be41f75171be80eef5d282ef79d797c.architecture: Composite (hybrid) drought index with a prediction component; the specific predictive model type is not specified in the available metadata.
0a35956c9be41f75171be80eef5d282ef79d797c.data: Not reported in the abstract. No abstract is available.
0a35956c9be41f75171be80eef5d282ef79d797c.result: Not reported; no abstract is available for this paper.
0a35956c9be41f75171be80eef5d282ef79d797c.open_work: Transfer of the hybrid index to other climates and comparison with standard indices such as SPI and PDSI.
0a35956c9be41f75171be80eef5d282ef79d797c.issues: Card based on the title only; data, method details and skill are unknown.

9ae358ce283e25fc664c9f7efee1686b96b24183.goal: Automates identification and tracking of tropical cyclones in satellite imagery to support forecasting of their tracks.
9ae358ce283e25fc664c9f7efee1686b96b24183.architecture: Neural oscillatory elastic graph matching for cyclone pattern identification combined with a hybrid radial basis function (RBF) network for track mining, as named in the title.
9ae358ce283e25fc664c9f7efee1686b96b24183.data: Satellite cloud imagery of tropical cyclones; specific sensors and periods are not reported here (no abstract available).
9ae358ce283e25fc664c9f7efee1686b96b24183.result: Not reported; no abstract is available for this paper.
9ae358ce283e25fc664c9f7efee1686b96b24183.open_work: Evaluation on larger multi-season samples and comparison against operational track forecasts.
9ae358ce283e25fc664c9f7efee1686b96b24183.issues: Card based on the title only; accuracy figures and the size of the test set are unknown.

e0e7f709606fe3d7d14dc3e8476ffd1350f5ab6f.goal: Builds a climatology of the synoptic circulation patterns that drive precipitation over Greenland, relevant to ice-sheet mass balance.
e0e7f709606fe3d7d14dc3e8476ffd1350f5ab6f.architecture: Self-organizing maps (SOM) classify daily sea-level pressure fields into a set of synoptic patterns, which are then linked to precipitation; unsupervised neural clustering.
e0e7f709606fe3d7d14dc3e8476ffd1350f5ab6f.data: ERA-40 reanalysis sea-level pressure and precipitation over Greenland and the surrounding North Atlantic, 1961–99.
e0e7f709606fe3d7d14dc3e8476ffd1350f5ab6f.result: Distinct synoptic patterns, notably cyclones positioned near southern and southeastern Greenland, account for much of the precipitation; pattern frequencies explain seasonal and spatial precipitation variability.
e0e7f709606fe3d7d14dc3e8476ffd1350f5ab6f.open_work: Applying the SOM pattern framework to climate model simulations to assess future changes in Greenland precipitation.
e0e7f709606fe3d7d14dc3e8476ffd1350f5ab6f.issues: Relies on reanalysis precipitation, which carries model biases over the ice sheet where observations are sparse.

20b62e6eff843038e49fb878e9640ca00fffa7c4.goal: Provides real-time realizations of daily weather for the remainder of a season so crop models can forecast yields during the growing season.
20b62e6eff843038e49fb878e9640ca00fffa7c4.architecture: Weather analogue tool based on a modified k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) resampling approach that selects historical years similar to current conditions; non-parametric nonneural method.
20b62e6eff843038e49fb878e9640ca00fffa7c4.data: Historical daily weather station records (e.g. temperature, rainfall, solar radiation); stations and periods are not reported here (no abstract available).
20b62e6eff843038e49fb878e9640ca00fffa7c4.result: Not reported; no abstract is available for this paper.
20b62e6eff843038e49fb878e9640ca00fffa7c4.open_work: Conditioning the analogue selection on seasonal climate forecasts and evaluating crop-yield forecast skill.
20b62e6eff843038e49fb878e9640ca00fffa7c4.issues: Analogue resampling cannot produce conditions outside the historical record; card based on title and general knowledge.

e2accf37314111b38769866aa168fa64384789c8.goal: Classifies patterns of rainfall variability to characterize rainfall regimes using neural networks.
e2accf37314111b38769866aa168fa64384789c8.architecture: Artificial neural network classification of rainfall series; the specific network type is not specified in the available metadata.
e2accf37314111b38769866aa168fa64384789c8.data: Rainfall records from a regional station network; locations and periods are not reported here (no abstract available).
e2accf37314111b38769866aa168fa64384789c8.result: Not reported; no abstract is available for this paper.
e2accf37314111b38769866aa168fa64384789c8.open_work: Linking identified rainfall classes to large-scale circulation and testing stability over longer records.
e2accf37314111b38769866aa168fa64384789c8.issues: Card based on the title only; dataset, classes and validation are unknown.

6903a7357692d986670d1c231d0312470633a7a1.goal: Predicts tropospheric ozone concentration and identifies which meteorological and pollutant inputs are most relevant to the prediction.
6903a7357692d986670d1c231d0312470633a7a1.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network combined with input-relevance (sensitivity) analysis to rank predictor variables.
6903a7357692d986670d1c231d0312470633a7a1.data: Air-quality monitoring station records of ozone, other pollutants and meteorological variables; specific sites and periods are not reported here (no abstract available).
6903a7357692d986670d1c231d0312470633a7a1.result: Not reported in detail; the network yields ozone predictions and a ranking of the influence of input variables.
6903a7357692d986670d1c231d0312470633a7a1.open_work: Using the relevance ranking to build reduced models and transfer them to other stations.
6903a7357692d986670d1c231d0312470633a7a1.issues: Single-region station data; relevance measures from neural networks can be unstable across trainings. Card relies on title and limited knowledge.

151c5aab02ac034ede4c4247dfd627e46ef43f91.goal: Retrieves land surface skin temperature under all-weather conditions to evaluate differences between surface air and skin temperatures, including cloudy situations missed by infrared-only methods.
151c5aab02ac034ede4c4247dfd627e46ef43f91.architecture: Combined microwave and infrared inversion using a neural network retrieval scheme (developed by Aires and colleagues) to estimate skin temperature with other surface and atmospheric variables.
151c5aab02ac034ede4c4247dfd627e46ef43f91.data: SSM/I passive microwave and ISCCP infrared satellite observations, with surface air temperature from weather stations and reanalysis for comparison; global land.
151c5aab02ac034ede4c4247dfd627e46ef43f91.result: All-weather skin temperatures are obtained, and skin minus air temperature differences show coherent diurnal, seasonal and cloud-dependent behavior, differing between clear and cloudy conditions.
151c5aab02ac034ede4c4247dfd627e46ef43f91.open_work: Using the all-weather skin temperatures to evaluate land-surface schemes in climate and weather models.
151c5aab02ac034ede4c4247dfd627e46ef43f91.issues: Microwave emissivity and penetration depth complicate interpretation of skin temperature; retrieval accuracy depends on first-guess information.

a9897b7147c26cf5b9131866b184be2a3c988750.goal: Detects clouds and classifies cloud types from satellite radiance profiles, a need of Earth Observing System algorithms that must know whether a profile is cloud free.
a9897b7147c26cf5b9131866b184be2a3c988750.architecture: Multicategory support vector machine (MSVM) that extends binary SVMs symmetrically to many classes and handles unequal misclassification costs and nonrepresentative training sets.
a9897b7147c26cf5b9131866b184be2a3c988750.data: Satellite radiance profiles labeled as clear or by cloud type, in the context of MODIS-type observations; details of the sample are only partly given in the abstract.
a9897b7147c26cf5b9131866b184be2a3c988750.result: The MSVM shows potential as an efficient cloud detection and classification algorithm and avoids failures of one-versus-rest binary decompositions.
a9897b7147c26cf5b9131866b184be2a3c988750.open_work: Applying the MSVM operationally to large volumes of satellite data and adding more cloud categories and surface types.
a9897b7147c26cf5b9131866b184be2a3c988750.issues: Demonstration on a limited labeled dataset; quality depends on the reliability of training labels.

8d53dc382753c2184fa8c1308b2916792260e5f2.goal: Derives monthly operating rules for a cascade system of reservoirs that account for inflow uncertainty.
8d53dc382753c2184fa8c1308b2916792260e5f2.architecture: Bayesian network that learns release rules from the results of a reservoir optimization model, giving probabilistic monthly releases conditioned on storage and inflow.
8d53dc382753c2184fa8c1308b2916792260e5f2.data: Historical and generated monthly inflow series and reservoir characteristics for a cascade reservoir system in Iran; details are not reported here (no abstract available).
8d53dc382753c2184fa8c1308b2916792260e5f2.result: Not reported in detail; the Bayesian network operating rules are presented as an effective way to approximate optimal operation.

36792a9d329063b7691a096ae6abe9e4ff7bf463.goal: Forecasts water stage in a tidal estuary during floods, where tides and river discharge interact, to support flood warning.
36792a9d329063b7691a096ae6abe9e4ff7bf463.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) neural network using upstream discharge, tidal levels and past stages as inputs.
36792a9d329063b7691a096ae6abe9e4ff7bf463.data: Hourly water stage, tide and discharge records from the Tanshui River estuary, Taiwan, including typhoon events.

de60af18709e8da650862f1f42f623daad24607f.goal: Produces solar radiation maps for regions where measured solar radiation series are scarce or of poor quality.

e2f3534b26fd37c86629d47e4647193ddac31ef3.goal: Improves ozone forecasts by combining an ensemble of air-quality model runs rather than relying on a single model.
e2f3534b26fd37c86629d47e4647193ddac31ef3.architecture: Sequential aggregation from machine learning (online learning with expert advice, e.g. exponentiated gradient and ridge-regression aggregation) that updates combination weights daily; not a neural network.
e2f3534b26fd37c86629d47e4647193ddac31ef3.data: An ensemble of about 48 chemistry-transport model configurations from the Polyphemus platform over Europe, evaluated against ground ozone observations for a summer season.
e2f3534b26fd37c86629d47e4647193ddac31ef3.result: Aggregated forecasts outperform the best single model and the ensemble mean, reducing RMSE of daily ozone peaks substantially (on the order of 20%).
e2f3534b26fd37c86629d47e4647193ddac31ef3.open_work: Applying the aggregation to other pollutants, to spatial fields away from stations and to operational forecasting.
e2f3534b26fd37c86629d47e4647193ddac31ef3.issues: Weights are station-based and need a training period; gains depend on ensemble diversity.

05e58d005c4db9d02173670446de94c0d84d24cd.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feedforward, Ward-style networks) using recent weather observations as inputs for 1–12 h ahead prediction.
05e58d005c4db9d02173670446de94c0d84d24cd.data: Weather data from the Georgia Automated Environmental Monitoring Network (AEMN), USA.
05e58d005c4db9d02173670446de94c0d84d24cd.result: The neural networks predict dewpoint with errors that grow with lead time and remain useful up to about 12 h ahead.
05e58d005c4db9d02173670446de94c0d84d24cd.open_work: Integration into decision-support systems and inclusion of forecast meteorology.
05e58d005c4db9d02173670446de94c0d84d24cd.issues: Station data from one state; errors grow at longer lead times.

ad51b3ca61fe49907a5d0d0e248908fd953c1fd3.goal: Models surface ozone concentrations and identifies relevant inputs using neural networks while avoiding biased sensitivity estimates.
ad51b3ca61fe49907a5d0d0e248908fd953c1fd3.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks with unbiased sensitivity analysis and pruning techniques to select inputs and simplify the network.
ad51b3ca61fe49907a5d0d0e248908fd953c1fd3.data: Surface ozone and meteorological measurements from air-quality monitoring stations; details are not reported here (no abstract available).
ad51b3ca61fe49907a5d0d0e248908fd953c1fd3.result: Not reported in detail; pruning and sensitivity analysis yield simpler networks and an input ranking.
ad51b3ca61fe49907a5d0d0e248908fd953c1fd3.open_work: Applying the techniques to other stations and pollutants.
ad51b3ca61fe49907a5d0d0e248908fd953c1fd3.issues: Card relies on the title and limited knowledge.

376b11664b5ef3bd38ed61db9f7609a2d29de04d.goal: Forecasts rainfall with a recurrent support vector regression model to capture temporal dependence.
376b11664b5ef3bd38ed61db9f7609a2d29de04d.architecture: Recurrent support vector regression (SVR) model; the abstract and parameter-selection procedure are not available.
376b11664b5ef3bd38ed61db9f7609a2d29de04d.data: Rainfall records; region and period are not reported here (no abstract available).
376b11664b5ef3bd38ed61db9f7609a2d29de04d.result: Not reported; no abstract is available for this paper.
376b11664b5ef3bd38ed61db9f7609a2d29de04d.open_work: Comparison with other machine-learning and stochastic rainfall forecasting models over more sites.
376b11664b5ef3bd38ed61db9f7609a2d29de04d.issues: Card based on the title only.

9846cd31de07be9004a60ee679c1874db0fea28f.goal: Improves flood forecasting with support vector machines by pruning the support vectors for simpler, faster models.
9846cd31de07be9004a60ee679c1874db0fea28f.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector network) regression with pruning of support vectors.
9846cd31de07be9004a60ee679c1874db0fea28f.data: Rainfall and streamflow/stage records during flood events in a catchment; not reported here (no abstract available).
9846cd31de07be9004a60ee679c1874db0fea28f.result: Not reported; no abstract is available for this paper.
9846cd31de07be9004a60ee679c1874db0fea28f.open_work: Real-time operational testing and comparison with neural network forecasts.
9846cd31de07be9004a60ee679c1874db0fea28f.issues: Card based on the title only.

7457f735a9e53efbba71c3a452702f8400ec94e1.goal: Predicts runoff and soil loss from natural-rainfall erosion plots, testing whether data-driven models can match or replace process-based erosion models at the plot scale.
7457f735a9e53efbba71c3a452702f8400ec94e1.architecture: Artificial neural network (network type not specified) mapping storm and plot characteristics to runoff and soil loss; compared with a process-based erosion model.
7457f735a9e53efbba71c3a452702f8400ec94e1.data: Natural-rainfall runoff plot records from several US locations; exact sites and periods not reported here.
7457f735a9e53efbba71c3a452702f8400ec94e1.result: Neural networks reproduce event runoff and soil loss at the plot scale with useful skill, comparing favourably with the process-based benchmark on the plot data used.
7457f735a9e53efbba71c3a452702f8400ec94e1.open_work: Testing transfer to ungauged sites, larger scales and other climates, and combining neural networks with physical erosion knowledge.
7457f735a9e53efbba71c3a452702f8400ec94e1.issues: Plot-scale, site-limited data; black-box models give little physical insight and may not extrapolate to unseen soils, land uses or extreme storms.

b2bf4a8ca7eedad1e9f1510ead1391829fc1db6d.goal: Characterizes regional drought from point observations, using neural networks to analyse the spatial extent and severity of droughts over a region.
b2bf4a8ca7eedad1e9f1510ead1391829fc1db6d.architecture: Neural network approach for spatial drought analysis; the specific network type is not specified here.
b2bf4a8ca7eedad1e9f1510ead1391829fc1db6d.data: Precipitation or drought-index records from a station network; specific region and period not reported here.
b2bf4a8ca7eedad1e9f1510ead1391829fc1db6d.result: Neural networks provide a workable way to map regional drought severity and areal extent from scattered point data.
b2bf4a8ca7eedad1e9f1510ead1391829fc1db6d.open_work: Extending the approach to drought forecasting and comparing it with geostatistical interpolation.
b2bf4a8ca7eedad1e9f1510ead1391829fc1db6d.issues: Details on validation and uncertainty are not available here; results depend on station density and the chosen drought index.

24497ddd9ffa0ff08fba4ca7e39793c23dfb22f5.goal: Develops a flood forecasting model for a typhoon-prone Taiwanese river to provide hourly streamflow forecasts a few hours ahead.
24497ddd9ffa0ff08fba4ca7e39793c23dfb22f5.architecture: Radial basis function neural network trained with a hybrid scheme: fuzzy min-max clustering sets the hidden-layer centers and linear regression sets the output weights.
24497ddd9ffa0ff08fba4ca7e39793c23dfb22f5.data: Hourly rainfall and streamflow records from storm events in the Lan-Yang River basin, Taiwan.
24497ddd9ffa0ff08fba4ca7e39793c23dfb22f5.result: The RBF network gives accurate one- to three-hour-ahead flood forecasts with efficient training on the storm events tested.
24497ddd9ffa0ff08fba4ca7e39793c23dfb22f5.open_work: Longer lead times, more storm events and comparison with other network types and conceptual models.
24497ddd9ffa0ff08fba4ca7e39793c23dfb22f5.issues: Small number of flood events, a single basin and short lead times; performance on unprecedented floods is untested.

0083fb1ce826a6479e61f608c55ecb9b8aba5b19.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels in a hard-rock aquifer, where heterogeneous fractured geology makes physically based modelling difficult, to support groundwater management.
0083fb1ce826a6479e61f608c55ecb9b8aba5b19.architecture: Artificial neural network (network type not specified) relating recharge and pumping drivers to observed groundwater levels; exact configuration not reported here.
0083fb1ce826a6479e61f608c55ecb9b8aba5b19.data: Observation-well groundwater levels with rainfall and pumping records from a hard-rock region in India; periods not reported here.
0083fb1ce826a6479e61f608c55ecb9b8aba5b19.result: The neural network reproduces observed groundwater-level fluctuations and supports scenario forecasting of levels under different pumping regimes.
0083fb1ce826a6479e61f608c55ecb9b8aba5b19.open_work: Longer records, more wells and coupling with physically based groundwater models.
0083fb1ce826a6479e61f608c55ecb9b8aba5b19.issues: Limited data at a single site; the black-box model may not extrapolate beyond observed pumping and rainfall ranges.

68069292be939b7e35cf89fd245a9b6746fceb71.goal: Predicts reservoir inflow at the Three Gorges Dam on the Yangtze River to support dam operation and flood control.
68069292be939b7e35cf89fd245a9b6746fceb71.architecture: Wavelet network model combining wavelet analysis with a neural network for inflow time series prediction; details not reported here.
68069292be939b7e35cf89fd245a9b6746fceb71.data: Historical inflow series at the Three Gorges Dam, Yangtze River; record length not reported here.
68069292be939b7e35cf89fd245a9b6746fceb71.result: The wavelet network model gives better inflow predictions than the conventional comparison models considered.
68069292be939b7e35cf89fd245a9b6746fceb71.open_work: Longer lead times, inclusion of upstream rainfall and gauge data, and operational testing.
68069292be939b7e35cf89fd245a9b6746fceb71.issues: Single-site, univariate setting; decomposition choices may be tuned to the record and boundary effects are not discussed here.

192f34cfbf03e83567d2c085e23aef74837f6667.goal: Classifies hydrometeor types in convective storms from C-band polarimetric radar, where attenuation and resonance effects complicate schemes designed for S-band.
192f34cfbf03e83567d2c085e23aef74837f6667.architecture: Empirically based fuzzy logic classification: two-dimensional membership functions on polarimetric power and differential phase variables plus a temperature membership function assign one of ten hydrometeor species.
192f34cfbf03e83567d2c085e23aef74837f6667.data: C-band polarimetric radar observations of a tropical thunderstorm near Darwin and a subtropical severe thunderstorm near Sydney, Australia.
192f34cfbf03e83567d2c085e23aef74837f6667.result: The scheme produces realistic hydrometeor classifications for both storm cases.
192f34cfbf03e83567d2c085e23aef74837f6667.open_work: Quantitative validation against in situ microphysics and refinement of membership functions for attenuation-affected regions.
192f34cfbf03e83567d2c085e23aef74837f6667.issues: Evaluation is qualitative on two case studies; membership functions are empirical and not independently validated.

263086107d91f87a9e541a41d96698446ab5d3b7.goal: Forecasts particulate matter concentrations in an urban area to support air quality alerts.
263086107d91f87a9e541a41d96698446ab5d3b7.architecture: Neural network models (type not specified) compared with linear regression and persistence for next-day particulate concentration forecasts.
263086107d91f87a9e541a41d96698446ab5d3b7.data: Hourly particulate and meteorological measurements from monitoring stations in Santiago, Chile; period not reported here.
263086107d91f87a9e541a41d96698446ab5d3b7.result: Neural networks give somewhat lower forecast errors than linear models and persistence for particulate concentrations.
263086107d91f87a9e541a41d96698446ab5d3b7.open_work: Adding forecast meteorology inputs, more stations and longer validation periods.
263086107d91f87a9e541a41d96698446ab5d3b7.issues: Short records from one city; gains over linear methods are modest and peak episodes remain hard to predict.

7b5b32f60b155683c2bb3e04492466eca6e8e1f6.goal: Estimates streamflow during river ice periods, when stage–discharge rating curves are invalid and discharge must be corrected manually.
7b5b32f60b155683c2bb3e04492466eca6e8e1f6.architecture: Artificial neural network compared with multiple regression for estimating ice-affected discharge from hydrometeorological variables.
7b5b32f60b155683c2bb3e04492466eca6e8e1f6.data: Hydrometric and meteorological records from Canadian river gauging stations under ice conditions; sites and periods not reported here.
7b5b32f60b155683c2bb3e04492466eca6e8e1f6.result: The neural network estimates ice-affected streamflow more accurately than multiple regression.
7b5b32f60b155683c2bb3e04492466eca6e8e1f6.open_work: Applying the method at more stations and in real time for hydrometric agencies.
7b5b32f60b155683c2bb3e04492466eca6e8e1f6.issues: Few winters and sites; ice processes vary between rivers so transferability is uncertain.

1b6dbe5a5afffff19aed1446d56886430268bf57.goal: Attributes projected 21st-century changes in Arctic atmospheric moisture transport to changes in circulation-pattern frequency versus changes within the patterns themselves.
1b6dbe5a5afffff19aed1446d56886430268bf57.architecture: Self-organizing map classifying daily sea-level pressure patterns, with moisture transport changes decomposed into pattern-frequency and within-pattern contributions; not a predictive ML model.
1b6dbe5a5afffff19aed1446d56886430268bf57.data: Coupled climate model simulations (CCSM3) for late 20th-century and projected 21st-century climate; Arctic moisture flux fields.
1b6dbe5a5afffff19aed1446d56886430268bf57.result: Projected increases in poleward moisture transport into the Arctic come mostly from changes within circulation patterns, chiefly higher atmospheric moisture, rather than shifts in pattern frequency.
1b6dbe5a5afffff19aed1446d56886430268bf57.open_work: Extending to multi-model ensembles and linking moisture transport changes to Arctic precipitation and sea-ice changes.
1b6dbe5a5afffff19aed1446d56886430268bf57.issues: Relies on a single climate model and emission scenario; SOM node count and domain choices affect the decomposition.

fb2c321ea0a2348012be55135ec8f38089093282.goal: Compares fuzzy inference systems for streamflow prediction to identify which fuzzy formulation is most suitable.
fb2c321ea0a2348012be55135ec8f38089093282.architecture: Comparison of several fuzzy inference systems (fuzzy rule-based models) for streamflow prediction; the specific variants are not specified here.
fb2c321ea0a2348012be55135ec8f38089093282.data: Observed streamflow records from river gauging stations; locations and periods not reported here.
fb2c321ea0a2348012be55135ec8f38089093282.result: Fuzzy inference systems provide skilful streamflow predictions, with performance differing between system types.
fb2c321ea0a2348012be55135ec8f38089093282.open_work: Testing on more basins, adding meteorological inputs and longer lead times.
fb2c321ea0a2348012be55135ec8f38089093282.issues: Limited stations; rule-base design and membership functions can be subjective and site specific.

6e6ce2e2414c2524e4a226fff28be81a131a448e.goal: Extracts the dominant joint surface and subsurface current patterns on the West Florida Shelf and their relation to wind forcing.
6e6ce2e2414c2524e4a226fff28be81a131a448e.architecture: Self-organizing map applied jointly to surface current maps and moored velocity profiles to extract coupled spatial patterns; not a predictive model.
6e6ce2e2414c2524e4a226fff28be81a131a448e.data: HF radar surface currents and moored ADCP velocity profiles on the West Florida Shelf, with local wind observations.
6e6ce2e2414c2524e4a226fff28be81a131a448e.result: The joint SOM identifies coherent current patterns, including upwelling- and downwelling-favourable responses linked to wind forcing, consistent between surface and subsurface.
6e6ce2e2414c2524e4a226fff28be81a131a448e.open_work: Longer records, seasonal stratification effects and use of the patterns to evaluate ocean circulation models.
6e6ce2e2414c2524e4a226fff28be81a131a448e.issues: Short observational period and limited spatial coverage; SOM map size choices influence the extracted patterns.

6b592ce8825ff0593645ffd09ab30a2185d1a9f0.goal: Characterizes drought risk patterns in southern Italy by classifying bioclimatic time series.
6b592ce8825ff0593645ffd09ab30a2185d1a9f0.architecture: Neural network-based classification of bioclimatic time series into drought-risk classes; the network type is not specified here.
6b592ce8825ff0593645ffd09ab30a2185d1a9f0.data: Long-term station climate records (temperature, precipitation and derived bioclimatic indices) from southern Italy.
6b592ce8825ff0593645ffd09ab30a2185d1a9f0.result: The classification identifies distinct spatial and temporal drought-risk patterns among stations.
6b592ce8825ff0593645ffd09ab30a2185d1a9f0.open_work: Linking classes to land degradation and vegetation impacts and updating with recent climate data.
6b592ce8825ff0593645ffd09ab30a2185d1a9f0.issues: Exploratory classification with limited validation; class interpretation depends on the chosen indices.

883207a7f27f1375b84647720f3e3005f3e3a3d2.goal: Builds a stochastic streamflow simulator that combines long but uncertain paleoreconstructed flows with shorter, reliable observed flows for water resources planning.
883207a7f27f1375b84647720f3e3005f3e3a3d2.architecture: Non-ML stochastic framework: a nonhomogeneous Markov chain fitted to paleodata simulates wet/dry states, and a nonparametric K-nearest neighbour bootstrap resamples observed flow magnitudes conditioned on state.
883207a7f27f1375b84647720f3e3005f3e3a3d2.data: Tree-ring paleoreconstructed streamflow and observed naturalized flows at Lees Ferry, Arizona, Colorado River.
883207a7f27f1375b84647720f3e3005f3e3a3d2.result: Simulations reproduce observed-period statistics and generate a rich variety of wet and dry sequences, including droughts beyond the observed record.
883207a7f27f1375b84647720f3e3005f3e3a3d2.open_work: Extending to multisite simulation across the basin and to climate-change conditioned scenarios.
883207a7f27f1375b84647720f3e3005f3e3a3d2.issues: Resampling cannot produce flow magnitudes outside the observed record; paleo state uncertainty is carried into the simulations.

cca1481637c9adfaaf34dac6c8f3e0410d02cbd2.goal: Forecasts wind turbine power output over longer horizons to support power system scheduling with wind generation.
cca1481637c9adfaaf34dac6c8f3e0410d02cbd2.architecture: Recurrent neural network for long-term-ahead wind power generation forecasting.
cca1481637c9adfaaf34dac6c8f3e0410d02cbd2.data: Wind speed and power generation records from a wind generator site; details not reported here.
cca1481637c9adfaaf34dac6c8f3e0410d02cbd2.result: The recurrent network gives more accurate long-horizon wind power forecasts than the simpler comparison methods.
cca1481637c9adfaaf34dac6c8f3e0410d02cbd2.open_work: Using numerical weather prediction inputs and testing at more sites.
cca1481637c9adfaaf34dac6c8f3e0410d02cbd2.issues: Single-site data and short evaluation; error growth with horizon and extreme ramps are not fully characterized.

680e972ceebe4f04a81bdc64027c3f31816f840c.goal: Develops and compares ozone forecasting models for the Mexicali–Calexico border region, where ozone frequently exceeds air quality standards.
680e972ceebe4f04a81bdc64027c3f31816f840c.architecture: Linear statistical models compared with artificial-intelligence-based models, including neural networks, for tropospheric ozone prediction.
680e972ceebe4f04a81bdc64027c3f31816f840c.data: Hourly ozone and meteorological measurements from monitoring stations in Mexicali, Mexico, and Calexico, USA.
680e972ceebe4f04a81bdc64027c3f31816f840c.result: The artificial-intelligence-based models predict ozone better than the linear models, particularly for higher concentrations.
680e972ceebe4f04a81bdc64027c3f31816f840c.open_work: Operational forecasting with predicted meteorology and inclusion of emission information.
680e972ceebe4f04a81bdc64027c3f31816f840c.issues: Limited monitoring sites and period; models may not transfer to other regions or emission regimes.

f96350b827dc142051f1217c64ab3e533692dc50.goal: Questions whether feed-forward neural networks are worthwhile for streamflow forecasting given their tendency to over-parameterise and fit noise.
f96350b827dc142051f1217c64ab3e533692dc50.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) with structure chosen by a validation-based model selection method, compared with a linear model and the GR4J conceptual rainfall-runoff model.
f96350b827dc142051f1217c64ab3e533692dc50.data: Two case studies: river flow prediction from upstream flows and rainfall-runoff modelling; catchment details not reported in the abstract.
f96350b827dc142051f1217c64ab3e533692dc50.result: Selected networks have only two or three hidden neurons, perform close to the linear model, and are outperformed by GR4J for rainfall-runoff.
f96350b827dc142051f1217c64ab3e533692dc50.open_work: Broader case studies and evaluation methods to settle the usefulness of neural networks in hydrology.
f96350b827dc142051f1217c64ab3e533692dc50.issues: Conclusions rest on two case studies and one evaluation method; networks of the period were small and trained on limited data.

0719a63450701017c89bfe3d60800485ae72c76b.goal: Forecasts airport weather, notably cloud ceiling and visibility, by retrieving similar past cases from long observation archives.
0719a63450701017c89bfe3d60800485ae72c76b.architecture: Fuzzy case-based reasoning system using fuzzy similarity measures to find nearest neighbour analogue cases and combine their outcomes into a forecast.
0719a63450701017c89bfe3d60800485ae72c76b.data: Long archives of hourly airport surface observations (Canada); exact stations and period not reported here.
0719a63450701017c89bfe3d60800485ae72c76b.result: The fuzzy case-based approach produces ceiling and visibility forecasts more skilful than persistence and competitive with standard references.
0719a63450701017c89bfe3d60800485ae72c76b.open_work: Adding more predictors, more airports and integration into operational forecasting.
0719a63450701017c89bfe3d60800485ae72c76b.issues: Analogue methods depend on archive size and struggle with rare events; few sites evaluated.

d65e88ca9604b139ee2a24f6b41f835a5faf1ec9.goal: Predicts ambient ozone concentrations from meteorological and pollutant variables using multivariate statistics.
d65e88ca9604b139ee2a24f6b41f835a5faf1ec9.architecture: Multivariate statistical methods for ozone prediction; specific techniques are not reported here.
d65e88ca9604b139ee2a24f6b41f835a5faf1ec9.data: Ozone, other pollutant and meteorological monitoring data from a Hungarian site; period not reported here.
d65e88ca9604b139ee2a24f6b41f835a5faf1ec9.result: Multivariate models identify the main explanatory variables and give useful ozone predictions.
d65e88ca9604b139ee2a24f6b41f835a5faf1ec9.open_work: Comparison with nonlinear methods and validation on independent years.
d65e88ca9604b139ee2a24f6b41f835a5faf1ec9.issues: Single location; linear multivariate methods may miss nonlinear photochemical dependencies.

dca2ec923d155b83c12818d412bdecf1e0296e50.goal: Tests whether a neural network can estimate soil moisture from surface and atmospheric variables observable by remote sensing.
dca2ec923d155b83c12818d412bdecf1e0296e50.architecture: Artificial neural network for soil moisture estimation; network type and configuration not reported here.
dca2ec923d155b83c12818d412bdecf1e0296e50.data: Training and test data from simulations and/or observations; exact sources not reported here.
dca2ec923d155b83c12818d412bdecf1e0296e50.result: The feasibility study shows that a neural network can estimate soil moisture with useful accuracy.
dca2ec923d155b83c12818d412bdecf1e0296e50.open_work: Applying the approach to real satellite observations and other regions.
dca2ec923d155b83c12818d412bdecf1e0296e50.issues: Feasibility-level study with limited evaluation; performance under real retrieval noise is uncertain.

360c5e797a96e6bc57fc548e8ba33a438a2f7caa.goal: Supports reservoir and dam operation decisions with neural network and fuzzy systems that emulate operator rules.
360c5e797a96e6bc57fc548e8ba33a438a2f7caa.architecture: Neural network and fuzzy system models for reservoir release decisions; configuration not reported here.
360c5e797a96e6bc57fc548e8ba33a438a2f7caa.data: Reservoir inflow, storage and release records from Japanese dams; periods not reported here.
360c5e797a96e6bc57fc548e8ba33a438a2f7caa.result: Neural network and fuzzy approaches reproduce operator decisions and can support dam control, with differing strengths between the two.
360c5e797a96e6bc57fc548e8ba33a438a2f7caa.open_work: Combining the approaches with inflow forecasts and testing in real-time operation.
360c5e797a96e6bc57fc548e8ba33a438a2f7caa.issues: Limited case studies; learning from past operations can reproduce past suboptimal decisions.

897a5ce93dbd6fe1f9f8f1d58477e4fe6e312080.goal: Predicts wind speed for applications such as wind energy, comparing statistical and neural network methods.
897a5ce93dbd6fe1f9f8f1d58477e4fe6e312080.architecture: Statistical regression compared with an artificial neural network for wind speed prediction; network type not reported here.
897a5ce93dbd6fe1f9f8f1d58477e4fe6e312080.data: Station wind speed and meteorological records from India; exact sites and periods not reported here.
897a5ce93dbd6fe1f9f8f1d58477e4fe6e312080.result: The neural network gives better wind speed predictions than statistical regression.
897a5ce93dbd6fe1f9f8f1d58477e4fe6e312080.open_work: Longer horizons, more sites and inclusion of numerical weather prediction inputs.
897a5ce93dbd6fe1f9f8f1d58477e4fe6e312080.issues: Limited data and sites; short-term statistical skill may not translate to longer lead times.

0750ec3896557468cfaa77b0c9ca429368783e52.goal: Measures marine surface wind vectors from nautical X-band radar sea-clutter images, offering a ship- or platform-based wind sensor.
0750ec3896557468cfaa77b0c9ca429368783e52.architecture: Wind direction from wind-induced streaks in radar image sequences; wind speed from a neural network relating radar backscatter, direction and other parameters to speed.
0750ec3896557468cfaa77b0c9ca429368783e52.data: Nautical X-band marine radar image sequences with in situ anemometer wind measurements from ship and platform deployments.
0750ec3896557468cfaa77b0c9ca429368783e52.result: Retrieved wind speed and direction agree well with in situ wind measurements over a range of conditions.
0750ec3896557468cfaa77b0c9ca429368783e52.open_work: Testing other radar systems and installations and combining with wave retrievals from the same radar.
0750ec3896557468cfaa77b0c9ca429368783e52.issues: Calibration is installation specific; rain, low winds and platform effects degrade retrievals.

57a72c51a978006acbe859fd6821bbf6bdd31f9f.goal: Creates a consistent, cross-calibrated global chlorophyll baseline from different ocean color sensors to support long-term records.
57a72c51a978006acbe859fd6821bbf6bdd31f9f.architecture: Machine-learning methods, mainly support vector machines and neural networks, mapping one sensor's radiances to another sensor's chlorophyll to remove inter-sensor differences.
57a72c51a978006acbe859fd6821bbf6bdd31f9f.data: SeaWiFS and MODIS ocean color observations with in situ chlorophyll used for comparison.
57a72c51a978006acbe859fd6821bbf6bdd31f9f.result: Support vector machines and neural networks bring MODIS-derived chlorophyll into close agreement with SeaWiFS, supporting a merged baseline dataset.
57a72c51a978006acbe859fd6821bbf6bdd31f9f.open_work: Extending to more sensors and longer periods and propagating uncertainty in merged products.
57a72c51a978006acbe859fd6821bbf6bdd31f9f.issues: Calibration to a reference sensor inherits its biases; generalization outside the training conditions is uncertain.

67dfb33de2be02a5150281d26dd92891d229fe98.goal: Classifies hydrometeors and estimates their content from C-band dual-polarization radar, accounting for C-band scattering behaviour.
67dfb33de2be02a5150281d26dd92891d229fe98.architecture: Bayesian supervised classification (maximum a posteriori) trained on simulated polarimetric radar signatures, with parametric estimators of hydrometeor content; not a neural network.
67dfb33de2be02a5150281d26dd92891d229fe98.data: Scattering-model simulations of C-band polarimetric observables for training; C-band dual-polarized radar case studies in Italy for application.
67dfb33de2be02a5150281d26dd92891d229fe98.result: The Bayesian approach yields physically consistent hydrometeor classifications at C-band with associated content estimates.
67dfb33de2be02a5150281d26dd92891d229fe98.open_work: Including attenuation correction and in situ validation and adapting the method to other wavelengths.
67dfb33de2be02a5150281d26dd92891d229fe98.issues: Training relies on simulated scattering with assumed microphysics; validation against ground truth is limited.

169fa91ccef3eaa59bd40181bbbbb67cfb261b45.goal: Forecasts tidal levels with artificial neural networks as an alternative to harmonic analysis.
169fa91ccef3eaa59bd40181bbbbb67cfb261b45.architecture: Artificial neural network for tide forecasting; network type not reported here.
169fa91ccef3eaa59bd40181bbbbb67cfb261b45.data: Tide-gauge records from Chinese coastal stations; details not reported here.
169fa91ccef3eaa59bd40181bbbbb67cfb261b45.result: Neural networks produce accurate tide forecasts comparable to or better than harmonic analysis.
169fa91ccef3eaa59bd40181bbbbb67cfb261b45.open_work: Including meteorological effects and longer forecast periods.
169fa91ccef3eaa59bd40181bbbbb67cfb261b45.issues: Details on data and validation are not available; surge-dominated events may not be captured.

8dad23e55ee83d26ee378da457af55e698a29006.goal: Models river discharge and rainfall time series with radial basis function networks designed via support vector regression.
8dad23e55ee83d26ee378da457af55e698a29006.architecture: Radial basis function network whose centers and weights are obtained from support vector regression.
8dad23e55ee83d26ee378da457af55e698a29006.data: River discharge and rainfall time series; locations and periods not reported here.
8dad23e55ee83d26ee378da457af55e698a29006.result: The SVR-based RBF networks model the discharge and rainfall series accurately with compact structures.
8dad23e55ee83d26ee378da457af55e698a29006.open_work: Applying the method to longer-lead forecasting and more catchments.
8dad23e55ee83d26ee378da457af55e698a29006.issues: Limited data sets; kernel and parameter selection influence results.

565d5a63eed060b2951ca0681a007216a6faa080.goal: Identifies the nonlinear phases of the monsoon intraseasonal oscillation objectively to improve understanding and prediction of active and break spells.
565d5a63eed060b2951ca0681a007216a6faa080.architecture: Self-organizing map clustering of large-scale convection and circulation fields to define intraseasonal oscillation phases, compared with linear methods.
565d5a63eed060b2951ca0681a007216a6faa080.data: Observed outgoing longwave radiation and reanalysis circulation fields over the Indian monsoon region; periods not reported here.
565d5a63eed060b2951ca0681a007216a6faa080.result: The SOM captures nonlinear convectively coupled phases better than linear decompositions, suggesting improved potential for extended-range prediction of monsoon spells.
565d5a63eed060b2951ca0681a007216a6faa080.open_work: Building SOM-based prediction schemes for monsoon intraseasonal variability.
565d5a63eed060b2951ca0681a007216a6faa080.issues: Phase identification depends on SOM size and input fields; prediction implications are demonstrated only partly.

763dc9b96c91f5facc055df50c465b302c2b0b95.goal: Compares an artificial neural network and a conceptual rainfall-runoff model using multiple performance criteria rather than a single score.
763dc9b96c91f5facc055df50c465b302c2b0b95.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) compared with the HBV conceptual rainfall-runoff model under multi-objective evaluation.
763dc9b96c91f5facc055df50c465b302c2b0b95.data: Daily rainfall, evaporation and discharge for the Geer River basin, Belgium.
763dc9b96c91f5facc055df50c465b302c2b0b95.result: The neural network scores well on some criteria but shows timing errors and weaker performance on others, while HBV is more balanced across criteria.
763dc9b96c91f5facc055df50c465b302c2b0b95.open_work: Multi-objective training of neural networks and improved input selection.
763dc9b96c91f5facc055df50c465b302c2b0b95.issues: Single basin; neural network performance is sensitive to inputs and training objective.

0bf58f6a8dcd7e343e7e671f6f9ea382e46ea7df.goal: Estimates global solar radiation from routine meteorological measurements where pyranometer data are sparse.
0bf58f6a8dcd7e343e7e671f6f9ea382e46ea7df.architecture: Artificial neural network for global solar radiation; the network type is not specified.
0bf58f6a8dcd7e343e7e671f6f9ea382e46ea7df.data: Meteorological station data from India; stations and periods not reported here.
0bf58f6a8dcd7e343e7e671f6f9ea382e46ea7df.result: The neural network estimates global solar radiation with good accuracy compared with measurements.
0bf58f6a8dcd7e343e7e671f6f9ea382e46ea7df.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates.
0bf58f6a8dcd7e343e7e671f6f9ea382e46ea7df.issues: Limited stations; preprint with few details on validation.

c371b452c8d301c4dab3057ca8001010672eda0c.goal: Retrieves chlorophyll, suspended matter and yellow substance from satellite ocean color radiances in optically complex waters.
c371b452c8d301c4dab3057ca8001010672eda0c.architecture: Neural network (MLP) inversion algorithm trained on radiative transfer simulations mapping radiances to constituent concentrations.
c371b452c8d301c4dab3057ca8001010672eda0c.data: Simulated top-of-atmosphere or water-leaving radiances from a radiative transfer model; ADEOS OCTS radiance data; in situ measurements for validation.
c371b452c8d301c4dab3057ca8001010672eda0c.result: The neural network retrieves the three constituents from OCTS radiances with reasonable agreement against in situ data.
c371b452c8d301c4dab3057ca8001010672eda0c.open_work: Applying the algorithm to other sensors and regions with regional bio-optical models.
c371b452c8d301c4dab3057ca8001010672eda0c.issues: Accuracy depends on the bio-optical model behind the simulations; limited in situ validation.

6c35b52778749ef28a7038891f4794079f125da8.goal: Predicts hourly surface ozone one day ahead in eastern Spain to support air quality warnings.
6c35b52778749ef28a7038891f4794079f125da8.architecture: Linear models compared with neural networks (type not specified) for next-day hourly ozone forecasting.
6c35b52778749ef28a7038891f4794079f125da8.data: Hourly ozone and meteorological measurements from monitoring stations in eastern Spain (Valencia region).
6c35b52778749ef28a7038891f4794079f125da8.result: Neural networks give better one-day-ahead ozone predictions than linear models.
6c35b52778749ef28a7038891f4794079f125da8.open_work: Adding forecast meteorology and extending to more stations.
6c35b52778749ef28a7038891f4794079f125da8.issues: Limited stations and period; peak ozone episodes remain challenging.

136ba9e8904073717950ff22bcc043d7ca896727.goal: Forecasts air pollutant levels using support vector machines as an alternative to neural networks.
136ba9e8904073717950ff22bcc043d7ca896727.architecture: Support vector machine regression for air pollutant forecasting, compared with neural network approaches.
136ba9e8904073717950ff22bcc043d7ca896727.data: Air pollutant monitoring data from Hong Kong; specific pollutants and periods not reported here.
136ba9e8904073717950ff22bcc043d7ca896727.result: Support vector machines give good forecasting performance and generalization for the pollutant series tested.
136ba9e8904073717950ff22bcc043d7ca896727.open_work: Kernel and parameter selection studies and multi-station applications.
136ba9e8904073717950ff22bcc043d7ca896727.issues: Short data records; hyperparameter choice affects results.

b3b1160717ee2f4246050212a204b394657f33af.goal: Estimates missing precipitation records at rain gauges using optimal functional forms for spatial weighting.
b3b1160717ee2f4246050212a204b394657f33af.architecture: Optimization-based functional forms for weighting neighbouring gauges in missing precipitation estimation; machine-learning type not specified here.
b3b1160717ee2f4246050212a204b394657f33af.data: Daily precipitation records from a network of rain gauges; region and period not reported here.
b3b1160717ee2f4246050212a204b394657f33af.result: Optimal functional forms improve missing precipitation estimates compared with traditional weighting methods such as inverse distance.
b3b1160717ee2f4246050212a204b394657f33af.open_work: Applying the approach to other networks and climates and to temporal resolutions.
b3b1160717ee2f4246050212a204b394657f33af.issues: Calibrated weights are network specific; extreme events and zero-precipitation cases are challenging.

dcd8c5e37dc2a4e3a4e076d014846ab5f0abb280.goal: Predicts tidal levels including strong meteorological effects such as storm surges, where harmonic analysis alone fails.
dcd8c5e37dc2a4e3a4e076d014846ab5f0abb280.architecture: Neural network models (type not specified) combining astronomical tide and meteorological inputs.
dcd8c5e37dc2a4e3a4e076d014846ab5f0abb280.data: Tide-gauge and meteorological records from Chinese coastal stations; details not reported here.
dcd8c5e37dc2a4e3a4e076d014846ab5f0abb280.result: Including meteorological factors in neural network models improves tidal level predictions during strong weather events.
dcd8c5e37dc2a4e3a4e076d014846ab5f0abb280.open_work: Longer lead times and use of forecast meteorology.

b332304d248ebb55e156ffdd487a988e1ebd4c75.goal: Models urban air pollution in Thessaloniki, Greece, with computational intelligence methods to support forecasting.
b332304d248ebb55e156ffdd487a988e1ebd4c75.architecture: Computational intelligence methods for air pollutant modelling; the specific model types are not specified here.
b332304d248ebb55e156ffdd487a988e1ebd4c75.data: Air quality and meteorological monitoring data from Thessaloniki, Greece.
b332304d248ebb55e156ffdd487a988e1ebd4c75.result: Computational intelligence models capture pollutant behaviour and provide useful forecasts.
b332304d248ebb55e156ffdd487a988e1ebd4c75.open_work: Operational deployment and comparison with deterministic air quality models.

ce1dfaefb4272c1fee7be717dbc9906db7ae5d64.goal: Models evapotranspiration using wavelet-transformed inputs and neural networks to capture multiscale variability.
ce1dfaefb4272c1fee7be717dbc9906db7ae5d64.architecture: Discrete wavelet transform of input time series combined with an artificial neural network (wavelet-neural network); network type not specified.
ce1dfaefb4272c1fee7be717dbc9906db7ae5d64.data: Meteorological station data with reference evapotranspiration estimates from Turkey; period not reported here.
ce1dfaefb4272c1fee7be717dbc9906db7ae5d64.result: The wavelet-neural network model estimates evapotranspiration more accurately than conventional neural networks and empirical methods.
ce1dfaefb4272c1fee7be717dbc9906db7ae5d64.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates and studying input selection.
ce1dfaefb4272c1fee7be717dbc9906db7ae5d64.issues: Targets are computed rather than measured evapotranspiration; boundary effects of wavelet decomposition.

4131a5624f767f0d92d25783fed5a9777fa78ef7.goal: Measures and predicts ground-level ozone around a heavily industrialized area to support air quality management.
4131a5624f767f0d92d25783fed5a9777fa78ef7.architecture: Artificial neural network (type not specified) compared with regression models for ozone prediction.
4131a5624f767f0d92d25783fed5a9777fa78ef7.data: Ozone, precursor pollutant and meteorological measurements from a monitoring site near an industrial area in Kuwait.
4131a5624f767f0d92d25783fed5a9777fa78ef7.result: The neural network predicts ozone levels more accurately than regression models.
4131a5624f767f0d92d25783fed5a9777fa78ef7.open_work: Forecasting with lead time and additional sites.

0615475e1d8cb8d02e0b065b87e221862d6f30ad.goal: Provides advance flood forecasts for Bangladesh using a fuzzy reasoning method to extend warning lead time.
0615475e1d8cb8d02e0b065b87e221862d6f30ad.data: Upstream and downstream river water level records in Bangladesh; details not reported here.
0615475e1d8cb8d02e0b065b87e221862d6f30ad.result: The fuzzy reasoning method gives useful multi-day advance water level forecasts.
0615475e1d8cb8d02e0b065b87e221862d6f30ad.open_work: Longer lead times and comparison with neural networks and hydrodynamic models.
0615475e1d8cb8d02e0b065b87e221862d6f30ad.issues: Limited events and stations; details not available.

122f1ef4fe859a627a66413dac55b2fe58ed3433.goal: Computes beam solar radiation at normal incidence for solar energy applications using neural networks.
122f1ef4fe859a627a66413dac55b2fe58ed3433.architecture: Artificial neural network for estimating beam solar radiation or its atmospheric attenuation parameters.
122f1ef4fe859a627a66413dac55b2fe58ed3433.data: Meteorological and solar radiation records from Indian stations; details not reported here.
122f1ef4fe859a627a66413dac55b2fe58ed3433.result: The neural network approach estimates beam normal radiation with good agreement with measurements.
122f1ef4fe859a627a66413dac55b2fe58ed3433.open_work: Testing at more sites and climates.
122f1ef4fe859a627a66413dac55b2fe58ed3433.issues: Limited stations; atmospheric turbidity variability may not be fully captured.

ef4a78e0cb4fd5ef0d38438f9e9c4ee0d669638d.goal: Trains artificial neural networks for rainfall-runoff modelling with multiple objectives to improve balanced performance across hydrograph aspects.
ef4a78e0cb4fd5ef0d38438f9e9c4ee0d669638d.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) trained with a multi-objective evolutionary optimization algorithm instead of single-objective back-propagation.
ef4a78e0cb4fd5ef0d38438f9e9c4ee0d669638d.data: Rainfall, evaporation and discharge records for the Geer River basin, Belgium.
ef4a78e0cb4fd5ef0d38438f9e9c4ee0d669638d.result: Multi-objective training yields networks with better balanced performance across criteria, including timing and peak flows, than single-objective training.
ef4a78e0cb4fd5ef0d38438f9e9c4ee0d669638d.open_work: Combining multi-objective training with improved input selection and comparing with conceptual models.
ef4a78e0cb4fd5ef0d38438f9e9c4ee0d669638d.issues: Single basin; computational cost and choice of objectives affect results.

86010b548214a97a8909cb03bab7060a5aec88a3.goal: Forecasts regional avalanche danger levels statistically and tests whether snow-cover variables simulated by a snowpack model add skill beyond meteorological predictors.
86010b548214a97a8909cb03bab7060a5aec88a3.architecture: Statistical classification models (classification trees and nearest-neighbour methods) using meteorological variables and SNOWPACK-simulated snow-cover variables as predictors.
86010b548214a97a8909cb03bab7060a5aec88a3.data: Swiss avalanche danger levels issued for the Davos region, with weather station data and SNOWPACK simulations; exact period not reported here.
86010b548214a97a8909cb03bab7060a5aec88a3.result: Models reach moderate accuracy for the danger level; adding simulated snow-stratigraphy variables gives only a limited improvement over meteorological predictors alone.
86010b548214a97a8909cb03bab7060a5aec88a3.open_work: Better snow-instability parameters from snowpack simulations and extension to other regions are natural next steps.
86010b548214a97a8909cb03bab7060a5aec88a3.issues: Single region; target is a human-issued danger level with its own inconsistencies; moderate accuracy limits operational use.

a6c1446e05ef3a7198997f0095b068c3691ccbc4.goal: Estimates or forecasts solar radiation from routinely measured meteorological variables for sites without radiation measurements.
a6c1446e05ef3a7198997f0095b068c3691ccbc4.architecture: Artificial neural network; the specific network type and configuration are not specified in the available record.
a6c1446e05ef3a7198997f0095b068c3691ccbc4.data: Meteorological station data (e.g., temperature, humidity, sunshine) from Iranian sites; details not reported.
a6c1446e05ef3a7198997f0095b068c3691ccbc4.result: The title implies the ANN predicts solar radiation with useful accuracy from meteorological inputs; quantitative results are not available here.
a6c1446e05ef3a7198997f0095b068c3691ccbc4.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates and comparison with empirical radiation models would strengthen the conclusions.
a6c1446e05ef3a7198997f0095b068c3691ccbc4.issues: Abstract not available; the number of sites and the period are not reported, and no uncertainty estimates are described.

1c69b49c5a8b891fb79cf48ba9592317418f57ec.goal: Predicts daily maximum and minimum atmospheric temperature, motivated by the nonstationary, regime-dependent nature of weather data.
1c69b49c5a8b891fb79cf48ba9592317418f57ec.architecture: Hybrid SOFM-MLP: a self-organizing feature map partitions the input space and a separate multilayer perceptron (MLP) is trained per cluster; a feature-selecting MLP identifies useful inputs.
1c69b49c5a8b891fb79cf48ba9592317418f57ec.data: Daily surface meteorological observations (temperature, pressure, humidity, rainfall, etc.) from a station in India.
1c69b49c5a8b891fb79cf48ba9592317418f57ec.result: The hybrid SOFM-MLP gives better temperature forecasts than a single MLP, and feature selection reduces inputs without loss of accuracy.
1c69b49c5a8b891fb79cf48ba9592317418f57ec.open_work: Extension to other variables, longer leads and multiple stations.
1c69b49c5a8b891fb79cf48ba9592317418f57ec.issues: Single-station data; next-day horizon only; no probabilistic output.

faa555e62484096706cb7dbda5193d9f8df07dda.goal: Evaluates how well IPCC AR4 climate models reproduce late-20th-century synoptic circulation patterns and associated precipitation over Greenland.
faa555e62484096706cb7dbda5193d9f8df07dda.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) classification of daily sea level pressure fields into synoptic patterns, used to compare pattern frequencies between models and reanalysis.
faa555e62484096706cb7dbda5193d9f8df07dda.data: ERA-40 reanalysis daily sea level pressure and precipitation, and late-20th-century simulations from multiple IPCC AR4 (CMIP3) models.
faa555e62484096706cb7dbda5193d9f8df07dda.result: Models generally reproduce the main synoptic patterns, but pattern frequencies and associated precipitation biases differ among models; better models are identified for later projection analysis.
faa555e62484096706cb7dbda5193d9f8df07dda.open_work: Part 2 applies the SOM framework to 21st-century projections of Greenland precipitation.
faa555e62484096706cb7dbda5193d9f8df07dda.issues: Reanalysis precipitation over Greenland is itself uncertain; SOM pattern counts depend on map size choice.

7c67745f52828d6a5b4819ab762ed18cbbd0fba4.goal: Improves short-term water level predictions at the entrance of Galveston Bay, where meteorological forcing makes astronomical tide tables inaccurate.
7c67745f52828d6a5b4819ab762ed18cbbd0fba4.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward) using past water levels and wind observations as inputs, compared with harmonic tide predictions.
7c67745f52828d6a5b4819ab762ed18cbbd0fba4.data: Water level and meteorological observations from the Texas Coastal Ocean Observation Network stations near Galveston Bay.
7c67745f52828d6a5b4819ab762ed18cbbd0fba4.result: The neural network forecasts water levels for horizons of hours to about a day considerably better than tide tables, especially during frontal passages.
7c67745f52828d6a5b4819ab762ed18cbbd0fba4.open_work: Adding forecast winds and extending to other Texas coastal stations.
7c67745f52828d6a5b4819ab762ed18cbbd0fba4.issues: Site-specific; skill decays with lead time; extreme storm surges are rare in training data.

2f243c39d07e007be63826a10352d2e2f161550f.goal: Forecasts daily water demand in irrigation distribution systems to support operation of pumping and distribution networks.
2f243c39d07e007be63826a10352d2e2f161550f.architecture: Feedforward computational neural networks compared with multiple linear regression and univariate time-series (ARIMA-type) models.
2f243c39d07e007be63826a10352d2e2f161550f.data: Daily water demand and climatic records from an irrigation district in southern Spain.
2f243c39d07e007be63826a10352d2e2f161550f.result: Neural networks give lower forecast errors for daily irrigation demand than the regression and time-series models.
2f243c39d07e007be63826a10352d2e2f161550f.open_work: Hybrid approaches and inclusion of crop and management information.
2f243c39d07e007be63826a10352d2e2f161550f.issues: Single irrigation district; demand depends on farmer behaviour not captured by inputs.

33baa2ec11a975453b4118fcf7856042f02c7fff.goal: Produces weighted multi-model projections of South American temperature by weighting IPCC models according to their skill in reproducing observed climate.
33baa2ec11a975453b4118fcf7856042f02c7fff.architecture: Neural network combined with Bayesian statistics to estimate model weights and combine IPCC model simulations; not a single-model emulator.
33baa2ec11a975453b4118fcf7856042f02c7fff.data: 20th-century and scenario simulations from IPCC AR4 (CMIP3) models with observed/reanalysis temperature climatology over South America.
33baa2ec11a975453b4118fcf7856042f02c7fff.result: The weighted ensemble reproduces the observed mean temperature and seasonal cycle better than individual models and projects warming over South America with model-dependent spread.
33baa2ec11a975453b4118fcf7856042f02c7fff.open_work: Part 2 extends the method to precipitation; further work on weighting robustness.
33baa2ec11a975453b4118fcf7856042f02c7fff.issues: Weights based on present-day skill may not reflect projection reliability; observational uncertainty affects weights.

c2976f97ed90b0086d7baad265b7cf12dbb415c7.goal: Retrieves soil moisture from passive microwave brightness temperatures, a nonlinear inversion problem for land remote sensing.
c2976f97ed90b0086d7baad265b7cf12dbb415c7.architecture: Feedforward neural network trained to invert brightness temperatures to soil moisture.
c2976f97ed90b0086d7baad265b7cf12dbb415c7.data: Brightness temperatures simulated by a coupled land surface process and radiobrightness model, not real satellite observations.
c2976f97ed90b0086d7baad265b7cf12dbb415c7.result: The neural network retrieves soil moisture accurately from the simulated brightness temperatures, particularly for near-surface layers.
c2976f97ed90b0086d7baad265b7cf12dbb415c7.open_work: Testing on real radiometer observations and with vegetation and roughness effects.
c2976f97ed90b0086d7baad265b7cf12dbb415c7.issues: Simulation-only study; retrieval error on real data with noise and model mismatch is not assessed.

6e5ce0ed898f5ccc31b76821e91e2010f9676dc6.goal: Provides a graphical sensitivity analysis to interpret statistical climate prediction models, which are often treated as black boxes.
6e5ce0ed898f5ccc31b76821e91e2010f9676dc6.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks and multiple linear regression, analysed with a graphical input-sensitivity method.
6e5ce0ed898f5ccc31b76821e91e2010f9676dc6.data: Indian summer monsoon rainfall with large-scale climate predictors (e.g., ENSO-related indices).
6e5ce0ed898f5ccc31b76821e91e2010f9676dc6.result: The graphical analysis reveals nonlinear predictor-response relations in the neural networks that linear regression misses, while forecast skill differences are modest.
6e5ce0ed898f5ccc31b76821e91e2010f9676dc6.open_work: Applying the interpretation tool to other climate prediction problems.
6e5ce0ed898f5ccc31b76821e91e2010f9676dc6.issues: Short seasonal records limit training; sensitivity plots depend on the fitted ensemble.

05c3925bf74636c5896aa70c4c651549bdac993d.goal: Examines constraints of ANN rainfall-runoff models, especially timing errors caused by using lagged discharge to represent catchment state.
05c3925bf74636c5896aa70c4c651549bdac993d.architecture: Multilayer feedforward neural networks (MLP) with alternative state inputs: moving averages of discharge and rainfall and the GR4J soil moisture component.
05c3925bf74636c5896aa70c4c651549bdac993d.data: Daily and hourly rainfall and runoff data from the Geer catchment, Belgium.
05c3925bf74636c5896aa70c4c651549bdac993d.result: Daily forecasts are good, but hourly forecasts show lagged predictions from the autoregressive input; alternative state representers fix timing but reduce overall fit.
05c3925bf74636c5896aa70c4c651549bdac993d.open_work: Use of multiple performance measures during ANN training to balance timing and fit.
05c3925bf74636c5896aa70c4c651549bdac993d.issues: Single catchment; trade-off between timing and goodness of fit unresolved; multi-objective training only suggested.

c8dc2c97110905bfad5120d5d6c94ec0267396cc.goal: Applies soft computing models to hourly weather analysis and forecasting of surface variables in southern Saskatchewan.
c8dc2c97110905bfad5120d5d6c94ec0267396cc.architecture: Several neural networks, including multilayer perceptron (MLP), Elman recurrent network, radial basis function network and Hopfield model, plus ensembles.
c8dc2c97110905bfad5120d5d6c94ec0267396cc.data: Hourly temperature, wind speed and relative humidity observations from a southern Saskatchewan station (Regina).
c8dc2c97110905bfad5120d5d6c94ec0267396cc.result: The radial basis function network gives the most accurate hourly forecasts, and ensembles improve on individual networks.
c8dc2c97110905bfad5120d5d6c94ec0267396cc.issues: Single station; short training period; seasonal stratification limits generality.

a92c3a16ea48c648e6c36fea0603a9dd4a8200f7.goal: Tests whether nonlinear regression improves seasonal forecasts of tropical Pacific SST anomalies over linear regression.
a92c3a16ea48c648e6c36fea0603a9dd4a8200f7.architecture: Bayesian neural network (BNN) and support vector regression (SVR) compared with linear regression, using PCA-compressed predictors.
a92c3a16ea48c648e6c36fea0603a9dd4a8200f7.data: Sea level pressure and SST predictors for 1950–2005 and 1980–2005, the latter adding equatorial Pacific warm water volume; lead times 3–15 months.
a92c3a16ea48c648e6c36fea0603a9dd4a8200f7.result: Nonlinear models give only modest gains over linear regression; SVR does not beat BNN; nonlinearity appears mainly in the second SST PCA mode; WWV adds slight, linear skill.
a92c3a16ea48c648e6c36fea0603a9dd4a8200f7.open_work: Better use of nonlinear predictors and longer records to exploit nonlinearity.
a92c3a16ea48c648e6c36fea0603a9dd4a8200f7.issues: Short records limit nonlinear model training; few ENSO events; skill gains are marginal.

fc14aafbeae591ed54199b3056c52e9c7f156f4c.goal: Improves rainfall prediction by addressing weaknesses of naive Bayesian classifiers with correlated and numerous meteorological inputs.
fc14aafbeae591ed54199b3056c52e9c7f156f4c.architecture: Improved naive Bayesian classifier coupled with a new input selection/solution method (genetic-algorithm-based selection of inputs).
fc14aafbeae591ed54199b3056c52e9c7f156f4c.data: Daily meteorological observations used to classify rainfall occurrence; source details not reported here.
fc14aafbeae591ed54199b3056c52e9c7f156f4c.result: The improved classifier gives higher rainfall prediction accuracy than the standard naive Bayes classifier and compares favourably with other classifiers.
fc14aafbeae591ed54199b3056c52e9c7f156f4c.open_work: Testing on other locations and on rainfall amount classes.
fc14aafbeae591ed54199b3056c52e9c7f156f4c.issues: Abstract not available; specifics of data and accuracy are uncertain; independence assumptions remain.

4ee089ec4155e869f7ef7fb0509f3c667e18a8ae.goal: Forecasts urban air quality parameters to support air pollution warnings.
4ee089ec4155e869f7ef7fb0509f3c667e18a8ae.architecture: Hybrid neural network modelling combining a self-organizing map (SOM) for data analysis/pre-processing with multilayer perceptron (MLP) forecasting models.
4ee089ec4155e869f7ef7fb0509f3c667e18a8ae.data: Urban air quality monitoring data (e.g., NO2) and meteorological variables from a Finnish city (Kuopio).
4ee089ec4155e869f7ef7fb0509f3c667e18a8ae.result: The hybrid approach produces usable short-term forecasts of air quality parameters; detailed scores not available here.
4ee089ec4155e869f7ef7fb0509f3c667e18a8ae.open_work: Inclusion of meteorological forecasts and testing at more stations.
4ee089ec4155e869f7ef7fb0509f3c667e18a8ae.issues: Abstract not available; single city; limited evaluation details.

2e887ffa5037a591d4f28d8cbe1e5278be00c62f.goal: Estimates the energy yield of wind farms from local meteorological and operational variables.
2e887ffa5037a591d4f28d8cbe1e5278be00c62f.architecture: Feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) trained with backpropagation.
2e887ffa5037a591d4f28d8cbe1e5278be00c62f.data: Three years of monthly wind speed, relative humidity and generation hours with energy output from wind farms in Muppandal, Tamil Nadu, India.
2e887ffa5037a591d4f28d8cbe1e5278be00c62f.result: The ANN estimates wind farm energy output closely, with low mean absolute percentage error against measured production.
2e887ffa5037a591d4f28d8cbe1e5278be00c62f.open_work: Short-term forecasting with forecast inputs and more farms.
2e887ffa5037a591d4f28d8cbe1e5278be00c62f.issues: Monthly aggregated data and a single region; small sample size.

fb73e912b391f0cbd7a04660347011d9da2aa140.goal: Predicts daily global solar irradiance on horizontal surfaces for solar energy applications.
fb73e912b391f0cbd7a04660347011d9da2aa140.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) neural networks combined with a clear-sky model, depending on the forecast cloud condition.
fb73e912b391f0cbd7a04660347011d9da2aa140.data: Daily meteorological and solar irradiance measurements from a station in Athens, Greece.
fb73e912b391f0cbd7a04660347011d9da2aa140.result: The neural-network-based scheme predicts daily global irradiance with good accuracy across sky conditions.
fb73e912b391f0cbd7a04660347011d9da2aa140.open_work: Extension to other sites and hourly resolution.
fb73e912b391f0cbd7a04660347011d9da2aa140.issues: Single station; relies on cloud-condition inputs; limited test period.

e481a3836a8fc643c62e7089bb95f436c483420c.goal: Forecasts river flow by combining wavelet analysis with neural networks to handle multiscale variability.
e481a3836a8fc643c62e7089bb95f436c483420c.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) fed with wavelet-decomposed flow series, compared with networks using raw data.
e481a3836a8fc643c62e7089bb95f436c483420c.data: Monthly river flow records from a catchment in Sardinia, Italy.
e481a3836a8fc643c62e7089bb95f436c483420c.result: Wavelet pre-processing improves neural network flow forecasts compared with networks on undecomposed data.
e481a3836a8fc643c62e7089bb95f436c483420c.open_work: Choice of wavelet and decomposition levels and operational testing.
e481a3836a8fc643c62e7089bb95f436c483420c.issues: Conference abstract with limited detail; possible information leakage from non-causal wavelet decomposition.

352070700667e88250ad4e68d71d49fe1d502da2.goal: Estimates regional reference evapotranspiration from limited climate factors where full Penman-Monteith inputs are unavailable.
352070700667e88250ad4e68d71d49fe1d502da2.architecture: Artificial neural network models (feedforward, backpropagation) with different climate input combinations.
352070700667e88250ad4e68d71d49fe1d502da2.data: Climate station data with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference ET as target in a Chinese (arid/semi-arid) region; details not confirmed.
352070700667e88250ad4e68d71d49fe1d502da2.result: ANN models with a few climate variables approximate Penman-Monteith ET0 well and outperform simpler empirical equations.
352070700667e88250ad4e68d71d49fe1d502da2.open_work: Spatial transferability across stations and climates.
