8d7faaba5c2a3e2959cb43cf24afb365c2899940.data: Station observations over Greece and large-scale predictors from a global climate model under future emission scenarios; model and scenario details are not reported here.
8d7faaba5c2a3e2959cb43cf24afb365c2899940.result: Not reported in the abstract; the two approaches project changes in extreme temperature and rainfall indices that differ in magnitude, especially for precipitation.
8d7faaba5c2a3e2959cb43cf24afb365c2899940.open_work: Using multiple GCMs and downscaling methods to quantify uncertainty in projected extremes.
8d7faaba5c2a3e2959cb43cf24afb365c2899940.issues: Downscaling assumes stationary predictor–predictand relationships; projections depend on the driving GCM.

ff2cef07a2c817e6f8768791b4a702acbca41c05.goal: Speeds up reservoir operation optimization by replacing an expensive hydrodynamic model with a fast surrogate.
ff2cef07a2c817e6f8768791b4a702acbca41c05.architecture: Artificial neural network trained to approximate (emulate) a hydrodynamic model, embedded in an optimization loop for reservoir operation.
ff2cef07a2c817e6f8768791b4a702acbca41c05.data: Simulations from a hydrodynamic model of a reservoir system; specifics are not reported here.
ff2cef07a2c817e6f8768791b4a702acbca41c05.result: Not reported in the abstract; the neural network surrogate reproduces the hydrodynamic model closely and makes optimization computationally feasible.
ff2cef07a2c817e6f8768791b4a702acbca41c05.open_work: Retraining the surrogate within the optimization and extending to multi-objective operation.
ff2cef07a2c817e6f8768791b4a702acbca41c05.issues: Surrogate accuracy is limited outside the training range of the hydrodynamic simulations.

9c95bf1c2b72b06fc5f20fd1bb99a3594edbb0e6.goal: Detects clouds automatically in optical satellite imagery so that cloudy acquisitions can be screened efficiently.
9c95bf1c2b72b06fc5f20fd1bb99a3594edbb0e6.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) classifier distinguishing cloudy from clear pixels or image areas.
9c95bf1c2b72b06fc5f20fd1bb99a3594edbb0e6.data: High-resolution optical satellite imagery; sensors and number of scenes are not reported here.
9c95bf1c2b72b06fc5f20fd1bb99a3594edbb0e6.result: Not reported in the abstract; the SVM approach is presented as giving reliable cloud detection.
9c95bf1c2b72b06fc5f20fd1bb99a3594edbb0e6.open_work: Handling difficult cases such as thin clouds, snow and bright surfaces, and generalizing across sensors.
9c95bf1c2b72b06fc5f20fd1bb99a3594edbb0e6.issues: Bright surfaces such as snow and thin cloud edges are typical sources of misclassification; validation scope is unclear.

9db3b4a8d99e059338822fdf03efafe8becb2985.goal: Forecasts reservoir releases in real time to support operational water management under irrigation demand.
9db3b4a8d99e059338822fdf03efafe8becb2985.architecture: Sparse Bayesian learning machine (relevance vector machine) giving forecasts with predictive uncertainty.
9db3b4a8d99e059338822fdf03efafe8becb2985.data: Reservoir operation, demand and hydrological records from the Sevier River basin, Utah.
9db3b4a8d99e059338822fdf03efafe8becb2985.result: Not reported in the abstract; the relevance vector machine forecasts releases accurately with sparse models and provides uncertainty estimates.
9db3b4a8d99e059338822fdf03efafe8becb2985.open_work: Integration into real-time decision support and extension to other reservoirs and longer horizons.
9db3b4a8d99e059338822fdf03efafe8becb2985.issues: Single-basin application; relationships learned from historical operations may change with management policies.

4566097c74e063e6af46e48082b3defd205de768.goal: Optimizes physical and computational parameters of a mesoscale model to improve quantitative precipitation forecasts of heavy rainfall.
4566097c74e063e6af46e48082b3defd205de768.architecture: Genetic algorithm optimizing two MM5 parameters (Kain-Fritsch CAPE reduction rate and Asselin filter coefficient) with a fitness function based on a QPF skill score; not a neural network.
4566097c74e063e6af46e48082b3defd205de768.data: PSU/NCAR MM5 simulations of a heavy rainfall case over the Korean Peninsula in June 2005, verified against observed precipitation.
4566097c74e063e6af46e48082b3defd205de768.result: Each optimized parameter significantly improves QPF skill, with the largest improvement when both optimized parameters are used together.
4566097c74e063e6af46e48082b3defd205de768.open_work: Optimizing more parameters and testing robustness of the optimized values across many cases and seasons.
4566097c74e063e6af46e48082b3defd205de768.issues: Optimization and evaluation on a single heavy rainfall case risks overfitting the parameters to that event.

82aa357b5a9f32a2f8d657793ca7b228c09f2c95.goal: Downscales and forecasts evapotranspiration at fine spatial scales for water management, combining multiscale analysis with machine learning.
82aa357b5a9f32a2f8d657793ca7b228c09f2c95.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet decomposition and support vector machines (SVMs) for downscaling and forecasting evapotranspiration fields.
82aa357b5a9f32a2f8d657793ca7b228c09f2c95.data: Remotely sensed evapotranspiration fields and related inputs at multiple resolutions; region and period are not reported here.
82aa357b5a9f32a2f8d657793ca7b228c09f2c95.result: Not reported in the abstract; the wavelet–SVM model downscales and forecasts evapotranspiration with good accuracy.
82aa357b5a9f32a2f8d657793ca7b228c09f2c95.open_work: Testing in other regions and with different satellite products and longer forecast horizons.
82aa357b5a9f32a2f8d657793ca7b228c09f2c95.issues: Dependence on the quality of the remote-sensing evapotranspiration estimates used for training.

fb369cde8120acb5010d6c4c757fec7cfbbc0a58.goal: Predicts typhoon storm surge along the coast of Taiwan quickly for coastal hazard warning.
fb369cde8120acb5010d6c4c757fec7cfbbc0a58.architecture: Artificial neural network (back-propagation feed-forward network) relating typhoon characteristics to storm surge levels.
fb369cde8120acb5010d6c4c757fec7cfbbc0a58.data: Typhoon parameters (pressure, wind speed and direction) and observed tide and surge records at coastal tide stations in Taiwan; events and period are not reported here.
fb369cde8120acb5010d6c4c757fec7cfbbc0a58.result: Not reported in the abstract; the neural network predicts storm surge well for the typhoon events tested.
fb369cde8120acb5010d6c4c757fec7cfbbc0a58.open_work: Longer lead times, more stations and events, and comparison with hydrodynamic surge models.
fb369cde8120acb5010d6c4c757fec7cfbbc0a58.issues: Limited number of typhoon events; extrapolation to stronger or unusual tracks is uncertain.

8e02e0ff833997db6554c8fdfbd16dafd8fe32c0.goal: Investigates which inputs a neural network rainfall-runoff model relies on, to open the black box and guide model design.
8e02e0ff833997db6554c8fdfbd16dafd8fe32c0.architecture: Feed-forward neural network rainfall-runoff model analysed with saliency analysis, measuring sensitivity of outputs to each input.
8e02e0ff833997db6554c8fdfbd16dafd8fe32c0.data: Rainfall and river flow records for a catchment; site and period are not reported here.
8e02e0ff833997db6554c8fdfbd16dafd8fe32c0.result: Not reported in the abstract; saliency analysis identifies the relative importance of inputs and shows it can help interpret and simplify the network.
8e02e0ff833997db6554c8fdfbd16dafd8fe32c0.open_work: Applying interpretation techniques routinely and comparing saliency results across catchments and network structures.
8e02e0ff833997db6554c8fdfbd16dafd8fe32c0.issues: Saliency results depend on the trained network instance and may not reflect physical causality.

38fa5f4a94e1c87e07f84c556300413dc569e65d.goal: Retrieves several ocean surface and atmospheric parameters simultaneously from SSM/I satellite microwave measurements for operational use at NCEP.
38fa5f4a94e1c87e07f84c556300413dc569e65d.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network multiparameter algorithm retrieving wind speed, columnar water vapor, liquid water and sea surface temperature together from brightness temperatures.
38fa5f4a94e1c87e07f84c556300413dc569e65d.data: SSM/I brightness temperatures matched with buoy and other in situ observations.
38fa5f4a94e1c87e07f84c556300413dc569e65d.result: Not reported in the abstract; the multiparameter neural network retrieves wind speed more accurately than earlier global regression algorithms, including under cloudy conditions.
38fa5f4a94e1c87e07f84c556300413dc569e65d.open_work: Extension to other microwave sensors and improved retrieval of the secondary parameters.
38fa5f4a94e1c87e07f84c556300413dc569e65d.issues: Accuracy is limited at high wind speeds and by the coverage of the matchup training data.

d9a6bd8a95d57850fcbd87209a1f86bc4c00555f.goal: Derives operating rules for a reservoir system from historical or optimized operations so they can be applied in practice.
d9a6bd8a95d57850fcbd87209a1f86bc4c00555f.architecture: Decision trees, neural decision trees and fuzzy decision trees compared for extracting reservoir operating rules.
d9a6bd8a95d57850fcbd87209a1f86bc4c00555f.data: Reservoir operation records or optimization results for a reservoir system; system and period is not reported here.
d9a6bd8a95d57850fcbd87209a1f86bc4c00555f.result: Not reported in the abstract; the comparison identifies differences in accuracy and interpretability among the three tree-based approaches.
d9a6bd8a95d57850fcbd87209a1f86bc4c00555f.open_work: Testing the derived rules in real-time operation and under changing inflows.
d9a6bd8a95d57850fcbd87209a1f86bc4c00555f.issues: Rules learned from a limited operational record may not cover extreme droughts or floods.

63f245e061f149e304454ff56deb1c290bdc8b87.goal: Forecasts daily summertime maximum surface ozone concentrations in the Lower Fraser Valley, British Columbia, for air quality warnings.
63f245e061f149e304454ff56deb1c290bdc8b87.architecture: Ensemble of multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks for daily ozone forecasting.
63f245e061f149e304454ff56deb1c290bdc8b87.data: Surface ozone and meteorological observations in the Lower Fraser Valley, British Columbia, during summer seasons.
63f245e061f149e304454ff56deb1c290bdc8b87.result: Not reported in the abstract; the ensemble neural network approach is presented as giving skilful and more robust ozone forecasts.
63f245e061f149e304454ff56deb1c290bdc8b87.open_work: Using forecast meteorology as inputs for operational use and improving prediction of high-ozone episodes.
63f245e061f149e304454ff56deb1c290bdc8b87.issues: Peak ozone episodes are rare and tend to be underpredicted; trained with observed rather than forecast meteorology.

4da079ff2dbbabe2c17399f9a4446be7ae25d98e.goal: Classifies and predicts precipitation occurrence from meteorological variables with an evolutionary method.
4da079ff2dbbabe2c17399f9a4446be7ae25d98e.architecture: Genetic algorithm used to derive classification rules or boundaries for precipitation occurrence; not a neural network.
4da079ff2dbbabe2c17399f9a4446be7ae25d98e.data: Meteorological observations and precipitation records from stations; location and period are not reported here.
4da079ff2dbbabe2c17399f9a4446be7ae25d98e.result: Not reported in the abstract; the genetic algorithm classifies precipitation occurrence with useful accuracy.
4da079ff2dbbabe2c17399f9a4446be7ae25d98e.open_work: Extension to precipitation amounts and comparison with other classifiers.
4da079ff2dbbabe2c17399f9a4446be7ae25d98e.issues: Limited station data and evaluation details unclear.

663dd4d3cc60fca1cf9cd97d83834a1a973adfed.goal: Homogenizes daily and sub-daily temperature records affected by station relocations or instrument changes, beyond what monthly adjustments can correct.
663dd4d3cc60fca1cf9cd97d83834a1a973adfed.architecture: Nearest-neighbour resampling method that adjusts daily and sub-daily temperatures using parallel measurements; non-deep statistical method.
663dd4d3cc60fca1cf9cd97d83834a1a973adfed.data: Daily and sub-daily temperature records with parallel observations, from the De Bilt station in the Netherlands.
663dd4d3cc60fca1cf9cd97d83834a1a973adfed.result: Not reported in the abstract; nearest-neighbour resampling corrects inhomogeneities in the distribution of daily and sub-daily temperatures, not just the mean.
663dd4d3cc60fca1cf9cd97d83834a1a973adfed.open_work: Application to other stations and variables and in cases where parallel measurements are short or absent.
663dd4d3cc60fca1cf9cd97d83834a1a973adfed.issues: Requires overlapping parallel measurements; resampling cannot create values outside the observed range.

1f28aeae14e8101b55e8747c3b135b0615d2b432.goal: Reviews the use of neural networks for estimating rainfall from satellite observations.
1f28aeae14e8101b55e8747c3b135b0615d2b432.architecture: Review of neural network methods (mainly multilayer perceptrons and related networks) for satellite rainfall estimation from infrared and passive microwave data.
1f28aeae14e8101b55e8747c3b135b0615d2b432.data: Review; covers studies using geostationary infrared and passive microwave satellite observations with gauge and radar references.
1f28aeae14e8101b55e8747c3b135b0615d2b432.result: Neural networks are shown to be flexible tools for combining satellite inputs to estimate rainfall, with advantages over simple statistical techniques.
1f28aeae14e8101b55e8747c3b135b0615d2b432.open_work: Better training data, merging multiple sensors and quantifying retrieval uncertainty.
1f28aeae14e8101b55e8747c3b135b0615d2b432.issues: Review perspective; performance depends on training data quality and networks act as black boxes.

5b1600392ecd816f810941ece945159c7a84b5b0.goal: Analyses meteorological drought in the Lakes District of Turkey using data-driven models.
5b1600392ecd816f810941ece945159c7a84b5b0.architecture: Data-driven models applied to drought indices; the specific model types are not specified here.
5b1600392ecd816f810941ece945159c7a84b5b0.data: Precipitation records and derived drought indices for stations in the Lakes District, Turkey; period is not reported here.
5b1600392ecd816f810941ece945159c7a84b5b0.result: Not reported in the abstract; the data-driven models are shown to be useful for analysing and estimating drought index values.
5b1600392ecd816f810941ece945159c7a84b5b0.open_work: Longer lead drought forecasting and inclusion of climate indices as predictors.
5b1600392ecd816f810941ece945159c7a84b5b0.issues: Regional, station-based study with limited data; generality is unclear.

f994043885b5dbcf4109c83b70d602ddf37303d0.goal: Downscales short-term extreme rainfall from large-scale atmospheric conditions to support flood and climate impact studies.
f994043885b5dbcf4109c83b70d602ddf37303d0.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) for statistical atmospheric downscaling of short-duration rainfall.
f994043885b5dbcf4109c83b70d602ddf37303d0.data: Large-scale atmospheric predictors and observed short-term rainfall for a study region; region and period is not reported here.
f994043885b5dbcf4109c83b70d602ddf37303d0.result: Not reported in the abstract; the neural network downscaling is presented as capturing short-term extreme rainfall with useful skill.
f994043885b5dbcf4109c83b70d602ddf37303d0.open_work: Application to climate model output for projections and improving prediction of the most extreme intensities.
f994043885b5dbcf4109c83b70d602ddf37303d0.issues: Regression-type downscaling commonly underestimates the most extreme intensities; transferability to future climates is untested.

f0cc9cdceaa7309492b5384244996d0af0214242.goal: Predicts seasonal to inter-annual climate variables with a data-mining approach.
f0cc9cdceaa7309492b5384244996d0af0214242.architecture: K-nearest neighbour (KNN) data-mining technique using historical analogues.
f0cc9cdceaa7309492b5384244996d0af0214242.data: Historical meteorological records (e.g. temperature and precipitation); region and period are not reported here.
f0cc9cdceaa7309492b5384244996d0af0214242.result: Not reported in the abstract; KNN gives reasonable seasonal predictions.
f0cc9cdceaa7309492b5384244996d0af0214242.open_work: Comparison with dynamical and other statistical models and use of climate indices as predictors.
f0cc9cdceaa7309492b5384244996d0af0214242.issues: Analogue methods are limited by record length and cannot extrapolate beyond past climate.

d94eb3a80806c0b4e25bded249a54f615d0c0fb6.goal: Characterizes and estimates energy production of wind farms within a region.
d94eb3a80806c0b4e25bded249a54f615d0c0fb6.architecture: Artificial neural networks relating wind and site information to wind farm energy production.
d94eb3a80806c0b4e25bded249a54f615d0c0fb6.data: Wind measurements and wind farm production records for a region; specifics are not reported here.
d94eb3a80806c0b4e25bded249a54f615d0c0fb6.result: Not reported in the abstract; neural networks estimate wind farm energy production in the zone.
d94eb3a80806c0b4e25bded249a54f615d0c0fb6.open_work: Extension to forecasting with numerical weather prediction inputs.
d94eb3a80806c0b4e25bded249a54f615d0c0fb6.issues: Limited data and evaluation details unclear.

69d9777f0f9b29bd634829b71f1947be2607c9da.goal: Forecasts PM2.5 and carbon monoxide near an urban expressway, where traffic emissions create high pollutant concentrations.
69d9777f0f9b29bd634829b71f1947be2607c9da.architecture: Multiple linear regression compared with artificial neural network models.
69d9777f0f9b29bd634829b71f1947be2607c9da.data: Hourly PM2.5, CO, traffic and meteorological measurements at the Borman Expressway, Indiana.
69d9777f0f9b29bd634829b71f1947be2607c9da.result: Not reported in the abstract; the study compares regression and neural network forecasts of PM2.5 and CO, with neural networks performing at least as well.
69d9777f0f9b29bd634829b71f1947be2607c9da.open_work: Using forecast meteorology and traffic data for operational forecasting.
69d9777f0f9b29bd634829b71f1947be2607c9da.issues: Single site; limited generalization to other roads and conditions.

327a2864a195cbc907a6701369560f1f1f43bcad.goal: Forecasts monthly and seasonal summer monsoon rainfall over Orissa, India, exploiting lagged teleconnections with large-scale climate indices.
327a2864a195cbc907a6701369560f1f1f43bcad.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type ANN) whose architecture is optimized with a genetic optimizer (genetic algorithm), using lagged climate indices as inputs.
327a2864a195cbc907a6701369560f1f1f43bcad.data: Monthly Orissa rainfall for June to September plus ENSO, EQUINOO and Ocean-Land Temperature Contrast (OLTC) indices; separate training and testing periods (years not reported in the abstract).
327a2864a195cbc907a6701369560f1f1f43bcad.result: Reasonably good accuracy for both individual monsoon months and total JJAS rainfall; large-scale teleconnection indices are shown to carry useful predictive information.
327a2864a195cbc907a6701369560f1f1f43bcad.open_work: Extend predictor sets and compare with dynamical seasonal forecasts and other statistical baselines; test robustness to changing teleconnections.
327a2864a195cbc907a6701369560f1f1f43bcad.issues: Short monsoon record and small sample; skill reported only qualitatively in the abstract; no uncertainty quantification or comparison with climatology given.

640b75420551fd48322255921edfc9d039e5e6a5.goal: Generates synthetic solar radiation time series for solar energy system design where long measured records are unavailable.
640b75420551fd48322255921edfc9d039e5e6a5.architecture: Recurrent neural network (supervised recurrent MLP-based model) that produces radiation series sequentially from previous values.
640b75420551fd48322255921edfc9d039e5e6a5.data: Measured solar radiation series from Spanish stations; exact sites and periods not reported here.
640b75420551fd48322255921edfc9d039e5e6a5.result: The recurrent networks reproduce statistical properties of the measured series reasonably well; quantitative scores not reported here.
640b75420551fd48322255921edfc9d039e5e6a5.open_work: Test generalization to other climates and compare with classical stochastic generators.
640b75420551fd48322255921edfc9d039e5e6a5.issues: Abstract unavailable; site-specific training and limited validation of extreme or long-term statistics.

023cf7b313c026cfd4adda505d2584d6c17a4546.goal: Estimates wind power output from wind measurements to support wind energy assessment and integration.
023cf7b313c026cfd4adda505d2584d6c17a4546.architecture: Artificial neural network; the specific network type and configuration are not specified in the available information.
023cf7b313c026cfd4adda505d2584d6c17a4546.data: Not reported in the available information.
023cf7b313c026cfd4adda505d2584d6c17a4546.result: The ANN is reported as a viable estimator of wind power; quantitative details not reported here.
023cf7b313c026cfd4adda505d2584d6c17a4546.open_work: Compare with physical power-curve approaches and extend to forecasting with NWP inputs.
023cf7b313c026cfd4adda505d2584d6c17a4546.issues: Abstract unavailable; site-specific evaluation with limited data; no uncertainty estimates reported.

2536df0f1ee8f6bf24722238d758ab39aef71c0f.goal: Forecasts short-term thunderstorm occurrence and rainfall using indices derived from radiosonde soundings, to support operational convective forecasting in north-eastern Italy.
2536df0f1ee8f6bf24722238d758ab39aef71c0f.architecture: MLP neural networks taking sounding-derived instability and moisture indices as inputs, with predictor selection, for classification (thunderstorm yes/no) and rainfall regression.
2536df0f1ee8f6bf24722238d758ab39aef71c0f.data: Radiosoundings from Udine-Campoformido with lightning and rain gauge observations over the Friuli Venezia Giulia plain; multi-year archive.
2536df0f1ee8f6bf24722238d758ab39aef71c0f.result: Neural networks using a few selected sounding indices outperform single-index forecasts for thunderstorm occurrence; rainfall amount is harder to predict.
2536df0f1ee8f6bf24722238d758ab39aef71c0f.open_work: Combine sounding indices with NWP output and extend to other regions and to severe convective phenomena.
2536df0f1ee8f6bf24722238d758ab39aef71c0f.issues: Single sounding site representing a region; rare event classes limit training; skill for rainfall amounts modest.

416d4b9550be72a9a7c92cc114193ab73d806735.goal: Predicts summer rainfall in the Yangtze River basin months ahead, where floods and droughts cause major impacts.
416d4b9550be72a9a7c92cc114193ab73d806735.architecture: Backpropagation neural networks (MLP) using climate indices and large-scale predictors.
416d4b9550be72a9a7c92cc114193ab73d806735.data: Station precipitation in the Yangtze basin and large-scale predictors such as SST, ENSO indices and Tibetan Plateau snow; exact selection not reported here.
416d4b9550be72a9a7c92cc114193ab73d806735.result: The networks provide useful skill for summer rainfall prediction over parts of the basin; quantitative scores not reported here.
416d4b9550be72a9a7c92cc114193ab73d806735.open_work: Refine predictor selection and test in operational seasonal forecasting.
416d4b9550be72a9a7c92cc114193ab73d806735.issues: Abstract unavailable; short records relative to network complexity; risk of overfitting and nonstationary teleconnections.

0316374ff1199b079471543f239fe68622a97cec.goal: Forecasts river discharge in Amazonia using large-scale climate information, for water resources and hydropower planning.
0316374ff1199b079471543f239fe68622a97cec.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feed-forward MLP) with ocean-atmosphere predictors.
0316374ff1199b079471543f239fe68622a97cec.data: Observed discharge of Amazonian rivers with sea surface temperature predictors from the tropical Pacific and Atlantic; periods not reported here.
0316374ff1199b079471543f239fe68622a97cec.result: ANN forecasts achieve useful skill for seasonal discharge; quantitative details not reported here.
0316374ff1199b079471543f239fe68622a97cec.open_work: Extend to more basins and lead times; compare with linear statistical and hydrological models.
0316374ff1199b079471543f239fe68622a97cec.issues: Abstract unavailable; few years of data relative to network parameters; teleconnection-based skill may vary over time.

056470255553f5e5061dc0020ffbd040b7592f8a.goal: Forecasts ozone concentration time series to support air quality warnings.
056470255553f5e5061dc0020ffbd040b7592f8a.architecture: MLP neural network trained with a novel hybrid training algorithm combining global search with gradient-based learning to avoid local minima.
056470255553f5e5061dc0020ffbd040b7592f8a.data: Ozone and related air quality and meteorological time series from urban monitoring stations; details not reported here.
056470255553f5e5061dc0020ffbd040b7592f8a.result: The hybrid-trained MLP improves forecast accuracy and convergence over standard backpropagation training; numbers not reported here.
056470255553f5e5061dc0020ffbd040b7592f8a.open_work: Test on other pollutants and sites; compare with other learning algorithms.
056470255553f5e5061dc0020ffbd040b7592f8a.issues: Abstract unavailable; evaluation limited to specific stations; no uncertainty quantification.

9493c723823870200572c0959b413a8ea7fbc930.goal: Estimates significant wave height over time from wind speed measurements for ocean engineering applications.
9493c723823870200572c0959b413a8ea7fbc930.architecture: Perceptron (single-layer neural network) combined with Kalman filtering to update weights recursively.
9493c723823870200572c0959b413a8ea7fbc930.data: Wind speed and significant wave height measurements; buoy source and period not reported here.
9493c723823870200572c0959b413a8ea7fbc930.result: The perceptron Kalman filtering approach estimates wave heights with acceptable accuracy; quantitative scores not reported here.
9493c723823870200572c0959b413a8ea7fbc930.open_work: Extend to multiple inputs (fetch, duration, direction) and to forecasting at longer leads.
9493c723823870200572c0959b413a8ea7fbc930.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-input model ignores swell and fetch effects; site-specific.

ebd21ad05b01ca3c954c019c9094686c544ddba1.goal: Reconstructs ensembles of annual streamflow from paleoclimate proxies to characterize long-term hydrologic variability beyond the instrumental record.
ebd21ad05b01ca3c954c019c9094686c544ddba1.architecture: Nonparametric K-nearest neighbour resampling approach conditioned on tree-ring predictors, producing streamflow ensembles; not a neural network.
ebd21ad05b01ca3c954c019c9094686c544ddba1.data: Tree-ring chronologies and observed (naturalized) annual streamflow of the Colorado River at Lees Ferry.
ebd21ad05b01ca3c954c019c9094686c544ddba1.result: The K-nearest neighbour method yields ensemble reconstructions comparable to regression reconstructions while capturing uncertainty and nonlinearity.
ebd21ad05b01ca3c954c019c9094686c544ddba1.open_work: Use the ensembles in water resources planning and drought risk assessment; extend to other basins and multisite reconstruction.
ebd21ad05b01ca3c954c019c9094686c544ddba1.issues: Resampling cannot produce values outside the observed range; proxy-streamflow relations treated as stationary.

ac6089098807a1bf687cd7ef48c6c651cd25f62c.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall using soft computing techniques for agriculture and water management.
ac6089098807a1bf687cd7ef48c6c651cd25f62c.architecture: Comparison of soft computing models (neural networks and neuro-fuzzy systems) with multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS).
ac6089098807a1bf687cd7ef48c6c651cd25f62c.data: Long monthly rainfall record from Kerala, India; exact period not reported here.
ac6089098807a1bf687cd7ef48c6c651cd25f62c.result: The soft computing models and MARS give comparable forecast accuracy, with differences in error and training cost; exact numbers not reported here.
ac6089098807a1bf687cd7ef48c6c651cd25f62c.open_work: Ensembles or hybrids of the compared models and inclusion of climate predictors.
ac6089098807a1bf687cd7ef48c6c651cd25f62c.issues: Abstract unavailable; univariate rainfall series only; single region.

46883d2d875e7e5f9ed2a6e6e405b5c30b4564cb.goal: Develops an operational warning system for tropospheric ozone peaks in Bordeaux, France, to inform the public of exceedances.
46883d2d875e7e5f9ed2a6e6e405b5c30b4564cb.architecture: Model-based statistical forecasting of ozone concentrations; the model type is not specified in the available information.
46883d2d875e7e5f9ed2a6e6e405b5c30b4564cb.data: Ozone and meteorological observations from the Bordeaux air quality monitoring network.
46883d2d875e7e5f9ed2a6e6e405b5c30b4564cb.result: The system provides operationally useful warnings of ozone exceedances; quantitative skill not reported here.
46883d2d875e7e5f9ed2a6e6e405b5c30b4564cb.open_work: Extend to other pollutants and improve with NWP forecast inputs.
46883d2d875e7e5f9ed2a6e6e405b5c30b4564cb.issues: Abstract unavailable; single urban area; evaluation details unknown.

a94c993ebeebfb81c1e630636f3c2edbded2c626.goal: Improves soil moisture prediction by combining a data-driven forecast model with data assimilation of observations.
a94c993ebeebfb81c1e630636f3c2edbded2c626.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression for soil moisture prediction coupled with an ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF) for assimilation.
a94c993ebeebfb81c1e630636f3c2edbded2c626.data: Station soil moisture and meteorological observations; site details not reported here.
a94c993ebeebfb81c1e630636f3c2edbded2c626.result: Assimilating observations with the EnKF improves the SVM soil moisture predictions; quantitative gains not reported here.
a94c993ebeebfb81c1e630636f3c2edbded2c626.open_work: Extend to spatially distributed and remotely sensed soil moisture.
a94c993ebeebfb81c1e630636f3c2edbded2c626.issues: Abstract unavailable; point-scale application; limited test periods.

fc80294d422888465f80deb39f05e20340530487.goal: Delineates homogeneous pooling groups of catchments for regional flood frequency analysis.
fc80294d422888465f80deb39f05e20340530487.architecture: Fuzzy expert system for assigning catchments to pooling groups, enhanced with a genetic algorithm to tune the fuzzy rules and membership functions.
fc80294d422888465f80deb39f05e20340530487.data: Catchment attributes and flood records from gauged basins; region not reported here.
fc80294d422888465f80deb39f05e20340530487.result: The genetically enhanced fuzzy system produces acceptably homogeneous pooling groups; details not reported here.

fc80294d422888465f80deb39f05e20340530487.issues: Abstract unavailable; homogeneity depends on chosen attributes; limited generality.

0b8b30a174464cc05700066a2b14f777ca728718.goal: Predicts airport cloud ceiling and visibility by finding analogous past weather situations.
0b8b30a174464cc05700066a2b14f777ca728718.architecture: Case-based reasoning with fuzzy set theory: a fuzzy k-nearest neighbour analogue method (WIND system) that retrieves similar historical cases.
0b8b30a174464cc05700066a2b14f777ca728718.data: Several decades of archived hourly surface observations at an airport (Halifax, Canada); exact period not reported here.
0b8b30a174464cc05700066a2b14f777ca728718.result: The fuzzy analogue system gives skilful short-term ceiling and visibility forecasts, comparable to or better than persistence and climatology.
0b8b30a174464cc05700066a2b14f777ca728718.open_work: Incorporate NWP output and extend to other airports and variables.
0b8b30a174464cc05700066a2b14f777ca728718.issues: Analogue performance limited for rare events with few historical matches; single-site evaluation.

095d75884bc5a421a1657d9c63d256dac73fdefb.goal: Estimates surface solar radiation from routine meteorological measurements where radiometers are lacking.
095d75884bc5a421a1657d9c63d256dac73fdefb.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feed-forward MLP) compared with empirical Angstrom-type models.
095d75884bc5a421a1657d9c63d256dac73fdefb.data: Measured solar radiation, sunshine duration and temperature in Cyprus; period not reported here.
095d75884bc5a421a1657d9c63d256dac73fdefb.result: The ANN models estimate solar radiation more accurately than the empirical Angstrom approach; numbers not reported here.
095d75884bc5a421a1657d9c63d256dac73fdefb.open_work: Extend to other stations and to satellite-based inputs.
095d75884bc5a421a1657d9c63d256dac73fdefb.issues: Abstract unavailable; limited station network; generalization untested.

ba3ffeff91c97f9293f9576558a3a81dd8ebebcd.goal: Retrieves global rain and snowfall rates, including Arctic precipitation over snow and ice, from millimeter-wave satellite sounders.
ba3ffeff91c97f9293f9576558a3a81dd8ebebcd.architecture: Separate neural networks for land and sea (warm and cold ocean treated differently), applied to principal components of brightness temperatures after surface filtering and nadir correction.
ba3ffeff91c97f9293f9576558a3a81dd8ebebcd.data: AMSU millimeter-wave brightness temperatures; training on MM5 mesoscale model simulations; validation with CloudSat radar and 231 global rain gauges.
ba3ffeff91c97f9293f9576558a3a81dd8ebebcd.result: Snowfall detections agree with nearly coincident CloudSat observations, and annual precipitation agrees reasonably with 231 rain gauges, including snow-dominated sites.
ba3ffeff91c97f9293f9576558a3a81dd8ebebcd.open_work: Further validation in cold regions and extension to other millimeter-wave sensors.
ba3ffeff91c97f9293f9576558a3a81dd8ebebcd.issues: Training relies on MM5 simulations so model microphysics biases propagate; surface effects over snow and ice remain challenging.

2f82f66235f7ef3a90abbb5d3d4bd799794a5deb.goal: Predicts tropical cyclone tracks in the north Indian Ocean to improve warning for coastal populations.
2f82f66235f7ef3a90abbb5d3d4bd799794a5deb.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward MLP) using recent cyclone positions to predict future positions.
2f82f66235f7ef3a90abbb5d3d4bd799794a5deb.data: Best-track cyclone positions for the north Indian Ocean; period not reported here.
2f82f66235f7ef3a90abbb5d3d4bd799794a5deb.result: The ANN predicts 24-h cyclone positions with errors smaller than climatology-persistence and comparable operational methods; exact errors not reported here.

2f82f66235f7ef3a90abbb5d3d4bd799794a5deb.issues: Abstract unavailable; uses only track history, so cannot anticipate recurvature driven by environmental changes; small sample of storms.

9857ba40590902f910ab4e2d9d293416eae822e0.goal: Forecasts wind farm power output by applying data mining methods to numerical weather prediction inputs.
9857ba40590902f910ab4e2d9d293416eae822e0.architecture: Comparison of data mining models including neural networks, support vector machines, random forests and linear regression.
9857ba40590902f910ab4e2d9d293416eae822e0.data: Wind farm power measurements and NWP forecasts; sites and period not reported here.
9857ba40590902f910ab4e2d9d293416eae822e0.result: Nonlinear data mining models such as random forests and neural networks improve over simpler baselines, though differences are modest; numbers not reported here.
9857ba40590902f910ab4e2d9d293416eae822e0.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and combination of models.
9857ba40590902f910ab4e2d9d293416eae822e0.issues: Abstract unavailable; site-specific evaluation; NWP errors limit achievable skill.

6374feef6feb2fe9ca84e61276e59c67fbc20794.goal: Predicts daily maximum ozone concentrations from meteorological conditions for air quality forecasting.
6374feef6feb2fe9ca84e61276e59c67fbc20794.architecture: Two-stage neural network scheme; the specific network types of each stage are not specified in the available information.
6374feef6feb2fe9ca84e61276e59c67fbc20794.data: Ozone and meteorological observations from monitoring stations; region and period not reported here.
6374feef6feb2fe9ca84e61276e59c67fbc20794.result: The two-stage network improves prediction of daily maximum ozone over single-stage models; numbers not reported here.
6374feef6feb2fe9ca84e61276e59c67fbc20794.open_work: Extend to other sites and forecast lead times using NWP inputs.
6374feef6feb2fe9ca84e61276e59c67fbc20794.issues: Abstract unavailable; limited evaluation details; possible underprediction of extreme peaks.

70e64745240e81a64cb29d67de24fcd0084b0786.goal: Improves prediction of sweetpotato harvest date and yield in Louisiana using growing degree days and agrometeorological variables.
70e64745240e81a64cb29d67de24fcd0084b0786.architecture: Linear regression compared with data mining algorithms: neural networks, support vector machine, multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS), regression trees and generalized linear models.
70e64745240e81a64cb29d67de24fcd0084b0786.data: 116 planting dates in Louisiana with temperature, humidity and soil temperature records and US#1 yield.
70e64745240e81a64cb29d67de24fcd0084b0786.result: A capped GDD method in a multivariable linear model gives the best adjusted r2 and high predictive accuracy; test harvests are proposed at GDD = 2600.
70e64745240e81a64cb29d67de24fcd0084b0786.open_work: Validate at other locations and seasons and refine yield prediction with early-season climate variables.
70e64745240e81a64cb29d67de24fcd0084b0786.issues: Small single-region dataset; data mining methods offer little advantage over linear regression; variable selection may overfit.

23dc20d759af4a1233d79771dca8eb0664c07cae.goal: Models the rainfall-runoff relationship of catchments with adaptive neuro-fuzzy systems.
23dc20d759af4a1233d79771dca8eb0664c07cae.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) combining fuzzy rules with neural network learning.
23dc20d759af4a1233d79771dca8eb0664c07cae.data: Observed rainfall and runoff data from a catchment; details not reported here.

23dc20d759af4a1233d79771dca8eb0664c07cae.issues: Abstract unavailable; rule base grows with inputs; limited physical interpretability.

e205a8ac5805eca612d615e89256232cd4d6e768.goal: Characterizes tropical Indian Ocean climate variability patterns, including the Indian Ocean Dipole, without assuming linear orthogonal modes.
e205a8ac5805eca612d615e89256232cd4d6e768.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) neural network classification of sea surface temperature anomaly patterns.
e205a8ac5805eca612d615e89256232cd4d6e768.data: Sea surface temperature anomalies of the tropical Indian Ocean from observations and/or coupled model output; datasets not reported here.

e205a8ac5805eca612d615e89256232cd4d6e768.issues: Abstract unavailable; results depend on SOM size and settings; diagnostic study only.

26672425c49ec68c445b9dd0821a6b2a9d86a687.goal: Interpolates precipitation spatially from rain gauges to estimate rainfall at ungauged locations.
26672425c49ec68c445b9dd0821a6b2a9d86a687.architecture: Fuzzy theory combined with a genetic algorithm to determine interpolation weights, compared with conventional interpolation methods; not a neural network.
26672425c49ec68c445b9dd0821a6b2a9d86a687.data: Rain gauge precipitation data from a watershed; region not reported here.
26672425c49ec68c445b9dd0821a6b2a9d86a687.result: The fuzzy-genetic interpolation gives lower errors than conventional methods such as inverse distance weighting; numbers not reported here.

26672425c49ec68c445b9dd0821a6b2a9d86a687.issues: Abstract unavailable; dependence on gauge density; no uncertainty estimates.

22771d9a0d18b54c298e9b4e67fb4c7503acc327.goal: Compares alternative neural network designs for simulating monthly runoff from rainfall.
22771d9a0d18b54c298e9b4e67fb4c7503acc327.architecture: Three artificial neural network designs (feed-forward MLP variants with different input and structural configurations).
22771d9a0d18b54c298e9b4e67fb4c7503acc327.data: Monthly rainfall and runoff records from a watershed in the United States; details not reported here.

22771d9a0d18b54c298e9b4e67fb4c7503acc327.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-watershed comparison; generalization uncertain.

11896abd4f977ec5c237209e8fb95f27da7c9f46.goal: Models solar radiation across China's thermal and solar climatic zones for building energy and solar applications.
11896abd4f977ec5c237209e8fb95f27da7c9f46.architecture: Angstrom-Prescott regression compared with artificial neural networks (feed-forward MLP).

67311ab211bc595de8792aaa62aa62230f1203f1.goal: Predicts local wind at specific sites, which numerical models resolve poorly in complex terrain.

e0c25fbf6015f49be587bee70435213935dc601b.issues: Abstract unavailable; targets may be computed from Penman-Monteith rather than measured.

4c49130956e9cfe6e384f50aa9c142c639b943e2.goal: Forecasts electricity generation of a grid-connected solar PV power plant.

281f8840c09acf96c0d27c66547609297da38e9b.goal: Forecasts the Palmer drought index to support drought early warning.
281f8840c09acf96c0d27c66547609297da38e9b.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feed-forward MLP) using past index values and large-scale climatic indices such as the NAO as inputs.

098eb0a26d2298e07ddcbf1e831bbfe61ba5e2b2.goal: Forecasts peak floods by combining multiple data-driven models.
098eb0a26d2298e07ddcbf1e831bbfe61ba5e2b2.architecture: Hybrid multi-model combining several data-driven forecasting models; the specific component types are not specified in the available information.
098eb0a26d2298e07ddcbf1e831bbfe61ba5e2b2.data: Rainfall and discharge records from a river basin; region not reported here.
098eb0a26d2298e07ddcbf1e831bbfe61ba5e2b2.result: The hybrid multi-model improves peak flood forecasts over individual models; numbers not reported here.
098eb0a26d2298e07ddcbf1e831bbfe61ba5e2b2.open_work: Test on more basins and events.
098eb0a26d2298e07ddcbf1e831bbfe61ba5e2b2.issues: Abstract unavailable; few peak flood events for training and testing.

46f5969fe36553c627788f69643da9269fd2da29.goal: Provides an explicit, easy-to-use formulation of reference evapotranspiration derived from a neural network.
46f5969fe36553c627788f69643da9269fd2da29.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) whose trained weights are written as an explicit equation.
46f5969fe36553c627788f69643da9269fd2da29.data: Daily climatic data from weather stations with reference evapotranspiration targets; sites not reported here.
46f5969fe36553c627788f69643da9269fd2da29.result: The explicit neural network formula estimates evapotranspiration accurately compared with empirical equations; numbers not reported here.
46f5969fe36553c627788f69643da9269fd2da29.issues: Abstract unavailable; formulation tied to training climate.

2fe437cf652b51925f6ba7b77b8707368585ed71.goal: Retrieves soil moisture from active microwave satellite data, where physical backscatter models are complex and poorly constrained.
2fe437cf652b51925f6ba7b77b8707368585ed71.architecture: Non-parametric methods: neural networks and fuzzy logic models, with land cover, NDVI and soil characteristics as additional inputs.
2fe437cf652b51925f6ba7b77b8707368585ed71.data: Active microwave backscatter data with NDVI and soil characteristics; evaluation against ESTAR soil moisture and field measurements.
2fe437cf652b51925f6ba7b77b8707368585ed71.result: Adding soil characteristics and NDVI reduces retrieval RMSE by about 30%; RMSE about 4.0% vs ESTAR and 6.5% vs field measurements; vegetated areas less accurate.
2fe437cf652b51925f6ba7b77b8707368585ed71.open_work: Improve retrievals over dense vegetation and test with other sensors and regions.
2fe437cf652b51925f6ba7b77b8707368585ed71.issues: Lower accuracy over vegetated areas; limited study area and period.

80e929fad44203293b60cd9d5d0e48206db99606.goal: Forecasts wind speed for wind energy while estimating forecast error.
80e929fad44203293b60cd9d5d0e48206db99606.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression with a forecasting error estimation scheme.
80e929fad44203293b60cd9d5d0e48206db99606.data: Wind speed time series; site and period not reported here.
80e929fad44203293b60cd9d5d0e48206db99606.result: The SVM gives accurate wind speed forecasts with error estimates; numbers not reported here.
80e929fad44203293b60cd9d5d0e48206db99606.open_work: Extend to multistep forecasts and NWP inputs.
80e929fad44203293b60cd9d5d0e48206db99606.issues: Abstract unavailable; single site; short evaluation.

117b608fff62548770cdaabc4427cc895ecbca17.goal: Extracts patterns of upper-layer circulation variability in the South China Sea.
117b608fff62548770cdaabc4427cc895ecbca17.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) neural network analysis of sea surface height anomaly fields.
117b608fff62548770cdaabc4427cc895ecbca17.data: Satellite altimetry sea surface height anomalies of the South China Sea; period not reported here.
117b608fff62548770cdaabc4427cc895ecbca17.result: The SOM identifies characteristic circulation patterns dominated by monsoon-related seasonal variability; details not reported here.
117b608fff62548770cdaabc4427cc895ecbca17.open_work: Link patterns to wind forcing and interannual variability.
117b608fff62548770cdaabc4427cc895ecbca17.issues: Abstract unavailable; diagnostic study; altimetry coastal limitations.

0f2c5231fa0d65c7466f2622d0faae9c7517d81c.goal: Quantifies model structure uncertainty in hydrologic prediction to improve reliability.
0f2c5231fa0d65c7466f2622d0faae9c7517d81c.architecture: Ensemble-based genetic programming framework producing multiple model structures.
0f2c5231fa0d65c7466f2622d0faae9c7517d81c.data: Hydrologic observations from a case study; details not reported here.
0f2c5231fa0d65c7466f2622d0faae9c7517d81c.result: The ensemble genetic programming framework quantifies structural uncertainty and provides prediction intervals; numbers not reported here.
0f2c5231fa0d65c7466f2622d0faae9c7517d81c.open_work: Combine structural with parameter and input uncertainty.
0f2c5231fa0d65c7466f2622d0faae9c7517d81c.issues: Abstract unavailable; computational cost; case-study specific.

e290952f7e084d267ca3618a93143fc2af8fd3c2.goal: Estimates daily solar UV radiation from global broadband radiation, which is more widely measured.
e290952f7e084d267ca3618a93143fc2af8fd3c2.architecture: Statistical model based on clearness indices and relative optical air mass compared with an artificial neural network using automatic relevance determination for input selection.
e290952f7e084d267ca3618a93143fc2af8fd3c2.data: Measurements at Almeria, Spain for development; independent testing at Table Mountain, Golden, Colorado, USA.
e290952f7e084d267ca3618a93143fc2af8fd3c2.result: The statistical model performs adequately at both sites (RMSE 4.6% on snow-free Golden days); the ANN is best at its training site but degrades at Golden with snow days (RMSE 6.5%).
e290952f7e084d267ca3618a93143fc2af8fd3c2.open_work: Train neural networks on broader climatic conditions including snow cover.
e290952f7e084d267ca3618a93143fc2af8fd3c2.issues: The ANN does not extrapolate beyond the input ranges seen in training; only two sites.

2645ed6eb12233621aa7379965e4bb69d64a08b4.goal: Forecasts low flows of rivers to support water management during dry periods.
2645ed6eb12233621aa7379965e4bb69d64a08b4.architecture: M5 model trees (piecewise linear regression trees).
2645ed6eb12233621aa7379965e4bb69d64a08b4.data: Discharge and precipitation records from Slovenian rivers; details not reported here.
2645ed6eb12233621aa7379965e4bb69d64a08b4.result: The M5 model trees provide accurate low-flow forecasts with interpretable models; numbers not reported here.
2645ed6eb12233621aa7379965e4bb69d64a08b4.open_work: Extend lead times and compare with neural networks.
2645ed6eb12233621aa7379965e4bb69d64a08b4.issues: Abstract unavailable; regional application; limited extremes.

1c4261151c4938b94c91de83f18ec313a5e5a62f.goal: Quantifies relationships between Arctic longwave cloud forcing and cloud parameters from observations.
1c4261151c4938b94c91de83f18ec313a5e5a62f.architecture: Neural network (MLP) trained on observations, with sensitivity analysis of network derivatives to infer nonlinear dependencies.
1c4261151c4938b94c91de83f18ec313a5e5a62f.data: SHEBA surface observations in the Arctic Ocean; period not reported here.
1c4261151c4938b94c91de83f18ec313a5e5a62f.result: The neural network reveals nonlinear dependencies of longwave cloud forcing on cloud parameters; details not reported here.
1c4261151c4938b94c91de83f18ec313a5e5a62f.open_work: Use relations to evaluate climate model cloud parameterizations.
1c4261151c4938b94c91de83f18ec313a5e5a62f.issues: Abstract unavailable; single campaign; sensitivities depend on training distribution.

d2763dfc51e1116af6c2ecb10273f3b01846f3ca.goal: Investigates the vertical structure of Northern Hemisphere extratropical wintertime climate regimes.
d2763dfc51e1116af6c2ecb10273f3b01846f3ca.architecture: Nonlinear principal component analysis (NLPCA) implemented with an autoassociative neural network.
d2763dfc51e1116af6c2ecb10273f3b01846f3ca.data: Gridded wintertime atmospheric fields at multiple levels; dataset not reported here.
d2763dfc51e1116af6c2ecb10273f3b01846f3ca.result: The analysis identifies regime structures with characteristic vertical profiles; details not reported here.
d2763dfc51e1116af6c2ecb10273f3b01846f3ca.open_work: Relate regimes to dynamics and model biases.
d2763dfc51e1116af6c2ecb10273f3b01846f3ca.issues: Abstract unavailable; NLPCA sensitive to overfitting.

189a807cfe01bc80848cae3fc1ac8552a549e56e.goal: Retrieves total suspended matter concentration in coastal waters from multispectral satellite data.
189a807cfe01bc80848cae3fc1ac8552a549e56e.architecture: Multiple regression compared with artificial neural networks (feed-forward MLP).
189a807cfe01bc80848cae3fc1ac8552a549e56e.data: Multispectral satellite imagery and in situ TSM samples in coastal waters; sensor not reported here.
189a807cfe01bc80848cae3fc1ac8552a549e56e.result: The ANN outperforms multiple regression for TSM retrieval; numbers not reported here.
189a807cfe01bc80848cae3fc1ac8552a549e56e.open_work: Extend to other sensors and coastal areas.
189a807cfe01bc80848cae3fc1ac8552a549e56e.issues: Abstract unavailable; few in situ samples.

fa9bdd4f5af8d1e5718f8a941dec6ffc3aa4265b.goal: Characterizes the nonlinear, asymmetric Northern Hemisphere winter atmospheric response to ENSO, which linear methods such as CCA or composites cannot fully capture.
fa9bdd4f5af8d1e5718f8a941dec6ffc3aa4265b.architecture: Neural-network-based nonlinear canonical correlation analysis (NLCCA) relating tropical Pacific SST anomalies to extratropical winter circulation anomalies.
fa9bdd4f5af8d1e5718f8a941dec6ffc3aa4265b.data: Tropical Pacific SST and Northern Hemisphere winter 500 hPa geopotential height anomalies from the NCEP/NCAR reanalysis over recent decades.
fa9bdd4f5af8d1e5718f8a941dec6ffc3aa4265b.result: The extratropical response is clearly nonlinear: the El Niño and La Niña patterns are not mirror images, with the warm-event response displaced eastward relative to the cold-event response.
fa9bdd4f5af8d1e5718f8a941dec6ffc3aa4265b.open_work: Extending the nonlinear analysis to other fields, seasons and coupled model output, and attributing the nonlinearity to physical mechanisms.
fa9bdd4f5af8d1e5718f8a941dec6ffc3aa4265b.issues: Few strong ENSO events in the record limit the robustness of nonlinear modes; NLCCA can overfit and its results depend on network settings and ensemble selection.

cd3fc69e10d43a2155d3e91e64aa05236be4e325.goal: Compares linear and nonlinear statistical downscaling of regional model output to improve daily rainfall forecasts over southeastern Brazil.
cd3fc69e10d43a2155d3e91e64aa05236be4e325.architecture: Feedforward multilayer perceptron neural network compared with multiple linear regression, both downscaling NWP predictors to station rainfall.
cd3fc69e10d43a2155d3e91e64aa05236be4e325.data: Output from the regional Eta model and rain-gauge observations over southeastern Brazil (São Paulo region).
cd3fc69e10d43a2155d3e91e64aa05236be4e325.result: The neural network downscaling generally outperforms multiple linear regression and the raw Eta model rainfall, especially in the summer rainy season.
cd3fc69e10d43a2155d3e91e64aa05236be4e325.open_work: Testing longer periods, more regions and probabilistic or extreme-rainfall forecasts.
cd3fc69e10d43a2155d3e91e64aa05236be4e325.issues: Short training periods and a single regional model; skill for heavy rainfall events and seasonal dependence are not fully characterized.

a60b50479ad4c5c9c4bf912459a280abbfb06f23.goal: Asks whether nonlinear statistical downscaling methods improve on linear regression for daily temperature at European stations.
a60b50479ad4c5c9c4bf912459a280abbfb06f23.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural networks compared with linear regression for downscaling large-scale circulation and temperature predictors to station temperature.
a60b50479ad4c5c9c4bf912459a280abbfb06f23.data: Large-scale predictors from reanalysis (e.g., 500 hPa heights and 850 hPa temperature) and daily temperature series from European stations.
a60b50479ad4c5c9c4bf912459a280abbfb06f23.result: Nonlinear neural network downscaling yields only small improvements over linear regression, mostly limited to certain seasons and stations; linear methods remain competitive.
a60b50479ad4c5c9c4bf912459a280abbfb06f23.open_work: Assessing nonlinearity for other variables such as precipitation, for extremes, and under climate-change conditions.
a60b50479ad4c5c9c4bf912459a280abbfb06f23.issues: Conclusions depend on the predictor set and network configuration; small gains may not justify added complexity, and stationarity under future climates is untested.

ac3f84c4016528ed55efeb3a5de6a88c1910f3ae.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff forecasting by integrating different hydrometeorological information sources as inputs to data-driven models.
ac3f84c4016528ed55efeb3a5de6a88c1910f3ae.architecture: Artificial neural network rainfall-runoff models fed with combined hydrometeorological inputs; the specific network type is not specified here.
ac3f84c4016528ed55efeb3a5de6a88c1910f3ae.data: Rainfall and streamflow records from a Taiwanese watershed; other details not reported in the available metadata.
ac3f84c4016528ed55efeb3a5de6a88c1910f3ae.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies that integrating hydrometeorological information improves ANN runoff forecasts.
ac3f84c4016528ed55efeb3a5de6a88c1910f3ae.open_work: Testing longer lead times, additional catchments and forecast rainfall inputs.
ac3f84c4016528ed55efeb3a5de6a88c1910f3ae.issues: Single-region application and black-box model; generalization to other basins and extreme typhoon floods is uncertain.

24efa3a07d257645de7205c2bc39f7b0b25b1f53.goal: Automates fixing the tropical cyclone eye centre, a routine task otherwise done subjectively by forecasters.
24efa3a07d257645de7205c2bc39f7b0b25b1f53.architecture: Genetic algorithm optimization that fits an eye template to imagery to locate the cyclone centre; not a neural network method.
24efa3a07d257645de7205c2bc39f7b0b25b1f53.data: Weather radar imagery of tropical cyclones near Hong Kong.
24efa3a07d257645de7205c2bc39f7b0b25b1f53.result: The genetic algorithm locates eye centres with accuracy comparable to manual best-track fixes for the tested cases.
24efa3a07d257645de7205c2bc39f7b0b25b1f53.open_work: Extending to satellite imagery, weak or poorly defined eyes, and operational real-time use.
24efa3a07d257645de7205c2bc39f7b0b25b1f53.issues: Performance degrades for cyclones without a clear eye; evaluation covers a limited number of cyclones.

29d135e1fba536d1b3715bf71b42ee03ebf3bd04.goal: Develops real-time ocean wave forecasts using artificial intelligence tools as an alternative to numerical wave models.
29d135e1fba536d1b3715bf71b42ee03ebf3bd04.architecture: Neural network based forecasting of wave heights from recent observations; other soft-computing tools are not specified here.
29d135e1fba536d1b3715bf71b42ee03ebf3bd04.data: Wave buoy observations; specific stations and periods not reported in the available metadata.
29d135e1fba536d1b3715bf71b42ee03ebf3bd04.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies AI tools give usable real-time wave forecasts.
29d135e1fba536d1b3715bf71b42ee03ebf3bd04.open_work: Longer lead times, more locations and coupling with numerical wave models.
29d135e1fba536d1b3715bf71b42ee03ebf3bd04.issues: Data-driven forecasts depend on buoy data continuity and degrade with lead time; physical consistency is not guaranteed.

b2afd1efef2a46f3ad82be7fd81054c7aecff1cb.goal: Forecasts basin-scale streamflow using information from large-scale atmospheric circulation phenomena to extend lead time.
b2afd1efef2a46f3ad82be7fd81054c7aecff1cb.architecture: Statistical/data-driven streamflow forecasting model using climate indices as predictors; the model type is not specified here.
b2afd1efef2a46f3ad82be7fd81054c7aecff1cb.data: Streamflow from an Indian river basin with large-scale circulation indices such as ENSO; other details not reported in the available metadata.
b2afd1efef2a46f3ad82be7fd81054c7aecff1cb.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies circulation information improves streamflow forecasts.
b2afd1efef2a46f3ad82be7fd81054c7aecff1cb.open_work: Testing other basins, additional climate indices and longer leads.
b2afd1efef2a46f3ad82be7fd81054c7aecff1cb.issues: Teleconnection relationships may be nonstationary; short records limit validation.

ea6ad1b443fbbfbdcf9c243401fe02df9781d0ec.goal: Reduces the dimensionality of GOME spectral measurements to make neural-network retrieval of ozone profiles efficient and accurate.
ea6ad1b443fbbfbdcf9c243401fe02df9781d0ec.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network inversion combined with pruning algorithms to select the most informative GOME spectral ranges, trained with radiative transfer simulations.
ea6ad1b443fbbfbdcf9c243401fe02df9781d0ec.data: Radiative transfer simulations of GOME (ERS-2) radiances; validation against other retrieval schemes and co-located lidar ozone profiles.
ea6ad1b443fbbfbdcf9c243401fe02df9781d0ec.result: The procedure identifies the spectral ranges most crucial for the inversion, and the reduced-input network retrieval performs well against other schemes and lidar profiles.
ea6ad1b443fbbfbdcf9c243401fe02df9781d0ec.open_work: Applying the approach to successor instruments such as SCIAMACHY or GOME-2 and adding error characterization.
ea6ad1b443fbbfbdcf9c243401fe02df9781d0ec.issues: Training on simulations may not capture instrument degradation and real-world biases; validation with a limited set of lidar collocations.

27b1a0afe558f883f1e1e5bf2242eb648fc85973.goal: Classifies sea ice types by combining multiple satellite sensors, since single sensors give ambiguous ice signatures.
27b1a0afe558f883f1e1e5bf2242eb648fc85973.architecture: Iterative statistical classification that updates class statistics from multisensor data; not a neural network method.
27b1a0afe558f883f1e1e5bf2242eb648fc85973.data: Spaceborne scatterometer and passive microwave radiometer data (e.g., NSCAT and SSM/I) over polar sea ice.
27b1a0afe558f883f1e1e5bf2242eb648fc85973.result: Multisensor iterative classification separates ice types (such as first-year and multiyear ice) more reliably than single-sensor approaches.
27b1a0afe558f883f1e1e5bf2242eb648fc85973.open_work: Extending to longer time series and more ice classes, and validating with independent ice charts.
27b1a0afe558f883f1e1e5bf2242eb648fc85973.issues: Limited ground truth; class definitions and seasonal changes (melt) complicate classification.

534a62aef1e3b564314e6487b5cacdf89968c703.goal: Reconstructs missing streamflow records, needed for water resources planning, using a hybrid fuzzy-neural approach.
534a62aef1e3b564314e6487b5cacdf89968c703.architecture: Counterpropagation fuzzy-neural network that combines fuzzy clustering with counterpropagation learning.
534a62aef1e3b564314e6487b5cacdf89968c703.data: Streamflow records from gauging stations in Taiwan; other details not reported in the available metadata.
534a62aef1e3b564314e6487b5cacdf89968c703.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies the network reconstructs streamflow with useful accuracy.
534a62aef1e3b564314e6487b5cacdf89968c703.open_work: Applying to other basins and comparing with conventional regression and backpropagation networks.
534a62aef1e3b564314e6487b5cacdf89968c703.issues: Reconstruction quality depends on correlated neighbouring stations; uncertainty is not quantified.

c1c6cafffaf8bdbe49c28fd35e62e9a304346d56.goal: Estimates mean wind speed and wind power at various heights across regions of Turkey for wind energy assessment.
c1c6cafffaf8bdbe49c28fd35e62e9a304346d56.architecture: Artificial neural network (backpropagation multilayer perceptron) mapping location and height variables to wind speed and power.
c1c6cafffaf8bdbe49c28fd35e62e9a304346d56.data: Wind measurements from meteorological stations in several regions of Turkey; other details not reported in the available metadata.
c1c6cafffaf8bdbe49c28fd35e62e9a304346d56.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies the network estimates average wind speed and power with acceptable accuracy.
c1c6cafffaf8bdbe49c28fd35e62e9a304346d56.open_work: Extending to more sites, temporal forecasting and turbine-specific power estimates.
c1c6cafffaf8bdbe49c28fd35e62e9a304346d56.issues: Limited station network; spatial generalization and measurement height extrapolation are uncertain.

6528756a81433f607d986f3fbb7cbbf1652d8392.goal: Predicts peak-period (February–May) mean monthly total ozone at Arosa, Switzerland, treating the ozone series as a complex nonlinear system.
6528756a81433f607d986f3fbb7cbbf1652d8392.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural networks with backpropagation learning, sigmoid activations, one and two hidden layers.
6528756a81433f607d986f3fbb7cbbf1652d8392.data: Mean monthly total ozone at Arosa, Switzerland, 1932–1971.
6528756a81433f607d986f3fbb7cbbf1652d8392.result: Both networks are skilful after training and validation, with the two-hidden-layer perceptron predicting monthly total ozone better.
6528756a81433f607d986f3fbb7cbbf1652d8392.open_work: Comparing with statistical time-series models and extending to recent data and other stations.
6528756a81433f607d986f3fbb7cbbf1652d8392.issues: Single station and old record; no comparison with standard autoregressive baselines or uncertainty estimates.

650912308fd23a1a57fec1da8dfc87e572532eab.goal: Forecasts monthly total ozone concentration using an autoregressive neurocomputing approach.
650912308fd23a1a57fec1da8dfc87e572532eab.architecture: Autoregressive neural network using lagged ozone values as inputs; detailed network configuration not reported here.
650912308fd23a1a57fec1da8dfc87e572532eab.data: Monthly total ozone time series; station and period not reported in the available metadata.
650912308fd23a1a57fec1da8dfc87e572532eab.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies the neural autoregressive model forecasts monthly ozone skilfully.
650912308fd23a1a57fec1da8dfc87e572532eab.open_work: Comparison with linear autoregressive models and inclusion of physical predictors.
650912308fd23a1a57fec1da8dfc87e572532eab.issues: Univariate approach ignores dynamical drivers; generalization beyond the studied series is unclear.

d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.goal: Compares linear and nonlinear transfer functions for reconstructing past summer temperatures from tree-ring chronologies.
d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.architecture: Artificial neural networks compared with multiple linear regression, linear scaling and a hybrid timescale-separated MLR model.
d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.data: Regional tree-ring chronology and instrumental temperatures from Lapland (northern Finland and Sweden), AD 1802–1998 instrumental, reconstruction AD 802–1801.
d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.result: MLR and ANN reconstruct reliably; linear scaling fails. MLR shows ~0.5 °C cooling from the Medieval Warm Period to the Little Ice Age, ANNs 0.2–0.5 °C.
d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.open_work: Applying ANNs to proxies and environments with more complex, noisier climate relationships.
d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.issues: Larger model disagreement outside the calibration period; ANNs give no clear benefit for this timberline dataset.

b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.goal: Nowcasts rainfall fields 30 min to 1 h ahead from geostationary satellite imagery for severe-weather warning.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.architecture: Neural network approach that extrapolates infrared radiance fields forward in time, followed by a calibrated microwave-based combined rainfall algorithm.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.data: Meteosat 7 infrared imagery with microwave-calibrated rain estimates; a rainfall event over Central Italy.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.result: The method produces short-term rainfall field forecasts whose accuracy is quantified by error indicators for the case study.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.open_work: Testing on more events and comparing with radar-based and optical-flow nowcasting.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.issues: Single case-study evaluation; IR-based rain retrieval is indirect and errors accumulate with lead time.

80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.goal: Supports pump operation in an urban flood control system by predicting water levels in a detention pond.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.architecture: Counterpropagation fuzzy-neural network trained on past operation records.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.data: Rainfall, water level and pump operation records from the Yu-Cheng pumping station in Taipei City, Taiwan.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.result: The network reproduces flood-control operation and predicts pond water levels accurately enough to aid operators.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.open_work: Extending to multi-step forecasts and real-time optimization of pump schedules.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.issues: Trained on limited historical typhoon/storm events; extreme events beyond the training range are uncertain.

86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.goal: Builds virtual sensors that estimate missing or unavailable spectral bands of remote sensing instruments from other measured bands.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.architecture: Data-mining regression methods learning mappings between spectral bands; the specific learners are not detailed here.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.data: Multispectral satellite observations such as MODIS reflectances over snow and ice; other details not reported in the available metadata.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies accurate and efficient estimation of spectra from other channels.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.open_work: Applying virtual sensors to other instruments and quantifying uncertainty in estimated channels.

4434ba1ea6b0ec82ae97269db16e165f25f4ee6e.open_work: Physical explanation of the quadratic response and use of nonlinear teleconnections in seasonal forecasting.
